reviews.author: Dilbert1961
reviews.title: Una profunda decepción
reviews.text: Hace un año escribí una reseña en la que indiqué que probablemente éste era el mejor hotel de Punta Cana. Ha sido una gran decepción volver y constatar cómo ha descendido la calidad de la experiencia. Me alojé en la zona de The Reserve y comprendo que no se puede pretender que el hotel coloque toallas nuevas cada semana, pero de allí a colocar toallas raídas y manchadas hay un trecho. Desde hace muchos años viajo una vez al año a República Dominicana y es la primera vez que he tenido que “liquidar” una cucaracha en mi habitación. Duchas de la playa que no funcionan, descenso en la calidad y variedad de los alimentos del buffet (aunque hay que reconocer que la calidad de los restaurantes temáticos de las cenas se mantiene) completan el cuadro. Si esto no se convirtió en una experiencia estándar como la de cualquier otro resort todo incluido de la zona, es gracias al equipo humano: Harry como concierge, Pedro y Rafael en la zona de playa, Barnelis, Franklin, Kelvin, Noralejandro y Santos en la zona de restaurantes, con su calidez y profesionalidad hicieron que al final la experiencia fuese “menos negativa”, pero la decepción persiste.

reviews.author: tamara8822026
reviews.title: Overall experience not great
reviews.text: Customer service was poor. Some staff members weren't hospitable. Our rooms weren't cleaned one night & the other nights they came LATE. The hotel room inside door lock didn't work as well as our refrigerator didn't work the duration of our stay. Definitely not a place i'd rush to visit again.

reviews.author: Dreaminggiant
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay for a Special Occasion
reviews.text:
We came to celebrate my father’s 80th birthday and unfortunately left feeling let down at nearly every turn.

The resort credit coupons included with our package are misleading — you can’t actually use them without spending significantly more, which is never disclosed at booking. When we tried to apply them at the Italian restaurant, staff couldn’t process them on the spot. A team member named Jonathan promised to have the credits applied to our room the next morning. They weren’t, and we spent 20 minutes at the front desk being questioned about it before anyone helped us.

The wristband tiering system creates a very transactional, unwelcoming atmosphere, and the constant emphasis on tipping added to the stress of what was supposed to be a relaxing family celebration.

The in-room phones didn’t work at all, meaning every request required a trip to the lobby.

Most disappointing of all — despite making it known this was a milestone birthday, nothing was done to acknowledge my father’s 80th. Not even a small gesture.

We’re unlikely to return to a Meliá property. I hope management takes this feedback seriously.

reviews.author: El R
reviews.title: Good hotel, service neess improvment
reviews.text: Needs improvment in the service department. Also the rooms are starting to show lack of maintenance.

reviews.author: MR Queen
reviews.title: SW16 Celebration
reviews.text:
Consider getting room confirmation before arrivals. 
Buffet dinner layout in the open. These items are fully exposed to flies, mosquitoes, sand, and other contaminants, creating a clear and serious food safety and hygiene risk

reviews.author: gotchapaper
reviews.title: Hospitality was not there
reviews.text: There were no one around to help out to help you out with you’re problems it took the day before I left the hotel to get it fixed I was there 5 nights

reviews.author: MDVal
reviews.title: Buena experiencia sin cubrir expectativas
reviews.text:
La experiencia ha sido buena pero con algunas incidencias.
Como muy positiva mi experiencia con el servicio del bar en la zona The Reserve y en especial con Antonia que se ha preocupado de que estuviera bien durante toda mi estancia.
La experiencia del spa también positiva y con el personal muy amable.
Respecto a la habitación reporté varias incidencias porque la caja fuerte funcionaba muy mal, la tapa del inodoro estaba floja, la ducha estaba suelta  y la luz se iba y volvía frecuentemente, pero nadie solucionó nada durante mi estancia.
Los restaurantes están bien aunque la comida es más cantidad que calidad. 
En resumen buena experiencia pero esperaba más por el precio de cada noche en el hotel.

reviews.author: dholakiahimangi
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Rooms were good but sanitary were ill fitted pillows were stained jacuzzi was not properly cleaned it had green algae

reviews.author: Agustín
reviews.title: Vacacioners familiares
reviews.text:
El hotel como tal, es muy bueno y las instalaciones son muy buenas e impactantes. La habitación que nos tocó fue muy cómoda y amplia, se podría mejorar el colchón de la cama. 
Con respecto a puntos a mejorar, el edificio cuenta con solo un ascensor y ubicado en un extremo de  las instalaciones, nosotros al estar en el 3er piso y con un carrito de bebe se complicaba a veces el tránsito, por lo que debíamos caminar varios metros para subir y bajar a nuestra habitación. 
Sería bueno también, que el hotel cuente con algún lugar para calentar la mamadera del bebe, que disponga de frutas a toda hora y otros elementos para brindar a los padres mayor comodidad para la asistencia del bebe. 
Un punto negativo, fue las bebidas en las barras del hotel, la calidad de las mismas era muy baja y la atención del personal en estos lugares no fue muy buena. 
Otro punto negativo, es que dentro de las instalaciones existen varios hoteles de la misma cadena hotelera, que están prácticamente conectados. El problema es que no te dejan utilizar nada de dichas instalaciones y a veces es hasta confuso porque no está delimitado y uno por comodidad se dirige a una de las barras y no te quieren atender. Lo mismo con la comida. Al ser las instalaciones de la misma cadena hotelera, sería recomendable que se pudieran utilizar las instalaciones en conjunto y es mejora ya que permitiría a los huéspedes poder conocer las otras instalaciones como para comparar y si son buenas volver a ir a estas en próximos viajes. En otras cadenas  hoteleras, eso es fomentado para que los pasajeros puedan conocer las instalaciones y venderle los servicios que ofrece cada una para un futuro viaje a realizar. Es más, solicité al gerente del hotel si podía ir a conocer otros hoteles de la cadena y me comentó que no se podía ya que era manejado por otra Gerencia.
Se veían conflictos internos entre el personal. y en algunos casos el personal de las Barras o camareros faltaban el respeto a los huéspedes por detrás

reviews.author: 39direccion
reviews.title: NORMAL
reviews.text: hay cosas que mejorar , sobre todo en el tema servicios , espero volver en otro momento y que todo esto haya mejorado , gracias

reviews.author: Departure758213
reviews.title: Beautiful and frustrating at the same time
reviews.text: Beautiful resort and good service. Food was fair. Trip started off with a negative first impression. We were traveling with another couple and they downgraded our rooms two days before travel. When we arrived only one of us had the reserve room. It took 3 different check ins locations and 2 hours to get both rooms downgraded so we could use the same amenities. We learned another couple also got downgraded with no notice. There was no effort to make it right with us other than blaming it on the person that took our reservation. The pool is beautiful but needs some maintenance. One of us cut our foot pretty good on a step where tile are missing.  The lifeguard bandaged it up but that was it. No follow up. The resort and location are beautiful as I mentioned. I wouldn’t say I would never go there again. The rooms were spacious and nice. If I went again I would go with my eyes wide open to not expect the same as other experiences with all-inclusives I have been at.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Diana F
reviews.title: No volveré a Punta Cana
reviews.text: El hotel  y las instalaciones son fantásticas, la comida no tiene el  mismo nivel,  y la atención regular...

reviews.author: FrequentFlier226133
reviews.title: Poor staff and lack of food quality.
reviews.text: The staff was not very courteous and only provided good service when bribed. The quality of the food was not good. We made a reservation at an oriental restaurant where it took more than 30 minutes for the waiter to attend to us, and at a steak restaurant the meat was tough, and the wine we chose took a long time to arrive and was served at room temperature.

reviews.author: momwadvm
reviews.title: Nice hotel but don't reserve the Kanna Beach Club or Bali Bed Experience!
reviews.text:
The hotel is lovely, the beach was great. Food was good but make sure to make reservations as far ahead of time as possible for availability. There were fun daytime activities (yoga, pilates, dancing, hat making, Dominican doll painting, etc). Nighttime entertainment was mediocre (mostly music and dance shows- one night had a circus-like performance)- seating is not great for watching the shows and quality of the performances were just ok.
The biggest negative I had is that I paid for the Kana Beach Club Experience, that was supposed to include reserved Bali Beds and food and beverage service. However, no one at the hotel was ever able to help me use this service I paid for. There was never anyone at the kiosk where they told me to check in for the service and find out what day I could use the service (apparently I wouldn't get to choose for myself). I spoke with the concierge and the front desk a few times during my stay and was not able to make any progress in using this service. Everyone was very kind and seemed like they wanted to help, but never did actually help.
In the end, it was not a big deal and I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. But I would like a refund of the money I spent on a service I did not receive. I was told by the concierge and again at check-out that I would be refunded but have not heard back. 
Pro-tip: Bring an insulated water bottle!!! You can get it filled with ice once or twice a day and keep cold water on hand all day.

reviews.author: Elías F
reviews.title: Gran Lugar, entorno y decoración pero servicio básico y mejorable
reviews.text: El sitio es espectacular, y las instalaciones muy bonitas pero la experiencia es inferior a otros similares de la cadena (Meliá Paradisus), motivado por un servicio reactivo y mejorable, y a un nivel gastronómico que no está a la altura (salvo excepciones como Santé).

reviews.author: billy jo L
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, room service such as cleaning and new towels poor, no hot water last day.
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, amazing food.   Only things that wasn't great was our room servicing and cold showers the last day.   We made request for clean towels and room to be made up, and we didn't get any new towels until the night before we left.  We turned our light for "please make up room" on multiple times, and it never was.   Despite these things, we did love the resort otherwise.

reviews.author: Clare T
reviews.title: Breakfast English Tea ..!
reviews.text:
We are an easy going couple with average expectations, however we were a little disappointed with our stay, arrived after a 9 hr flight, went to our room, all we waned was a cup of tea, there were a couple of tea bags, 2 expresso cups, that only hold an egg cup full, there was a kettle which we weren't expecting, we did bring our own as this is our second  time to Dominican, there was no milk. Everyday we had to get a plastic water bottle and fill up with milk from Breakfast and smuggle 2 mugs out, then once in room, washed the mugs up and hide way so the cleaner didn't take them ..!
There was a Wedding party that stayed for a week, it got rather rowdy and noisy at the swim up bar and a couple of females were rather over familiar with staff, i felt embarrassed for the staff, the were there to do  a job. 
There was not the selection of food as in previous hotels at Dominican. the hotel was very clean and staff were always cleaning floors/ glass
Being British, i  just found it hard work to get a cup of tea/coffee in the room, i took our own tea and coffee, travel kettle and tea spoon, will take mugs next time

On the whole it was an OK experience, there are better hotels available that make you more welcome. The staff's English was not that great either, bearing in mind that they cater for the American and Canadian Market

reviews.author: Romuald_Sh
reviews.title: В целом так себе, ADULTS ONLY в отеле нет
reviews.text:
Добрый день! Пишу пока свежи впечатления! 

1. Видели бы вы общественные туалеты в зоне бассейнов и пляжей! Это уровень ЖД вокзала в Индии, а не 5* отеля в Доминикане. Видимо руководство отеля считает, что нормально просто окунуться в бассейн и помочится в него!
2. В основном ресторане нет смены питания ни на завтрак, ни на обед, ни на ужин, 7 дней в неделю, 3 раза в день одно и то же. Ресторанов а-ла-карте много, но радости по кухне никакой от них нет. Диетического стола тоже нет. 
3. Также один из самых неприятных моментов в том, что в отеле на пляже как бы есть зона "только для взрослых", есть при этом  специальная намного бо́льшая зона для семей с детьми, но по факту пляж для взрослых заполнен безумными детьми и не менее безумными родителями. Персоналу просто наплевать на это, я был вынужден ругаться, но простите, в конкретно  ЭТОМ отеле это настолько массовое явление, что выяснение с наглыми гостями подобно борьбе с ветряными мельницами. Визжащие, свистящие, орущие дети на пляже для взрослых по уровню шума напоминают новогоднюю ночь! И в этом отеле это  есть явление массовое. Отель ограничился лишь информацией на бумажном концерте про зоны только для взрослых. Повторюсь, персоналу плевать, ноль реакции на происходящее.

  Внешне отель очень красивый, персонал food and beverage в целом хороший. Но отель далеко не люкс. Когда-то это был самый лучший, люксовый отель курорта, общее его состояние внешне, на первый взгляд, неплохое и сейчас (минус общественные туалеты, возмущен настолько, что внутри до сих пор все клокочет), но поверьте, сейчас здесь много мелочей, которые расстраивают общее впечатление от отдыха.  По своей сути теперь это отель более низкого уровня, чем это было до пандемии!

reviews.title: Disappointed for the price paid!
reviews.text:

Spent extra to be in the Reserve area but found the concierge amenity to be more of a challenge than a luxury.

reviews.author: Trisha P
reviews.title: Glows and Grows
reviews.text:
Glows- The grounds are beautiful. The beach is well maintained too. The adult only pool and 90 Degree swim up bar was a favorite. The lobby bar, Ginger, was also good. We had a variety of mixed drinks at these bars that were quite good, unlike at some of the others. We enjoyed Blue Agave Mexican and the Hibachi restaurant. We also got room service which was good. The Junior Garden Suite was fine.  We did not need to upgrade to The Reserve.  Adult pool was relaxing. Plenty of chairs. Pool bar was great. 

Grows- Very disappointed in the buffet.  The hot food was cold. We gave this multiple tries, but same results. The only food that was hot was the toast and made to order eggs. Some of the food tasted stale like French toast, pancakes, desserts and tortilla chips. The buffet is a nice space but providing hot food is a must. Our room’s mini fridge was not working. They replaced it and it still did not get cold. We gave up. Housekeeping came at 5:00 which seemed late.

reviews.author: jpstouch
reviews.title: Tres bel hôtel mais pour couple
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné en famille au Paradisus Palma Real et notre expérience est globalement mitigée (3/5).

Commençons par les points positifs. Les chambres sont propres et bien entretenues, le ménage est fait avec soin et les installations de l’hôtel sont globalement très propres. L’emplacement est excellent, directement sur une très belle plage. Nous avons aussi beaucoup apprécié les bars, l’animation autour de la piscine et l’ambiance générale du resort.

La restauration est également un point fort : le buffet est varié et de bonne qualité, les restaurants à la carte (inclus) sont très bons et le service est globalement attentionné.

Nous avons aussi beaucoup apprécié le golf Cocotal, situé juste à côté de l’hôtel, qui est très agréable à jouer.

Cependant, plusieurs points nous ont déçus. Une grande partie des espaces de piscine et même certaines zones de plage sont réservées soit aux couples sans enfants, soit aux membres du programme Circle. Cela limite fortement les zones accessibles pour les familles et donne parfois l’impression d’un hôtel à deux vitesses.

Lors de la présentation des zones réservées aux familles, on nous a même indiqué qu’il n’y avait pas de zone avec transats sur la plage pour cette catégorie de clients. Finalement, en allant directement sur la plage, nous avons constaté qu’il était possible de s’y installer, ce qui rend la communication sur ce point assez confuse.

Le principal problème a concerné l’organisation de nos chambres. Nous voyagions avec deux adolescents et avions demandé deux chambres côte à côte dès le mois d’août. J’ai envoyé trois e-mails pour confirmer cette demande et on m’a assuré à chaque fois que ce serait fait. À notre arrivée, ce n’était pas le cas : nos chambres étaient séparées par deux autres chambres, ce qui n’est pas très pratique avec des adolescents.
Malgré nos demandes, l’hôtel n’a pas pu résoudre la situation, alors que l’établissement ne semblait pas complet. La seule solution proposée a été un surclassement payant vers d’autres chambres, ce que nous avons trouvé assez peu commercial.

Enfin, nous avons trouvé la sollicitation commerciale assez insistante. À la piscine, on nous invite régulièrement à participer à des présentations pour devenir membre « Circle ». Nous avons accepté un rendez-vous qui a duré plus d’une heure, ce qui nous a semblé un peu excessif pendant des vacances.

En résumé, le Paradisus Palma Real reste un bel hôtel avec un très bon emplacement, une restauration de qualité et des installations bien entretenues. Cependant, l’organisation des chambres, la segmentation de nombreux espaces et la pression commerciale ont un peu gâché notre expérience.
Nous avons le sentiment que cet hôtel est surtout adapté aux couples avec un budget confortable ou aux clients séjournant dans les sections premium comme The Reserve ou membres Circle. Pour une famille avec adolescents, ce ne serait probablement pas notre premier choix.

reviews.author: 936amandae
reviews.title: Beautiful Property, but Limited Accessibility for Families
reviews.text:
Our family of seven (5 adults, 2 children) recently stayed here. While the resort is physically beautiful and clean, we likely won't return due to the restrictive dining and service structure. We found that many areas and restaurants were reserved exclusively for "Elite" members or adults, which wasn't clearly communicated on the website. Having stayed at a high-end resort in Mexico this past January where amenities and food were abundant and accessible, this experience felt noticeably lacking in comparison.

The Highlights:

Concierge Service: Our concierge, Andres, was a standout. Having him assigned to us to handle dinner reservations was a fantastic, unexpected perk.

Cabana Service: The cabana servers were attentive and it was nice to have a guaranteed front-row seat at the beach. 

Accommodations: The updated Swim-Up Master Suite was spacious, clean, and perfect for our family. The private bar hut for the swim-up pool was a great touch.

The Grounds: The resort is gorgeous and the beach is beautiful. While the water was a bit murky during our stay, I suspect it was a weather-related fluke.

The Downside:

Food & Drink Access: There is a significant lack of "quick bite" options. With only one buffet open for breakfast and lunch, and no easy way to grab food for the beach, we felt limited. We were even turned away from a beach grill at the sister property.

Beach Service: Drink service on the beach was nearly non-existent. We rarely saw servers and had to flag people down ourselves, which eventually led us to pay for cabanas just to receive attentive service.

Family Suitability: The family beach area is quite small, and there isn't a proper pool for children beyond a tiny wading pool.

Facilities: The bathrooms near the main pool were consistently clogged throughout our stay.

Inauthentic Interactions: While most staff were nice, the service on our final day felt disingenuous. The servers at the buffet became overly affectionate (hugs and warm greetings) only to request our room number and email addresses for reviews.

reviews.author: AGG488
reviews.title: Close to being a 4 star resort, but too inconsistent to earn that rating.
reviews.text:
Review of Paradisus Palma Real

Stayed for 7 nights/8 days in mid February.  We were in a reserve swim-up Jr. Suite in the adults-only section of the property.  Overall, the vacation was fine, but value for price wasn’t quite up to the level of other all-inclusive resorts we’ve stayed at.   Inconsistent service and mediocre food really weighed down the rating.

The hotel and room:
The hotel grounds are stunning—part of a 5 resort compound with 4 other Melia properties, a tennis center and a few other related buildings (the family fun-zone, casino, etc).  Everything was lush, green and well maintained.  The Palma Real is a neo-classical architecture—lots of columns and open atriums everywhere.  So many flowers everywhere and giant, clean pools at every turn.  The beach is immaculate—between the sargassum net and daily grooming, the beach was a high point.  Also, lots and lots of chairs, pool beds and beach beds/palapas meant never having to search for somewhere to relax in either sun or shade.  The ocean in front of the resort is sandy bottomed and beautiful.  One of the best things about the compound was miles of walking trails for morning walks.  You could walk among all of the properties and explore.  We ever saw peacocks on one of the resort grounds. 
The room we stayed in was nice—spacious, clean, well appointed and made up every day.  A mini-bar and snacks replenished often, and warm to hot water in the shower and bath.  The doors are opened using an rfid bracelet that is also your resort bracelet, so no need to ever carry a key card.  

The food and beverages:
Food was probably a low-point at this resort, and was mediocre at best.  Not a ton of variety, and high-volume cruise-ship flavors.  The best restaurant for us was Blue Agave, the Mexican restaurant.  The worst was the Italian restaurant.  One of the main bummers was that for breakfast and lunch, the only options were buffets or the sports bar (which was not very good).  Luckily, on the reserve site, the buffet also had ala-carte for breakfast and lunch, which helped a little bit.   The Dominican restaurant was okay, a few dishes were good, a few were objectively bland and tasteless.  The hibachi wasn’t really hibachi—it was just loud stir-frying on a blackstone.  No onion volcano or egg spinning here. 
The drinks were good—top-shelf liquor was available at most places if you asked for it.  Highlights were the espresso martinis with freshly made espresso at the Ginger lobby bar and the pina coladas—which seem to be made from fresh pineapple.  Better than at other resorts we’ve stayed at.   

Entertainment/excursions:
The main lobby entertainment at night was not great.  It felt low-production value and repetitive.  The highlight was the 60s/70s/80s show.  If you’ve gone to Mexican all-inclusives with cirque-de-soliel type entertainment, this will leave you wanting.  
One cool thing about being on the reserve side was an included activity where they take you on a catamaran to a fairly secluded beach to do yoga, and then stop at a swimming hole for cocktails and loud music.  We wish our concierge would have told us about the second part of that so we would have brought swim suits.
We golfed at the affiliated Cocotal golf course.  Nice course in good shape, decent rental clubs.  We had a speedy round—3.25 hours and never had to wait on a tee box.   It was one of the highlights of the trip—and not just because we both played well!

Service:
OK, this is going to sound whiny, but the service at Paradisus Palma Real was very, very inconsistent and took what could have been a 4.5 star resort down to a 3.5 star rating for us.  The concierge, while friendly, often missed stuff and made a few things a little bit awkward.  The drink service folks at the bars, beach and poolside didn’t seem interested, even when we were tipping a few bucks on every drink.  We found maybe 1-2 staff who seemed generally interested in being friendly and helpful, otherwise it was very transactional and even a little bit grumpy.   It wasn’t for lack of our trying and for sure not for our lack of tipping for service (which we noticed many folks didn’t tip at all).  I’m wondering if there’s some (maybe well deserved???) anti-American sentiment at play.  
We did notice that this resort had many, many more Europeans than other resorts we’ve visited in the Caribbean.  Maybe because Melia is a Spanish-owned company.   It definitely was more of a European service and timeliness vibe to the resort.  If you are hustle-bustle Americans, that could be frustrating.
Summary:
We wouldn’t go back to Paradisus Palma Real at the price point we paid for it.  It is very close to being a really good resort, but the food and service were not up to a 4.5 star rating.

reviews.author: fsc0rza
reviews.title: No volvería
reviews.text: Estructura que tiene muchos años, muy linda y bien mantenida, el trato del personal es excelente y la gastronomía muy buena, pero las habitaciones son viejas, armarios que no cierran las puertas, pérdida de agua en el baño y la limpieza muy deficiente. Los ruidos y las música fuerte en el hotel comienza 6.30 am y termina a media noche, difícil para descansar.

reviews.author: BeneditaC789
reviews.title: Esperava mais
reviews.text:
Primeiro pontos positivos:
- fica mesmo na praia, que tem pouco ou nenhum sargaço e areia limpa
- exteriores cuidados e com segurança 
- comida razoável - não é a melhor que já comi  em resorts mas também não é a pior

Pontos negativos: 
- fui com os meus filhos. Na praia de areia ou você pertence ao The Circle (que é o time share do Melia) ou não tem espreguiçadeiras onde possa passar o dia com eles. Pode ir à praia mas ou aluga cama balinesa ou não tem onde ficar. Só mesmo nas piscinas com crianças.
- existe uma clara separação para quem pertence ao The Circle: zonas que você não pode frequentar na praia, 2 restaurantes e nos restaurantes temáticos, comidas que não pode pedir. O Paradisus é um resort de luxo, isto não faz qualquer sentido
- os empregados são pouco simpáticos, a menos que você lhes dê gratificação, e mesmo assim, às vezes você quer dar mas o serviço é tão mau que está fora de questão dar
- fizemos check-out às 12h, mas só tínhamos transfer às 17h. Têm quarto de cortesia para poder tomar banho mas é super pequeno e formou-se logo uma fila porque éramos 5, com outros hóspedes a reclamar do tempo que demoramos
- o serviço é pouco eficiente: tivemos um problema com o Ar condicionado e tivemos de reclamar via telefone, e-mail e na receção e só ao fim de 2 dias é que finalmente resolveram
- havia dias em que a camareira não ponha toalhas de mãos, ou tapete de duche ou toalhas suficientes. O mesmo com o servico de quartos em que tínhamos de ligar a pedir água e mesmo assim não traziam. 
- à refeição demoravam imenso a recolher os pratos e trazer bebidas. 

Resumindo: para um hotel que alega ser de luxo, deixa muito a desejar. Se for com família, é melhor procurar outra opção.

reviews.author: Christy C
reviews.title: Inconsistent - Beautiful property - food and service disappointing
reviews.text: Just returned from the Paradisus Palm Real Golf and Spa resort.  This was our first time to the Dominican; we usually travel to Mexico.  I will start with the positives.  The beach is beautiful, wide, white soft sand.  The resort itself and the rooms were felt really clean.  We had a swim out in the Reserve section, which was nice.  The cabanas on the beach provide the perfect amount of sun and shade with beautiful views of the water.  The check-in process was pretty seamless, we booked through Costco travel with transportation, which worked out really nicely.   We celebrated Valentine's Day and our anniversary while we were there, the butler, Gustavo, had Champaigne, rose petals, a dessert and a bath with bubbles and rose petals.  The butler also scheduled our nightly restaurant reservations.  We golfed one day, the transportation was easy and the golf course was nice.  We participated in the caterman yoga on the beach for reserve guests which was a nice ride and a quick yoga session followed by a stop in the water to jump in and enjoy cocktails before heading back to the resort.  We also each had a massage at the on-site spa. We purposefully stayed in the reserve to be a way from kids; there wasn't a ton of kids but nice to have the adults only pools and beach and a restaurant.  The opportunities for this resort, the service especially the first 4 days we were there was not good, it slower improved a little as the week went on, we were there for 8 days but i would say overall, service was just OK.  The food was probably our least favorite.  If you are going for a culinary experience, this is not the place to go.  For lunch and breakfast, it was the buffet, which was OK.  Room service food options were not good, chicken nuggets (reminded me of Mcdonalds), fries and a couple of other options.  Blue Agave the Mexican restaurant was our favorite.  Overall, the consistency of the service did not live up to our expectations, the bars seemed disorganized, never had enough glasses, there were some questionable sanitary choices made by the bartenders and I'm certain they broke 20 glasses just while we were at the bars during our stay.  Not a huge deal but for what i thought was a 4.5 star resort, the service and food did not live up to it.  Drinks were served in paper cups and there were not options to just grab a snack.  The employees didn't seem all that happy to be there and again the experience depending on who you got was hit or miss.  You had to sit down for any food you wanted to order aside from room service.  Overall, the resort itself was beautiful, the grounds very well kept beautiful beach and pools.

reviews.author: cady66
reviews.title: Esperaba más
reviews.text: Creo que la relación calidad precio es un poco exagerada. Ha habido cosas muy buenas pero tambien cosas regulares cuanto menos.

reviews.author: Gabriel kreim
reviews.title: Buena infraestructura, pobre servicio
reviews.text: Estuvimos alojados la 2 semana a de febrero. La habitación muy buena, espaciosa, linda y prolija. Las áreas comunes del hotel, muy lindas, salvo las piscinas que estaban HELADAS. No cuesta tanto calefacción árelas. El desayuno, básico sin lujos de un 5 estrellas. Los restaurantes, buenos.. El personal en general, poco amigable, apenas contestaban, muy floja la atención de los bares de piscina.El personal de check in si fue amable y expeditivo

reviews.author: latabhattarai
reviews.title: 7 days vacation experience
reviews.text:
Guests who speak English have difficulty getting the necessary information during their stay at the hotel. Because of this, we were unable to book all the restaurants during our 7-day stay. We only figured out the process ourselves after three days.

Additionally, some staff made us feel that guests who are not Circle members are not given equal attention. It seemed like being a Circle member was necessary to receive proper service. This made us feel overlooked and left out as regular guests.

The large number of adults-only sections significantly limited the areas available for families traveling with children. As guests visiting with kids, we felt that our accessible space within the resort was quite restricted. Many facilities and areas were designated for adults only, which made it challenging to fully enjoy the property as a family. This created a sense that our options were limited compared to adult-only guests, and it reduced the overall comfort and flexibility of our stay.

reviews.author: Ross S
reviews.title: Excellent property and staff, but extremely poor food and limited activities.
reviews.text:
(Excellent property and staff, but extremely poor food and limited activities.)
￼
🌴 Beautiful Property, Great Staff, and Strong Amenities
This is an older resort, but it’s exceptionally well maintained. The grounds, beach, and pools are all beautiful, and the lobby area is a standout with a 24‑hour bar offering made‑to‑order cocktails and coffee.
The staff is outstanding—warm, welcoming, and genuinely friendly throughout the stay. The gym, once reopened from repairs, was immaculate with attentive staff and nearly updated equipment.
Another pleasant surprise was the Nespresso café, serving excellent made‑to‑order coffee drinks and very good ice cream. Our room was spacious, quiet, had a great pool view, and the mini‑bar was well stocked and replenished promptly.
￼
🍽 Food Quality Was Extremely Poor
Unfortunately, the food was the biggest disappointment and significantly impacted the overall experience. The buffet offered plenty of options, but most items were bland, poorly prepared, and lacking flavor and texture. Baked goods were also subpar.
The specialty restaurants (Flora, Mina Mezzalune, and Blue Agave) were difficult to book, and the meals—when we finally got in—were consistently cold, flavorless, and poorly presented.
Even 24‑hour room service was a miss: cold, old, and barely edible items like chicken fingers, fries, cheesecake, and brownies.
The only consistently great food option was the made‑to‑order omelet station at breakfast.
￼
🎯 Very Limited Activities
The resort advertises a range of activities, but in reality, there was almost nothing to do on property:
• No non-motorized water sports
• No diving
• No visible options to book excursions
This felt misleading compared to what was advertised online.
￼
🛏 Rooms & Other Notes
• Room: 4.6/5
• Property: 4.6/5
• Food: -10/5 (yes, that’s how disappointing it was)
• Beach/pool chairs and towels were always available, though service quality varied.
￼
❌ Would I Return?
No, I would not return.
And no, I would not recommend this resort to friends or family.
It’s a beautiful property with fantastic staff, but the food and lack of activities prevent it from being the 4–5 star experience we expected for the price.
￼

reviews.author: sanahashmi2026
reviews.title: Beautiful place.
reviews.text: It was a very beautiful place. Staff needs to be trained more with their services and also should know how to speak English and understand what the guests are saying.

reviews.author: Ashwin K
reviews.title: Immaculately maintained property. OK but SAFE food. Value for money
reviews.text:
We hd a good time at the property and enjoyed our time here. improvements are needed in restaurant availability, and not getting tables at some of the restaurants was a BIG turn off. I didn't pay as much as I did to settle for less. do something Paradisus.

On a separate note, our concierge Guillermo was very respectful and attentive and helped make our stay pleasant

reviews.author: BigSightseer
reviews.title: Average, but won’t go back
reviews.text: The grounds, beach, pool, and room were excellent and very well maintained. Thought, the pool was very cold and almost empty in February. Unfortunately, the food was below average with very little variety — it was mostly the same items every day. The specialty restaurants were also below average. We tried mediterranean and Dominican. 3 of us got food poisoning after having dinner at the Dominican restaurant, which was very disappointing. Won’t go back to this resort.

reviews.author: Benjamin N
reviews.title: Food ruined an otherwise beautiful resort
reviews.text:
The good: the resort and atmosphere were beautiful! Great atmosphere. Weather didn’t cooperate the whole time, but that is no one’s fault. Our personal concierge Adriel Cabrera was incredibly helpful, kind, and responsive! 

The not-so-good: the menus look great, and our first night experience was very good, so I want to say it was hit or miss but honestly after that it was mostly miss. Food quality was maybe a 6/10 while food safety was a 2/10. Both of us got sick. Food that should be hot was barely warm or cold and food that should be cold was room temperature.

Not much can redeem the overall experience from that. Sad, because the staff and atmosphere were wonderful.

reviews.author: shannon483
reviews.title: It was fine
reviews.text: The location facility and staff are all nice but the food was disappointing and service was often slow.

reviews.author: JOHN R
reviews.title: So close to awesome
reviews.text:
Just wrapping up a full week here on 6 Feb.  Not a veteran of all inclusive or reviews for that matter but wanted to chime in on what we would have done differently.   I'll do this pretty quickly:

Grounds/beach- 9/10. - almost all ready are sleek, clean, updated, and luxurious.  Only a few dated aspects (main pool for one)

Vibe: 10:10 - very chill and friendly.  Exactly what we like.  No one trying to grab you for extras or to
Join  thier club. Etc.

Staff: 10/10, I'm sure many places have friendly staff that call you "family". Feels like most staff here mean it - they personally want you to be happy in their home country.   JUILA at the swim up suite- amazing - always made sure we had the freshest pina coladas!

Room:  the trip originated as a 3
Day company meeting in standard junior room, but we splurged and came the whole week and upgraded to the Master Swim Up.  Amazing room, maybe even a little too much.  Very clean, no issues, super comfortable.  Housekeeping was also excellent.

Food - 6/10. Didn't have any preset expectations, so it was decent. Not a big factor for us either way.

So why 3 stars?  Value for the room.  While the rom was awesome, the large upgrade cost was disappointing. We were in building 3, pool right in front, but the constant motorized traffic in front was a bummer. Every time you doze off into a nap, or holding a chat with a friend, there was some type of motorcycle, delivery truck, catering, supply shipment buzzing by just on the other side of the hedge.  Where I wanted the most quiet, hard to come by during most of the day. For that, dissatisfied in the value my upgrade cost.  

If we chose to return someday , we'll be sure to stay in the adults only Reserve.

reviews.author: Pam R
reviews.title: Not as we hoped
reviews.text: Disappointed with the humidity in the room as the air conditioning stopped by a motion sensor. Hot items at the buffet were usually cold and lacked variety. Overall nice hotel but we enjoyed Secrets much better.

reviews.author: Ricardo S
reviews.title: La experiencia Circle es buena aunque a veces le resten exclusividad.
reviews.text: Han creado un área en la playa qué se ha impuesto a la exclusividad de los socios y han limitado el área de playa de los socios. Kanna, no puede estar delante del único acceso que tienen los socios a la playa. Los socios Circle deben tener un área adecuada, cómoda y que esté sin los obstáculos de las camas y áreas de Kanna qué han fabricado para sacar más dinero. Eso resta exclusividad al socio y no por el hecho de que exista Kanna, sino por que ahora el socio fue desplazado hacia atrás. Esa decisión no fue atinada.

reviews.author: Scarlett W
reviews.title: Great trip away from the colder weather of home.
reviews.text:
This was our first time traveling to the Dominican Republic and staying at an All-Inclusive Resort and the first time at a Melia property.  We were very happy with the resort itself.  Beautiful public areas, our room was wonderful, the beach was great and the pools were amazing.  We had a suite overlooking the Kanna Beach Club, which was fine until a conference welcome dinner was set up on the area in front of our room and the music was very loud.  We did have to complain about this. 
We were disappointed in the quality of the service and food at the restaurants.  We ate at the steak house, the Italian Restaurant and Flora, the DR one, along with The Lunch Box.  The buffet was great for breakfast and lunch but we thought the dinner food was mediocre.  All of the restaurants that we went to were the same.  The quality of food was just not what we thought it would be for an all-inclusive luxury property. The service in all of the restaurants, especially the buffet was not good at all.  The employees did not seem to enjoy being there.  They weren't friendly and it usually took 3 to 4 asks before they brought something to drink....even water.  The other thing that we were disappointed in was the amount of workers at the resort who didn't understand/speak much English.  For this to be a resort where a lot of Americans visit, the English should be understood and spoken at a level that any English speaking visitor could feel comfortable communicating. 

I do have to mention that our concierge, Adrial, was very helpful and I would give him a 5 star review.  The only dinner reservations that he could initially get for us when we arrived was at 8:30.  This is too late for us to eat so he worked diligently the nights that we were there to get us in the restaurant earlier,  He was attentive and checked in on us daily. 

Overall, we did enjoy our stay and the property is beautiful, we would pick another resort to try next time due to the service aside from our concierge.

reviews.author: Andy M
reviews.title: We enjoyed our time at the Paradisus Palma Real....for the most part
reviews.text:
We had a good time but there were a few moments that were a bit frustrating.  First the good.....the resort is very clean and well maintained.  The pools are cleaned regularly.  The rooms were very nice and also well maintained.  We had a nice view of the ocean and adults only pool from our balcony.  The minibar was regularly stocked which was nice.  The quality of the food was generally quite good.  The staff were quite friendly and accommodating.  Nice layout to the resort and we were never far from anything.

Wifi was probably the best we've experienced at a resort.

Some of the challenges we faced were at check in.  We had booked a room with a king sized bed, but were told upon arrival that there were none available....adding that they don't guarantee king sized beds.  That was odd.  We were then told that we'd be moved on Tuesday to a different room, but that never happened....and they seemed surprised when we asked again.

While dining was good, trying to get reservations was not easy.  The app is not helpful, so we had to line up with others with the hope of getting into one of the a la carte restaurants.  Other than breakfast, we are not a fan of buffets.  A stand out for lunch was Kanna.  Very nice.

While staff were good, there was sometimes a lack of staff in high flow areas like the bars.

We were south in July and experienced the full brunt of seaweed season.  It was better recently but still far more sargassum than we've experienced in the past.  That was disappointing.  The beach was clean and well maintained.  There were lots of kids in the adult only beach area so if you're looking for quiet, you may be a bit put off.

Costs were reasonable and expected.  There was not a lot of upselling, so that was good.

reviews.author: mrblizzard2026
reviews.title: Opposite of Hospitality
reviews.text: Find another resort, this resort gives you an attitude that they don’t want your business.Many things in room non functional. Half of the staff was rude and smug. Workers wake you up with insane hallway noise every morning. Impossible to make dinner reservations. Workers speak very little English. They just don’t seem to want you here, maybe they dislike Americans.

reviews.author: Shelleykoop
reviews.title: Honest review from an experienced traveler
reviews.text:
Buckle up, this is going to be a bit long but I want to give the experienced traveler a heads up to the Paradisus on The Reserve side of the resort.
The positives
1. The rooms are very, very clean. Our bed was quite comfortable. We were in the building closest to the beach, 2nd floor, ocean view(not ocean front) directly above the beachside adult only rectangular Reserve pool(there are 3 adult only pools). Our room was cleaned every day between 10-11 am. All excellent except they did not replenish my face wash cloth after the first day( I had to use a hand towel to wash off my cleanser)
2. Kelvin was our personal concierge. He checked in every morning, arranged our dinner reservations, golf for the guys and spa services for the ladies(shout out to Gladys at the spa. She was amazing). He met us every evening(with the exception of once...we were early though) at our restaurant reservation and checked in with us. It was a nice personal touch. Upon departure, he met us at the lobby and bid us a farewell. He was friendly and attentive. I know he could have done more for us, but we are chill, low key, unassuming travelers so we didn't feel the need to bother him much. I know that he would have delivered on pretty much anything for us though with his quick responsiveness to our simple requests. I was thankful for his assistance.
3. There are ample, EXTREMELY comfortable chairs/beds on the beach. They rank up completely with the Ritz' that we have stayed at. Seriously the BEST.
4. There are plenty of beach towels for guests, with no limit on how many you can take. Something to note though, if you wait and don't get down to the pool /beach until around 11...there may not be any and you'll have to hunt some down. They are constantly replenished at the counters/stands but I did see a pattern of people coming down closer to 11 and I did have a few people ask me where to get towels because there weren't any at the huts. I must have a welcoming look because it happens to me often with travel. haha.
5. The big freeform Reserve pool has plenty of chairs open throughout the day so we set up there on our pool days. I appreciated not having to rush down at 7 am and "save" spots. I would head down around 9:30-10 and get my prime sunny spot without issue. 
6. The resort is very clean everywhere. No bugs, landscaping meticulously maintained, public bathrooms super clean.
7. Restaurants: Some are good, some are decent, some are awful. Here is my opinion and what my husband, son and his girlfriend thought.
Blue Agave-Mexican: 3 star. Decent food, limited menu, small portions, average drinks
Mina-Steakhouse: 3 star. Decent food(do not get the chicken. It is super dry) decent portions and good drinks.
Sante-Mediterranean(for Reserve guests only): 4 star. Excellent steak, above average food. I was pleasantly surprised by it. We had an AMAZING waiter there, I wish I would have gotten his name but he made the experience excellent. He was truly a gem. We tipped him $20usd...he was THAT attentive. We did NOT receive that attentiveness, not even CLOSE anywhere else...well, maybe a close second was at Flora but that was only after my son who is very fluent in Spanish started speaking it and joking around to the waitress and she finally warmed up and didn't act like we were a complete inconvenience to her.
Flora-Dominican:3.5 star Decent food, good drinks, decent portions
Mazcalzone Italian: 1 star. HORRIBLE FOOD I couldn't believe how awful it was. Waitress was nice though as in, she smiled and didn't act like we were an inconvenience...minuet interaction with her like most places.
Banna-Japanese teppanyaki: 4 star for the teppanyaki, 1 star for the sushi appetizer. I love rolls and these were disgustingly bad. Drinks decent 3 star, portion size was HUGE, your typical teppanyaki.
Buffet restaurant...I don't even know how to rate it. It was just beyond bad. My husband who eats everything and is not a picky eater even said how bad it was. If you want to eat breakfast, just get room service. Lunch...good luck...we ended up mostly ordering room service to eat around 9 am and just waited to eat for dinnertime. Which rolls me into the negatives on the resort......
1. The service(other than Kelvin and the bartenders at the freeform pool and waiter at Sante which were outstanding) was abysmal. The lack of service was overwhelmingly bad and totally tainted our experience. The coffee shop upstairs by the lobby was terrible and the attitude of the girls working behind the bar was something to behold. They treated us with actual disgust. All I literally said to the one was, I'd like a macchiato please. I got the biggest eyeroll, sigh, and she said...What? So I repeated myself. This was day 3. She turned away, grabbed the metal pitcher that was on the counter and poured it into my cup. hahahahahahaha! She literally didn't make what I asked for and had the audacity to roll her eyes. It was coffee with cream in it. I just had to laugh at the absurdity of it. I then sent my husband the rest of the trip when we didn't get room service coffee. And, let me tell you, the coffee at the lobby was CRAP. I read reviews and everyone said it's good...It is NOT good and the service is even worse. The majority of the "wait staff", (and I use the term wait staff loosely), was utter laziness and dismissiveness. You had to hunt everything down. Good luck getting your water glass filled. Seriously. If they hate the vacationers that are their LIVELYHOOD so much why work at a resort????  I would rate the overall staff that we encountered other than the aforementioned, as 2 star at best. It was just sooooooooo bad.
2. The food. Well, I rated everything above but man, that is being generous on a lot of it. Maybe it's because most of the Americans are overweight(we are not) they feel that they can serve bland, flavorless, poor quality food because they'll eat whatever is given. I don't know but wow, I was never so happy to eat a Wendy's cheeseburger(which I normally never eat) at the airport prior to boarding my flight home.
3. The drinks. Well, if you are a beer drinker, my husband and adult son were complaining about the 8 oz cans. They felt like they were constantly running back and forth to the bar. I will say this. It definitely discourages overindulging when you are getting up every 45 minutes to get another drink if you so choose IF you don't want to be in the water in front of the swim up bar all day long. I am not a beer drinker and do prefer tequila( which they did have Don Julio) but their mixers are sadly lacking. There were several days of my 8 day stay that I just did not drink anything other than water. I one million percent did not get my value from the all inclusive at this resort. Also, know that even though they will come around and collect the empty cups and cans occasionally  they will NOT offer to bring you another drink....EVER. We made the mistake of tipping the guy $10 usd (we do this in Mexico all of the time and they are ON IT with stellar service) the first day at the pool thinking maybe he'd get the hint and come back around but we never saw him again on our side of the adult only freeform area. 
4. The umbrellas poolside at the freeform Reserve pool are too small in circumference and too tall to provide really any shade. The base's are extremely heavy concrete, so to move them around is difficult and you have to be super careful to not get your toes or hurt your back. I did want to try to sit at one of the 2 smaller rectangular pools on the Reserve side for the cabanas but all of the old people got up super early and snagged those by 8-8:15 am. It was irritating but honestly, the freeform gigantic Reserve pool was so quiet and the bartenders at the swim up bar were super nice and fun that I didn't really care. It would be cool though with how massive the pool deck area is for them to invest in about 10 cabanas in that area as well. 
5. The vendors on the beach are NONSTOP harassing. We spent 2 1/2 days out there and it was so disappointing to be bothered over and over and over again. I finally gave up and spent the rest of my time pool side, which was sad because I LOVE the Caribbean beach sand and the view. Also, next door at the Melia, the music starts around 11 and it is a constant thumping beat all day. 
6. This may be nit picky but it happened and it wasn't handled well on the adult only side that we paid MORE money to stay at. One afternoon at around 2 pm a woman in her early 30's came into the pool with another friend and an approximately 2 year old child. They proceeded to get into the pool. The small child began playing, splashing and squealing. Typical toddler behavior, which is perfectly fine ON the OTHER SIDE OF THE RESORT. The woman started hushing the child which only egged the child on. There were MULTIPLE staff around setting up for the dinner that evening for the Riser convention going on. I took a picture of them and was getting ready after about 15 minutes to send it to Kelvin to handle it since no one seemed to care. Finally an employee walked over to the woman and asked her to leave. The woman started arguing with her and WOULD NOT LEAVE. After about 2 minutes of the exchange the employee just walked away!!! LIKE.....WHAT THE ACTUAL!!!!!?????!!!!! I looked at my husband and said, I'm watching the clock and if she doesn't leave in the next 5 minutes I AM calling our concierge. Well, 3 minutes later, 2 men and a woman, official looking started walking toward them and all of a sudden they got up out of the pool and walked away. Unfortunately the official looking staff didn't follow them which I felt was ridiculous. Especially since to stay on the Reserve side you do pay quite a bit more for the kid free experience. 

So, overall after all of these things, I would not recommend Paradisus. I will not return. There are so many other places to try and maybe one of them would be better. It did not enamor me to the DR that is for certain. I've been to Cayman, Turks, St Lucia, Jamaica x 5, Puerto Rico, Aruba, Maldives, Mexico (multiple locations x 20), Hawaii x 7, Florida various locations x 32. I would return to every one of those locations and resorts off of US soil without hesitation. DR, not so much. Good Luck!

reviews.author: Aramis A
reviews.title: Problemas com a hotelaria em geral
reviews.text:
Funcionários agradáveis e muito solícitos, porém tivemos problemas com a hotelaria e na marcação de passeios.
Alguns problemas não foram resolvidos

reviews.author: marisä p
reviews.title: Mediana e lamentável
reviews.text:
O hotel é magnífico, lindo, limpo…contudo algumas coisas não são boas:
Falta toalhas na piscina, falta copos, falta toalhas e arrumação no quarto, não fazem reposição no frigobar, o serviço no restaurante principal horas e bom, horas é pessimo, funcionários relapsos.
A beleza que carece de dar o tratamento sendo hóspedes ou sendo sócio…
Apesar de lindo não tenho vontade de retornar

reviews.author: Gigi1125
reviews.title: Not the Paradisus I remember
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed in Paradisus Palma Real for the second time in November 2025 for 5 days. This was our 5th stay with Paradisus brand, we have stayed in Paradisus La  Esmeralda and Paradisus Cancun in Mexico in previous years, and the most disappointing one. 
The resort has been updated and remodeled since our stay in 2019, so the rooms are beautiful and have a lot of storage for clothes, which other resorts lack. The beach is wide with plenty of chairs and the water had no seaweed. There are waiters that take your order, though because we went off season, the service was slow. The main pool is great and the new smaller pools in front of the buildings  are a great new touch. 
The entertainment at the resort was minimal, so we had no choice but to return to the room early. There was a singer one night but we never saw a show...
The service at the restaurants and buffet was ok, not special.
Though the restaurants  were good, I feel like if you don't upgrade to the reserve or are a part of the circle, you will feel "less then", because there are restaurants that you can't go to, reservations for restaurants weren't readily available and you can't go to parts of the beach. We stood in line in front of an ice cream stand on our way back to the room from the beach, only to be told that we didn't have the correct bracelets and could not get ice cream. I wish I knew prior to reserving that we needed to upgrade in order to feel like we were a part of the experience.
Even though our stay was good, it was not wonderful, not sure if we will return.

reviews.author: Jen02
reviews.title: Not a 5-star hotel
reviews.text:
Hubby and I are avid travellers and we have been to many brands of hotels so this is the first time that we tried Paradisus/Melia brand and it was not what we expected, based on some of the reviews on here.  First impressions usually leave lasting impressions, and the initial impression we received was not very good.

CHECK-IN:
We arrived about an hour before the 3pm check-in and was told that our room was not ready (as we expected that).  We were down there to celebrate my birthday so hubby was curious about getting an upgrade to our room to which they recommended "The Reserve" rooms. I am sorry, but $650 US a night for the upgrade was a little outrageous so we just stayed in the room provided (they did not offer any other upgrades at this point).  We then decided to have lunch and come back at 3pm.  We came back at 3pm and were told that our room was still not ready so we waited in the lobby for them to let us know when we can check-in.  Around 315pm I went back up to the desk and was told it was not ready and he flagged down a staff member to check our room.  The staff member came back and told us our room was ready and we then checked in.
**We later found out that there were other room upgrade options, less expensive, from another guest as they were given one, and we were surprised that those other options were not given to us**

ROOM:
When we booked our vacation, we requested a king bed but when we got to our room it was 2 double beds to which the staff at the check-in never informed us of.  So we go and unpacked our luggage and hubby went to the fridge to grab a drink only to find a half bottle of Coke Zero.  Then we checked the rest of the room and found no bathrobes, slippers, iron board/iron.  Later on in the day, when they brought the missing products, they also included wash cloths, glasses for the bathroom sink, and bath soap (which we did not notice were missing either...UGH).  We brought all this to their attention as technically the room was not ready for any guest at this point.  They offered us an alternate room, which did have a king size bed, but unfortunately it was basically a room with NO VIEW at all and it was as if they were sending us down to the dungeon.  We decided to stay where we were as it was conveniently located near the lobby, restaurants and the adult pool.  However, throughout our stay we also noticed the hair dryer was not working, TV remote not working AND at one point the door to our room was not working as the batteries were low (SMH).  Also a heads up, there are not bathroom walls, just a sheath curtain separating the bathroom from the bedroom. (Toilet is in an enclosed area only)

RESTAURANTS:
We tried all the ala carte restaurants, except the Flora, and all these restaurants were fantastic!  You can book these restaurants ahead of time as they allow you to book 2 days in advance.  We never had issues with reserving tables at all.
The buffet was not great, not a lot of selection and the selections were basically the same at lunch and dinner with a few changes.  

POOL:
There are several pools at the hotel.  We basically stayed at the adults only pool and it had their own pool bar there.  We never had to reserve chairs as there were plenty of them.  The other pools had all the daily activities but we never participated in them.

BEACH:
Beach was full of sargasm and the hotel made every effort to clear it every morning so we did not frequent the beach unless we were just walking along the shore.  My issue with the beach area is that they pack the chairs onto one side of the beach like a can of sardines.  There were a lot of chairs but they were all crowded together.  Also with the sargasm around the beach, it was hard to enjoy sitting there when you can smell the sargasm and it was not pleasant.

ENTERTAINMENT:
We never really saw any entertainment crew around the hotel so we just assumed they stayed around the main pool area during the day.  They posted the activities/events daily so you would have to go down in the morning to see what the events were for that day.  There was another location on the compound called Fun Republica to watch some shows as well.  Not a very exciting hotel for events, the shows were kind of boring to be honest.

MONEY TIP:
If you are bringing down money to exchange, don't bother.  We brought down Canadian money thinking we can exchange it for Dominican pesos at the front desk BUT they do not do exchanges.  They will only change US dollars for US dollars.  At one point, they told us to go to the casino to make our exchanges (the casino was at another hotel on the compound!).  Not once did they tell us that there was an ATM in the hotel until another guest told us.  We went to a bank in San Juan Plaza and they would not exchange our Canadian or US dollars.

LANGUAGE BARRIER:
Unless you can speak their language, we had a hard time communicating with some of the staff.  Many times we had to repeat ourselves or try and explain what we wanted as they did not understand.  We told them that we had a half bottle of Coke Zero left in our room when we checked in and for the first hour we were in our room, they kept trying to bring more bottles to us.  We told them that we did not have an ironing board and iron and they brought us two ironing boards.  We told them that the TV remote was not working and they came to turn on the TV instead of change the batteries in the remote.  My husband asked for a beer and water and they gave him a pina colada.  It is the little things but when the majority of the guests speak English, the staff that deals with these guests should at least be able to understand or speak the language as well.  

OTHER:
-Went to their gym daily.  it was open 24 hours but when I would go early in the morning, there were no towels.  Gym was full equipped with exercise equipment, which was great!
-When you check-in. you are approached by a concierge who claims they will be at your beckon call.  Ours was okay but we rarely heard from him.  We asked him to look into our pickup time when we were departing, we even provided him with our flight number and everything and he told us that he has it on file and will inform us 24 hours before our departure but surprise, surprise, he never got back to us about it...LOL.  

OVERALL IMPRESSION:
It is a beautiful hotel, beautiful landscaping throughout the resort. They kept the resort clean at all times.   I think it just lacks in customer service and satisfaction.  Would I go there again?  Probably not.

reviews.author: gfernandez2026
reviews.title: Estancia Hotel Melia Paradisus Punta Cana.Cana
reviews.text: Conocemos bien el Hotel porque hemos ido muchas veces. La ubicación y el equipo es fantástico, pero la habitación tenía muchas deficiencias, algo poco habitual con Melia. Además, pese a ser clientes habituales del programa Rewards , no se nos permitió usar alguno de nuestros beneficios como el late check out sin cargo . Los problemas y deficiencias de la han tardaron en resolverse. Pese a ser una Jr Suite vista mar , necesita ciertas reformas.

reviews.author: Nina511
reviews.title: Bel hôtel mais service à améliorer!
reviews.text:
Bon: l’architecture coloniale de l’hôtel, la plage de sable blanc, la qualité des serviettes de bain, le confort du lit, la propreté de l’hôtel. 
Le service des serveurs du buffet principal et celui du café Nespresso.
Très belles piscines.

Mauvais: le service sur la plage, il n’y en a pas. Pas une seule fois  on est venu nous voir pour prendre une commande de boissons. PAS UNE SEULE FOIS en 8 jours!
Placer deux personnes adultes dans un étage de jeunes familles avec jeunes enfants. Rien n’a été fait quant au manque de respect de nos voisins de palier. Hurlement des enfants, des parents, claquement de porte incessants, nous n’avons mal dormi toute la semaine!
Nous avons demandé à être changés, mais étonnamment sans vouloir payer pour l’espace Reserve, il n’était pas possible de nous reloger dans une autre section.
Très choquée de voir des gens sur la plage des gens avec la même catégorie de bracelet que nous qui étaient dans la 
section adultes seulement.

Pour avoir du service, il faut faire les demandes 3-4 fois.

La bouffe: le restaurant Asiatique et l’italien: très ordinaire.
Le steak house et le dominicain: c’est bon.
Choix au buffet: varié, il y a même de la langouste en saison. Seul hic:  la bouffe est souvent froide, et ce, même aux restaurants à la carte.

Pour la plage et la mer: c’est une belle plage de sable blanc. Suffisamment de chaises disponibles 
Dans la mer il y beaucoup de sable en
suspension, algues et sargasses on ne voit plus le fond, 30 ans d’exploitation exponentielle sans mesure de protection pour les berges commence à se faire ressentir à Bávaro.

reviews.author: Walter I
reviews.title: La habitación para 3 es para  2con una cama adicional muy incomoda y poco lugar para guardar el equipaje
reviews.text:
Nos vendieron una habitación para 3 adultos y era una habitación doble con una cama adicional,  estuvimos incómodos los 5 días,  el hotel ya no es lo que era,  bajo su calidad en la comida como en sus barras.  El concierge Alam hizo todo lo posible para mejorar nuestra estadía. 
Gracias Alam

reviews.author: Victoria E
reviews.title: Agradable, pero ha bajado la calidad.
reviews.text: La ubicación es muy buena, sobre todo el sector de Playa en The Reserve. Sin embargo hay algunas cosas que cambiaron respecto de otras ocasiones en que he venido: The Reserve ya no es tan exclusivo como hace algunos años, esta todo demasiado junto con el Palma Real, no es tan buena la atencion y sobre todo bajo mucho el nivel de la cocina y la atencion al cliente, tanto en las habitaciones como en los restaurantes. La bebida en las barras no es tan buena y los bartender tampoco. Ha bajado mucho la calidad. Si puedo rescatar la atencion de Alan, nuestro consierge que hizo todo lo que estuvo a su alcance para hacer nuestra estadía mas placentera,  reservó siempre distintos restaurantes y estuvo atento a nuestras necesidades. Gracias Alan!

reviews.author: T B
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience — Reserve Upgrade Not Worth It
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin. I am genuinely confused as to how this resort has received such glowing reviews, with “lackluster” being the most consistent theme throughout my stay.

Despite my room being ready, I waited nearly an hour in the Reserve lobby while the front desk agent assisted multiple other guests. The check in experience set the tone for what was to come. 

The Kanna / private members-only area is visually appealing, but unfortunately it highlights how underwhelming the rest of the property is by comparison. I paid $575 to upgrade to The Reserve, and upon arrival, seriously considered leaving altogether.

My first experience with a Reserve-only restaurant was shockingly bad. The host appeared visibly annoyed by my presence, and after being seated, no one approached me for an extended period of time. The food was genuinely inedible. I initially tried the buffet, couldn’t stomach anything, and then ordered from the menu hoping for improvement. It wasn’t. The salad was soggy and unappetizing, and the gazpacho was equally unpleasant.

The two Reserve-only pools were extremely secluded and had no bar service, which made the upgrade feel pointless. Ironically, the large adults-only pool with a swim-up bar was accessible without any Reserve upgrade and was far superior.

After exploring the property, I immediately returned to the Reserve lobby to ask about a refund and potentially changing resorts. While the hotel did agree to refund the Reserve upgrade, they refused to refund any portion of my stay. As a result, I downgraded my room and stayed for the remaining five nights.

I have previously stayed at a Meliá property in Mexico and had an excellent experience, which made the quality gap here especially surprising.

The rest of the resort is, at best, mediocre. Poor maintenance was obvious everywhere: bad paint jobs, cracked fixtures, aging infrastructure, and neglected landscaping. Most staff members appeared disengaged and unhappy, which unfortunately showed in the service. I tried three specialty restaurants, all of which were underwhelming. The food quality across the resort was a 4/10 at best. Ironically, the buffet offered the best food and service during my stay.

Housekeeping was inconsistent. My minibar was never refilled, and service often consisted of only making the bed and removing towels. The magnifying mirror in my room was falling out of the wall, and I walked past the same dead roach on the stairway for four consecutive days before it was finally removed.
Basic guest conveniences were also lacking. Obtaining small bills to tip staff was surprisingly difficult. At the sports bar, I ordered a gin martini twice and received a vodka martini both times. The walls in the rooms are extremely thin — I could clearly hear everything happening in the adjacent room.

I also visited the spa, which was another disappointment. The reception staff were unfriendly, and while I was required to prepay for my service upfront (which was fine), there was no option to tip the therapist. I booked the 80-minute signature wine massage, which sounded unique and indulgent, but it turned out to be nothing more than a basic Swedish massage. None of the advertised elements were incorporated.

That said, a few employees truly stood out and deserve recognition. Christopher, my concierge, was excellent and the highlight of my stay. Jimbert and Rosanna in the buffet were very warm and personable and consistently went out of their way to make breakfast enjoyable. Luis at the Ginger bar and Jonathan at the pool bar were also fantastic, as was every member of the bell staff I encountered.

Unfortunately, good employees cannot compensate for poor management, inconsistent service, subpar food, and a tired property. I would not return to this resort and would not recommend it to others. For the price and the promises made — particularly around the Reserve upgrade — this property falls well short.

reviews.author: oscarpl2026
reviews.title: Expect more for the price
reviews.text:
We paid extra for a beach view room and did not receive it. We also tried to use the outside jacuzzi, but staff immediately told us we couldn’t because it was leaking downstairs.

Inside the room, the bathtub had loose screws and was leaking as well. We had to let two different maintenance people into our room on different days during our stay to try to fix it.

I also got cut by an outside chair because it was missing a handle, which is a safety issue.

The staff were very polite and helpful, which we appreciate. However, the buffet breakfast both mornings was disappointing—it was very noticeable that food was reused. The pancakes were extremely hard.

The shows were nice, but the noise carried straight into our room. We were traveling with our child, and he couldn’t fall asleep until late because of the loud music.

Overall, good service from staff, but several room, safety, food quality, and noise issues affected our experience.

reviews.author: Chechi23
reviews.title: Le falta al personal
reviews.text: El hotel es lindo pero la atención y el personal no corresponde a la categoría del hotel. Los empleados no tienen idea de nada. Casi suspenden la fiesta de año nuevo por lluvia y cuando se confirmó, nadie se  dignaba a retirar los plásticos mojados de las sillas (yo misma tuve que hacerlo), no organizaron la entrega de copas de champán, fue todo improvisado. Hoy no habían toallas para la playa, le pregunté al empleado a qué hora reponían y me respondió que le no sabía y para completar hoy volví a mi cuarto 7pm y no habían toallas de ducha y tampoco habían repuesto el agua del fríobar ni los snacks. Un par de veces que he preguntado a algún empleado donde es el bufete o donde está un restaurante y tampoco dan razón. Parece que todos fueran nuevos y estuvieran perdidos en la luna.

reviews.author: Wanderer556578
reviews.title: Some tips if you go
reviews.text:
The positives: the resort is sparkling clean. We had a two bedroom suite which was magnificent. Big and clean. We had two separate bedrooms for 3 adults with every amenity you can dream of there was a common area with a couch and TV and little table.

Tips and average features: 

the food is mediocre at best. The Japanese restaurant is really good - do hibachi. 

The buffet is a free-for-all. The food is sort of mashed together. The kids touch things, especially the desserts. For someone who likes things as germ-free as possible, this might not be your taste. 

We have a nice concierge who was very accommodating. His name is Alam 

Most important, take at least 100  $1 bills. We left ours at home. Big mistake. You can’t get decent service if you don’t tip. Some of the servers at the buffet didn’t even acknowledge your presence if you didn’t give them money.

There is no beach. You can only go snorkeling as an excursion and it’s very expensive. All the excursions for that matter are expensive. They are constantly trying to upsell you as well.

Order breakfast room service the night before. They came right on time.

reviews.text: El personal te atiende con desgano, se ve claramente diferebmncia al cliente latino que al norteamericano

not bad but ,food was ok ,liked the FLora restaurant.
 Entertainment was great ,the rock girl with the band .

reviews.text:
A l’arrivé ont nous conseille de upgrade la chambre pour 800$ us j’ai refusé 
Il ont baissé le prix à 400$us mais cash avec une personne qui va nous aider pendant notre séjour ont a accepté,la chambre etait tres bien placé proche de tout mais ont nous a pas mentionné que étant basses saison pas de buffet

reviews.author: Lucas H
reviews.title: 4 Star Hotel with 3 Star Service
reviews.text:
Having stayed at a stellar Melia property in the Balearic Islands, I had high expectations for The Paradisus Palma Real. While the resort physically has a lot going for it—our rooms were great and the beach is beautiful—the experience fell short of a true 5-star standard.
I booked 'The Reserve' package expecting the VIP experience touted on the website, but frankly, it wasn't worth the premium. While a basic package here might offer decent value, the luxury service just wasn't there. Our concierge, Christian, was absolutely fantastic, but general service across the resort was slow and lacked attention to detail.
Maintenance was also a major issue. It felt 'low rent' to see chunks of tile missing from many of the pools. Furthermore, the three jacuzzis near the main pool bar were broken with missing tiles. Basic amenities were also frustratingly scarce; pool towels were consistently gone by 2 PM and rarely restocked.

Overall, this is a decent resort, but compared to other Melia properties, it feels neglected. If you are used to true 5-star luxury, you will likely be disappointed.

reviews.author: Ferhat A
reviews.title: Lower than expectations
reviews.text: The hotel rooms are way different than what they show on the pictures. The food is also medicore at best. Nothing really fresh and even the restaurant options were limited. Furthermore, the waiters were not that friendly. The beach was great and the poools were also good and well maintained. The kids club is also great!

reviews.author: Harriscj9
reviews.title: Not an adults only resort
reviews.text:
This is not an adults only resort. Not at all actually. This resort cuts corners/blends and if you’ve ever been to the one in playa del Carmen Mexico, you will understand what I mean. That’s basically two separate resorts with two totally independent sides. 

This resort has no real distinctions between the adult and family “sides”. The adults only buffet (Malva) is closed during the day for breakfast and lunch so everyone eats at one location, “the lunch box”. Malva restaurant is only open at night and that’s because the resort restaurants are open so they count on most people and families eating at those instead of the buffet which is very limited as a result food wise. There’s also families there (Malva) at that time. So unless you’re in a reserve section, there are no adult only dining options. The restaurants for reservation are family restaurants as well. Adults and kids alike. The pools are also not adults only really. There’s one on one side but it’s so dead with no activities and kinda pointless to be at unless you just want to be in water. No poolside bungalows, in water pool beds or poolside entertainment/activities at that pool. Just a swim up bar and water. The main pool is basically adults and kids with most of the entertainment and activity catering to the kids and parents. 

The heart of the resort (main entry) is the same. This is where all the restaurants line up and where the sports bar (kicks bar) is. Again, another family area so much so that they even have face painting for the kids at night. 

There’s nothing wrong with a family resort but if you identify and select a resort as adults only, that’s what you expect. Not kids running around, screaming, crying and having to listen to their screen entertainment devices playing while you’re eating. But that’s not what you get here by far. 

The staff… there were a few shinning stars but in all, the staff is not very friendly as experienced at other resorts. Not horrible but not as warm and just bubbly and welcoming. 

The resort is also old. At least the side I stayed on was. It def needs revamping and reconfiguration. The main terrace furniture is kinda old and dated. Hard plastic with thin cushions I hate comparing this place to the playa del Carmen location but it’s night and day as far as luxury, accents and even upkeep. 

This is my 3rd time at this resort since 2010 and I definitely remember it differently. 

There’s a lot that can be improved on here. 

I will say that the buffet food is pretty good. 

Overall, I think there are other resorts for a cheaper price for what you get here. But go see for yourself.

reviews.author: havoc2005
reviews.title: Okay experience
reviews.text: Not satisfied with some room conditions and food choices for vegetarians. Selection were limited for food and drinks.

reviews.author: valemaba
reviews.title: El hotel es hermoso pero el personal poco amable y con pocas ganas de atender
reviews.text:
La comida abundante pero siempre estaba fría. La bebida llegaba cuando estabas terminando de comer 
El personal poco amable

reviews.author: LECF
reviews.title: Disappointed in Paradsius
reviews.text:
If you arrive in the evening, expect to have to eat from a buffet at the Malva, which is a food bazar, and includes interesting items that has been set out since 5 PM. It’s not pleasing, especially at the price you are paying. 

As far as the food is concerned, we definitely would not give it 5 stars.

They are into buffets here, and know that the food will be cold and disappointing.
