Our room smelled of mold, we didn’t have any running water in the morning, and our hair dryer didn’t work. So there is that…

Do not buy any excursions from Asovenesco. It was a joke! 

Also, do not pay the extra “taxes” they require. Somehow, they simply go away when you start to walk away.

Jensy, Miquel, & Anthony at the Rum Republic Spice and Sugar Bar were amazing!

There was a lot of missing entertainment on the app, so be sure to check the lobby for an updated list. 

We ordered room service for breakfast a few times, and the order was never correct, but the view was amazing.

To end our vacation, when we went to check out, they charged us $297 more than expected! When we tried to dispute it, they were not helpful at all, and we had the shuttle waiting for us, so now we have to dispute the charge with our credit card company. I think one of the saddest parts of vacation, is that we chose Meliá based off our experience in Spain. This was a completely different experience, and will not be using them again.

reviews.author: Kelsey H
reviews.title: Ehhh - Its ok
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort. The rooms are spacious and it was nice to have an area to relax that was separate from the bedroom - especially nice when we were there during a significant amount of rain and couldn’t be outside as much as we would’ve liked. 

However, the all dining situation is odd. At check in we were given a pamphlet and told the hours for the Lunch Box, but it was closed the majority of our stay. For most of our meals we were forced to eat at Malva. 

We called the front desk a few days into our trip to verify the Lunch Box hours thinking that we misunderstood something, but it was confirmed that we had the right hours but that the Lunch Box was indeed just not open. We were told by the front desk that Malva was “the same”. 

Malva is significantly smaller than the Lunch Box and absolutely could not accommodate the same number of options as the Lunch Box. I am a picky eater and noticed that when the Lunch Box was open there was many more options that I would eat. When we were forced to eat at Malva I found myself eating the same few things on repeat since they did not have the large variety that the Lunch Box does.

I can’t say for certain that we would return. For the high price tag, I dont feel like we got what we paid for given the main buffet was closed majority of our stay. The website also lists amenities such as a casino and shopping, but these are located at sister resorts and not directly on the Paradisus grounds.

We loved many of the staff that we interacted with. Roseanna during breakfasts and lunches. Victor and Eddy at the Celcius bar. Victor at the Malva bar.

reviews.author: Burleigh G
reviews.title: World class hotel & very nice workers. Service not so much.
reviews.text:
Went for a wedding and the venue is top notch. I've been to the Dominican Republic many times and this by far was the nicest hotel I've stayed at. However compared to all the other places I've been the food and service was not the greatest. Again the hotel and workers were world class but after the 2nd day it was extremely hard to get the mini bar restocked, room service delivery times were all over the place.

1 person who did and tried the most was Jendry. He definitely eased some of the pain when it came to customer service. Would probably only go back there if I could get him again.

reviews.author: Jam_Travel_Regular
reviews.title: Lovely rooms and grounds .  Food is wanting
reviews.text: Stayed for conference.  The room was big and comfortable. The free room service was great to have although one night they said issue with the kitchen and would not do it.   Adequate amount of pools and easy to book excursions from the hotel.  First thing in the morning has to be to reserve a restaurant as gh4 main buffet food trends from bland to inedible.

reviews.author: swaldman111
reviews.title: Service excellent, Food blah…
reviews.text:
We spent one week at the Reserve section of resort.  Service at the resort was very good.  Our concierge Christian was the best!  He took care of everything we needed and went above and beyond for my entire family . Whatever request you might have, they do their best to deliver.   I can’t remember everyone’s names, but every single person we interacted with at Sante were amazing. Barnella, Amanda, Melaqui, Kelvin, Franklin, and I know I’m missing others were great.  They really work hard to make sure guests are happy.  Resort is clean, rooms very comfortable.   It’s a shame that the standards for cuisine fell way below our standards.  

A big part of our vacations are for great food. We are not big drinkers, so I can’t comment on drinks.  Food was 2 stars at best.  We did not go to Flora or the buffet.  It did not look like the uneven have a chef.  More like a cook preparing premade meals.  The desserts look like they were massed produced at Costco , pastries is morning were store bought and stale.   So if food is important factor I wouldn’t come back.  A shame cause the people working here are great.

reviews.author: gi0vannil87
reviews.title: BELLO MA .. DA MIGLIORARE
reviews.text:
Sono stato ospite del Paradisus Palma Real per 10 notti e posso dire che, come gruppo Melia Hotels, questa struttura si presenta come una delle più belle di Punta Cana. L'hotel è ampio e offre diverse zone di svago e intrattenimento.

La mia Suite Master era spaziosa e rispecchiava le mie aspettative, ma la pulizia non è stata sempre all'altezza. Ho notato che le lenzuola non venivano sempre cambiate con la frequenza desiderata e, in alcuni casi, non erano perfettamente pulite. Suggerirei di migliorare la frequenza di cambio delle lenzuola e di assicurarsi che siano sempre bianche e fresche di bucato.

Il buffet iniziale era meraviglioso, ma purtroppo la qualità è calata nei giorni successivi. I ristoranti all'interno dell'hotel, invece, sono stati deludenti. La cucina era priva di sapori e non consiglierei nessuno di questi ristoranti, in particolare il Mascalzone e il ristorante messicano.

La spiaggia era ben attrezzata e il servizio di beverage era eccellente. Tuttavia, se non fosse stato per il buffet, avrei avuto difficoltà a trovare opzioni culinarie soddisfacenti all'interno dell'hotel.

In conclusione, il Paradisus Palma Real è un hotel bellissimo, con paesaggi mozzafiato e acque cristalline. Tuttavia, ci sono margini di miglioramento nella pulizia delle camere e nella qualità dei ristoranti. Spero che queste osservazioni vengano prese in considerazione per migliorare l'esperienza degli ospiti futuri.

reviews.author: wr0d
reviews.title: Paradises
reviews.text: Restaurants too noises, hairdryer broken, room was excellent, and porters, beach service was average.

reviews.author: Lindsay K
reviews.title: Good and bad
reviews.text: At check in we had four rooms and wanted to be near each other but they placed us all over the resort with several rooms on adults only side despite  wanting to be on the family side where the grandkids were. My parents reserved a swim up room on family side but were told they had to go on adult side. No one got a room with double beds as requested. Resort was not accommodating to place dinner reservations for a party of 10 despite asking on day one. It took three different trips to the reservation desk to get three dinners booked. Otherwise we ate at the buffet for all meals . Most of us had diarrhea during the trip and two of us had actual food poisoning with omitting for a day and a half. The resort is beautiful but they were not accommodating to our party of ten. Mina and Hibachi restaurants were excellent everything else was ok. Restaurant staff were very nice but other staff were not as engaging. It was a beautiful resort the pool and beach were great but. Silent dance party was fun. We had a great time bit there were a lot of ups and downs and undue stress. We have been to DR several times and with the amount of resort options we will not choose Paradisus Palma Real again.

reviews.author: Katira M
reviews.title: The quality of the hotel has declined
reviews.text:
I want to start by saying I have stay with the  company for over 10 years and the quality of the service have change. I decided to give a try to Palma since it went through demodulations. 

Let’s start with the check in took me approximately 3 hours to check in the app tells you that you can check in before and is not true. Once there the employees don’t seem to be happy starting from the reception. Shout out to Melvin like a good team player he was trying to help everyone the reception the accommodation and concierge personal. . 

The phone in the room adds inoperable for me that is a safety issue I was not able to communicate with the reception or any building personnel.  Ac stop working in the middle of the night. They came and I have to wait until the morning . 

I also saw a couple complaining that they need it sheets because his child threw up and after an hour they did not received the sheets. 

To be fair the employees are trying really hard but looks like they are not provided with the correct tools. Therefore they are not up to the standards that I am I use to. Please pay a couple of more dollars and go to the hotels in cap Cana are.

reviews.author: Lillyr83
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: The grounds at Paradisus Palma Real were beautiful! The resort itself was really nice. We had a master suite deluxe room and it was spacious and clean. We had a patio with a jacuzzi as well. We were a family of 7 that included 3 children ranging from ages 4-11. We did not think the resort was very kid friendly. It felt more like an adults only resort. Not a lot of entertainment happening at this resort. It was also on the smaller side. We wished there were more activities throughout the day and evening. As for the food, it was ok. Typical resort food. We were disappointed that the restaurant Flora was “adults only” yet there were kids eating there everyday. When I questioned it they said they needed to speak to a superior to get an ok for my children to eat there. Unfortunately, it was not approved. We found that to be unfair. Overall, the employees are such hard workers. Everyone is super nice and friendly. Shout out to our concierge Andres for booking our dinner reservations everyday and sending us the daily programs for activities. The pools are immaculate. The beach was clean but it’s sargassum season so not very clear. This is obviously out of the resorts control but they did work hard to keep up with it.

reviews.author: JAIME N
reviews.title: Buena infrestructura, mal servicio
reviews.text: A pesar que tiene todo para una gran experiencia, la atención del personal no es buena. No reponen los buffets, no están atentos al servicio, en general solo se mueven si hay propinas. No se ven con burna disposición. Mención aparte el buffett que no reponen los productos, se acaban los cubiertos etc etc a pesar que el hotel está con baja ocupación

reviews.author: ronaldo dias
reviews.title: Review of Paradisus Palma Real – A Family Experience with Highs and Lows
reviews.text:
⸻

I recently spent six nights at Paradisus Palma Real with my family, including our young daughter, and wanted to share a balanced perspective that might help other families considering this resort.

⸻

Strengths of Paradisus Palma Real

1. Outstanding Staff

The team at Paradisus truly stood out. Special mention to Ovil, Wilson, Abigail, and Jonathan for their attentiveness and friendliness—especially towards our kids. Their warm attitude added a personal and memorable touch to our stay.

2. Impeccable Cleanliness

The cleanliness across the resort is remarkable. Every restroom, restaurant, and room was spotless and well-maintained. This level of hygiene is a major plus, particularly for families traveling with children.

3. Vibrant Entertainment

Although I regret not catching his name, the staff member overseeing entertainment deserves applause. He was visibly active from morning till night, ensuring that poolside activities and evening shows at Plaza Colonial ran smoothly and with great energy.

4. Diverse Dining Options

With five on-site restaurants, the variety and quality of food were excellent. The chefs were accommodating and happy to tailor dishes to personal requests, which made mealtime both enjoyable and flexible.

5. Engaging Kids’ Activities

There was a full agenda tailored for both adults and children. My daughter especially loved the kids’ programs, which were thoughtfully designed and well-supervised.

⸻

Challenges That Affected Our Experience

Unfortunately, a major drawback during our stay was the resort’s handling of a large international congress that coincided with our vacation. Hosting 500+ conference guests appeared to take priority over the experience of remaining leisure travelers—roughly 250 of us—including families like mine.

Here are a few specific concerns:
	•	Night Entertainment Disruption (June 19): A private event for the congress replaced the regular programming at Plaza Colonial. This meant families missed out on the beloved music show from 6:00 to 9:00 PM, leaving our little one disappointed and without her usual nightly routine.
	•	Noise Pollution from Late Events: While family-friendly events at Plaza Colonial ended by 10:30 PM, a Karaoke night for the congress continued until 11:10 PM—directly below the Ocean View Suites. This inconsistency disrupted our sleep, especially for our child.

Despite raising these issues with Manager Willy and the Guest Experience team—who listened respectfully—it’s clear that better balance and coordination are needed when hosting large conventions alongside family-oriented guests. Of our six nights, two were notably disturbed by excessive noise from late-night karaoke or bar events.

⸻

Final Thoughts and Recommendation

We genuinely enjoyed many aspects of Paradisus Palma Real and were impressed by the staff, cleanliness, and programming. However, the decision to prioritize a corporate event at the cost of family guests’ comfort left us disappointed—especially considering the financial investment involved.

Advice for Future Guests with Children:
If you’re traveling with little ones, I strongly advise carefully choosing your room category. Avoid Ocean View Suites during peak event seasons, as the location may expose you to late-night disturbances, making it hard to rest—just as it happened to us.

Would I return? Possibly, but only with clear assurances that our family’s peace and comfort won’t be compromised by overlapping corporate events.

reviews.author: Monica A
reviews.title: Despite its potential, the stay didn’t meet expectations - I wouldn't recommend it.
reviews.text:
We were really looking forward to our stay as we were celebrating a family birthday and chose this hotel based on its amenities and positive reputation. As a well-traveled (80+ countries), adult family (age 44+) who enjoys staying active, we were especially excited about the tennis courts and included water activities.

Unfortunately, upon arrival we learned that all the tennis courts were under construction and unavailable for the entirety of our 7-day stay. It would have been helpful to know this in advance, as tennis was one of the main reasons we selected this property.

The water activities, while technically included, were located at a nearby sister hotel—not on the property as we had expected. This was an acceptable alternative, though worth noting for future guests. The beach had quite a bit of seaweed during our stay, and the swimming area was limited due to buoys placed for safety, as there was significant boat traffic just beyond the designated swim zone.

That said, the hotel grounds were beautiful, the property was well-maintained, and the service overall was warm and welcoming. Staff were friendly, concierge was incredibly helpful and the hotel was clean and inviting throughout our stay. As a business consultant, I could write a book, but I wasn't expecting perfection - but what's fair for a hotel of this caliber.

There are a few other areas where we felt the experience could be improved. While there are “no smoking” signs posted throughout the property, enforcement seemed inconsistent. Guests were frequently smoking in common areas, including at the swim-up bar and right next to non-smoking guests. When we brought it up to staff, they appeared unaware of the policy or unsure of how to address it. Similarly, the adult-only areas were not consistently monitored, which affected the experience for those seeking a quieter atmosphere.

The pool itself, while large and visually impressive, was another point of concern. The depth was uniformly around 4.5 to 4.75 feet—even at the steps—which made it difficult to relax or wade comfortably, especially for shorter guests. There was no shallow area aside from a small baby pool and the bar stools at the swim-up bar, which was surprising given that the pools accommodate children as well.

One of the more disappointing aspects of our stay was the food. While we understand the challenges of maintaining high standards at an all-inclusive resort, we found the buffet options to be lukewarm at best—even during peak dinner hours around 6:30 p.m. Some items, particularly fish and meat, lacked the warmth and freshness we’d expect. Most of the meats were tough - probably due to keeping them warm over a long period of time without turnover, but when items like fish are to be kept cold, and the plate they're on is room temp - that's a huge safety concern and something that wouldn't be acceptable in the US.  The breads also tended to be stale, likely due to humidity and low turnover, which may have been affected by the low occupancy during our visit (less than 50%).

Overall, while the property and staff had many positive qualities, there were several missed expectations and inconsistencies that impacted our overall experience. We truly wanted to love our stay, and with a few adjustments, this could be a fantastic destination.

reviews.author: Nicole C
reviews.title: Caro y aburrido. Comida de mediana calidad y pocas actividades. No lo recomiendo
reviews.text: Lo único bueno del hotel fueron sus instalaciones. Quedamos con un trago bastante amargo de la experiencia. Para ser un hotel 5 Estrellas y el más costoso de la cadena de hoteles del sector; es muy débil respecto a las actividades lúdicas tanto para niños como para adultos. El pool bar principal, aburrido, sin onda, poca variedad de alcoholes y olvídate de pedir un cóctel bien preparado…qué decir de la música ( la misma playlist de 10 canciones sonando todo el santo día) poco ambiente; sin animación o guía para saber qué actividades hay programadas durante la jornada. Los monitores pasaban más dentro de la piscina que realizando actividades. Niños aburridos y papás desilusionados. Si van en plan pasarlo bien y con ganas de bailar por las noches este hotel NO es la opción. Respecto a la comida… poca variedad, poco saludable; literal todos los días los mismos platillos; no hay refree; la calidad de los vinos es mailisima, dos o tres tipos de jugos… y los rest temáticos… malos; salvo por ahí uno mexicano; el resto… horrible. A las 1 am el hotel ya está muerto; no tiene discotec.  Creo que no habían más de 60 personas  en todo el hotel - ojalá cambie la administración porque no le veo futuro considerando otras cadenas de hoteles.

reviews.author: Andy1936
reviews.title: Average experience, not 5-star
reviews.text:
I've stayed in 20+ hotels in the last year, everything from 5-star Maldives to 1-star motel in Australia, even 2 Airbnbs. This resort is by far the most inconsistent experience. 

Housekeeping is all over the place, sometimes not remembering to make up our room, sometimes forgetting to replenish tea and coffee, sometimes missing a towel or flannel. It's surprisingly basic stuff and tells me there's a lack of process and checklists. 

Food standard is pretty average. There's much made on the website about the high end restaurants, it's not reality. Most meals were fine, but the standard of cooking suggests the chefs need further training to align with the aspirations to be finer dining. That said we found The Winery, Mina and Tokimeku to be good, you can tell it's close to being consistently really good.

Overall I wouldn't return here. And I'd advise anyone who is really looking for great food and consistently high standards to look elsewhere. But if you like big resorts, if food isn't that important, if you're more relaxed about consistency, this could still be perfect for you. Especially if you're in The Reserve and you have someone like Zenovia as your concierge... she was brilliant. As was management when they were made aware of some of the issues.

reviews.author: francisbaez15
reviews.title: Mala experiencia
reviews.text: Durante tres días de estadía no pasaron a limpiar la habitación, personal con mas lo gestos como que le estaban pidiendo favores

reviews.author: comecoco1
reviews.title: La oferta culinaria no estuvo a la altura del hotel
reviews.text: Las atenciones de los maleteros es muy buena pues desde que llegas te dan el soporte necesario hasta llegar a tu habitacion.  El proceso de registro fue rapido. La habitacion 6101, estuvo bien, el baño limpio aunque tuve que llamar para que me trajeran jabon pues ni en el lavamanos ni en la bañera habia (ni liquido ni solido). Las almohadas son comodas y mullidas, se descansa bien. No es la primera vez que voy pero esta vez la experiencia culinaria fue pesima, El desayuo estuvo aeptable, al medio dia el buffet no tuvo la variedad, calidad y sabor de las visitas anteriores. solo comi pescado y embutidos. el gran problema fueron las cenas, para lograr una reserva en cualquiera de los restaurantes tematicas es muy. dificil pues debes levantarte temprano para ser de los primieros en el lugar de las reservas. Si lograbas una, como paso con unos amigos que lograron una reserva para la ultima hora en el restaurant de carnes, la espera para la comida fue de 25 minutos.  Por otro lado este fin de semana en las noches cerraban el buffett grande y solo estaba abierto el pequeño (Malva), la oferta para la cena no era atractiva y el lugar donde estaba la comida no oliva agradable. Ademas parece que estaban con poco personal, pues para lograr una bebida tuve que pararme a solicitarla a Host en la puerta.  Entiendo que no deben bajar su calidad y volver a estar a la altura de antes.

reviews.author: meltonsrus
reviews.title: 2nd trip to Paradis Palma Real, 4th trip to a Paradisis Property in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Hard to get dinner reservations, in the past we set them up for the week as we arrived and had coffee delivered rom service every morning at a set time.  Neither was available on this trio in spite of paying for "The Reserve".   A great was our beach was about the only beach free of sorgasm grass,  It was raked daily with a floating barrier in place.  Food was good at sit down places, OK on buffet.   Great nightly entertainment in the square.  Bring bug spray!!!

reviews.author: Tonivlc
reviews.title: No es el hotel que yo esperaba
reviews.text: Para mi y mi pareja no es un hotel de ( estrellas de lujo le falta mucho para tener ya que nosotros estavamos en. the level  habitacion suite real  no tiene el servicio que esperavamos los restaurantes la comida muy regular sin surtido solo valia el restaurante de the level el servicio de playa fatal la animacion regular es la segunda ves que hemos hido a este hotel una 2008 y a hora 2025 por probar  ya hemos hido a la republica dominica 10 veces pero a este hotel no volveremos mas

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: PROBABLY WON'T RETURN
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, there was total chaos at the front desk. There were 4 in my group, and 2 arrived approx 2 hours before the rest of us  and still had not gotten their room key. 3 of us reserved swim up King rooms and there were only 2 available. The mini bar was not stocked and the snacks  were stale.

The grounds are an 8 out of 10 but the service was not what you would expect from a 4 Diamond rated resort.

Initially when we tried to make dinner reservations we were told all the  restaurants were booked  thru Sunday..mind you we arrived on Wednesday.  We had to reach out to a gentleman named Antonio who went out of his way to get us reservations. Baffles me how a person could say the restaurants were all booked for dinner but you are checking guests in. THANK GOODNESS FOR HIM.  Also, Jose Rameriaz was also very helpful during our stay. THANKS JOSE! 
The food was nothing to brag about and was average. All guest have to eat  breakfast at one location unless you are club members..I  assume they have other options.
Additionally,  I  would suggest arranging your own transportation to and from the airport as the resort has no dedicated transportation service.
I don't know if this review will elicit a response and I really don't want to hear back from the resort. I WILL JUST SAY THAT THE CUSTOMER SERVICE NEEDS TO DRASTICALLY IMPROVE ESPECIALLY AT THE FRONT DESK. ONCE AGAIN, THANKS TO JOSE AND ANTONIO FOR THEIR EFFORTS

reviews.author: Shawn K
reviews.title: Not a four diamond resort as advertised
reviews.text:
The resort itself is so beautiful and breathtaking - beach, pools and open spaces. However the food doesn’t match the level of the resort.  It’s just plain bad and not edible. There are a lot of options but nothing is good.  The beef doesn’t taste like beef, salad leaves are wilted, and the seafood is so overcooked & fishy.    We expected the buffet to be not good but the restaurants aren’t even better.  And this resort is supposed to be 4 diamonds.  

Some notable cons:
There are too many commissioned locals going around trying to sell you excursions and DR souvenirs. The same people go around throughout the day and asking you over and over again despite having said we are not interested.  

People take your sunscreen so don’t leave them lying around. I should expected this since they charge $34 for a 6oz spray at the gift shop.

Unless you staying at the Reserve section or paying for concierge service, getting reservation at the restaurants is nearly impossible. We had to tip our ‘unofficial’ concierge $50 to get reservations for the entire week. Since the buffet food is so not edible, this was worth it. But this should not have been the norm, especially since the restaurant was half empty around 6pm. The resort may be doing this purposely to get more people to eat at the buffet. Again the restaurants wasn’t that much better than the buffet but at least the restaurant food was edible.

Lastly, housekeeping took our housekeeping tips without actually cleaning the room and restocking the items. We had to bring this up with someone each day to get water, towels and toilet paper restocked.

We will not be coming back to this resort but what a shame, the resort is so nice and had great resort activities.

reviews.author: Nasti58
reviews.title: Decepción total
reviews.text:
El personal es muy amable (sonrisa Disney) pero ineficaz. Tuvimos un problema y pese estar en la zona reservada para adultos y en teoría disponer de un "concierge" para nosotros, hasta que no hablamos con la dirección el problema no se solventó. Estuvimos más de cuatro días perdiendo tiempo de vacaciones buscando quién podía solucionar el problema. No nos funcionaba el teléfono y mi marido no se encontraba bien. Por la noche era angustioso ya que si se ponía peor hasta que llegaba a la recepción para avisar, se quedaba solo. El teléfono de emergèncias del baño tampoco funcionaba.
Las cenas en los restaurantes temáticos son desagradables por los grupos, sobre todo americanos, que hablan tan fuerte y hacen tanto ruido que no oyes ni al camarero e imposible mantener una conversación, pero nadie les llama la atención.
Mucho mejor estar con niños que con estos grupos.
Los parterres de las habitaciones en la zona que estábamos estaban muy descuidados y casi cada día había un pintor que iba dando brochazos pintando los desperfectos de la pared pero no lo indicaban y si te apoyabas te manchabas la ropa.
Las instalaciones en la playa están en mal estado. Hay como unas camas que están rotas y no aplanan la arena, o sea que quedan torcidas y estás muy incómodo.
Pesaban muchísimo para moverlas y en general, aunque vean que estás intentando acomodarte, el personal de la playa se queda en la zona del bar hablando entre ellos.
Mención especial por su interés y amabilidad a Pedro, personal que nos atendía en la playa que se desvivió por hacer nuestra estancia agradable. Zenobia también se tomó mucho interés.
No aconsejo este hotel. Hemos estado varias veces en República Dominicana y hay otras cadenas mucho mejores.

reviews.author: damonpollard24
reviews.title: Not what I was expecting
reviews.text: I was excited about my stay and even more so once I arrived and saw how beautiful the grounds were. The staff was great and our personal concierge was great. That's were the excited ended. Restaurants were not great. Not enough food options for someone with a restricted diet.

reviews.author: Terri R
reviews.title: Beautiful place but lacks all-inclusive and adults-only experience
reviews.text:
Paradisus has some of the best food we've had at an all-inclusive. While there is only one buffet, it is delicious and has something for everyone, including vegetarians and those dairy-free. We had dinner at three of the restaurants available to non-members and can recommend Flora (Dominican) and Mascalzone (Italian). Skip Blue Agave (Mexican).

Paradisus has the most luxurious room we've enjoyed at an all-inclusive. There's a king size bed, soaking tub, lounge area, and balcony, among other amenities. Note: we paid for the adults-only area of the hotel, and the rooms were set up with couples in mind. There is no private space to dress, other than a light curtain around the bath area. If you are traveling with a friend or family member, I suggest asking if there are rooms with more privacy.

Even with the best food and room–and with the hotel situated directly on a gorgeous and inviting beachfront–I felt misled. The hotel photos and map boast 10+ restaurants and a plethora of pools, but non-members are relegated to one-third of the property, including only a handful of restaurants and 2 pools. Smell a barbecue wafting from a pool deck? Ignore it. Looking for an adults-only experience? It’s simply not there for non-members and should not be offered (and up-charged!).

Everyone can enjoy the beachfront activities (paddle board, snorkeling, boogie board, and catamaran), fitness center, and daily aqua exercising. Also available to all are the nighttime performances and parties. During our stay, these included a fun silent dance party and a kooky “under-the-sea” themed concert complete with familiar sing-along tunes and photo ops with staff dressed as sea creatures.

Paradisus was a quieter, calmer all-inclusive, and I appreciate that might be just the ticket for first-timers or families looking for a low-key, easy break. The staff were unfailingly nice. With its all-white buildings, terra cotta rooftops, and pristine grounds, the word that came to mind was “classy”. We definitely want that in our all-inclusive. But we also want the fun, abundance, and yes, inclusiveness that the all-inclusive name suggests. With so many members-only restaurants, pools, and beach segments, I found myself feeling confined by our third day. Thus, while we are glad to have visited this once, I’m not at all sure we’ll be back.

reviews.author: Xavier_Kuri
reviews.title: Nice resort, but food and service could be better
reviews.text:
The positives: hotel grounds are very nice and the renovation looks great, with stylish and tasteful decor and quality interiors.
The negatives: Service was hot or cold (whether super friendly and warm, or rude and unhelpful). The food was OK at best, but sometimes it was difficult to find good options in the buffet (yes, hundred of options, but most was from mediocre to not that great, especially desserts). Also most of the staff was expecting (high) tips, which added some tension to the interactions and also triggered rudeness if they were not happy with it.

reviews.author: Golf_Mom79
reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, absolutely stunning resort. The open lobby area overlooks the main pool and you can see the ocean behind it. Very clean and spectacular from the entry. As we arrived in a very large group, the check in was easy and our bags would be brought to our room. Only problem at check in was that we didn't actually know how to get to our room, so a very kind gentleman, Robindson, helped us on our way. It's a very large resort, with the family area rooms on one side and the adults only area on the other. In the center are all the restaurants, the courtyard overlooking the pool (which is where the shows are at night).

The rooms in the adult side aren't huge but spacious enough that you can put away most of your clothes. The bathroom is large and enclosed with sheer curtains, with an open tub (it was lovely!), glass shower, and a separate area for the toilet. The room was clean and our cleaning lady was awesome. There is a mini fridge stocked with water, pop, and beer and snacks are replenished daily as well. We were in building 6 overlooking the back of the property (which actually looks over another resort). There was a roadway behind us that was constantly being used by resort trucks and the other resort but it wasn't too loud.

The adult pool is very large and quiet. It's located beside the spa (which is outdoors?) so it's pretty quiet music playing. The pool is deep-- I'm 5'8" and had to walk on my toes to be comfortable. Suggest bringing or buying a floatie to relax better (I sat on the stairs often). Not a ton of shade, but lots of chairs all with umbrellas surrounding the pool. The bar at the adult only pool wasn't great. It was often understaffed and most of the times they didn't know how to make simple drinks and there wasn't a great variety. Little to no poolside service. Drinks served in paper cups and paper straws, so bring a tumbler to put your drinks in (really helps as the pool is so deep). There are absolutely no activities at this pool, so if you like quiet and unbothered (other than the occasional spa worker) this is a great spot. I just wished the bartenders were a bit more energetic and knowledgeable.

The main pool is huge. Lots of umbrellas and tikis. There's an area for whole family and an area for just adults (again this part is really deep!!) Really appreciated all the spots to sit and talk with people in the pool--ie sunken loungers in the water and little sitting booths in the water. Higher energy and this where the aerobics and all the activities get done. I saw a really cool activity on paddle boards in the pool where they were dancing or doing a workout on the boards that I wish I had gotten there earlier for. The bar is well staffed and busy. The drinks were really good. When I asked for something and they didn't have the ingredients, Jonathan was quick to come up with something else for me. Lots of energy of the bartenders, lots of smiles.

Beach area had lots of Tikis and loungers. There is a separate area on the beach for the Adults Only as well as the reserve--these chairs have soft mattresses on the loungers so a bit more comfortable. The water was pretty wavy, lots of wind comes up in the afternoon, but the water was lovely. There's  a quick drop off at shoulder height but nothing too bad. The beach is nice sand, raked daily.

I did the Lunch Box for Buffet breakfast most days. Lots of selection. 3 omelette stations, lots of fruit, a self serve juice/mimosa station. Foods from different areas of the world. If it was made in front of you it was delicious. If you chose precooked pancakes, eggs, avocado toast, it didn't taste anything spectacular. It was ok, just not anything I'd grab the next day. This is also one of the only places open for lunch. Burgers, nachos, pizza, salad, pasta, fish, and world cuisine all available. One day we had lunch in Malva, the Adults only buffet. It was much smaller and very little options which was disappointing.

For dinner you will need to make a reservation, and they seemed to go quickly. I tried the Malcazone (Italien) twice and was underwhelmed with my meal both times. The spinach salad on the other hand was delicious (and my boyfriend loved the caprese salad and the pizza).

The Mexican restaurant (name is excaping me) was ok. I"m having trouble remembering what I had to eat but I remember it being not bad, just not great. Atmosphere was nice though.

Flora, the Dominican restaurant, was my favourite. Lots of interesting appetizers that were quite tasty. I had the gnocchi for dinner and was less impressed. But the atmosphere was great and the service was great.

We didn't eat at the steakhouse or the Tepanaki restaurants. We heard good things about the menu at the Sports Bar and tried to go there for lunch but they don't serve food until 3 or 3:30 pm.

Took me 2 days to find it, but the GinGer lounge is a terrific spot in the lobby upstairs for coffees in the morning or smoothies. Also for a night cap at the end of the day. They had great bartenders and great selection of booze. At night there was often live music which was wonderful. Lots of cozy little spots to sit at. Which I had found it earlier on in the trip.

Gym was nice, but busy. Lots of treadmills, bikes, machines in the middle. Not a ton of room for free weights or laying down to do abs but able to make do. Water, fruits, towels all supplied in the gym. Friendly gentleman (I wish I knew his name) that oversees the gym and helps you out as needed.

Overall, I had a great trip with the company I was with. For the most part I had an amazing time. I've been to several resorts in Dominican, Cuba, and Mexico, and seemed underwhelmed by the service and the food for the most part at this resort. It was clean, but dated and needed some work: there were many missing tiles in the main pool; the server's station outside for the servers in the buffet looked like it was being held together with zip ties. Many people we were with had a good time, but the common complaint was the service and lack of knowledge of the adult pool bar staff and that the food wasn't as good as they were hoping. We also had a good number of people in our group who had stomach issues for a day or two.

reviews.author: h0ch0e
reviews.title: Nice hotel but inconsistent service
reviews.text: Facility and room were great. Service was not reliable - our room was not ready when we arrived; concierge did not follow through on reservations (do it on your own as soon as you arrive!); cleaning staff did not clean our room one day.

reviews.author: Brennan H
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort Cold Food
reviews.text:
High Potential resort, struggled to deliver

Positives:
-brand new rooms
-well laid resort 
-big buffet and many restaurants 

Negatives:
-buffet food was cold
- a lot of staff but weren’t happy most of the time
- very little entertainment besides nightly entertainment

reviews.author: anapm95
reviews.title: Una experiencia bastante desagradable
reviews.text:
Muy mal trato, fuimos al mejor “hotel” y nadie pudo ayudarnos nunca. 
No podíamos ni comer por falta de un mayordomo que ellos deberían de haber asignado a cada habitación. 
Al momento de hacer el check in me dieron una habitación con personas dentro, para después decirme que una de mis tres habitaciones una había sido modificada para abril por alguien en recepción a una hora en la que yo no estaba ni siquiera en República Dominicana.
La inseguridad que nos causo a un grupo de 8 mujeres que pudimos entrar a una  habitacion ocupada y que cualquier persona podía modificar mi reserva. 
A la mañana siguiente fui a recepción a ver lo de la modificación y no solo me querían hechar la culpa si no que querían cobrarme la habitación a la tarifa del dia cuando yo hice mi reserva desde octubre del 2024.
En fin una experiencia bastante desagradable ya que nadie tomaba responsabilidad ni estaba dispuesto a resolver o mínimo a ayudar
Después de todo esto no recibimos ni una disculpa, ni un chocolate, ni una recompensa.

reviews.author: Diane C
reviews.title: Décevant
reviews.text: Positif et négatif.nous sommes un couple avec beaucoup de voyages tout inclus adultes à notre actif.Nous étions ds la section La réserve,face à la mer bloc 8 au 3 ième étages SANS ASCENCEUR pourtant c’est écrit avec ascenceur??La chambre était bien ,meublé ikea,propre,correcte,avec une belle vue.A notre arrivée pas de consommation de bienvenue,une première.Le concierge parlait français à notre demande concierge invisible Thomas ,car il n’est pas venu nous voir  durant notre séjour seulement ,communication par. whatsapp . Dès le début de notre rencontre il nous a avisé que c’était difficile d’avoir des réservations aux restos à la carte.C’était lui qui jour par jour choisissait les réservations selon les disponibilités.On a parlé au représentant de transat il est a parlé au concierge et nous avons pu y allé.A chaque resto il avait des tables de libre ?? De toute façon ça ne vaut pas la peine car les menus sont avec peu de choix et des extra partant à  $50.00 us.et le buffet offre les mêmes choses.Seul le santé vaut la peine.La plage et les piscines sont correcte mais sans serveurs,Peut-être un qui est discret tellement qu’il faut nous même aller chercher nos consommations.Les bains tourbillons dans la piscine sont tous brisés.1 fois sur 2 ils nous donnent des verres de cartons pour les consommations.Ahhhhh à la plage aux 2 minutes les vendeurs itinérants du matin au soir nous sollicitent 😡Les spectacles,chanteurs/ses instrumentalismes sont bons.Mais ils sont à ciel ouvert et c’est venteux et froid,seul le bar ginger est mieux.Il y a beaucoup de famille avec des enfants aux restos et partout sauf à la plage et certaines piscines.Rien à grignoté durant la journée à moins d’aller au resto à la plage et on ne peut pas sortir de nourriture Il fait froid dans les restos et la musique américaine très forte partout..Voilà notre opinion.Nous n’irons plus au Paradius Palma Réal.

reviews.author: Sunil K
reviews.title: POOR SERVICE AND GOT CHEATED
reviews.text: Was a nice stay up until check out.  We were given $200 worth of resort credit (coupons) which winded up being worthless !  The Rep. at checkout said we should have used them at the Spa.  How ever Spa staff said we could use them at checkout.  I informed the front desk Rep. of this.  He proceeded to call a member of Spa staff to sort it out.  Turns out she told my wife she could either take discount she's giving her OR use the coupon.  Not both.  I accepted this  I apologized to both Spa Rep. for the mis understanding.  The discounts we were given added up to $115.  So they owed us $85 in credit/discount ($200 - $115).  Front desk Rep. refused.  I kept explaining that we only got $115 in credit.  He kept saying we were supposed to use coupons at Spa.  I explained to him several times that staff told us we could use at checkout.  & that staffs' English wasn't the best.  That likely wjat caused the confusion.  He wasn't polite at all.  Very curt & kept saying, he couldn't change amt. in system.  I worked in hotel industry.  There is always a way to over ride, correct charges.  I asked for a manager.  He didn't attempt ot call one.  Just said they are not available.  Right ???  This huge resort has no manager available to handle price discrepancies/disputes ???  I explained to him, I'm not stupid.  AND I just saw them lying to guests.  Saying they did not have change.  However when customer pressed, signal was given by a colleague to open drawer & give change !  ... to make a long story short,  I walked out of hotel, yelling these guys were cheating me and this isn't service I'd expect from " 5 Star " resort.  My wife pressured me back inside.  She acknowledged I was indeed being cheated, but to go ahead and pay.  So I did.  It left a very bad taste in my mouth though.  I don 't like being lied to & cheated.  It wasn't so much about the money either.  The attitude, rudeness and disregard by this gentleman was totally wrong.  Unfortunately I don't know his name.  Lucky for him I guess. He didn't once try to understand our point of view, apologize, empathize or anything.  They treat Club Members differently/better.  Perhaps Club members are the only ones they break $10 bill for ???  In summary, don't expect them to care about your greivances.  Don't expect to be respected and valued as a customer.  And don't expect to speak to a Mgr. in charge.  Pretty property but bad memories !!!

reviews.author: msteigerwald2025
reviews.title: Great Stay, But the Food Was a Disappointment
reviews.text:
I had an overall pleasant stay at. The rooms were comfortable though noisy/bright, the staff was mostly friendly, and the amenities were well-maintained. However, the food experience left much to be desired.

Unfortunately, the food was consistently served cold or, at best, lukewarm. Whether it was breakfast, room service, or dinner at the restaurant, I found myself wishing for a hot meal but was repeatedly disappointed. This was particularly frustrating given the otherwise high standards of the hotel.

If the kitchen could improve on this, it would make a huge difference. Until then, I’d recommend the hotel for its accommodations but suggest looking elsewhere for meals.

reviews.author: richard c
reviews.title: problems with resort
reviews.text:
PROBLEMS. My wife and myself booked our 50-wedding anniversary in November 2024. we booked the ocean front reserve adult room. When we arrived, they said they did not have a room till the next day. UNBELIVEABLE, how can that be.  Then they put us in a room looking at a wall. WE TRIED TO STAY POSITIVE. The next day we moved our luggage to the ocean front room we booked and thought everything would be ok. Then we found out the room was not stocked; the room had no hot water and the internet didn't work. We took a cold shower and went to dinner. I spent a substantial amount of time trying to get the issues resolved but the PRIVATE CHECK IN area was useless to fix our issues. Everyone said don't worry we will take care of it.  Our concierge tried but it was out of his control. It seemed it was out of everyone's control. My wife was very upset as this was our 50th wedding VACATION. I booked a spa treatment for my wife (paid for by hotel) and when I was back in the private check in to push for our new room number, they told me we did not have a spa booked. They made me go back to the SPA and I verified we had a booked time for 10AM the next day. So, I went back to the PRIVATE CHECK IN AND THEY BASICALLY SAID NOTHING.  It appears one hand doesn't know what the other hand is doing. Finally, they fixed the hot water and internet in oceanfront room and now it was the 3rd day since we arrived for our 7-day vacation. In talking to other guests, some of them had similar issues with the room not being available. I attribute all these issues to a MANAGEMENT PROBLEM not the staff. It is incomprehensible to me that your reservation system doesn't know the rooms are booked or the spa has been booked. I would take a hard look at management and the systems. 

On the positive side THE RESORT was well kept. The staff was friendly, and the beach was beautifully maintained. The staff on the reserve beach was very accommodating especially Martin and the bartenders at both beach bars. The food was plentiful in multiple locations' the Sante and Mexican restaurants were very good, the buffets were clean and good. The Japanese and steak restaurants were very disappointing, but we had other options. 
All In all, if we didn't have the issues, I think would have rated the resort higher but it was unfortunate we had all those issues.

reviews.author: poriain
reviews.title: The small things weren't done right
reviews.text:
The resort was very nice and well presented. Clean with good food. Buffets had great selection. Miguel and Maria at the rum bar and Ana Michal at Flores were the best staff we encountered. 
But small things weren't done properly. The adults only section of the beach wasn’t enforced or properly sign posted so as a result families with children disturbing the peace were allowed to remain there and complaints fell on deaf ears. If you’re looking for a peaceful vacation do not come here. The restaurant booking process is awful. You stand in a line for 20 mins to book for only up to 3 days in advance which means you have to stand in the line with everyone else multiple times, and then they tell you the restaurants are full or you get crap seating times. One night we didn’t get dinner until after 10pm. It’s a decent resort but it’s not being played on an A game by management. There’s better options for the price.

reviews.author: Dan C
reviews.title: Most Recent Stay
reviews.text:
The level of service and hospitality is much better at other islands.  The beach was full of trash on most days and not one person picked it up.  The constant selling of absolutely anything from either workers on the beach or even their own staff is annoying.  There was only a handful of employees that we felt were at the level this hotel is suggesting they are.  Food choices were not bad, although they became repetitive.  The reservation of restaurant reviews is legit, however $20 here and there got us what we wanted and needed so everyone unfortunately not fair, could be bought, which sucks for the people who would never think about doing something like that or its not part of their culture.  Activities for kids were far and beyond, but hey take a 2 hour tour to hear about what we could sell you, and they will get us some water park tickets for the day.  No thank you- again, $20 to a worker got us in no problem and we didn't need to waste hours out of our day.  I must say the grounds are impeccable, hats off to all of the grounds staff. a good brand of alcohol doesn't exist here again unless your privileged ( or in our case we were nice to the workers and gained a relationship which went a long way)  So , to sum it all up, i think this hotel has a long way to go to become something special.  Right now its just a nice hotel on the water.  The lack of hospitality is genuinely missing and you cant just get that.  Hire staff that fit your mission, it'll be better for the guests instead of having to deal with staff that doesn't want to be there.  Last item- individual restaurants ask if you have a food allergy.  However i don't think they understand what the allergies actually are.  Lactose is what everyone assumes but dairy allergy is not a lactose allergy, they are quite different.  The level of English speaking cooks or servers to get answers to questions is far to come by, and when you did find someone, they didn't know for sure.  Knowledge is key. Training is a must.  I am a Chef at a resort as well, and man to I feel luckily with how knowledgeable my staff is and the level of training that we have gone through to make sure these situations that I dealt with at palma real doesn't happen.  It all starts from above- Above needs to implement change and this hotel will only be average until change takes place. 
Shout out to Jose from bar in between blue agave and Italian, as well as Ricky from the buffet!  They were excellent!

reviews.author: Emilio O
reviews.title: Disappointed!
reviews.text:
When we first go to the resort we were surprised how beautiful the hotel was pictures online did not do justice. Then we realized how unhelpful and rude the staff was even through tipping we felt we were inconvenienced for the staff not one smile or hello anywhere around. Food was terrible specially at the buffet! 
Has the staff was a little nicer the experience would have been better.

reviews.author: Heidi R
reviews.title: A Mixed Experience at Paradisus Palma Real – Hoping for Better in the Future
reviews.text:
Having stayed at Paradisus Palma Real multiple times, I was looking forward to another relaxing vacation. The property has always been one of my favorites for its lush, tropical grounds and stunning setting. Unfortunately, this trip left me questioning whether I’d return.
The Good
The resort’s grounds are as lush and beautiful as ever, making it a perfect backdrop for morning runs or leisurely walks. The pools are plentiful, with ample lounge chairs and shady spots for guests to relax.
I also loved the coffee bar, which became a favorite spot in the evenings. Enjoying an espresso martini while listening to a violinist play pop covers was a delightful experience—very Bridgerton-esque!
The Disappointing
Check-In Experience
Despite being a repeat guest and noting that we were celebrating both my birthday (the day before our arrival) and my daughter’s birthday (three days after our departure), there was no acknowledgment of these milestones. It was a disappointing start to the trip, especially since these details were included in our reservation.
I requested a room closer to the beach for convenience, but most rooms near the beach seemed reserved for Circle members or other unclear categories. We were placed far from the beach, making trips to our room inconvenient.
Upon arrival, it was pouring rain, and it appeared that the housekeeping carts had been left exposed. Our bed was made with damp sheets that smelled awful. To make matters worse, the sheets were put on incorrectly (in the wrong direction so they did not cover the length of the mattress), forcing me to remake the bed myself after housekeeping ignored the issue the following day.
The thermostat in the room was permanently set to not go below 69°F, but the air conditioning never cooled the room below 70°F, which made it uncomfortable at times. Additionally, the room safe was broken upon arrival, and despite requesting for it to be fixed, it was never repaired during our stay. We also had to request snacks to be restocked in the room, as they were replenished sparingly.
Dining Challenges
Restaurant reservations were a disaster. We checked in on Monday afternoon and immediately went to make dinner reservations, only to be told the system closed at 4 PM. The next morning, we tried again and were told everything was fully booked except for a late 9 PM slot on Thursday. This would have left us eating at the buffet for every meal, which was not what I envisioned for our trip.
A manager eventually helped secure some reservations, but it was stressful and completely unnecessary. Strangely, all the restaurants appeared to have many empty tables, leaving guests frustrated and confused as to why reservations were so limited. Additionally, you can’t make reservations in advance of your stay, which makes no sense for a property this size.
Food Quality:
•	Mascalzone (Italian) and Blue Agave (Mexican) were, in my opinion, the best options with attentive service and enjoyable meals.
•	Flora (Dominican) had a challenging menu, and we ultimately opted to leave and eat at Kicks, the sports bar, which offered typical bar food.
•	Tokimeku (Hibachi) was underwhelming. The chicken was rubbery, and the steak was tough.
•	The buffet offered a wide selection, but much of the food seemed to sit out too long, and staple items were often unavailable. For example, spinach and tomatoes for omelets were missing one morning, and chicken breast—a go-to lunch option for me—was unavailable for the entire trip (I used to get it every day during my prior visits to Paradisus).
Shortages of Basics
One of the most frustrating aspects of this trip was the frequent shortages of basic items. For instance, I tried to order a Dirty Monkey, a favorite vacation drink, only to find they were out of bananas for 2 days and chocolate syrup – which they never got in stock for my entire stay. These shortages happened repeatedly and detracted from the overall experience.
Final Thoughts
While Circle members and guests in upgraded rooms seem to enjoy a more seamless experience, it’s disappointing that regular guests are treated as an afterthought. The inconsistent service, dining reservation issues, and basic shortages made it difficult to fully relax and fully enjoy the trip.
That said, the property remains stunning, and I’ve had wonderful experiences here in the past. However, this visit has left me wondering if it’s time to explore other options for my next trip to Punta Cana.
Melia, please take a closer look at this beautiful property and the guest experience—it deserves better.

reviews.author: Karell R
reviews.title: Un peu plus un peu moins
reviews.text: Nous sommes partis en famille à trois, des adultes murs, mes parents et moi. nous logions dans la section "The Reserve", car l'hôtel général est plutôt bruyant, pour plus de tranquilité. L'hôtel possédait avant une discothèque et un casino et a souhaité se réorienter vers plus de sérénité. Les bains à remous ne fonctionnent plus depuis des années. L'hôtel a été construit en 2006, et est relativement vétuste bien remarquablement propre et bien entretenu. L'hôtel est situé sur l'Atlantique, si bien que l'eau n'est pas turquoise, trouble et en sus pleine de détritus. Je vous déconseille l'attraction touristique proposée "Monkeyland', qui est onéreuse, où les singes sont en cages et est une vraie arnaque à touristes. Le conseiller en activités Salvador est très gentil et de très bon conseil, vous trouverez son bureau à l'accueil de l'hôtel près de la boutique. Le concierge Eriol d'origine haitienne est très francophone et francophile et était très à l'écoute de nos demandes. Les prix en dollars US sont exorbitants même au regard d'un porte-monnaie américain. Vous serez souvent harangués par les locaux pour vous vendre toutes sortes de services ou de babioles, même sur la plage de l'hôtel. La nourriture des buffets est plutôt moyenne avec quelques petites confections qui se démarquent, donc il faut tester et voir. Comme restaurants, je vous recommande le Flora (cuisine dominicaine), le Blueagave (cuisine mexicaine) et le restaurant asiatique pour l'expérience. Commandez vos jus frais pressés le matin, il n'y en a pas le reste de la journée. Le cadre, cependant, est supérieur à de nombreux autres hôtels, même plus récents, dans un style andalou avec colonnades, patios et fontaines, l'hôtel est plutôt vert. Le SPA asiatique est magnifique même si nous n'en avons pas testé les services. Les piscines de The Reserve sont de loin les meilleures. L'hôtel mériterait d'être encore rafraîchi. Il y a beaucoup de pourboires à donner et de services extras. Sur la plage, réservez vos places le plus tôt possible dans la journée. Janvier est le mois le plus froid, donc vous pouvez avoir des nuages et de la pluie ce qui n'est pas si désagréable d'autant que l'eau de la mer demeure bonne et que les piscines sont chauffées. Le rapport qualité-prix demeure questionnable. Nous étions dans la suite junior garden view. La literie pour ma part était surannée, le balcon tout petit avec du mobilier défraîchi. Le service était plutôt lent, long et compliqué avec beaucoup de "bugs" donc pas toujours de tout repos, mais les dominicains sont des gens extrêmement empathiques et chaleureux qui savent faire des efforts. Dans l'ensemble, c'était une escapade agréable quand on vit dans des régions froides. Ne venez pas que pour une semaine, c'est un peu court. L'hôtel fait parti des hôtels "très bien", mais d'autres hôtels sont notés "excellent", puis "merveilleux", puis "exceptionnels". Si vous en avez les moyens !

reviews.author: leonardo19782025
reviews.title: No respetan Reservas anticipadas
reviews.text: 5 viajeros de Alemania, Canadá y Colombia, en dos habitaciones reservadas con 7 meses de anticipación y en check in nos dieron otras habitaciones de categoría inferior y no nos informaron, sólo al ingresar a ellas nos dimos cuenta y debimos reclamar pero sólo nos las cambiaron hasta  el siguiente día. Los siguientes 5 noches tuvimos nuestras habitaciones contratadas y fueron de muy buen nivel la primera noche habitaciones de nivel bajo. Recomendación para los viajeros paguen el nivel The Reserve si quieren accesar a mejor alimentación y servicio d e mejor nivel.  Para el valor que se paga el servicio debería ser mucho mejor.  YHY spa bastante bueno en atención pero se debe seleccionar las terapistas con más experiencia para tener un nivel acorde con el precio alto que se paga por los tratamientos

reviews.author: Departure28042919763
reviews.title: Sobrevalorado
reviews.text: El hotel esta en un lugar paradisiaco. En mi caso particular somos socios Melia. Resulta que han limitado la experiencia del Socio Melia incorporando categorias superiores como Circle y Circle Black, a las que le dan acceso a experiencias superiores, relegando al socio anterior. Es asi como suprimieron el uso de lo que era La Reserve, que ahora se llama Zel y esta vedado a Socios Melia. Tampoco continuan con el uso del Spa YHI, que estaba disponible para socios Melia, y ahora se llama AUA, y es pago. Lo que realmente es pesimo y dificil de encontrar tan malo es la comida en los Restaurantes. La calidad de la preparacion es muy deficiente, realmente una esperiencia totalmente nefasta. El servicio de buffete sigue siendo el único potable y muy bueno, pero al ir en epoca de alta demanda estaba desbordado de gente. No vale para nada 150 dolares por persona por dia la comida, una locura.

reviews.author: Global578786
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, subpar dining
reviews.text: Amazing beachfront property and beautiful facility, but food quality and overall dining experience was not consistent with price and hotel star level

reviews.author: Beau1967
reviews.title: Beautiful beach and property but the little things kill 'em
reviews.text: The beaches are beautiful, the rooms are very nice, the property is gorgeous but these guys are their own worst enemy by pooching the easily solvable little things. Lots of folks including myself often had no hot water at the end of the beach day to shower with; my suite's air conditioning was weak and attempts over a week to fix it never really helped; even with a butler hired for the week (who had 27 clients to manage) we couldn't get restaurant reservations many nights and we 'on our own,' and so forth. Plus the beach is crawling all day with vendors hawking cigars, fishing excoursions, parasailing, henna tatoos, hairbraiding, and so on like 1970's New Yrk style squeegee men. There's a lot to love about this place, but these little things all stack up and feel less little after a while.

reviews.author: Courtney R
reviews.title: Can’t get more pillows or dinner reservations
reviews.text:
It is impossible to get extra pillows and to make a dinner reservation. 
My room is a suite and is beautiful but my children are sleeping on the pull-out and when they made the bed they didn’t include pillows. 
They are also unable to accommodate dinner reservations for 10 people. We have had to eat at the buffet every night. No restaurant seems full. 
Seems like if you upgrade to a different level they treat you better. For the amount of money this vacation is costing, that just isn’t right / fair.

reviews.author: Julia E
reviews.title: Beautiful but zero service- won’t go back.
reviews.text: We went as a family of 5 with teenage kids as an annual getaway to a warm retreat after Xmas. The hotel, beach & pool are good, weather great. The food was quite good for an all inclusive. The issue, as always with the DR, is the level of service. If you’re a laid back person who doesn’t care that it may take an hour or more to get your food, you’re going to be fine. If you’re some one who expects a certain level of service for a 5 star hotel, you won’t be satisfied. The golf course was wet & muddy. The concierge said he made golf reservations, but never did. No one at the golf course answers the phone. A lot of the staff simply don’t understand English and communication can be difficult. Very few of the staff want to help. We asked for coffee with breakfast, which never came. The key fobs malfunctioned every day, at least once, causing us to have them repeatedly reset. There are not enough pool chairs and the beach chairs are tightly packed and you can’t see the water well, so we rented a beach cabana every day. In the 4 days we were there we saw some one go to the front desk and ask if they could get a better experience by just paying more money. In the sports bar, we saw a guest actually start yelling at staff after he’d been waiting about 90 minutes for chicken wings while other were apparently being given his order. The drinks are definitely watered down unless you tip regularly and when doing so we saw a bartender literally look over his shoulder while pouring a normal drink. I cannot understand how TripAdvisor has so many good reviews unless they’re left by customers who aren’t bothered by poor service. The place is beautiful but don’t expect any service.

reviews.author: wayougo
reviews.title: Ok experience
reviews.text:
Experience was ok.
PROs': 
we had a great room, clean, modern spacious, great room service 
Beach is awesome 
Lots of beach chairs to choose from
Staff are generally very nice 
Coffee/Bar in lobby was great 
CONs
All restaurants were ok at best - not worth the reservation hassle the only amazing one was Flora
Minimal activities so boring if you have three teens 
Didn't love the sectioned off spots ie circle , reserve etc most of that space wasnt unused would rather be at a resort that just treats everyone the same 
Buffet was ok 
If you want a VERY low key resort with ok food but awesome beach this is for you

reviews.author: Zibouil
reviews.title: Great infrastructure but all the rest is average!!
reviews.text:
Wonderful hotel with comfortable rooms, several pools and enough sun beds, nice prepared beach but that all doesn't compensate the quality of service which isn't what it should be in a 5* hotel.

Restaurant reservations are very difficult and very badly organised internally.
Concierge service is very poor compared to other places in the region.
Food is average in all of the restaurants available.

Customers are mainly Americans or Canadians, anyway the English level of all the staff is very very low.
Great advantage if you expect a good quality of service: speaking Spanish!!

Worse part: if any of the concierges suggest you to take part at a presentation of the hotel and its advantages, just send him to Hell!
It's just a very bad manner to get you to lose some of your holiday time and try to get you to become a member of their "Melia Circle" what will cost you much more money than they tell you.

We had a good time because the staff was mainly very nice but I wouldn't go again.

reviews.author: Duca D
reviews.title: Not the best all-inclusive experience we've had
reviews.text:
The way some of the staff treated us was not the best. On many occasions we were completely ignored.
The food was good, but not too many options.
The room that we stayed in was a bit dated and you can notice the many layers of paint on the closet doors.
The pool was nice, the beach was also nice.

reviews.author: Cindy W
reviews.title: Customer Service needs improvement
reviews.text:
While the facilities are excellent, the customer service and attention to detail need improvement. We are still at the resort and it took multiple calls and trips to the front desk to have our AC fixed. Housekeeping took our trash can when they cleaned the room and called multiple times for a trash can. No hangers in the room and had to ask multiple times for some. Couldn’t get into our room because our bracelets stopped working. Spoke with the Guest Services Supervisor regarding a little cake to wish my daughter a happy birthday, said it would be at dinner tonight, restaurant was unaware.

My parents are staying in The Reserve and we had to make numerous calls and trips to the front desk to get their refrigerator fixed.  They went to the adults only buffet for breakfast this morning and was told it was reservations only. The restaurant was empty and the directory says it’s a buffet but they couldn’t eat there. Parents are celebrating their 55th wedding anniversary and asked the same Guest Services Supervisor for a special celebration. Said Bottle of wine, small desserts/chocolates, etc. would be in their room by 12pm today but they received nothing.

We are HuGE fans of Paradisus resorts, have stayed at multiple ones but this is the most disappointing one from a customer service aspect.

reviews.author: Alejandro E
reviews.title: Un cinco estrellas, con muy pocas estrellas
reviews.text:
Estuve una semana alojado y sinceramente no cubrió mis expectativas con relación precio de la estadía.
La gastronomía no es buena , el servicio de playa no funciona y tuvimos la sorpresa que al llegar de la playa a la habitación a última hora la habitación no estaba hecha.
Fuimos a cenar al restaurante Japones y se inundó por la descarga de las heladera (tengo el video) no es una queja sin fundamento.
Rescato a el personal que es muy atento y alivianaron la estadía.
Indudablemente no volvería.

reviews.author: Enrique Reutter
reviews.title: malos servicios
reviews.text: casi imposible conectarse al Wifi por señal muy débil, no hay reposición del frigobar, no cumplen con el traslado gratis al aeropuerto incluido en The Reserve, molestos lo innumerables vendedores en la playa, molesta el acoso para integrarse al Circle, comida no muy buena y sin consideración a problemas alimentarios, shows bastante malos. infraestructura del hotel es bastante buena. Personal en general amable pero poco resolutivo.

reviews.author: snsr s
reviews.title: Go somewhere else
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at this resort and were left disappointed by various aspects of the experience. While the rooms have been updated recently, many features were either broken or run-down. The bathroom and walk-in closet doors wouldn't close properly, and the patio door didn't work, which limited our access to the outdoor space we were looking forward to. The AC system was also a problem—it wasn’t adjustable, maintaining a chilly 18°C at all times, which made the room uncomfortably cold, especially for families with kids.

Housekeeping was subpar, particularly at night. We requested that the sofa bed be made up for our child every night, but each time, we had to call repeatedly, and no one would show up for an hour or more. This lack of attention was frustrating and left us feeling neglected by the staff. Furthermore, the concierge service, which initially came across as helpful, turned out to be more focused on selling a timeshare-like membership than addressing any of our actual needs. It was clear that their friendliness was more about getting us into a presentation than providing genuine assistance.

Dining options were also limited and disappointing. More than half of the restaurants were closed most nights, restricting us to only a few places. The hostess at Flore restaurant was especially rude—she even skipped over us in line to serve people who arrived after us. This level of poor service is unacceptable, especially given the resort’s premium pricing. The buffet lacked variety, with the same vegetarian options repeated daily, and while the desserts were visually appealing, they all tasted the same. If you’re seeking flavorful cuisine, particularly Indian or Thai options, I’d recommend looking elsewhere.

A few positive notes: Miguel, a bartender at the restaurant, was fantastic. He was attentive and welcoming, standing out from the otherwise lackluster service. However, restaurant reservations were another hassle; they had to be made in advance, and though some restaurants appeared empty, they still wouldn’t take walk-ins. The main buffet was closed for dinner every night, which limited our options further.

Overall, this resort has declined significantly since our last visit. Unfortunately, with such deterioration in service, food quality, and room conditions, we wouldn’t choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: fabricio0807
reviews.title: Regular nomas
reviews.text: El hotel es cómodo pero solo regular, el último día no me atendían en la zona de snacks por preferir turistas de usa

reviews.author: Karen Richardson
reviews.title: Horrible customer service  but beautiful resort Garden Suites
reviews.text:
Fabulous room  Garden Suites however RCI screwed up my payment process and ended up paying over 700US with no help from customer service.spent every freaking day trying to get this resolved and no help .5 of 7 days sitting in their lounge waiting to hear who would take the blame for screw up..played pass the ball all week
DO NOT USE Company recommended for transportation from Hotel..called to inform of problem with flight, they left us stranded at the airport , said to use another company and we would be reimbursed then baled on that SO $60 US wasted

reviews.author: miltonmborja
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Great hotel and facilities, they just need to get their act together in the check in process so that when you arrive at the room, its not steaming hot and you need to contact the hotel so they can “turn on” the Air Conditioner remotely, in addition in 2 instances after check in both Housekeeping and Facilities came into the room unannounced. Unacceptable.

reviews.author: ondina
reviews.title: Mi experiencia 😵‍💫
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en el Congreso de Cardio Metabólica de la Sociedad de Medicina Interna de la República Dominicana , la llegada una experiencia agradable , muchísimas gracias Adrián ( un chico amable y preocupado por complacer el cliente en la recepción con el verdadero sentido de atención al cliente  👏👏)  por ser la primera impresión del hotel🙌🙌
La comida normal pero de manera general buena , la locación es muy bonita , el hotel no tiene ascensor y es un poco lejos el área de los restaurantes y el centro de actividad del bloque que ocupamos #6  , imagínate subir 3 planta escalón por escalón con la maleta en mano 😵‍💫😵‍💫.
 Algo que nos llamó la atención la discusión de los empleados y el jefe o supervisor  en el área del bufet general (sábado en la tarde )  , de repente estaban con una ocupación mayor de lo usual tomando tiempo extra de trabajo pero eso no implica que como usuarios oigamos el disgusto de los empleados,  seamos mal tratados como huésped  y las reclamaciones del supervisor😵‍💫. 
Las amenidades buenas  : los chicos que tocan saxo geniales , el grupo que toca muy bueno , los tragos buenos, los chicos de los bares y camareros buenos  ; pero ojalá no te toque quedarte en el bloque 6 y que te atienda una camarista en el arreglo de tu habitación de nombre madeline , pienso que probablemente extranjera , porque creo hablaba creole con una compañera , que poco tacto que maltrato a los huéspedes del hotel que poca atención al cliente , la gotita que rebosa la copa, su actitud en la tarde de hoy  y como una persona puede contribuir más de manera negativa con tu experiencia en el hotel . 
Creo que deben de dar un mejor entrenamiento de cómo tratar los clientes y entender que por nosotros su hotel funciona y  vive …… y como nosotros los usuarios somos su mejor promoción. 
 Si me preguntaras si vuelvo ?? …. te diría que no , y si tienes la opción de algo más por el mismo precio tal vez te convenga experimentar otro lugar ….. es una pena que una locación tan bella le falte atención al cliente , calidez, humanismo, cortesía y amabilidad . 
Recordar que hay muchos hoteles que ofrecen lo mismo por el mismo precio con locaciones bellísimas también , pero es el trato al huésped lo que hace la diferencia 🙏🙏

reviews.author: Ronald B
reviews.title: R&N Punta Cana
reviews.text: The resort was very nice. Staff was helpful and outgoing. Our guest concierge Ernesto Guerrero was extremely friendly. Greeted us with open arms. Ernesto accommodated us with all of our needs and information. Set up massages at the spa and our dinner reservations.

reviews.author: roco72
reviews.title: Not This One
reviews.text:
This resort offers a beautiful and peaceful environment, but unfortunately, the service is only 1-star. Overall, I’d give it 3 stars. The food quality is just below average for an all-inclusive, and the staff generally seem very low motivated.

I wouldn’t recommend it!

reviews.author: jose ignacio g
reviews.title: Precio/Calidad deficiente
reviews.text:
Habitación muy cómoda, mala atención del personal en general. 
Restaurantes sobrepasados sin infraestructura para la cantidad de gente hospedada. Todas las mesas de los restaurantes con juego.
Grandes grupos de convenciones generaban largas filas en horario de desayuno, almuerzo y comida

reviews.author: annonymous292
reviews.title: Need better food options
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice but lacks vegetarian food options. We had a group of 29 and we tried making restaurant reservations in advance and never received a response. We tried making reservations at the hotel and received such a hard time. They are not accommodating! Also there is a huge language barrier with the staff.

reviews.author: Anthony Ciampoli
reviews.title: Nice place but a lot to fix
reviews.text: Just a lot of little things went wrong that made me feel like we did not get the value for what we paid.

reviews.author: Landy E
reviews.title: Sweet and Sour experience
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real for 6 nights/ 7 days. We had been there before it was remodeled and we stayed there 2 times after the renovation. The resort grounds is well maintained. The room was spacious and clean.This time we were very disappointed. The room service only offers 5 dishes, they removed some dishes from the menu this year(like the club sandwich). Nobody contacted us to help us with the restaurant reservations or to help us with anything. They don’t even have a water park for the kids and if you want to use the water park from the sister facilities you need to pay extra, that’s ridiculous. We have been at many others resort in Punta Cana and when you pay for the most expensive resort you can use some of the amenities of the lower level resorts. The resort service has become very basic and bland! They only had one buffet (Lunch Box) open during our stay. I want to thank Joel Salcedo the buffet’ manager and his crew especially, Maria Ortiz(she’s amazing). I recommend  people to ask for Maria if you want to be treated like a king or queen, thanks to Joel for accommodating us, he went above and beyond to try and satisfy our needs. Miguel one of the guys that helped us with our bags was excellent and attentive. But the resort management need to stop being cheap and to get it together because the competitors are offering much more for you money. I previously suggested this resort  to many family & friends but not anymore after this stay! The true bright spot of our stay was Maria! Please make sure to pass our thanks to Joel and Maria Ortiz from the Lunch Box.

reviews.author: Maria A
reviews.title: Worst food vs best resort facilities
reviews.text:
This is the best hotel I’ve been at in Punta Cana, facility wise. AC works great, great rooms, great beds and showers . The pool is big and nice, however note an average tall person will only be able to walk when you are at the stairs or at the pool bar, it is a very deep pool, not for children, and the water is not warm. This is my 4th trip to Punta Cana, and I’ve tried to upgrade to a better/more expensive hotel every time, however this year did not work out as expected. The food in this hotel buffet is AWFUL.
