I’m not only taking about quality and flavor, but also about the hygiene of this place. The floors behind every food counter we’re disgusting, they were as black as the black mármol
Counters. I felt like asking someone to clean it. I could not share these concerns with a manager, because I didn’t see one there in the floor in my 6 nights stay. If you are a foodie like me, stay away from this hotel. Food is not labeled, and some staff “might” get upset when you ask what it is. Desert table is the poorest I’ve seen in Punta Cana, like 5 to 6 deserts the most, and you will only find 3 ice cream flavors, with no names, you will have to ask the flavors to the staff. Not to mention about the flies everywhere. What a disappointment,  I will never stay at a Melia resort anymore.

reviews.author: Abbie
reviews.title: Beautiful Facade but Cracks Underneath
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful place but I have been frustrated with the food and the reservation system. It has been so hard to gain access to the premier restaurants and the alternatives at the buffet are not necessarily up to par. The staff is nice though, we love Wander, he is so nice and fun!

reviews.author: garby8
reviews.title: Para tener en cuenta si vas a The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana .
reviews.text:
Para tener en cuenta :
Si te gusta la playa de agua color turquesa típica de punta Cana , este hotel lamentablemente NO la tiene , agua color café y en el fondo lleno de sargazo , que en esta época se intensifica , caminamos más de 2 kilómetros para encontrar playa con mar caribe al que acostumbramos 😓, optamos por The reserve porque sabíamos de su buen servicio y a nosotros nos gusta el
servicio de excelencia y buscamos eso en un hotel de esta categoría , puedo decir que la comida hasta ahora nos ha sorprendido gratamente , lamentablemente aún no podemos probar los platos de especialidad ya que ha sido difícil que nuestro concierge logre gestionar reserva , pero no pierdo la esperanza ,la habitación bellísima , la cama muy cómoda , la piscina solo para adultos es tranquila y abierta 24 hrs … pero creo que falta personal para atender a sus clientes tanto en esta área como en la playa , si quieres beber una bebida o Cocteil debes ir al bar y conseguirlo , y eso está bien … pero no en The reserve .
En esta época el hotel debería estar en su máxima ocupación y sorpresivamente hay muy pocas personas , quizás se debe a lo de la playa o el clima pero hasta hora nos ha tocado sol y lluvia típica de Rep. Dominicana y clima muy agradable .
Continuará …..

reviews.author: cmwass23
reviews.title: Probably wouldn't go back again
reviews.text: The whole stay was very inconsistent regarding service and food quality. Some days it was amazing, other times not so much.

reviews.author: crygonz616
reviews.title: Beautiful resort.  Eat and drink with caution.
reviews.text:
First. Let me start by saying this is a beautiful resort and you can tell a lot of care was taken in the remodel. The beach did have quite a bit of debris and seaweed on it, but there were storms in the area that may have caused that.  The pools and grounds were lovely. The rooms were gorgeously done with modern decor.  

We were there on an incentive trip, so there were a lot of people there.  And getting reservations in the nicer restaurants was a challenge. Which, unfortunately, left you with the buffet as an option.  Food was undercooked, and sat out all day.  With the open atmosphere to the outside, there were birds flying around and landing inside. 

We had A LOT of people get sick!  I understand that Montezuma’s revenge is a possibility when traveling.  However, we were assured that the water at the hotel was safe and not a concern with brushing our teeth. Apparently not the case.  We used a lot of ice on the trip because our refrigerator did not work and we gave up after 4 attempts to get it repaired or replaced. We are concerned now the ice was tainted. I know more people who got sick on this trip than didn’t, and the illness is lasting for days.  In fact, it will be two weeks tomorrow since my initial onset of symptoms which was vomiting and diarrhea the 3rd day I was there.  In fact, based on what I’ve read about Travelers Diarrhea, I fear I contracted something else.  Diarrhea and stomach pain is still an issue after 3 days of an antibiotic.  

I really wanted to love this trip because I worked hard to earn it.  Definitely not the case… and after this being my second bad experience in the Dominican Republic, I won’t be back.

reviews.author: leanne s
reviews.title: Disappointed for a 5 star
reviews.text:
My mother and I travelled a few days ago and although the grounds and views are stunning, they have a lot of work to do for it to be an actual 5 star and for the price they are charging. We spent 2500$ CAD each and it did not match the services and food. 

Food is not the best and we’ve travelled many times to punta Cana and never had  1 complain about the food but this time it was not good. The buffet was terrible, tasteless, cold, some of the meats were raw or overcooked to the point where you couldn’t even cut through. One of the staff member serving the fish gave people attitude when they asked for their salmon to be well done because he was serving it half rare, another lady asked for her bacon to be more crispy and he just picked up the bacon from her plate with his fingers- she was livid. Some staff members were amazing and super nice and some seemed to be there out of being forced. 

Entertainment- barely any entertainment which I haven’t seen at an all-inclusive hotel. The vibe was very boring, no beach activities. 

Beach- stunning! Never had issues getting chairs. Only negative to it is that the vendors can be very disturbing and hover around constantly asking you if you’re interested. 

I would rate this hotel a 4 star and wouldn’t pay more than 1500$. Unfortunately I would not come back or recommend to anyone. I hope management takes these into consideration as the reviews are very accurate.

reviews.author: Diego R
reviews.title: Resumen
reviews.text: Reservé mes y medio antes y llegué el 14/04/24 día de mi cumpleaños. Pasé un pésimo momento en recepción en general creo que por eso les pongo un 3 sobre 5 la recepción y todas las personas que atienden ahí desganados, sin ninguna amabilidad ni empatía. Pedí hablar con un administrador pues simplemente me dijeron que no tenían habitaciones disponibles… el administrador solucionó pero el mal rato y en mi fecha de cumpleaños lo tuve que pasar. Es un hotel bello pero no es la atención que yo esperaba. La comida del buffet normal ( repetida todos los días) las habitaciones limpias y bonitas, el servicio a la habitación bueno tb. No regresaría por el precio que pagué iría a otra cadena.

reviews.author: Dustin & Emily H
reviews.title: Mostly poor service but nice amenities
reviews.text:
The highlight of our trip was the spa. Wow! My wife and I did a couples massage and facials, and both of us agreed it was the best message we have ever had!

We rate this place average because of its service. Here's why:

1) We spent over $4,000 here and have yet to receive Melia points for our stay. The reason? Apparently the resort 'forgot' to link our stay with our Melia account. I've contacted Melia HQ, a Circle salesmen (Carlos, who promised to resolve it for us), the resort (twice), and our concierge and this still hasn't been resolved.

2) We agreed to meet with their pushy Circle salesmen in exchange for a free massage. One of the salesmen, Santos, stood up and left our conversation, slamming his notebook on the table and exclaiming, "Dear God" when we refused to upgrade our Circle membership. We continue to be disappointed by Circle.

3) We called housekeeping 3-4 times requesting items they had forgotten to restock during our stay, such as towels and water, and our request was only resolved once.

4) Most days we had to contact our concierge to ask when and where our dinner reservations would be. One night she arranged reservations at a place we told her not to, and she failed to inform us that a new restaurant had opened, which we went to on our own.

We spent every day on the beach soaking up paradise, although the beach was noisy with hawkers and loud party boats passing by with bass vibrations we could feel.

Our favorite places to eat were Sante (especially for breakfast and lunch; see photos below) and the buffet. We were spoiled by the men working The Reserve beach, too. They were always willing to lend a helping hand, made us special drinks, and even purchased me a mamajuana kit after I discovered I liked it. I'm terrible with names so I should have written them down, but they alone earned this review an extra star/circle!

We stayed at The Reserve. However, we will not be returning to this place as part of our Circle experience, especially after having visited Playa del Carmen last year.

reviews.author: cookincarrief
reviews.title: Nice resort but food is lacking.
reviews.text: The food and restaurant reservation system is lacking. The staff was not overly friendly.  The resort itself was beautiful.  The rooms and pools were nice and the beach is amazing.

reviews.author: Johnathan H
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, lots of pools, must try the hot chocolate! The beach was beautiful and the little huts are great when sitting at the beach

reviews.author: Javier F
reviews.title: Mi peor experincia en melia en mas de 20 añ0s de cliente
reviews.text:
me senti estafado y ninguneado, no pude hablar con el supervisor, se negaron a darme una hoja de reclamaciones y me cobraron un dinero (180$) sin justificacion alguna
tuvimos problemas con la ducha, enviaron a alguien dos veces y no solucionaron nada
es cierto que el lugar es maravilloso y que la gente de restaurantes, bares etc son encantadores

reviews.author: raphaelrep
reviews.title: Razóavel
reviews.text: Estrutura muito boa, acomodação excelente. A maioria dos funcionários pouco prestativos, ficam esperando por pagar gorgeta. Não é possível utilizar alguns bares e piscinas do hotel, somente associados ou que pagaram por acomodações superiores, mas ninguém informou isso no check in, estávamos em uma piscina nas cadeiras, e fomos convidados a nos retirar, pois ali nossa pulseira não dava direito. mesma situação no bar desta mesma piscina, não podiamos ser atendidos.

reviews.author: rich49022
reviews.title: Nice place - maybe try somewhere else
reviews.text:
The property was clean, well maintained, great beach, spacious, nice rooms, etc...I wouldn't go back.  They need to  fix the dinner reservation system to accommodate all guests.  Unless you are staying in the reserve, you will not not be able to get preferred dining reservations, top shelf liquor, access to the Sante restaurant, and access to a closed off beach area, just know that if you go.

Here's why dinner reservations are so important.  The breakfast and lunch buffet are fine.  The dinner buffet isn't very good.  They don't do any theme nights or specials to make it a place you'd want to go eat.  If you want a decent dinner, you will need to go to a restaurant.  On the day you arrive, you can't get a reservation because you need to book a reservation earlier in the day.  (the reservation desk opens at 8:00 even  though the brochure they give you says 9:00.  The brochure also doesn't tell you what days a few of the restaurants are open since they weren't open every day during our stay)  I tried to make a reservation ahead of time sending an email to the hotel before I arrived and never heard back.  During our stay I was at the reservation desk every morning at 8:00, I could only ever get a 9:00 pm dinner reservations.  Why that matters is you aren't done with dinner until 10:30 pm at the earliest.  Guess what time the entertainment ends?  10:30 pm.  So you never get to enjoy the entertainment because you can't get a decent reservation time.

Also, there are many vendors walking the beach which is common in Punta Cona.  While they pass right by with a no thank you, its almost impossible to fall asleep based on their frequency always asking you if you want something.  When a security guard is present, they stay down by the water.  When the security guard leaves, they walk in and out all the seats.  I don't understand why the hotel doesn't have security guard there every day.

I saw one person take a bribe for a dinner reservation and clearly tipping will get you extra attention.  

I brought all of this to the attention of a manager before I left.  I did have to get a little loud to get access to a manager since the person at the guest services desk wasn't interested in hearing my feedback.

With so many options for your vacation along that beautiful beach, I would consider trying somewhere else unless you pay to stay in the reserve area.....and that's a shame.

reviews.author: MaryseT731
reviews.title: Moyen-Moyen
reviews.text:
Endroit bien, section adulte calme. Un peu cher pour la section The reserve. 
Notre Butler avait de la difficulté a réserver nos restaurants. Manque réellement de service à cet hôtel pour le prix. Bar sportif zéro pas bon. 
Bar du lobby surpeuplé.
 Personnel au bar pas sympathique.

Ne vaut PAS la peine de payer pour un Butler il n'a jamais réservé nos chaises a la plage. ! Rapport qualité-prix pas très bon. Un Riu on mange mieux aussi et moins cher.

Bref, section adulte bien belle chambre. Les restaurants pas si formidable buffet assez froid et ordinaire. Personnel non chaleureux. Bref, très moyen pour le prix.

reviews.author: WienKarin
reviews.title: Sehr schöne Hotelanlage - aber...
reviews.text:
Wir verbrachten 1 Woche in dieser wunderschönen Hotelanlage.
Zum positiven: Hotelzimmer sehr schön und sauber, die Angestellten bei den Restaurants und Bars sind alle sehr freundlich und immer gut gelaunt. Strandliegen sehr bequem und Strandtücher gekommt man so viel man will.
Zum negativen: schon beim einchecken gab es Probleme da wir direkt über Melia für die bessere Kategorie "Reserve" gebucht hatten, keiner wusste etwas nach einigen Hin und her dann doch die Reservierung gefunden. Eingecheckt, Armband drauf und ab ins Zimmer. Keine Erklärung was mit diesem Armband getan werden kann. Nächster morgen wieder zum Guestservice, da erfuhren wir, dass wir einen Butler hätten, der sich um alles kümmert wie Restaurants Reservierung etc. Eine Woche mussten wir auf einen Tisch beim Italiener warten. Wobei das Essen bis auf zwei Lokale schlecht war und in 20 Minuten ist man mit dem Essen fertig. Keine Atmosphäre in den Lokalen da sehr laut. Für unseren Airporttransfer mussten wir uns selber kümmern, drei Tage wurden wir im Kreis geschickt, das Personal hinter den Schreibtischen ist sehr überheblich und behandelt einem von oben herab. Schlussendlich bekamen wir eine email Adresse wo wir hinschreiben mussten um eine Reservierungbestätigung zu bekommen und mit dieser geht man zum Tourdesk wo man wieder weggeschickt wird da man erst einen Tag vor Abflug mit der Bestätigung kommen darf. Es wird einem nichts erklärt ( wahrscheinlich mit großen Dollarnote schon). Wenn man Reserve Kategorie bucht sollte man schönere Zimmer mit guter Aussicht bekommen, leider nicht zutreffenden. Für uns kommt dieses Resort und alle anderen der Melia  Gruppe nicht mehr in Frage.

reviews.author: Tony D
reviews.title: Go big or lower your expectations.
reviews.text: The can't resort.    To begin, the staff worked hard.  However, if you don't do the reserve...your enjoyment is limited.  Can't eat everywhere, only  a breakfast buffet, can't get drink everywhere, unless privileged, can't, can't access restaurant close to your room, canr get iron.  The most upsetting can't was getting change at front desk...the staff deserving of tip after 3rd day here...can't get tips because the did not gave change at front desk....go ask the bell men...was their solution...  staff works hard, managers need to work harder to help staff.  Food overall where we could eat was good.

reviews.author: Sherpa39757077598
reviews.title: Plan ahead if you are an adult couple.
reviews.text:
It is a beautiful resort. We are still vacationing at it next now. Wanted to leave a review to help others plan ahead. We are adults and for some crazy reason they put us next door to a family with children under the age of six. Woke up at 1AM, 3AM and 6:30AM when the babies woke up. I’m baffled why they put us next door to a family with small children when the resort is half empty. That wasn’t thought out very well. 

If you are an adult couple you might want to check with the front desk about your neighbors when you check in.

reviews.author: Pioneer158852
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
So, this was our first time at an all inclusive resort.  We, my husband and myself, usually preferred non inclusive because we like the idea of eating and going where the locals go.  But we had a difficult year last year and the idea of letting someone else help with decision making sounded perfect to us.  Not to mention everything was paid for ahead of time.  Ok, lets get started.  The good: the grounds were beautiful and the drinks and bartenders were top notch. The weather, pools and beach were amazing as well.  We selected the upgrade to the reserve.  From my understanding this included a concierge, which would help will all our needs as well as reservations to the restaurants as well as access to sante restaurant, a priviledge only for those at the "reserve", which by the way is adults only.
We met our concierge upon arrival, checking in a breeze, and he walked us around to explain the lay of the land. He asked us if we were celebrating anything and i was hesitant to mention, that we were celebrating my cancer fight.  Hey, he asked and I thought maybe it would be nice to get some sort of celebratory something.  We explained to him that this was our first experience with the all inclusive.  Well, that was pretty much the last we saw of him! He made our reservations, ,which you need to do or else you will be eating at the buffet every night.  He texted us in the morning where we wanted to eat, he made the reservation and that was that.
Unless you upgrade , you will be eating breakfast lunch at the buffet every day.  And yes there is alot to choose from but nothing is particulary good.  Its passable but thats it.  There is no other place to eat lunch of breakfast.  We had breakfast at sante because we were "reserve".  The restaurants were not good.  Im not quite sure what others ate but everything we had was either passable or not good.  Thank God for the drinks!  Mexican place was boring and tasteless and the italian was bad.  Lasagna was just awful!  Flora was ok but thats it.  
Food not good!  No matter where we went it was the same story.
Outdoor bars in the day are pretty good and they are attentive. Kicks is pretty much the only real bar on the grounds.  There are 2 smaller bars in between the 4 restaurants, very small, but they are only open in the evening.
Hard to find a beach bed unless you pay the beach guys but we managed just fine with that.  Always space at our pool or any other.
Now our concierge did absolutely nothing for us, except the reservations and he screwed one of them up so we were forced to eat at the buffet.  Talking with other guests, one told me hers got her a cake to celebrate National Womens Day another couple said that theirs brought up a special dish that was not on any menu. Where the hell was ours?  Especially knowing this was our first time!  What did we pay for.  He had no interest in us.  
At the end we dragged down our luggage, no elavators, someone helped us bring them up the stairs to the lobby, thank god.  He arranged a taxi to airport that never came.  He also texted he will send someone up to get our luggage , we said forget we are already here.  Never said anything after that!

My take away:
grounds beautiful
drinks great
food bad
not much entertainment  . Please please bare in mind,  your only breakfast and lunch options are the buffet.  Nothing there was that good.

reviews.author: coastal218549
reviews.title: Golf Group
reviews.text:
Our Golf Group has been going to Punta Cana annually for many years and in the last number of years we have stayed at Paradisus Palma Real, mainly because of the warm and professional treatment provided by our concierge Nicolas.
We golf everyday at Cocotal, which is the resort course and is supposed to be included. The green fees are technically included, but they charge you $100.- per man as a " cart fee".  So its $200. for a cart that was built in the 1980's . They have let the greens go, some are hardly playable.
The resort itself is very nice, our rooms were recently renovated in buildings 6 and 7. We had an issue with 2 rooms not being ready upon arrival. Two of us had to stay in temporary rooms until the next day, and the problem wasn't solved until 11pm, meaning they couldn't unpack ,which is frustrating.
I am sure this issue would never have happened if our concierge Nicolas was on duty, but unfortunately he was off until day 3. From then on it was smooth sailing. Nicolas looked after all our reservations and details as he does every year. He even booked a fishing trip for us on our day off. He is the most professional concierge ( butler) you will find at any resort.
Honestly , we would not have booked this resort if Nicolas was not available. It seems that the experienced staff they used to have before covid are for gone, for the most part. They have cut back in different areas ( i.e. all beers are now small )
We golfed at Punta Espada one day , which is one of the best courses anywhere in the world. This was a highlight.

reviews.author: Ellen W
reviews.title: Disappointed....
reviews.text: This resort had amazing rooms but otherwise I was not impressed. Food was mediocre, quality of alcohol was poor unless you wanted to spend astronomical amounts of money to get decent liquor or top shelf liquor. We have stayed a multiple brands of all-inclusive resorts and Melia was very disappointing. Spend your money elsewhere. We had a 12 year old with us, a 17 year old that they made me pay for an adult but SHE DOES NOT DRINK because she is not an adult?!?! This was overall a poor experience. The vendors in the resort do not leave you alone. Constant interruptions to resting and family time trying to sell us stuff. I expect that out on the beach but within the property, it is unacceptable. The drinks were often gross and the few that were tasty were hard to find. They only allow beer in the minibar and I cannot have gluten so was left with nothing. When I asked and explained they did not care. The activities were underwhelming with very poor instruction and guidance. There was an employee around the pool that thought it was funny to bark like a dog constantly and disrupt the peace of the guests. There are much better properties where you can get way more for your money.

reviews.author: Nate I
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
This was our second stay at Paradisus Palma Real. My wife and I decided to come back after honeymooning there in 2015. We stayed in a garden view, junior suite on the reserve side. For the most part it was a let down. 

From the moment we checked in, it seemed unorganized. We had a reservation on the reserve side, but the bellman didn't have us on his list, so we had to wait in line at general reception only to be escorted to the reserve check in. There was only one person checking guests in, so that took another 30 minutes.  Our concierge gave us a very cursory overview of the resort, and off he went. 

The resort felt very split up. There is the Circle side, general population, and the Reserve side. It seems the Circle guests receive more amenities as they had their own lounge.

The good:
The resort overall is beautiful. They did a great job with the recent renovations. 
Jose at Mina was by far the best waiter we had during our stay. This was also our best meal.
Wanda at the Reserve pool bar is fantastic.
The guys at the reserve beach are wonderful as well.

The bad:
Overall the service and food at the hotel is not good. When we dined at Blue Agave, it took over an hour to receive our food. Our waiter did not return after the initial round of drinks, we had to go to the bar ourselves and get more. This is the case at most of the restaurants. The week we were there, it was noticeably not busy. I would suspect the resort was maybe 2/3 full. We could not figure out why it took so long to get food from the a la carte restaurants. When we ate at the Italian restaurant, we noted 5 cooks in the kitchen, yet my lasagna came out cold...not sure how that happens.

The buffet was awful. No variety, the same food seemed to be prepared each day, the chefs weren't friendly, often food was cold. Trying to flag someone down to get coffee in the morning took forever. 

Our concierge was barely helpful. We did our research and communicated on our first day which restaurants we wanted to eat at. Every day it was a struggle to get reservations. He had to ask us multiple times where we wanted to eat and what time. We ended up eating at random times even though the restaurants were never more than half full. 

Our stay was booked for 4 days. By the morning of the 3rd, I was ready to go home. No one should feel like that on vacation, right?

Stray observations:
- It was not noted or recognized that we were return guests. This was off-putting.
- There is very little opportunity to get food outside of meal times. There is no "snack hut" or anything like that.
- During the change from "Royal Service" to "The Reserve" it seems they did away with the lounge for this side of the resort. 
- There are not any nightly shows at this resort anymore. Apparently you have to take a shuttle to a different resort to see any kind of show. 
- The app is almost useless.

reviews.author: Leslie L
reviews.title: Not what we expected from what was supposed to be a 5 star resort
reviews.text: Not a 5 ⭐️ resort unfortunately. The hotel grounds are lovely, the butlers in particular Kelvin and Alvaro worked so hard to make our vacation seamless and made the dinner reservations perfectly but when it comes down to it the food and beverage management at the hotel is so subpar. Most days the meals at the resort at best were mediocre, but often fell into abysmal. After a full week we could honestly say we only enjoyed two dinners. Breakfast and lunch were not better. Housekeeping often didn’t come to clean our room until very very late in the afternoon. It just was not up to par for what we expected.

reviews.author: Joel JZ
reviews.title: Lovely place ok food
reviews.text:
As an avid traveler and lives to go to all-inclusives in Mexico, Dominica Republic, and throughout the Caribbean. this place had the view, the nice rooms swim up pools bars etc. but what it was lacking was fun activities, heated pools, and better quality food. The food was edible but lacked the quality you would expect in such a nice place like a Miele property. The best thing was the fresh made breakfast omelets, the Asian and the Italian was just ok and the best meal was the items we recommended the chef to make for us at the Mexican restaurant. One of the other items was the number of people trying to sell us add ons or excursions at the pool and beach or food upgrades in the restaurants. my favorite person was this big, tall man with a chef's hat. He was so nice and was able to get us ice cream when the ice cream section was closed. 
Also, the chef at the Mexican restaurant is working, making the tacos. he was terrific! Sunrise views were amazing.

reviews.author: Lou R
reviews.title: not very good food, be aware!
reviews.text: beautiful resort, but food was awful! Lots of it but really not good! Also pressure to join their "vacation club", very pretty but I won't return. They were very defensive when I wrote how poor the food was. Paid a lot for 4 nights. if you don't upgrade to a certain level where you get a "butler" you wont get reservations at the specialty restaurants. But the food was no better there.

reviews.author: Chelsea P
reviews.title: It just depends on what type of traveler you are
reviews.text:
Overall: 3.75 Stars. Best suited for age 55+ and desire peace & quiet over fun. I’ve stayed at many resorts in the Caribbean and this was the most beautiful. You’ll feel like a Kardashian as soon as you enter. However, the low quality, limited variety, and poor taste of food will probably keep me from returning. If the food was good, this would truly be a [third- world country standards] five star resort, in my opinion. 

In Depth Review: I’m a 47 year old black American female traveling solo for 5 nights without hubby. I’ve traveled the world on a shoestring budget, lived in South America for 7 years,  and currently live in a major metropolitan city on the east coast. I’ve stayed in huts in the jungle with flying bats and roaches and I’ve stayed in some pretty swanky joints. So I’d like to say my review is pretty trustworthy. However, reviews must be taken with a grain of salt because they are simply opinions. You’ll have to form your own, but below was my experience. TIP: Spanish speakers, like myself, will have a better experience due to the language barrier.

Arrival: 2 Stars. Resort is a quick 20 minutes or so from PUJ. Nobody helped me unload or carry bags to front desk and acted like it was a chore to walk me to the check-in desk. No welcome drink or extra fanfare but at least I had no wait and the whole process took about 10 minutes. The desk girl was nice and even upgraded my room. I was given a bracelet but it wasn’t explained that it doubled as an electronic room key. I was given a map of the property and basically a “good luck finding your room and everything on your own” since nobody offered to help me any further. I had to ask directions from another worker. He pointed, but didn’t offer any other help. I was starving from a long day of travel but nobody told me where I could eat. I wandered around tired, hungry, and feeling unwelcome. TIP: Request to be personally taken to your room. Anything else is unacceptable.

Room: 5 stars. I will be upfront and say I did need to open windows and air out the harsh bleach and cleaning chemicals. But the room was spotless, spacious, and posh. I even had a private patio with my own Bali bed. I  was truly impressed with all the little details that make this a fancy place. No need to call the front desk if you forget your toothbrush. All toiletries are included, even toothpaste. TIP: Leaving sliding door open turns off your AC and lets in mosquitos! Also there is a red or green button by your door to push if you desire privacy or cleaning. 

Food: 1 star. Due to low capacity, the main dinner buffet was closed and we were forced to either have a restaurant reservation (also not explained to me and not all were open) or dine in a tiny makeshift buffet area called Malva. Hot foods were lukewarm (I never saw heat lamps) and cold items were not kept on ice at all. Breakfast and lunch were just as gross. I’m talking gray asparagus, chicken put in a blender and called “shredded”, and an Inedible omelette that tasted like Fabuloso. It left my tongue slimy and I got an instant headache, which leads me to believe they are washing their pots and pans in non food-safe chemicals. The restaurants I tried were just as terrible, but friendly service. TIP: If you ask for a paper plate from the hostess you can take your buffet items to the beach/pool. Otherwise, no food is served on the beach or poolside, which was sad. 

Drinks: 4 stars. At one beach bar I was told that technically they weren’t supposed to serve me because I had a green bracelet. Another thing not explained to me. But they were nice and served me a piña colada anyway. It was poured from a bottle mix and I ended up throwing it away. Hands down the best bar is Ginger Bar in the lobby. That’s where all the cool kids hang out and the drinks were strongest. TIP: Mixed drinks will give your tummy syrup rot but stronger cocktails or simple drinks are amazing. Try a refreshing Basil Smash!

Entertainment: 5 stars if you’re part of the older crowd and like to be in bed by 10pm. Amazing singers/musical performances, but not much else. I absolutely loved it and enjoyed getting a quiet restful sleep since the shows end early. TIP: Get your seat for the show early as they fill quickly. 

Beach: 5 stars. I was there in early February, so there was no seaweed to muck through. Clear waters with small waves and miles of beach to walk. Weather was perfect! Drink service was far and few between but Vanessa was a sweetheart. TIP: Bring your good attitude and realize you will be asked to buy something from hawkers frequently. But remember they make like $5 a day and you’re staying in a 5 star resort. Don’t be a jerk, Karen. 

Pools: 5 stars. Sparkling, clean, and not overpowering with bleach odor. However, the color of your bracelet will determine which pools you can swim in. I never had an issue getting a chair; no need to wake up early and reserve it. TIP: You can purchase towel clips at the gift shop to prevent your towel from blowing off your chair into Neverland.  

Staff: Extremely hard working. Yes, they are hoping for a tip, but don’t act like it’s required. TIP: Remember, you’re visiting a different culture. What might seem rude or apathetic to you is really just their shy and quiet nature to some extent. Dominicans don’t try to be best friends with strangers like Americans sometimes do. You have to earn their trust and respect their country first and foremost. Speaking Spanish will get you preferential treatment, but that’s at any resort in DR. 

THE GOOD: Pure relaxation and great sleep!

THE BAD: The food is disgusting!

THE UGLY: If your skin is darker than a paper bag be prepared for horrific racism. I had to discuss this with management when a security guard tried to get me thrown out. Vicmar truly seem to care and said he would launch an “investigation”, but nothing was ever done, and I wasn’t notified of the outcome nor offered even a free massage to compensate for my humiliation.

reviews.author: Diane C
reviews.title: Bon spectacle mais trop cuit
reviews.text:
Bon spectacle les enfants ont pu participer, repas généreux, a l'écoute de nos allergies ( gluten et poisson) mais trop cuit a mon goût. Merci a toute l'équipe qui était motivée  et dynamique et qui se forçait a parler français. Au Melia Resort Caraïbe  Punta Cana février 2024                  
Le coût est environ de 300$ can pour 5 personne. Les enfants ont aimé le spectacle.

reviews.author: Happiness742831
reviews.title: Authentic assessment
reviews.text:
The place is beautiful. The view is spectacular. The rooms are nice and the people are nice, but I wouldn’t return to the hotel. We had a very long day of travel and when we got to the hotel it was around 7:30pm. 

They gave me the contact to our direct concierge but didn’t provide any details about what they do for you. A gentleman walked with us to our room with our luggage cart where we learned none of our keys work, and neither did his master key. He called somebody. We thought it would be a five minute wait. He called six more times, and around the hour mark, somebody came to change the battery out to our door so the keys worked. We were tired, sweaty and hungry. If that’s the worst part of trip-then no big deal. He was a trooper though, he didn’t leave us and his tip was well deserved.  

Most employees only speak Spanish which I respect so we used Google translate, but my two friends spoke much better Spanish and that helped. 

Somebody said we needed reservations at all restaurants so I texted our concierge, and asked if he could just schedule us each night at a new restaurant and have a two hour time frame to pick from and the five restaurants that interested us. He could only do one day at a time so I had to message him every morning at 9am. I asked if he could get us beach chairs. He couldn’t but he didn’t say which chairs we could or couldn’t sit in so we learned that quickly being asked to move from front row. He then spent the next two days asking where I was so he could meet us. I’d tell him, and the get a text he couldn’t make it but where were we now. That was two full days of texted every few hours. I finally met him, but he didn’t really offer anything I hadn’t figured out by then. 

The drinks were great. The food is okay, but kinda of expect that at an all-inclusive.
 
The beach: the water and sand are perfect. However, the locals walk up to you nonstop while lounging on resort beah chairs  all day to buy their things. First few times saying no thanks was no big deal. Saying it all day took away from experience. Setup a place where if we want to buy, we can go there and buy but putting animals on your shoulder behind you while reading isn’t welcomed. 

Massage-recommend. Amazing!

Lastly, the nonstop asks for Google reviews. This is not the employees fault. They clearly get rewarded financially for five star reviews so you do it. This is why there are so many five star reviews. They hand you the paper to scan and it takes you to a review where they put 5 stars for each category and then ask you to write a review and give you their name and often manager’s name. It’s a 200 word minimum required for each. Once done, they take your phone, take pic of review and submit it. This is the servers at pool, beach, restaurants and bars. 

Oh and bring lots of cash for tipping. I’m glad I brought a bit extra this trip not knowing how they handle tipping, and that cash was needed. 

The pools are wonderful, plenty of space, lots of towels. Bathrooms are clean and the resort is clean. If you don’t mind everything else, it’s a beautiful view. The airport is also very efficient and easy to maneuver through Customs.

reviews.author: 765ginette
reviews.title: Déçu du Paradisus
reviews.text: L’hôtel et les chambres sont belles et la plage est magnifique mais c’est tout. La nourriture n’est pas satisfaisante et répétitive au buffet. Tout est froid. Dans un restaurant on a dû retourner notre plat car il n’était pas cuit et froid. Le buffet adulte qui était rénové était fermé. Les tables du buffet général étaient désuètes et même rouillées, pas digne d’un 5*. Aussi, les vêtements de certains employés ne semblaient pas propres et le service manquait de professionnalisme. Les employés à la réception étaient peu sympathiques, on avait l’impression qu’ils se moquaient de nous. On a eu des problèmes avec la porte de notre chambre dès notre arrivée, le personnel d’entretien incapable de la réparer devait la changer le lendemain. Ils ont essayé en vain avec du mastic qui sentait très fort qui nous obligeait à sortir sur le balcon. Et, comme on était incapable de barrer la porte, on a demandé de changer de chambre. On a dû référer à l’agent Transat pour régler le problème ayant peu de réponse du personnel sur place. Trois heures plus tard, nous avons eu une nouvelle chambre. Quelle perte de temps, trois heures assises dans la chambre en attente du règlement du problème. Un autre irritant était qu’à tous les jours on devait attendre en file pour réserver le restaurant du lendemain sans avoir l’assurance d’avoir celui qu’on avait choisi car la priorité est donnée à la section Club et Réserve. Les autres clients passent en second. Pour ce qui est des activités le soir, c’est absolument de bas niveau (ex.:chanteuse qui ne sait pas chanter et qui fausse constamment) et je dirais presqu’inexistantes au cours de plusieurs soirs. Vraiment pas intéressant de passer une soirée dans cet établissement. Même la section bar n’est pas intéressante. Conclusion, je ne recommande pas cet hôtel qui mérite au plus un 3*, en comparaison aux multiples hôtels 5* que j’ai visité. Si vous voulez absolument aller dans cet hôtel assurez-vous d’être dans les sections Club ou Réserve car on dessert différemment selon les classes de clientèle.

reviews.author: Euge L
reviews.title: Experiencia de mi estadía
reviews.text: Las instalaciones como habitaciones son superiores. No obstante, de veces anteriores a las que fui al hotel, el servicio, y la comida y bebida bajó mucho en calidad. Los platos muy malos, y los mozos estaban distraídos. Si vuelvo a ir es por la imagen que tengo anteriormente del hotel, NO por esta ÚLTIMA.

reviews.author: Jag S
reviews.title: Average at best proceed with caution
reviews.text: Average at best resort. Lackluster entertainment and flavourless food makes it an average one time affair. The Lunch Box buffet restaurant should be renamed The punch box as you will punch yourself with the food on offer. No daytime entertainment makes this resort an absolute NO. If you like vacation with no disturbance and food flavours at all, this one is for you. Cold pool in Sunny 31 degrees tells the story. The only revival is some great staff. People/chefs behind the buffet stations are disinterested. Lobby Bar staff is best and so is the grill staff on the beach. Great restaurants outside the resort if you want but don't expect and flavours here. Even Cuba food resorts with food shortages taste better.

reviews.author: Escape43197631100
reviews.title: Lindo hotel, fallan algunas cosas
reviews.text:
Lindas instalaciones, muy buena habitacion si te toca el area de la reserve, las habitaciones comunes no son muy buenas.
Tuve suerte de encontrar a richard en el front desk, siempre dispuesto a resolver cualquier inconveniente y muy amable.
Las actividades del resort no existen.
No hay un centro de actividades, no las comunican bien, no hay ningun deporte acuatico incluido, ni siquiera los no motorizados, el buffet de comida es muy basico, y los restaurantes son promedio, ninguno es excelente.
En el area de restaurante santo resuelve cualquier inconveniente, gran servicio por parte de santo, siempre ayudando, pero para reservar un restaurante hay que hacer media hora de cola a las 9 am cada dia de la estacia.
Sistema anticuado y lento.
La playa es espectacular y siempre hay reposeras disponibles.

reviews.author: Julie M
reviews.title: Bien mais sans plus.
reviews.text:
Vieille hôtel qui a voulu se réinventer.  La qualité de la nourriture est très moyenne ,  le service … Ils sont tous très gentils  Mais sans la finesse  et le professionnalisme  D’un cinq étoiles . La chambre sent beaucoup l’humidité et l’air climatisé dans les chambres est bloqué à 22 degré. 
Je dois avouer  Que les lieux sont très propres  et que les lit sont vraiment très confortables . 
La section adulte est tranquille  et la piscine des Swim Out  Sont également très tranquille . 
Bien mais me sans plus.

reviews.author: Carolyn R
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
The staff was amazing! Great service. Especially at breakfast buffet , Maria Soto, Yefrezy, and Yanieda Sosa were always happy. They greeted me with a smile, and great energy.

However, the food has changed dramatically. The quality has gone down since previous years. There isn’t much options in the Buffett, same thing every day.

reviews.author: Adventure41098302630
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Mediocre food and food service
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a 6 night stay in the Reserve section of the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort by Melia and wanted to share our experience.

The property was beautiful, steps from the beach with multiple pools, lounge chairs and day beds.  Housekeeping and grounds keeping staff kept everything clean and tidy. 

Our room was large and well appointed,however it was not the room that we had reserved.  We reserved and paid for a premium ocean view suite with a king size bed.  Unfortunately the resort failed to honor our reservation and our room had two double beds. 

We were told that a ground floor room without an ocean view with a king bed might become available the next day or two.   We were not willing to move and accept this downgrade. 

We were not the only ones who experienced this problem as several guests were complaining of this same issue when we were checking in at the private “Reserve” check in lounge.

As the “Reserve” is an adults only section of the resort that presumably caters to couples it makes little sense why they would have double beds at all.

Our Concierge, Zernovia, was a delight and worked day and night to make our stay easy and enjoyable. She provided us with exceptional care and service during our stay.  This was our first visit to this resort and she took care of our reservations, transfers to the airport and luggage.  She is kind, knowledgeable and was one of the best part of our visit

The major weakness of this resort is the food and food service.  The food was plentiful and fresh however as a general matter it was poorly prepared, poorly presented and flavorless.  While there is a language barrier for many of the hardworking staff there is a level of disorganization, lack of supervision, and division of roles that resulted in unreliable service at almost every restaurant at the resort. 

We had many instances of not receiving the correct food that we ordered, our ordered food not being delivered to the table as well as receiving food and drinks that we never ordered, which seemed so wasteful!  Most days whatever we ordered was not delivered, served cold, without a vegetable, and often over cooked and flavorless.  

The buffet served the same food daily, and despite the variety it was extremely difficult to find anything palatable.  There is no place to get a snack at night or an ice cream if the buffet is closed. 

The resort touted an adults only buffet Malva which without explanation was randomly closed.  

When we went to daily activities the constant topic of conversation among the guests was the beauty of the facility and awful food being served.  The activities (candle making, soap making) were fun but class always started minutes to a half a half an hour late, and in locations that were difficult to find..  

Other than the pastries which were tasty, reflecting a qualified pastry chef, the food reflected a lack of competence.  Two exceptions were the Hibachi restaurant which was a fun experience, and tasty, the wine cellar (a speciality upcharge restaurant) where the staff was professional and the limited menu of meats served family style was properly prepared.  

When making your reservation you should inquire if there are any meetings or large groups scheduled to be at the resort.  There was a large business group there during the first half of our stay.  The sports bar was closed for this group’s private events for two nights leaving resort guests crowding the hallway peering through the windows outside the bar trying to watch the NFL playoff games.   On Saturday night the entire central plaza of the resort was closed to guests for a private concert, cocktail party and dinner for this group.  Since there are no night activities at the venue, closing the main lobby area meant a night with nowhere to go. 

 While we understand convention business is quite lucrative, it was disrespectful to other guests that for a large part of the day, a section of  the pool closest to the bar was filled with members of this group  drinking, and being loud and boisterous as if it was a college fraternity party. 

Due to dynamic pricing employed by Melia, We paid a premium rate for our 6 night stay and  it was awful that services that were unavailable to us due to the business group.

reviews.author: Melissa S
reviews.title: Overall very good, but probably won't return
reviews.text:
We would have given this resort 5 stars, rooms were nicely updated, large balcony, and restaurants looked newly refreshed.  A lot of entertainment at night with live bands/shows etc.  

Our main issue was the non-stop repetitive merengue music in Spanish all day long at the main pool with swim up bar.  We like Dominican music, but not continuously all day long.   We know there is an adult pool which was very quiet, however, we like a lively atmosphere with a variety of music.  

Also, the dining reservation process is ridiculous.  You cannot eat anywhere without a reservation except the buffet.  I was told to go to the dining reservation area at 9:00 am the next day to make a reservation for the next 2 nights.  The next morning I was in line at 8:40 am for 30 minutes to find out that there were no more reservations left for that night.  So that left 2 out of our 4 night trip eating at the buffet. 

We frequent a lot of all-inclusives and the pool music and dining reservation system would keep us from returning to this resort.

reviews.author: MS26733
reviews.title: Food is horrific
reviews.text: The hotel itself is nice - rooms are nice and the beach is nice, but the food is horrendous. I am truly shocked at how bad it was. Service is good and overall if you don't care at all about food quality, then I guess staying here is ok.

reviews.author: DANIEL R
reviews.title: Some good and some very bad
reviews.text:
We have been to this resort 3 times and referred people here.
The good: mostly friendly staff and the grounds are super clean.  Food and drink options were available for the most part.
The bad: Impossible without a hassle or asking for hotel manager to get reservations for dinner.  Staff is not properly trained to assist here either.  This should be available by the app prior to arriving at resort.
     NONE of the jacuzzis worked and they have not worked for an extended period of time.  This is deceitful advertising on their website.
    Although you could find the occassional edible food item, for the most part the food was horrible to inedible.  DONT go expecting any culinary exerience.
I've traveled many places and as I said third time here.  Unlikely to ever return.  Management needs to step up and raise their standards and training

reviews.author: @jcantill
reviews.title: Servicio Decadente
reviews.text: 3 vez en el hotel , la calidad del servicio creo cada vez desmejora , un problema lograr una reserva a los restaurantes con el hotel ahora en temporada baja , la calidad de las comidas y vinos ha bajado , servicio en la playa malísimo , los empleados excelente actitud pero insuficientes, pésimo wifi en la playa

reviews.author: JRojas5
reviews.title: Won't be returning
reviews.text:
We usually stay at the Hilton La Romana but my husband wanted to try something different this time. 

The property itself is really beautiful and well maintained. The gym was under maintenance when I was there but I was able to use the gym at other properties close by and they were more than adequate. We spent most of our time in the main pool and my 3-year-old had a blast. The pool bartenders were excellent. The main areas of the hotel near the restaurants had live entertainment at night that sounded fun, and I was pleased that the sound did not travel to the rest of the hotel. 

We had a swim-up suite. The room was nice and spacious. But when we first got in it was blazing hot. The a/c clearly was not working. There was a cheese platter on the table to welcome us but the cheese was melted. I thought it was odd that our concierge would leave us in the room when it was clearly way too hot and not try to fix it for us right away. But I messaged him and eventually someone came to fix it which was a relief. 

Probably the most annoying thing in the room was the lights. The lights for the entire room run on a motion sensor out by the kitchen. I would be in the SHOWER and all the lights would turn off, and I'd have to stumble into the living room waving my arms like a lunatic to turn them back on. When they turned back on it would make the microwave beep in the same room where my kid was asleep. It was extremely inconvenient and we had to complain multiple times before it was fixed. From a business perspective I'm sure this saves them money, but from a guest perspective it made no sense at all. The room had a pull-out bed in the living room where my son slept, but the cleaning staff never put it away during the day so we could sit on the couch. I tried to put it back in myself but didn't want to force it in and possibly damage it, so I left it half-in thinking the cleaning staff would get the message and finish the job. That was not the case. Not a big deal but it would have been nice to have more seating space. 

The food...in two words, NOT GOOD. Most of the food in the buffet looked unappetizing at best. It looked dried out and gross, to be frank. This was way below the level of buffet food I have experienced in other resorts. The buffet area also sorely needs fans or some sort of air circulation in the eating area. We would move to eat in the Kanna area where there was some sort of breeze. 

The food in the restaurants was better. The Italian was the best and service was top notch, steak house was good, Mexican was decent. Flora was very disappointing. Dominican food is my favorite cuisine so I was very excited for this restaurant. I asked the waiter if it was possible to get tostones (fried plantains) and he came back and said they couldn't make any. So I ordered the mofongo with shrimp and when it came out the shrimp were just on top of the mofongo and not mixed in like it usually is. That, paired with the inability to make me tostones, tells me there aren't actually any fresh plantains back in the kitchen and the mofongo was probably pre-made. And tasted like it was. The food was so unsatisfying we left and ate buffet pizza instead.

The last thing that really soured the experience was the concierge. At first he was very helpful and nice. But eventually he tried to push a time-share presentation on us. We were very clear that we were not interested, but he wouldn't stop. Trying to guilt trip us about not meeting a quota or something and it was just very uncomfortable. My husband had to tell him no multiple times. And this was in our room so it just felt very intrusive. Then a day or two later he texted me trying to push it again. That really irritated me. No means no, not keep trying. But I am sure he's been instructed to continue pressuring. 

Overall the resort was beautiful and we had a good time. But I will stick to the Hilton next time.

reviews.author: Dale R Markowski
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: After seeing and reading a lot of the reviews about the resort my wife and I were very disappointed with the restaurant’s menu selection and food taste. We were just at the melia in Cancun and loved the food there so we were hoping for the same. Big let down. The service of employees just seems like there are not really interested in you as a whole. There were a few exceptions though. The resort grounds are well kept and beautiful. No issues there. The room is spacious and clean. The drive from airport only 20-35 minutes. We booked welcome pickups. $22 US one way the cheapest I found book way in advance. It can go up. The weather in January has been superb. We are heading to the Hilton La romana next on the west side.

reviews.author: Esther J
reviews.title: Nikte Swim Out
reviews.text:
2 of us, we are regular carribean travellers inc Cancun, Maya Riviera, Cuba, Aruba, St.Martin and Punta Cana and have been to many different resorts.  We stayed for 3 nights at Nikte Swim out Junior Suite. It is beautiful resort with very clean, spacious room.  Many small pools with lots of beach chairs and umbrellas. They offered everything needed during the stay, nice hospitality supplies in the room too (complimentary beach bag, flip flops, umbrella, sleepers, tooth brush etc).  Nikte package comes with a concierge (our concierge was Mack), unfortunately he wasn't that useful. He was only able to make one dinner reso and he was more focused selling a membership. He wasn't able to confirm any of our requests and disappeared after we said no to membership LOL.

Alcoholic drinks were good, no water down.  Food, i had no expectations so it was edible. However steaks were better at Buffet than Steak House 'Mina'.  Overall, I don't think I would come back.

reviews.author: Eric C
reviews.title: TERRIFIC resort, HORRIFIC service
reviews.text:
--- Non circle member ---

Pros:
- Amazing white sand beach
- Great area to swim in the sea, not much seagrass when we were there
- Exceptionnal rooms (we had the Nikte Master Swim Up suite)
- Lots of palapas on the beach, no need to wake up early
- Very good music during the day on the resort ("slow" remixes of pop hits)
- Very friendly housekeeping and minibar personnel 

Cons:
- ATROCIOUS check-in (long waiting time, mix-up of names at check in)
- Had to "fight" with check-in to have my "included" concierge after 1 day
- Uneven service of my concierge (couldn't book a restaurant 2 days out of 7 and couldn't help me with name problem)
- Little to no service everywhere in the resort (especially on the beach)
- Uneven opening of bars / restaurants (the bar in front of our swim up opened 4 days out of 7 even though it was written "open")
- Layout of the resort is hard to understand; places for Circle members / reserved palapas on the beach
- OK food, not the best but not horrible
- Not very good room service menu (no drinks available even though they were listed, not lot of food choice)
- Horrible / complicated restaurant booking

We went to a few other "luxuous" resorts (Secrets, Sandals, Excellence, Paradisus) and this one was the worst in terms of service. I would say this is a 3 stars at best for its service. 

It all started really badly when the check-in guy mixed up our passports with another room. When I saw the mistake (my app was in German and we were 5 German people listed in the room instead of 3 Canadians), the check-in guy didn't seem to care. Everybody at the check-in counter seemed annoyed when people asked questions. It took forever to check-in and took 3 rounds of visit to check-in counter to correct the mistake. Even though it was corrected, they still had the wrong names at restaurant reservations.

After that, I wanted to have my concierge service (which was included) and no one could find the name of the concierge. Our concierge (Luis Cadet) arrived a day after. I think he tried his really best to help us but couldn't book a restaurant for 2 days in a row. If it wasn't to skip the horrible restaurant booking, I would say the concierge was not a necessity during this stay.

The overall service on the resort was simply low to non-existent. Except for one server we had 2 days in a row in the Mexican restaurant (thank you Georgi!), the servers were mostly rude or annoyed. One exception is the housekeeping service and minibar service. If you love being served in a resort, this one is not for you. I had about 7-8 drinks delivered on the beach by a server during our whole trip and we had to call the server most of the time. The service at the bar was not that good either. 

Another thing annoying about this resort is its layout. There are places which are reserved for Circle members but this rule is not respected at all. Since the Circle bar was near our room and our bar was closed most of the time (see below), I had about 10 drinks to the circle only bar and they served me. After 2 days, we started seating in the Circle section of the beach since everybody there were not Circle. We even saw Falcon's people in the Palma Real section. If you want to make rules, please apply them. If not, just make the whole resort accessible.

There was also a really uneven opening of bars and restaurant. We couldn't look on the app cause this one was not updated. They closed the dinner buffet 4 days in a row to open another smaller buffet. The Kanna (beachside grill wich we loved on day 1) was also "closed" for service for 6 days, serving buffet food outside. Our bar near our room was closed most of the time during our stay. We could also go without reservation (at 18:00) to the asiatic restaurant, something that is not written anywhere.

Now, for the positive note: this resort has an AMAZING beach and really beautiful rooms. This saves the review because if it wasn't I would've gave a 1-2 stars review. The food was REALLY good at the mexican and asian restaurant. It was OK in the Italian restaurant and OK at the buffet too. Nobody got sick so that is a good news!

So, if you are looking for a really beautiful place and not minding horrible service, this could be a good choice. If you are looking for a 5 star service, you really need to skip this one!!!

reviews.author: Richard G
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort
reviews.text: Très bel hôtel mais la qualité de la nourriture n'était pas satisfaisante. Si vous avez des allergies, dont le gluten, cet hôtel n'est pas pour vous. Ils ne sont pas en mesure d'offrir de bons repas sans gluten et ils ne portent pas attention aux contaminations croisées.

reviews.author: Stephanie M
reviews.title: The good and the Bad, mostly bad unfortunately
reviews.text: New year's weekend. Look for the review in the Hotel's website. Look for alternatives.  People very nice but amenities and restaurant availabilities etc. not so.  Never able to get a reservation in the in dining restaurants (not buffet) our a/c was never repaired and we asked the front desd directly 2 times.  Garden view?? Too bad I can't upload the picture of the garden

reviews.author: Sherpa21248275589
reviews.title: Great property not run right.
reviews.text: The property is absolutely beautiful. The waitstaff is mostly rude. The food is not good. The restaurants are always full and you can’t get a reservation. You can only eat the nasty buffet. They keep the ac units from being adjusted. The room thermostat must stay at 74. You have to beg the staff to lower the temperature and they lie about it.

reviews.author: Curiosity16277242439
reviews.title: Passer votre chemin
reviews.text:
Le séjour a mal commencé parce qu’on nous a attribué une mauvaise chambre. Aucune explication sur le fonctionnement de l’hôtel et sur le service Nikite (en supplément).
La nouvelle chambre était tout aussi bruyante (on a du appeler 3 fois la réception en pleine nuit pour qu’ils interviennent 4/5h du matin).
Les draps étaient systématiquement sales.
La porte des toilettes ne se fermait pas et la fenêtre non plus. 
Le service de conciergerie Nikite ne nous a servi à rien.
La nourriture n’était clairement pas bonne (sauf petit dej) 
Service de plage et piscine pratiquement inexistant. 
Le personnel du bar a la piscine très gentil. 
Je ne recommande absolument pas cet hôtel. Il fallait tout réclamer. 
Très mauvaise expérience

reviews.author: brogers24
reviews.title: Won’t return - lack of professionalism
reviews.text: Service and food is generally below average. Reception for us took an hour plus to check in.  Unique restaurant experiences as first plate may come out 1/2 hour before the last, drink orders forgotten. Much of the food has little taste/seasoning perhaps due to cooking for massive numbers of people. Overall, a lack of professional service. Beyond that a nice experience.

reviews.author: Jason L
reviews.title: Stunning resort and great potential, but the food is a major flaw and needs major improvement.
reviews.text:
I wanted to try and keep this brief as it is a big resort with lots of moving parts but I need to provide detail for various aspects of my review of the resort. 

Firstly I will start with the biggest pro - the grounds and environment of this resort are really beautiful. It is a large, clean, and incredibly lovely place to be. The beach is beautiful and the pool area also great. A small note for the pool is to not sit right by the bar as the music is far too loud (a common theme with all music at the resort). The hotel also make a big effort on the entertainment front and did a lovely gift giveaway on Xmas for the kids. I thought that was a very nice gesture. 
Overall score for environment/grounds - 8

The staff are generally friendly and wanting to help but communicating was often difficult as very few people speak more than a few words of basic English. I found this surprising for a destination which is so big for American tourism. We managed, but it was a bit tiresome having to use google translate to communicate at times.
Overall score for staff - 7

We did not use the kids club itself but I spoke daily to their supervisor through WhatsApp who was excellent in her communication and assistance in organising a daily babysitter for my daughter while we went to eat dinner. This was one of the strong points of the staff at the hotel. One thing of note again was the language barrier which sometimes made it a bit tiresome trying to communicate with the babysitters when they arrived. One also was relaxing on our bed when we got back (which we did not appreciate) and one ordered room service while we were out, which could have potentially woken our daughter, so again wasn’t very professional. Special mention to Susu who was a massive help and smiling face from start to finish. 
Overall score for Kids Club/Babysitting - 8

Our room itself was a Junior Garden Suite and was well designed and well laid out, with great lighting (rare in a hotel room!) and a lovely full length mirror (also rare in a hotel room!). One thing of note was the toilet paper was the cheapest, thinnest paper and you’d hope for better. The walls are also paper thin and between the noise from the lobby, the fountains, and our neighbours to the side and above, it was not a quiet room a lot of the time. 
Overall score for Room - 8

Housekeeping was not great. There were multiple days our room was not made until late afternoon when we were returning from a full day at the beach, one day in fact being 8pm while we were at dinner. Bear in mind ind we were out our room each morning by 7.45-8am, so there really is no excuse for this. On that particular day, it threw our entire evening routine for our young daughter off, which ended up ultimately in us having to cancel our babysitter and bring her to dinner with us, which we generally don’t do. Towels were also never properly replenished and we had to always ask for the towels we needed. 
Overall score for housekeeping - 5

The gym in the resort was a decent size, probably a little small for the size of the resort but it had a decent selection of equipment and a good range of free weights. The air con didn’t seem to be great in there so the workouts were extra sweaty but it was pleasant to use. 
Overall gym score - 8

Food and Beverage
Where do I begin. In short, terrible,. This is what takes this resort from looking beautiful and like a dream 5 star resort, to being somewhere I’d never return to. 
The restaurant booking system is a joke, with huge portions of the available space in the restaurants being held back for priority members and I was queuing every morning from 8.30/40am until the reservation desk opened at 9am, often being told I could only get a 6pm or 9.30pm booking in a restaurant I didn’t want to visit. This made the whole process tiresome and whilst Franklin did do his best to assist me, it was all a bit of a nonsense. The restaurants are often half empty when you walked past in the evenings but “full at time of booking” when the reservations for that day had just opened. You have to push VERY hard to get the dinner you want. 

Buffet
Breakfast - 8 - good spread and fresh eggs so hard to go wrong. 
Lunch - 5 - The fresh fish is good if you guide the chef to cook it how you like it, but almost anything to do with meat in the hotel is dreadful. Nearly everything under heaters is like warm at best and nothing feels overly fresh. 
Dinner - 2 - Terrible. Again, nothing seems very fresh and the cooked food is questionable at best. It’s either still raw or butchered and overdone beyond belief. Avoid. 

Flora (Caribbean)- 1 - Inedible. 
Mina (Steakhouse) - 3 - Could have been good but the meat was massively overcooked, tough, dry and destroyed. 
Blue Agave (Mexican) - 8 - The only restaurant we truly enjoyed and wanted to visit more than once. 
Mascalzone (Italian) - 4 - Cheap ingredients, small pizza and the most pathetic excuse of a Caprese Salad i’ve ever seen! 
Malva (Mediterranean)- 2 - Again, no idea when it comes to meat. Asked for Medium, came Double well-done. MY wife asked for medium-well, it came RAW. Not blue, RAW. Chips were ice cold straight out the fridge. 
Asian - 4 - Went to the cooking show - awkward, not entertaining. The rice was burnet beyond belief, overcooked AGAIN (see the theme here?), just tasted burnt. The meat was dry and overcooked, the chicken dry and overcooked. 

Food summary: Overall the food is what lets the entire resort down. Aside from Blue Agave and the Breakfast, the food in the hotel is basically just appalling quality. The ingredients are all the cheapest versions of themselves and I’m almost certain there isn’t one trained chef working in the hotel. Between meat being served either raw or butchered beyond recognition, vegetables being served with mould on them, all soft drinks and cocktails being made from machines or ready-mixes, and none of the staff seeming to care about any of this, it makes the entire dining experience here unenjoyable and something that tarnishes an otherwise beautiful setting. Add in the ridiculous booking system and it’s all just a pain and not what you want on your holiday. I could do a better BBQ at home better than any chef in the hotel could cook a piece of meat, and when you go to a 5 star resort, you expect to be paying for better.
Also, not having the ability to order food by the pool or beach is a shame as you then always have to go the buffet and miss out on your sun-time. 

All in all, stunning location, friendly people (for the most part), but this place is crying out for a few top trained pro’s to come in and overhaul the F&B, from ingredients, to staff training and care in service. 

Overall hotel score: 5.4/10 - mainly let down by food.

reviews.author: cheriegudz1995
reviews.title: Okay but not great
reviews.text: Great beach and pretty resort but certainly not a 5 star.  Food was ok, but it was very difficult to get a reservation at the restaurants, even with an assigned concierge.  Entertainment was amazing and Rafael at the beach provided wonderful service.

reviews.author: davenyc028
reviews.title: Some great things, some bad things but depends on your situation  and perspective.  Wouldn’t go back though
reviews.text:
First let me start off saying I am not that high maintenance and you are in a tropical paradise on a great beach with great weather so nothing is that bad and overall the resort is very nice but there are reasons I wouldn’t go back and would try somewhere else:

1) First and foremost the food is just not good.  What others have reviewed in this site is just true.  And even though it’s an all inclusive and you don’t expect it to be fantastic, it is sub par.  The breakfast and lunch options are limited to the buffet (which is plentiful but middling in quality) and one other restaurant with a very limited menu, so it’s the same monotonous thing each day until dinner.  The dinners are in nice atmospheres, with hit or miss service (mostly good enough though), but just rehashes of basically what that have at the buffet but gussied up a little.  So because of the food alone we wouldn’t come back.  I would say Blue Agave and Mazcalone were the better options though.  

2) The rooms are very nice and updated and large.  However the construction and walls are very thin and so you hear the people next to you at all hours and vice versa, they hear you.  If someone is walking upstairs above you or moving a chair you hear it loudly.  You hear water flowing in the pipes, and they start lawn maintenance es at 7am all week with lead blowers etc that you hear loudly right into the rooms.  They maintain the property very well and it’s immaculate which is great but they shouldn’t start at 7am with loud machines.  

3)  It looks like they do a wonderful job for adolescents with programming and nighttime activities (they build teepees and movies on the beach, they bring in carnival like games on the beach, etc) but they don’t do anything for teenagers at night.  We traveled with teens and they get kicked out of the sports bar (which is the only place to watch live sports except for your room and it’s college football bowl week, NFL in season, NBA) at 9pm and there is no where else for them to go and hang out or congregate as there is entertainment each night in the plaza but it’s decidedly for adults.  So the resort needs to work on that as I wouldn’t necessary recommend it for families traveling with teens.

4)  It’s weird but they don’t seem to care if you tip or not.  I tipped a lot and didn’t really get many thank you’s or friendlier or better service.  This isn’t necessarily impactful on my or your stay but just informational that don’t think you have to perhaps tip as often as you think.  

5) The property is relatively small and all the restaurants are in one relatively small plaza basically.  In some respects this is good obviously as way to get place and less walking, but over a 7-8 day stay can feel a little confining or stale.  

6)  Making dinner reservations as you read in other reviews is a pain and you aren’t sure night to night where you are eating or exactly when, even with the help of a concierge.  Although the concierge can generally help a couple of days in advance once at the property.  

7)  The nightly entertainment in the plaza, while geared to adults, is pretty good, entertaining and appreciated for the effort.  

8)  We were there for Christmas and I thought they did a wonderful job Christmas morning by literally giving probably hundreds of real (not cheap or chintzy) gifts (skateboards, basketballs, dolls, creative arts kits, etc) to kids.  I don’t celebrate Christmas but thought the overall decorations, the gift giving by the hotel, etc was very nice and they put in a lot of effort.  

9) The pools are nice with some quieter ones around the rooms and a more active one in the middle of the resort.  And yes they are cold as people have said but once in you get used to it.  The beach is very nice and they do a good job is seaweed control and cleaning it.  There are enough chairs at the pool and beach to always find even during a busy week like Christmas.  Although not alot of chair-side service as you need to go to the bar to get drinks.  

10) The gym is decent to above average, although not that big for a resort of this so sometimes too many people fighting for space.  It has all the equipment you need including bench, smith machine, free weights, etc and bikes, treadmills and ellipticals. 

11)  Not a part of the property but I would highly recommend the Dolphin Experience you can do off property  (and it includes snorkeling with fish, sting rays and sand sharks).  It’s a perfect 4 hours total including transportation back and forth and is in an enclosure in the ocean and is really a great experience (not cheap but worth it).  Family loved it.   

So in summary depending on your situation and things that are important to you, this could be a wonderful place, and frankly nothing is too bad when you are on vacation at a beautiful beach, but for us, it wouldn’t warrant a return visit and there are a lot of other places you can spend similar money that we would try.

reviews.author: T T
reviews.title: Missed The Mark Will Not Stay Again
reviews.text:
I will start with the disappointments and end with the positives. The lack of attention to detail added up over time.  By itself each small thing is nothing- but for a property of this caliber I expected more. Check in was painfully slow. We booked direct and they made an error in our room assignment. Husband and Wife- we booked a king and at check in we had 2 doubles. If we booked through a third party site I would be more understanding. They fixed it after 15 minutes of looking for an option on the computer this was the first small error in a string of many. Next no concierge was available on our first evening (we arrived at 5:30pm local time) so we had to eat at the buffet. The concierge is supposed to book your reservations and send you a daily message with activities to your phone. We never ended up with a concierge contacting us and just used the APP. Our room was not stocked properly when we checked in, no hand soap and the shampoo and conditioners were near empty. We called for hand soap and got one bottle for the sink. The next morning we realized we had no body soap for the shower. Still no hand/body soap for the shower after housekeeping came on day 2 so we called for that as well. The next day it took a stop in the morning and again in the late afternoon to get a concierge at the desk to be able to make us dinner reservations. We did not NEED or necessarily want a concierge  but the reservation stand by the buffet would not make us reservations for our entire stay and told us we had to book through our concierge. We already did not have the place or times available that we wanted in day 1 and day 2.  Our mini bar did not get restocked with housekeeping. Late night room service options are awful. We have a time change and were hungry at 8pm our local time when the buffet was closed. Basically a terrible tasting hamburger or chicken nuggets were our options. There are exclusive buffets for those who join their Circle time share or pay to be in the Reserve. I wonder if those buffets were superb because the general buffet food was awful. At check in we were told there was an adults only buffet but it was not available or staffed during our stay.  There is no coffee shop. I missed having a cappuccino with flavor.  Nowhere to just grab a snack. Only the buffet or restaurants with reservations. There is almost no entertainment on the property. If you buy into their time share apparently there is a special show for the Circle members. Our evening entertainment was in the bar usually a singer and on Friday there was a short dance performance by 3 couples. 
The positives. The grounds of the resort itself are gorgeous. Very well maintained. Plenty of pools and chairs. Plenty of room on the beach. Almost every staff member was delightful and smiling. With a little effort this resort could absolutely be 5 stars.  For me it’s a 4 star resort with 2 star food. I think there are too many other options to book here again.

reviews.author: omaresh2023
reviews.title: Things sure have changed at Paradisus PalmaReal. Not as impressed as we once were
reviews.text: The whole concierge approach can be q tricky thing. For one, u r assigned a buttler type of idea and we expected based on what we were explained, we could entrust our dinner plans to this subject. For three out of our 8 days we were scrambling to get reservations as we were repeatedly told there was no room at any of the choices we asked for. Only to find the places often had and empty restaurant at the time we chose for dinner 6 to 6:30pm. Go figure.

reviews.author: Kathleen R
reviews.title: Great Resort,unless you bought in
reviews.text:
I have never felt so bad about a review.  Why?  Because this is still a great hotel but….
My husband and I have been Melia Club members for about 10 years and it is quite clear that it no longer means anything.  People who get a deal on Expedia ( not that there is anything wrong with that) and I are getting the same service.   My brand loyalty, let alone my paid up membership and annual maintenance clearly are meaningless.  Why? Because I won’t buy Circle Black.  Just doesn’t fit into my retirement plan.
