So I get no decent chairs at the beach or pool. ,no special treatment in restaurants, spa or golf.  It would frankly be cheaper to get my trip from Expedia.  
For anyone considering Paradisus,it’s a great resort - service is good,food and drinks much better than average.  But for ClubMelia members, the service and perks we paid for are gone. Melia, if you don’t want me anymore, feel free to buy me out.  I would at least then be able to enjoy the resort for all of its virtues.

reviews.author: Plitín M
reviews.title: Me aburro como una ostra. Al menos, vengo con mi pareja y con él, siempre lo paso bien.
reviews.text: Cementerio de lujo, con buen alcohol y comida tirando a buena. El hotel es bonito. Tenía ganas de venir a este hotel pero, la verdad, me arrepiento. Qué aburrimiento!!! Prefiero un hotel peor y que tenga más actividad.

reviews.author: Kiddie K
reviews.title: The Reserve is a joke
reviews.text:
We have visited this resort in the past and had a blast so much so that we visited other locations for the brand. My husband was excited to plan a surprise visit back for my birthday and unfortunately the experience wasn’t the same. We book the “reserve” package that included a swim up room. 1. The swim up room was more of a “walk up” not like a private pool but where you walked to have direct access to the shared pool. 2. The reserve is supposed to grant you top shelf alcohol but this only happens at two specific bars and during our stay they “ran out”. 3. I was bitten in the bed by bugs. They switch our room and told me it was ants. When we tried to approach the managers to discuss our dissatisfaction and ask for compensation for at least one night of our stay, we were passed around to different people who always stated that their manager was in a meeting. This included but not limited to Marilisa, the manager at the reserve, Marcos, Ingrid and plenty more who I didn’t catch the names. Finally they offered an upgrade for our NEXT stay (yeah right) and told us our experience didn’t warrant a night refund. 

The rooms are nice and updated and for the most part the service at the restaurant was good. However, if you decide to stay, don’t book the reserve it’s a waste and The entertainment is underwhelming. Also I met a “CIRCLE Member” who was also displeased with her stay. 

Unfortunately the Meliá group has lost a loyal customer.

reviews.author: zach842023
reviews.title: Not great but not bad
reviews.text: Had a big check-in mess up, we got sent to three different rooms (we also did not get comped for this). Also, the adults only section they had kids in. Food was OK but service was good. But the bartender Antonio was absolutely fantastic. He honestly made the trip for me and my girlfriend. I would go back purely for him.

reviews.author: Blackhawks2010
reviews.title: NOT a 5* Resort.  Lower Expectations and have a great time.
reviews.text:
This is NOT a 5 star resort, more like 3.5- 4 stars on a good day.
Pros:
Large beach, close to Cocatal for golf, smaller pools throughout the resort in front of the buildings on the north side end up being like private pools, although I might be upset if I paid for a swim out room that’s open to the public.

Cons:
If you are not a Circle member or part of their time share program you are limited in the food options in most restaurants and access to many amenities throughout the resort.  You need reservations for all of the restaurants except the buffet but all of the time slots are reserved for Circle members and timeshares….many people were complaining.  Service in the buffet for all meals was very hit or miss.  Twice I had to go to the service cart and get my own water.  The daytime entertainment by the main pool and beach was some of the worst we’ve experienced in almost 20 years vacationing in the Caribbean.  The buffet food was just ok, 3 out of 5 when comparing to other Paradisus resorts in Mexico.  The water at the beach was warm and swimmable but murky due to the seaweed…not their fault but still a bummer.

reviews.author: drtbird2023
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Did not live up to my expectations. Many front desk issues. Assigned the wrong rooms. Took several hours to fix. My children were billed for spa treatments that we said would be covered on our bill. Not a seamless experience in any way.

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.title: Bring your $ if you want good service!!
reviews.text: Honest family review....think about what matters the most to you before you go. If it's food and you're not a circle member of this resort, go elsewhere. The restaurant reservation system is a joke and extremely hard to make or secure nightly dinner reservations,  we ended up at the buffet most days which was Medicare at best. Drink service is very very slow so be prepared and if you want top service better get your $$ money ready for tipping.

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: Wouldn’t come back
reviews.text:
Still here for a couple more days. This property was not what I expected. Having read previous reviews I guess my expectations were a bit high.
The friendliness of some of the staff are extremely subpar. My wife and I just sat down for breakfast (we seated ourselves). My wife waited a few minutes to get some water but no server came by and offered us anything. No big deal right! I can wait. So my wife went to the buffet as I waited at the table. Still nobody has came by to say hello, or ask if we would like anything to drink. Also no silverware at the table. To cut this story short, not 1 person came to our table the entire breakfast. My wife got up and went to the bar area to ask for 2 water bottles. The staff seems as if they don’t want to be here. Not very welcoming at all.
The buffet’s are not that great either. Very very small with minimal choices.
The staff at the Adults only pool are great, full of energy, just fun people.
The property itself is decent. Not the best, but not the worse either. Would not come back.

reviews.author: Lori G
reviews.title: expecting high quality but it was average
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Melia brand hotels in Punta Cana before so I thought we would try a new resort. This resort needs a lot of work. The check in and check out process is very long. I booked a king size bed in the reserve area on the 1st floor. When I completed the online check in they had me on the second floor. When I went to the desk it took almost 2 hours for them to tell me they didn't have another room available. So we took the second floor room - it had two double beds. I thought I was going to lose it. I had to wait three days for them to switch me to another room. Very disappointing. The Tokiemeku restaurant I would skip- all the food was overcooked. Go to the Flora restaurant- great service and good food. We ended up going there twice. The Mascalzone and Blue Agave were okay. The reserve section had it own restaurant called Santa- we did enjoy this restaurant for breakfast and lunch every day- we did have one dinner there. The gym was good but you needed to get there before 8:00am or it was packed. The night time entertainment was okay - they need to get better shows like the ones that were at the old Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana. People reserve chairs at the pool and also at the beach very early in the morning and sometimes never used each area. I think this needs to be monitored. The first 5 days were great it was very quiet at the pool and then a group conference came in for 3 days and they took over the place. Grown adults throwing a football in the pool and talking so loud!

reviews.author: LawtToronto
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Worst Service and Food
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort but very poor service, booked for 9 day stay.
Beautiful beach, comfortable loungers and palapas.
Resort food was the worst I have ever experienced at a 5 star resort, very poor quality,  by  day six  I was having problems from the food.
 Stayed at the Reserve adults only swim-out room with luxury concierge  service, I spoke with the concierge person once when I arrived only to never hear or see him again, don't waste your money for that service.
 Went to the reserve service room for information only to be sent somewhere else, what a joke.
The resort caters to business  Conventions which is not a problem other than it made it harder to get seating at restaurants.
Tables in the buffet restaurant   sticky dirty.
I arrived on a Friday and was told the information  session  was on Monday, couldn't find the tour guy, was sent to the other resort no guy there, I gave up wasting my time.
The room was very nice, but spotty cleaning service, had to switch out the pillows due to moldy smell. No turn down service which was offered in package I purchased.

The room is not sound proof, every night I could hear snoring, the TV, people talking from the room next to me, and these people were not loud party people.
It got to the point where I couldn't take another day at this place, booked a flight home the next day at extra cost for flight and airport service.

Resort made me sign a disclaimer, saying there would be no refund for not staying to the end of my reservation, no problem signed and done.
I will never return this place, not worth the money and not  5 star service.

reviews.author: Jake B
reviews.title: Ingredients are there but lack management and or leadership
reviews.text:
Staff tries but lacks finish.  No one would go out of there way if it wasn’t in their specific area - staff lack any initiative or empowerment.

Another pet peeve is that you must reserve a restaurant despite being 3/4 empty at all times.staff did you the biggest favour to try and accommodate you though was all inclusive

reviews.author: piera
reviews.title: Muchos malos ratos, desilusionados
reviews.text:
Hemos venido en varias ocasiones, desde hace 10 años, estamos muy desilusionados del servicio del hotel, todos los días tienes que pedir lo que falto en la habitación como toallas para el piso, toallas de cara, vasos, tasas el té o el café. En el comedor el bufet a bajado la calidad, si quieres algo tan simple como aceite de oliva tienes que esperar que lo busquen, aceto balsámico nos trajeron en un posillo con una cuchara sopera (una vergüenza) las reservas de los restaurantes ya no las puedes hacer uno para la semana sino que dependes de un Consierge que tienes que insistir y preguntar todo el día donde cenarás y lo peor sin saber la hora.
En una de nuestras estadías compramos la Membresía “Club Meliá” la que ya no es la estrella de Melia por lo que pasas a segunda categoría, los edificios donde te alojabas hoy no puedes entrar ni siquiera a esa área, todos te dan una información distinta con mentiras, en la playa el sector que tenía asignado los socios hoy solo te puedes instalar desde la cuarta fila hacia atrás, lo que es ya escandaloso como trato a un cliente que anualmente está pagando una membresía para pertenecer a dicho “Club”, si el propósito es aburrir al cliente para que te cambies de esa forma por lo menos con nosotros no lo lograrán.
Una lástima ya que es un hotel hermoso que despreocupan su servicio y a sus clientes sin mantener la categoría que debe tener un Hotel de la categoría y prestigio que tenía Melia con sus Paradisus
Piera y Antonio

reviews.author: Monica Rosario
reviews.title: Bien, pero puede mejorar!
reviews.text: La habitación y el área es un 10 . Pero la calidad de la comida ha disminuido sustancialmente año tras año. Personal que no habla español es otra cosa en  contra en  contra. El resto del personal bien

reviews.author: Maribel2323
reviews.title: Nuestra Experiencia,
reviews.text:
No recomendio si tienen niños majores de 10, ya que no tienen muchas opciones para los niños. Este hotel particularmente es mas para adultos. Despues de las 6pm, todo es callado y no hay mucha vida nocturna. Los restaurantes no son 14 en este hotel y la comida para el almuerzo y cena en el chef box debe mejorar con mas variedades. 
El personal si es muy atento, especialmente, 
Stephanie Castillo-guest service 
Yensy Del Rosario

Carlos reception

Edito- waiter
Luis Francisco- breakfast chef
Fernando- guest service 
Mario Ferreiras -Melia caribe aquatic park 
Santos paredes -aquatic dolphins 
Inez Bello. Housekeeping

reviews.author: Mike D
reviews.title: Beautiful but room for improvement
reviews.text: The grounds and beach are wonderful,  overall the food was very good for an all inclusive but we had some issues.  Housekeeping was the worst we have ever had, forgot basic items every day like soap, shampoo, wash clothes etc   And then it would take awhile ot be brought every night.  The outside vendors non Stopped harassed us every day at the beach.  Even the internal spa vendor was rude to my wife.  Do wnot do the speciality romantics dinner on the beach,  quality was awful and took so much time.   Finally the inside areas were very warm,  kicks was amazingly warm.  Overall we had a great time since they were only 10% full and pool/beach was wonderful, quiet and relaxing.

reviews.author: WordsTravel
reviews.title: Not bad.  Could be better.
reviews.text: Stayed with family of six adults and four children.  We found the resort to be clean and well kept.  The night time entertainment was very entertaining as well.  The food was hit or miss being good in some and not well prepared even cold at some.  Would have rated higher but found the dining experience to be merely average.

reviews.author: Dee M
reviews.title: All Adult - Not so much!
reviews.text: This is not an all-adult resort.  I would not recommend if that is what you are looking for.  You will experience children at every turn.  Even in the so called all adult venues.  We were very disappointed and will not travel to the DR again.

reviews.author: Traveler17394771561
reviews.title: What’s a good service
reviews.text:
The best was Natanael and Maria at the bar Ron republica. Good service and better proffessionals. Never mind how busy they are, always with a smile and kindly.
The other part of the restaurants must really increase their quality

reviews.author: Amine
reviews.title: Disappointing food but clean resort.
reviews.text:
Firstly, I should note that we're not very experienced with all-inclusive resorts. We usually stay in hotels and prefer to choose our own restaurants and activities. Our only experience with all-inclusive resorts was in Mexico, which, as I understand, is a more competitive market than the DR.

We stayed at this resort for six nights in the Reserve, the adults-only section. As others have mentioned, the food was a big disappointment across the whole resort. Despite having five restaurants, the hotel seems to use the same ingredients but presents them differently to create the illusion of variety. For instance, the same salmon filet might be topped with chili flakes at the Mexican restaurant and with cheese at the Mediterranean one (yes, in the DR Mediterraneans eat their fish with shredded cheese). The hot buffet was mediocre, with the exact same options everyday. However, it did offer some decent salad options. I'd strongly advise avoiding the charcuterie and cheese, as they're kept in the heat all day—surprising for a Spanish chain. The poolside snacks consisted solely of a type of ceviche on hard tortillas every day.

The pools and common areas were clean and well-maintained. The drinks were good, although tipping became necessary over time to continue receiving top-shelf liquors.

Our room was consistently clean and tidy, and the concierge was always available via WhatsApp. It's worth noting that the concierge service here seems more for show than for practical use. Like other guests in our section, we were invited to a 40-minute presentation about the "Circle Club." We attended, partly to help our concierge with their performance review. Although our concierge wasn't aggressive, she did seem a bit disingenuous at times. For example, she told us that we were receiving special gifts, when in fact everyone received the same cheap Chilean Merlot in their bedroom and the wine voucher after the presentation. It's not a major issue, we all have to hustle but it does reflect a certain culture within the resort. Maybe was she expecting something in return?

Overall, we didn't feel the experience was worth the cost. This resort might suit families looking for a secure environment but who aren't overly concerned with quality. If you're a couple looking for a relaxing poolside experience with good food and drinks, I'd recommend going to a place where the food is more respected.

reviews.author: jose3372
reviews.title: Great hotel miserable service
reviews.text: Beautiful resort but not all the staff is there to help you. We arrived late at night and were made to feel special.  That changed in the morning. The staff is more interested in getting reviews than in providing service. My son needed a band aid for a small cut. The team member held the band aid and said “I will give you the band aid but first you need write a review about my service.” This occurred several times including with our luggage at checkout.  Then again during the nightly entertainment by one of the staff members.  I was very content with the hotel but the staff apparently receives alot of pressure to receive reviews.  Overall Punta Cana will not be s place I intend to return to, much less paradissus

reviews.author: Forest_Reviewer
reviews.title: Could be 5 star, should be 4 star but gets 3 stars
reviews.text:
The first impressions of this resort are spectacular. The entrance lobby and views of the sea are amazing. That is the general feel around the place, that you are somewhere special

The next best thing for us was the room. We booked directly through the Meliá app and that saved us a ton (just have to join standard Meliá rewards programme). The room for 5 had 2 bedrooms and two lounge areas with sofa beds so every kid got their own bed

So far so good…

The buffet and restaurants are pretty decent. A lot of choice and the Italian was surprisingly good, steakhouse was below average and Hibatchi was ok. Downside is 4 out of 5 of us got very sick from the food and we took all the other precautions of only using bottled water. So that lost a star for us.

Service on first 2 days was amazing, Dayzi our concierge was super attentive at first until they ask us to attend the Circle presentation. When we said we were not interested her smile turned upside down and we were no longer visible. We felt a bit bad so did agree to finally attend with a clear plan of how we would survive the heavy sales pitch. They realised in 20 mins they weren’t going to make a sell an so we were quickly escorted from the ‘special Falcons hotel’ they had golf carted us to and returned back to Paradisus. From then we were lucky to hear from our Concierge.  You see all these poor families dragged through the same unnecessary process and it spoils the experience. If we had been left alone to enjoy our vacation we would not have knocked our review of the resort down another star. The irony was our room gave us use to all the special pools the Circle crowd use anyway! 

Overall this place could easily feel like a class act but the watered down drinks, inconsistent quality of service, tacky sales tactics and suspect food takes the edge off it. Shame as the little activities they do are fun like art, dance and mixology, decor is good and beach is not crowded . 

We still had a good vacation, despite the negatives but glad I paid the 3k less through the app than I would have through booking.com or Expedia.

reviews.author: Freedom34027866689
reviews.title: Great Concierge but decent experience overall. Stay somewhere else if you can. Not worth the money.
reviews.text: We had a good time at this resort. Our hotel concierge was phenomenal. He helped us book our excursions and everything in between. His name is Jose Simeon (ask for him if you can). The food was a 7/10 (no seasoning) and the adults only parts, were everything but. My families rooms were not correct and the hotel did nothing to correct it.

reviews.author: RVF
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
I just recently got back from a family trip with over 80ppl. I stayed at The Reserve side which is VIP for adults only with a private pool and private restaurant, however we spent most of our time in the swim up pool(which is super close) and hung out with our family on their side by the buffet. I don’t think it’s worth paying extra for “VIP” it didn’t really feel VIP except for the few Coronas my husband was able to get as a reserve member (premium drinks). The private pool was always empty and quiet, so if that’s what you’re looking for then it might be worth it. The food was OK, the staff was really friendly. The bartenders at the swim up bar - Victor and Jonathan are the best! They were always super attentive and friendly. They made our time by the swim up bar fun! Thank you for that!
A few things to keep in mind : make sure you make reservations as soon as you check-in, otherwise it’ll be hard to get one. Also, unless you press the button for your room to be cleaned it won’t get done until 5pm when you’re getting ready for dinner, or sometimes won’t get it done at all. I made sure to request it everyday before I went out to the pool. Overall it’s a big beautiful resort that caters to both adults who are looking for a quiet escape or a not so quiet at the sister hotels, and families with kids looking for a fun kid friendly hotel.

reviews.author: Carlos T
reviews.title: Buena
reviews.text: Habiendo estado en el año 2017, con una gastronomia de primer nivel, nos encontramos con que actualmente ha bajado muchisimo el nivel de la oferta gastronomica de este hotel 5 estrellas superior. Por lo demas la atencion y las instalaciones del sector de adultos son execelentes.

reviews.author: Virginia K
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.text:
He estado una semana de vacaciones con mi familia, dos adultos y dos niños. El hotel, en general, es muy bonito. Bastante nuevo, bonita decoración, piscina inmensa y situado en una playa fantástica. Importante saber que si vas con niños hay prácticamente medio hotel al que no vas a poder acceder porque es solo para adultos. Vas paseando por el hotel y cuando llegas al ala derecha te tienes que dar la vuelta porque está el cartel “adults only”, estás nadando en la piscina con tus hijos y sí, también hay una zona que tiene el cartelito (sin contar que ya hay otras piscinas exclusivas para adultos), si vas a la playa también tienes que preguntar en qué hamacas te puedes poner con los niños porque el primer día nos pusimos en primera línea y resulta que también estaban reservadas sólo para adultos. Si pretendes entrar durante el día en el único bar con aire acondicionado que hay en el hotel  tampoco puedes con niños porque es para adultos. En resumen, es un hotel que no recomiendo nada para ir en familia. Si no eres Circle pues eres un cliente de segunda, hay zonas exclusivas para ellos, piscinas y también platos en la carta de los restaurantes. 
También encontramos que estaba todo muy enfocado al turista americano. No había snacks que no fuesen perritos, hamburguesas o nachos. Los españoles madrugamos allí por la diferencia horaria del viaje, si los niños desayunan pronto y les apetece tomar algo a media mañana o les das un perrito o no hay mucho más dónde elegir, ni fruta, ni un dulce, ni pan con algo… y lo mismo pasa con la merienda, el colacao tampoco existe. Respecto al buffet creo que ha sido la mayor desilusión, para un hotel de esa categoría nos pareció malísimo, he viajado en otras ocasiones a República Dominicana, sé que hay cosas que no se pueden comparar con el nivel de España pero si me venden un hotel como de “lujo” esperas un mínimo. Había días que no sabías ni qué echarte en el plato porque la mayoría de las bandejas eran relleno que no valía nada. Entiendo que se quiera representar la gastronomía local y haya platos típicos dominicanos pero no me cruzo yo el océano y pago un pastón para comer yuca hervida. La fruta pochísima, esto sí que no me lo esperaba. La zona de ensaladas muy pobre y normalmente no había aceite de oliva para aliñar. Lo más aceptable era la zona de plancha pero tenías que tener suerte para que el cocinero te hiciese el filete a tu gusto, si te gusta la carne poco hecha pues mala suerte porque allí las hacen requetepasada. Alguna vez nos tocó alguien amable que nos sacaba la carne al punto que le decíamos y otras veces le pedías por favor el filete poco hecho, te echaba en el plato uno de los que tenía de hace rato pasándose en la plancha y ni te miraba a la cara. La amabilidad del servicio dejó mucho que desear, de entrada el cliente bueno es el americano porque suelta muchas propinas, el español no interesa, si les das propina todo son sonrisas, si no pues no existes, lo mínimo y porque estaban obligados. Además es algo tan evidente que molesta, camareros que en vez de dar los buenos días te vuelven la cara para que vayas a sentarte a una mesa de otra zona mientras al americano que le da propina hasta lo abrazaban, es que ya nos daba hasta la risa. He dado muchas propinas cuando lo he considerado oportuno pero no voy a un todo incluido para tener que soltar dinero cada vez que me sirven una bebida. La verdad es que la amabilidad del personal nos ha decepcionado bastante y cuando llegabas a cruzar tres palabras amables con alguien te sacaba el móvil con un QR donde te comprometía a dejar una opinión positiva en el momento sobre el hotel y a nombrarle personalmente, a veces hasta nos daban un papelito con la lista de nombres de varios compañeros para que los mencionases en la opinión. Ahora entiendo tantas criticas positivas mencionando nombres propios de camareros o conserjes. 
De los restaurantes temáticos de las cenas sólo diré una cosa: decorados bonitos y pompa pero comida mediocre. Intentaré adjuntar una foto de la PARRILLADA DE SALCHICHAS (no había muchos primeros platos para elegir) que pedimos en el restaurante de carne Mina y que resume en general toda la experiencia en este hotel, nos dio un ataque de risa al verla. Eran las mismas salchichas de los desayunos. En fin, espero que esta parrafada sirva de ayuda a alguien, cuando haces un viaje tan largo está bien contar con la mayor información posible.

reviews.author: manueldB5129AG
reviews.title: Most disappointing stay in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
It's painful for me to write this review since I am not the most demanding or pretentious client, however it must be told so future guests have an idea of what to expect.  I would call it constructive criticism.
We have been traveling to Punta Cana for the past 20 years and this was by far the worst experience at any of the resorts we have visited  which include all the Majestics, Iberostar, Barcelo among others.
We arrived a bit early at 1pm ( and I know check in is 3 PM ) other hotels usually accommodate guests asap, not here. We did not get to our room till well past 4 PM. 
We were celebrating our wedding anniversary and they recommended we have  dinner at  Flora, their  Dominican restaurant, it was the worst mistake we made as the food  was beyond terrible. 
Their restaurant reservation system  operates from 9am to 4pm, don't bother trying to make a reservation  because they will only have available the 6pm or 9pm seating  ( We were  the first online at  8:30 am several times ) and it did not matter.
The buffet is not the worst, but the service is horrendous, in several occasions there was no one attending the dessert station and there were arguments among the staff as to who should be attending.  On another occasion more than  15 minutes went by before we had to call someone to come finish setting the table and offer us something  to drink. It's pretty obvious that the personnel working there are not very experienced. 
They offered us complimentary dinner at their signature restaurant ( SANTE)  which normally  has a separate charge, don't waste your money, it was pretty bad, to put it mildly. 
What makes the whole situation worse is that if the hotel was at  50 % capacity it's being too optimistic on my part.
I must however mention  the two bright  spots of the trip, the Ginger bar in the lobby had very attentive staff and their coffee was very good. The beach area is indeed very nice and the people that work there are also very friendly and attentive.
Mariaelisa in the customer service area, went out of her way to make things better for us and helped with the reservations at the restaurants after the bad experience we had the first day there.  I would recommend requesting Osvaldo Veloz as your buttler.
My overall  humble opinion is that the hotel has very poor management in place and they are not focusing on the issues that really matter ( the everyday guest) instead of the conventions or other events that add value but you need to be prepared to accommodate both. They are part of the Melia group, a hotel chain with presence around the globe. ( you would think it  would  be better run ). 
I would rate it as a 2 star hotel based on management  and attention to the guests. The location with the beautiful ocean view from the main lobby , rooms,  grounds and beach may be worth a 4.5/5 star rating.

I CANNOT SEE US GOING BACK  TO THIS HOTEL.

reviews.author: EPM3
reviews.title: CAN'T HELP FEELING LEFT OUT
reviews.text:
As I arrived with my wife and two children ages 21 and 15  I was amazed by the beauty of the property and the ocean view from the lobby. Check in went smoothly  and when we arrived at our 2 bedroom master suite we were impressed by the large size of the suite and quality of the furnishings. 

As we explored the property we started to realize that we were considered "standard people" based on the green bands that were put on our wrists when  we checked in. These serve as room keys and as we started to realize keys to many other things if you had a different color band.

It took a full day just to figure where we could eat, sit on the beach,or get a drink. It turns out there is an adult side to the resort which we knew about but there is also the circle club. Within this club are three levels based on the color of your band. This circle club has its own beach area, bars with upgraded liquor and restaurants they can only go to. I have to admit after spending a significant amount of money it irked me that I was considered "standard". 

Once I got used to being just a green band and discovered where I was allowed I had a good time. We enjoyed the Tokimeku which is an hibachi style restaurant as well as Macalzone the Italian restaurant. Mina the steakhouse was also good.The buffet Lunch box was average at best. While on the topic of food I must mention the one recurring theme, temperature of food. Unless the food was cooked in front of you like the hibachi  you would be hard pressed to find any food that was other than lukewarm at best. My family found it comical that the food that should be hot was not and the food that should be chilled (like the cheese at the buffet) was warm and sweating like someone who just completed a triathlon.

We found the people who worked at the property to be nice especially Victor the bartender and Lucy at building 4 where we stayed. We did find that there was a language  barrier with few workers understanding English, which I found confusing since 60% of the clientele seem to be English speaking.

This is where I get to the title of my review. I left this resort feeling like I missed something due to my "standard " designation. The beach was beautiful, the property was beautiful,  room was great but I felt  like you only get so much up to a point and that's it unless you upgrade. I understand that this is a growing trend especially  in all inclusives but maybe the resorts should consider a seperate and distinct property for the higher levels so people who spend a substantial amount of money don't feel like me...left out.

reviews.author: Barbie
reviews.title: Excelente servicio Ginger Bar
reviews.text: Excelente el servicio del bar café GINGER, el trato siempre amables, excelente actitud de ANTONIO, CLARI Y DOMINGA, las bebidas excelentes y ellos 3 siempre bien alegres y serviciales, atentos a lo que les pidas, excelente servicio en el ginger

reviews.author: Shailesh D
reviews.title: Top management need more helpers during group arrivals. They need to provide better minibar service for refilling.
reviews.text: Marvin is an outstanding employee. He has gone out of his way to accommodate our group of 10 people. During lunches and dinner. his services were second to none. You are fortunate to have Marvin. Top management needs to provide better service. They need to keep their promises. They must assure that they will not run out of food such as Hashbrown, fries, etc

reviews.author: Cadys C
reviews.title: Pérdida en la habitación.
reviews.text: Estuve en el hotel y perdí parte de mi maquillaje. Alguien se lo llevó de mi habitación. Lo utilicé el viernes y ya el sábado no estaba. Llamé y Seguridad me dejó 3 horas esperando en la habitación y nunca llegó. Al final salí del hotel y nadie dijo nada.  Y la puerta se abre sola, no requiere llave. Increíble 🥹🙈🙈

reviews.author: Karen Denise H
reviews.title: Visit Paradisus by Melia Punta Cana
reviews.text:
The purpose of our trip was to help the community in the sugar cane fields in Eguay.  We accomplished our mission.  We fed over 100 families and gave clothes, shoes and toys and candy to the children! Melia Paradisus Punta Cana was the bonus for our mission trip.  This property is nice and has even greater potential, the attention to detail is lacking, crossing the “t” and dotting the “i”.  

The package that I purchased included transportation but unfortunately the resort did not receive my request after I followed the instructions, followed with many phone calls and additional emails. The voicemail was full and I was told they don’t work on weekends.

I arrived in PC and the partner transportation company Otius at the airport could not assist me as my name was not on the list. The situation was resolved for my return trip however I was NOT reimbursed for my taxi ride to Paradisus.

Once we arrived the room was nice however again the mini bar was included but it was NOT stocked daily and we had to call to get more beverages.  The room was cleaned daily however they ran out of face towels and body wash after the first day.

Food service was good however we dined at the Mina Steakhouse and they were out of the New York Steak, I thought that was interesting for a steak house!  Room service was available 24 hours but the number of items you can order per person was limited. Very interesting as well.

Just to be clear the resort was not busy at all until the 4th day of our stay so I’m not sure how or why these mistakes occurred.

Our butlers Samual and Jose were amazing and the wait staff in the restaurants were so kind Alex, Jesus, Gladys and many more.  Marielisa was so patient and helped me secure my transportation back to the airport with Simon and Bonnie (Otius Transportation).

For your amazing staff consider better ventilation for your staff that are at cooking stations.  The temperatures were extreme.  And they work hard to keep up with orders.  The staff serving beverages, cleaning tables, floors, etc, they are incredible and they keep the customers happy and coming back!!!!!

Will we come back ? Yes. There is more mission work to be done here.

reviews.author: juan r
reviews.title: No the same Palma a Real that I knew
reviews.text:
I want started giving thank you for the employees that I contact for help and support me in my vacation. Like Raul tepanyaki ,Luis y Santos en el Cana, Raul our server in the beach, our concierge Ariel. The hotel is nice if you come first time, but for the repeat customers is a bit disappointing. The breakfast  does not have everything that the hotel used to offer customers, for examples simples things as a bagel, cream cheese , Serrano ham, mini cereal boxes, diferente fruit juices, the variety in a lunch and Dinner are not to many things to pick and make your decision.
