You’ll be approached every five minutes by someone selling something. Might even be the same guy multiple times. Even if you walk the beach to different resort sections it still happens.  Very uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: First Time to the Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
Of course I had an amazing time as we were on an island in the middle of North Dakota (USA) winter. The hotel was only so-so. I am taking into account that I am sure that COVID has hurt all hotels and trying not to be biased.  The villa area that we were in the ponds have been neglected and the center of the villa/room area looks as though it may have had a fountain and plants at one time but has been forgotten.

 The hotel was probably about 40% full. 

Pro's
Not crowded
Buffett had a large variety of food
The wedding & Dinner that we attended was beautiful
Beach was taken care of plenty of seating near the ocean
We had a 1 bedroom suite and the room was huge (more like an entire apartment)
Pool was well maintained & pool bar was fun
When we arrived our safe did not work but it was replaced as soon as we said something
Very Friendly staff and guest service attendants
Pool towels are provided
Close walk to a shopping area

Con's
If you were not in the reserve section reservations for restaurants were late (like 8:30-9pm)
Our mini-bar was sometimes stocked and sometimes not
The restaurants are not all inclusive - we went to the Steak Cave and had a terribly thin overcooked "ribeye" for $55 each - would not recommend
Spa was very overpriced - $200+ for a massage

If I were to stay here again I would definitely upgrade to the reserve section. When they say preferential restaurant reservations they mean it. The reserve section also has their own pools and restaurants only available to them.

reviews.author: Barbara M
reviews.title: Mal trato para Melia Rewards Platinum
reviews.text:
Fuimos al paradises palma real con una reserva a través de la web de Melia con una tarjeta American Express Melia Platinum. Reservamos en la web la habitación más cara, Roulette que no sabíamos que era como un juego a la ruleta y no tiene que coincidir con las fotos. 
Cuando llegamos nos dan una habitación vieja con un minbar prácticamente vacío. Al día siguiente cuando quisimos ir a la zona de hamacas nos dicen que con nuestro pulsera blanca no podíamos estar allí, vamos a recepción y como cliente Paltinum de Melia Rewards nos dan una pulsera que nos permite ir a las zonas exclusivas pero al pedir el cambio de habitación nos dicen que no tienen nada mejor.
Una habitación vieja, con una nevera que hacía tanto ruido que nos despertó dos noches, con un minibar que nos rellenaron el día antes de irnos porque lo pidieron desde el departamento de Circle (de lo que también somos socios red). El ultimo día al llegar de la playa a las 17 de la tarde aún teníamos la habitación sin hacer y para terminar de rematar al recoger nos faltan unas chanclas de la playa que quiero pensar se fueron al recoger las toallas del suelo al recogernos la habitación. 
En definitiva, no sé si esta gente sabe cuanto dinero hay que gastar para conseguir un nivel platinum de Meliá pero deberían de tener más cuidado y algún detalle más que simplemente pedir disculpas, más cuando el hotel estaba en torno a un 50-60 %.
Le doy 3 estrellas porque los empleados son muy amables, pero sinceramente poco resolutivos. 
Para lo que pagamos por 4 días hay mejores opciones en la misma zona hotelera.

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Has its ups and downs
reviews.text: Food at restaurants were good.  Buffet was fair except for the sauteed grouper-excellent.    Pool bar and lobby bar was great.  Luis rocks!     Demand service from your concierge.  Ours was not very helpful.  Didn't help us much other than one late night reservation.  Beach, bars, pool all very good.  Expect lots of solicitation at beach from locals.      Rooms were a little dated but fine. Room service was a little shaky.  Didn't know if towels or fridge was going to get stocked.   Brush up on your spanish.  Big language barrier.

reviews.author: Marcelo M
reviews.title: Lo mejor el bar de la plaza,excelente los barman y los tragos
reviews.text:
A la noche, después de cenar lo  mejor es el bar  de la plaza,
Aveniu!!!
En especial Doris, que nos atendió siempre súper bien! 
Excelentes tragos y servicios, muy amables y gentiles, en un ambiente muy especial, cálido. 
La cerveza presidente excelente!

reviews.author: Shay D
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, friendly staff, cold food.
reviews.text:
I would give this 4 stars, but the food was not great.  I’m easy going and I can always find something I like, but the main problem with the buffet was the food is not hot… ever. The ingredients seemed good - lots of options, but everything was cold.  The restaurants never got our orders right - not once.  They use some kind of app to place your order, and it clearly doesn’t work well.  Maybe it would be easier if you could point to items on a menu, but they don’t have paper menus, it’s all QR codes.

The resort itself was beautiful.  It looks a bit ill-maintained, though.  Just needing some repairs to tiles in the pool, and things like a handle missing on a cabinet in our room, our air conditioner was really loud (needed service), but nothing terrible.

The staff here is really friendly.  The service is more prompt with tips.  I found that at the buffet, if I put a few dollars down at the beginning of the meal, I received faster beverage service.  Not much of the staff is English-fluent, but it’s a Spanish speaking country, so that should be expected.

We stayed in a swim up room at the reserve.  I was worried about the distance from the beach, but the golf carts were almost always at the ready.  Only once or twice did we have to wait. I think the additional space we had in our room was worth the distance from the beach.

Some of our group were in the main part of the hotel, but had upgraded to “reserve” rooms in the main hotel. I think the biggest benefit is that you have a concierge that helps you make all of your dinner reservations and responds to other requests via WhatsApp. I saw people waiting in line at the restaurant desk after breakfast each day, and was happy to not to have to do that.  Plus the Palazzo restaurant was nice for lunch, but I wish I could bring my kids there.  The reserve pools are totally dead.  No one uses them it seems.  But if you like quiet areas with lots of Bali beds pool-side it’s a plus. My kids used the pool a lot, which was nice when we wanted to go back to the room, but they wanted to keep swimming.  The beach also had reserve-exclusive areas, but the resort wasn’t very busy so you could find chairs with shade at any point of the day both at the beach and the pool, especially at the adults only pool area (which is connected to the main pool).

Covid testing was a breeze.  It took about 10 minutes.  In speaking with other groups we had heard that they had claimed they only had one positive test in the past week in the whole resort, which seemed like a very low positive rate. We didn’t meet anyone who had anyone in their group test positive, and there were multiple weddings there.

Overall, I think I got what I paid for.  This resort was nice for the cost. I probably wouldn’t recommend it just because of the food - but we definitely had a good time.

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.title: Beautiful Property; AWFUL Food
reviews.text:
So, this will be a long one with both good & bad. I stayed here from Jan 18-28, 2022 with 26 other people for my destination wedding week. Let me start by saying the property was BEAUTIFUL. The grounds were well maintained, and staff were constantly cleaning the property. The beach was very nice & the pool is very close to the beach, so there is not much walking required from your room, to the pool, or to the beach unless you are staying in the Reserve, which was great. The check-in/out was very easy, with minor issues. They switched rooms for whoever wanted to switch rooms with no issue. The WIFI works great throughout the entire resort. 
All of the staff that we encountered at the resort were amazing. Everyone seemed lovely & happy to be there & everyone really went out of their way to make you happy. The main issue was Food.
Food: AWFUL. I have been to Punta Cana several times & always stay at 5 stars & this was by far the worst food we’ve ever had. It was IMPOSSIBLE to get dinner reservations at any of the restaurants & when you did, it took over an hour to be served. Several couples in my party had the same issue & all of us had the same issue at the Italian where no one got served after an HOUR of waiting. We finally said something to our waitress & when our food finally came, the meatballs were RAW. When we told the manager, he apologized & stated how the chef working was not a real chef & for us to write a review, as he needs more staff/help. It was not these workers fault; it was very easy to tell that they are understaffed & Melia needs to hire more staff. For reservations; we had to tip to get anywhere & that was the only way. We went everyday @ 10AM when they told you to come & the girl said no to every single place. It was honestly a joke!! All of my 26 guests had the same issue. You couldn’t get one whether you had 6 people, or 2. The buffet food was always cold (for every meal). The warmers were never turned on & when we recommended they turn them on, we were just told no. Breakfast was okay but it was still never warm. The staff at the main buffet during breakfast were amazing, especially Rosanna! The beach cart that served food was good but it never opened on time, which wasn’t fun when we were hungry! We were also disappointed that there was no sports bar to go late at night… This sucked big time!! All I can say is by the end of the week, we were leaving the resort to go eat elsewhere for dinner because the food was that bad.
Main Pool: The pool was pretty quiet with no activities, but the bartenders were awesome! The staff near the pool were awesome too. Everyone was very attentive & they remembered what you liked to drink, which was very nice. They made shots for our big group everyday & always had us feeling great! There is music playing at the pool. It was always easy to get a chair, or several chairs. The pool also has an amazing view of the ocean which was beautiful to look at all day. We really did enjoy the pool! This is where we spent all of our time.
Rooms - Luxury Junior Suites: Quite outdated IE: Cracks everywhere, doors to balconies broken & don’t lock, the fridge is very loud & shower takes a long time to warm up. The cleaning staff did come everyday but we had to call SEVERAL times for water to be refilled. We finally gave up on the third day & went & got some bottles at the lobby bar. When they did decide to refill the fridge, they also brought cookies & chips, which we enjoyed but this maybe happened ONCE during our 10 day stay. We also had multiple guests have issues with the safe & AC. Our AC was not great but it wasn’t awful enough for us to switch rooms.
COVID 19 Protocols: We all felt very safe here! There was hand-sanitizing stations everywhere, and all of the staff wore masks. Masks are enforced in the buffet, where you also wear a glove. You were supposed to wear a mask everywhere that was enclosed but it was not always enforced. I do wish they enforced this a little better, but again we all still felt very safe. Most places are outdoors, so it was nice in that sense. The testing process to go home was very simple. They set this up for you when you checked in. 
Wedding: I was supposed to get married here & am SO glad that I didn't. When I first reached out to the resort, they were in constant contact with me, and when they got my $500 deposit, the contact ended. I emailed several times asking questions or for updates with no reply. With only 2 months before my wedding, I talked to many other brides having the same issue & I am SO happy that I made the decision to get married at the Jellyfish. I found through Facebook Groups that the Romance Department was not fully operational due to Covid, which I understood but then why take on my wedding?! I just couldn't plan my wedding with a team that wasn't 100% working & I made the right call. Paradisus was giving no incentive to have my wedding there, even though I had almost 30 people staying with me for 7 days. It was also going to be almost 25KUS for a wedding that didn’t have everything I wanted. Please, brides looking into Punta Cana, go to the Jellyfish. It was AMAZING & half the price for the wedding of my dreams. The Paradisus also did nothing for us even though it was our wedding trip; this didn’t help us get reservations, upgrades, etc. It was also impossible to use our $500 credit. You can use it on the Spa, or Wine. So we bought lots of wine! 
Overall: The resort is beautiful & has the perfect layout, the staff were all amazing, but they need to improve the wedding program & they MUST do something about the food because it was an issue for everyone, including every couple we met at the resort that week. Everyone agreed that the food was not good & no one could get into the restaurants for dinner (when they looked almost empty every night). Very sad for such a beautiful resort. We all understood that Covid may have changed things but it was simply ridiculous. If the resort is going to run with no staff, they shouldn't be charging for a luxury price. This seemed to once be an amazing resort, but I assure you I will never return.

reviews.author: Drodo
reviews.title: 2022 wedding Trip
reviews.text:
I want to first off by saying that the resort, beach and pool is beautiful. But the food is garbage. 90% of the food at the buffet is cold and the other half is gone. Went to the buffet at 730pm and a lot of the food was picked over and not replenished.  Some of the specialty restaurants are tasty but seemed to be understaffed and not ran well ( at one restaurant we waited an hour for the appetizer... ). 

The drinks were really good at the resort but not consistent at every bar.  Overall it was an amazing trip but wouldn't go to this resort again based on the food experience.

reviews.author: Bruno O
reviews.title: Great property, friendly staff but food needs much improvement
reviews.text:
My wife, daughter (17 months old) and I stayed from Dec 18 -27 at the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel.   For this review I'd like to concentrate on 3 areas that are important for my family when traveling.  1. The property,  2. The Service and 3. The food.   

1. The property (about 10 years old - I was told by the concierge) -  We booked the luxury junior suite during our stay (room 3209).  The room itself was OK -  looked renovated, it came with all the advertised amenities and we even had a crib delivered to our room which was very nice and comfortable for our daughter.    The only issue was with a couple un-invited cockroaches we saw in the washroom during the 9 days we were there.   The property overall looks very well maintained and clean;  the lobby, pools, beach, common areas, etc.   Amenities within the property were also to standard.     

2. The Service  -  From the time we arrived we felt that the staff were attentive and friendly.   We had personalized concierge service provided by Reina; who was hyper-attentive and friendly.  Reina gave us her cell number so we could communicate with her at any time during our stay.   She took care of all the restaurant reservations and every morning she sent us a daily list of activities for the day; which we found very handy.   During Christmas eve she left a gift for our daughter and a nice bottle of wine for my wife and I; which was supper nice of her. There was definitely value in having Reina throughout our stay as she made us feel at home and organized.  There were other staff we interacted with regularly, like Rosanna - our waitress in the breakfast buffet area, Raul Jimenez - our server at the pool and the bartender also at the pool who I can't recall his name unfortunately.   They were all very friendly and always attentive.   However, we also felt that other staff members were not as happy and attentive sometimes.   We strongly recommend their Photography Services.   We had a photo shot session and shots came out great.  Prices are reasonable and photos look professional.   

3. The Food - I fully agree with other reviews on this hotel.   The food is just not up to standard for a 4-5 star hotel.   Morning and Evening Buffet - there was some variety; however, most of the food did not taste good, it was cold, bread was hard (old), meats were too chewy,  sauces had no flavour, etc.   There were 5 specialty restaurants in the hotel; however, the only ones we enjoyed were Brisas and the Sushi Bar.   I would not recommend the hotel if having good Food is a priority during your stay.  

I think that if this hotel can get their act together on the food it would make a huge difference.

reviews.author: darryl m
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We are very experienced travelers sandals secerts ,royaltons.  WE stayed at the reserve This hotel is beautiful pools, bars Restraunts  staff is great beach is very nice cleaned up every day from seaweed.The main problem is the food the buffet is 3 star the meat was like chewing rubber.The specialties restraunts  where worse super small portions and  no where the quality of the above resorts. very disappointed would not go back or recommend.

reviews.author: PatriciaI
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Christmas & New Years 2021
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, this review is not the one I hoped I would be writing. Our family trip to the Paradisus Palma Real resort was short of expectations. We were 2 adults and 3 teenagers. 

To be fair and honest, the hotel itself - main lobby area, the plaza, pool, restaurants for dinner where you needed a reservation were of 5 star quality, these main areas were clean and kept up to date including the gardens. Covid-19 sanitary measures were observed, a lot of hand sanitizing stations and employees masked. 

The Beach itself is one of the best. Simply outstanding. Soft white sand that is kept clean (big trucks come and clean the seaweed). Chairs & towels always available. The water sports team was always helpful and kept the equipment clean and ready when needed. This area of the hotel was efficient.

When we arrived at the hotel on the 23rd, our room was not ready, however we were greeted with drinks while the front desk processed the paperwork and presented us with our very own concierge who was responsible for booking  our dinner reservations, resort activities, extra excursions and to help us during our trip. She brought us to the buffet for lunch while we waited and we exchanged what’s app QR codes (this was the main route of communication) for us to contact her whenever we needed.  This service & employee (Leonela) in particular was clearly experienced and for our entire stay kept us informed early each morning of the resorts activities of the day and confirmed our dinner reservations. She also checked in several times each day to ensure we were comfortable and having what we needed.  Having her as our concierge was essential for us all to relax and enjoy. Her services were of 5 star quality. 
She took care of everything. Quite literally - even when it fell outside of her responsibility.
Let me explain.

Accommodations: We reserved a Master Suite with 2 bedrooms. The room very large but …size means nothing. Aside from being completely outdated. It had broken cupboards - literally off the hinges, cleanliness was sub par, moldy smelling, windows and class was filthy, only full size bath towels available, a million little bottles of hair conditioner, no shampoo or body gel (except for the last night - we received full size bottles of body gel). You simply didn’t want to touch anything. The sofas were very old and not comfortable and we had no place to hang our swim suits to dry…which i found a little odd. We spent a good 20 -30 minutes every night chasing and killing mosquitos that i can’t explain were rampant in the room. The television remotes in all the rooms (4 in total) did not work - none of them. We took turns manually changing the stations. The toilets were not functioning smoothly. Fans in the bathroom were not working and in one of the showers the drain was clogged so you took a bath while showering. 
The day after we arrived, we went to guest services for them to contact maintenance and advised them of the clogged drain in the shower & mosquitoes, we had to go back 3 more times as nothing was done. On the 4th day, I  took pictures of the shower clogged with water filling and sent them to Leonela. Within 1 hour she came to see me on the beach to advise that a maintenance team was in our room at that exact moment fixing the drain.
The next day, before 8am - I sent her pictures of the broken cupboards and at 9am, the maintenance was knocking at the door to fix it. 
This IS ONE OF THE MAIN REASON we rate this hotel 3 and only 3 STARS.

Food: This is mixed. But 4 stars. Let me address the food itself. The restaurants were very good. The Mexican Cielo has a wonderful bavette steak,  Mediterranean Aqua served a delicious lamb kabob (at the reserve), Teppanyaki Mizu (at the reserve) was entertaining, Italian Olio had amazing wood oven fire pizza. Each provided an ok menu selection and all seated us earlier than our reservation. The bad side was they always seemed to run out of dishes particular to that restaurant ex. At the Mexican we went twice with the idea of eating Mexican. But the only Mexican dish on the menu was not available….both times??
On the 24th and 31st - it worked a little differently.  There was a set menu for the entire resort with only 2 selections so no matter which restaurant you were booked at on those nights you ate what everyone else was eating. Proved very disappointing for the 31st as we were booked at the SAL steakhouse. No options ….the set menu was mainly seafood (not a big hit with my teens) and a very small (maybe 3ounce piece of steak). Extremely disappointing. After all, we paid a premium to be at this place on these dates and it felt they cheaped out on us. The icing on the cake was when i ordered an apple martini and they served me in a paper cup (the disposable ones you get on the beach bar). i refused to accept it. 
Also - snack bar. They had no snack bar available in a 24 hrs cycle. Nothing. So if you missed the buffet closing - you were clear out of luck to grab a snack in between meals UNLESS you went back to your room and ordered room service. This was incredibly annoying and not what we expected from a supposed 5 star hotel. 

The Buffet. Well, what can i say?  A bloody disaster. No coordination of comings and goings, they provided masks and gloves as you entered but they did a poor job of ensuring patrons had their masks and gloves on….think about this for a minute……the only food choice for breakfast and lunch is the buffet. The least they could do was enforce masks & gloves were on properly as people mulled about yelling at each other about what they were piling on their plates…. over the open stations…during a pandemic. The food itself was good and not bland by any means, can’t complain too much. Good fruit selection, great dessert choices. They covered the basics. Even the beach BBQ snack bars where burgers, dogs, wings and nachos were served daily were tasty but Again, they did a really poor job managing the buffet aspects of dressing your burger with lettuce, tomatoes, onions etc. (I had to tell a parent that their 6 year old boy was eating lettuce directly from the buffet…in front of everyone who was lined up for beach bbq). More attention during a pandemic was expected. 

Room Service: AVOID. FULL STOP. We ordered breaking our first morning and vowed to make it our last. 

Drinks: Lobby bar, Gabi Beach bartenders were good. But there was no consistent level across the resort. Hit and miss depending where you ordered from. Beach service was strained. Everywhere seemed to run out of ingredients for drinks requested...seemed odd for a bar. Definitely not consistent. I got the impression the guys running the beach were understaffed. We had to flag down someone down quite often to give our orders or just went directly to the bar ourselves. All the drinks ordered were decent, but the bar at the reserve at the restaurant was exceptionally good, she was pleasant and knew how to make drinks. 

Service. Oh my god. Where do I start. 3 out of 5. Period. With the exception of the concierge (5). The service was excruciatingly poor.  NO ONE, and I mean NO ONE spoke English…..ok well, maybe a few. But asking for a drink, a fork, a napkin was a real pain in the you know what. The front line staff - that is everyone who works where customers are present could not speak English (excluding the guest service or front desk) It was a real shock. Not even the basics. So it made getting good service HARD. We were not blind either to the large Spanish speaking customers who flooded the resort - so we understood that - but a few key words in English is basic. What made it worse, It was evident these employees had no service training, or customer facing experience.  There was no consistency whatsoever. 

The SPA - a full on 5. YHI was WOW.  To have the services I requested I had to go to the Adult resort on the Paradisus property. The bell person brought me over ….3 minute drive. Seriously one of the best spa experiences I have had ever.  Leida was phenomenal, highly recommend. The Palma Real also has a YHI spa but limited only to massages. 

Resort Activities: 4 STARS - water activities were organized and coordinated quite well. The daily scheduled activities had a great variety and the ones my teens did they enjoyed. 

Although we did not receive the experience we expected, we also understood the context of the travel industry resuming after being shut down. That being said, we also felt that Melia and the Paradisus brand gave a false impression about the hotel and services. We paid for 5 star service and received a 3 star experience, And they know it. 
They absolutely know they are fleecing you and hide behind the pandemic as an excuse. 
I will tell you why.

It is this thing called The Circle. They took us on our last day to the Gran Cana a minute away to show us their exclusive higher end luxurious resort…rooms are stunning! They pitched to us that if we became members of ‘The Circle’  we would have access to that resort at half the price of what we paid for at the palma real. 
Seriously? 
So they know the Palma real have terrible dilapidated rooms (they admit this) yet, the membership costs approx $88k-$120k USD which you can pay over 5 years and staying at the luxurious sister resort will cost half of what i paid to stay in crappy conditions at the Palma real.
This version of timeshare is a horrible scam. 
They rely on people being on ‘vacation mode’ and ‘not thinking straight’
The sales guy could read my face and backed down when I said ‘Sorry, this kind of investment is not to be made on a whim” when i asked for the papers he gave to me with the numbers, he refused. So i whipped out my camera a took a snap shot.  Thank goodness we listened for 1.5 hrs only (I got a $100 GC for a massage out of it) …i heard a family who got roped in for 3 hours…..

This is not the experience I paid for and will not be returning to this resort. The key drivers for this decision is because of the rooms/accommodations and service. 
But I highly recommend Punta Cana, cant beat the beach and weather. Put your hard earned vacation money somewhere else!

reviews.author: Paul M H
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
This is my third time at this resort and I must say the resort has deteriorated significantly.  Here are some specifics:
Front Desk: 4/10.  Friendly people totally disempowered by Melia policies and practices.  We had what should have been a minor problem created by Melia booking.  It took two hours to correct and only with me personally calling Melia.  The local staff could not correct things or accommodate us in any way.  A powerless local staff could be a significant issue when traveling in a time with COVID disruptions 
Beach: 6/10.  OK except for continual vendors and a significant algae problem. 
Buffet: 6/10 Okay for kids with hamburgers, pizza and nachos.  Otherwise nothing special.  Service is spotty.
Specialty restaurants: 8/10.  Generally good.  Best part of resort.
Golf: 5/10. Very average course in a region of truly great golf courses (Corales, Punta Espada).  $75 per round is not unreasonable, but they should not pretend that it is free.
Service: 3/10.  Very spotty, perhaps because of COVID staffing problems.  We asked house keeping to make up our room at 10:00am, then again at noon, again at 2:00pm and again at 4:00pm.  It is now 5:00pm and I am still waiting.

Of 30 or so Caribbean resorts I have been to (some exclusive, some inexpensive, some inclusive) I would rate this resort slightly above average overall,
 but considerably below average in value per price.  I will not be coming back.

reviews.author: amanisofia
reviews.title: An Honest Review
reviews.text:
I do not understand how there can be so many five star reviews for this resort. Please be sure to read all the 3 star and lower reviews because that is what you will experience. I have stayed at many resorts and this is my honest review. This resort is situated on beautiful grounds so for appearance it get five stars. However the actual service and food is three stars. The major place to get food is the buffet and it is a zoo .It is basically a free for all. Seat yourself and get your food. You will most likely finish your food before you even get a drink. The food while plentiful and of wide variety is very poor in taste. Lots of it is cold and undercooked. Two of the people in our party got sick from it. I would recommend the restaurants and do not do the buffet. You will need to make reservations for the restaurants and there is a long line that forms every day to make reservations for the restaurants. The food is only a little better but at least you will get some drinks.
There is also very little service by the pool and beach. You will basically have to get up and get your own drinks. The alcohol is lower tier alcohol. They display all these top shelf bottles at the bars however those are not available to you. This is very strange for a five star resort. They have 50 bottles of grey goose lined up on the bar but they don't give it to guests.
We booked the reserve package. We never met with our butler until we went and found him on the second day. He luckily did make our reservations for us. As a reserve member you can also eat at some restaurants and some buffets that are only for reserve members. The only good thing about these buffets for breakfast and lunch is that they are not super crowded. The food is about the same. I also learned later that  there were a lot of extra benefits to reserve that we were never told about.
Also if you are expecting some crystal clear water that is no longer here. It appears the reef has died so while the water is blue it is very sandy and you cannot see through it. Very different then what is in the pictures. It still is a very beautiful beach though with soft sand.
Also of note is that if you do not speak Spanish you will have a hard time since many of the staff only speak only Spanish. Luckily I speak Spanish but I could see other guests frustrated by this.
I was hoping this would be our new family vacation destination but after this experience it was a one time trip to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Eileen S
reviews.title: NOT truly full All-Inclusive
reviews.text: Read the fine print...we thought we were getting all inclusive of golf but turned out that is another $75/person per play.  We bought the top of the line package but were only allowed to use the good restaurants 4 out of the 6 nights.  Xmas night dinner was the same at all places so we wasted one of those nights with the same menu as the buffet or any other place.  Service was hit or miss but our butler was amazing!!!  Wait staff was slow or non existent at times.

reviews.author: eduardosantos2022
reviews.text: Hemos ido varias veces pero esta última encontramos falta de servicio,instalaciones, el tema logístico de reservas fue bastante caótico y si bien en general tuvimos una estadía plena, nos quedamos con vacíos en el servicio y atención.

reviews.author: mom_msp123
reviews.title: Very average resort, not a 5 star experience.
reviews.text:
I booked my vacation through Apple travel agency and I was disappointed.  The website description is for a 5 star experience and advertises it as perfect for an active family.  There were no "non-motorized water sports" i.e. snorkeling, kayaks, etc., and it was very difficult to access the schedule for the limited activities.  

A big disappointment was the upgrade necessary to access the majority of the dining options and largest portion of the beach. Without purchasing this upgrade at arrival our family would likely have been stuck eating the buffet at every meal.  It was also very stressful getting the limited dinner reservations.  We got in line for a dining reservations 15 minutes before the one person in charge of reservations for the entire property gets to her desk.  We were lucky to be assigned times for our 3 nights left, but had no choice on times or location.  It was take this option or go back to the buffet.  

On a bright note the staff was friendly, the food was good and the grounds were beautiful.  But without the "Reserve" upgrade, it would have been much worse.

reviews.author: thebeadinglady
reviews.title: Did you find an eternity wedding band, engagement 💍 and Trinity Cartier ring (3 in 1)
reviews.text:
Stayed here from Nov 14-22 attending a destination wedding .  We were welcome by concierge Reyna, warm and friendly like most Dominicans but immediately try to introduce us into visiting a Melia time share which we decline. We were tired and just looking to having a   relaxing vacation.  Unfortunately next day on Monday one of their spa's therapist Gladys came around selling the spa services.  This time I agree to a massage as our package included a 20  minutes massage which she tried to upsell the  upgrade of 90 minutes massage. Massages are  meant for relaxation and when the therapist  starts talking non stop and asking very personal  questions is difficult to relax,  I'm not an old lady  or look like one and proudly will wear the badge when the time comes,but every other sentence she would say "you must looked pretty when you   were young", while she probably was trying to complement, it just came the wrong way, maybe better training should be done  especially for the hefty price of the massage US$190 and US$215 . Our vacation changed and turned for the worst  as when I returned to chaise lounge where my  husband was seated and I had left my  engagement, wedding  and Cartier trio rings went  to pick up something at front desk missed 2 steps  in lobby, fell and twisted my ankle. Just then as I'm   rubbing my ankle in pain realized I never put my rings back. Quickly texted my husband to tell him I  just fell, when he comes quite a distance from pool side to lobby I asked him to go back and check bag and no rings to be found. In pain and    all I wanted to go back and check as at this point          don't know what happened in the time I was gone      and left in bag at chaise by pool side.  Long story       short though I was told by mgmt they would lookat cameras, I later found out apparently not many cameras to look at, not even at Palazzo Restaurant right accross from where our lounge was. Mgr Grace initially put me in a wheel chair and stroll me back the path that I had  walked to front lobby by then already dark and  we had to wait until next day to search.  The  assistant mgr Delgis and security Weslley and Edy  showed more compassion towards the end of the  week and interest in helping us find   which the sentimental value they represent is    irreplaceable.  After returning home, I've been in   touch with Mgr and assistant mgr and they said        they're still keeping an eye but so far no good    Samaritan have return them.  If you found them   would you kindly contact Grace or Delgis in guest services at hotel. We are hopeful that in the spirit.   of the  season, someone will do the right thing  
 and return them, they mean the world to me and my husband 🙏❤ 
While at hotel, I kept checking with guest services every day to see if someone had found them. After flying back home I contacted Grace again since I didn't hear from her the rest of the week but so far no one has returned them.  We are still waiting for a good Samaritan to return them to  guest services or for hotel staff to find in  bushes/grounds and return.      
Overall the grounds are beautiful, very clean but  to keep it clean you are subjected to constant  noisy leaf blowers while you're trying to relax in  lounges by pool area.   Beach had a lot of seaweeds but tractor do clean in the morning.           
Only 1 buffet restaurant for customers not part of The Reserve.  It seems as if they are short staff for waiters on outside tables. Plastic gloves and  
  masks available before entering buffet line.
Casino worthless, very small and unappealing,  
1 gift shop with touristy items.
Rapid Covid test done on site at no extra cost. PCR US $90.00 
Entertainment show every night at courtyard.
Steak house, Japanese and Habashi restaurants very good. Mexican permanently closed for now.

reviews.author: Zodiac54
reviews.title: Nice resort with room with several issues
reviews.text:
PROS
Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort with stunning architectural design. Best location on one of the widest and most scenic sections of Punta Cana beach. Huge swimming pool. Several good specialty restaurants. Generally friendly and attentive staff at all levels. Carry a working cell phone everywhere you go as no menus, schedules or announcements are simply posted anywhere. You will be surrounded by QR codes which your phone needs to read. Covid testing required for a return flight home is free and available in the hotel.

CONS
1.Food in a buffet restaurant always lukewarm and subjectively average at best. Coffee weak and most likely instant. 2. Resort is open to big weddings, events and conventions. There was actually one in the second half of our week. That meant big, loud (over 100 dB according to my Apple Watch) but private parties (you cannot join) in the main courtyard until late at night and congested restaurants. On the beach itself, right at the border between the Reserve part of Palma Real and the adjacent resort there is another huge, ugly concert stage pumping decibels throughout the day and into late night hours. I was told that the stage is not permanent but I would think twice before accepting a room in the SE corner of the Reserve section at the moment. 3. Be prepared for a relentless pressure from your concierge (one is assigned to you to help you book restaurants, etc) to attend a pressure cooker-type “presentation” designed to have you join an expensive Circle by Melia travel club. Innocently but deceitfully described to you as just to “explain how you can book your next vacation directly with Melia” the scheme is an unscrupulous, hard-to-avoid high pressure operation handled by several layers of sales people and “supervisors” who will not easily take your no for an answer. Overall, Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful place and would be highly recommended if the above issues could be addressed.

reviews.author: Jodego79
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but lacking management quality service
reviews.text:
We spent a week at the Paradisus as I had read reviews of this resort being one of the best in Dominican to have a wedding and I wanted to do in-person research and possibly book the wedding.  The resort is architecturally beautiful and all of the main areas, pool and beach are kept as clean as possible. The wait staff and entertainment staff were very friendly especially Imael at the lobby bar who makes the best happy coffee, Ruby at Gabi Bar, Alejandro, Darlin and Jairo from the entertainment staff.  We had fun dancing with them most nights!  But the hotel and management side of the resort doesn't work as well.  The hotel rooms are nice but the washrooms are open concept - fine for couples not so great for friends or families visiting.  There really isn't too much privacy.  The huge bathtubs looked nice but didn't look clean enough to use.  There were discolourations and marks on it. There is a definite issue with the phones as some of them don't even work.  We had to use the phone in the bathroom to actually talk to someone.  The cleaning service for the rooms did do a good job on a daily basis but I found the mini bar wasn't replenished every day.
Our entire contact with the management team was really uninviting.  When we checked in we were told we had a concierge who would contact us but no one ever did. We had asked for a room with 2 double beds but despite asking twice, we ended up with 1 giant bed and a roll-away bed (we were 3 girls in 1 room and we all wanted our space).  On our 2nd night, my friend sleeping on the roll-away bed realized she had bed bug bites all over her legs.  She had experienced bed bugs before so knew what to look for on the bed as proof. As it was late at night, we decided to wait till the next morning to inform management.  They didn't seem to recognize the signs of bed bugs (rusty blood stains and fecal matter residue) but that could have been a language barrier.  We asked for a new room and they were good enough not to argue about that.  We met with the supervisor Emelin at registration and she initially did suggest they were mosquito bites but didn't push further when my friend said this was her 3rd time and she knew the difference. We were promised a new room that afternoon and once again I asked for 2 beds and the sofa bed to be opened up - we were not going to get another roll away bed.  We had also asked about the concierge that was promised on day 1 and were told we actually weren't eligible for that service but they would give it to us now.   We met with Reina who gave me her phone number and said to call or text her if we needed anything! That afternoon after spending the day at the beach, we went back to the lobby, picked up our suitcases and got escorted to the new room only to find we had 1 bed again (the beds are pushed together).  We asked the person who escorted us and they said they would get someone to fix it.  We then opened the fridge to get some water and it was empty!!  We had to call someone from the bathroom phone but it is impossible to get through and talk to someone who understands.  We tried a few times and we weren't sure if the person we spoke to understood as there was no clear response from them.  I texted our concierge who said she would look into it and I walked back to the desk to tell them that we still don't have 2 beds and no water.  It took 2 hours for our fridge to get filled!  I understand that they might be short staffed after COVID but they are also only at 40% capacity.  My concern is that the service issues is not a temporary issue.  We went out for dinner and came back at 10 and we still had just 1 giant bed for the 3 of us.  So we started again with calling from the room, texting the concierge (with no response from her at all) and we got the service in under an hour.  The concierge never even responded to my message. The next message from her was the activities for the day received the next morning.  We did not see her or receive any more messages from her for the rest of the week - not even the activities for the day!
I also asked when I checked in to talk to someone about wedding inquiries.  It was friday evening and no one was available till Monday.  I had to email them to get an appointment.  My email was returned by Monday aftenoon at which time we were waiting for water in the new room after having bed bugs!  I emailed them back the next morning and told them the list of issues we were having and that I wasn't sure  about having a wedding here anymore. They apologized and asked which resort we were staying at.  I was sad that they couldn't even coordinate that information on their own!  
My friend posted her review on our 3rd day in and on the 4th day, we got told we were getting upgraded to  the Reserve service - access to a separate buffet restaurant for breakfast and lunch, the adult only pool and bar with premium drinks and 1 separate restaurant.  While we really enjoyed all of the perks, the hotel did not see fit to give us this as soon as we reported our issues - only when we complained on a public forum.
Lastly, there is a management practice that we really did not appreciate.  The entertainment staff who we had so much fun with knew when it was our last day and literally were forcing us to give the hotel a 5 star review.  I can't blame them for following the instructions they were provided but management has told them that if they don't get a 5 star review with their names mentioned, their jobs are in jeopardy.  You cannot give the hotel a 3 star review but mention their names and give them credit.  They went so far as leaning over you and hitting the 5 star button on your phone to make sure it gets done.  This really turned me off the hotel management as the final straw.  Exploiting their staff's connections to force a review.  I can easily say that I will not readily choose Paradisus again because of all of this even though I enjoyed the sun, the beach and the food!

reviews.author: 231rt28
reviews.title: not what it used to be
reviews.text: went from a 9 to an overall 5 maybe even a 4 paid for royal service butlers were gone no premium liquor had to beg for 7 ounce can of beer. condition of pool poor missing tiles all over. i wont be back. our paid excursion was terrible not worth losing a whole day

reviews.author: sandy c
reviews.title: Could be better...
reviews.text:
I travelled here with my friends with the intent of experiencing the resort first hand before booking her destination wedding here for next year. We are currently still here on day 3.
The check in process was not pleasant. As soon as we arrived we wanted to take our luggage with us. We were forced to leave it with the bell boys. Then we were asked to be seated and someone would come talk to us. He basically gave us our bracelets and told us our room number with no other information about the resort, how we go about booking the restaurant or our covid tests back.
Because it was 3 of us we confirmed that there were at least 2 beds in the room. There were 2 bed alright but pushed together to make one giant bed. When we tried to call front desk they kept hanging up on us so we had to go back to front desk to make our requests. We asked that the beds be separated and also have a roll in bed brought in (we were not keen to use the sofa/pull out bed). When we returned they brought the roll in, pulled out the sofa bed and the two double beds were still together. All good. We made the best of it. Also we did not expect the rooms to have open concept washrooms. Overall not a huge inconvenience, just some hiccups. 

We haven't had a chance to try the restaurant food yet as we arrived on Friday evening and all reservations were booked.
(Tip: restaurant reservations open up for the week on Sunday morning. If you arrive for your trip on say a Monday or Tuesday, you probably won't get a reservation.) 
But so far we have really enjoyed the buffet food and variety. 

Here is where it goes downhill... 
By the second night in our bedroom just before bed, I noticed little bumps on my legs. It wasn't from mosquitos as we hadn't seen any. And immeditaky I knew to check the bed (I slept on the extra roll in bed). There were bedbug droppings and stains. I didn't sleep all night. The next morning we requested for a room change - I will say that they were very accommodating and did not question or challenge us and agreed to change our rooms. Although when I showed them the photos I took of the bed they said was was just 'rust'. 
We asked that the room have the beds separated. Once again the beds were not separated plus it was just not a stocked/ready room in general (empty fridge, no robes or slippers etc) so we called (at 5pm) to have this corrected. 20 mins they said. The fridge was stocked at 6:30pm and we went for dinner. We returned at 10pm and the beds were still not separated. Made another call and they came right away. Finally. 

Although no fault of the resort, the beach was just not quality compared to those in Jamaica, Varadero, or Mexico. Very choppy and full of Seaweed, despite their best efforts to clean it up constantly. 

The positive is that the service staff are incredible: 
Ismal from the lobby bar makes the best 'happy cofee' and Ruby from the main bar next to the buffet 
is just an absolute gem - pun intended.
The resort grounds are beautiful and kept immaculate. 
Even Alejandro or 'happy boy' - the event staff is a ton of fun and super friendly.

Lastly, my friend never received a response back from the wedding booking/romance office. And at this point the decision has been made not to hold the wedding here.

We do have 4 more days here... So let's see how it goes... But for me personally and my extremely itchy legs... It's put quite the damper on my mood. But I will make the best of it, because this is still paradise and will update should anything notable is worth sharing.

reviews.author: LuGi
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real reversed
reviews.text:
La atención de mayordomo Ariel espectacular y en la barra cerca de la piscina principal Raul excelente. Lastima que recepción no tengan la atención al cliente al igual que los demás perdí más de Cuatro Horas para la habitación y no tuvieron voluntad ni tuvieron la amabilidad de acomodarnos en el primer piso como fue acordonado 2 mese antes de nuestra estadía. 
Pero la atención de Ariel fue excelente y por esa razón consideraríamos volver en el futuro.

reviews.author: Marcela
reviews.title: Our experience: the wait staff was super friendly. However, Juan Castillo, our concierge, in particular was outstanding!
reviews.text:
With exception of the Wine shop, Sal. Steakhouse and Brisas, the food left a lot to be desired. The Italian restaurant (next Brisas) could not find a bottle is Astica, I had to get the bottle from room. 
Our room had a leaky drain pipe and we were out of Kleenex for three day although we made very obvious there were none.

reviews.author: Gendra M
reviews.title: Not value the money
reviews.text:
Hotel looks ok, food is bad, service very bad . Room is nice but we book suite 127m2 , but not clean. Lock doors is broken, we ask to fix it , 2 days we still waiting when they fix them. 
Phone in the room was broken, but they fixed after 1 day asking… 
When we drive in the room, in bathroom was some black hairs, and they are still there. Room cleaner seams to not wash the floor…

reviews.author: dalkysfeliz
reviews.title: Calidad
reviews.text: Me encontré el menú muy repetitivo había lo mismo todo los días servían lo mismo y como mi estancia fue de jueves a domingo me sentí aburrida y sin opciones con respecto al menú, también en las noches.

reviews.author: Jay M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, little disappointed
reviews.text:
Pros:
Beautiful Resort, grounds and facilities were wonderful. Food was excellent. Room was very nice. Beach is phenomenal 

Cons:
Meliá still attempting to up sell “time share” option. Of course they call it that but at the end the day it is still a Time Share. (We know because we owned a points based ownership)
Resort too segregated based on colour of band, if you don’t invest in higher privileges stay you cannot eat or drink or use pools and beach areas in some areas. At least 4 to 5 different levels of access, simply feel too much like a nobody if you have the White band on, 
 Most staff lacking English language skills.

reviews.author: billdav3
reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel for Relaxing
reviews.text: We had a group trip there in September 2021 with several family and friends. I will say this is one of the best looking hotels I have stayed in and I travel quite a bit. We had a One bedroom suite which was outstanding. The hotel is large and the people that work there are very nice. The casino was closed but I'm not much of a gambler anyway. The large pool is very nice although you had to way up the the front of the swimup bar for covid reasons, which didn't make since to me. So you had to get out of the pool, get your drin and get back into the pool...smh. The entertianment is where they loose major points with me as you could really say there is none. The Silent Party was ok, but other than that, the evenings just had a DJ and very few people Participating. The beach need to get the seaweed out, as why stay at a beachfront resort and not be able to enjoy the beach. The restaurants were nice, when open, but the buffets were not good at all. Had the same experince at a Melia hotel in the Bahamas with their buffets, not good at all. the also had food at the pool, but the choices re limited and very slow.  If you want to get away and just relax, this would be a nice place for it, but if you looking for more of a party type of atmosphere, this would not be the place for you.

reviews.author: Rondalya D
reviews.title: Reserve vs Standard side
reviews.text:
Stayed/paid to stay on the Reserve side but received standard service. Please note that the hotel was at limited capacity due to COVID restrictions so it was not like concierge service was overwhelmed. Overall, rating of the standard services was good. 
I would return to the standard side. The food quality and options were good. Staff were very nice and accommodating. Had to complain about housekeeping 
: not cleaning the room in a timely fashion. Only to return to the room, call and have to leave after being out all day so they could clean. Asked for washcloths several times without success.

reviews.author: Alvaro G
reviews.title: Excelentes Vacaciones! Hotel Estupendo pero MUY Mejorable. The reserve o royal service INSUFICIENTE
reviews.text:
Esta fue nuestra segunda estadia en el hotel, fuimos con un grupo de 40 personas en el 2019, realizamos alli nuestro casamiento, y decidimos volver para poder disfrutar solos en pareja de nuestra estadía en esta ocasión. El hotel pese a todo esto y a pedidos que realizamos con antelación para pasar nuestra estancia alli, y siendo miembros del programa melia rewards, no nos han respodido como hubiesemos querido. Ni un trato que haga la diferenciq por haber invertido en el hotel en una ocasión y volver a elegirlos en una segunda.En general la estadía fue maravillosa, las instalaciones y estilo del hotel hacen todo. Mucha confusión y comunicación poco clara de parte del hotel referente a los beneficios del upgrade que adquirimos para poder acceder al Royal Service o The Reserve que lo llaman. En este sentido sentimos haber adquirido y pagado demás por ello ( sentimos que el hotel busca solo la venta por la venta y no fidelizar clientes) ...en este momento la mayor atención del hotel va para el sector del nuevo hotel Vip llamado grand cana the circle, que la diferencia de precios es minima, solo la ubicacion de la propiedad que queda alejada de la playa es la diferencia, cosa que a nosotros no nos gusta mucho, por ello no elegimos hospedarnos allí. Supuestamente siendo parte de este sector the reseve o royal teníamos acceso exclusivo a zonas de solo adultos y bebidas premium, entre otras cosas. Estos accesos realmente estaban liberados para todos los huespedes del hotel con la excusa de la pandemia (en sintesis primera decepción por haber pagado más por este upgrade) ademas las bebidas premium que supuestamente estaban incluidas eran muy dificiles de encontrar porque nunca las tenian en los bares tanto de la psicinas, del gabi beach, de la plaza, etc. Y si querias tenerlas te insinuaban darles propina permanentemente para poder conseguirlas. Los accesos a restaurantes palazzo y brisas si son exclusivos de the reserve, pero nada sorprendente más allá de un poco de privacidad en ellos. La comida ofrecida por los restaurantes Palazzo, Brisas, Sal, Vento, el Japones realmente excelentes, sin quejas. Las atenciones del personal en todos ellos también muy buena. Aqui resaltar la atencion de José Ramos en Palazzo y Naos, que si nos hizo sentir exclusivos en todo momento. En los bares de la piscina tanto royal como la principal y la de the reserve pegada al circle, los camareros muy desganados y con ganas de solo insinuar propinas para moverse un poco más, pero mala cara y desgano, y sin animos de resolver los pedidos que uno realiza solo ponen trabas. Y eso si, en todo un dia de playa o piscina se acercan unas tres veces como mucho, luego ya depende de vos ir hasta la barra constantemente a pedir lo que quieras tomar, esto sí muy lamentable de parte del hotel, y mas aun del servicio royal que hemos pagado. The reserve o royal service una estafa en este sentido (segunda grand decepción). El buffet Naos con variedad de comida aceptable, de calidad aceptable,  muy monótono, sin cambios en el buffet. Postres buenos en general. El buffet de playa sumamente monotono, solo hamburguesas y nachos, los 10 dias que estuvimos era ir a buscar y encontrar lo mismo, y de muy baja calidad, a veces daba un poco de miedo comerlos, quesos con olor, nachos de dia anterior, etc.
Pallazzo era  de acceso exclusivo the reserve, para desayuno, almuerzo y cena. En el desayuno allí no tenian buffet, era a la carta, y eso nos hacia decidir ir a desayunar hasta naos que nos quedaba mas lejos y habia mayor aglomeracion de personas  (punto en contra para the reserve)
Por ultimo, las habitaciones, mucho que mejorar, pedimos el cambio en la primera que nos dieron, con olor a humedad, telarañas, luces sin funcionar, ninguna supervision previa antes de entregarlas (tercera gran decepcion the reserve, no tiene ningun sentido de verdad pagar casi la mitad de la estadia extra por un pesimo servicio que promete exlusivo).
Resuelto esto al dia siguiente, es chuparse un dia de habitacion mala, que nadie te devuelve. 
Más a alla de todo, hemos pasado unas lindas vacaciones, en el proximo viaje tomaremos algunas decisiones más inteligentes, y ojala el hotel sepa resolver estos puntos que tiene en contra. Seguro que volveriamos, pero pagaríamos el upgrade en propinas y aseguramos una estadia exclusiva de verdad jajaja
Por el mismo precio o muy poco más uno se hospeda en hoteles de verdad mas exclusivos y serios. Seguro es lo que hariamos en el proximo viaje a punta cana.

reviews.author: Enrique T
reviews.title: Buena atención pero mal servicio
reviews.text:
no creo que vuelva, la cita en restaurante japonés mal atendida y fuera de hora. 
no dejaron entrar a mi chófer en la garita principal y tuve que ir con la maleta a la entrada para poder 
irme, causándome una decepción con el hotel.

reviews.author: Eduardo B
reviews.title: En proceso
reviews.text: Algunos platos no tenian la consistencia adecuada les faltaba coccion,pero gracias al excelente servicio de Sandi Antigua y Devil Martinez disfrutamos la velada excelentemente agradables,amables y serviciales ajos cerrados les doy mi aprovacion

reviews.author: jeaton2021
reviews.title: Not a great experience
reviews.text: Communication and signage was very poor.  There isn't any information in the room.  You are given a butler and you communicate via smart phone app.  Ours wasn't reliable.  Once we first got there our fridge was stocked with beverages and there was snacks.  The food was horrible and wasn't easily accessible so we asked for more snacks.  We never got them.  Due to no communication and unreliable butler we were never able to get in to any of the restaurants.  The main dining buffet was always hot and crowded.  The food was horrible and everything was room temperature or hot including salads and water.

reviews.author: N5370KIjosea
reviews.title: POCO CLARO "AL MEJOR ESTILO MELIA"
reviews.text: No tienen en cuenta para nada las preferencias y gestiones que se hacen antes del registro. Encontrar lugar/reserva  en los restaurantes puede ser una experiencia desastroza. LOS ALIMENTOS NO SORPRENDEN.

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Our time at the hotel was amazing, the room was clean and the service was superb. The food on the other hand was not good at all. We ended up at the buffet after every dinner reservation we had.  Still had a great time.

reviews.author: Gmills54
reviews.title: Spa was great. The food and drinks were great. Keeping the room clean daily was great. Seven day stay.
reviews.text: The place was nice. The air quality was great. Glad they cleaned the room every day. The food at Palazzo, Vento, Cafeteria and Sal was good. Not happy with what Sal and Rosemary put me through with reservations and spa time.  My three days of spa time was awesome.  Poto over pricing needs to stop. People spend a lot to attend and do things the photos should not cost that much. Otherwise let peering their on cameras or phones and take pictures if you are going to price gouge.

reviews.author: Justin V
reviews.title: Some things very good some things very disappointing
reviews.text: Butler Jessica was fantastic and the highlight of our stay. Helped in all aspects. However biggest takeaway was confusion when we arrived. did not receive any fore warning we were having to move resorts if booking the level or reserve rooms. All alcohol drinks were watered down and not what they said they were. Got a bottle sent to room and it froze in the freezer. All good bottles we were told were display so its just a scam for pictures. All bars were out of the higher end bottles and the cheap stuff was cut with water. Swim up bar was closed even though because of covid which was disappointing. Rooms were an upside and were very nice. Have to make reservations every night for dinner. Food was good in some spots and ehh in others. Very international style buffet which was a hit or miss some days. Big language barrier with servers. COVID tests at resort was very convenient in order to get back to states.

reviews.author: Nyta
reviews.title: Au top mais attention à la séance d'information
reviews.text:
Cet hôtel est magnifique, les gens sont gentils, la nourriture est bonne et la chambre était top mais il y a eu quelques soucis.

Au moment ou nous sommes arrivés nous nous attentions a une magnifique plage mais celle-ci est bleu foncée avec des algues et un long couloir d'algues ( ils ont fait un barrage) rien a voir avec les photos.

Un soir nous n'avions pas eu d'eau chaude alors que nous avions prit une chambre VIP, le service de chambre a fait la sourde oreille malgré nos quelques appels pour expliquer la situation.... Ca fait cher payé pour une chambre sans eau chaude...

Je tiens à vous avertir sur la séance d'information. En vérité il s'agit de vous vendre un abonnent à divers hôtel. la séance était supposé duré 30 min mais elle a duré 2h30!!! La personne qui a tenté de nous vendre ceci ( une italienne effrontée) s'est montré extrêment désobligeante et même rabaissante. nous nous sommes sentis sous pression et dénigrés. je m'en veux de ne pas être partis avant de ce moment de torture mais bon. Vraiment, meme si il vous propose 30 min de massage gratuit contre ce sale moment, n'acceptez pas vous avez meilleur temps de le payer ce massage lol

Mise à part ca j'ai passé un merveilleux moment avec mon compagnon.

reviews.author: TGP
reviews.title: You can do better
reviews.text:
Staff will cater primarily to fair skinned guests and ignore their colored guests until they’ve taken care of their white guests. I’ve even been denied service at the buffet for not wearing proper attire, which I can understand and I am more than happy to change and return, but white guests were allowed to dine despite wearing the same inappropriate attire that I had on. When I returned from changing my clothes (because I was the only one told to do so, of course) and fixed myself a plate, the food was subpar. Everything tasted of salt with extra salt and a pinch of salt on the side. Their food is also mostly frozen, by the way. I had some soursop, a delicious fruit from my home country, and the skin on the soursop they served was black. This only happens when the green, fresh fruit is stored in a freezer and is left to defrost over several days. Keep that in mind, in case you were expecting to taste some natural, homegrown Dominican fruit.  

Our butler was excellent, in terms of booking reservations for restaurants and sending staff to repair most of the items in our room (since, y’know, they were all on the verge of falling apart). Though that seems to be the extent of the butler’s duties, which doesn’t make much sense to me since the front desk should be able to handle that also. And why didn’t we contact the front desk you ask? Well, there’s no number listed for the front desk anywhere in the resort. I always had to go through the room service line and ask to be connected to the front desk. 

The architecture of this place is beautiful, though. If you don’t mind the muddy, stagnant water leftover from when the fountains used to be cleaned and tended to regularly. Nothing says “tropical vacation” like dead, rotting vegetation on the way to my hotel room. 

Now, the beach— don’t even get me started. That place is covered in seaweed as far as the eye can see. The water is rough, which is understandable considering that the Atlantic is sitting right there, but tumultuous waves aside, the seaweed truly makes it difficult to enjoy the beach. 

The pool may be the best part about the Paradisus. It was very clean and well maintained. (I’d just like to point out that if a large hole in the ground filled with treated water is the best part of your vacation, maybe consider staying somewhere else.) 

Overall, I felt more stressed than relaxed here and that’s the exact opposite experience I was expecting when getting away from NYC. Save your money and hit up somewhere with a beautiful beach, and unprejudiced staff. I’d recommend St. Martin! Or Jamaica. Maybe even the Amazonian rainforest. Literally anywhere else on the planet.

reviews.author: Jose L
reviews.title: HORRIBLE
reviews.text:
The building is great. The service overall is horrible. The food is just ok. I will not come back. Had enough of a fake 5 stars. Not even the coffee in your room is real. It take hours to get room service. They give you discounted vouchers for wine that only work if they use the smaller ones.  The beach is non existent.
Full of seaweeds. Go somewhere else. Ver unhappy for a fake and cheap service. There are many other options in Punta Cana and in the Caribbean in general.  Asking for a cappuccino in the morning is a challenge. HORRIBLE AND EXPENSIVE. Just avoid it.

reviews.author: Delia Rodica
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: El personal del hotel,ciertos empleados Claritzel,Jesús Parguero,son los mejores,no así las instalaciones,las habitaciones huelen a humedad,y el bufet mediocre,a pesar del buen servicio,necesitan renovar

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Lackluster experience. Very average resort- there is better out there.
reviews.text:
I visited the Paradisus resort in Cancun in November and had the most incredible time there. Literally 10/10 from beginning to end! After having such a great experience in Cancun, when my family asked me to pick a resort for our vacation in the Dominican Republic, Paradisus was my first pick.  My originally booking was for The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, however this resort is CLOSED. It is worth noting I was never informed of this via email or telephone and found this out only after seeing comments on their Instagram page asking when they’re reopening. Not good customer service on their part. After calling the resort directly I was informed that Punta Cana was indeed closed and I would automatically be “upgraded” to Palma Real which is more upscale. 

Checkin- We arrived to check in a bit early which is great we did because it was not a smooth process. Upon arrival we were informed that there no longer existed a Reserve experience at this resort. Major disappointment there because that was a big reason why I chose to rebook a Paradisus location in the first place. I am also still a little confused as to if that is even the case after being here for two days because there are several different colored bracelets, all which represent different levels of service. I digress.. 
I booked two rooms, one of which I asked several times to be a double as I would be sharing it with my brother. Well, my brother is currently asleep on a sofa bed instead of a real bed. I am not sure how doubles are not available given that occupancy is clearly low. We don’t see much people here to what exactly are they doing with those empty rooms? After we finally get sorted we are guided to the buffet to basically kill time since our rooms are not ready. 

Drinks/Alcohol- My dad went up to the bar for a Johnny Walker and he is informed they don’t carry that there. What happened to the so called premium drinks they’re offering? I’ve been to other resorts in the Dominican Republic where they keep full sized premium liquor bottles in the hotel rooms, and here they don’t even have it at the bar/ only have it at one bar. 

Food- I am honestly not picky with food but have enjoyed the buffet, however making reservations for the restaurants they promise is difficult. Again, after having such a great experience in Cancun I was really looking forward to the restaurants here. There seems to be only 2 open and the reservations fill up quite quickly. So, be warned. I am not sure if it’s possible to call ahead of your checkin date to reserve but if so, I would try that. I did manage to snag a reservation at Tokimeku and from start to finish it was incredible. I recommend arriving a bit early to get drinks at the bar before your dinner there. Food was great! 

Property- Pretty, but some parts definitely need updating and just basic maintenance. 

Rooms- Because of our inconvenience we were supposedly given the biggest rooms. The room is spacious but looks outdated. 

Staff/service- the staff is kind but it seems the service really varies depending on where you are at the resort. For example, earlier today at the pool when I was with my brother we were approached several times by a waiter for drinks, which was nice. However later that day when we went to the swim up pool the bartender informed us they are not serving guests at the pool and we have to come up to get drinks. Not a hassle, but then what’s the point of a swim up pool? 

Bottom line- the COVID excuse can only get you so far. This resort is certainly not on par with other Paradisus locations and if you’re looking for an amazing vacation in the Dominican Republic and have the money to spend, I would personally recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: MARTA HELENA AZUERO
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real en decadencia
reviews.text:
La calidad , presentación de las comidas es de muy baja calidad.Nunca quedé satisfecha de ir a ningún restaurante ,que había sido una experiencia muy buena en ocasiones anteriores. Eran restaurantes manejos hasta por chefs con estrellas Michelin.
El personal es muy amable

reviews.author: Rebecca698
reviews.title: If you're planning on that $1,000 "Resort Credit" be warned.
reviews.text:
Pro's: The grounds and beach are some of the most beautiful on the island. The staff are, for the most part, amazing...kind and generous people.  Pedro, at the Royal Service beach bar remains a stand out two trips in, he's just awesome.  Almost all the staff are patient and willing to guide you if you're a Non-Spanish speaker (seriously), even the grounds guys.

Con's: If you booked with the hope that you could do something special with your $1,000 resort credit, basically that boils down to a checkbook of coupons that you'll receive at some point in your trip, which you have to present at the time of the service.  By the way, none of that will be explained to you (even when you ask).  So just know that.  Also, be FULLY prepared to be constantly asked to visit their fancy new area, "The Circle" so that you can experience "endless vacations".  You guys, the legit guilt trip that's laid on you to visit is nuts.  I get it. COVID sucks.  This is a resort town that needs vacationers, but we were stopped and asked (at length about this) at least five times. And not asked, asked, but like in depth conversations.  Lastly, the beachfront "guards" will never intervene with vendors selling their wares on the beach.  If you're there, prepared to be asked to buy something several times a day.  It is what it is. 

Will we be back to Punta Cana, YES.  Will we stay with Melia again? TBD.

reviews.author: RetiredandReady
reviews.title: Beware - the property is not open. You will stay at The Circle by Meliá
reviews.text:
The good- DR is beautiful and we were able to get into the country and resort last minute. We were headed to Cozumel until Hurricane Delta hit. So fast forward 2 days. We originally book at another resort but service there was no existent. Agent got us move to PPRG&SR last minute, but when we arrived we actually were at the Circle by Meliá. Very modern but NOT beach front. So I can’t review PPRG&SR, but until Covid impact is over be sure and ask what resort you will actually be at. 
They didn’t tell my agent about the change.

reviews.author: Vacation39541512059
reviews.title: Not very Royal
reviews.text:
Not very pampered for Royal service. Advertise that golf is included but paid $75 per person for carts. Why is that not included in the :royal" service?
Restaurants are not really "dining" they are more like mess halls with very bright lighting. Food is served as fast as they can make it.

reviews.author: Kian
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text:
-The food was very average

-Making reservations for restaurants was based on an incredibly silly system: you have to make a reservation everyday (fine so far), then you have to go back at 3 PM to confirm! I mean when you reserve then you reserve...what's with the going back. It takes time from your beach and other activities. Good luck going back :)

-The staff were great! Very polite and professional

- The rooms were dated and the ventilation system was noisy at night

reviews.author: sean m
reviews.title: not so happy
reviews.text: we've been here three times now over the last 4 years and its gotten a little worse with every visit.  tho the resort and  its beach area are very well maintained the service had a lot to be desired.  with the exception rauoly who helped us with our poolside  service-everyone else that we dealt with wasn't very friendly. there seemed to be a push for the staff to "upsell" us. we paid enough to get there why try to get every last nickel out of us when we are still getting the same service-rooms-food and drink.... the food in the buffet was just average and become very redundant by the third day and the so called 'specialty' restaurants aren't really that special.  the food was average at best and the wait between courses was a bit too long. not sure why they require reservations to these places - everytime we went they were barely full and yet we had to wait well past our reservation times to be seated.  all in all i don't think we would recommend the palma real like we once did and won't be returning in the future.  there are many other options all up and down resort row...

reviews.author: Katrina k
reviews.title: Overall enjoyable stay
reviews.text:
Visited  the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for a 3 day weekend trip, a girl’s weekend.  This was my second time at the Reserve, my first visit being several years prior with my children, but this was my girlfriend’s first time in Punta Cana.  We had the one bedroom master suite which is plenty large, however the water closet is so small that you can’t close the glass door when using the toilet, as the door will literally hit your knees.  The room was clean and comfortable.  Do expect  grainy tv reception on every channel if you enjoy watching tv at night before turning in.  The front desk was gracious enough to move us on our second day to a pool facing room so we could have a nicer view.  The staff we encountered at the resort are all friendly, professional, always with a seemingly genuine hello and small talk.  

Several restaurants were closed, which we found out from a trolley driver. That was one of the disappointing things about our stay, not just that several areas were closed but also that it was not mentioned by the desk staff. I distinctly remember on my first visit being given a thorough rundown on checkin of all the various eateries, locations of lounges, a map of the property, etc.  I remember having a concierge at the Reserve to help with making reservations and anything else.  I remember having someone help secure pool lounges and also turn down service and a surprise snack/desert/ treat waiting in the room every night.  The level of service from the Reserve previously experienced is what made me book a return trip here.  That was lacking on this trip. We did not receive any information upon checking in, no resort map, no details about what would be open during our stay, not even a list of activities. I asked and was given the activities schedule at the desk, but that should have been automatically given with checkin.  We were left to figure things out ourselves.  Had I not visited the resort previously we may not have even found half the places we did (for example, we were checked in through the main resort lobby and brought by golf cart directly to our room in bldg 42, bypassing the Reserve lobby and concierge, and if you don’t walk around you’d have no idea it was even there).  

The resort is doing some renovations/repairs as the entirety of the restaurants that were down by the beach were all closed with the exception of the Gabi Beach Club buffet and that was only open for certain meal services. The Gabi Club in the Reserve appeared to be open to everyone, which made for an extremely busy and crowded dinner service our last night, with the kitchen running out of glasses at one point and giving out water bottles and only having enough silverware to provide a single fork and knife at our sitting.  Overall, the food is just average, with a few exceptions like the shrimp ceviche at Fuego.  I found the Italian restaurant to have the worst food, with the food at Vento good but surprisingly slow service, and the service at Fuego to be the best.   Considering it is the same pool of waiters and servers just rotating shifts at the various restaurants that are open on a particular night, why the level of service varied was puzzling. The buffet food was really good to just serviceable depending on the item.  (Good: ceviche, beef tips, grilled white fish, surprisingly bad - omelette, first place I’ve ever had a tasteless omelette). There are no local dishes to be found anywhere on property, a little puzzling and disappointing. The drinks were all excellent.
