The resort grounds are beautiful. The pool, availability of sunbeds and loungers were great.  The place did not appear to be crowded, except for that last dinner at Gabi Club buffet.  There was nightly entertainment of some kind each night.  The dancers were all great as was the DJ.  

A minor sticking point with our stay was with checking out.  We had an early morning flight which required us to be in the lobby at 5 am to meet our transport driver. I started calling at 4:30am and no one at the front desk, bellboy, “0” or concierge extension answered after several minutes (20 minutes to be exact).  I pressed room service accidentally and they managed to pick up on the 3rd ring. So we had to bring our luggage down 3 flights of stairs and walk to the lobby, thankfully building 42 is close enough to the lobby but hurrying in the rain was not how I expected our visit to end. A porter came seemingly out of nowhere when we got to the driveway to the waiting transfer driver and said to us “why didn’t you call me” and even said “it’s raining “ ! I had to yell at the desk to get someone to come take the keycards, even though the porter called someone to confirm we were checking out and that “no one had called”. The whole incident put a sour note on what had been an enjoyable stay overall.

Would I return or recommend visiting here? Honestly, I now see no point in paying extra to stay at the Reserve vs the main resort, as there isn’t enough delineation between the two to make up the cost difference. The hotel grounds and beachfront are gorgeous, and the people are all so wonderful (esp Bienvenido (sp?) and the Gabi Club bartender and food shack waiter).  Maybe once all the reno/repairs are complete and all areas of the resort are open it will be worth it, but now, only if you secure a bargain rate.

reviews.author: HPsauce
reviews.title: Needs Improvements as 5 Star Resort
reviews.text:
2nd visit, and sadly worse this time then 1st time. 

On the positive side first, I want to thank most of the staff, especially Lillian, Victor at lobby bar and Christian & Pedro at bell service. 

Now onto the realities:

- our initial luxury 1 bedroom suite in the main building had no hot water and were shown 7 other rooms before we found one, in an another building.  This process took 3 hours to accomplish, we had to wait until our new room was ready.  Despite the inconvenience the front desk was not too quick to fix the issue and even suggested softly for us to upgrade to “Royal Service” at $100 per night extra.  For the record we didn’t go Royal Service this time because the butler was too intrusive on our last visit.

- food was mediocre at best overall, buffet was very average.  Speaking of the buffet, one lunch seating I had to walk over to the Gabi bar for bottled waters as no server was in sight, already halfway into our meal and then when he finally showed he forgot my wife’s diet coke order! The lunch buffet doesn’t open until 12:30pm, don’t they realize some want to eat a bit earlier?  I do understand food changeovers but how about offering alternative place to eat lunch?

-  I do understand tips are how the workers make a living there. But in my opinion it has gotten out of control.  It felt like every time I moved I had to tip and a few times I didn’t have money/small change and boy did I get the dirty looks.  After all, it is an all-inclusive correct & tipping should be optional?  I am not saying this to be cheap, in-fact I went out of my way to visit the front desk for 2 days straight to get ample small tipping bills but was told no change, both days multiple times!  They kept saying 12-12:30pm, I followed orders but still no change, & why am I on their schedule?  Wouldn’t they want to inventory the small bills so everyone gets more tips?

Bottom line, Melia management, you have a beautiful facility but please improve your service or be honest and lower the star level of your offering.  We have travelled to 15+ all inclusive over the years and this experience is close to the bottom.  We won’t be back sadly.

reviews.author: Paulo T
reviews.title: Mofo.
reviews.text: Um grande defeito para quem tem alergia, renite alérgica é o mofo , comum em regiões costeiras próximas ao mar. Quando chegamos já recepção do hotel já tivemos problemas com nossa reserva e estava bem lotado o saguão principal e o calor não ajudou em nada.

reviews.author: Damian Sauco
reviews.title: Aniversario 25° de bodas
reviews.text: La experiencia en general fue positiva. El complejo es increíble,  así como el servicio y la comida. Animación debe mejorar. Nos prometieron un obsequio en la habitación por el aniversario. Lo reclamamos más de 5 veces, hasta el momento del checkout que nos tuvimos que ir sin él. Nos recibió Julio Luna, quien fue cordial hasta que le dijimos que no queríamos someternos a una charla de 90 min en otro complejo, el que según la oferta, teníamos pase por un día. Esto empañó nuestra estadía.  Una lástima.

reviews.author: Mark R
reviews.title: Nice looking hotel
reviews.text: The hotel in general is very nice looking rooms are OK they need work ,dinners in the evening are very good and the buffet is OK but too much processed food the beach is lovely and the staff is wonderful I had to pay an extra $650 to get a A room with a better view, after an inspection of the hotel several sections in the area that I was in are not maintained very well ,they need work ,fountains are not working, and as you move farther away from the beach the rooms are not as nice and the location is not nice the garden view rooms are OK ,but at the time when I was there the ponds were empty, there is no nightlife except for a tiny casino, the Palazzo restaurant I find is the best restaurant there my butler was wonderful and the staff is really nice and accommodating it was an average stay Nothing extraordinary and I’m hoping that the new management will do a better job you’re a sushi lover you will be very dissatisfied with the sushi they do not know how to prepare sushi properly, The beach is very nice and the cabanas are lovely , The worst thing was that they offered me to 30 minute massages which I did not use to go look at the circle hotel it was supposed to be a 45 minute presentation to try to get us to invest in the property it took nearly 5 hours and when I kept telling them that I was not interested because the other hotel was not on the beach they kept passing me over to more and more people , They took complete advantage of my kindness and patience and ruins in entire day for me and my wife

reviews.author: Al1H
reviews.title: Déception vis à vis de la Direction
reviews.text:
5ème séjour au paradisus 
Certes les dernières fois remontent à une dizaine d’ année mais nous nous réjouissions néanmoins de revenir dans un établissement que nous apprécions
Rien à redire sur l’ hôtel, les prestations hôtelières, les restaurants, le personnel.
Tout est calibré et de qualité
Précision importante tout de même :  il faut savoir que l’ hôtel est principalement familial; il y a donc beaucoup d’enfants.
Mais la déception n’est pas venue de là.
L’hôtel n’était pas à moitié rempli et notre vol de retour était programmé le samedi à 21h le soir 
Vu le peu de monde à l’hôtel, j’ai sollicité de pouvoir conserver la chambre après le Check out du midi en rappelant que nous venions pour la 5ème fois 
Surprise, non seulement je me suis heurté à un refus catégorique, mais il m’a été proposé les tarifs suivants :
De 12h à 14h : 40$
De 12h à 16h : 140$
De 12h à 18h : 260$
Aucune discussion possible !!!!
Que l’hôtel soit plein et que la chambre soit facturée, ça se comprend; mais quand l’hôtel est à moitié vide...je ne comprends pas.
Du coup nous ne séjournerons pas une 6eme fois au paradisus

reviews.author: JLGpineda
reviews.title: Experiencia rara
reviews.text: No rengo nada que objetar en cuanto al personal(muy servicial y atento.Lo mejor del hotel).Por mi experencia de otros hoteles como este tuve una sensacion rara pues habia mas personal de servicio que clientes. Es un hotel pequeño.Lo normal es tener un restaurante BUFFE a orilla de la playa(para asistir incluso en bañador) y otro en el interior sobre todo para las noches...Bueno pues aqui solo hay uno para las dos funciones,el problema que hace mucha corriente de aire(no ay puertas, no hay ventanas)Asi cada dia tanto para desayuno,almuerzo y cena.Aqui la limpieza de las mesas inexistente(una bayeta para las mesas de madera, asientos y cualquier cosa sin enjuagar ni lavar!!,asquito!!,lo he visto personalmente).Muy mal la animación inexistente en la playa y sin espectaculos en el Teatro(solo dos noches)y el resto en la plaza colonial(solo musica al aire libre y aguantando el viento e incluso la lluvia mas de un dia). Resumiendo: Lo mejor el servicio del personal, la tranquilidad(casi no se veia gente, muy extraño) Lo peor:La situacion del Buffe con sus corrientes de aire y lluvia entrando en la instalacion(Solo 2 dias no ha llovido.En eso he tenido mala suerte)

reviews.author: harriette
reviews.title: Spa services at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: While there were several things about this hotel that I did not think were up to par, I was completely thrilled with the 2 spas on the property. I love massages and I was so happy with the setting and Masseuses, I had 4 massages while on my 1 week trip and 3 of them were with Sintya! , at the Oriental Garden Spa. She  was professional, Kind and very skilled. Her energy was so calming and she listened carefully to what kind of pressure I wanted and went out of her way to make my visit  deeply relaxing. She made all the difference!

reviews.author: SeleneDioli
reviews.title: Paradisus... antico!
reviews.text:
Abbiamo soggiornato per 12 giorni in questo Resort con la famiglia (bambina di 7 anni e bimbo di 2 anni).
Il Resort si affaccia direttamente sulla bella spiaggia di Bavaro. 
Paradisus... antico perché la struttura è di architettura un po’ datata ma tenuta discretamente però negli anni si sarebbero dovuti investire un po’ di soldi in rinnovamenti (sdraio della spiaggia sfondate e piastrelle della piscina) e migliorie.
In particolare modo per le famiglie non c’è nulla: piscina per bambini ridicola (vedi foto), kids club o play room non c’è.
Riguardo ai ristoranti a colazione e a pranzo è solo aperto il ristorante principale Naos a buffet qualità abbastanza buona. Il problema è la dimensione troppo piccola del buffet rispetto alla capienza del ristorante stesso.
Alla sera oltre al buffet del Naos c’è la possibilità di prenotare (mi raccomando fatelo il primo giorno che arrivate per tutta la settimana) in 3 diversi ristoranti à là carte Rare, Bana e Vento. La qualità di questi tre ristoranti è buona.
Le camere: come detto la struttura è antica e il bagno sono praticamente affacciato sulla stanza senza possibilità di dividere i due ambienti. Inoltre le dimensioni dell’armadio/cassetti sono esigue se si pensa a una famiglia di 4 persone.

reviews.author: arun567
reviews.title: Good one, but lot of room to improve
reviews.text: The hotel is awesome. The rooms are nice and clean, overlooking the gardens.The pool is huge and very nice. The beach is right next to pool. The evening activities are very entertaining. But food is just Okay. Same stuff in the buffet place every day. Lunch is good. But break fast and dinner are big let down. The staff is not very friendly and overall the service is not great. And everywhere some one is trying to sell local excursion trips, gifts or photos etc.,, in pool, beach and restaurants, that is really bothering.

reviews.author: bstillitano
reviews.title: Pretty Hotel, but certainly would not return
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, your eyes will gaze upon a beautiful lobby with a majestic view straight through to the ocean. Check-in is very simple, but after that is where we encountered several problems.
We were placed on the third floor, took the elevator up and proceeded through a long, long maze of hallways to get to our room. As someone who walks with a cane, this walk was far, far too long. After finding out the elevator was the only one we asked for our room to be switched.  We were told no.  When we spoke to the kind bellman who had helped us, he said not to worry and within 5 minutes, he had gotten our room switched.
One night our lights and a/c went out.  Maintenance was only able to fix our a/c and in the little Spanish I could understand deciphered that he would return in the morning to fix our lights. 
The next morning, I awoke to find everything on my side of the bathroom counter soaking wet; all of my make-up and brushes (expensive things), hair things,toothbrush, etc. As it turns out there was a leak in the light fixture above. We found out that evening that they would compensate us by offering one of us a 1/2 hour massage. We were leaving the next day, and did not have time for a massage. When we explained this, the only other thing offered to us was a room upgrade on our return visit - something we do not plan to do.
Not good enough to me. We will not be returning.

reviews.author: SimplyTravel
reviews.title: Complex nice - service & food medium
reviews.text:
We have been with a big group. 
This is a typical Dom Rep resort. Even bigger that the ones we have been before. 
The complex is nice. Beach is great and everything seems to be well maintained.
Check in was good. Pick up from the airport also worked fine. 

3 things that really annoyed us, and are the reasons we will most probably choose another hotel the next time:

- Service: we have been to Punta Cana before and experienced great service. Not here. Most people working here seemed annoyed by guests. Some where even unfriendly or refuse to work.
Drinks come after 10 mins. In the restaurant. Orders are not taken correctly and waiters are angry if you tell them. One day we asked 3 times for an extra plate- never was brought to the table.
For a hotel.of this category an absolute no-go.
Service at the beach - hm. Got asked one time - afterwards no one came. As well : could be better

-Food: most all-inclusive hotels we have been so far, food never was spectacular but rather tasted neutral. This is even kind of understandable. Nevertheless, we thought the food to be worse than in most other places. Actually most food tastes like nothing. Some dishes are even just bad. Truffle Pasta without truffle (no truffle oil - simply nothing).
Beef with seemingly 50% Fat. 
Hashbrowns which are obviously several hours old or rewarmed with a consistency of rubber.
Wine which is rather vinegar than wine. 
All salt pepper shakers blocked from humidity (if you find some). Personal not able to help you when complaining.

Honestly the best food were the burgers which they make at their beach as well.as the pizza at the buffet as well as the fresh eggs and the French toast at the breakfast. Everything else really not worth it. 
- Room & service: our shower was leaking. We asked 2 times to repair it. Nothing happend and the water kept running for 6 days. I have been to 2 star hotels where this would have been handled more professional.

All together we were kind of disappointed.
As we have been more than 100 people, I know that most of our companions thought the same way.
Consering the price they charge, at least de service should be better.

reviews.author: gonzaloarrieta
reviews.title: Buenas instalaciones, habitaciones antiguas
reviews.text: El hotel si bien es muy bonito en infraestructura, se encuentra bastante descuidado en mantenimiento. La habitación que me toco era antigua y mal mantenida. La playa es linda, piscinas también. Personal muy atento

reviews.author: mddns
reviews.title: EXCELENTE RESORT! PÉSSIMO SERVIÇO AO CLIENTE!!
reviews.text: Pagar Royal Service não justifica. Atenção resort organiza grandes convenções que estragam todo o ambiente. Alguns empregados muito pouco profissionais para um resort de luxo. Quase parece que eles é que estão de férias. Resort é lindo mas os quartos começam a pedir renovação de design.

reviews.author: Christian P
reviews.title: Wedding Anniversary Experience
reviews.text:
We got married at Paradisus Palma Real a few years ago. It was an unforgettable experience so it was a no-brainer to celebrate our anniversary at this place.

PROS:
The place still looks as amazing as we remember it in our wedding. Specially the Main Square and the Pool. 

Our Room, although a bit aged, it was well maintained and clean. Pool, Beach, Gardens and common areas were very well maintained. 

Friendly Bartenders. Every bartender at the resort was friendly, polite, and professional. Great Piña Colada and Chinola (passion fruit) Mojitos. 

CONS:
Preferential Dinner Reservation: It seems that certain hours were for the “better” guests as we noticed later during our stay that none of the restaurants were at capacity. We also requested to add something special on our table for our anniversary. Unfortunately, nothing special was added at dinner time at the restaurant. 

Annoying “Circle by Melia” Staff: Every day we were being approached by “Circle by Melia” guys to sell us those Time-Share packages. One of them even told us to participate on that 2-hour seminar so that he can get his “points”.

The Beach and Pool waiter service was almost non-existent unless you tip. During our 4 day stay, we were approached only once by a waiter. We decided to get the drinks ourselves from the bars. 

The food quality and variety has dropped dramatically. Low quality wine at the restaurants. Some plates at the Vento restaurant were just not fresh.  

Not so peaceful on the weekends, specially at the Pool area.

reviews.author: Anvitha A
reviews.title: Huge pool, Proximity to beach, Average quality food at Buffet but good food at Restaurants if you can get Reservations
reviews.text:
We were disappointed with service at Naos buffet where wait staff did not come to even take drink orders the first 2 days, but after complaining  to head waiter Jose RIviera he ensured we had service from then onwards. We could not get reservations on Friday (the day we arrived) or Sat which is unfortunate and Dinner Buffet food is almost similar to lunch buffet food. Buffet is not great, but we were able to find atleast one thing we liked each time. Burgers and Hotdogs at the beach available 12-1.30 and around 4 pm. So you will not starve, but we got pretty bored after 2 days. Our concierge Richy was great. My daughter got an ear infection when we were there and he picked up antibiotic from Pharmacy for us. Thankfully we did not have to use the doctor onsite (said 160$ charge, but we called our pediatrician and she told us what antibiotic to use). 
Pros: Pool is huge with multiple stations to rest and drink. Drinks were pretty good. Restaurants Aqua, Vento, Rare and Mizu were good; Circus, MJ show and DR show are decent  
Cons: Beach is full of kelp and not cleaned in morning or evening. Some wait staff did not show interest to serve. Entertainment shows were nothing but Dance music/DJ night
Helpful tips: Email ahead for dinner reservations or go to the concierge when they open at 9am Sunday morning to make reservations for the week. If you are traveling from US, DO NOT CONVERT Dollars to Pesos. They use only Dollars in DR and all prices and services are in US Dollars.

reviews.author: Renee
reviews.title: Destination wedding
reviews.text: Overall, not super impressed... we had a lot of broken stuff in our room, including a giant hole in the spa tub. I’m really only writing this review for Freddy Mota at playa-pool. He was amazing. Always there whenever we needed something. He even went and got me a regular Coca Cola from the main kitchen at 730am before the pool opened. Great staff... you have. Just work on the infrastructure a little more- keep up your rooms better.

reviews.author: o1d27jmmmg
reviews.title: No es lo quer era antes.
reviews.text: Fui el 2015 y realmente me encanto! La comida, el servicio era genial. Por el mismo motivo he vuelto...pero es muy distante a lo que fue antes!. No es le mas económico pero ahora la comida no es nada del otro mundo y el servicio normal. Algunos muy agradables solo que se notan que ha habido muchos cambios porque están un poco perdidos. Ademas me enferme con la comida y estuve fatal por casi 2 dias. Relacion calidad precio, no de las mejores!

reviews.author: andysca
reviews.title: Desilusión.
reviews.text:
Estamos en el hotel. Vinimos porque hace dos años estuvimos en el Paradisus Playa del Carmen que es espectacular. Y con esa referencia vinimos. Pero debo decir que no tiene nada que ver con el de México. 
Llegamos a las 13. Nos hicieron esperar para el check in. Hasta ahí todo bien porque es la hora de ingreso y si llegas antes y no te permiten entrar esta todo bien. Lo más grave de todo es que eran las 15.10 y seguíamos esperando que nos den la habitación. Nos decían que la estaban preparando aún. El hotel está, diría, ocupado en un 20%. Esta casi vacío.  Y luego de esperar dos horas, llego la hora de ingreso y todavía había que esperar a que este lista la habitación? Con la cantidad de habitaciones disponibles que tienen? 
Luego. Lo más grave! El kids club no está disponible. Sii. Gravísimo. Vengo por el kids club y no esta disponible.  Dicen que esta en  reparación. Parece posible que uno viene a este hotel por los servicios que tiene y al momento de la reserva no avisen que el kids club no va a estar? Como pueden hacerle eso al cliente? 
Pero claro. Como se piensan que ellos siempre tienen la razón (y no el cliente), te ofrecen el kids club que está en otro complejo (the reserve) al que hay que ir en carrito de golf y que claramente esta distante a uno. O sea es imposible usarlo y estar cómodo. Porque la idea es que tu hijo esté cerca tuyo y no a 2 km de distancia jugando.
Tercero. A la mañana tenía dos botellas de mi niño para lavar. Llamo al servicio de conserjería y me dicen que no tienen con que lavarlo ya que no me pueden mandar detergente y ellos no pueden lavar las cosas.
Cuarto. De cinco restaurantes que tiene el.hotel, hay dos en reparación. 
Quinto. Primer día entero en el hotel. Vuelvo a la habitación y esta arreglada muy mediocre. Limpieza básica. Cama con manta arrugada.
Sexto. Nos vinieron con el verso de que nos regalaban un día en el complejo The Grand Reserve sin decirnos que teníamos que fumarnos 3 ha de charla con el personal del hotel que te quiere vender la membresía. O sea. Te engañan diciéndote que te ofrecen tres regalos entre un día de ingreso al otro complejo, un masaje o una tercera opción que ya no recuerdo. La cuestión es que como dije, ya estuvimos en un Paradisus y ya caímos en el engaña/pichanga del "regalo" a cambio de una pequeña charla. Ya pasamos por eso y caímos en la cuenta que de pequeña la charla no tiene nada ya que el complejo es enorme, las opciones son diversas y no tardas media hora en conocerlas.  Estas mínimo 3 hs perdiendo de tus preciadas y esperadisimas vacaciones en escuchar sus opciones carísimas en dólares que te ofrecen para ser miembro y ayudar al.que te habla a ganarse una comisión. O sea ganan solos ellos y a vos te usan para terminar poniendo la teca y si no la poner perdiste medio día en el Caribe para nada.
La cuestión es que al ya haber pasado por eso cai en la cuenta de que me estaban ofreciendo esa vil mentira y le empecé a preguntar a la chica que.no le quedó otra que reconocer que era eso lo que en verdad me estaba ofreciendo. 
Lo que no me queda claro es si el señor Melia no apuesta a que el cliente regrese y conozca las particularidades de esta rara e incomoda forma de vender la membresía que solo perjudica al cliente y lo espanta.
De hecho no vuelvo más a un paradisus dado que hay muchas otras cadenas y opciones. Aposté esta segunda vez a ellos y es la ultima porque el servicio no esta para nada a la altura de las circunstancias.

reviews.author: Karina J
reviews.title: Ya no es lo que era antes
reviews.text: Fuimos por 2da vez y ya no es lo mismo bajaron la calidad y variedad de la comida, los show. Si no fuese por la atención de ariel, orlando y pedro nada hubiese sido igual. No sé si volvamos a ir al hotel

reviews.author: Mary-Ann M
reviews.title: Leaving the Snow
reviews.text: Nice area stayed on in the resort. Lots of options for food but somehow it all tasted the same. The bar was great, Must try a mamajuana. After arriving we did pay for the upgrade and was moved closer to the beach but right outside the garden shed. They start working early. Nice getaway not sure if we will do-over.

reviews.author: Lcedano
reviews.title: No tiene entretenimiento
reviews.text: Bonitas instalaciones (habitaciones, restaurantes, bufet general, piscinas y bares), comida y bebidas de buena calidad, personal muy afable y dispuestos a servir, el hotel no cuenta con amenidades luego de la cena, no hay nada que hacer, donde ir

reviews.author: GoPlaces597089
reviews.title: Not what it use to be
reviews.text: The buffet , was just regular , rooms , a little old fashion , and not activities at night , most restaurant where closed, as it was low season , hotel was really empty , but need to concentrate in the people is there , casuse then if you close all and low the quality even those one will not come back.

reviews.author: Luiz S
reviews.title: BOM HOTEL, MAS COM VÁRIOS DEFEITOS
reviews.text: Funcionários muito atenciosos. Destaque para Vilfrido do bar da piscina exclusiva do Royal Service e Edison do bar principal do hotel. Restaurantes Aqua e Rare nos serviram comida requentada, mal feita e mal servida. Chegamos à conclusão que todos esses restaurantes normais atendem muitos hóspedes e as comidas são pré-preparadas. Fugimos deles a partir daí. O Palazzo(exclusivo) é o melhorzinho. Bebidas incluídas na diária são boas, exceto o vinho, rótulo único, péssimo. Opção é The Winery, atendentes bons, mas tem que pagar, no mínimo U$ 32.00 a garrafa. O Refeitório onde servem breakfast, almoço e janta é razoável. Praia com areia e águas turvas devido à grande quantidade de algas. Não servem comida nas áreas das piscinas. Nada de porção de camarões para acompanhar as bebidas. Achei um absurdo. No segundo dia ofereceram um café da manhã em outro hotel, alegaram que éramos especiais, mas era para nos vender o pacote do Meliá Circle. Declinamos imediatamente, e não gostamos dessa atitude do hotel. Somos fumantes, mas nos consideramos educados, e não tivemos nenhum problema, já que havia muitas áreas disponíveis, inclusive a varanda do nosso quarto. Lembre de levar cigarros, porque os vendidos no hotel são muito caros. O acesso à internet é de boa qualidade. Cuidado na escolha do quarto, pois na área não exclusiva há algumas habitações próximas dos aquecedores de água, com muito ruído das máquinas. O hotel tem cassino, mas estava sempre vazio. Não frequentamos. Há alguns shows noturnos ao ar livre, com a apresentação de artistas locais, nada especial. As cadeiras à sombra nas piscinas são disputadas, inclusive às do Royal Service, que têm que ser reservadas com antecedência. Na área de Royal Service não são permitidas crianças.

reviews.author: Anmatama
reviews.title: Normal
reviews.text: Fuimos a pasar un cumpleaños un grupo enorme. Llegamos unos días antes que todos junto con 2 familias más. Solicitamos estar en el mismo piso que una de esas familias ya que tenemos niñas chicas y nos era cómodo, nos informaron que no había disponibilidad en ese momento, les pregunte si iba a haberla después así no desempacaba y nos mudábamos pero nos informaron que no. Al otro día y los días subsiguientes llegaron todas las otras familias y fueron instaladas en el piso que solicitamos INCREÍBLE! Tuvimos un inconveniente y lo trataron de solucionar lo mejor posible. El personal muy desatento y con mala gana. Solamente destacar a 1 o 2 que fueron amables. El resto no. Las habitaciones cómodas pero un poco anticuadas, la comida bajo la calidad y variedad desde la última vez que estuvimos. Podría escribir muchas cosas más...

reviews.author: ScottS24
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: My family of 4 stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Aug 13-20.  Overall I was a bit disappointed in our experience.  We had stayed at the Paradisus La Esmeralda in Playa del Carmen, which we loved,  so we decided to try another Melia property in Punta Cana.  To start, when we booked online, we were told on 2 different occasions that we could book a room with a king bed, 2 double beds, and a sofa bed.  We prefer separate beds for my 8 and 14 year old kids.  However, when we called to confirm our reservation, we were told to get that bed configuration we had to upgrade to a 2 bedroom suite, which was about $1000 more than we were originally booked for.  Being that it was 2 days from when we were supposed to arrive, we were told we had the option to cancel or pay the extra money, which we reluctantly did.  Upon arrival we were again misinformed and told that the bed configuration we requested did not exist at this hotel and were stuck paying the extra money and still didn't have the bed situation we wanted.  The room we were given was not good.  The shower in one of the bathrooms did not work properly and there was no hot water.  On of the televisions didn't work either.  After complaining about all of this to Guest Services, we were given a different room the next day.  This room was better but 2 of the 4 televisions didn't work and after a request through the app to fix it, we never saw anyone to do the repairs.  The app was pretty useless so don't bother with it.  On multiple occasions after our rood was serviced we were not given fresh towels or had the mini bar restocked.  We had to ask for new towels and bottled water.  The food was ok but the real issue was that there were only 3 restaurants open to eat at besides the buffet so after the 4th day we had to repeat where we ate.  On Friday during out stay, a huge crowd of people came to the resort and it seemed the hotel could not handle the crowds.  The buffet was out of many breakfast foods at 9:30 a.m.and not replenished the service was very slow and some of the servers seemed annoyed to serve us.  By Monday the crowds seemed to have gone so the service was a bit better but still slow.  The drinks were watered down even after asking for double shots in some of the drinks.  The beach was beautiful and there seemed to be a lot of chairs available to relax.  However, there was a constant barrage of vendors bothering you every 5 minutes to buy jewelry or go parasailing, which became quite annoying.  The same man trying to sell us a photo shoot asked us 5 different times even after we kept telling him we weren't interested.  My kids seemed to be quite bored after a couple days and we were not told about any kids club or kids activities whatsoever.  This was our first time in Punta Cana and I don't think we would return, at least not to this hotel.

reviews.author: jorgekirchnerlc
reviews.title: Amigos y Golf
reviews.text: Bueno, normal. sin pretensiones. El check in DESASTROSO !!!!! Estuvimos esperando 10 hs antes de que nos entregaran la habitaci'on. Por lo dem'as, lo m'as rescatable es el personal: muy amables, educados, siempre dispuestos

reviews.author: Maximiliano A
reviews.title: personal poco informado
reviews.text: Estando de luna de miel. El aera contrata estaba cerrada y nunca fuimos informados. Nos mandaron a una sin consultar que era la mitad de lo que pagamos. Si preguntar que buscabamos. Todo muy mal organizado

reviews.author: _jdfb27
reviews.title: Hotel went down hill in a matter of a year
reviews.text:
In a matter of a year the Reserve Hotel was closed and Aqua restaurant as well as other restaurants in the Paradisus were closed.  Seaweed maintenance stopped and there was no way to get on the beach.
The restaurants that were open were NOT vey good.  My husband got VERY sick from eating a muscle in his soup Vento.  We win;t be going back--sad to say

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: Lack of communication
reviews.text:
Back in March, we originally booked our trip to stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana from 8/8-8/11. Then we received an email on 7/29 stating that the Royal Service room we had booked had been closed effective 7/1 due to construction at a neighboring resort, but that we were being 'upgraded' to the Palma Real -- there were no details in the email regarding our confirmation number, transportation arrangements or reasons as to why we only received the email a week prior to our trip, thereby preventing us from having any choice in the matter in regards to staying at the Palma Real. We frantically began reaching out to all of the hotel contacts we had acquired, to ensure our booking was correct (as this information was not updated on our Melia rewards account), and had to update the Otium transportation company as well. Once this was done, we then arrived in Punta Cana on 8/8/19. We were quickly led out to a van by the Otium rep and were left there for 30+ minutes without any word of what we were waiting on or for how long. Thankfully the other couple in the car spoke fluent Spanish and were able to question the driver, as they had been told that they were waiting on US to arrive and they had been waiting an additional 30+ minutes before we got in the van. With the waiting without explanation and cleanliness of the van, highly recommend reserving private transportation with another company.

We arrived at the hotel at the main lobby, and had to then turn over our passports in order to confirm that we were Royal Service guests (even though the hotel had our arrival information). It was a nice gesture by the hotel to upgrade us to an ocean front room, as we were celebrating our 10 year wedding anniversary. We had arrived early, so we were able to put our bags in the office and go enjoy the resort until our room was ready. The room was nice enough, although with the bathroom, there was little to no privacy -- the door for the toilet was clear and did not close off the room, and open area/ shutters leading into the bedroom area meant you could not take care of certain business in complete privacy. There was also an issue with the air conditioner leaking, so the floor was constantly wet. 

The issue with the communication definitely showed when it came to food. We were automatically booked at the Palazzo for the first night, but we asked our butler if we could change as we would like to have sushi (we did not mark Italian on our pre-arrival preference sheet). He was able to make the change to Bana, then dinner on the beach the next night and then the last night at Rare. We were also informed that we only had access to 3 restaurants as several of them were closed due to renovations/ relocation -- none of this information was made known to us on the website or at check-in. The grounds of the hotel were OK, the pool area was good. For Royal Service, the area is supposed to be adults only, however there were kids in and out, with no workers policing the area. We were also not informed by the hotel regarding meal times (breakfast only until 11:30, lunch only from 12:30-4:00, dinner begins at 630pm and an extremely limited room service menu), so needless to say we missed lunch the first day and breakfast on the 2nd day. When we went out that night, it turned out that BANA was only hibachi (no sushi) so we didn't end up eating. We went to Brisas for a drink and were shocked to see people eating sushi and a sushi chef. When we asked our butler about it the next day, he advised that he was told they were closed. 

For dinner on our second night, we arrived at the beach to find that there were 2 weddings set-up and no special beach dinner. We overheard another couple saying it had been cancelled. We texted our butler to see if there was a way to get into another restaurant. We went to RARE and the couple in front of us were explaining the situation to the hostess in Spanish the exact same situation we were in -- the difference was that she gave them a table and blankly stared at me when I explained the same situation in English, and then refused to seat us. This was the first vacation where on more than one occasion, we felt ignored or treated lesser than because we spoke English. Our butler was able to get us a table at Palazzo for the Italian food -- which was fine, but not a restaurant we had planned on visiting.

On the last night, we did the Circle presentation and received a voucher for Palazzo -- which was an interesting experience, but I would not recommend paying $80 a person for the tasting menu. For the main buffet, there was an OK selection, but it was the same each day. For the buffet at Palazzo, I would not recommend, as they leave the food in an open air area, and we watched black birds peck at the food with the waiters shooing them away (and leaving the food behind) – the main buffet is indoors and sealed off, so highly recommend for hygiene.

The Palma Real was not our original choice, and I am not sure of the experience we would have had, had we gone to the Paradisus Punta Cana as we originally planned. The food situation was extremely disappointing and frustrating, especially considering we were only there for 3 nights and did not get to eat at any of the restaurants or types of cuisines that we wanted to. 

In regards to the royal service, I would also not recommend paying extra for this. The main buffet was better than Palazzo, the pool area was small and kids were able to enter/ exit without issue, and we only communicated with our butler via Whatsapp to assist with correct dinner issues (we did not need anything else). We would have greatly appreciated saving $100+ a day by not booking with the Royal Service add-on. For the beach, chairs were still first come/ first serve, no one brings you drinks or snacks on the beach or at the pool, so I failed to see the value for the additional fee.

For the staff, aside from the hostesses at the restaurants and waiters at the main breakfast buffet, everyone was extremely friendly and personable. Our butler Armando Minier was extremely friendly and was very quick to resolve the issue with getting us a reservation after the beach dinner was cancelled – as he was unaware that it had been cancelled. In regards to night time activity, it would also have been great if there was a schedule posted so we would know what our options were.

reviews.author: familiarm2015
reviews.title: Bonito hotel, servicio basico:si no eres VIP, no eres nadie
reviews.text:
Viajamos en familia con niños pequeños y mi resumen es el siguiente:
Hotel bonito, limpio y agradable
Playa:bien. Limpia sin tanto zargazo, faltan palmeras pero las sombrillas cumplen bien para la sombra
Restaurante: poca variedad de restaurantes sin necesidad de reserva. Al ir con niños pequeños las reservaciones son complicadas. No siempre hay horario,tardan más tiempo en traer los platos, por lo que solo te queda la opción del buffet. El mismo del desayuno y almuerzo. Al menos la comida es muy buena, sin tanto ajo (para mi importsntisimo)
Servicio: aquí el punto débil... no teníamos membresía de ningún tipo y no tomamos ningún upgrade. Nos sentimos un poco a la deriva. Avisamos al momento de la llegada que celebrábamos los 10 años de aniversario a lo cual me ofrecieron una cortesía,espumante a la habitación y un banner. El día de nuestro aniversario encontramos un banner de luna de miel en la puerta y nada más. 
Poca atención a los detalles. 
Kids club:destacado, atentos los chicos con los niños, cariñosos, impecable. Felicitaciones por este punto positivo.
Resumen: no se si volvería. Pero no lo descarto del todo.. vería otras alternativas antes de todos modos.

reviews.author: luistaver
reviews.title: HA BAJADO LA CALIDAD
reviews.text: Estuve en el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real a finales de junio 2019. Anteriormente había estado en Agosto 2008.  Comparando con aquella ocasión, me di cuenta que ha bajado la calidad, tanto en la Comida, como en la Bebida. La comida del Buffet muy poca variedad. Los Mariscos brillaron por su ausencia. Los Postres siempre los mismos. El vino de muy mala calidad. Las reservas para los Restaurantes temáticos es un desastre. Reservas y luego no aparece o si no solo aparece la reserva para una parte de las personas.  Las instalaciones necesitan una reforma.  El Aire Acondicionado de la habitación sonaba muchísimo.

reviews.author: Phong H
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Room is clean. Hotel has beautiful beach. Swim up bar needed improvements. Foods are just average in my opinion.Restaurants is tough if you arrive midweek like We did. Breakfast is good and it opens early at 6. Different bars have special drinks but you have to ask. Overall, we have a good time.

reviews.author: beach_bum 0701
reviews.title: Just an OK vacation!
reviews.text:
Just returned yesterday and probably will not be back.  We stayed end of July to the beginning of August.  Paradisus just didn't WOW us.  I'll start off with the Good and then the Bad.

The Good is that the hotel is very beautiful.  Our room was great, clean, spacious and even had a jacuzzi tub.  The buffet had a great variety, was clean, tasty and loved the outside seating area.  Gabbi Beach was perfect in the evening for having drinks.  It's right next to the beach so you can see the sand, hear the waves and catch a cool breeze while having cocktails at night.  Mini bar was restocked.

The Bad......Beach Chairs........They are so old, worn and broken that they look like they've been recycled from a garbage dump.  Shame on Paradisus for what you pay.  Obviously they prefer spending money on the Grand Reserve, the Reserve and Family Concierge.  I don't even need chairs as nice as those but just new, regular lounge chairs would be great.

The Bad......Beach......it is on a horrible stretch of beach.  The water is a dark, disgusting color with lots of seaweed.  It's not just the time of year because if you walk much further down the beach to the left the water gets turquoise blue and hardly any seaweed.  The last few days of our stay we walked pretty much an hour down the beach to where the other Paradisus Punta Cana is.  The Beach is picture perfect there.  Hardly any seaweed, turquoise blue water, almost clear and there is a little wave activity too.  Sadly the sister hotel which isn't as nice sits on a much better beach.  

The Bad......Reservations......Only were able to get reservations after we fought and yelled.  I shouldn't have to do that while I'm on vacation.  We came to relax and get away.  Then we were only able to get reservations at two restaurants.  Vento and Rare.  Bana was open only one night of our stay but we were refused because they were full and there was nothing we could do we were told.  After not liking Vento and Rare and not wanting to eat there again, we decided to walk up to Bana the night it was open.  We walked right up.  Were asked if we had a reservation.  We simply stated "no and that we could not get one and really did not want to eat at the others since we did not like them.  No problem.  We were seated.  Just like that so why was it fully booked????  I will have to say it was the best restaurant of the 3 open and only open one night that week.  Reservation policy is a joke.  They clearly don't want you to eat in them.  

The Bad......Staff......So unfriendly.  No one smiled or said hello.  It seemed like you were a hassle to them.  We were not made to feel welcome at all.  At checkin, no one bothered to explain the hotel, policies, where anything was etc.  You were given your room key and that was it.  Other hotels we've been to they explain the map to you and where everything is and on the cart to your room they point things out and tell you where the beach, pool and restaurants are in relation to your room.  In the room, I noticed one card said towels.  I assumed that you used it for towels but at checkin no one bothered to explain it to us.  There was another card that said circle on it and to this day I still do not know what it was for since no one bothered to explain anything to us at checkin. The whole first day we were looking at the tiny little map to see where things were.  The map is so small we were using the flashlights on our phone to read it.  Checkout was the same unfriendliness.  No "hope you enjoyed your stay or thank you or anything".  Just a "show this card to the bellman with your luggage when you're ready to leave".

The Bad........Activities.....We were completely bored.  Nothing going on.  The only thing they had for entertainment was music and it wasn't even live.  We're not party people by any means so if we were bored, I can see what others were feeling.  There was nothing for our teenage son to do.  No activities.  No activities team like some of the other AI have.

The Bad.........Beach Vendors.....It was constant from hair braiding, to photos, to jewelry, to excursions, to alcohol, to clothing etc.  The first day or maybe even the second it was ok with a "no, thank you" and they would go but it gets to be excessive when you have to put up with this for the entire week.  

The Bad.........Service........The week we were there, there was no wait service by the pool.  None.  Our first time here so maybe they don't have pool service.  No beach bar.  They have food at the beach but it is very limited.  They only had wait service two days at the beach and that was all.  The waiter couldn't get an order straight.  My son ordered a coke one day and received a pina colada.  I ordered a beer the next day and received a pina colada.  They might as well just come around with trays of pina coladas since that's all they know.  

Too many misses for us to come back to anything Melia since Paradisus is supposed to be their better product.  While this hotel looked much nicer all around than others, I think other places like the AMResorts provide a better overall product.  No reservation hassles, staff is much friendlier, always wait service by the beach and pool constantly, activities, shows, movies etc.  They always also post a sheet with daily activities and time and sometimes even a copy in your room.

reviews.author: Vacation686864
reviews.title: Ok stay
reviews.text: Hotel was nice not many night actively and no swimming st night allowed. It was a good trip wish they had more things to do at night.  The night dessert server did not look happy at all. We were afraid to get more dessert lol

reviews.author: Lorrey S
reviews.title: Not sure I would go again
reviews.text: I have traveled to this resort many times.  There have been many changes and not all of them good.  Royal Service pool staff not attentive at all to people in the pool area except Pedro, Wanda and Martin.  The younger, newer people did care if you were there or not.  Think it is time for a different resort.

reviews.author: MarkBoo
reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.text:
For starters, my wife and I have traveled extensively through the Caribbean, Mexico, and Central America.  We have also stayed at Melia resorts before, so I'd like to think we have a frame of reference to put this review in context.  Here we go:

Pros:  The resort itself is very nice and well kept.  Pool, rooms, and facilities are clean.  Staff was very friendly and tried to help when we had a couple questions.

Cons:  I can't point to one glaring thing.  It is rather a combination of things that leads me to have such a lackluster review. For starters, the food was really not very good.  Do yourself a favor and avoid the Mac & Cheese at the buffet.  I saw at least one other person comment on it before we went, and they were spot on.  Cold and disgusting.  Stick with fresh fish and get your eggs cooked fresh in the morning and you'll be ok with the buffet.  The irritating part was most nights, only 1 or 2 of the nicer restaurants were open.  This was probably due to the fact the resort was half empty.  There were several nights in a row where the only choice was the Italian place or the steakhouse.  And the steakhouse filled up quick, so we just had to eat the buffet a couple nights.  The high end reservation only restaurant food was not bad, but it was also underwhelming.  Lots of other people have commented about food issues.  Melia needs to take this to heart and implement some immediate changes. 

We were also unimpressed with the alcohol.  Of course being all-inclusive, they tend to water down drinks.  The house wines were gross.  They said "Reserve" on them, which is a joke.  I know wine, and the only thing that house wine should be reserved for is a garbage can.  I mean, a couple notches below a table wine.  And the pina coladas and margaritas were just weak.  Very disappointing.

Our rooms were clean, but somehow getting hand towels and wash rags required a special call to guest services a couple days in a row.  Holiday Inn knows better than this. Clearly they have some training issues to miss this big.  Should be automatic.  Also, we couldn't get the room below about 74 degrees no matter how hard we blasted the A/C and kept the blinds closed.

We also booked an excursion through the hotel.  It was supposed to be 4 hours and include riding in speed boats, snorkeling, and snuba (similar to scuba but for beginners since we have teens).  It was a huge disappointment.  Both teens were bored out of their minds.  They also said we would be fed a lunch.  It consisted of a soda, chips, and queso out of a can.  Completely lame.  We were starving for real food by the time we got back.  And the whole outing was not well organization.  The hotel should reconsider who they align themselves with for something like this. 

I think some of our experience was just that DR is not quite as polished as other areas that have a lot of tourists, as we have found the places and people in VI, Bahamas, Barbados, Mexico, Costa Rica, Cayman, etc... to simply have it together better when it comes to food, keeping rooms in order, and overall organization.

While our prior couple of experiences at Melia were good, we left this trip underwhelmed and will not be returning to DR or Melia for future trips.  We will look to other destinations going forward.

reviews.author: Noelia005
reviews.title: Para pensar la decisión de volver ....
reviews.text:
Esta es nuestra tercer visita al hotel en familia, sin dudas uno de los mejores de Playa Bávaro. De todas maneras ya ha quedado un poco viejo en comparación con otros, incluso con The Circle, el nuevo hotel de la misma compañía. 
Ya encontramos algunas pequeñas cosas en el mantenimiento de las habitaciones: por ejemplo techos, cuadro de ducha, ropa de cama, colchones algo vencidos, televisores viejos. 
Lo más sorprendente y decepcionante de esta visita, por lo cual NO recomendamos hospedarse en este hotel en esta época, es que de 7 restaurantes temáticos solo abrieron 2 y algunas noches 1 solo Restaurant, limitándote a comer en el bufet general ya que obviamente era difícil encontrar lugar para comer en UN solo Restaurant. También estaban cerradas el resto de las amenities como el Kids Zone. Nosotros pagamos para utilizar todos los servicios del hotel y nos llevamos una gran sorpresa. Tampoco nos brindaron una solución, cómo podría haber sido enviarnos a cenar a algún restaurante temático de otro hotel de la cadena. Una gran decepción y perdida de dinero! 
También tuvimos una mala experiencia con la atención de la persona encargada de la reservación de los restaurantes, Nicalis, quien nos atendió con desgano, mirando el celular y agendado horarios erróneos en las reservas, pero eso no empañó nuestras vacaciones. 
La playa con algas, eso lo sabíamos de antemano, el zargazo no es ajeno a Punta Cana (aunque en menor medida q México), ya no son las aguas turquesas o cristalinas del Caribe sino más bien verdes o amarronadas.
Ah, tuvimos cucarachas en una de las cenas en el restaurante Bana, revisen sus mesones al sentarse !! 
Por lo demás la atención y comida del bufete es excelente, los traslados internos, el servicio de housekeeping muy bien y el Spa, sus masajistas, de alto nivel.
Para pensar la decisión de volver ....

reviews.author: Justin W
reviews.title: The best of a bad situation.
reviews.text: We booked a vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real and found out the day before traveling that the reservation was made at Paradisus Punta Cana instead. I was beating myself up for the mistake wondering how i made such a huge mistake. Upon arrival, I upgraded to the reserve and added family concierge, which certainly improved the experience, and then also met 6, yes, 6 couples who also thought they had booked the Palma Real as well.  The overall trip was 4 stars, but the 3 i've given represents the bate and switch I experienced, and it would have been a 2 if I hadn't upgrade to the reserve, which has better amenities for families with young children.

reviews.author: Nomad24534669587
reviews.title: Fair
reviews.text:
Unfortunately the staff the sells the excursions stole one of our cell by the pool area.  They should 
be escorted by the hotel personal to avoid this problems or only sells the excursions by the lobby area.   Rest of the staff from the were very amicable and always attentive on our needs, except for the two who stole the phone.

reviews.author: Elisa Hegarty
reviews.title: Not so inclusive all inclusive
reviews.text:
My finance and I came to Palma Real as a means to unwind for a few days from our busy work schedules. Keep in mind we typically prefer more adventurous cultural vacations with amazing food, so this will largely explain our review. This being said, the food was extremely low tier in quality and some times down right gross (I attached a photo below of what was supposed to be Gnocchi ordered from their Vento restaurant.) 
Restaurants- 
Buffet: lots of options, probably better than your average American buffet, I actually preferred it to the dinner dinning options.
Rare: steak focused restaurant, the steaks / meats were actually pretty good, the side items on the other hand were disappointing to say the least. The Mac and cheese might be the worst I’ve ever had, their side salad wasn’t very fresh and the fries tasted like they came from a freezer bag. For dessert we had carrot and cheese cake, both were stale. 
Vento: Probably the worst restaurant, not surprising as pasta isn’t a common food in the DR. The wine tasted like vinegar, my Gnocchi was down right gross, my finance got a ravioli dish that was decent enough you could have gotten it in the freezer isle at the store but it was eatable the only thing on his plate that wasn’t eatable was the large peels of wax rind from what was once from a parmesan cheese wheel. They didn’t seem to know it wasn’t cheese....
Ilbana: hibachi restaurant- while the food was just ok we enjoyed this one the most. Everything is cooked fresh in front of you and had the best flavor. The pistachio ice cream and the fried rice were quite good. 
Drinks - the cocktails were perfectly drinkable but very weak. We found it took a lot of drinks to feel a buzz and we are not huge drinkers. We ended up having liquor on the rocks which is probably the best choice if you want to achieve a buzz 

Customer service:
Everyone here is very accommodating they are always ready to bring you drinks or anything you might need. A massive down side and turn off was a person assigned to us that was basically our own personal sales person. She was trying to get us to go spend an afternoon at their other resort and then offered us a free gift if we went to take a tour over there. We did not want to waste our vacation time touring another property and when we told her we didn’t want to do it she begged us and told us she would get in trouble if we didn’t go. She then bombarded us the next day to try and sell it to us again it was very tacky and rude. I have attached the convo below as well.
There are also sales people on the beach that bombard you constantly trying to get you to buy things. 

Over all, the resort did give us an escape from work and we feel refreshed, I wouldn’t spend more than 4 days here, in fact we felt like we could have gotten the same experience and stayed closer to home as it did not feel like we left the US . 
Resort life maybe just isn’t for us lol

reviews.author: Departure61222476226
reviews.title: Royal booking should make you feel royal
reviews.text: Got bored with the royal breakfast, as well as the selection of restaurants maybe a Mexican you advertised 11 restaurants? Where were they? Our room had many broken things and the bed set up was totally not what I requested, had to sit in the room while various workers came in and repaired things, ridiculous! Our butler was in an all day meeting the day after we arrived, what? After complaining to manager we were moved and felt taken care of after that. Shouldn’t have to waste time on vacation explaining my frustration to management on vacation but that’s what it came down to.

reviews.author: Judith H
reviews.title: Beautiful Property with Mediocre Customer Service
reviews.text: Great resort property but there are many customer service areas that need to be improved upon. Staff not very friendly and most do not speak English.  Food is average.  More evening entertainment needed.

reviews.author: Inspire12384298331
reviews.title: Séjour a The Reserve Punta Cana
reviews.text: satisfaisant, sans plus. L'hotel est agréable, le personnel parfait, mais un manque d'animation certain, surtout en soirée. Attention, ne faite pas la visite de l'hotel The Circle, qui vous sera proposé avec insistance dès votre arrivée vous allez perdre 2 heures, on essaie de vous vendre un très improbable programme de fidélisation...

reviews.author: Sightseer08884571939
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Nice trip with friends, the staff were very helpful , little big, very nice room but not enough towels, food good but the buffet not enough variety but we still ate a lot and it was good, and the beach is very nice.

reviews.author: Gretch B
reviews.title: Resort information
reviews.text:
I am here now (first week of a June) for a wedding.  There is such little information on the web site, I thought I’d write to share for those while traveling to Palma Real.  The gorgeous property is huge with Palma Real being closest to the beach. There are what seems like numerous price points/ways to be on the property (there is also Grand reserve, Reserve, vacation club (time share) and an even swankier area called Reserve Beach, Royal, adult only....). 
1.) we are in a double beds Jr suite room basic guests (green arm bands).  Ground floor , building V2. I think this is closest to walking to beach and restaurants. V1 is closer but I believe it is an upgraded area. Our room size is fine but there is only a curtain from the bathroom to the room. So be aware privacy is limited. 
2). On arrival, we were “sold” into upgrading to have Reserve access. Sounded great not really knowing what it was.  It includes one beach front restaurant, an extra bar, a more quiet smaller pool, a roped section of the beach and access to the Reserve pool and restaurant (golf cart ride away) and top shelf alcohol. There may be more to it than that, but after one day we down graded as not feeling it as worth it to us.  Also, the restaurant was not a sit down breakfast - dinner and lunch only and “fancy” seafood.
3). Pools close at 6 pm and are 5 ft deep. So glad we had floats/rafts for my 5 & 8 year old.
4). KidZone on the Reserve property (golf cart ride away) is very nice. They use the WhatsApp to communicate with you.  There is a schedule of activities so be sure to get from front desk. 
5). Tips - we tip a couple dollars at breakfast and lunch and leave $5 at dinner.  Tipping bar tenders, golf cart drivers, omelet guy ... we figure why not, so we do. (No one has told us to do so). 
6). Restaurants need reservations and can be made in one location by main buffet from 9 am - 4 pm. Show up the reservation desk at 9 am on your first day. There is limited space. 
7). There are nightly shows at 9 pm and scheduled activities, so ask for the flyer of times. 
8). Beach is large. Lots of chairs.  The higher end area has cushions on the lounge chairs. Lots of vendors pushing on the beach, so be aware. 
Hey management  - would really be nice if the kidZone, activities schedule and restaurant info was in your room on arrival.
I hope this helps someone out there. The resort is nice. Food has been pretty good, and all inclusive means, you don’t ilke what you ordered for food... get something else ;)
We are enjoying ourselves just not sure we would choose the property again on our own

reviews.author: Trip06722952948
reviews.title: O local é bonito, mas não vale a pena pelas chateações que os hóspedes podem passar
reviews.text: Camareiras falam alto e gritam pela manhã, logo cedo. No banheiro, o pior papel higiênico do mundo. Não há ducha higiênica. Me enganaram no SPA em relação ao preço da massagem, não aceitaram meus argumentos e me cobraram mesmo assim. Os vouchers de 1000 dólares só me entregaram depois de muita cobrança e não valem a pena, é propaganda enganosa, pois só podem ser usados em serviços e compras se a pessoa gastar muito mais, e os descontos já estão incluídos nos preços. Enchem o saco dos hóspedes para vender um pacote de fidelidade de férias no Meliá. Ninguém vai passar férias numa praia para ficar ouvindo encheção de saco de vendedor insistente. Ninguém merece.

reviews.author: Vlad
reviews.title: Great vacation with bad experiences
reviews.text:
I’m not sure where to begin with my review... Right now I am beyond angry and can honestly say that today’s experience at the hotel has ruined a fantastic 4 day stay. We check out tomorrow early morning and I felt I needed to let others know my frustration now.

This was the first vacation my wife and I took with our 10 month old son. We had a great time all week. We got to enjoy the great pools in the main Paradisus hotel as well as the one at The Reserve. We selected the one bedroom swim up suite so we could enjoy the pool without having to go far away from our room. This made our trip with our son a lot of fun. If he was fussy during our outings at the hotel we would come back to the room, put him to sleep, and hang out in the backyard or pool with our baby monitor. This allowed him to get his much needed sleep and us to continue enjoying our vacation without being trapped indoors.

Almost all the restaurant food was amazing; I think the meat options were not the best quality but the seafood was excellent. The sushi was just odd so I would suggest staying away from that. 

Now on to the bad stuff.... It’s not ok for waiters/strangers to touch my son. Throughout the week staff at the hotel kept touching my son’s hands, feet, and even tried to hold him without asking. It was obnoxious of people to assume my child wanted to be held by strangers and that we are ok with strangers touching him. It wasn’t that bad until today/our last day when during dinner, the waiter started touching his cheeks and rubbing his hands. I’m not sure why people think that’s ok. I would never ever go up to a stranger and touch their child. Apparently that’s not the case at this hotel.

Now onto some worse stuff. We arrived at the hotel on our first day at just before noon but check-in wasn’t until 3 PM. They tried their best to get us a room as soon as possible to accommodate our tired son and thankfully they got us a room around 1:30 PM. When we arrived at the room we immediately realized the crib they promised wasn’t there. No big deal since they brought us a crib immediately. Upon delivery we put our son in the crib and he immediately fell asleep as it was long day of travel for him. Since we got the swim up suite we brought our baby monitor and decided to hang out in the backyard while he slept. A few minutes later we heard our son screaming at the top his lungs and so we ran inside where we found two maintenance staff in the living room attempting to fix the pull out couch that they left open before we got there. I’m not sure why they would attempt to perform maintenance in front of a sleeping baby. Maybe it was our fault for not putting a privacy tag on the door but they should have immediately left when they saw a baby sleeping in the crib right next to where they were trying to work. 

While that was annoying the worst was actually when a cleaning lady decided to ignore the privacy tag I placed on the front door and wanted to clean our room at 9:00 PM at night! This hotel doesn’t have a deadbolt on any of the rooms so I placed a bench in front of the door so I could hear if someone tries to come in again like the first day. At 9:00 PM I didn’t hear a single knock; what I did hear was the bench being moved so I ran out thinking someone was breaking in. Keep in mind my son is already asleep for the night too! I asked what she was doing (in a stern, upset, and not so polite way); she responded with ‘I am here to clean your room.’ After a not so nice exchange she left and I noticed that she took the privacy tag from the door.

Now it’s almost 11:00 PM at night and we are leaving at 7:00 AM tomorrow. My wife is scared thinking that anyone can come into the room at any time and I really don’t blame her. 

So thank you Paradisus for ruining what would have been an amazing trip by doing a lot of stupid stuff. 

I would love to have rated this hotel as excellent but the mistakes make it average at best.

reviews.author: ted s
reviews.title: Great butler, horrible food, slow service
reviews.text:
Wife and I visited for my sister's wedding. Sister and now husband had visited there a couple times and enjoyed it which is why they chose to get married there. The wedding events were very well executed, even with rain forcing us to relocate to a covered area. Event staff went above and beyond to make it a memorable couple days. 

As for other aspects of the resort, we will never return to vacation on our own. Staff are friendly but get things done slower than slow. Our first group dinner (planned well in advance) saw the slowest service we've ever seen at a resort. It took two hours to get our meals and we had to ask multiple times just to get drink orders. 

The lunch buffet was run of the mill. Lots of mediocre cafeteria food that sits out for far too long. Watch out for the tuna tartar, it wasn't chilled and that was a tough lesson to learn on day 2 of a 6 day stay. We paid extra for the royal treatment part of the resort which included a restaurant available only to those guests. The service was excruciatingly slow and the food was beyond sub par. The a la Carte menu had limited (bland) options. Ordering an omelette in the morning took forever and was no where close to what you'd expect from a nice resort. The mini buffet was filled with 80% of things no one ate that just sat out and 20% of things people ate that they didnt have a steady supply of. 

We attended the Michelin star restaurant (Passion) one night and that was impressive. Well worth the cost! Service was warm and personable and the experience was memorable. Would highly recommend. 

Our butler Felix was great and hard working. He went above and beyond to make our stay memorable for positive reasons and hes the reason for a 3 star review and not a 2 star review.

reviews.author: Mortee
reviews.title: Loved the location and people hated the pressure time share tactics.
reviews.text: I spent my 10 year anniversary here and the resort and amenities were spot on. From the get go the staff was willing to help in anyway they could with out hesitation. the rooms were clean and house keeping kept clean towels and refrigerator stock full of beer and water. The beach and gardens were well maintained and enjoyable to be at or around. I had only 2 issues on the downside for this resort. The all inclusive package we booked was supposed to come with a coupon book worth up to 1000 dollars I asked a couple of times and got vague excuses and no answers if it was ever going to show up. The other issue happened on day 2 we got swindled into seeing a newer add on resort with the promises of a free meal at a higher end restaurant. The only way I can explain it is a bad visit to a used call lot.  They are selling time shares and pressure is the sales tactic the offer started out at 12k over a time period of a couple years payoff which was turned down then 3 or 4 counter offers later the price dropped 9k. These salesmen refused to hear that I wasn't interested and finally I blatantly told them no. This got their attention but not after the evil looks and gestures. All in all loved the resort hated the timeshare trap.

reviews.author: Rotceh2046
reviews.title: Weeding Good 👍/Rooms Maintenence Poor👎
reviews.text:
Last year we visited this Hotel to celebrate my moms 75th birthday and was PERFECT. Then we decided to host my weeding here due to that previous experience. This year something CHANGED. Our Romance advisor Mariangel was AWESOME!!!! She handle every opportunity in our weeding in a professional manner. We travel with over 35 family members and friends that took the time to celebrate with us this important date but the constant issues with our friend's and family rooms really disapointed us. 
First, my father in law was moved from his room due to electrical issues. Then the second room given had cockroaches in the coach and the shower head was faulty (both of them).
Then, three more rooms from our party reported the following issues:
-A/C unit humidity causing respiratory issues
-Shower door handle completely loose
-A/C and water temp control not working

On Saturday, May 25th there were restaurant reservation issues in terms of schedule and availability. And last but not least the food quality and service has declined compared with last year's visit.

reviews.author: Curious51008629475
reviews.title: Beware of Melia' harassment staff
reviews.text: Royal service not worth it.  Butler unavailable most of the time.  Melia' (Circle) staff harass and deceive Royal service staff to try to get them to purchase a 50,000 Melia membership.  They used the conceirge to try to act like the 45 minute presentation was a VIP service lunch for Royal service members, a waste of about 3 hours out of our precious vacation time.  Butler, Jeri was useless and made dinner reservations without consulting with us first.

reviews.author: Vvv
reviews.title: Great place but beware of where you sign!
reviews.text:
I really wanted to give this place a five star rating, but I will not for two reasons:

1. At the time of checking into the hotel please read all documents properly before signing. They came to us with a few papers and asked us to sign. We were tired from the flight and really wanted to go to our room ASAP to unpack and begin our family vacation. Of course we did not care to read where we were signing and apparently we agreed to attend their sales presentation the next day. So they took us to another Melia resort for breakfast saying that they have a gift for us. There they did not let us eat until their stupid paper work formalities were complete. By the time our 18 month old had become very cranky and had lost his appetite. After an hour of waiting they assigned us a sales guy who took us for breakfast. After breakfast he showed us around and then took us to a meeting room. This is where they harassed us for more than an hour, trying to sell us their vacation packages. We kept telling him that we did not want to buy but God the guy was persistent. After wasting more than half our day we finally got to go back to our resort! Please read all documents carefully before signing.

2. The family concierge assigned to our family sucked. We did not see him after day 1. He had offered to make reservations for us at some restaurants, which he did not. The price of a family concierge is included in their package. He is supposed to make your trip worthwhile by assisting you with things like restaurant reservations, providing you with pool floats for kids, etc. - basically offering any facility available to you that you may not know about but would enjoy. I would rather have the price I paid for the family concierge refunded! 

Aside the resort is absolutely beautiful, the food was good, and all services except for the above  were fantastic.

reviews.author: Joy G
reviews.title: Beautiful property but lacking
reviews.text: Beautiful property but the food was very mediocre and the nightlife was seriously lacking. Nightly entertainment was very boring in comparison to other resorts we've stayed. It wasn't a terrible experience but I wouldn't go back. We had the royal service and had an awesome butler named Alberto who took care of us every day!!! I would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Gliset N
reviews.title: Our wedding at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Great food and amenities! Beautiful grounds! The beach was very clean.The night entertainment was great. Music, drinks and staff were amazing. We celebrated our wedding there and the celebration was everything I wished for.

reviews.author: Rakesh M
reviews.title: Good family resort with a few flaws
reviews.text:
We picked this place because it was family friendly, which was definitely true.  However, the overall experience was just ok.  I have stayed at many all inclusive resorts in the Caribbean (including in Punta Cana before) so here are the pros and cons - 

pros - family friendly.  reserve has a kids pool which was great.  kids activity room was nice and lots of fun.  had kid friendly shows as well.  in general, excellent place for kids.  also, the service was actually pretty good for the most part.  people were friendly.  

cons - food was below average.  the italian restuarant Aqua was good, and Vento was great, but otherwise nothing to write home about.  the grill near the pool was actually pretty bad.  buffets were not good either (compared to other resorts we have stayed at) and the buffets were not air conditioned.  i dont understand why none of the buffets were indoors for air condiitioning and most of the restaurants were also outdoors... we were placed on the 3rd floor, which is not great considering my in-laws are over 70 and we had a 2 year old kid, lots of walking up and down the steps (there are no elevators in any of the building).  the beach is really far from the Reserve area.  didnt see any basic non-motorized sports at the beach.  rooms look a bit old and didnt allow for 2 beds (the sofa bed in the living room was terrible to try to sleep on).  

i have mixed feelings about this place.  while it was nice for our 2 year old, i didnt enjoy many aspects.  and the prices were not that cheap, so we expected better.  also, the free $1000 of resort credits are useless, they are small amounts that can only be used for very specific things , so thats basically a useless scam.  also, mosquitos were a huge issue for us.  bring serious mosquito spray because most of the restaurants are outside and there is tons of water (which attract mosquitos) and they did not have anything to combat the problem.  i also never saw a lifeguard at the kids pool or the main pool or the beach.

reviews.author: jemery619
reviews.title: We had a great time with a few snafus
reviews.text:
The resort itself is beautiful. My husband and I stayed there this past week for his company trip and really had a great time. The food was pretty good, everyone was very polite, the spa was relaxing, and the beach is beautiful.

My only complaints were that our lights and water kept randomly going out in our room, and also on a night that appetizers were served- they were served with some type of leaf skewer. Unfortunately the skewer separated in the appetizer that I ate- resulting in me swallowing part of the skewer, and 6 days later it is still lodged in my throat (I will be seeing a doctor). 
Our butler Angelo was always courteous and helpful.

reviews.author: Wanderer03838687001
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort Punta Cana
reviews.text: We had Royal Service which I think is expensive for what you get.  The food is very average, and entertainment at night is average.  Nice rooms, clean, and great beds.  Beach amazing, Beach lounges old and some need replacing

reviews.author: tmdsilva
reviews.title: Excellent beach and premises
reviews.text: Set within a charming garden, this massive resort boasts spacious rooms, clean surroundings and an extensive beach diligently cleared of weeds. The Indian fare at the Naos buffet was quite authentic and the Naos became the default choice once  we established our meal options. Take note of the fact that depending on your booking choices you may be locked out of certain beach areas which can be quite perplexing. This resort has tremendous potential to become a leading one in PC were it not for the unimaginative menus and poor quality of preparations at the specialty restaurants-other than Passion which unfortunately incurs a cover charge. Service at the Naos is often sketchy and sporadic- employees mostly seems distant and unsmiling - unlike other similar resorts where the enthusiasm is palpable. If you want to experience a fantastic beach and spacious accommodations without being too picky about the meals then it’s the place for you.

reviews.author: Jennifer C.
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL Vacation!
reviews.text: We just returned from Paradisus Palma Real on Tuesday.  We had a fantastic 6 days in paradise!  We had Royal Service which I highly recommend.  Our butler Richard was great. Made all of our dinner reservations.  Checked in at least twice a day to see what we needed.  When we returned from the beach there was either fruit and cheese or chocolate covered strawberries waiting for us daily.  The food was very good.  Wanda the bartender at the royal service bar was very nice.  Martin our beach waiter was great.  He was sweet and took great care of us!  The beach is beautiful.  The beds on the beach and around the pool were so comfortable. All the restaurants were very good.  DJ every night and always something going on to do.  I can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Capturedbykd
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort okay food okay beach
reviews.text: The resort is Gorgeous and the entertainment was awesome! I thought the food was just okay. They have plenty of restaurants for the evening (which you must make reservations ahead of time) and one buffet pretty much open all day ;). It is a public beach so lots of vendors all the time. The water isn’t clear til you swim quit a distance. Beautiful place and pleasant people.

reviews.author: quietbeachgirl
reviews.title: It’s fine
reviews.text:
Depends on what you like. I dislike wearing a hotel bracelet and really dislike having to make dinner reservations while on a resort holiday, especially when you cannot get into the restaurant of your choice! I much prefer the buzzer system that the AM resorts (Zoetry, Secrets, Dreams, etc.) offer.
The palapas on the beach are so close to each other you could almost touch the couple sitting next to you!
The beach itself was nice but Bavaro Beach, in general, has gotten far too crowded for me over the last decade. Really dislike the constant intrusion from the local entrepreneurs trying to sell their cheap wares and hawk their tours too.
Room was ok, food was ok.  Main entrance to the resort and the courtyard was pretty as were the grounds. Would I return? Probably not.

reviews.author: Michele Hardin
reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.text:
My husband and I were there on for a rewards trip.  Upon arrival everything looked great!  The view of the ocean when you walked in was gorgeous!  Every place you looked was spotless.
