We got to our room and it was very nice with a separate sitting room which included a mini kitchen.  The AC was set to 24 celsius (75 farenheit)  so it was just semi-cool.  I turned it down and went about my day.

That evening we had a group event.  The food was awful.  Either the food was overcooked, under-cooked or just didn't have any flavor.  That seemed to sum up the food for the week.  The buffet during breakfast and lunch was not good at all.  We never ate the buffet for dinner, so I cannot comment on that.  I did eat a bunch of salads during the trip, even though their dressing was extremely watery.

The next day I went down to the front desk to complain about the AC, and they said they would look into it.  This same conversation happened all week with nothing being done to fix it.  I truly don't think they even ever looked at it because I never heard anything said about it when I asked day after day. Two days before we were leaving, the AC shut off.  Nothing.  We had to open windows and the sliders to the patio to get the fresh air to circulate.  

Colleagues told us that they did not have hot water in their room, another told us their room was very musty and smelled, and another told us that their light fixture in their room was hanging with wires sticking out.

We went to one of the specialty restaurants, hibachi.  While sitting there waiting for the cook to start, a mouse ran across the floor.  Needless to say, we were a bit grossed out and left.

The pool area, spa, beach were very nice, and of course the swim up bar.

For the amount of money they charge, they can upkeep their guest rooms much better.  I would not recommend this resort with so many others in that area.

reviews.author: Mike K
reviews.title: Good value, horrendous service
reviews.text:
This is a nice resort with friendly people and a nice clientele.  Lots of things to do.  Food is good, not great.  Drinks are good, not great.  If you come, eat at The Winery every nite.  There is good service here.  Wines are very very good and well priced.  They will serve you customized meals.  Really good!!   

The biggest thing is the overall service.  Lots of people work here but nobody really wants to help you.  Lots of handoffs and excuses.  Everything is slow and lots of errors.  For my money, Cancún all inclusive are SO much better.

reviews.author: jounianni
reviews.title: Could be a lot better if they would train staff for service...
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our 10 days vacation at Paradisus but were left with quite mixed feelings from this hotel, which has potential for much more

Positives
+Juan Carlos & Tennis teacher is superstar. We ended taking both private lessons and participating on free of charge lessons (morning for beginners and late afternoon for advanced). He is great teacher with great service attitude - best in resort
+ beach and surroundings well taken care of
+ Cocotal golf club with free of charge green fees is 15 minutes walking distance (or free bus once ever hour). Pleasant - not toughest course - we enjoyed 3 rounds
+ wide choice of restaurants and bars

Negatives:
- service is really hit and miss - you get positive suprises but for majority they are just working there. It is clear that management was nowhere visible asking and meeting customers
- Reception zero welcoming (we are melia gold rewards members) but just wanting us away fast - asking to sign credit card reserve without even explaining how much and why 
- Very noisy. Neighbour hotel played very loud music each evening - worst night until 2 am. Sleeping without ear plugs impossible. Loud music at pool and beach all day long 
- We ended up at front desk 7 times for changing keys which always stopped working (no - we did not keep them next to phones). No apology given
-Safety box in our suite didnt work and shower very low pressure and extremely hot water - mentioned on this issue a few times with no action
- Even if they have many ala carte restaurants there are really only 2 good ones (Aqua - great quality and ok Italian). Rest of them adequate at best. Book reservation in advance to avoid long waiting lines
- Huge resort and at easter time running at limit - plenty of colf carts transporting people back and forth but none of drivers stopping and asking to take you anywhere even if tehy were empty / employees only on board
-Fix the tennis court !!

If youre looking for party vacation at Caribbean beautiful beach this is a great place - if youre looking for high quality and service with quiet surroundings please go elsewhere... Comparing with Melia Zanzibar this was at best 3 star experience

reviews.author: 903travel
reviews.title: Unfortunately it is not the best experience
reviews.text: I was so exited to go in Paradisus Palma Real and could not wait to stay there. Unfortunately this hotel did not meet my exspectation. Hotel is huge and have a different level of service. The biggest problem is nobody explain you what you can and can not use according to your room accomodation, nither give you a tour around the property when you checking in. Absolutely poor managment. We had a huge problem with restorant reservation. Even spend more then 40 minutes to make a reservation for the reatorants for 7 nights, we got very unprofessional person by name Nicalis, who gave us a paper with a list of restorant reservation, but did not put it in the computer. We came to the Aqua restorant very nicely dressed up and nobody could found the place for us. The hole vacation was completely ruined after that night. Thank you very much Tata, Yohendy and Milly who help us to make another reservation for the rest of our stay. Unfortunately we did not  have an experience with Aqua restoraunt, but Vladimir made a reservation for us in Pallazio. I want to say thank you for the manager in the reception(sorry, forgot her name) and hard working personal in this hotel. Everybody in the buffet, restoraunts, bars, lanscaping are working just excellent. The room are clean. The beach is gorgeous, but beach beds are very bed and need to be replace. The entertaiment is good. This hotel has great potential to be one of the best in Punta Cana, but right now has a poor management. If you can pay top dollars for the Royal Service, you will enjoy it. Otherwise you will feel like a poor guest on the expensive ball.

reviews.author: Ciusni
reviews.title: Needs to improve
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, family proposal but the furniture is too old. They don`t have tropical gardens as they claim to have. Very noisy, noisy rooms. Very small buffets, when the hotel is full is hard to go inside the buffets.
The beach is not children family, bavaro beach is for sure much better than the one where this hotel is located. When we leave the hotel to the airport, they told us it costs USD 35, but for my surprise, the driver told me it is USD 40. 
Really needs to improve.

reviews.author: BR10016
reviews.title: Family trip that left a bad taste in our mouths
reviews.text:
This was my family's second time at the Reserve at Paradisus. When I booked, I requested the same room as last year or something similar. We were first floor and pool facing. I'm not sure if other reviews warn about the rooms not facing the pool, but be aware, they are awful. They face the road and you will hear carts (shuttle buses the hotel takes guests on), scooters (used by staff), and other loud noises late into the night and early morning. We were on the side facing the edge of the hotel's property and could hear thumping music from the adjacent hotel all night long. They made no effort to honor our request. Clearly they don't value return customers. 

What left the worst taste in my mouth - literally and figuratively - was that at the time of booking (black Friday), we were told “as a special thanks” we would be given dinner for two at Pasion, their "premier" restaurant (which carries a charge, is adults only, etc). We figured "why not," arranged for my mother to babysit the kids, and scheduled for our dinner. Pasion is a tasting menu--of the ten courses, about three were edible. I am a seafood lover, but this was the most fishy, inedible seafood I had ever tasted. At the end of an unnecessarily long (3 hour) dinner, I was presented with a bill for $160 ($80 per person). I mentioned to the waiter that we had been offered dinner for free, and he looked at me and said to speak to the management. I was upset and angry and immediately conveyed what had happened to our Family Concierge. She said she would look into it. After asking her day after day about this, I spoke with the Concierge manager.  What they failed to mention, was that what we were offered was a three course "sampling" of Pasion. I explained that I felt completely tricked into eating at this horrible restaurant. After going around and around, they wound up charging us half. I made it clear that I didn’t think was a satisfactory resolution - they did not seem to care what I think. While this was my personal story, it reflects on the overall experience at Paradisus—they will try to “sell” every minute of the day. Quietly sitting by the pool, you'll be hounded by salespeople trying to book family photo sessions (many of who didn't politely take no for an answer). Waiters wanting to bring you "drinky drinky" so that they'll earn a tip. The whole place just feels like everyone is hustling. Overall, I found that tiresome and, in the case of Pasion restaurant, downright shady.

reviews.author: Dany00
reviews.title: Necesita una Renovación
reviews.text: Por el precio, esperaba más de las instalaciones, que sí bien se nota que en sus días de esplendor fue lujoso, se ha quedado atrás respecto a la gran competencia, por la falta de renovación. Un hotel de esa categoría no puede permitirse tumbonas y muebles rotos, habitaciones desactualizadas, pero menos la piscina rota al punto de causarle una herida de puntos a mi niño. El hotel se hizo cargo de todos los gastos, como debe ser en un caso así. Debo destacar el excelente servicio de todos los empleados y tienen un muy buen Miniclub para los niños. Visitamos el restaurante Aqua donde lo mejor fue el postre de chocolate y el Japonés donde fue muy entretenido el show de cocina.

reviews.author: Jose Manuel Tamayo
reviews.title: Un hotel con una infraestructura excelente pero con un personal que no representa una excelencia en servicio
reviews.text:
Nuestro viaje fue familiar, 10 personas en total, la recepción es lenta por lo que hay que tener paciencia desde la entrada si vas en un grupo, te piden nuevamente las tarjetas de crédito que usaste para pagar la estadía, en nuestro caso ya teníamos pagado el 100% de la estadía pero de todas formas nos pidieron las tarjetas de crédito para un cobro de seguridad.
Todos teníamos la categoría Family Concierge, supuestamente esto seria un upgrade de nuestras vacaciones pero realmente no vale la pena contratar este servicio, en mi caso personal nuestro concierge no se preocupo por nosotros y teniendo en cuenta que viajábamos con un bebe de 5 meses acompañados de nuestros suegros que cumplían años de casados... En servicio en general no es tan bueno como lo pensábamos, yo personalmente venia con expectativas altas, ya que nuestra ultima estadía fue en el Hard Rock, en general en los restaurantes y barras si no andas con dolares en la mano  los chicos no te atienden de la mejor manera y se les nota en la actitud... al parecer el típico norteamericano que anda dejando dolares en todos lados tiene al equipo de Paradisus muy mal acostumbrado ya que sin dolares en la mano no vas a tener la misma atención que con una buena propina. 
(Esto es lo que diferencia a un equipo realmente fidelizado, la atención es siempre buena y esto genera en el cliente las ganas de dejar una buena propina y este no fue el caso)
La comida en general es buena y las instalaciones de primer nivel.
Reposeras en la piscina ni se molesten en buscar, nunca hay disponibles, de alguna forma el hotel permite que los huéspedes dejen reservada las reposeras todo el día!! Vas a las 7 AM y ya están todas las reposeras con toallas y cosas.

En general si algún día recomiendo el hotel les diría que hay que ir con muchos dolares para propina y que la suerte los acompañe con un buen concierge.

reviews.author: Andressa V
reviews.title: Serviço deixou muito a desejar
reviews.text:
Os empregados ou não sabiam dar informações ou davam informações erradas de propósito... 

No dia em que chegamos tivemos dificuldade de ligar a hidromassagem da banheira do quarto e a atendente do prédio disse que nossa reserva não dava direito à hidromassagem e por isso não conseguiríamos ligar. Achamos estranho, pois na reserva constava a hidromassagem. No dia seguinte perguntamos a outra atendente como fazia para ligar, ela nos explicou como ligava e funcionou. 

No dia em que chegamos solicitamos um berço para o nosso bebê e disseram que iriam providenciar, mas não providenciaram. Pedimos a vários funcionários e ninguém resolveu. Diziam que era para esperarmos que eles levariam o berço no quarto mas ninguém levou. Nosso bebê não teve berço para dormir na primeira noite.Somente resolveram a situação no dia seguinte. 

Em outra ocasião, perguntei à atendente de drinks do gabi club onde ficava o banheiro e ela disse que só havia na área da piscina (longe), mas depois descobri que no próprio restaurante Gabi Club havia banheiro. 

A limpeza do quarto não foi adequada. A camareira não recolheu o lixo (que estava cheio) em diversos dias e eu tinha que sair procurando local para depositar o lixo. A camareira também não limpava a banheira de hidromassagem e deixava sujeira dentro dela. Nós tínhamos que limpar antes de usar.

Tivemos dificuldade de reservar os restaurantes para o jantar pois a recepcionista dizia que não havia vagas, só consegui as reservas depois de muita insistência e em horários horríveis, com o restaurante quase fechando na maior parte dos dias. Expliquei que tinha bebê pequeno que dormia cedo e que não poderia ir muito tarde, mas não adiantou muito, pois ela dizia que estava tudo muito cheio. Contudo, em diversos dias encontramos os restaurantes com muitas mesas vazias. 

Tenho um bebê e por isso precisei solicitar alimentação para ele, já que ainda não come todos os tipos de alimentos e temperos. Conversei com o empregado Siberian do restaurante Gabi Club, expliquei o tipo de comida que precisava, e era simples (arroz, batata, brócolis, ovo e frango picadinho). Marcamos um horário para que eu fosse ao restaurante buscar a comida do bebê e quando eu chegava lá nunca estava pronto, teve dia em que ele esqueceu de fazer e quando eu cheguei ele mandou dizer que não estava, mas eu o vi na cozinha...

O serviço foi muito aquém do que eu esperava... principalmente considerando o valor pago e o fato de ter adquirido uma estadia no "The Reserve"

reviews.author: negra30
reviews.title: Sobrevalorado
reviews.text: Vinimos en un viaje de amigas buscando el all inclusive de playas bien cuidadas , tragos y comida. Primeo, hay que contratar el royal service si no el trago es el nacional, el buffete general es promedio, el rest de carnes demasiado lento, muyy muy lento y la carne la mas dura que he comido nunca. Las instalaciones bien, playa de royal service muy bien pero me llama la atencion que algo tan basico como botanas de papas fritas con chili o nachos y guacamole no hayan en este hotel, poca informacion, etc. Por la misma plata he ido a mejores

reviews.author: Blake Seven
reviews.title: Proceed with caution
reviews.text:
All in all we had an ok time but read all reviews carefully. If you think you are coming to 5 star luxury and like good food be very careful. Your not getting luxury and the food is average at best and shocking at worst. 

Without family concierge everything is difficult. We managed to get restaurant reservations but we had to be flexible on days and times. If you are in a group with  children and want to be specific. Forget it without family concierge. 

Pros. 

- Amazing kids club, the staff are brilliant and facilities great. 
- great beach, shame about the constant sellers. 
- Grounds are stunning. 
- Evening shows are quite good and the kids liked them. 
- Generally a good buzz around the place in the evening. 

Cons. 

- Rooms are tired, dated and literally falling to bits. Frayed mats, lampshades torn and a broken fridge but to name a few. 
- Food, the buffets are just ok at best and sometimes VERY poor. Cheap cuts of meat (knuckle, thigh etc) plus limited options and a lot of repetition. 
- The other restaurants are ok, but service very up and down and the food tries hard but is mostly all show and no taste with very small portions. 
 - Watch your drinks. They served our KIDS ALCOHOLIC punch in Mole restaurant. 
- Wine markups can be VAST. Sometimes 500%. We know that as we paid an checked. 
- ADVICE - if you are going to buy wine then look at the menu and use a wine app. You see the rating and also check the value. Many wines were 500+% mark up but some wines were less so and well rated. 

Passion restaurant - was a good evening, food was great but note that when we took the 80 US wine pairing that all bottles used were 6 - 12 USD per bottle. After the buffet food you’ll feel like your in heaven. Worth the investment, not perfect for a chef with 10 stars to his name. We sent back one Hake fish dish where the ‘fish was from spain’ it was so tough (and I mean tough) I can only assume it swam it’s self to DR. 

We won’t return to this resort as it’s just not what we hoped for. We’re pretty relaxed as a family but i can see how a lot about this resort could really irritate people. Especially if you booked the holiday after looking at the official website. 
That place on the website existed 10 years ago. It doesn’t now! 

If you get a cheap deal on this place and like your food quantity over quality then you’ll be fine.

reviews.author: Coll_B
reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text: Now that I’ve been here,  I highly recommend only booking Royal Service or staying at the Grand.    I booked The main hotel which has good ratings.  The beach is beautiful.   Activities in the pool were fun.  The a la carte restaurants are very good.   The buffet is not great and the service in the bufffet area is awful.  I refilled our coffee and water and they ran out of many food items and dishes.  Many of the staff don’t speak English.   We moved our room due to leaky ceiling and shower.    The rooms in the main hotel are outdated.    The new room was much  better in villa 5.   The wrist bands are confusing with what you have access to.  I’m used to having access to all restaurants and bars with an all-inclusive.  We were turned away from three places for not having the right wrist band.  The app for the hotel didn’t work where the activities were listed so I stopped at the front desk each night to get the list.  It isnt posted anywhere on property what the activities are.     I paid for premium liquor and access to the Reserve.   Many bars didn’t have or ran out of grey goose.  What’s the point of paying for it if you are going to stock it?  With all that said many of the staff were fun, and memorable!   Nixon and Miguel were awesome.

reviews.author: GBubrick
reviews.title: Don't Go to Enjoy Fine Dining
reviews.text:
Stayed five days in Royal Service (exclusive) Section at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.  The facilities and staff are first class.  The dining options were extremely disappointing.  No taste, no taste, no taste.  I joked to my partner - "The best item is the mantequilla (butter)."

I really have no one to blame but myself.  There is a legit reason why I never, ever stay at All-Inclusive resorts.  The food is created for the masses, bland and repetitive.  Here our dissatisfaction was so profound that we dined off property 60% of the time.  Even their Michelin 1-star (Passion) was nothing special.

Sorry but that's how we felt.  Again, staff was tremendous.  So many went out of their way to please.  But, when management and ownership don't provide the ingredients, not  much the staff can do.

reviews.author: rross111
reviews.title: 6th time in Punta Cana - hotel OK
reviews.text: This was our 6th time visiting Punta Cana and our 1st and last at this resort.  Our daughter was hospitalized and unable to come so we were given a "voucher" due to they DO NOT issue refunds. Well, now we are trying to use our "voucher" and of course there are issues. 1st issue: try to have someone respond to phone calls and emails in a timely manner is impossible, 2nd: a person in the business office needs to get back to us (?), 3rd: then we were told rooms are unavailable for our dates - that's funny because there are rooms available when booking online.  We are getting the run around trying to use our voucher. I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: hopalum
reviews.title: Members get less every year
reviews.text: We have been members 5 years.  We always have customer service issues, but we keep coming because traveling here is convenient, we have a paid membership and the resort itself is beautiful.  However, they are now pushing members to "upgrade" to their new resort - the "Circle" that is far less desirable - far away from the beach, very stark, lousy room set-ups.  They are asking for huge money to change, which we have refused.  However, now they are excluding members from various "Circle-only" restaurants in an effort to push people to move to the Circle.  In addition, while they are excluding members from various bars and restaurants, they are now catering to massive college trips and the drunk students have taken over every bar, INCLUDING THE MEMBERS ONLY BAR, making it unpleasant to be essentially anywhere in the resort.  They seem to only enforce "exclusiveness" against the members.  I have complained and despite that I am still listening to drunk college students hooting and hollering in the members only sections.  In addition, we got no answers to calls and emails attempting to arrange for dinner reservations, and when we arrived, were told that basically there were no reservations available other than the generic buffet where we must eat lunch and dinner every day.  We did ultimately get some reservations after my husband threw a fit.  They used to provide "butlers" that would arrange for your needs - minibar, dinner reservations, tours, transport, etc. but they no longer do that.  The trip this year has been unbelievably frustrating.

reviews.author: Culture41908899577
reviews.title: Paradisus in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Housekeeping was excellent and the room was great, not enough Restaurant to make a reservation to go for dinner, it's a big resort, staff doesn't speak much English. Most of the people were from English speaking country therefore the staff should speak it enough to understand what we are asking for.

reviews.author: Inspire22266216083
reviews.title: Ho-Hum
reviews.text: Very friendly staff.  First impression was good but property need maintenance.  Had a couple cold showers, Room door handle was difficult to operate - tug twist & push just so to open room door.  Weather was terrific.  As soon as you get on the beach away from the resort many local sales people bombard all the guest.  No pre-check out service so give yourself plenty of time to wait and checkout at the main counter.  Buffet was ok, nothing organic - had enough of it after going for 3 days.  Mixed drinks not consistent and alcohol tasted adulterated.

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: Horrible Management, Excellent Staff
reviews.text:
So I am extremely torn about this resort. The staff is the beyond amazing staff (minus one, well get to that later) and the grounds are beautiful. But I’ll just start from the beginning. The only reason I’m giving it three stars is because of the great staff. Also, I feel like the Royal Service rooms could be better, ours felt a tad worn and tired. 

This was a girls trip with myself (29), my sister (27) and our cousin (26). We booked our reservation through RCI for 2/23-3/2. About a week out, we still hadn’t heard from Paradisus. We sent them an email because we wanted to pay for the pre paid all inclusive fees. We heard back from them and were sent a form to fill out with our stay information as well as the credit card information. There was an issue with a signature and we had to refill it out, but that was the only issue they said there was. A week later we arrived and went to check in. Our receptionist Alicia (?) was very sweet and kind, but went to confirm our dates and said we were only there until 3/1, which we corrected her right away. We wanted to upgrade to Royal Service and a manager was brought out to see if there were rooms available. Again, they said until 3/1 and we corrected them once again and all we got was “okay okay.” So we thought there was just an error on their side since all of our paperwork said 3/2. We were taken over to Royal Service and received our keys and wrist bands and met our Butler, Jose. He was very nice and escorted us to our room. We quickly told him what restaurants we were interested in for our stay and then went to enjoy the rest of our day. Before Jose left us, he said again that he has us until Friday, and again we said “no, we’re here until Saturday.” He said he’ll try to figure it out. Then again on Wednesday, we found ourselves in the Royal Service Lounge and they said again we were supposed to check out on Friday and we corrected them again and heard nothing. Come Thursday Jose found us after breakfast and told us that we were in fact checking out on Friday. So back up to the Royal Service Lounge we went. Angela was so sweet and tried helping us and ended up getting reservations on the phone for us. The woman we spoke to was so extremely rude and kept talking over both me and my sister for about an hour. What the issue was, was there was an email sent BEFORE we sent in the final paperwork that said six nights instead of seven. On our final paperwork the dates were 2/23-3/2 with a final amount circled and initialed by someone in accounting and our credit card receipt attached. I guess they only charged us for six nights. Now. We wouldn’t have had any issue if we had solved this within the first couple of days like we were trying to, but they waited until the very last minute to say something and basically left us with the choice to pay or leave because of someone else’s mistake. We ended up talking to the Royal Service manager and showed her our paper work all signed off and completed with our dates on there and all she kept doing was showing us copies of the email that said six nights. No dates and it was just an email, not official paperwork. We kept trying to tell her this but she was so extremely nasty and rude and ended up screaming at us “you know what. I think you did this on purpose and said six nights and booked your flight a day later wanting to get a free night and free $500 from us!” I have NEVER, EVER been so disrespected in my entire life. She was so unprofessional and she humiliated us in front of all of the other guests inside the full Royal Service Lounge. Why would we be trying to get a free night if we had been trying to take care of the issue ourselves since we checked in?! And for multiple days after?! There was no apology for the mishap on their end just the accusation of trying to “get $500 for free.” No compensation for the inconvenience of wasting four hours of one of our last days (we missed the pool party we had been waiting for all week and even moved our excursion because we wanted to attend it so badly). All we wanted was an apology that someone on their end didn’t look over the paperwork correctly and some kind of compensation for the inconvenience of them waiting until the very last minute to address the issue we had been trying to solve ourselves since the day we got there and for being berated by the Royal Service manager. I’m a flight attendant, my sister is the manager of a hair salon, and my cousin is a server so we all come from a customer service background and were so throughly disappointed in the way the situation was handled and how we were talked to. We also believe that this was an age discrimination issue. We all felt that if we were an older couple, this never would have happened. We were also embarrassed to step foot into the Royal Service Lounge for the remainder of our trip because we were so embarrassed. Even going in there to check out, I almost had an anxiety attack. 

Now, onto the good things about the resort. The staff (in no particular order)!!! I can’t say how wonderful it was to see the same faces every day and have everyone know and remember us.  

Every morning we walked onto the beach, they always had towels and a bed waiting for us. Elbin was our go to guy for four days. He was so friendly and constantly made sure we were doing okay. He would even have a tray of new drinks for us before we were even done with our first ones! And even when we were by the pool, we still got the same great service. Martin was always so happy and singing and dancing and willing to help. Rafael was also amazing at helping us with whatever it was that we needed quickly. They all work so hard and it really shows. Alberto and Nixon at the activities desk we so nice and so much fun and helped up book and reschedule (because we wanted to go to that pool party...) our excursion. We all LOVED Polanco!!! He was by the pool every morning for activities (he taught us to salsa) and every night for the party at Gabi Beach and was always fun to dance with and talk to (and even helped my sister out when a guy was getting a little too close for comfort for her). 

The bar staff!!! Every bar we went to had such an amazing bar staff. At the Royal Service pool bar, Wanda made the best bloody Mary’s, Pedro would bounce back and fourth between the beach and the bar but would always take care of us, Wilfredo kept our drinks coming all day (he made the best drunk donkeys!). And Wonderly!!! We only saw him one day, but he really did make an impression on us because of his customer service skills and he was so kind. At the lobby bar Jacinto was our favorite!!! He made us the best drinks and was always on top of refilling us and he was such a good time (and he made the best lemon drop shots we had all week). Teddy was working at the disco one night and also was amazing and kept us very happy (the DJ was also super nice and played a great selection of music). Armondo was our server for two nights (one at Vento and one at Rare). We had dinner at the two, two nights apart and he still had remembered our drink orders. Jose at Palazzo was always so kind and welcoming to us and always made sure to say “see you tomorrow” each time we left. Our hostess at Palazzo was also always so nice and kind each time we saw her. Ariel in room service was also our best friend at night once all the restaurants had closed. He was so funny!!

Now onto our butler situation. When we checked in we had Jose. He was very nice, but we didn’t feel like he was being attentive enough to us. I don’t know if it was because we were young and were low maintenance, but we would always just get general answers from him (like we asked about the pool party one day and all he said was “there’s an activity by the pool at noon every day.” But we didn’t know what kind of activity. I feel like this is also on the hotel, there should be a sheet or something in the lobby that tells you the schedule of events happening in the hotel. Every night we just walked past Gabi Beach at 2100 to see what was going on. I’m sure he is a great butler to others, but I don’t think he was the right fit for us. We had Jeuri as our butler for the last two days and he was more our speed. He was super attentive and would stop to chat with us every time he saw us (even before he became our butler, he knew us and was taking care of us). He also had a wonderful cheese and meat plate as well as chocolate covered strawberries waiting for us one day. 

Overall, we really liked the feeling of the resort and how everyone knew us (we’re from California and were known as the golden girls all week). Every time one of the above staff members saw us, they always took time to check in with us and that meant the world to us. But with the issue we had and the way we were treated by that Royal Service manager, I really don’t think we’ll ever return, and it honestly breaks my heart. I will also be letting all 30,000 of my co workers know to stay away from this resort and Melia in general because of the horrible management and treatment we received by them.

reviews.author: PureCdnMaple
reviews.title: Wasn’t terribly impressed
reviews.text:
The airline put us up at the Paradisus when our flight was cancelled, so this review is based on just a one night stay. 
Check-in was very smooth. Front desk was polite and very efficient. The hotel was very beautiful. 
When we arrived in our room the first thing we noticed was how beautiful it was, the second thing was the nasty, musty, moody smell. I had to use room freshener that I had brought with me or we wouldn’t have been able to stay in the room. The beds were comfortable enough, but the bedding wasn’t luxurious by any means. The pillows were useless as they were as flat as pancakes.  When I went to take a shower, I found an unwrapped, used bar of soap and a half empty bottle of shampoo (something tells me the maids didn’t clean here). There were many light switches in the room, but only one worked and it turned on every light there was (including the bathroom). I think the tv was the first flatscreen ever made and the smallest one available. When we arrived the t.v. was already on and when we went to go to bed, we discovered there was no remote anywhere in the room. The on/off switch on the t.v. didn’t work either - I had to unplug it to shut it off. 
We had one meal at the resort - the buffet. When we arrived there was no one to seat us, but we stopped a staff member to ask if we were to just seat ourselves and there response was to wave their hand at us and say “I’m too busy” and walk off. There was not a clean table in the place and customers were either sitting down at dirty tables or clearing the m themselves. We cleared off a table and managed to flag someone down to wipe it and get us some cutlery - the table across from us gave up trying to get cutlery and ate with their hands. The food was very good, especially the Indian items. One restauraunt employee was exceptional - he was working as hard and fast as he could to help everyone and continuously apologizing for everything “I’m so sorry, there is just too many people”. He had a big smile on his face the whole time and was doing the best he could. All the tables were not full, so they obviously did not have enough staff working. 
If I was paying, and not the airline, I would never stay here.

reviews.author: LG81
reviews.title: Terrible to Average/Good. Its strange.
reviews.text:
Its conflicting. Was it the worst; no. Was it OUTSTANDING; heck no. Every poor review was accurate, every good review was pretty close to accurate. This is my 9th or 10th all-inclusive experience so I know what to expect, and at what price point. This is not a party place. There is no swim-up pool bar. 5:00 p.m. the pool is ghost town.  Caters to families with smaller children. A bit over priced for what they are currently offering. I literally spent days reading reviews so I went in prepared! 

We were greeted with a lame check-in. They had a display of food and beverages nobody told us about around the corner (we ran into days later). We came in with 4 kids and my parents; we had to ask for water and the gentlemen checking us in was as cool as ice. No info offered. We (by reading the reviews) asked questions.  Not warm welcome overall.  

Concierge: I mean, he was nice but we asked for everything (and he supplied) but not much was offered besides dinner reservations. AND I have NO IDEA what everyone is talking about 'reserving cabanas', we were told 100 times they do not do that any longer as of 6 months ago!!!  We got up early to grab one. His answer was ‘there are plenty don’t worry- we no longer do that’.  AGAIN, if we did not read reviews we would not have known to ask for these little things for the kids or the cabana reservation. The service is nice but a bit more forward-thinking would be good. We kept asking for stuff that we read about lol- nothing just happens. We still tipped him well and appreciated his effort. 

Rooms: Spacious and family-friendly. Seemed clean enough. Yes, a bit tired but not old or gross. Always plenty of water bottles around, that’s good! No hot water one day (fixed), no water next day (fixed). Limited hot water third day (we gave up). Blow-dryer started to smoke (replaced, I think?). Some days we got fresh fruit and cheese, some days not. Maybe it was the days we complained lol?  AC whacked out, fixed quickly. Some lights didn't work. Whatever. One day, bed had one pillow. After 3 calls, we had an extra. TV's do not function properly. Remotes, nope. They don't work. Just weird.  They need to tighten up the rooms overall. A-Z. 

Food: Not great. This needs major overhaul for the price.  Reserve buffet is limited  (and small) and its literally the same EVERY DAY.  Beach buffet is the same, literally, limited and the same food. Not good. Bar food= gross/limited menu. Room service, ya, nope. Same food as buffet and limited. If they show up. Waited 2 hours for kids chicken strips a few nights. But in the morning, coffee came fast? Bar is OK. Drinks were typical cheap drinks unless you asked for better. I do not even think they bother to use fresh fruit in smoothies.  Liquid fruit concentrate with a token half-banana thrown in. Sad. Food I think needs the MOST work. It’s just not good. Restaurants were OK. Steak house NO NO NO. Don' waste your time.  

Grounds/pool/ lobby are clean and well-maintained. Some staff is friendlier than others. Overall, hospitality is OK. Not awesome, not bad. I feel like for the price they should up their game... English is not great overall with the staff.  Tipping does not matter. Tip normal. They do not exceed expectations with pre-tipping or over-tipping lol! 

Yes, golf carts carry you back and forth. No, they are not easily obtained! We waited 45 minutes for one back from the beach to the Reserve, we called 4 times. Some days they were better but overall, your waiting. It is doable walk, though. And most days wait was less than 10 min. 

Beach: Clean and lots of grass/seaweed. Cabanas are old but fine. Reserve area is roped off. Waiter is OK. It is just one, so you wait but he works hard.  Sand is clean and the people selling on the beach are pretty frequent but do not linger once you tell them no. 

Kids Club is nice and clean. A nice way to cool your kiddos off. Buffet is lame for them but it’s something to snack on. Very clean overall.  I don't think the itinerary they give you actually takes place. That huge kid pool and not one organized activity to bring all these kids together! English is not strong so  I was hard-pressed to leave my kids there for very long. Overall, it’s nice. The play room is big and seems full of toys but as you linger you start to notice, none work, none have parts and none are good shape. But its clean and cool so the kids were OK. 

We booked through Costco. We will have some words with Costco over the inconsistency of what was promised/expected. The hotel was not reimbursing us for anything. They gave us a sad voucher to come back... hmmmm... 
Overall, our trip was nice. Hiccups along the way but my husband and I are easy-going. I imagine most people would be pretty heated not to have hot water for their family in a family concierge master suite but we plucked along.  They are clearly in a decline overall based on older reviews. It was pretty quiet there, not many people around so that speaks volumes too. 

Also, there is no entertainment. None there. A few nights there were some DJs and a singer. Sleepy hotel overall. If that is what you’re looking for, you got it here.

reviews.author: Odyssey11738882323
reviews.title: Never Again!
reviews.text: Bring plenty of Imodium as you are likely to have diarrhea and also do not count on electricity 24/7 during your stay.  The power went out every day were there for 1-5 hours usually in the afternoon when we were heading for our room to cool off.  The butler service isn't worth it and the Royal Service is a gimmick as our butler gave us mostly lip service especially when making reservations at the restaurants.

reviews.author: Ana Vasquez
reviews.title: Nos decepcionó esta vez
reviews.text: Es la cuarta vez que visitamos Paradisus en Punta Cana y ya no pensamos volver pues la calidad ha bajado muchísimo. Los meseros y las hostess atienden con pésima actitud como si no fuéramos clientes sino que estuviéramos rogándoles por un favor. La primera noche fuimos a cenar a uno de los restaurantes del resort y tuvimos que irnos antes de empezar a cenar porque el aire acondicionado estaba súper frío. Cuando pedimos que lo subieran, nos dijeron que no se podía porque era aire central. Uno de nuestros hijos se resfrió gracias a eso. La comida ha bajado muchísimo de calidad y no hay nada en todos los menús que uno pueda decir que fue preparado para un hotel cinco estrellas. Para terminar nuestra estadía, en el momento de salir para el aeropuerto el taxi que debía recogernos no estaba pues “se canso de esperar” y cuando le pedimos al hotel ayuda nos dijeron que eso no será su problema. El hotel fue quien nos recomendó la compañía que nos transportaba al aeropuerto. Nos tocó pagar dos veces el taxi pues estábamos sobre el tiempo y nos tocó llamar otro taxi para no perder el avión. Definitivamente no lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: Venture25656072964
reviews.title: Los creditos ofrecidos on line, son simples cupones de descuento, que implican realizar compras para poder utilizarlos.
reviews.text: Ofrecian pasar el dia en un nuevo hotel de la cadena, pero si o si, habia que asistir a una presentacion comercial, para lograr el pase. No encontre la calidad Melia esperada. Se nota la intencion permanente de querer vender servicios que deberian estar incluidos.

reviews.author: Buono15
reviews.title: Not the Same!!
reviews.text:
I have to say I’m a little disappointed.  We were there four years ago and the level of food has gone down considerably!! The rooms defiantly need to be updated.  They are pushing the new section The Circle.  It’s beautiful but far from the beach. Don’t put all your money into one section and disregard the rest of the property.  I had to request a room change they put us in room 1102 it is the nosiest room!!! So awful it is right outside the stair case so you can hear every persons conversation and climbing the stairs the worse is it is also right outside the maid chambers.  So you are awakened  at 7am when they arrive and start their day very loudly!!!
I’m glad with the Royal Service at least we had the Palazzo Restaurant for another breakfast and lunch option.  The Buffet was just not up to standers. A lot of food but not good quality.  Even Passions wasn’t to the same standards.  Vento was actually our favorite restaurant to our surprise!! Our Butler Angelo was outstanding he made our trip and so did the pool staff!!! We had a great time but won’t be going back

reviews.author: montbalt43
reviews.title: Was Better 3 Years Ago
reviews.text:
I returned to the resort after an extraordinary stay 3 years ago. It is just as beautiful as ever but I think the quality of food, service and infrastructure has slipped. The power went out several times in my room (and those of other guests I spoke to), there were issues with the key cards etc. I recall the restaurants on property being much better 3 years ago - all of them seemed relatively bland this time.

You won’t find a more beautiful beach resort anywhere, but this isn’t a spot for “foodies.”

reviews.author: Alexandra F
reviews.title: A NOT so Royal Service
reviews.text:
Leaving Canadian winter for a week was great! Weather in DR was perfect most of the time; food was very good, grounds were beautiful.
Stayed in ‘beach front suite’: on 2nd floor with a view of the beach but no direct access to the beach. Were woken up every morning at 4-5 am by beeping trucks cleaning the beach.
Suite itself was pretty but jacuzzi had lots of mold, sink not draining properly and housekeeping staff “forgot” to give us towels, soap, replenish mini fridge on several occasions.
Royal Service meant easy check in/out process, guaranteed bali bed on the beach, access to all restaurants on resort. 
Butler made restaurant reservations and answered a few questions but was not otherwise very useful: he was not able to tell us where to get local souvenirs, did not ask/offer excursions, did not tell us we could access activities/facilities at neighbouring resort (same head office).
There was minimal evening entertainment: sound and light management of said entertainment were mediocre.
Lots of day time activities however. 
And if lucky you get invited to a “30 min. presentation of the new Circle resort” which in fact is a 3 hour pressure sales pitch to invest thousands of dollars in exchange for future vacations, provided you pay your yearly service fee! We got a 30min Spa treatment out of it.
Overall a good vacation but overpriced and not deserving of ‘royal’ qualification.

reviews.author: Alexi
reviews.title: Termites in the room
reviews.text: After paying so much money the room was over run with termites.  Pretty upsetting I must say. Called the front desk and they were pretty unconcerned. After much fuss housekeeping came at almost midnight  & changed the sheets.. .foid was ok nothing to shout about...grounds very well kept.

reviews.author: Culture545166
reviews.title: February 22, 2019
reviews.text:
Totally agree with Brooklyn Dad - the amenities require some renovations, beach equipment is very outdated and looks ugly, and the food and drinks are really bad, very low quality. Surprised because four yeas ago food was really great.
On a bright note - Staff was very hospitable and helpful.
One tip to take - low quality of everything except of hospitality.

reviews.author: Dalton257
reviews.title: Golf resort....Really?
reviews.text: Hotel is fine. Beach is great. Spa is very relaxing. Passion restaurant is worth the surcharge. Palazzo restaurant for Royal service guests is excellent, especially for breakfast and lunch. HOWEVER, if you’re planning on playing golf, beware! Course is mediocre. Carts are disgusting and cost $65 per person + $1 for a bottle of water! For $75 per person, water is included but the carts are still dirty and in disrepair. Security is lacking on the course. A hotel that claims to be a golf resort should have golf amenities that are on a par with the hotel.

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.title: Not as great as last time - horrible food!
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Palma Real, Royal Service, having been there 3 years ago prior.  This time we were a bit underwhelmed. The hotel is in need of renovation, it's looking old and dated.  Our bathroom specifically was in dire straights, the shower pressure was horrible! Rusty pipes exposed and mold in the doorway.

Most disappointing was the food quality, it has gone way down! Don't think about eating at Rare (the steak restaurant) it was inedible! The hibachi restaurant was no better, tough chicken and shrimp and basically a rice dinner.  The only benefit of staying in Royal Service was eating at Palazzo, food was okay.  We paid extra to eat as Passion one evening, don't waste your money! Just because you add foam, doesn't make it good!

Martin at the Royal Service beach made our stay pleasurable! He was so attentive to our needs, having our beach chairs ready each morning and checking in consistently! He also makes the best Bloody Mary's!

reviews.author: Culture302380
reviews.title: No encontre la calidad Melia esperada
reviews.text: Hola, estuvimos alojados desde el 31/01 al 07/02. Los restaurants a la carta no tienen el nivel de otros hoteles de la cadena. La utilizacion de los cupones que ofrecen al reservar en la pagina de internet implican realizar gastos/compras.

reviews.author: RPKory
reviews.title: Winter Vacation
reviews.text: Very nice resort, overall a nice place to stay. We did enjoy it. The look and feel of the resort is great.  There are a few things could be addressed. The buffet is very sub par for the level of this resort. If you are looking for a quality food experience you may want to look elsewhere. Its not bad, but not great. The restaurants are nice and the food is pretty good. Not always open, and sometimes the wait time at table to get served is long. The merchants on the beach can at time get to be to much as you just want to relax and enjoy. Unfortunately at times, many tend to get to aggressive. You can get beer sent to your room by room service, but be prepared to call an hour ahead at least. The one thing that was a bit more annoying is that the staff is contently on their cell phones. Not a good look when your waiting and their texting.  MIGUEL Rodriguez the bartender at the bar near beach is awesome. Makes the best Bloody Marys and is super friendly!! SOSA at the Tappenyaki was also very good!

reviews.author: Meander04920181505
reviews.title: All inclusive que no lo tiene todo
reviews.text: Cosas por mejorar.- Servicio regular no es el mejor que haya recibido, encontrar agenda para reservar en los restaurantes es muy complicado, no hay variedad en distracciones, la piscina estaba helada y por último la zona en la que se encuentra el hotel no es la mejor para disfrutar de la playa, Bávaro no es una playa bonita.Cosas Excelentes.- En el Spa la pasé muy bien a diferencia del resto del hotel el servicio es excelente, las habitaciones son muy lindas y acogedoras, en general todo muy limpio

reviews.author: Maps19300100299
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text: Poor room lighting. Overhead fan light not working.Patio door lock broken. Would not lock...ground floor suite.Two double beds pushed together as one large bed, but sheets were overlapped and unable to fit properly.

reviews.author: Meiqi R
reviews.title: Maybe Punta Cana is not for me?
reviews.text:
We attended a cousin's wedding in late January at Paradisus Palma Real. The wedding hotel room block was not available until November and we had trouble getting in touch with the proper resort staff to reserve the room. Upon booking, there was no description offered of the different types of rooms available, only room A for price X and room B for price Y. I had (deliberately) never been to an all inclusive before and did not know that the type of room/bracelet purchased meant that we would be restricted from certain areas of the resort. Upon arrival, the concierge did not offer detailed information about the restaurants or activities available; instead he tried to reserve our time for the following day for a time share presentation. We went snorkeling the following day to the Marinarium, which I naively believed was some kind of animal conservation park. No, it was a pen in the water that trapped nurse sharks and rays for the guides to wrestle for tourist photo ops. All the coral was dead and there were hardly any fish to see. We went on a second snorkeling boat ride organized by a family member and it was even more depressing as we stopped by a pen for dolphins no bigger than an average American backyard. Our room would have been nice had the jacuzzi tub stopper and the TV been operational. The beach was also disappointing: you couldn't swim for fear of getting hit by a boat and the second you stepped over the resort property line, everyone and his brother wanted to sell you something. 

I know the bride and groom were happy with their wedding and we were happy to attend. However, if I were booking my own trip, I'd return to Vieques, Culebra or Fajardo instead. The one bright spot was the resort spa: we had the Royal Balinese massage and it was one of the best massages that I've ever had.

reviews.author: Fabrice_Olivier
reviews.title: Sentiments mitigés
reviews.text:
Lors de notre séjour à la réserve du Paradisus en 2011 nous avions vraiment apprécié cet hôtel. Par contre cette fois-ci l’expérience client n’était pas au rendez-vous et nous n’y retournerons pas compte tenu du rapport qualité/prix.

Voici selon nous un résumé des points positifs et négatifs :

Positifs : 
•	La plage avec section réservée pour la réserve et lits confortables à l’ombre (et toujours disponible)
•	La beauté du site (Paradisus et réserve)
•	Les employés sont en général très gentils
•	La possibilité d’avoir une expérience culinaire incroyable au restaurant Passion (80 USD par personne sans le vin) par l’un des plus grands chefs du monde. Un incontournable.

Neutre
•	La réserve est très familiale avec un coin pour enfants. Donc si vous avez de jeunes enfants ou une grosse famille c’est très bien.
•	Qualité et quantité de nourriture acceptable, ni plus ni moins. Souvent tiède dans les réchauds.

Négatifs :
•	Niveau de service médiocre malgré les bonnes intentions des employés. (Manque évident de supervision et de formation des employés.)
•	Plusieurs vendeurs (vous importunant plusieurs fois par jour) de forfaits et d’excursions dans la zone plage de l’hôtel.
•	Des votre arrivé les représentants de Circle insistent pour vous faire visiter d’autres sites Mélia.
•	Nous n’avions jamais le même concierge. Je ne sais pas si c’était un problème particulier de notre habitation, mais il y avait changement toutes les 2-3 heures. Promesses pas toujours tenues.
•	Nous n’avons pas pu avoir accès à tous les restaurants à la carte malgré une réservation le lendemain de notre arrivée. Système de réservation quelques fois en panne durant notre séjour.

reviews.author: SAWORLD
reviews.title: Hotel o złym stosunku jakości do ceny !
reviews.text:
Na wstępie dodam że byliśmy gośćmi z dopłatą do Royal Service i nie jestem pewien czy pokoje są jednakowe.
Hol po przyjeździe robił wrażenie, ale po przeglądnięcia się czystości , szczególnie foteli i podług w barze przy holu pojawiły się wątpliwości które okazały się później uzasadnione...

Pokoje:
Najbardziej zawiedliśmy się na czystości i wyposażeniu, oraz uzupełnianiu braków mini baru, kosmetyków i wody! Formuła All Inclusive ( % ) nie działa w pokojach ! W mini barkach tylko woda i napoje gazowane + lokalne piwo.
Wyciszenie pokoi bardzo złe!
Wielkość pokoi była ok, pokój wyposażony w podstawowe przybory w łazience ale o szlafroki trzeba było poprosić. Sejf , żelazko ( kiepskie ) były na stanie.
Ciągły problem w uzupełnianiu chusteczek czy kawy!

Obsługa:
Bardzo nastawiona na napiwki!
Nie ustępuje i nie przepuszcza gości przodem! Chodzą jakby byli w hotelu najważniejsi! Bardzo rzadko zdarzało się że ustępował ktoś na schodach w przejściu czy restauracji ...
Zdążają się oczywiście wyjątki i naprawdę bardzo miła obsługa - szczególnie Ci którzy znają już gościa.

All Inclusive 
Bary: 
Nie są zrobione atrakcyjnie ani zachęcająco, nie wiem czemu większość barów ma schowane butelki - chyba tylko po to aby nie było widać co można zamówić bo standardowo leją tanie alkohole jeśli się nie upomniał o markowe i importowane !
W zaopatrzeniu barów ciagle braki, szczególnie importowanych alkoholi! 
„Szampan” bo tak był przez obsługę nazywany nie był nawet winem musującym, a koktajlem owocowym na bazie wina (5% alkoholu) - okropne! Trzeba było za każdym razem mówić dokładnie co się chce bo wciskali ten tani sok!
Wino w formule All In. również nie dało się pić - podróbka wina z 8% zawartością alkoholu.
Pełno lodu zamiast drinka!
Dziwne bo naprawdę z innym podejściem formuła All In. mogła być uznana za całkiem na wysokim poziomie bo czasami dostępne importowane alkohole w większości są dobrej jakości. 

Restauracje:
Jedzenie słabe, a czystość i higiena pozdrawia wiele do życzenia!
Zdarzały się dania które warto było powtórzyć ale to były nieliczne przypadki.

Basen - brudny mimo że był niby sprzątany ! Płytki w narożnikach momentami czarne! Prysznic przy basenie nie działał przez ponad tydzień naszego pobytu ! Goście wchodzili do niego spoceni i brudni bo nie można było się opłukać!
Wrażenie robi wielkość głównego basenu.
Leżaków bardzo dużo zarówno na basenie i plaży, zawsze są jakieś wolne.

Plaża:
+ Bardzo szeroka z ładnym piaskiem.
- Sporo glonów, są zbierane z plaży ( ale nie regularnie ), wejście do wody mało przyjemne ze względu na glony.

reviews.author: kcarrow
reviews.title: Comparing to other Paradisus properties we have stayed out
reviews.text:
This is our third Paradisus hotel in 3 years that we have stayed out.  We have been to the one in Cancun, Cabo San Lucas, and now Punta Cana.  Of the 3 we have stayed out, this one is our lease favorite and I will describe why in a bit.

Pros:  Beautiful grounds and Pool at the hotel.  We went with Royal Service for the first time and that is the only reason we were happy with this property.  Our butler Alvaro ensured that we had nice surprises in our room for both a birthday and our anniversary during the week we stayed there.  He made all our dinner reservations and helped with reserving Bali Beds for us on the beach most days.  Most importantly, when our transportation back to the airport did not show up that Paradisus provided in our package, he stood with us until alternative transportation was provided.  He also tracked down the Scuba person at the pool that we had tried for days to find and stayed with us to take some pictures while we learned to Scuba dive in the pool.  We loved having access to the Palazzo restaurant and the food there was so much better than the other restaurants.  We enjoyed the nightly entertainment provided most nights as well.  Pedro was a breath of fresh air when we needed lounge chairs on the beach on the Royal Service side.  His enthusiasm and friendliness is what we expected from others but that was not the case.  I know management reads these and my recommendation would be to have other employees observe the way Pedro interacts with guests.  The wait staff at your restaurants (with the exception of Palazzo) would be the first ones I would put through it.

Cons:  Of the 3 Paradisus properties we stayed at, we found the employees to be the least friendly at this property, and the food was the worst.  The saving grace was the Palazzo restaurant which we went to for most meals but you have to have paid for Royal Service to go there.  We found it very odd that you could not get food at the pool area or the beach area as we were able to do that with the other Paradisus properties we stayed at.  Additionally, we were on our own for getting drinks on the beach about 80% of the time even with Royal Service.  We talked to some people who have been coming to this property for 12 years and they said it used to be 5 star service but it is sadly now 3 stars.  They said they believed it was due to newer management who has cut back on a lot of the help and the difference is dramatic.  The steak restaurant called "Rare" did not understand what the words medium rare meant even when I translated it to the Spanish.  Both times I ate there I got a steak that was Medium Well and was chewy.  We ate breakfast at NAOS twice and the food was awful.  They overcooked many items they had and some items were just inedible. They tasted like maybe they had been recooked or reheated over multiple days.  

As part of my package, I counted on the hotel for transportation back to the airport and was told the time I needed to be at the front lobby.  Nobody was there to take us back to the airport and no explanation was provided. Otium is the company they use and they are on property.  You shouldn't have to pay for Royal Service to have a great experience but having it was the only thing that made this a good overall experience for us.  This has really soured our desire to go back to another Paradisus as our experiences have gone downhill after the fabulous time we had at Paradisus Cancun and without Royal Service.  I am not writing this review to discourage others from going to this property, my main reason for writing this is with the hope that management will read this and make some changes.  I am only making my comparisons to other Paradisus properties I have stayed at which I think is very fair.

I know they claim to clean the seafweed off the beach daily but we did not see that.  We only saw it cleaned once in the week we were there.

reviews.author: Jeffrey J
reviews.title: 4th stay at a Meliá Paradisus resort in Royal Services first time in at Paradisus Punta Cana Real Spa Gulf Resort
reviews.text:
My wife and I have stayed at Melia Paradisus, Royal Service 3 other times in different locations, this was our first visit to this resort.
We both agree the beach is wonderful and the grounds are immaculate! The employees were wonderful especially Yenny, Miguel at Palazo. The service they gave us was top notch and we enjoyed our meals at Palazo. Kelvin, our butler met all of our needs and we were grateful for his service.
I was not impressed with the Royal Service lay out. Our room was far away from the Royal Service lounge and compared to our other stays the lounge was lackluster in accomadations. The Royal Service pool had a bar and that was it no food service which we have had during our other stays. There was very little service on the beach and if we wanted any drinks including water we were basically on our own to get them. Not what we expected or experienced at other Royal Service stays.
We were also surprised when we couldn’t eat at the Aqua Marina after paying for Royal Service and finding out it was only for Reserve quests and the menu looked good compared to other restaurants on the resort. 
We enjoyed our meals at the Palazo and Naos provided a good selection but were unimpressed with food at the other restaurants including Aqua at the reserve.
We have had good experiences in Mexico with Paradisus Resorts but I sorry to say I don’t think I’d pay what I did to come back to this resort. I think this is a Management, Melia issue and not the great staff that we met.
Beautiful location but needs improvement.

reviews.author: Javier Noble
reviews.title: Preocupacion
reviews.text:
Somos socios Melia hace unos años y ya he reportado varías opiniones sobre este hotel. Como somos asiduos, podemos dar una opinión en perspectiva en el periodo de tiempo que lo hemos visitado. Una primera situación que nos llamó la atención es que nunca recibimos un email,los días previos dándonos la bienvenida , deseándonos una buena estadía, y ofreciéndonos el traslado ( a costo nuestro), que siempre tomábamos. Otra cosa que nos llamó la atención es la disminución de gente que visita en esta oportunidad el hotel , tanto en La Reserve ( lugar para socios) así como también en la parte que no es para socios, lo cual puede tener su lado positivo, para aquellos no nos gustan los acúmulos de gente. En la Reserve nos explicaron algunos empleados que esta disminución se debe a la apertura de un nuevo hotel para socios Circle y muchos habían sido invitados este año a visitarlo, situación de ser cierta no se nos ofreció. Si hace 2 años ( tenemos una membresía bianual) se nos “ ofreció” una extensión de beneficios y pasar a el nuevo sistema CIRCLE con un costo extra bastante elevado, cosa que rechazamos.
Notamos varios cambios más, varios que ya habían sido notado por algunos otros usuarios en opiniones que leímos.
Por ej peor surtidos los frigobar de las habitaciones , impresionan estar “ ahorrando” , años anteriores tenias varios tipos de bebidas, este año no tenían cervezas y casi nada de snacks. También notamos poca variedad de comida en los restaurant buffet, desayunos menos surtidos, por ej años anteriores infaltable la botella de champágne para preparar con jugo de frutas ( muy consumido por europeos) , este año no había. Restaurant cerrados , por el el restaurant la Mole , cerrado durante el día, antes habría de día y de noche , el Restaurant el Grill cerrado algún día, etc.
El hotel sigue siendo bueno, sus empleados amables pero se nota un claro descenso de la calidad de sus servicios , preocupante para los que nos gusta visitarlo.

reviews.author: Kpenn24
reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text:
This our first time visiting DR. When we first arrived, we were impressed with the property. The staffs were very friendly. When we got to our room, we were surprised by the bed size. According to our travel agent, the beds in our rooms were queen beds not full size beds. We had 3 to 4 people per room and that false information made a big different. The bathroom situation was also pretty awkward. Instead of a wall, there was a curtain with a big gap on the corner. Our bathtub had missing cap on the side and two big screws hanging out. Every time we called to ask for something for the room, we ended up calling at least 3 times and waited for over an hour.  Just FYI, the water pressure in the bathroom was very low. We had trouble flushing our toilet.  
I have to say they did a really good job at the buffet restaurant, lots of choices for everyone to choose from. We all loved the buffet. We had a few reservations at the restaurants. Our first reservation was a mess and we ended up at the buffet. Our second reservation at Rare for 10 people ended up being for 2 according to them but they made it work and it was fantastic. I’d suggest making dinner reservations before you arrive if you can. NYE dinner in the ballroom was magnificent with wonderful presentation. NYE party was awesome, great Djs. Our family enjoyed the shows as well. We learned the best time to be in DR is spring break. It was a bit windy when we were there and the pool was a little too cold for me but the kids didn’t seem to care and had a blast.

reviews.author: ANFU18
reviews.title: Sem infra estrutura para bebês
reviews.text:
Passamos o último Ano novo no hotel, escolhemos o "The Reserve" pois entendemos que seria child friendly, mas não é.
 
O hotel é cheio de escadas, mesmo ficando na quarto térreo não há como chegar no restaurante ou recepção sem passar por escadas e consequentemente ter que levar o carrinho na mão. Não consigo entender como fazem um hotel sem oferecer um mínimo de acessibilidade para carrinhos e cadeiras de rodas.

Falta trocadores para bebês, a area dos restaurantes fica distante dos quartos, sem trocadores próximos, somente pegando um trem (que demora 10 min ou mais para passar) ou andando mais de 10 minutos a pé. Passamos por uma situação constrangedora onde tive que trocar a fralda da minha filha, e me vi tendo que tirar uma fralda suja da minha filha no lobby do restaurante, no meio de todo mundo.

Já ficamos em hotéis 4 estrelas, com serviços inferiores que o hotel oferecia coisas básicas para bebês, como micro ondas, leites, papinhas, etc.

A televisão do quarto parou de funcionar no meio da viagem, ligamos diversas vezes na recepção, falaram que viriam trocar a televisão e nunca trocaram. 

É um bom hotel, mas definitivamente, não para bebês e tampouco 5 estrelas para adulto e se você tiver problema de locomoção, não vá.

reviews.author: Alvaro
reviews.title: Correcto.
reviews.text:
Después de pasar  7 días en familia, 6 adultos y 4 niños, hemos disfrutado y pasado una agradable estancia. 
Las instalaciones del hotel, piscinas, kids zone, el gabi, gabi beach, buffet de playa y la playa muy bien.
Las habitaciones bien, amplias,  un poco antiguas, tv,  sanitarios y duchas de finales de los 90,el sofa cama para el niño un poco incomodo, minibar y cafetera, sin cuberteria pero correctas. Al fin y al cabo, cumplen de sobra su función con una agradable terraza, allí no necesitas tele y se descansa bien, ell WiFi muy bueno.
El personal muy simpáticos, el servicio en la piscina y en la barra del Gabi muy bien, en el restaurante también muy bien.
Puntos negativos, el transporte caotico, la playa esta lejos the reserve y la frecuencia de paso de trenes es muy baja. 15-30 min la media cada día en subir y/o bajar de la playa, parada en paradisus, vuelta, paradisus, playa.. fácil solución incorporando un par de trenes en temporada alta, tuvimos que sufrirlo.
La eleccion de restaurantes un caos, el primer día debes elegir donde cenar cada día por que esta todo ocupado y las horas libres son las 18h o las 21h, siempre tienes los buffets libres por supuesto, el huésped debe planificarse para encajar con el planning del hotel, bastante incomodo para una familia por la poca disonibilidad.
La comida, mal, no me vale eso de que no se va al Caribe a comer, he estado en otros hoteles del caribe y comimos mucho mejor, la comida es muy muy floja.
En definitiva no vale el precio que pagamos, la baja calidad de la comida y el caos de transporte son los culpables, por lo demás se pasa de maravilla y aun con esos inconvenientes se disfruta mucho, como en todo el caribe, no repetiremos pero guardaremos un grato recuerdo.

reviews.author: Brooklyn Dad
reviews.title: Good family destination, but issues to be aware of
reviews.text:
We stayed here from 12/24 through 12/31 in the master 1 bedroom with family concierge service and overall had a good time at the Reserve, but wanted to pass along our observations for future family travelers given the cost and other largely positive reviews. If you're reading quickly, the main take-home is: if you are a foodie or selective eater, you *will not* be happy here -- the food is *bad*. (Speaking to my fellow spoiled Brooklynites here.)

Pros: The hotel is a quick jump from the airport and arrival was made very easy. Our family concierge was very helpful throughout the week in booking restaurants and the pool cabana, which was luxurious and terrific. With two kids under 10 the pool was our go-to and we spent many happy hours there. There are activities at pool-side and the kids club - while we didn't use it much - appeared to be well-run and was stocked with snacks for the kids and some things to do, though mostly meant for kids under 8 (and especially designed for kids under 5 I would say). 
- Service-wise, the pool-side attendants were very accommodating. 
- The hotel is close to good activities nearby. We had one of the most incredible experiences of our lives at Dolphin Discovery 15 minutes away. (10 Stars - Highly Highly Recommended!)

Cons: 
- Be aware that unless you book a pool-facing room, you will be facing a *road* - not a garden, there is no garden - on which golf carts and small trucks pass several times an hour all throughout the day and into the night. You *will* hear them. This resort is narrow and very long, and the reserve is completely surrounded on both sides by these roads. We had booked a garden room and insisted on moving to pool-facing, which they thankfully did accommodate.
- The rooms are showing their age. The king bed is nice and the bathrooms great (though the showers take some experimentation to figure out how to work, as they are European-designed), but the pull-out couch for our kids, while it worked, was very flimsy and cheap. No adult could comfortably sleep there.
- Main headline, fellow travelers: The food here is simply bad. There is no other word for it. The buffet meals are clearly designed to look attractive for the camera but we found them to be largely inedible. I personally ate only things cooked fresh on the grill - mostly plain meat & fish w/no pre-seasoning - and my family subsisted on bread and pastry (not at all good or fresh), boxed cereal and fruit. The salad bar was minimal and strange for a US palate, the pre-made entrees were vile-looking, the baked goods stale and tasteless, and the desserts universally awful. I am not someone who goes in looking to criticize; I'm writing this because we spent a lot of money on this trip and the buffet food was a nightmare. The restaurant food was *slightly* better: decent meals were had at The Grill and Fuego, halfway decent hibachi, but otherwise truly bad. Again, if you are a foodie or expect any kind of eating experience, you must stay away, really. This almost ruined our trip.
- The resort is so large that to get to the beach and most restaurants, you need to take a golf cart or trolley that comes around irregularly every 10-15 minutes. Even for New Yorkers used to walking, this was annoying, especially late at night with kids after a meal or event. The place is just massive.

Neither pro nor con:
- Service-wise: we found most staff at the hotel to be helpful and kind and friendly to families with kids, of which there were many. 
- Amenities-wise, with two small kids we didn't do too much so I cannot comment on most of the activities. The beach-side Cirque show was good, some of the other programming looked decent. There is one small shop to buy provisions, not very well-stocked. (No rash guards for a child? No shorts for an adult man?) The pool wasn't stocked with toys but they were available for purchase and parents mostly shared.
- The beach was beautiful-looking but we couldn't use it the whole week because it was so windy and sand blew everywhere. Not the hotel's fault, but a risk to be aware of.

Overall, we had a good trip in DR but if we hadn't upgraded to a pool-side room it would have been a disaster, and the food almost killed it.

reviews.author: Climber56614995063
reviews.title: Just an okay vacation spot
reviews.text: Beautiful location and resort. Hotel beautiful, rooms okay. Room towels dingy and snacks/beverages never automatically replaced , without asking, which was part of the elite package that I paid for, at least I thought.Butler service awesome. Resort Staff , outside of the butler service much  less attentive than any other vacation spot ever visited. The food was subpar and less than average. First night they advertised a lobster buffet, only for us to find out upon arrival to dinner, that the menu had changed. The items on the menu were awful. Went to bed hungry and woke up to have a less than average, visually unappealing  breakfast at the buffet. I did not have one full meal that I enjoyed during my stay.I also felt that there was too many sales panhandlers on the beach. We could not sit and talk for five minutes without someone interrupting you to sell you something, making for an uncomfortable “vacation “ experience.

reviews.author: Dana H
reviews.title: The real truth- Days 1-3
reviews.text:
As an avid traveler, I want to give anyone considering coming to this the real truth about This resort for the first few days of our visit. I am traveling with my husband and two daughters in their 20s. The lobby and grounds are very impressive. Grand. Most Staff at guest services and front desk have great attitude. 

I like to make dinner reservations And advance of a vacation so I don’t have to deal with it while on vacation. This cannot happen at this resort As their system only allows you to book Monday through Monday. Upon arrival on Saturday,  all 10 sit down restaurants beyond buffet were full. I had emailed with my request early and there was no response or reservations made so I need to spend hours dealing with this upon arrival. Guest services (Yicel) was understanding But did not remedy the situation until Sunday. They did give us a complimentary reservation at the Grill which was delicious And finally booked all of our reservations for us which was appreciative. Highly recommend you make dinner reservations the entire time is the buffet gets old fast. 

We had 2 rooms and were promised that they would split the beds for her daughters but it never happened. When anything doesn’t work in the room ( like our TV or bed broke), they make empty promises- say they will come in 15 minutes but it never happened until the next day.

Most of the staff does not speak English so cannot answer any questions that you have. Many times they say yes to make you happy but do not follow through because they either didn’t understand you or can’t make your request happen. The most frustrating experience so far is the responsiveness that staff has any requests made. 

When it rains and towels need to be replaced, The towel shack doesn’t have them for like an hour. I recommend that hotel understand when these things happen but guess want to be able to get towels pretty quicklyWhen the weather clears up.

The minibar in the room only includes shelf wine and beer. The 1000 resort credit includes $500 of shopping coupons at a nearby mall and $500 of various coupons.  So if you want to massage the cost is around $200 and you can only use one coupon of $30 towards that.

Pool area is nice and if you want to sit by the pool you need to be out by 6:30- 7 am to save a spot. The beach is more open and has seats past 9 am. We sit at beach which has nice soft sand. Surf is high and weather is windy. 

Yoga and Pilates is complimentary at wellness center at higher prices Reserve sister property and beautiful setting. Highly recommend it. Take short shuttle over there. The gym is small and treadmills are usually all booked up him in the morning. So we would run to the gate and back and throughout the properties nice pathways.

Shelf alcohol is a problem but the Dominican rum and Diet Coke’s are good. Not good vodka. 

New Year’s Eve is tonight and I will do an update at the end of our trip!

reviews.author: Jordan W
reviews.title: Failed to meet expectations
reviews.text: Beautiful grounds, spacious rooms, and wonderful beach, but service throughout is inconsistent. Restaurant reservations were difficult and food below average. Royal service was worth it just for the less crowded beach and pool. Butler service was disappointing. Best part was the beach attendant Rafael who performed at the highest level. From having beach couches and chairs ready every morning and offered drinks throughout the stay. Bartender Wanda was also exceptional. Hostess at Rare also very attentive during hectic Christmas-New Year’s week. Queen cover band was terrific.

reviews.author: tkhanna
reviews.title: great facilities but experience moderated by management inattention
reviews.text: the facilities and food were great at the resort, as was attitude of most folks working there. but management needs upgrading. there are many system wide failures that are easily corrected, but no one appears accountable. (simplest examples - getting a restaurant reservation at resort is a chore, and no one warns you up front of how much planning is needed!;  it's hard to get towels on the beach, the simplest logistical exercise that we brought to their notice but they refused to resolve for days)

reviews.author: Flyer41121128700
reviews.title: Prewinter
reviews.text: Purpose of trip was total rest and relaxation.  Beach vendors were very aggressive and I had to get into a shouting match one day to be left alone.  Sold a massage and was misinformed about price.  25% discount (for the day).  We had a 50 dollar credit that was to be applied (and wasn't) and they neglected to mention 18.5% sales tax.  Service given was much cheaper in United States and I wouldn't have purchased.  Our attendant at the beach was phenomenal - couldn't have had better.  Breakfast was excellent.  Dinners were hit or miss.  Hibatchi was good/fun.  Golf was rushed.

reviews.author: STLfans
reviews.title: Fought for Four Stars for Christmas Trip
reviews.text:
We are in our late thirties with two boys, 12 and 9.  This was our 7th time to the DR total, half with kids and half without.  This was our first time at this resort.  I have tried to hit most subjects here.  I will say we usually stay at the number 1 to 5 resorts listed on here.
