We wouldn't return to this one again, but it was okay if you want a good price and can afford to upgrade to the Reserve or just pay for Reserve access.  We got a "deal" for Christmas.

Preview - This trip began with an email for us to upgrade our room from a Junior Suite to a room at the Reserve.  We had previously stayed at the Palma Real Reserve and had a swim up suite.  We would definitely go there again and not here.  After sending back an email to negotiate the room from 180 to 150 extra a night, two hours later they emailed back and said that there were no rooms available.  On a mission, I called at least 20 times over the next week leading up to our trip and they kept saying they were overbooked even though I agreed to the 180.  Fine.  I get it.  It is Christmas, but then don't offer a room to me and not hold it at least for an hour so I can communicate with you!

Arrival - We got there and were "upgraded" and paid 1000 for a room that was supposed to be part of the Reserve by the beach, but was not.  It was spacious (actually two rooms with a living room), had a partial kitchen, but only had 2 full size beds (smaller than queens) after I had specifically requested a king bed for my husband and I who are both 6 ft tall.  Our two boys are also 5'5 and 5'7 and we had to order roll away beds.  Although the couches did pull out, I couldn't imagine that they would be comfortable as the room was over 20 years old.  The Reserve is newer and more modern from our previous experience at the Palma Real.  This room was old, the air-conditioner didn't work well, and the door lock kept catching and it wouldn't close half of the time.  It had two bathrooms though, which was nice.

Customer Service - some people helped right away and some people never came.  We waited 24 hrs for the second roll away bed for my other son after travelling all day and being exhausted.  After travelling to the DR seven times, this is the only time we have been unhappy with a resort's customer service.  Tips are helpful, but there was more of a language barrier here than anywhere we have ever stayed and we do speak a little Spanish.  It just seemed like every time we called for something, we would get transferred around, especially calling from the US.  Don't bother.

Beach - nice.  Barely any seaweed, no rocks, and beautiful water.  Since we did have Reserve access, we were allowed on the nicer section of the beach with covered beds and pillows.  The regular side did not have this!  Beware if you don't have Reserve access.  Believe me, you kind of get what you pay for.  If you pay for the Reserve, you get access to the beach bar and the waiters, who are awesome and come around every 10 mins.  Best beach service and bartenders on a beach ever.  The beds on the beach are plentiful and shaded, but only if you pay for the Reserve.  You can ask for access for 70/day if you aren't able to upgrade your room.  

Restaurants - Excellent...when you can get a reservation.  We were told when we arrived that the restaurants were mostly booked.  They are small and there aren't enough of them for this large of a resort.  They are usually very half empty and if you show up around 9, you can ask to go in.  We complained several times and finally got reservations.  I did make reservations over the phone the day before we came, but I didn't know which restaurants to book or which ones would be good, so it was difficult. That being said, the food was very tasty for a resort.  The best restaurants are Vento, Fuego (amazing sushi), Banya (Japanese style---fought for three days to get reservations at least once there), and The Grill, which is barbeque (awesome steaks and ribs Dominican style).  Stay away from the Gabi beach buffet.  It is horrible.  There isn't even real orange juice.  If you want fresh squeezed, order room service. The breakfast buffet at the Reserve part was very good.  They made fresh omelettes and the food was more fresh in general and tasty.  Again, if we didn't have the Reserve benefits, breakfast would have been horrible every day.  

The Pool - great, but it was winter in the DR, so it was chilly.  This was the biggest disappointment of all and has nothing to do with the hotel, but since I saw that the weather is always 82, I assumed they didn't have a winter.  I personally like warmer swimming water, and I barely swam.  December water in Punta Cana is cold.  It took getting used to, and some days were cloudy so I didn't even get it in.  The kids didn't mind, but the women I met and I did.  The pool was large and very nice though.  In the pictures, it looks like there are hot tubs, but there aren't.  That would have been nice.  Heated pools would have been ever nicer.

The Spa -  We did not book a service, but we went to use the hot tubs.  The hot tubs were luke warm (wishing the pool was the same temp), and the ladies weren't pleased to see us since we had not paid for a service.  They told us that they didn't have towels after they found out we hadn't booked a service, but we said we'd drip dry and we didn't care.  We did find towels in the bathroom, so that was not true.  

Babysitting - the hotel has babysitters and a nice kids club.  If your kids are older and just want to stay in the hotel room, I would suggest a private sitter.  They will bring games to play with the kids and are very nice.  For two kids, the charge is 25 an hour, but it is worth it.

The Casino - Fun.  We played roulette a few nights and won some.  The casino is smaller, but it has great music and fun people.  There is a 5 dollar minimum on roulette.  Remember to tell your credit card company that you are going out of the country or they will not let you take out money there since it is a casino.  That happened to us, and it took a twenty minute phone call and a day to process.

The Property - outwardly beautiful and well-maintained--again our room was very 90s, but I am unsure of how an actual Reserve room would have been instead of what we got.  It was decorated so well for Christmas, with the bases of the palm trees in white lights and several Christmas trees around the property.

Christmas Celebrations - Being there for Christmas on the beach was fun.  There was a Santa booth set up on the beach and the entertainment staff dressed up like elves that took pictures of you.  We just got one with our phone, and they didn't mind.  Every kid got a gift.  My boys are 9 and 12, and my nine year old got Jenga (came in handy with the babysitters), and my twelve  year old got a proper wooden baseball and a bat.  Nice touch. 

Liquor - top shelf --very nice, but the clear liquors seem watered down a lot.   My husband's Jack Daniel's was always fine, just like at every other nice resort, but my Vodka, as usual, was watered down everywhere except for in the casino and at the Reserve Beach Bar on the beach.  If you want a real clear drink, go to those places.  If you drink dark liquor, that is all fine.  They cannot water that down without people noticing the color.  Again, I have been to the number one resorts in Mexico and the DR several times, and this is always the case.  I am a drinker, so I know my stuff.  

Weather - mostly 82, cloudy, some rain on some days for an hour or so, very windy --we usually travel between April and July when it is hot and you cannot lay out for more than 20 mins at a time without dying to get in the water.  This was not the case.  We laid out in the sun, mostly on an uncovered bed and were really comfortable without ever getting in the water.  I personally like it hotter and wouldn't return again in the winter.  

Price - we paid 3470 for the four of us for a Junior Suite and then 1,000 upgrade to the old room with Reserve privileges and beach access.  This was an awesome price at Christmas and we booked 6 months in advance on Expedia and then used points from our airline to fly.  I would definitely recommend booking 6 months in advance as prices were close to 700 a night within two weeks of our trip.  

Crowd - very classy crowd mostly from other countries (non-US).  No complaints there.  Polite folks.  

Overall -  I am very glad we only stayed five days since we were unhappy with the room, the service, and the water was chilly so we weren't all in the pool or ocean a ton.  I am glad we went, but I would rather stay at the sister resort at the Reserve with kids and the Iberostar Grand without kids.  True 5 star resorts.  Without the Reserve, you will get about a 3 star experience here.  Ours was about 3 and a half.  

Suggestions - answer the phone when people call and have the employees follow through with requests and don't transfer people to different departments, require better English speakers at the hotel for English speaking guests, put more covered areas on the regular part of the beach, make the whole hotel a pleasant stay even if guests don't have Reserve access, make the regular buffet better for guests who don't upgrade so all guests can enjoy it.  If you treat all guests well, not just the ones who pay more and upgrade, the review would have been very good and this would be a five star resort.  Make more restaurants for this huge hotel so people have a chance to have the food they paid for and not "mediocre to okay" buffet food.

reviews.author: Abigail P
reviews.title: Should (and could) be better for the price
reviews.text:
Though we had a wonderful time overall with great friends, and though the beach itself is lovely, this resort is missing so many beats that I could not recommend it unless the hotel owners improve things soon.  At breakfast you will sit forever before getting coffee poured, and then it will be poured hastily by staff who seem overworked and annoyed to have to do this task.  (The coffee itself should also be better.) The food at every meal is just average and the buffet starts to look tired and sad after hours of sitting there.  Maybe because everything is all-inconclusive, there is no quality liquor behind the bar, and it tastes as if they’ve even watered down the vodka and tequila to save money.  On the beach, you are only allotted one towel per person, and though the towel staff will begrudgingly give you two if you ask, they’ll warn you gravely that you won’t get another one unless you return them at the end of the day.  I should mention a major positive: the hotel concierge, Juan Castillo, was absolutely wonderful and attentive. 
The fitness gym is actually very pleasant, but a close look at the exercise machines will show you that they’ve let them go without repair — an elliptical handle is torn, a bike pedal cage is missing, a water holder on another bike is also missing, the metal parts are rusty.  Half-way through the busiest week of the year — Xmas to New Years — the gym staff removed one of three elliptical machines. That just felt like a metaphor for the resort.  Our actual room was very gracious with a beautiful view of the water, and the housekeeping staff was very kind and hard-working, but for some reason the hotel has designed the closets so they open INTO the drawers and vice versa, so you are inevitably scraping the paint off as you get dressed.  In general, this could be (and our friends tell us it WAS) a very nice resort with good food and attentive staff, and the resort IS largely very lovely to look at, but our experience was so mixed as to weight it to the disappointing column.

reviews.author: Brian G
reviews.title: Good but not great
reviews.text:
It's hard to really say anything bad or anything really great about this resort because it kinda falls in the middle on most points.  The property is nice and clean.  There are a tons of bars, so getting your free drinks is very easy and rarely any wait.  The buffet is huge, but bigger isn't necessarily better.  The breakfasts were pretty bad while the lunches and dinners were fine.  I've had better buffets at other resorts, but this one is fine.  The service at the buffet was a bit poor, however.  Usually took forever to get water or other drinks - waiters often forgot orders.

There are many restaurants that are open for dinner, but getting reservations is difficult.  None of the restaurants were anything too exciting (hey, they're all free), but some were  better than others.  The steak restaurant "Rare" was *horrible* - while the others were generally better, but not exactly high cuisine.  The pool is big, but unheated and there's no hot tub.  The water in the pool was downright freezing when we were there over Christmas, so I only got in it once or twice and for short periods that I could tolerate.  It was also surprisingly deep everywhere - there's no shallow end.  It goes from steps to tippy-toes-deep instantly.  Most of the time was spent on a lounge chair instead.

The grounds are very nice, but still, I've seen better.  No "wow!" factor, just very nice grounds.  Rooms are decent enough, but we had some issues like a leaking toilet that would run all night long.  Actually, two of our family's rooms had this issue.  I told the front desk but it never got fixed.  Also, a bit of lack of privacy in the bathroom as the bathroom is separated from the bedroom by a large curtain.  That means you hear everything, and if someone needs to use the toilet in the middle of the night the entire bedroom lights up from the lights in the bathroom. 

The energy level of the resort seemed a bit low.  Very few of the staff ever showed much enthusiasm.  The only one who did was the guy who would refill our snacks and mini-fridge every day.  He was always in a great mood, but the waiters, bartenders, etc. all seemed really low-energy and rarely smiled.  This may be more of a Dominican Republic thing than a resort thing because it seems everyone in the DR is a little low energy compared with other island destinations.  Nobody on that island seems particularly happy.

So, this is a nice resort, but I've definitely stayed at better.  Would I recommend it?  Probably not - I'd say try another one.  But is anything really bad?  Just the lack of a heated pool - the rest is just fine.

reviews.author: Andrew G
reviews.title: 6 Night Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed in a suite which was clean and far more updated than the rooms other family members stayed in. The showers are quite difficult to operate and we could never get one of them to make hot water. When we arrived the toilet seat was literally disconnected from the toilet leaning up against the wall. We needed maintenance to come repair a bathtub which wouldn’t hold water. The room of a family member had water leaking from the ceiling after a rain.  The staff were inconsistent about replenishing items in the room requiring a phone call request which eventually led to us getting what we needed.

The grounds of the resort are very pretty and well maintained. There are some nice areas where you can sit and relax. The pools are extremely cold making swimming very unpleasant. It is necessary to get up early in effort to reserve chairs or you will likely have no place to sit. The staff are good about coming around and offering drinks in the pool area. It can be difficult getting towels as they run out. They also make you show a card in order to get one towel per card. The pool area does not have a hot tub which seems strange for a resort.

There are quite a few restaurant options. Unfortunately, you are basically stuck with buffets for breakfast and lunch as the restaurants are only open for dinner. When we arrived for dinner we were initially told there were no opening for any restaurants during our stay. They did try to sell us for the upcharged beach dinner. After expressing displeasure and asking to speak with a manager there were miraculously openings for us. The restaurant experiences varied from pretty good to awful regarding the food. All of the restaurants are quite pretty inside. The buffets gets packed and it is often very difficult to find a chair. Families often have to walk around looking for a table. Typically when you do find a table it will be dirty because others just left so you will be waiting there for staff to clean the table which can take a long time. The service at the buffet was quite poor. We would often not get the drinks we ordered or if we did we wouldn’t get them until our meal was basically over.

The bars are easily accessible and won’t take long to get a drink. The staff are friendly and will get you what you need. Unfortunately, the beer, wine and liquor they have to work with are very low quality.  After drinking a few you might not mind that the booze is bottom shelf. 

The beach is pretty with no issue finding chairs. There are friendly staff who will come buy offering drinks. During our visit the beach was covered with seaweed. There are people trying to sell you things everywhere on the beach. Only a couple minutes will pass before you will asked about purchasing an excursion, photographs, jewelry, sun glasses or cigars.

Overall, the resort is clean and has very nice decor. The eating options are limited as 2/3 of your meals will be at a buffet which tires easily. The restaurants vary significantly in quality. The pools are ok but it would be nice if there was a hot tube or an area specifically made for kids. It seems like the rooms varied quite a bit in how updated they were. We had a nice trip because we were with family and the issues we encountered did not stop us from enjoying ourselves. It is not a resort I would recommend or choose to go back too.

reviews.author: Slava1226
reviews.title: Terrible Service, Run down rooms
reviews.text: It was our second stay at Palma Real Resort, but the experience was not nearly the same to say the least.  We have paid 10k for the family of 4, however the service at the buffet and restaurants was awful. The staff was not able to serve the amount of guests at the hotel. Extremely long wait to be seated, serve the table, to get coffee, water and etc. Bars refuse to serve good quality alcohol. Impossible to make reservations at various restaurants. Everything was fully booked on the day we have arrived. Finally, they have accommodated our family to serve food from one of the restaurants at the buffet. But out of the whole menu they decided to serve one entree and one appetizer without asking us what we want. My request to order different items from the menu was refused. There were never enough clean beach towels. The room amenities are unsatisfactory. The shower constantly changes from cold to hot on its own. The clean towels are not left in the room. I had too look for the housekeeping staff to get clean sets of towels. The rooms needs to be renovated, everything is old and broken. Beach lounge chairs need to be replaced, majority are broken and uncomfortable. Overall, will not come back.

reviews.author: Rob Payne
reviews.title: Entertainment, What entertainment
reviews.text: This resort is my favorite resort. It was any way, Service again is very good, friendly staff and excellent people. But what happened to the music and the entertainment around the pools in the day time. It's disappointing to know that you need to bring a blue tooth speaker to have any music. This is crazy!!. I am a member and review so many Melia brand hotels and cam honestly say that this lack of entertainment and music around the pools in the day time is a constant complaint on almost every Melia resort I review. Cmon management time to up your game, members buy in and every year the entertainment is less and less.

reviews.author: brucebU3797CF
reviews.title: Need to update rooms and resort.
reviews.text: This was our 6th time in seven years at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We have seen in the last 2 years they have have done a lot of cut backs. One being the mini bar snacks...the water when entering The Reserve. Just not the same vibe we have experienced in our past visits . The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana needs an update. At the Hyero bar at the pool has tiles missing on the roof. The burgers had a funky color liked they added ingredients to save on cost of quality beef!!!

reviews.author: TrangDo
reviews.title: Overall good resort with certain drawbacks
reviews.text:
We are a family of 5 (3 adults + a 3 and a 1 year old) stayed at this resort from Nov. 7 to Nov. 14 and we got 2 rooms #2361 and #2363 2nd floor facing the kids pool. This was my first time in the DR but we're not new to the all inclusive concept. I've been to multiple ones the past few years so I'll be very straightforward with my review. Because we have small kids, our priorities are a little different compared to single folks. The stay was overall a good experience, but not exceptional and here's why. 

Pros 1. The property: the ground is beautiful and very well kept. 
          2. Service: everyone is so welcoming and genuinely friendly. This is what makes up for whatever department the resort is lacking. Treat them well Melia because you guys are lucky to have such wonderful staffs working for you.  The resort was adequately staffed as far as I can see during my 8 days stay. Not even one staff looked stressed out or in a hurry. They seemed to really enjoy their work which is always a great sign. 
          3. The food: After reading the reviews about food and because food quality is quite high on my list, it did not disappoint. The Reserve buffet Gabi Club food is of good quality although the selection is rather small. I am one of a few who enjoyed the buffet much more than the seat in restaurants, even the highly raved The Grill. Mole was good, The Grill was alright depending on what you order. We ordered rib eye and the meat was so chewy that it almost inedible. We also ordered flank steak and skirt steak and they were on the drier side, slightly overcooked. We tried every single restaurant on the property and their food quality was decent. As for an all inclusive resort, the food was decent, not too bad, not amazingly good either, somewhere right in the middle. While we’re on the restaurant topic, stay away from Bana at all cost. It was the most uncomfortable meal of my life. We were seated with 6 other people for a teppanyaki type of dinner and we were the only party with younger kids so apparently we took a lot longer to finish our food than the rest, and everyone had to wait for us to finish ours before the next course is served. While everyone tried not to look at us or pretended to play on their phones, knowing there are other people around waiting and looking when you eat just kills the appetite big time. 
We did not find dinner reservation difficult. We spoke with Guest Service at the building lobby and they were able to set us up with dinner reservation for the rest of the stay. 
Now off to the negative part:  
2. The room: the rooms were dated and appeared run down. Both TVs remote controls weren't even working properly. The TVs were so old that the screens were grainy. The couch in the living are looked pretty beat up and dirty probably was never cleaned ever. No toilet paper holder in the bathroom so they placed the toilet rolls on top of the water tank so appearance wise, the rooms aren’t up to the standard, let alone being a five star as boasted. 
There’s a coffee machine in the kitchenette with ground coffee and creamer but no spoon so good luck making your own coffee in the room. The scale in the bathroom broke and so did the hairdryer. Asked guest service and they said to bring us new one the next day. Also they need to provide every room with a stool if the family has toddlers. The first 2 nights we had to lift our 3-year-old up when brushing teeth because she’s too short for the sinks. Here’s the highlight of my trip. One of the nights my husband intentionally left the door to the balcony open for some fresh air. Little did we know that a cat got into our room overnight and peed/pooped onto our stuffs and OMG the entire room stink so bad we couldn’t even breath. We talked to Guests Service and they took our stuff away for cleaning but the smell lingered for days. So disgusting !!!  And there were cats were running around in the restaurants as well. The cat ‘s ordeal was over and a roach decided to visit us to keep the story going. On our 5th day my husband found a roach crawling in our bathroom and he squashed it. When we raised our concern with the Guest Service personnel and he went "this is not supposed to happen" well, the fact is it did happen and they were pretty indifferent or could care less about it. How is this considered a 5 star resort where basic sanitary is lacking. 
3. Amenities: the kids zone is okay. The brochure said they have certain activities for older kids but went there 3 times and did not see any activities besides a TV with movies running for older kids. The best part about it is that they watch your kids for you and you can leave to have some childless time for yourself. Their time is 10am-7pm. The pools are fine. I’m not in love with the design of The Reserve pool. The Cabanas by the kids pool are all taken by 9am every morning cause there are only a few and they’re hard to come by. Management needs to do something about people reserving the spot by Family Concierge but never showed up. Also management needs to replace beach chairs/towels. They’re very worn out.
4. The buggy ride stopped by the Reserve randomly, not every 10/15 mins as said/scheduled. If we didn’t have 2 young kids who loved buggy rides so much we would rather walk because we would get around faster on foot than waiting for the ride to come by. The instruction where to wait for the ride is inconsistent. Sometimes they’d say the building’s lobby, sometimes they’d point at the hut about 20 steps from the building lobby. There were times when we had to walk back and forth between those 2 places to catch a ride or chase them down on foot because no one seemed to stop at the Reserve building 36/37 lobby to pick up guests.

All in all, the stay was not bad, we just felt like for the price we paid and what was advertised, we expected more. Will we consider going back? Probably not until they renovate the rooms which they say will happen in 2019.

reviews.author: Dream754946
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Decent Food, Poor Service
reviews.text: The grounds and beach are beautiful and the pool is great.  The food was decent overall, some meals were very good, some were just OK.  The food at Passion was excellent, but of course that costs extra.  The service, however, was mediocre at best.  The staff were very friendly for the most part.  The issue is clearly that they are understaffed in many areas, disorganized, and uninformed.  This is a clear issue of poor management.  I would almost go back just for the beach, pool, and grounds alone, but the level of service would probably cause me to go elsewhere.

reviews.author: pandccoppola
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star Resort
reviews.text:
It is always difficult for me to give a less than good rating.  In this case, I have no choice.  My wife and I booked this resort with 5 other couples.  Four of us requested room changes after the first night.  The rooms we were assigned were the most remote rooms on the resort.  In addition, they were dirty, one had no hot water, the door to our room was half off the hinges, the décor was dated along with many other problems.  Did I mention we were all seniors?
The day after moving our rooms, the rooms we originally occupied were torn apart and were being rehabbed.  We were told the resort was 50-60 % occupied.  There was no good reason for assigning us these rooms.
Now for the "average" part.  The food was just OK.  The buffet rarely changed.  In the reservations required restaurants the food was barely average.  In the high end steak restaurant, 4 people found their rib eye steaks too tough to chew.  We made reservations to restaurants on the resort with our personal concierge and in all but 1 instance they managed to mess those up, wrong time, wrong number of people.
Staff always managed a "good day" when we passed them in the halls.  Just don't make a request.  I could go on with everything that fell short of their promises and our expectations.
Fortunately we were all good friends and laughed at these misadventures.  There are many 5 star resorts in Punta Cana.  This is not one of them.

reviews.author: LanceMannion
reviews.title: Royal Service section very good, main section service was inconsistent
reviews.text:
Royal Service: the service was very good, especially Martin on the beach, Yoel our Butler, and the hostess at Palazzo most mornings (her name began with a Y). The room was nice albeit a bit outdated. I can not understand why they build some of these resort hotel rooms with a partially open wall between the bathroom and the rest of the room. In this hotel if you turn on the bathroom lights there is no way to shield some of the bright lights from shining on the bed where your partner may be sleeping, or trying to sleep. And if you are with someone that you would rather not see naked if will take some very conscious planning (your kids, a sister, etc.) as there are sizable gaps that can not be sealed.

In the main part of the hotel where the bulk of the restaurants are, service was spotty. Some great staff, and some pretty poor service. Some meals no one would refill water or coffee, service in Vento was outright BAD and several people we met said the same about Vento. No Chardonnay at all anywhere at the resort.

Wifi coverage was excellent everywhere, including on the beach.

The Beach is great!  Soft sand, swimmable water, nice for long walks. Pools were very nice. Overall, the facilities are beautiful, just the service is mixed. I am comparing this to Paradisus Playa Del Carmen where the facilities ar enot as beautiful but better maintained and the service by staff has been consistently outstanding on separate visits.

reviews.author: J_WN
reviews.title: Royal Service a MUST-3.5 Star Rating Because of Food
reviews.text:
We booked our 12 day holiday through Costco travel and enjoyed a hassle free airport transfer to and from the hotel. We also booked the Royal Service experience as it was recommended by other reviewers on Tripadvisor. Check-in was a breeze, our accommodations were clean and comfortable. Alvaro Fernandez was our butler, he was fantastic! He walked us through the hotel services, restaurants, and amenities and took note of any special requests we had to make our stay more enjoyable. We strongly suggest booking your restaurant experiences with your butler the day of or following your arrival. The Royal Service pool and beach were lovely, clean, and beautifully kept..Alvaro reserved a cabana and sun bed for us the day prior to our requests for pool time, which was wonderful! Wanda (bartender) at the Royal pool bar was wonderful, her drinks are fabulous and fresh.

Our other favorite bar to grab a truly special cocktail was in the upper lobby; Edison and Lillian were our bartenders and they surprised us with unique and expertly mixed cocktails, we will miss them! :-)

On to the not so great dining and otherwise experiences (the reason for our 3 star instead of 4 star review) during our otherwise lovely and relaxing vacation.

The food at the buffet was mediocre at very best. 

The steak at RARE was terrible and inedible, I can’t remember when I have had a less desirable cut of ribeye (maybe never), and my husband’s lobster (he was willing to pay the $40 upcharge), although beautiful in presentation, was also inedible.

The food at Vento was terrible and tasted rancid. We were seated near the glass encased kitchen and noticed the chefs pulling food from catering warmers covered in foil (see photo) and reheating everything...nothing that we could see was cooked to order and it tasted as such. We barely ate any of our appetizers or entrees and left after only 15 minutes.

Nightlife here is abysmal and either too loud music or none at all. :-D

On to the BETTER food options and the restaurants we loved! ALL of our preferred restaurants would not have been available if not for Royal Service, hence the recommendation. Please keep in mind that regardless of the quality of food, the service at ALL of the restaurants was wonderful and accommodating!

Passion was our favorite, best to order the complete tasting and wine pairing (not included with hotel package but worth the expense) for the full experience. My husband and I are foodies, so smaller portions and better quality are appreciated and we truly enjoyed the meal from start to finish!

Aqua was also very good (Royal Service only), loved the entire meal, all courses from start to finish.

Palazzo was our saving grace, as it was the only option (for Royal Service only) that served a decent breakfast and lunch buffet (far better quality than the standard Naos buffet at Gabi Beach) as well as menu items. Dinner at Palazzo was decent, the CAB steak was our favorite as well as the prosciutto mozzarella appetizer.

In closing, the grounds and beach at this resort are lovely, the staff are wonderful, and we loved our butler, Alvaro...stick with Royal Service to enjoy better dining and service options! :-)

reviews.author: Fitim K
reviews.title: Beautiful place but average service!
reviews.text:
We arrived on a Wed midday, had to wait 20mins just to check in, as we were checking in the lady at the desk was very confused and barely spoke English, (which is fine but took her a long time to just understand we had the room already reserved) she then said oh you are a member of Melia which I kindly replied yes. We are traveling with a 1.5yr old baby, so we asked ahead of time for a quite area since I had read reviews about ongoing construction, that of course was as if I had asked for a room close to construction, two days later we changed the room because of the loud noises and are now in a new room, where guess what the toilet doesn’t work, and that took until 10pm to get it fixed!

Everything takes forever even though the place is half empty, so not sure what is really happening here! Most of the ppl are nice and go out of their way but way to much of our vacation time has been spent waiting on service.

The food in the restaurants (Vento, Brisas) is great and the service is good for the most part. The server at Rare was mostly busy talking to others then actually providing service.

The beach hasn’t been that great and today was one of the worst days of it. However the views are breathtaking! 

Overall I give it an average rating which is unfortunate since we really enjoyed and loved Paradisus, Mexico. We came here hoping for the same experience and what we got is average!

reviews.author: Elizabethbuk
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort but Service is Lacking
reviews.text:
Let me preface this by saying that I traveled to another MELIA resort in a similar beach setting and was blown away by their resort, services, and food. It was amazing and I expected this MELIA resort to be the same. Although beautiful, we encountered many issues on this trip. 

I will say that Junior, Freddy, and Emil were OUTSTANDING waiters. They went above and beyond to make sure we were happy and cared for. 

After a 10+ day of travel, we arrived and a woman walked us to the front desk to be checked us in with a gentleman who wasn't overly friendly or even make eye contact. He spoke very little English and could not explain any of the charges. He gave us the option to pay at the end but we decided to pay up front. He figured the charges out on a calculator so who knows if they were even correct. We were given very little information upon check in in regards to reservations, events, and where things were located on the resort.  We weren't offered a drink, let alone a bottle of water.

There were four of us and we had two rooms. When we booked 3 months in advance, we requested that these rooms be relatively close in proximity if possible. We asked Daniel and he didn't understand what we were asking. When we finally explained, he told us that it was not possible. I understand that there may not be any options at that time but we requested this with plenty of advance notice. 

When we arrived into our room, it smelled terribly of mold and mildew mixed with cleaning supplies. The cabinet was also falling out of its hinges. Our bags arrived and they were our friends luggage, not ours. It honestly could have been our mistake but again, there was a language barrier upon arrival so who knows. 

We went down to the front desk to speak with someone else to see what our options were because of the issues with our room and our friends. Betty helped us and was very kind. She said that there wasn't anything available tonight but to come to the desk tomorrow at 3 pm and she could move us. We were satisfied with that solution and appreciated the offer. After we went to grab dinner and talk to the front desk, we came back exhausted from traveling and got ready for bed. We were turning the lights out and getting into bed and realized that the air conditioning only worked if the lights were on! We called the front desk and they said they would send someone up. It was 11 pm and we just wanted to sleep. We told them we were going to pile in our friends room and sleep there because we were so tired and would deal with it in the morning. We tried all combinations of light switches and knew it was faulty electric work so the chances of being able to fix it immediately was slim.

The next morning we had a knock on our door and a man with a screwdriver was there. He didn't speak any English, which was fine, but didn't even know what the problem was upon arrival. We told him not to worry about it because we were moving later that day. 

We ended up moving rooms across the hall from each other which did not smell like mold and had working AC Nothing was comped or refunded even though we were unable stay in our room that night.  A few days later, we were getting ready for dinner and heard dripping in the shower.  We discovered that the room above was leaking extensive amounts of water through the ceiling.  We called maintenance multiple times but we never saw anyone come to check nor was the issue resolved prior to our departure. 

Housekeeping: Our room was tended to each day and appeared clean however, our mini bar and snacks were NEVER re-stocked. We had to call multiple times to even get water. We called one day for wash cloths and they never came. 

Beach: The beach was BEAUTIFUL! This was the best part of the trip. Yes. there was seaweed but it changed from day to day and didn't bother me at all. As they explained, it is part of nature and is a floating ecosystem naturally occurs. The sand was beautiful and so soft. It didn't burn my feet and there was plenty of space on the beach to spread out. Again, we had fantastic service from Junior all days. The water wasn't clear but was blue and beautiful. I had no qualms about swimming in the water. The only complaint about the beach are the vendors. These people come up CONSTANTLY and yell "PARA-SAILING PARA-SAILING" all day. Other vendors come up to you while sleeping and upload their merchandise trying to sell. It is very annoying but may be something that the resort has no control over. 

Food: The food was great!  The food was delicious and presentation was beautiful.  We had excellent service particularly at the bar between Bana and Rare by a bartender named Emil.  It was sometimes difficult to get water but that seemed to be a common theme no matter the restaurant or buffet that we ate at. 

Pool: The pool was beautiful although, we spent most of our days at the beach. 

Events and activities: We were never told once about activities, reservations, or events. Thankfully, we knew that we needed to make reservations but it was never mentioned once upon arrival. We didn't have a reservation one night and every restaurant claimed they were full. We looked in and there were MANY open tables. I understand that there may be a shortage of staff but there should be other options besides the buffet. There were multiple restaurants closed while we were there. There was a Thanksgiving buffet offered out in the main area and nothing was advertised and we were never told by staff. The app didn't reflect the events that were happening. On the last night, there was an Alice in Wonderland event on the beach. Multiple people came up asking what was going on but we didn't know either. It seemed that the activities people were only fishing for a Trip Advisor review. 

I would like to add that the friend who was on the trip with me left a similar review. Someone from the resort found her phone number and offered her a free night stay voucher and asked her to remove the review! That is completely backward customer service! Had they made the situation right when we didn't have a room to stay the first night, this review may have been better but don't call me to offer a free night voucher when you had an entire week to remedy the situation!

Although this may seem like a negative review, I would like to point out that Junior and Emil were fantastic during our stay.  Junior was so accommodating and provided excellent service on the beach.  Email was very talented and took time to entertain us while at the bar.  He even brought back the 7 year old girl who was traveling with us to let her try some tricks with cups behind the bar.

Overall, the resort was beautiful but service left much to be desired. We did extensive research prior to traveling and honestly, I would not return. I tend to look on the bright side especially on vacation however, this trip left a sour taste in my mouth. I had read other reviews that were our EXACT experience.

reviews.author: JAS
reviews.title: Beautiful Surroundings, Poor Service
reviews.text:
The resort itself is absolutely beautiful. The grounds are lush and meticulously cared for. The beach is white, cool sand and the ocean is a brilliant blue-green.

When we arrived after a very long day of traveling we were greeted, but we did not feel exactly welcome. We were not offered a drink when we arrived (even a water would have been wonderful at that point). The person that checked us in was very cold and did not make eye contact. Any questions asked or requests made were met with annoyance and no clear answers. We also were given VERY little information about the resort, services offered, restaurants offered or activities offered. There was no mention that if you do not make reservations for the restaurants immediately, you will miss your opportunity to eat where you want (or anywhere for that matter) and will have to eat at the buffet. We were given no information about restaurant reservations, period (more on this later).

We were given a very short tour (it really wasn't a tour because it was the way to our room) with not a lot of information as we were escorted to our room. As we walked into our room, it immediately smelled like mold that they had tried to cover up with cleaning supplies. We were told that we were in a renovated room when in reality it had just been painted (and the paint had not been cleaned up well). As we tried to go to sleep we realized the switch that turned off one of the lights also turned off the air conditioning. Therefore, if we wanted to have the air on, we had to sleep with the light on all night (I know this sounds bizarre and we felt crazy, but I assure you this was the case). We ended up sleeping in our friends’ room as there were no other rooms available until the next day. After 3pm the next day they moved us to another room (as well as our friends because their first room had issues as well). There was no effort made by the staff to make up for the inconvenience of packing our stuff up and changing rooms. We were offered nothing for our hassles. 

One more thing to be aware of, in the building we stayed in – there is no actual sound privacy in the bathroom. There is a window with just a curtain (no actual glass or anything) separating the entire bathroom from the room. The bathroom does have a door, but with the curtain situation it’s really unhelpful and unnecessary. The toilet is in a small separate room, but the door from the bathroom to the toilet room is glass, partially see-through, and open at the top and bottom. There is absolutely no bathroom privacy so you may want to keep that in mind depending on who is staying in the room with you.

Our mini bar was restocked ONCE the entire seven days we were there after calling and asking for more water. We had family staying in other parts of the resort that had their mini bar restocked every day without asking. Our family in the other building also received a butler that offered to make dinner reservations for them (they DID NOT have Royal Service). 

We tried to make dinner reservations for Tuesday night (we arrived late Saturday) and were told all restaurants were booked. A butler of another family member told us we could show up at any restaurant to try to get a table. We did this and were told by a hostess at Aqua that we could not eat there and all restaurants were full, but we could eat the Gaby Club next door. We then went to Gaby and were told we could not eat there because we did not have Royal service. The butler of our family member had told them that we could eat at any restaurants at any of the resorts. The underlying issue here is that not even the people that work at this resort have a grasp on who can and cannot eat/do what/where. We decided to go to the buffet for dinner as that was our only option. Unfortunately, that was closed. There was a Dominican buffet dinner that was open to all (again, we were not aware of this) and that is why the buffet was closed so we ended up eating there. There was also a dinner on the beach Friday night. There was no information or signs about it. We had to ask other guests what was going on and realized what it was after we had dinner.

About half-way through our stay, my cousin and I were getting ready for dinner and heard the shower dripping quite a bit. Neither of us had used the shower in at least 20-30 min so we thought it was kind of odd. After looking we realized that it was not the shower head dripping from leftover water from the last shower, but it was from the shower in the room above us. It was leaking from the ceiling (not just leaking, more like a waterfall). We told the front desk about it immediately and they said someone would come look at it. As far as we are aware no one came that night. It happened again the next day so we went to the front desk. Someone wrote it down and said they would send maintenance. We have no idea if it was ever resolved. At that point we gave up trying to get any help because the service experience overall had been so poor. We took it for what it was and moved on to try to enjoy the rest of our trip.

Although this review seems very negative, we did have some exceptional individuals serving us. Junior was a server for the beach and pool. Junior was friendly, welcoming, and provided an all-around positive experience. The bar between Bana and Rare has a wonderful bartender in Emil. He made us all different drinks and even had his own signature drinks. Emil was our favorite bartender and we went out of our way to get drinks from him. We also had great service from the bartenders at the bar next to the sportsbook. 

Overall this is a beautiful resort (the pool, the beach, the restaurants and bars), but the accommodations and service leave little to be desired. It honestly was very disappointing based on all of the wonderful reviews we read prior to our trip (and have read after our trip!). We totally understand that nothing can be perfect and things come up and happen all the time – especially when you are running such a huge resort, but we felt there was nothing done to make up for the lack of service and the poor experiences.

reviews.author: Passenger57008969653
reviews.title: RECLAMAÇÃO AO SERVIÇO ROYAL SERVICE
reviews.text: Fizemos uma viagem de lua-de-mel e não recebemos qualquer atenção especial ou notamos diferencial por isso. contratamos o serviço de concierge, este se limitou a fazer reservas em restaurante e nos dar pequenas orientações. o serviço foi de baixíssima qualidade, não recomendo a amigos.

reviews.author: J G
reviews.title: 2nd time not a charm
reviews.text: Service simply did not compare to our experience at this resort last year.   There was more than once we waited nearly half an hour for the transportation around the property,  once they never came,  after requestimate twice, we were forced to walk, which normally isn't a problem, but with a foot that's had four surgeries, in flip flop type sandals, carrying a heavy beach bag, it was not enjoyable walk.

reviews.author: Patricia Kubudi Glasman
reviews.title: Apesar da estrutura varias falhas
reviews.text: Acabei de retornar do hotel. Realmente a estrutura é ótima! O hotel é lindo, os restaurantes são ótimos! O quarto é realmente muito confortável. Mas ocorreram falhas que não condizem com um hotel 5 estrelas. Primeiro, apesar de termos um concierge, este se ausentou quase 3 dias de nossa estadia de 7 noites e não tinha outro para substitui-lo. Pagamos por um serviço que não tivemos. Este mesmo concierge deveria ter nos dado, na nossa primeira noite, um "cheque" com vários vouchers de desconto. Mas só o recebemos no dia da nossa partida. Os restaurantes são deliciosos, mas pecam muito no serviço. Com um criança, não há como ter um jantar que leva 2h...mas nos foi informado que muitos funcionários estavam de férias e por isso a lentidão. Não acho que um hotel deste porte possa ter falta de funcionários! E por fim e o mais grave: ficamos 3 noites sem agua quente nos banheiros. Ou seja, tivemos que tomar banho frio e dar banho frio na nossa filha. Não pudemos aproveitar a banheira de hidromassagem do quarto, que ao que parece era uma exclusividade do hotel! Mas o que mais me espanta da situação e a falta de comunicação do hotel que fingia que nada estava ocorrendo. Todos reclamando e nenhum comunicado oficial, nenhum pedido de desculpa oficial, nada! Um hotel exclusivo para famílias, que estavam em sua grande maioria com bebes e crianças pequenas, que na sua grande maioria não gostam de banho, ainda mais frio! Todos lá trabalharam o ano inteiro para tirar uma semana de ferias e poder relaxar e aproveitar o hotel, não é correto termos que tomar banho com agua esquentada na chaleira como nos foi sugerido pelos funcionários!

reviews.author: jennychiletraveller
reviews.title: Club Melia vs Paradisus
reviews.text:
Me and my husband arrived Monday for a 2 day stay after speding 1 week at hard rock hotel.

Our family is Club Melia members so we decided to spend this 2 days here. Its my 4 th time in this resort.

So far we were received at the club members lobby area, which was really nice and fast. 
We got a big suite very well located with nice pool and sea views best room location I ever gotten. Although nothing had change in the rooms since my first time here in 2011! (Very old fashioned).

This morning we received a call that we need to go to speak with the club representative about new things.... we were very reluctand and made ourselves very clear that we only had 2 days here and just wanted to relax and go to the beach! Pretty obvious since its a vacation! They took us to a room specially design for new club membership sales. We explained again were not interested we just want to go to breakfast and enjoy our day. 

Next thing we know were having breakfast with a sales representative!! Again! Our familiy already bought the membership therefore we don’t want more nor needed it! It was a horrible experience since nobody wants to be rude but we had to explain again for a 3 o 4 th time WE ARE NOT INTERESTED. So when the sales guy finally understood he made us go with him back to the offices to explain to his boss....clearly there had been a mistake.... but muy first breakfast was ruined

Anyways

Rooms are extacly the same as when they were built 15 year ago even beds and pillows must say the black out curtains fail to provide full blackout and room AC not ver good either... were staying at a 3rd floor with no elevetor The bell boy even complaint when he had to bring up our suitcases up.....

Only the main buffet area gabi beach has been updated, it was very nice. With a bar and music playing.
Few people. No not much of a vibe going on whats so ever. There is not even music at the pools.

Every area of the swimming pool and beach have different separate areas according to your status: Club Members. Royal service, family Concierge, The Reserve. Not liking all this divisions! Even some restaurants. It doesn’t make me feel special at all! (Clearly some are more special than others and you have to pay accordingly ) however nobody actually takes care if you just go eveywhere. But is still very uncomfortable.

There is kids club and kids pools at The Reserve located far from the beach not sure of its open to every status.... this time its only me and husband I wouldn't bring the kids back since its kind of boring for them...

At the beach and even at the pool areas lots of off resort vendors offering day trips, clubbing etc.... and sales techniques involve having to talk to them for a couple of minutes to make them understan I’m NOT INTERESTED. (By the way its not a language issue since I’m chilean therefore speak Spanish!!)

Food was so much better than previous visits. the Buffet at Gabi Beach improved alot.

The Beach is very nice for swimming since the tide is soft. 
Service in general was pretty good... better than muy previous stays. 

Just came from the Hard Rock hotel were you can party all day and night of you want.... or relax at more tranquil areas and also have amazing kids pools, kids club and shows etc.... plus an amazing casino.
I will go back to Hard Rock definetly, much more exited and bringing the kids for sure.

Here´s my thinking, ever since this hotel was purchased by Melia. Their main efforts has been focus in membership sales, yo can see representative speaking with vacationers everywhere. But nothing has done to improve the actual hotel and its design, they could easily redecorate lobby areas and rooms. 

Instead they have built more a more hotel The Reserve and now Circle which are even further form the beach, in order to offer new sales opportunities for this time sharing business that is The Club Melia. Which I doubt is really that good after all you still new to pay 100 US per person per day....which added is very Close to any deal you can get at Expedia. I have to take a better look at it

reviews.author: Leonardo L. Monescau
reviews.title: Opiniones encontradas
reviews.text:
Fuimos una semana del 27/10 al 3/11. Nuestra experiencia ha sido variada pero no me permite calificar al hotel mejor. Comienzo con lo bueno:

La Recepción: nos han recibido con mucha cordialidad y nos guardaron la valijas un par de horas dado que llegamos a las 13 y el check-in es a las 15 hs. 

Nuestra Coordinadora: Tuvimos de coordinadora a una chica muy amable llamada Trazy que supo aconsejarnos y resolver todas nuestras consultas en forma satisfactoria y profesional.

Las habitaciones: Nos alojamos en una Suite Junior, si bien eran grandes y con camas muy cómodas, no nos gustó que entre el baño y la habitación haya una ventana con una cortina, lo cual hace que se escuchen todos los ruidos naturales que se pueden hacer dentro del baño y resulta muy incomodo por mas que sean parejas o amigos.

Los restaurantes: El buffet principar donde se sirven el desayudo, almuerzo y cena es muy completo, gran variedad de platos y los mozos muy amables y atentos.

LO MALO:

Cucarachas: en 3 partes distintas del predio (Buffet, Entrada de Restaurante Vento y baño de la habitación) hemos encontrado estos insectos.

Ladrones: Uno de nuestros amigos olvidó su billetera en la habitación y le robaron 20 dólares e hicieron compras con su tarjeta de crédito.

Vendedores: Termina siendo insoportable la cantidad de vendedores dentro del hotel y en su playa, deberían controlarlo mas ya que a veces son muy molestos.

Club de Vacaciones Melia: Te invitan a una charla para que conozcas el nuevo hotel que están construyendo, The Circle, la misma promete ser de 30 minutos o 45 como mucho y termina siendo una charla de 1 hora y media en donde al final te presentan el Club de Vacaciones del Hotel en donde practicamente te obligan ahí mismo a comprar el paquete mientras que a cada rato "otros sospechosos compradores" que parecían mas actores que otra cosa celebran con champan su compra gritando para que se escuche y así convencerte a comprar (estrategia de venta). Me pareció muy maleducado el vendedor que nos atendía que al ver nuestra negativa a comprar se fue sin saludar. Si no estás interesado en comprar un club de vacaciones, no vayas a la charla pues es una pérdida de tiempo.

reviews.author: Martinirigoin
reviews.title: Maltrato por parte de la gerencia
reviews.text:
El hotel en si está bien. Hay mejores por ese precio. El servicio por parte del personal es sobresaliente, super serviciales y atentos TODOS absolutamente. No puedo decir lo mismo de la parte gerencial, nos tuvimos que quedar 2 días más por un problema en la aerolínea y hablando con el gerente me dijo que como gentileza si me quedaba en el hotel me hacía un precio diferencial, siendo así tomamos la oferta. Ya que de tener que pagar la tarifa regular nos íbamos a otro. Al momento de pagar nos cobraron el precio de lista y nos dijeron que dicho valor (que nos pasó el Sr. Carlos Sánchez. DIRECTOR) no era posible (tengo aun su mensaje guardado donde nos paso una tarifa diferente, el cual no cumplieron). En resumen no nos hicieron el descuento que nos prometieron, más allá de pagar de mas el cual no es el punto. Me molesta como cliente (ya estuvimos en la cadena por 3ra vez) que no tengan palabra ni puedan respetar lo que un directivo nos dijo y cobrar por algo que no estaba acordado ya sin posibilidad de irnos a otro hotel. Un desastre a nivel gerencial y muy mal trato a un cliente que por esta actitud dejará de utilizar el hotel. nos sentimos muy mal y esto hizo que se opaquen nuestras vacaciones, en lugar de ser contemplativos y generar un buen vinculo con el cliente, prácticamente nos sentimos estafados, ademas invirtiendo tiempo de descanso, en explicar la situación varias veces que no supieron resolver. No era tan difícil, simplemente respetar la tarifa que nos dijeron. Una pena que una cadena prestigiosa falle en las relaciones humanas a nivel gerencial, sinceramente desprestigian el servicio y la buen labor de todos los que trabajan.
También teníamos de cortesía el Transfer al aeropuerto y nos dijeron que ya tampoco era válido por cambiar la fecha de partida. No solo nos quedamos en el hotel dos noches mas (que las pagamos carisimas) sino que no nos dieron la gentileza de brindarnos el transfer (que ya teníamos antes) en lugar de darnos mas como clientes por elegir quedarnos, nos quitaron beneficios que ya teniamos. DE CUARTA PARA UN HOTEL 5*.
El hotel está algo viejo, la comida es normal y poca variedad. La mayoría de los restaurantes temáticos son al aire libre y prácticamente te morís de calor (si vas en época calurosa), el restaurante Pasión es muy bueno (comida y servicio). Nos invitaron  por escuchar una charla de venta, que te dicen "son solo 20 minutos", pero es mentira te quitan 4 hs de tus vacaciones, con tal que le dejes aunque sea USD200 de reserva. La relación precio/calidad  no es la mas conveniente, viajamos a punta cana  unas 18 veces y hay otras opciones mejores.

reviews.author: Worldexplorer93
reviews.title: Hoch und Tief
reviews.text:
Zum Positiven:
- Sehr schönes Hotel mit toller, gepflegter. Anlage.
- Gutes Essen (man bekommt zwar ab und zu mal Bauchweh oder ein WC-Besuch ist nötig, aber geschmacklich sehr feines Essen.
- Tolle Zimmer, auch von der Qualität.
- Sehr freundliches Personal (hier möchte ich explizit der Strandboy Argenis De Los Santos erwähnen, er hat uns immer ein Lächeln ins Gesicht gezaubert.
- Einer der schönsten Strandabschnitte Punta Cana's
- Gutes WLAN!

Zum Negativen:
- Enttäuschung gleich zu Beginn: Unser Zimmer gab's im Paradisus Punta Cana nicht. Gemäss Check-In Typ sind die Blöcke mit den Junior Suiten in dieser Zeit geschlossen. Somit waren wir im Paradisus Punta Cana "the Reserve", was ca. 10 Min. vom Strand entfernt ist. Dem wiederspricht die Reiseleiterin. Gemäss Ihr war der Hotelwechsel, weil der Hauptpool geschlossen war. Bitte um ehrliche Kommunikation.
- Hauptpool war in dieser Zeit zu wegen Renovationsarbeiten.
- Wie oben erwähnt bekam ich leider Magen- und Darmprobleme. Wie viele  andere auch im Hotel.
- Unsere befreundete Familie wurde leider ausgeraubt und zwar aus dem GESCHLOSSENEN SAFE. Das ist absolut krass und das Hotel kam für keine Entschädigung auf. Achtung also!! Immer schön das Geld nach zählen.

reviews.author: Alvaro
reviews.title: Member and disappointed
reviews.text:
2 days in and my room hasn’t been cleaned yet. Been trying to conserve my membership with hard work, very disappointed. !!! Their answer!!!! Worse. Any ways .. punta cana simply the best!!! 
Hope they understand !!!

reviews.author: islandgirlvacations
reviews.title: Beautiful beach & pools!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a girls trip & had some fun at the Paradisus Palma Real. The service was NOT good to start...no one seemed to know where to take us & the reception was not very friendly. BUT luckily the situation improved & we did have some ***excellent, very attentive service in the pool area! FREDDY...NIXON & JEAN are wonderful*** pool/bar attendants & made our girls trip so fun :)
I am a travel agent and travel very frequently-so I'll give a brief recap of other aspects of the hotel....Food is OK, drinks OK (very hard to get ahold of top shelf or a beer other than Presidente). The 2 bedroom master suite had excellent space-which we needed in our group of 4. It was clean, but was quite dated.
The specialty restaurants are a bit difficult to make reservations in but we did try the steak house "Rare"...food again was OK...I think my burger was a frozen patty. The hibatchi grill was better-we enjoyed that, but could only get in at 9:45pm, which was pretty late. The entertainment at night was fun! we particularly enjoyed the Circus (Cirque de soleil-style). We also had a very fun night in the dance club :) 
Overall, this "research" trip was pretty much what I expected Punta Cana to be, personally I like Mexico much better.

reviews.author: Gautam M
reviews.title: Very commercialized now
reviews.text:
We first visited Paradisus in Feb 2017 with our 1.5 year old daughter , absolutely fell in love with the building, service and ambience in the resort , Enjoyed every second of our all inclusive 1 week stay , Loved the resort so much that we booked again in Sept 2018 and specially brought our mom to show her this resort, Unfortunately the expereince was not the same this time around , first we had to wait 2 hours for check in as we reached 12:30 pm and the check in starts at 3 pm and with one 3 year and one 6 month old it was a huge challenge , had two rooms booked but the second room was far from the first room which was an unnecessary hassle , secondly the AC for one the rooms was not working , reported it and the Gentlemen on Duty , Mr Sandy Gil was very proactive and great help 
I reccomend seeing him whenever you visit this resort , he is a thorough peofessional who takes good care of your needs ,he next day transferred us to ocean view room at no cost , if there were people like him all over the resort , it would have been a memorable stay
Secondly a big shout out to Jean Marcos who was in activities at Gabi beach club,thank you so much for everything you did for our daughter , you are a true gentlemen and we wish you all the best in life

All in all an average experience at the resort as it has lost it natural value and raw appeal but thumbs up to the staff that i mentioned above and others      ( both waiters at swim up bar)

reviews.author: mrexotic
reviews.title: " Far From A 5 Star Hotel "
reviews.text: Hi. I'll try to make it brief and efficient. Hotel common area buildings, lay out, lobby are really good; pool is huge and deep(5 feet deep) allowing you to swim a good 50-60 meter. Beautiful landscape. Proximity of beach, pool, buffet, restaurants and lobby is an advantage. All pool bar staff are very good. Beach is pretty wide and vast but at the time of my stay was loaded with seaweed which turned the ocean not swim-able at all although they were cleaning it every day. I stayed at luxury suite which was relatively bigger in size but really tired and in desperate need of a reno specially bathrooms. I asked many other people and almost every one was sharing an unhappy experience about room condition. BIGGEST TURN DOWN of this hotel is the SERVICE WHICH IS CLOSE TO TERRIBLE; at the same time staff are trying hard but I believe service issue initiates from management as they were visibly short staffed. My wife and I are  not picky with food but FOOD was not better than a 3 star hotel in terms of variety and quality. They charge you $5 US for room service(they advertise that room service is free and included but they charge $5. US and they say food is free while guests have to pay for service!!! and they claim themselves as 5 star amenity!?). Daily entertainments are limited to 45-60 minutes around  pool bar area and that very simple. Grounds are very normal with lots of dried spots and many spots with full weed instead of lawn. Check-out could be a disaster if you are in rush, make sure you get your receipt and transfer bus voucher if you have to pay for check-out. Casino seems to be a scam( I have seen very odd things going on on a black jack table) Casino applies a ridiculous exchange rate for currencies other than US dollar. No one goes on a Caribbean vacation to gamble and make money but dealers were not shy to show their happiness and satisfaction when swiping table with guests money.

reviews.author: Juliana M
reviews.title: Great hotel, but NOT ecofriendly
reviews.text: The hotel is great, good food, good amenities, good staff... but they claim to be an ecofriendly resort, they even have a mangrove. As my boyfriend and I decided to walk around in it, we found plastic bags, plastic straws and even old batteries laying around. This is completely unacceptable anywhere, but especially in a resort that calls itself a Reserve and claim to be ecofriendly. You should care more about nature and keep these areas clean. All the wildlife in it is being poisened!

reviews.author: BD3223
reviews.title: Recent travel
reviews.text: The Resort/Facilities:  On the surface, this resort is very appealing to the eye. However, once you take a closer look, it's average at best.- Room: Nice - a decent size with a unique layout and a nice shower - but our "mini-bar" (a poorly-situated, one-door fridge) was bare, the jacquzzi tub was less than inviting, toilet was quite cramped, and the phone didn't work. The air conditioner also made everything feel damp despite adjusting the temperature in either direction. - Pool: The pool was interesting.  Nice big size, clear water, in-pool bar, lounging areas... Pretty much what you'd expect visually until you get in.  I'm not a tall guy at slightly over 5'7", but it was a bit odd to find the water level was up to my neck.  It was also fairly cold.  I dealt with it fine, but there were plenty of others finding it pretty difficult to walk around - especially with drinks, which were served in tiny paper cups for those who didn't arrive with their own Yetis/mugs like we did. That aside, the bartenders were great and the drinks on par.- Beach: Sloppy. Seaweed all over the sand & a good 30 yds entering the water.- Spa: Excellent! Highly recommended.The Service: On average, all the staff members were very friendly and attentive. However, it'd often take several different people to provide a simple answer or point you in the direction. Like everyone was brand new.  - Front desk: Spoke with the same person 3 times in 3 days to ensure we wouldn't have to change rooms for the last two nights of our trip that were in addition to the company-paid portion. Was told we'd be all set and just have to come back down on the day of the new reservation to provide a credit card. That day we were told we had to go to the other side of the resort to speak with a different group. Then they asked us to go back to the room to get our passports. When I returned, they said they actually didn't need them and just had to give new room keys. Get it together!- Maids: Not great. Consistently came as we were about to hit the pool, wouldn't come in, and never came back. We stayed 5 nights/6 days, and our room was only cleaned twice. Got to the point where we'd have to call down for towels.The Food: - Restaurants: Decent at best, and unnecessarily difficult to get reservations.- Buffet: Awful. Almost a week later and my body still doesn't feel quite right. Everything else in this review could be overlooked, but food alone would stop me from returning.

reviews.author: stephanielanghart
reviews.title: Mystery meat?
reviews.text: The service, people, property was wonderful. The food was not so good, meat was dried out and boarderline disgusting. Even the steak restaurant was meh. Loved the zip line and monkeys. Felt very safe and never went without!

reviews.author: LaCroixNYC
reviews.title: Average - limited food options, beautiful in parts, but the whole needs a renovation
reviews.text: The entryway to the water with the fountains and statues looks like a palace and the pools are expansive; however, the rooms themselves were a bit dated, and the food options were limited. The beach itself is beautiful.

reviews.author: dhoffman556
reviews.title: Left Something to be Desired
reviews.text: We stayed in the older portion of the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  It was well maintained, and the staff was friendly, but no one seemed to know what was going on.  The guests were often left on their own to figure out how things work.  It seemed like some of the members of the staff were genuinely sincere, while others were primarily interested in hustling the visitors instead of providing great service.  It had a beautiful setting and grounds, but we couldn't help commenting how great it would be if someone like Disney got hold of it!  We traveled in February and learned that the wind blows constantly that time of year, which dampened our experience somewhat.

reviews.author: flaviaemareclo
reviews.title: Razoável
reviews.text: Correu tudo bem, mas nada de extraordiário. A qualidade das bebidas e das comidas deixou a desejar, poderia ser melhor. A praia tem muitas algas e vendedores que não param de importunar as pessoas para vender de tudo, é muito chato. Basta pisar na praia que já vem dois ou tres vendeores oferecer coisas e te importunar. Isso foi muito desgradável.

reviews.author: Adam K
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with mediocre service
reviews.text:
Overall the resort was beautiful. Spectacular views. You could see the ocean walking in and see if from almost anywhere in the resort. The resort was also well maintained and very clean. We did the royal service as it was our honeymoon and liked the fact that you could have an adults only area and many amenities with this. Our butler Argenis was amazing. He helped with anything we needed and went above and beyond. Unfortunately besides him the service was mediocre. The only other people I can say gave great service was Fernando and Mario at the swim up bar by the pool and Martin who was at the royal service bar. If it weren't for them our experience wouldn't have been so great. The service at breakfast and lunch was terrible and dinner service just ok. I had to flag someone down just to get a drink. Kuddos to Argenis, Fernando, Mario and Martin! They were amazing. As far as royal service, was it worth it? Maybe. It was worth it as far as having someone like Argenis help us out and being able to get a bed on the beach reserved by Martin. The different pillows and having essential oils was a cool touch as well however there were some things about royal service that were just ok and could be improved. 1. Although there was an adult only pool it was secluded. Just because we want adult only doesnt mean we don't want to have fun. Adult only was literally just a small separate pool. The music was at the main pool as well as the swim up bar and all the fun. I want to enjoy the swim up bar and music and the fun activities so we just ended up going over to the main pool vs. using the separate adult only area.  The other thing that could be improved is the alcohol choice for royal service. We had to go to specific bars to get better alcohol and even then found out it wasn't included. We felt for royal service it should be. Additionally I've never been to an all inclusive resort where stuff isn't included. There is a wine bar but it's not included and you have top alcohol but it's not included. What is the point of all inclusive then? Additionally, royal service gets a separate lobby to check in with extra amenities and alcohol. We walked there to get a drink and they have all the top alcohol but when I asked what they had that I could mix the grey goose vodka with all I got was sprite or coke. I asked if they could do vodka lemonade or vodka cranberry and they said no. I guess I'm not sure the point then in having this alcohol there. Unless you just want a jack and coke it wasn't worth it. 
-Dinner's were ok. We liked Bana, Rare and Passion. Palazzo which is part of royal service as well was just ok. There was lack of seasoning throughout all restaurants. I think the only one that was spot on was Passion which you have to pay extra for. Additionally when we ate a passion I didn't want to have to pay extra for wine as the resort has plenty of house wines. I was shocked when I asked for the house cabernet and was told I couldn't have the house wine in this restaurant. I was left to then spend $14 per glass of wine and had no choice. I was puzzled as the resort has wine that is included as I'm paying for an all inclusive resort yet I couldn't get that wine in this restaurant so not only am I paying extra for the meal but I am now paying extra for drinks. Did I mention we are "royal service?" That doesn't matter. The dinner food overall however was ok. We were not a fan however of breakfast or the lunch options. Honestly, our room service we order was better than what we ate for breakfast or lunch. There needs to be more options with better seasoning. If you are looking for a resort with beautiful views but are ok with average food and service you'll love it. I guess the saying is true, you get what you pay for!

reviews.author: deimutta23
reviews.title: A bit less than what you‘d expect
reviews.text: Best part of this place is the well kept gardens. Make sure to book „Family Concierge“! Food could offer more variety at all meals (you‘ll get bored if you stay more than a week). Shows at night are quite nice.

reviews.author: Passport166451
reviews.title: Personal de animación y de la piscina de Royal service excelente
reviews.text:
Estuve Alojada con 4 amigas y el personal que nos atendía en el bar de la piscina del Royal service fue excelente. Un trato super amable, alegres y siempre pendientes de lo que necesitábamos. Muchas gracias a Luisito y Pedrito!! 
El personal de animación del hotel, super divertido. Gracias a los chicos que nos hicieron bailar en las noches!! El jefe de este servicio super amable y los otros chicos también!

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: The Cat in the Hat
reviews.text: The front desk staff were professional to a degree. Some were very pushy and didn't seem to understand that folks would split their room bill and spa services. There was a mildew smell on alot of the pillows in the rooms on the couches and on the bed. Emil in the bar between Rare and the Hibatchi restaurant had a great personality and was an excellent bartender. Davidson was a great waiter and was very attentive during my breakfast at the buffet spot. It took a long while for someone to address one of my friends issue with her room due to the moldy/sewage smell that hit you once you hit the door. There was a random cat that walked the halls of the facility while I was there. Aqua restaurant was awesome.

reviews.author: Gladys G
reviews.title: No nos gustó tanto como las veces anteriores
reviews.text:
Debo contar que es política del Hotel según nos dijeron por seguridad del cliente,  que había que llevar la tarjeta de crédito con la cual se había cancelado la estadía, mi esposo llevo otras , pero no esa, por lo que nos hicieron cancelar de nuevo, a pesar que les dijimos  que era nuestra tercera estadía en Royal Service y nos dimos cuenta que  ellos no  tienen fidelización del cliente y  les da lo mismo perder clientes por cuanto siempre el Hotel está lleno.  Por lo que entrando al Hotel ya nuestra experiencia fue mala, así es que como consejo no se olviden de llevar la tarjeta.  En general debo decir que lo pasamos bien, pero habían muchas instalaciones que están deterioradas, , a las habitaciones no se les ha hecho ninguna mejora, el colchón de la cama muy bueno, pero la cama en el respaldo sonaba cuando te recostabas sobre él, tb la ducha a la salida de la playa, salía apenas un chorrito, el baño que se ocupa en la piscina varias veces estaba tapado. También hubo un día que no arreglaron nuestra habitación , por lo que al llegar de la playa tuvimos que pedir las toallas.
La comida en el Palazzo y en los restaurantes que fuimos estaba buena, excepto, muy mala en el Restaurante Fuego, donde mi esposo y yo pedimos un arroz chaufa de marisco, el cual casi estaba incomible, por lo que nos paramos y terminamos comiendo en el Buffet.
Me imagino que se dejaron estar porque están construyendo otra etapa del hotel denominada Cirqle.
Lo bueno que siguen contando con el capital humano que hace que todo lo malo se olvide. nuestros mas sinceros agradecimientos a nuestro mayordomo Armando quien se preocupó de hacernos las reservas en los Restaurantes y que todo lo que le pedimos lo hiciera con mucho gusto. A Pedro y Rafael en la piscina donde nos tenían las tumbonas con sus toallas y nos servían unos ricos tragos, en el restaurante Palazzo, mención especial a Miguel, pero la atención de Felix, Gustavo y José también era de lo mejor, en el Bar Gerinaldo quien también se esmeraba en la atención , lo mismo que Olga. y en el retaurante Rare, Esteban.
La animación en general muy buena, 
Nos encanta Punta Cana, pero ya no volveremos a hoteles de la cadena Melia

reviews.author: ceciaco1981
reviews.title: Para meditar y descansar bueno...para divertirse con amigos no es el lugar
reviews.text: El concepto del hotel se orienta a un sector de invitados que solo quieren silencio y descanso. Para grupo de parejas de amigos sin hijos no tiene mucho que ofrecer. Por lo tanto no encontré completamente lo que buscaba

reviews.author: graciela653
reviews.title: desepcion
