There were only 4 antique bikes available and really no good way to reserve the bike.I never saw the pool spin classes happening during my entire stay. A bit frustrating!! The spa was way too expensive like 180.00 for 60 minutes plus 18% tax and tip!!! 
Some good things about this resort which changes this from 0 stars to 3 stars. The property is nice with beautiful pools and fitness areas. The restaurants and buffet are really good and no complaints. Our butler Leidy, salvaged our trip by being very attentive after all the issues and communicated via What's App throughout the day. Noel the fitness trainer is amazing and makes the spin class challenging. 
This could have been a 5 star resort Too bad !!

reviews.author: vanessa12342015
reviews.text:
Well, 50% good, 50% average. It takes some explanation. To put this in perspective, we have stayed at Paradisus Cuba and Mayan Riviera. This hotel is prettier and cooler, but fell short.

Pros: beautiful grounds and The Reserve beach is a nice area; nice rooms (once you get what you confirmed); the food and service at the Reserve is much better than else where on property; good gym; convenient and easy transport to the beach; nice pools at the Reserve and main hotel; GREAT bar staff at the Reserve Miguel and Erys); GREAT pool staff (Germania - aka Naomi); the beach and ocean are beautiful. Breath taking. 

Cons: before I get into this, keep in mind, we have stayed at numerous all inclusive, boutique and 5* resorts in the Caribbean and Mexico. And my husband previously worked in the travel business. We understand and have an appreciation for service and all inclusive. The only way to go at this one is to book with a butler. 

When we arrived, they told us we had been “upgraded” to a lesser room than what we had booked online with the hotel directly and had proof of booking, understanding the room was guaranteed with a king bed. Our “upgrade” was 300USD less, 2 dble beds and a view of the parking lot. It was the worst “premium master 1 bedroom” in the furthest back corner of the hotel. Who has ever heard of an “upgrade” to a lesser room at a lesser price? Bogus. Clearly, they had over booked. They denied it up and down. We had to make a scene for a better room and they finally agreed to switch us to next day to a suite with a king bed and a better view. But they weren’t happy about it. We were much happier as this met our confirmation and expectations. 

Another disappointment - Previous times, we have booked family concierge at the other Paradisus hotels, but didn’t this time. Why not? We called Meliá directly to discuss room options and figure out what each category delivered before we booked (the web site is confusing). They told us because our children were 11 and 14, we didn’t really need family concierge or a butler. It was mostly for little kids. BIG MISTAKE. It was hard finding pool or beach chairs with shade because they were all reserved for families with butlers. Even when no one showed up by 1030am for their palapas at the pool or beach, we weren’t allowed to take. 10 am was supposed to be the cut off when others were allowed to use. So basically, you felt like you were interloping, waiting for a better chair.

It was also Impossible to get decent reservations for dinner because premium times are reserved for families with butlers. Fully booked or 9pm was what we were told - way too late for kids. Tried it one night at Bana (tapinakyi). We had a 9pm reservation. We were seated at 945 and done dinner at 11. Not fair to the kids. If you can afford it, family concierge is a much better option. 

Thankfully, the food at Gabi Reserve was excellent. I’m a nutritionist and have high standards. The food quality and selection was amazing,

reviews.author: anne-lise B
reviews.title: Paradisiaque mais ...
reviews.text: Nous avons effectué notre second séjour de 15 jours à la réserve Punta Cana. Le cadre est magnifique, tout est mis en place pour que le séjour soit reposant. Les points forts : le cadre, l’entretien de l’hôtel et des jardins (impeccables), la literie (et c’est important), la nourriture (toujours bonne et variée), le personnel agréable et le kid zone ! Nos enfants aussi ont passé un merveilleux séjour grâce à des animatrices en or, à l’écoute des besoins de chaque enfant, toujours souriantes. Yafresy, Michelle, Martina, Jairol, Johanna, Epifany y Katiuska gracias ! Le kid zone est propre et grand. Notre fils de 16 mois a été chouchouté et notre grande de 6 ans s’est beaucoup amusée notamment pendant les temps de piscine. Seul bémol les horaires d’ouverture ne sont pas en adéquation avec les besoins des parents. Beaucoup de parents auraient aimé déposer les petits à 9h (notamment pour les excursions) mais ça ouvre à 10h. Et ça ferme à 10h du soir(!!), ce qui est très étrange et inutile. Les points faibles :  les prix ont doublés depuis notre dernier séjour d’il y a trois ans et sur place aucun changement ni amélioration, plutôt même l’inverse je dirai. Un spot de la piscine principale a flotté pendant une semaine à la surface, peut être flotte t il toujours ... à la réserve le service au restaurant laisse à désirer (20 minutes pour avoir un café), on doit demander les choses trois fois avant de les obtenir (on a attendu 40 minutes et dû appeler trois fois pour avoir un lit bébé à 21h après 18h de trajet ...), les activités qui étaient bien calées il y a trois ans partent en cacahuète total, changement de lieu, d’horaire ... on a eu l’impression de courir après pendant quinze jours. Ce sont des « détails » qui ne passent plus à un certain tarif. Augmenter les prix pourquoi pas mais dans ce cas là on augmente la qualité. Pourtant on aurait aimé revenir pour le cadre et pour les animateurs qui sont attachants (Pedro, Capuccino y Marionnel que notre petit garçon a adoptés et qui nous ont amusés, Luis le danseur ...)

reviews.author: willc704
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort...but the service is terrible
reviews.text:
Despite being a beautiful resort, the service here is horrible

Room: The room was nice. We stayed in the Paradisus Suite in Building 40. The room had a separate bedroom, living room, and bathroom included a Jacuzzi Tub, which was in a room that was separate from the bathroom and the bedroom, however, it did not work as well as expected and there was not much hot water. The bathroom was very nice, however the shower was confusing to operate, as it had three different knobs that were not labelled as clearly as they should have been. In the separate living room, there was a flat screen TV, which was somewhat dated, a small kitchen area with a sink, a cabinet with glasses, and a minibar. The living room did have a pull out couch that was somewhat uncomfortable, but even with the couch pulled out, there was ample space for a roll-away bed. Finally, the living room did have a table, however, in a room that sleeps 4, there were only two chairs, so getting room service was not possible. Overall, an okay room.

Housekeeping: Housekeeping took a very long time to come and clean everyday. We were told that our room would be cleaned 3 times a day, however, one day, it was not even touched by 6 PM! It also took a very long time to get our minibar restocked. Overall, horrible

Restaurants and Bars: The Reserve had two restaurants, Vento, Hydro Grill and Gabi Club. Gabi Club is the buffet. There were many options, but none for kids, which was not good for my children who are very picky eaters.The buffet also was lacking in other options that we had at other resorts, like a Pasta station, fondue, etc.  In addition, because we could never get a waiter for coffee or drinks, we had to walk to the bar and get them ourselves. During the trip, we also ate at Mole (Mexican), The Grill (steak), and Aqua (Italian), which are all at the main Paradisus section. Vento (Italian, Reserve only) had terrible service but had good food, The food at the other three restaurants was very good and the service was great and quick. However, if you do not have a reservation, you are screwed, and are forced to eat really early, really late, or at the buffet. All of the bars were fast to get you a drink and they all had espressos.

Workers: Most of the concierge workers are trying to sell to you; either a time share or an excursion. They do not ask you outright, but do things like help to change our reservations and help us around the resort. This did happen to us. A worker, who I will not name did help us, and then invited us to the sister resort @ Palma Real for a lunch, but when we declined, he did not speak to us for the rest of the entire trip. 

Grounds: The grounds were beautiful, and the beach was kept very clean! The resort was very big and shuttles ran every ten minutes and were very quick! 

Others:
The hotel has great nightlife, and great pools

tl;dr
Okay Rooms, Bad Service, Nice Grounds
We won't be returning. 5/10

reviews.author: JOHN O
reviews.title: Shattered Expectations.
reviews.text:
Our booking was made on the 17th February 2017 and fully prepaid in December 2017.

Three days before we were due to start our 19 day holiday commencing 16th January 2018, we received an email from the Reservation department informing us that due to "unforeseen circumstances" that we would not be provided the ocean front suite we had booked.

They left us with no option but to accept lower grade accommodation and with the minimal compensation which they eventually agreed to.  They gave us no notice, so we could not investigate other hotel options.

We are a couple in our 70's and the whole objective of the holiday was to relax on an ocean front view terrace enjoying our books and waking up in the morning looking out to sea.
Glynis and her team at the Royal Service desk did their best but they had limited choices available to offer us.  The room we were given was north facing Garden View with no sunlight coming into the room causing it to be damp.  The bedding felt wet and the room had unpleasant smells of mildew which could not be hidden by repeated applications of bleach.

The resort is in a stunning location and is maintained to a high standard by all the very friendly staff.  It is a pity that we did not get the room we booked and the first half of our holiday was stressful taken up with trying to resolve compensation issues with Management.
We like the Melia product but because of the attitude and incompetence of this management we will not be going back to Palma Real.

reviews.author: doll06666899
reviews.title: Mixed Experience
reviews.text:
This is one of the most expensive hotels in the DR yet have had better experiences at lower cost locations (notably Royalton).  The food was ok, rooms are dated, and the activities are limited.  The lobby was beautiful and beach was perfect.  The resort is really quiet.  

The biggest upside of the trip was the people at the resort.  Literally can say it was like we made new friends.  Freddy Mota at the pool was the best - always smiling and taught us a bunch of Spanish.   Great service too.  :).   Yenny at the buffet was always friendly and helpful - and highly attentive to the needs of the visitors.  

The only reason I’d be tempted to return would be the people at this resort.

reviews.author: TomJoePat
reviews.title: Disappointed: Average at best
reviews.text: This was our third trip to Punta Cana and each time we chose a non-adults only resort.  The other times were fine, this time not so much. Three examples: the main buffet dining room was an obstacle course of children running, the a la carte reservation restaurants (with dress codes) had children upside down on chairs and loudly playing their handheld games and lastly running around the main bar even after 10pm! Quite frankly these issues are the resorts fault as much as that of the parents but having said that management should take some control.  Despite the a la carte dress codes on the brochures and the webpage in the lobby, people were wearing bathing suits and sandals in their so called  prestigious Steak house.  When asked, they apologized and said their webpage hadn't been updated.  The buffet food was just average and stayed the same the entire week. It appeared they were understaffed and unorganized as the service was very poor. ie: waitng for coffee, asking for but not receiving etc.  It just wasn't up to the standard we were led to believe...a swimmer at the swim up bar stood on the bar, grabbed bottles from the serving side and poured liquor into the mouths of the boisterous group there.  Something out of animal house. Servers were preoccupied on the deck side of the bar.  Again, understaffed.  The pool was so cold it was not swimable.  They must have had to empty it and refill it just before our arrival. Virtually no one was in the pool the entire week.  This resort also doesn't have complimentary access to catamaran sailboats which baffled me as their webpage shows a photo of one when describing availability of motorized and non-motorized watercraft?  I will say the green areas of the resort are very nice and the rooms were very good as well.  Wouldn't recommend this specific resort though.

reviews.author: JosiasMoraes
reviews.title: Local muito agradável. Senti muita segurança, pois perdi uma mochila e me foi devolvida pelo gerente Yammel.
reviews.text: Os maleiros, condutores e funcionários em geral são muito simpáticos. Destaque para o maleiro Mário, muito amável e prestativa. Comida e limpeza, entretanto, deixam um pouco a desejar. Restaurantes típicos, servem comidas atípicas.  Todos os passeios, serviços  e produtos cobrados devem ser negociados, pois a maior parte é terceirizada e os preços de lista são absurdos. Para se ter uma idéia, uma simples massagem  no SPA do complexo hoteleiro, que em lista custava U$ 270,00, saiu por U$ 50,00. Gorgetas resolvem quase tudo! O melhor de tudo é set "All Inclusive"!

reviews.author: tandypolo
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
This was our second visit to a Melia property, so we had something to compare to. (We've stayed at Paridisus Esmeralda playa del Carmen).
Pros- the beach is very nice, broad, sandy, beautiful turquoise water. The restaurants were fairly easy to get into after the first night- they let you make reservations for your entire stay at once. Bana was our favorite . The rooms were large and roomy. The gym facilities were very nice, as was the spa. For the most part the staff was friendly, attentive and pleasant. 
Cons- we stayed on the ground floor and has visits from cockroaches, centipedes, spiders and mosquitos. They likely came from the garden. The front desk couldn't do anything for us because they were full to capacity. They fumigated and cleaned the room with bleach, which seemed to do the trick (we slept with the bathroom lights on as a deterrent though). They room was musty and tired. It could use some updating. Most furniture was damaged. Once they bleached the room, it smelled much better. We also removed the fabric canopy from above the bed which helped with the moldy smell. Asked for a bleach cleanse and remove the canopy if the mold bothers you. 
This property was great if you just want to relax. There is not a whole lot to do on the property at night. I didn't notice metered taxis either. There are two shopping areas about 15 min away - small malls. The beach was very windy this week- but that wasn't the hotel's fault. It was difficult to sit on the beach as the sand was whipping and our faces. A lot of seaweed was also on the beach and in the water. Many of the chairs needed to be replaced. It was more comfortable by the pool. However, you only received cushions on the reserve side.
We had trouble with the food and resorted to pasta and rice every day. There is a large selection at the buffet but not enough for our liking. (We generally don't like all inclusive food though). I suggest staying at the Reserve or paying more for the Royal service if you want access to certain restaurants or beach/pool areas. We felt limited. All in all it was a nice week. Next vacation we won't do the all-inclusive type of place.

reviews.author: Jesse G
reviews.title: It's beautiful, but overpriced. Cancun has much better options.
reviews.text:
I returned last Monday from a 5 night stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana with my wife and kids (6 and 8 years old).

What we liked:

- The resort grounds are beautiful and they put a LOT of effort into maintaining it.

- The large pool by the beach is AWESOME!  I wish we would have gone there on the first day, then we wouldn't have bothered spending time in the pools at the reserve (which are much colder and much less interesting).

- There were many kind and helpful staff members there. (Not all, but many)

- Our kids really liked the trampoline station.

- We had dinner at Passion. That was the highlight by far. We had an excellent experience there. Really great food and service! (The only actual part of the experience I would give 5-stars).

- Our family concierge set up a surprise bubble bath with balloons for our kids at an awesome time. They REALLY enjoyed that.

- We got the "Family Concierge One-Bedroom Suite". It was a nice room (with a few minor issues).

What we didn't like:

- They make you wear bracelets. (I know a lot of resorts make you do this, but I personally don't like it)

- The food was very low quality.  We've stayed at 3 all-inclusive resorts in Cancun (which were less expensive and WAY better quality food). We were very disappointed. The only things I enjoyed eating were the chips and guac at Mole (the "mexican" restaurant whose menu consists of only 20% mexican food) and the room service coffee (the only good coffee you can get there).

- The drinks were very low quality. I realize that most all-inclusive resorts tend to offer low-quality drinks. We're not alcoholics and aren't looking to get drunk or anything, but you really couldn't ever tell there was any alcohol in the drinks at all. I didn't mind the El Presidente beer for what it was.

- They give you "cards" to "check out" towels at the pool and if you forget to bring them back you theoretically lose the privilege of getting more towels. However, we didn't receive any cards when we checked in so we got the stinky face when we asked for towels the first time. They gave us 2 (even though we had 4 people).  I realize they're trying to conserve resources, but WTF? We paid a lot of money to come here, don't make us feel like beggars to get a towel!

- Because the food at the buffets is so blah, you really hope that the restaurants will come through and be awesome. "The Grill" and "Mole" were better than the rest, but they were not great. "The Grill" charges you money for anything that looks good. The thing I hated most about the restaurants is how they require you to make reservations 24 hours in advance. So, after a long day of travel, you arrive at the resort, have a long checkin, then you have to make decisions about restaurants (without any good information available). They tell you to download an app on your phone so you can learn about them, but the app is useless. At one point we wanted to change a dinner reservation. The family concierge said "We really don't have a way of doing that, if you really want to change reservations, you can walk 10 minutes down to the restaurant yourself to ask".  I was like what am I paying you for? You're the concierge. Why is this difficult?  They create this sense of "scarcity" for restaurant reservations. No idea why. So dumb. And they're not even good restaurants!

- The "Hibachi" restaurant was really weird. We had the first reservation of the night, but since the tables seat 12, we had to wait for like 20 minutes for some no-shows before we were able to be sat.  I have eaten at a few Hibachi restaurants in the US which were very entertaining and delicious. This was neither. 

- At 4 out of 5 breakfasts, I had to walk over to the waiters who were hanging out to ask for a coffee refill. It was not busy at all.

- The "Family Concierge One-Bedroom Suite" was nice overall. We liked having a separate bedroom from our kids (who slept on the pullout couch). We didn't like that the toilet room had a glass door. We also didn't like how many doors there were! I think we counted 13 doors in our little room, you really had to work to get from the main bed to the bathroom.

- There were two nights when we had been out all day and came home to our room being cleaned (right before dinner time). Just seemed like bad timing and you had to wait for like 15 minutes for the room to be ready.  They did an awesome job making the rooms nice and we showed a lot of appreciation (verbally and in terms of tipping), but I am just listing things I didn't like.

- The family concierge thing was a waste of money for us. The balloon bath was nice, but other than that, we really found zero benefit.

- Our kids didn't like the Kids Zone (except for 1 hour they spend in the kids pool with one of the guys). The year previous we stayed at the Hyatt Ziva in Cancun and they never wanted to leave the kids club there, so my wife and I had a lot of hopes that they would enjoy the Kids Zone in Punta Cana. They spent 3 hours and never wanted to go back. They just said they felt forced to do activities they didn't want to do.

- I wish we hadn't chosen to stay at The Reserve. Our primary motivation was to be close to the Kids Zone, but that didn't work out for us.  The food options at the Reserve are the worst in the resort. The pool is colder and way less interesting than the pool near the beach. We also spent a lot more time walking / shuttling back and forth between the beach and our room.

- My wife took my son to two of the shows. A circus show and the "Lion King". They said it was so loud that they left after 20 minutes. 

Conclusion:

I realize it may sound like I am a stuck up jerk who can't appreciate anything or anyone. However... we've stayed at 3 all-inclusives in Cancun: Live Aqua, Hyatt Ziva and Moon Palace. While none of them were exceptional in every respect, Hyatt Ziva and Live Aqua were WAY, WAY better than Paradisus Punta Cana by a long shot and less expensive.

I am not entitled to a heavenly experience and I don't expect that in my day-to-day life. However, when I am spending many thousands of dollars on a trip, I expect to get value out of that. It happens that I got a LOT more value in Cancun than at Paradisus Punta Cana.

I think the people who work at Paradisus work VERY hard and we really appreciated that (and showed it with words and generous tips), however... The people in charge are making bad decisions. This is a 3 star resort, but they're trying to sell it as a 5 star resort. They have stupid policies (restaurant reservations, towels, etc) and really bad food. They can do a lot better.

reviews.author: Julianasal
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 5 night stay in Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real. I traveled with my boyfriend and overall we have a mixed review and most likely will not return unless some changes are made. I would like to thank our butler Ariel Benzo for the exceptional butler service that was provided throughout the week. He was attentive, thoughtful, and very responsive. He made my birthday very special and made sure all of our issues in the room were resolved. Ariel was the main reason we enjoyed our stay here despite the many shortcomings.

Royal Service: We upgraded to royal service which provided a butler service and access to an exclusive restaurant, and an outdoor pool area with a bar. If the price difference is minimal I would say it is worth it for the butler service, but otherwise not worth is as the exclusive pool area is very small and the service at the pool and beach was really lacking and at times non-existent.

Room: We had a garden view suite on the first floor which was very convenient and private. For us, the “king” bed was actually two queen beds pushed together so the bed was huge. The sheets and blankets are shared and you cannot feel the separation between the beds so this was fine. Our room (1103) definitely had issues when we arrived that took a few days to resolve. For example our safe was not working and we kept being told it was the key, no it’s the battery. We could not get a straight answer and had to carry our valuables around for the first 2 days which was rather annoying. Other issues we noticed: the fridge did not get very cold at all (and was not restocked unless we asked) and the phone cord was too short so we can to keep it in the center of our bed before it was fixed three days later.

Someone should have checked all of these things, especially the safe, before anyone was able to check into this room. Also the issues should have been resolved immediately or we should have been sent to a new room. Our butler did offer to move us to a new room after 2 days but it seemed like more of a hassle to move everything.

Housekeeping: they cleaned the rooms once per day but the little things started to bother me: did not restock toilet paper or espresso cups. We had to stick our heads out of the room to find someone to help. Or we would call and they would bring one espresso cup. 

Service at the Pool and Beach was NON-EXISTENT. The reason people come to all-inclusive resorts is to relax. This is not possible at this resort because there is no one serving drinks at the pool or beach. We sat on the beach in the royal service section for an entire day and were not approached one time asking of we would like something to drink. This means that you have to keep walking back and forth to the pool bar if you would like anything. We did have service by Martin one day which was good but he was only one of two servers on the beach so attention was limited. The other issue is that there is no food service on the beach or snack bar for lunch. This means if you would like to eat during the day you have to go to a sit down restaurant or the buffet. This really takes away from time in the sun and out enjoyment of the day. If these two items were changed we would be more than happy to return.

Food: Overall we really enjoyed the food! I am pretty picky but found something I liked at each restaurant, although we did not try them all. Highlights for us were dinners at Fuego (for the food only, service was pretty terrible) and Rare (good food and exceptional service by Johnny). 

Palazzo is the exclusive royal service restaurant. The highlight was hostess. I think her name was Fatima. She was so kind and accommodating each time we visited the restaurant. Management should take note that this is what service should be like throughout the entire resort. The waitstaff was ok not great, could definitely be trained better. And the noise from construction was unbearable throughout breakfast and lunch.

Overall we had a good week at the Paradisus Palma Real royal service. This resort has a ton of potential, especially the location right on the beach, but the service is really lacking. Honesty, with the exception of our fantastic butler Ariel and the host at Palazzo, the staff needs to be trained and standards need to be raised. It truly felt like the staff did not want to be there and were you were bothering them if you asked for anything. I have stayed at other all inclusive resorts and have never experienced this before. Therefore we will not return and if you are looking to truly be pampered I would find somewhere else to stay until the Management makes some real changes with the level of service at this resort.

reviews.author: TravelAddict6464
reviews.title: Rooms Very Far from Beach
reviews.text:
A resort within Paradisus Punta Cana with newer rooms but the facility is very far from the beach and many rooms face the road!  Make sure to ask for a room facing the pool if you want a view and/or more tranquility. Unfortunately the golf cart for transport does not come by very often and Circle members (time share) have first priority so be prepared for allot of walking!

Rooms are newer but the closet is very small and it was hard to fit all my clothes.  I cannot imagine a family or couple sharing such a small closet.  I also experienced many maintenaince issues with room especially with air conditioning.  Room was so cold that I couldn't sleep for first 3 nights, even though I made several calls to fix!

The pool is wonderful with plenty of activities (best part), but the bar does not serve premium alcohol which I am surprised at given the price paid!  Spa has very limited water therapy activities.  Food is average.

Overall, I would not return given that there are 100+ resorts and many newer with better amenities along the Bavaro, Punta Cana strip.

reviews.author: Tylerlu
reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.text:
So the good first, the resort is beautiful. Grounds are immaculate. The beach is beautiful as well. The staff were very friendly and helpful when asked. The Bana restaurant is the only one we enjoyed. Sushi and grill there were very good. Fuego the Peruvian restaurant had excellent ceviche. The rest of the menu not so much. 

The negative is that the rooms need a bit of updating and renovation and the food overall was not very good. We had a hot and miss mostly of dishes we enjoyed. 
The buffet while extensive was not very good. Most of the food was lukewarm and dried out. Get the made to order foods if you go there. As they will be hot. It’s the only thing open for breakfast amongst all of the restaurants that we could figure out. 
The last two mornings we ordered room service and it was much better. 

The palazzo which was the exclusive royal service restaurant was not impressive. I ordered a scallop risotto and the scallops were tiny dehydrated pieces chopped up in it and the rolls were hard as a rock. The eggplant appetizer dish was good. 
We did pay for the royal service but beyond our butler making reservations and the better seats on the beach there wasn’t a huge difference. That being said, the seats on the beach are super nice and that made it worth it. There were several people sneaking over from the resort next door and no one seemed to notice. 
The first two days on the beach we did not have anyone come take drink orders until I asked. 

The royal service room we were in was a garden view but it backed up to the service road and we hear vehicles, trucks and equipment being moved most of the night. 

If we go the the Dominican again we will try a different place. I had to give it three stars because the resort was so beautiful and the beach was so nice.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.title: Mediocre - 8 day stay, second visit to Paradisius Palma Real.
reviews.text:
Cons:
- time share pressure was extremely rude, annoying.  concierge is responsible for making reservations at restaurants.  My concercierge, Kati spoke very little English. I explained I was here last year and attended the time share mutual and was not interested. The next day she catches my attention and again she is literally begging me to attend a meeting and that she will give me two free massages or a $50 gift voucher and that it would take 20 minutes.  To appease her I went to chat with them. I explained to them the exact same thing and they understood and asked me is there any point in me chatting with them or see a presentation again. I said no it is no, then they sent out their manager the manager was very rude and he said that he was there to run a business  and that they would not be giving me a free massage.  He insinuated that I was there merely to get a free massage and not to listen to the presentation. This was not the case I was merely doing Kati a favour, I specifically told her I do not want a massage and she insisted that it was something that I would receive.   In fact she told me that she would give me two free massages. And then this manager comes out and tells me that they would not be giving me anything. I did not care for any motivation or incentive.  The manager could not have been more rude. I get massages all the time at where I live. I was merely doing the concierge, Kati a favour.   I am not  impressed with this tactic when a person is on holiday.   The reason I am letting Travelers know about this is they will tell you that it will take 45 minutes of your time, this is not true they will keep you there in excess of one hour, they are using this incentive IE. Free massage or a $50 gift voucher to be spent at the hotel, to lure you to attend their  timeshare "Circle" meeting.  Personally, this is a big turn off for me.  Feufteen minutes of my life wasted with these timeshare business.  Note that they will express their dusmay to your face, when you express no interest, and do not stay for their complete sales pitch.  

.  They ask you to present a towel card to get a beach towel. When you return the towel they give you back a beach card. Purpose of this is to ensure that you return your towel. I found this  very inconvenient, and I let the concierge genesis no and I asked her to do something about it. Genesis was very kind and attentive and looking after my concerns. She spoke spoke  English well. I let her know for the remainder of my stay I will not be presenting a towel card to receive a towel nor will I be returning a towel. I explained that this is a five star hotel and I am wearing a bracelet so why would I need to present a towel card,  I found this to be insulting and insinuating that people would steal towels. I was here in March 2017 and they did not have this towel procedure in place. 

The concierge that was assigned to me specifically Kati was not helpful whatsoever. However another concierge, Genesis spoke English well, was extremely friendly and understanding sympathetic and helpful. 

 Upon check in to my room there were several deficiencies including a safe that was not attached or secured anything. It was like a loose shoe box. As well the combination attachment/ mechanism was loose. A lightbulb needed to to be replaced. A lizard needed to be removed.  I was locked into the bathroom,  and could not get the door open. I had to climb out of the bathroom through the window shutters. The temperature of the water in the shower constantly fluctuated from cool to too hot. This is not safe.

. Hotel is worn and needs to be updated.

. The Bavaro Beach is public therefore there are vendors everywhere constantly approaching me asking me to purchase their goods. Picture this, here I am lying on a lounge chair and venders literally come within 2 feet of me and asks me whether I want to have my hair braided or to purchase bags hats sunglasses.  They weave/walk all around the people on lounge chairs to solicit.  This made me  very uncomfortable and unsafe. As well as  I am walking along the beach they will  approach  and ask me to take an excursion, to go shopping in their stores along the beach, this unwanted solicitation is constant, and annoying.

. Communication difficulty because some staff do not speak English well, and definitely should if they are assigned to an English speaking guest as myself.

Pros:
. Good variety of restaurants.  Some food was very good. Great varieties of food.
. My room was cleaned well daily.
. Nightly entertainment which was okay.
. Some staff are friendly and helpful.
. Paddle board exercising was great, taught by Xavier, Noel, Hanson.
. Enjoyed the mini trampouline exercise session.

reviews.author: Carolina P
reviews.title: No es el mejor hotel de la zona
reviews.text: Mi jacuzzi se aberio y mojo toda la habitacion de abajo. Fue un caos. Ademas de que la bebida no es de la mejor calidad para el precio que pagas. Ademas de que la comida de buffet siempre estaba fria. Recomendaria que vieran antes de ir como esta la playa por que estaba muy alta la marea en Enero.

reviews.author: orudiskt
reviews.title: Four Adults who paid for Adults Only Royal Service put in Kids Hotel
reviews.text:
Checked in today and I don’t understand how 4 adults who paid for the adults only Royal Service extras were put in an area of the resort without this service.  If I wanted to be surrounded by kids I could’ve stayed home. Taking a shuttle to the adult only section is a total hassle and not a real solution. 

Also, the outdoor restaurant in this hotel was dirty when we arrived today and there were flies everywhere.  

I expected more overall.

reviews.author: leahb908
reviews.title: Not sure how I feel about this property...
reviews.text:
The common areas of the hotel were very nice and the food was fantastic! Sit down restaurant portions were very small, however.

The beach is lovely and cleaned often, and there are lots of chairs.

But - basic maintenance was lacking and several things in our 1 bedroom suite were in obvious need of repair and/or didn’t work at all. Rooms are VERY noisy. We could hear the people in the next room, everyone who walked down the hallway, even people outside.

The mini bar, coffee, and bottled water were inconsistently stocked from night to night. And FYI the only place to get coffee in the morning is at the buffet and it is not a convenient process. 

The staff were not particularly friendly or helpful, which at times was quite frustrating. You wondered if they were walking away to get you what you asked for or just walking away (both were normal).

I wouldn’t stay away from this property for these reasons necessarily, but for an upscale hotel I expect better and I’m not sure the quality is worth the price.

reviews.author: islandgirl88
reviews.title: Clean, comfortable but not the greatest beach experience. Really for pool people.
reviews.text: This was my first time to an all inclusive and also first time to the Dominican. The rooms are very spacious and clean. The whole place was very clean. The beach was ok with lots of thatched "umbrellas" and lounge chairs but lots of hawkers except  before 10am bothering you all day. The buffet was ok and the Agua restaurant was the best food wise. There was only one  restaurant (other than the buffet) which was open to the night air which was too bad. I think it was called Fuego. Some of the others had the AC blasting. The staff very pleasant but they failed to mention at check in that one should not drink the tap water. Also the beach while nice was not to compare to Turks and Cayman where the water is also safe. And they do rope you off not far from shore. It's fine but if you really like to swim a bit cramped feeling.  And motor boats passing close to the swim area with para-sailors a lot of the time too. Not the most relaxing beach experience at all.

reviews.author: Ronald G
reviews.title: Amazing hotel, spectacular food but ...
reviews.text:
We visited this hotel and we were impressed by the facilities. There was a problem with our flight and we ended up arriving to the hotel around midnight, we were hungry but we were concerned if eating snacks at midnight was going to cause us stomach problems. The snacks were real food, they even had a chef that cooked something for us, it was amazing.

We had a small problem with the AC of the room (at 3am) but they turned it off and changed us to a different room first thing on the morning.

Food was amazing, hotel employees were great, very diligent and always help us with a big smile.

We will definitely come back.

Said that, there is a BUT, the concierge contacted us with a lady that was selling the Melia program, she met with us for lunch and after that everything was terrible. She was so intense and pushy, we did not enjoy the lunch, she was nice at first but when I asked for a paper and a pen to make some numbers if the program made sense versus continue booking different hotels, she got upset and told us that if she gives me the paper then the deal was off. We spent almost 3 hours with her, we ended up feeling bad, almost stalked and I told her that I was going to make the numbers on my room and get back to her at 4pm (which she agreed to wait for me and met in their office) then I ended up finding that she left to attend other clients and she didn’t bother to tell us ( I told her that we were going to be in the room) Why I complaint about her of not being there!!! Because I spent 20 minutes getting there and 20 minutes going back for my wife.

We will come back, we liked the hotel, the people (except her), the food, the beach but I think they should be more careful on how they treat customers just for selling a 25-50 years royalty program.

reviews.author: AlexTMoscow
reviews.title: С каждым годом всё хуже...
reviews.text:
Отзыв получился длинным, но ничего не поделаешь - накипело.

Это уже моё третее посещение этого отеля. Первый раз был 10 лет назад, когда Парадизусу было всего 2,5 года. Отель был велеколепен. Ещё через 2,5 года, когда мы приехали во второй раз, он уже начал ветшать. В наш 3-й и уж точно последний раз я, конечно, догадывался, что отель не станет лучше, но надеялся, что хоть где-то что-то обновят. Зря.
Обо всём по порядку.
Заселили нас достаточно быстро. Правда забыли кое-что сделать, об этом позже. Мы жили в обычном корпусе (не Royal Service), но в 2 bedroom master suite. Номер большой, с мрамором в ванной, но в нём всё разваливается! Провисшие дверцы шкафчиков, отломанные части гидромассажного душа, перегоревшие лампочки, не таботающий телефон, не работающий телевизор, проржавевший замок балконной двери, тарахтящий холодильник, сломавшаяся древней конструкции кофе-машина и, несмотря на наличие кухни, полное отсутсвие посуды, кроме стаканов и 2 бокалов во второй спальне. Что-то по моей просьбе устранили, что-то так и не смогли.
Нас поселили на 3 этаж, на нашей вилле не было лифта, что при наличии 2 маленьких детей представляло определённые неудобства, когда надо было затащить наверх коляску со спящим ребёнком.
Уборка номеров посредственная и каждый раз в разное время. Воду обновляют не понятно как, приходилось приносить из бара. Полотенца тоже когда поменяют, когда нет. Тоже самое с обновлением геля для душа. Мини-бар обновили всего 2 раза за 2 недели!
Когда я первы раз попытался сдать одежду в стирку, то спустя некоторое время мне позвонили и сказали, что не могут её взять, т.к. эта услуга платная, а при регистрации не взяли данные моей кредитной карты. Пришлось бежать на ресепшн и оставлять эти данные. Что самое удивительное, при этом в ресторанах за милую душу нам приносили вино, которое было за доплату. 
Дальше пляж. Лежаки продавленые, а попадаются и просто сломанные. Есть специальные части пляжа для гостей Royal Service и Family Concierge - там лежаки получше, но в Royal Service не селят с детьми, а Family Concierge находится в La Reserve, а это в полукилометре от моря. Полотенца дают по карточкам! Я уже и не вспомню, когда я сталкивался с подобным. И да, при заселении мне никто не дал эти карточки! На пляже или рядом с ним нет никакого детского клуба, он есть только в La Reserve, да, в том самом, до которого полкилометра! 
У басейна есть бар. Бармены вежливы и услужливы, но делают всё просто нарочито небрежно.
Сам пляж шикарный - широченный с тончайшим белым песочком, совершенно без коралов! Когда мы были там в этот раз, было очень много водорослей. С песка их постоянно убирали трактором, но всё он убрать не мог, ну а в море водоросли плавали постоянно. Это конечно не вина отеля. 
Е!ть какие-то развлечения - танцы, йога на воде, иногда ставят надувные батуты и горки. 
Территория отеля шикарная! Она большая, озеленённая и ухоженная. Есть пруды с черепахами и фламинго. Но при этом в одном месте жутко воняет канализацией причём 7 лет назад она так же воняла в том же самом месте. За 7 лет ничего нельзя было сделать?! Как то раз во всё отеле на пару часов пропала вода. 
О еде. В рестораны а-ля карт очень сложно записаться - делать это надо за пару дней и то не гарантировано, что будут места, а если будут то в не самое удобное время. Но я хочу сказать, что общая "столовка" вкуснее других ресторанов. И уж точно быстрее. Из а-ля карт нам понравился только Bento и то за десертами лучше зайти в общий ресторан. В нём много разнообразной и достаточно вкусной еды. Даже бесплатное вино вполне себе. Единственное, чего не хватает во всех ресторанах, это свежевыжатых соков. Какое-то подобие есть только на завтраке, а в остальное время какая-то разведенная бурда. Сами завтраки тоже хорошие. Еще в общем ресторане не менят приборы, если только не попросить. Официанты вежливые и дружелюбные, но всего просто не успевают. Отдельно хочется рассказать, как мы пошли на тепаньяки. Понятно, что к настоящему тепаньяки это имеет очень опосредованное отношение, но зато там должно было быть шоу поваров. Наш повар гостей не развлекал никак. А в конце просто взял и ушёл не сказав ни слова. Мы заказали десерт, подождали 40 минут и ушли в столовку. 
Да, румсервис ужасный. Выбора почти нет - только пицца и бургеры и те та себе.
Персонал плохо понимает по-английски.
Хочу отметить, что, когда у меня заболел ребёнок, мне выделили сотрудника отеля, с которым мы поехали на багги к врачу в соседний отель Melia, а потом на отельной машине в больницу к педиатору. Такая забота тронула.
При этом особенно не понравилось, что в отеле всё заточено, чтобы люди покупали допуслуги вроде Royal Service и пытаются впарить членство в каком-то клубе. Я не против того, чтобы отель дополнительно зарабатывал, но нельзя же для этого ставить сломанные лежаки на общий пляж! Ко мне и в этот раз подошла русская сотрудница отеля, чтобы продать членство. Но в прошлые разы они былиэкуда более навязчивыми. По пляжу тоже ходили в меру навязчивые сотрудники продающие всякие полёты на парашюте и т.п.
Ну и напоследок вишенка на торте. В последний день мне позвонили и попросили подойти на ресепшн с картой, которой я оплатил проживание за 7 месяцев до этого. Я объяснил, что этой карты больше не существует в природе, т.к. банк её перевыпустил. Уже на выписке мне сказали, что я должен оплатить своё проживание второй раз, т.к. по их правилам я должен был предъявить ту же самую карту, которой оплачивал проживание, а первый платёж мне вернут в течение 10 банковских дней! Почему 10 дней? Почему мне об этом не сказали в первый день?! Деньги как раз успели бы вернуться. Почему я вообще должен платить второй раз, почему им недостаточно моего физического присутствия с паспортом? Единственное, что они сделали это написали мне на бланке бумагу, что деньги вернут. Так и я мог бы написать, что не буду требовать назад заплаченные 7 месяцев назад деньги! А если бы у меня на карте не было этой суммы? Наверное я никого не удивлю, что когда 10 банковских дней прошли, я ничего не получил. Пришлось звонить в отель и только тогда их мне вернули.

Мне, как бизнесмену, было просто досадно смотреть, как отель, который прекрасноэрасположен и изначально отлично построен, не использует свой потенциал. Все недостатки можно достаточно недорого устранить. 

И да, отель, на мой взгляд очень не дорогой. Я давно не платил так мало за отдых. Возможно, у меня были завышеннные ожидания.

reviews.author: Traveling_Jewel
reviews.title: Average resort, Great staff (mostly), but don't plan to book again :-/
reviews.text:
My husband and I vacationed at Paradisus in August 2017.  We selected the Royal Service, Beachfront Accommodation.  Overall, it is a nice resort, but we do not think we’ll return to this particular resort because it did not meet our expectations.  The next time the Dominican Republic hits our vacation rotation, we’ll likely choose a different resort.  Please see the PROS and CONS below.

PROS:
Beachfront view:  The beachfront view from our room was spectacular.  If we were not on the beach or walking around the resort, I was spending some time on our balcony enjoying the view from our room.

People: 
•         Giselle in the Royal Service lounge was a delightful.  She was very cheerful and kind.  We had requested a room on a high floor, but we had been assigned one on a lower floor.  We asked if it was possible to change to a higher floor.  Giselle was SO accommodating.  She checked to see if one was available, went to check that it had an amazing view and made sure it was cleaned and made available to us.  She also walked us to the Palazzo restaurant for lunch.
•         Francesco, the Royal Service Manager, was very pleasant.  When we were preparing to leave, he could tell that we weren’t as excited about our stay when he indicated he hoped we would return.  He pressed us gently to explain our concerns because he wanted to know how they could improve.  I found that to be very professional and a characteristic of quality customer service.  Every comment won’t be positive, but it is important to accept constructive criticism and use it to improve.  We shared a few things with him and he was very receptive and apologetic.  He still asked that we complete a trip advisor commentary as well, and that is something that many would not have done if they thought it might include some criticisms.  It really made us feel that he would take our suggestions and use them to improve their services.
•         Juan De Aza and Felix, in the Palazzo restaurant, were excellent servers.  Both were very attentive, very nice and exhibited excellent customer service.  They were both a pleasure.
•         Fatima, in the Palazzo restaurant, was a lovely hostess.  She was always extremely friendly, seemed to genuinely ask how everything was going and bid us a pleasant farewell when we left the restaurant.  She is perfect for that position.
•         Ramon, the luggage and golf cart assistant, was charismatic.  He took us to the check-in counter and then escorted us to the Royal Service lounge.  He ensured our bags were taken care of while we waited to check in.  He also remembered us and was very friendly each time he’d see us around.  He is a great person for that position; however, if he chooses another customer-oriented position, he’d be great for that, too!
•         Juan, in the buffet restaurant, was a phenomenal server and he even remembered where we liked to sit and what beverages (non-alcoholic) we liked from the bar.
•         Jose De Jesus, the bartender in Palazzo, was magnificent.  From the first time we met him as he shadowed our Butler during the resort tour, he endeared himself to us.  He was very friendly and helpful.  Once we got settled and were trying to find a location on the resort, he actually left the Palazzo (they were closed for a break) to show us where we needed to go.  He prepared special non-alcoholic drinks and mocktails for us that were delicious.  He was very personable as well and we enjoyed speaking with him about his goals, his family, etc.  We hope that he is able to accomplish all of his endeavors.
•         Raphael, the beach attendant, was nice and he ensured we had a cabana or bed even when our butler had not reserved one or had not told us that we have to arrive at the beach before 10AM to maintain the reservation.  That was odd because we saw many reserved cabanas and Bali beds where the guests definitely were not there by 10AM nor several hours AFTER 10AM. 
•         Anthony, the server in Fuego, Naos and Vento restaurants, was very cordial and hospitable and he even helped me hone my Spanish skills.  There were two men named Anthony in Vento, so this refers to the Anthony who casts a larger shadow. ;-)
Adult-Only Restaurant: There is one adult-only restaurant on the premises and it is reserved for Royal Service guests.  The service was phenomenal, the atmosphere was generally calm and copacetic (except for a loud group one evening) and the food was delicious.  Our compliments to the chef and all who work to make that restaurant exceptional!

Yoga Class:  The yoga class was amazing.  I wish I had attended more frequently, but because of its location (see CONS below), I changed my mind.

Buffet Restaurant:  The buffet restaurant offered a great variety of foods that were delicious.  The lady at the ice cream counter should definitely be friendly.

WIFI:  The resort has a great wi-fi connection.

CONS:
Arrival coordination:  When we arrived, we were not asked our names or whether we had reserved Royal Service.  Royal Service included private, air-conditioned check-in with snacks and drinks.   After being taken to the check-in counter, they then realized that we were Royal Service customers and we were taken to the correct location.  Our suggestion is that, upon arrival, the attendants outside should greet the customers, ask for their names and have a system (i.e. a tablet, iPad or an alphabetical hardcopy of those who should arrive that day) to determine where they should check-in.

Butler Service:  We are loyal Sandals, Butler-Level customers, so our expectations for butler service were based on the Sandals level of butler service.  Sandals, however, is not currently available in the DR.  We selected this resort because it offered butler service.  Unfortunately, their butler service is very limited and left us longing for the level of service we receive at Sandals.  For example, we did not meet our Butler for HOURS after arriving.  We were told that the Butler cannot meet you until your room is ready.  That’s a poor practice.  The Butler should still greet the guests, provide a tour and then take them a restaurant if the guests would like to eat.  This resort’s Butlers leave at 4PM daily; however, that leaves a large portion of the day remaining for guests to fend for themselves even though they have paid extra for Butler service.  At Sandals, there are two shifts, so a Butler is available until at least the last restaurant reservation seating time and generally later than that.  Further, our Butler at this resort could not bring our room service, was not supposed to bring specialized drinks to our room, wasn’t supposed to bring beverages to us throughout the resort (particularly on the beach), wasn’t on duty to walk us to our restaurant dinner reservations, instructed us to call room service or housekeeping for things we needed in our room, and couldn’t use the cart to take us between resorts, to name a few.  Further, our Butler did not check in on us as frequently as we’re accustomed with Sandals. There were times when he’d say he was off, but we’d see him walking along the beach looking for certain guests and sitting with them and talking for quite some time.  Though we are extremely low-key, non-bothersome guests, we still expect the Butler to contact us throughout the day a few times if we haven’t contacted him/her.  At Sandals, all of these amenities and others are provided, and the responsibility for contacting other departments is not a part of our tasks while we are on vacation.  I arrange and schedule enough things at home, so I don’t want to have to do that on vacation when I’ve paid for a service that I believe should handle that.  Finally, if a Sandals Butler enters our room while we are out and we have dirty towels or room service items in the room, he/she ensures those items are handled appropriately, towels are replaced, etc. before we return, even if he/she has to do it.  That did not happen at Paradisus.  Our Butler would enter to leave treats only and didn’t even check to make sure our requests were completed.  I had requested various fragranced pillows throughout our stay.  We finally got some one night after asking again, but did not receive any others the remaining nights.  We suggest that the management staff meet with Sandals management and Butler department for some tips on how to improve their Butler service and perhaps send their Butlers to the same training school as Sandals butlers.

Adult-Only Restaurants:  There is only one adult-only restaurant and the same menu is offered for breakfast, lunch and dinner with some variation in the small plates buffet.  It would be nice to include more than one adult-only restaurant, have specific nights where the other a-la-carte restaurants become adult-only and/or provide themed nights at the Palazzo restaurant and/or modify the menu, so there is more variety.  The menu does not offer very many options, so having stayed for one week, it was easy to become bored with the offerings.

Service at the Beach:  Unfortunately, the service at the beach was not always consistent.  If I’m not relaxing in my room or walking around the resort or eating, I want to be on the beach enjoying myself.  In fact, I want to be able to enjoy a meal on the beach as well that is not just a mediocre pizza. The service that Raphael provided was OK, but when he was not at work, his replacement was rarely seen at all.  In fact, we had to call our Butler and ask him to tell us who we were supposed to see for beverages.  There should be staff walking around constantly asking if anyone needs a new drink, taking away empty containers, as well as bringing specialty drinks and waters on their trays that guests can select.  There were times when my husband had to go to the bar for service, and I noticed many others having to leave their comfortable cabanas and Bali beds to do likewise. 

Transportation between resorts:  I was very interested in the Yoga classes that were offered at the resort.  Unfortunately, the yoga class was located at the neighboring resort – The Reserve.  One day, we rode over to the other resort (being ignored by the golf cart driver as he spoke exclusively Spanish to the other couple about the resort grounds).  Once there, I realized I had arrived at the wrong time.  The ladies at the spa were amazing and courteous, but can you believe we waited for more than 45 minutes for someone to return with a golf cart to take us back to our resort?  NO ONE CAME.  The ladies called again and still NO ONE CAME.  My husband called our butler and he said he was not allowed to use a golf cart to retrieve it.  Seriously?  Again, at Sandals, our Butler or even another Butler who was free would have arrived to retrieve us within minutes and they are EXTREMELY busy at Sandals.  I eventually asked for a map to walk back to our Resort because I was drenched in sweat and tired of waiting.  So, one of the ladies explained that the golf cart drivers were probably very busy and that is why NO ONE CAME for us, so she offered to walk us over to their lobby where she hoped we could finally get service to return to our resort.  We stood there for a while waiting until thankfully the security guard, NOT the host and hostess coordinating the transportation – but the security guard (thank you, kind sir), noticed that we were still waiting and being ignored and he took it upon himself to ensure that we were able to ride back to our resort on a golf cart that, ironically, was just about to leave to go back to our resort and neither the host nor hostess had said anything to us, so we could ride back.  SMH!  After all of that, and this is what really frustrated us, when we returned to our resort, an attendant was sitting on a golf cart chilling out and other carts were also available alongside the wall (if my memory is correct)!! If THAT is what is called busy in the DR, I do NOT understand the definition!

Towels:  We made it clear to our Butler that we use new towels and wash cloths every time we shower and asked for extra to accommodate our needs.  I am not sure what extra means to others, but extra to us does not mean 3 wash cloths and 3 towels for TWO people.  Further, in most cases, there were stains on the towels that we received, so we could not use them.  We had to repeatedly call for more towels and cloths throughout our entire stay.  I really wished I had just bought some from a store at home that I didn’t mind leaving at the resort when we left, so I would be sure that we had sufficient, clean towels and wash cloths.

Housekeeping:  We prefer housekeeping every other day while on vacation.  Between those times, I make up the bed and tidy what I can within the room.  On the days that we do not have the “DND” sign on the door, we expected housekeeping to come in and actually clean the room, including changing the linens.  Housekeeping did not automatically do that.  They only thing they did was make the bed and replace the towels.  After complaining, on the next housekeeping day, they actually completed their job.  There was a noticeable difference in the room: it smelled clean, the floor had been swept and mopped, the linens had been changed, etc.  That should be a given.  We should not have to complain to have the room actually cleaned.  Further, when we arrived, there was a half-used bottle of body wash or shampoo in the shower.  No one wants to re-use someone else’s leftovers.  Anything that has been opened should be disposed of before the next guests arrive.

Things to do/Excursions:  There weren’t as many options for things to do as we had hoped.  There were nightly shows that were generally tailored for children.  We were supposed to receive a coupon booklet when we arrived.  We asked our Butler about it a couple of times and he kept referring us to this 1-hr sales seminar and indicated that was the way we could receive it.  He asked us several times if we had gone to the seminar (Do they get a commission for that?), but who really wants to sit through a sales pitch during vacation? WE didn’t.  Anyway, finally, two days before the end of our vacation, we reluctantly decided to see what the seminar was about.  We explained to the lady sitting outside of the sales room that we were supposed to receive a coupon booklet and asked what we needed to do to receive it.  Can you believe she looked up our information and gave us the booklet?  We didn’t have to sit through anything because, just as I thought, we were supposed to receive it upon arrival.  FURTHER, we found out a shuttle train travels between the resort and the shopping center every 15 minutes or so and that is where we could use coupons that were also in the booklet.  What?? Why didn’t we know about the shuttle? I asked the Butler about it, but he just focused on the fact that shuttle is not available every 15 minutes.  [sigh]  The other options that were available were group excursions and they seemed to be centered in Santa Domingo – two hours from the resort.  That’s four hours of riding away my vacation time.  There needs to be more options available locally and private options need to be available as well.  Everyone doesn’t want to sightsee in a group, sign up for parasailing, pictures with birds and monkeys and banana boats.  We would have loved a private tour of the local area, learning about its history, eating at a local restaurant, taking photos of the area, shopping at a local market, etc.

Utilities:  On two occasions, the utilities failed at the resort.  This includes, not just the electricity, but the water as well.  Once, it happened just as I was thoroughly soaped in sensitive areas and there was no water to rinse in the shower.  I had to ask my husband to bring bottled water (that was cold in the fridge – burrrrr), so I could rinse.  The utilities were off at least 5-10 minutes.  There were never any apologies or explanations.  I understand that things happen, but be accountable.

Tipping:  Tipping is acceptable at this resort, so we did tip those who provided good service; however, we noticed that service was better if you were known to tip.  That should not be the case.  Exceptional customer service should be offered for FREE.  Some patrons may have saved just enough to be able to afford their accommodations and their service should not be lessened because they cannot tip.

Room service menu:  The menu is sorely lacking.  Please add some more variety to that menu.

Thank you.

reviews.author: Renee R
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text:
Don't stay at The Reserve - you will need to take a buggy or walk to the restaurants/beach Do not book The Royal Service as an extra cost  (you will be disappointed) 
Highly recommend the beach and beach bar in the evening.  Eat at NAOS buffet where fresh fish/pasta cooked to order.  Generally catering for the American markiet ie large portions and standard quality food

reviews.author: bubba636
reviews.title: Very nice resort for the price, we will be back!
reviews.text:
Traveled Jan14-21 2018, this was our first time at this resort. I will start with the cons as to leave you with the good things. First off, the cons are "picky" and WILL NOT deter us from returning!! We stay in room 3435 which was on the left side of the resort, facing the ocean, behind the restaurant Fuego. Arrived, checked in with no issues. Most of the other resorts we have stayed at offered drinks, little foods, towels when we were checking in, nothing here. We were escorted to our room, bags followed right behind us. We had an issue with the room card reader, our greeter tried different cards twice and the 3rd time I went back to the desk and got new cards. 3rd time was the charm. We tried the safe, no issues. opened the sliding door and the right side metal piece fell off. The greeter called for it to be fixed, within 5 mins a person arrived and fixed it, for the time being anyway. Opened it up the 2nd day, same thing happened so I went to the desk and told them, and the whole trip it was never fixed. In the bathroom we had a dead mosquito with a blood splatter, it was finally wiped off the wall on the 5th day. twice we did not get the bed turned down and once they came to turn it down at 10pm when we were in bed already. On the 6th day, sometime after 3pm, the entire resort lost water. We went up to wash for dinner and found this out. Called the front desk who told us by 6pm it will be fixed, we had 6pm dinner reservations. At about 550 we started to get water, but the hot water did not show up until sometime after 9am the next day. One thing that we got used to, but you may not ... every morning between 4-5 am the "garbage" truck would show up. We heard the back up alarm for the truck, the glass bottles and garbage bags being loaded into the truck and the workers "talking". For this reason alone you might want to request a different building. There is a window over the bed head board that must not be seated correctly in the opening, every night when the wind would blow, the window would rattle and the howl of the wind would come through. We were pretty tired each night and this did not effect us. The bathrooms around the resort could have used a little more timely attention. At times we found it difficult to communicate with some of the people who worked there, as their English was not that good, but we got through it pretty well..... and that is just about all the cons. 

Pro's: the rooms were very nice, a/c worked nice, never used the hot tub or "living or sitting" room in the room, king bed and pillows were nice, bathroom, shower and toilet no complaints. Just a nice room, nothing special. Food, NOTHING AT ALL BAD to say !!! From the breakfast and lunch buffet with plenty to choose from and the dinner restaurants .. the food was top notch!! The servers were very nice, especially Davidson who took care of us each morning!! Always knew I wanted coffee, my wife and friends O.J.. He ALWAYS had a smile, and took a few minutes to talk to us .. he made waking up on vacation that much better !!! Thank you !!! Everything was clean, the outside walk ways were not slippery during our short rain breaks. Unknown to us there was a company trip there and they had about 1400 people, these additional people did not make any difference in any way. We stayed at the main pool during the day, plenty of chairs to sit in and soak up the sun. Everyday we saw workers cleaning the pool. Swim up bar opened at 10am, and the waiters were always walking around asking if you wanted anything to drink. Drinks were good and beer was cold. The swim up bar was the active pool area, there were 2 guys trying to keep everyone busy with dancing, stretching, volleyball, and such. One guy was Felix, great kid, 25 years old, always asking trying to get us up but respectful enough to stop when we told him we were there to relax. He also took some time to talk to us before he got busy, good to know how he thought about Trump, Americans, the hurricane, Haiti, working at the resort. He was a very nice young man !!
We went in the ocean 2-3 times, 1 day was very nice, waves but not bad and no seaweed. The other 2 times there was plenty of seaweed and a little rougher. We live on Long Island and are used to the waves so this was not a problem, as for the seaweed .. not gross just not nice to swim in. Beach was large, pure white sand, plenty of chairs and huts to sit under. It is a public beach so the jewelry, hat, cigar, bag, shopping mall, parasail, jet ski .. etc... people were around and kept asking, even after saying no 2-3 times to the same people. We only stayed a short time on the beach, partly because of this. 
Again, I hope the cons I wrote about do not deter you from going here. They were only minor things to us and we hope to be back sooner then later !!!! Any questions, feel free to email me @ bubba636@optonline.net
Thank you all for making this a relaxing enjoyable vacation !!!!

reviews.author: Coach1075
reviews.title: very relaxing
reviews.text: The rooms are nice nothing special. The all inclusive food was better than average. The all inclusive drinks however was house no name liquor that all tasted the same. Hospitality was very good but the maid was dipping in our liquor. The beach was nice but the water on this side of the Island was very rough and not as blue as it looks in the picture. Not a place I would revisit.  Below is asking when did we travel and it only goes back to 2017 we were there in 2013 hopefully things have improved

reviews.author: gustavokaedei
reviews.title: Abaixo das Expectativas
reviews.text: Me hospedei com esposa e uma filha pequena em dezembro/2017. Apesar das boas instalações (quarto, piscinas, Kids Zone etc.), e do ótimo serviço de concierge, não gostamos, em geral, da comida servida nos restaurantes, muito abaixo do que se espera em um Resort cinco estrelas. Há um restaurante estrela Michelin (Passion), mas é cobrado a parte e não aceita crianças, por isso não fomos. Também não entendemos por que um hotel localizado em uma área tropical não dispõe de sucos naturais de frutas (somente servem sucos industrializados). O serviço de praia é muito bom para quem adquire o serviço de concierge (há uma área separada), porém, o mar que fica defronte ao hotel é muito agitado para crianças, nesse ponto, nos arrependemos de não ter ficado no Paradisus Palma Real, que tem corais em frente, e o mar é mais tranquilo (descobrimos isso em uma breve visita oferecida para conhecer uma proposta de time sharing que, a propósito, foi uma perda de tempo).

reviews.author: Isabel F
reviews.title: Playa Maravillosa , Buen hotel
reviews.text:
El Paradisus Palma Real es un lindo hotel que necesita hacer unos upgrade en sus habitaciones y en alguno de sus servicios.
El nuestro era un grupo grande , 18 personas incluyendo adultos , adolescentes y niños más pequeños.
Para el personal del hotel fue complicado 
Organizar nuestros horarios de cena , las reservas siempre se atrasaban y terminamos saliendo del restaurante muchas veces después de las 11:30
PM.
Jimmy Soza fue nuestro concierge y trato de solucionar y organizar.
Las habitaciones son buenas pero necesitan una renovación especialmente de almohadas. Estas eran muy malas e incómodas.
Las puertas no cerraban bien , la del baño y también la de la habitación .
La lámpara de velador de mi habitación estuvo siempre rota, nunca se arreglo.
Son muchos los detalles y me parece que un hotel 5 estrellas como este debería solucionarlos.

reviews.author: Alfonso S
reviews.title: Viaje por Navidad y Año Nuevo
reviews.text:
Mi viaje fue por 10 días desde el 23 de diciembre al 02 de Enero acompañado de 12 personas en familia .En general quiero manifestar que la pasamos muy bien , sin embargo tengo algunos comentarios que pueden ser considerados como una oportunidad de mejora :
1. Mejorar el servicio de atención al cliente en general para la solución de problemas . Es importante un cambio en la actitud y en conocimiento del servicio
2. Incluir entre la variedad de restaurantes un mexicano o un italiano 
3. Remodelar las habitaciones en cuanto a modernidad y funcionamiento de los equipos , mini bar, luces , etc

Quiero dejar sentado el gran apoyo de 2 personas que nos ayudaron a tener una estadía muy confortable y solucionando los problemas : Una de ellas la Sra Eugenia , Gerente de Bebidas y Alimentos quien solucionó de manera impecable todos los problemas y siempre estuvo preocupada porque todo estuviera en orden ejecutando acciones inmediatas y efectivas 
La otra persona es Boni una de las personas que atiende en la playa el servicio de bebidas y licores quien nos brindó una atención excelente , respetuosa y sobre todo con una sonrisa y una disposición de primer nivel 
Atte

reviews.author: Vandana M
reviews.title: DEFINITELY not a 5 star
reviews.text: Spend your money elsewhere! Hotel staff is nothing but unprofessional and not even sorry about their behavior.  Front Desk Manager is one rude guy, who asked us for the tip upfront at the time of check-in (can you believe that???)  lack of English, lack of customer skills. Chef and waiters have indecent behavior.  Don't get excited about all inclusive. Food was average, drinks were watered down, unless you give a hefty tip, you do not get a decent drink. Same food in restaurants, breads,salad, sweets are repeatedly  same unless thy start smelling bad. Damp, musty smelly rooms, shower needs big time upgrade. The only good this property, its beautiful.Pool was nice, Beach was beautiful. Weather was perfect. there is no way that its a 5 star.

reviews.author: Dana D
reviews.title: Decent stay in a beautiful atmosphere
reviews.text:
The resort had the exact look of what I consider to be paradise.  It has all the workings of being a dynamite stay at first glance.  I had issues that the quality was spotty at best.  We had to ask for towels every day since there always seemed to be one type or another missing.  The was no fitted bedsheet.  Instead there was a sheet tucked in that did not cover the bottom of the bed.  The doors to the rooms had no quiet close.  Even carefully closing the door sounds like it is being slammed at full force.  The room itself was fantastic.  I just didn't like the pillows or the sheets, besides the noise.  

The entertainment available was not very good, but that is certainly not what we went to the resort for.  We stayed for 7 nights, but you are only allowed to book restaurants for four nights of your stay.  They are reservation only so the other nights you are forced to eat at the buffets.  The buffets were fine (hit or miss items like you would expect), but got old quick eating them morning, noon, and night for a week.  There is only one restaurant open for lunch that allows a la carte ordering.  One other puts together a small buffet.  There are no restaurants open for breakfast except the buffets.  The restaurants were not very good.  Only two good meals in my opinion.

We stayed in the Reserve and I would not recommend it for couples.  Either splurge for the adults only are or go to another resort.  I would pick another resort.  All the beds and chairs were taken up from sun up to sun down at both enormous pools by towels left there all day by absent families.  The beds on the beach for the reserve were my favorite part.  It was a smaller and quieter beach.  It is about a 10 minute walk from the rooms or they have sporadic shuttles.  Note the beach is public so peddlers bug you all day.  Still worth it for the beach. The water was red and yellow flags the whole time we were there, so I cannot say how clear it normally is.  We went in December and the weather was beyond perfect for sleeping on the beach and taking dips in the ocean.  The pool was a little too cool for me.  I was not a fan of the service at the beach or at the pools.  The staff would bug you for tips constantly and ignore you at the same time.  The favorite saying of one of the people assigned to the Reserve area was "wakey, wakey, drinkey drinkey."  I kid you not.  So much for naps on the beach.  That being said our favorite spot was definitely the beach.

reviews.author: FamilyTravellerwith4
reviews.title: Questionable 5 star rating
reviews.text:
We had a group travel and were pleasantly surprised by how gorgeous the view was of the hotel.  Our trip started out quite lovely with beautiful rooms and service.  As we continued our stay everyone was getting sick from the food.  Half of the restaurants weren't open and they kept offering us buffet for every meal.  They were having difficulty keeping the food hot so every meal was cold and exactly the same.  They served lots of  sushi, curries, and cream sauces that didn't work at the temperature it was being served and their staff didn't want to make fresh food as we explained that we were getting ill from it.  We were concerned the kids were going to be ill so we started to use room service and the food actually arrived hot.  The hotel is under new management and the hotel had some risky areas where the flooring had holes that weren't being repaired.
Some of the staff were quite rude in the restaurants and they didn't honour their reservations that were booked well in advance.  
They seemed understaffed and unprepared at times.  They also added a room service charge but we were not aware of this until we arrived.  Overall this hotel is 4 star.  Their beach is great and so are their gardens but the food and service is a 2.  We couldn't even get a hot cup of coffee unless we ordered a cappuccino or ordered room service.  I probably would try a true 5 star next time as this hotel isn't quite what it advertises.  Definitely needs to be relisted as you aren't going to get the luxury you've paid for.

reviews.author: Retire2022
reviews.title: Disappointed!
reviews.text: Beautiful view of the beach (seaweed) but hotel rooms definitely needs updating. Landscaping is beautiful outside. The pools need to be repaired in some areas. People are allowed to reserve cabanas by placing towels on chairs so all are taken even for early risers.

reviews.author: chanconrad28
reviews.title: Could have been great...
reviews.text:
Beautiful property. Very segmented into various levels of comfort. Standard means no cushions on beach chair. Reserve meant cushions and better location and service. Annoying that our room location meant we had to walk through and around upgraded areas to get to the standard beach and pool. 

Nice facilities but continuous LOUD construction our entire stay at the beach front bar/buffet area. Sanders. Spray painting. Men on unsecured ladders 10-15ft above you. Very dangerous, especially if you had little kids. 

Restaurants were average at best. Very few selections and food was uninspiring. Buffet, though, was very good. Wonderful Indian and Caribbean food every day. 
Staff was indifferent at best. I spoke more Spanish than some of the customer service folks spoke English. 
Rooms were decent but had to change on the first day because of lighting issues and NO TOILET SEAT in one of our rooms. 
Dec 20-25 seems like a strange time for major construction. 
Staff only attentive when they were trying to sell something additional to you.

reviews.author: romka1975
reviews.title: well past its glory
reviews.text:
Visiting Paradisius with 2 kids. Overall impression - not worth the money, and is far from the 5 stars advertised.

1. Rooms (one bedroom suite) - roomy, good balcony. Condition and appliances (from coffemaker to TV) is 10 years old, poor wuakity. Had electric fuses go out 3 times, telephones did no work.
