However, These reservations needed to be made 4 days in advance and required negotiations, begging and pleading to get in.  Once there for a 6 or 7 PM dinner, there was only 3 other tables occupied.

reviews.author: Maria H
reviews.title: Good Hotel with excellent Staff but definitely not 5-Stars
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus from August 27th through September 3rd.  The hotel's common areas are beautiful.  We paid for Royal Service so the check-in process was painless and our room was ready when we arrived.  The staff at the Royal Service Lounge was very polite and professional.  Our butler Francis Newton was absolutely outstanding.  He truly made a positive difference during our stay. He checked-in on us everyday, made our reservations and took care of any issues or requests.  He is professional, polite and efficient, a true asset to Paradisus.  We also want to recognize Martin Tineo, the pool butler.  He's amazing!  Such a positive attitude, we never had to ask him for anything.  After the first day, he knew all our likes.  Thank you Francis and Martin!  
The staff at the buffet were so amazing!  These employees work very hard and everyone we came in contact with was polite and happily took care of any requests although they were very busy.
The hotel however needs to address a some things.  The reservation process for the restaurants does not work.  It's almost impossible to get a reservation between 7:30 to 9:00 pm in any of the restaurants.  Even days ahead of time.  In all honesty, I don't think they are even worth the trouble since the menus are extremely limited.  We had dinner at the steak house and the experience was horrible.  Not enough staff, the waiter took forever to take our order, the orders were brought incomplete, the salads were awful, most of the steaks were tough and we ended up leaving without having dessert.  We tried Oleo and did not like the menu selections.  We also ate at the Peruvian restaurant.  Much better experience, the waiter was excellent, brought us several appetizers and brought our entrees just as we requested them.  The management also needs to address staff training on food handling and invest in better refrigeration/storage areas for food.  They should also offer hand sanitizer to guests in the buffet.  Both my husband and I were sick for an entire week from something we ate, starting the day before we left the hotel.  We were so sick we had to go to the doctor.
The rooms in the Royal Service area need to be remodeled.  Our room smelled musty, some of the furniture needed repair or replacement, needed painting and overall looked worn. Not what I expected from this hotel, specially in the Royal Service area.
We enjoyed our stay despite the issues I describe above, mostly because of the hard-working staff.  We finally decided to just have dinner at the buffet which was much easier than dealing with reservations and issues at the restaurants.  However, that back-fired when we got extremely ill.  I am not sure if I would return to the Paradisus Palma Real in light of the fact that the negatives outweigh the positives for us, at least at the current time.

reviews.author: Gee D
reviews.title: Hurricane Irma
reviews.text:
Had a great time thanks to Victor and Eduardo with water aerobics and yoga . They provided us with an awesome time . We laughed so much it was great. This made the trip seem so much better since we basically had nothing to do because of the hurricane scheduled to come all was canceled or closed . 
We were only able to use the Gabi restaurant buffet due to storm preparing etc. however the food was good . 
The service was some what lacking but no major complaints. 
Junior one of the servers was the best most pleasant person at the establishment . 

We only lost power for about 2 minutes and had an issue with our air conditioning unit which took about an hour or more to fix but it was fixed . 
Again lots of the same issues I had im sure had it not been because of the hurricane disruptions etc it would've never happened. Would visit again and hope to take full advantage of the other restaurants being that We were cheated this time around .

reviews.author: Mabcbravo
reviews.title: Nice Hotel but lacks on service
reviews.text:
I have been going to Punta Cana for 7 years. I have stayed at the Excellence and Ibero Star Grand Bavaro. These two hotels were far better than the Paradisus Palma Real
The food wasn't great, we've had a better food at the other restaurants at the grand Bavaro. Lobster is priced extra, at the Grand Bavaro, you could eat lobster for breakfast lunch and dinner. the buffet would "run out of shrimp" and wait 15 minutes for a plain cheese pizza
Don't expect to sit in front of the beach because you will never find a spot/cabana available... you need to have a concierge to get a beach bed or a good cabana at the beach front. So if you go to the beach you probably wont find where to sit. someone actually suggested to wake up at 7 am to place a towel on the beach chairs to save our spot. obviously we never made it
We stayed at "the reserve" which is supposed to be the higher end hotel, but honestly it is not worth the extra money, you are very far from the beach (around 15 min) and the food buffet is not really that much better 
The last thing I'll say is that the service is not great, staff have attitudes and they're not helpful as you would expect. we were waiting for a table and most of them were dirty, i asked 3 different guys to clean them and no one even stopped, i went to the hostess and she said (with a huge attitude) they were just too busy, so a bunch of families and us were kept on waiting. There were tables, they were just dirty.
I would say that the hotel infrastructure is phenomenal. Very modern rooms, restaurants and pools. I love the fact the hotel is green (they don't use straws anymore)

reviews.author: Kelguzman
reviews.title: Opinión
reviews.text: La comida y la atención bien, pero las habitaciones tienen que remodelar, poner más variedades en el snack bar de la habitación, almohadas más confortables entres otros, es decir el precio está muy elevado para lo que te brindan

reviews.author: N B
reviews.title: Second visit to The Reserve
reviews.text: We booked our second vacation at The Reserve expecting to have a wonderful vacation and the same superior service that we experienced 3 years ago. Unfortunately, we were disappointed. It seems they have changed the hotel management so expect delays on service .  When we arrived to our  room the  towel rack was broken and the TV had a buzzing sound. Although is a beautiful resort we  will look at other options in the future.

reviews.author: delia m
reviews.title: decepcionada
reviews.text: la habitacion .fue normal.pero para entrar a ella tuve que esperar desde las 10 de la mañana a las seis de la tarde.dado que me querian dar una habitacion totalmente fuera del standard comprado/.la bebida .fue intomable.caso que tuve que comprarles mi propia bebida que no salio barata.falta total de entretenimiento.la playa totalmente limitada a un espacio pequeño.que juntamente con la pileta.tenia sus limites por no tener cinta dorada,compartiendo con niños casi adolescentes que rompian toda tranquilidad  ya que se tiraban encima de los pacientes huespedes.por lo tanto falto control en ella.paRA obtener una taza de cafe o bebida.en desayuno teniamos espera de mnedia hora por lo menos.caso de procurarnos nosotros los cubiertos y demas.estoy tan descontenta con esed hotel que no lo recomiendo i al mas enemigo

reviews.author: veronica b
reviews.title: Bajaron la calidad
reviews.text:
Han bajado la calidad de la comida y de la bebida teniendo en cuenta que uno es socio de club Melia. 
Ahora parece que lo que era una maravilla paso a ser categoria standar debido al nuevo sistema circle.
Los amenitis de baño tampoco lo dejan, si alguien los necesita debe pedirlos. 
Lo único 100% recomendable es la atención de Sabino Nolasco en el sector playa!!!!

reviews.author: lightblue1110
reviews.title: Fun time with friends
reviews.text:
We stayed here in June/July for a destination wedding. We had a blast with our friends. The beach is beautiful and so are the grounds. Here is a list of what we did not like:

-food/drinks mediocre
-reservations to the restaurants is difficult-best restaurant is Vento
-service is slow
-check in is weird and slow
-the room was clean but showing wear and tear
-we did not find the staff very friendly
-people left empty cups all over the pool area and no one seemed to be quick to clean them
-the pools did not seem that clean
-the staff did not speak English that well

In summary, we did not really care for Punta Cana. We have no desire to return.

reviews.author: Denice84
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: I would give it 3.5 stars; grounds are nice, well kept. We stayed on the reserve side, had its own pool which was really nice, you do have to get up early to get a cabana. Typically guest with concierge get to reserve cabana but from my understanding after 10 am if not taken available to everyone. It's about a 8 minute walk down to the beach, they have trams if you don't want to walk. Felt like to get drinks by pool or beach hard to come by, typically you had to go to bar to get your drinks. Most of the restaurants are at the main hotel, which you can take the tram. The reservations for the specialty needs some modification. If you have concierge you get preference, if not you make a wish list and they are supposed to let you know what's a available the day after you turn in your list. We never received any confirmation, we had to call to find out if we got what we wanted. Overall food was good, nothing extraordinary. The shows put on by the staff were good, entertaining. From other reviews if you splurge for the concierge you get better service. I wanted to relax and do nothing, enjoy a beautiful beach and I got to do that, so I am happy with my trip.

reviews.author: yasind894
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: I had a very bad experience during my stay.  From service provided by employees to maintenance of my room.  The hotel is beautiful, but employees are not happy, which reflects in the service. I was not happy at all with my stay, and I will not recommend it to one else.

reviews.author: Evachad
reviews.title: Good however not outstanding
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for 10 nights in the end of July. It is listed as a 4.5 star resort and during our stay my husband and I had a conversation about wondering how it got that many stars with what we were experiencing during out stay. Not sure if people are just saying it was great or if they are true reviews. I will write a true review of our experience so people that use Trip Advisor to decide where to go for a trip will have quite a bit of information. This resort is defiantly not a 4.5 star resort. During our stay I did end up talking to a lady that her family has stayed there many times before and this time was different. She said they went downhill from what they were before.

When we arrived we were directed to our family concierge building to check in. However, unlike other guests we were not offered a drink or snacks at any time during check in. Once checked in they took us to our room and said that our concierge would be to our room soon to go over everything with us. Eileen was our concierge for the week and she was really sweet. She came with an information sheet with restaurants to get our preferred time to eat, where we wanted to eat, etc. so she could set up dinner reservations for us. She also asked if we wanted to do any spa treatments. She asked if we were celebrating anything while we were there. Our anniversary was during our stay there so we set up a couples massage on our anniversary and a dinner at Passions the day after our anniversary (extra pay restaurant) for just my husband and myself. During out stay Eileen set up a bubble bath for our girls with balloons. Candy pillows for them one of the nights we were there. I did have to ask about the robes & slippers and turn down with milk and cookies for kids after already being there a few nights. I was thinking they would be taken care of without having to ask due to them being on the description of the room when we reserved. Once she was aware that we were not getting the nightly sweet treats she made sure they were delivered. She also did a bubble bath the afternoon after our anniversary with roses and wine which was a nice touch. She did check in with us daily to see if we needed anything. Our daughter got sick while we were there and Eileen got her some Gatorade to help, very thoughtful of her. One thing that was a really nice touch with staying at the reserve with concierge is that you get a cabana by the pool each day. You just have to check in by 10am so they don’t open it up to other people. We communicated with her through the what’s app and that worked fine for us. Their website says you get a cell phone to stay in touch so maybe you get that if you don’t have a cell phone with that app on it already? It was easier for us to just use our personal phone. 

The Family Concierge buildings were in a nice location to the shows, main lobby and not that far from the beach area. You can walk there and it is not that far of a walk. There is a short cut that takes about 5 -10 minutes to walk down to the beach. They also have carts (trains as they call them) that run constantly through the resort so it is not hard to get on those if you are not up for walking.  Rooms were spacious and clean. Mini bar was always stocked each day. Housekeeping did a great job! The grounds of the resort were beautiful. Very well kept up and clean everywhere! 

Pool- the reserve pool was large, less busy and more quiet than the main pool on the non-reserve side of the resort. Would have been nice if they had some music playing during the day. We were told we could bring our speaker (if we brought one) and our phone to play music. In my opinion not something you should have to do if you are paying to stay at a nice resort. They did have two activities in the late morning yoga and aerobics in the pool for adults. At 3PM they had an art activity that our daughters enjoyed doing by the pool. Beyond that there wasn’t a whole lot of things for a 14 and 12 year old to do. They were too old for the kids club which was a lot of younger kids (average age 5-8) and too young to be with the teenagers (average age 16 or 17). Teen club is on the beach each night and it just wasn’t’ going to work for us to have them get down to the beach and back alone while we tried to do a date dinner. Wasn’t a big deal just would have been nice if they had more for that age range of kids. The last day we were there they did paddle boarding in the Reserve Pool and that was really fun for families to do. We wished they would have done that more during our 10 day stay. 
Pool Yoga- Eduardo and Emilio that did the Paddle Board Yoga in the Non-Reserve pool was great. My husband and I did that one day and had a great time. After the adults did yoga he did a little 15 min activity with the kids which they LOVED! They were friendly and great at what they do! They really liked to interact with the guest and make sure they are enjoying themselves.

Food - we've been to other 4 and 5 star resorts in the Caribbean and we all thought the food at this one was just okay for the buffet food. The three buffet restaurants are very small with limited options. Same food for breakfast each morning and same lunch selection.  We have been to resorts where they had a different selection for breakfast each morning to change it up. The same stuff for 10 days strait was not appealing. A couple of the a la carte restaurants we tried were pretty good. MOLE was very good, THE GRILL was our favorite! AQUA was another really nice one and FUEGO was good too! Beyond those the others were okay and nothing great. We did also go to Passions (pay restaurant) and that was really good too. 
Bars – Most of the bars are outdoors so depending on the weather it can be hot and humid. We did find the Red Lounge that was great treat for us. It was indoors and we can’t say enough about Lorenzo Frias! He was wonderful, friendly, professional, quick, and had good knowledge of many drinks for us and our teenage daughters! He took care of everyone that came to his bar to have a drink with the same professional attitude and made sure everyone was happy. He was defiantly a 5 Star employee! We wound down in there each night after dinner and it was a nice way to end the day! He was top notch and they are lucky to have him as an employee!!!!

Spa – Spa was nice however a couple little issues with our reservations we had booked through our concierge. When we checked in for our couples massage they had us listed down for another type of massage (more expensive) and the one we requested. Once that got settled and we got on track it was very nice. The ladies doing our massages were Elvia Moore and Rosanna Beras. They heard us talking to the lady up front about it being our anniversary and they went and got flowers and make a heart out of towels at the door way. Very thoughtful and sweet of them. They were very good and we would recommend them! The second time I went to the spa it was for a facial and again when I got there and checked in they had me down for different facial treatment than what I asked to have reserved, again more expensive. I told them which one I asked to have reserved and they tried to talk me out of it to go with another one. I told them I wanted to stick with the original one and filled out the paperwork for the facial. I did talk to the lady about them doing the extractions and that I wanted them to do that. I was then told to go into the other room and wait and they would take me back shortly. I had asked for Rosanna to do my facial and requested her for my reservation. A lady came back and told me that Rosanna was on lunch and would not be able to do my facial that it would have to be someone else. The lady they put me with was good however did not speak any English so I could not communicate with her at all. She never did the extractions so I had asked another lady to translate and they said that with the after sun facial they don’t do the extractions due to the skin being sunburned and it would irritate the skin. I was not sun burned or even close to being sun burned. I explained to her that I wanted the after sun facial due to me being in the sun more than normal over the last 9 days and wanted the extra moisturizing part of it. My guess is the lady that talked to me in the beginning did not communicate that with the lady that actually did the facial. I just left as I was getting nowhere trying to communicate that I did want that done.  

We did book through Costco and the extra resort credit discount coupons are worthless. We tried using the restaurant coupons at multiple restaurants and were told that we either couldn’t use it there or that is was for buy one get one free where you are spending at least $50.00 after the coupon. There are no exclusions on the restaurant coupons as it states you “can use it at any extra fees restaurant at Paradisus Punta Cana”. There are also wine coupons and those you can only use to get $20.00 off if you buy a bottle of wine priced over $100.00. The only coupons we were able to use is the 3 spa coupons that came in the book. All the other coupons were for romantic dinner on the beach discount, casino match play on table play only (no slots), room upgrade (we booked the upgrade originally so we could not use that) or shopping coupons at the mall they are connected to for shopping. We did end up talking to a manager about the restaurant coupon due to everywhere we went they said it could not be used when we were trying to use it as it says on the coupon. The manager was not going to do anything for us until my husband asked her point blank if she was going to put a credit on our room charges for the amount of the coupon. She finally said yes she would do a credit however did not know how much she could do. In the end it was not the coupon amount however it was better than nothing.

reviews.author: tammy r
reviews.title: Have a mixed review
reviews.text: A little late in posting but we went there in late July.  The resort is huge and has beautiful facilities and grounds. Initially we were very disappointed that we were given a room that faced a parking lot but the manager made it right and moved us the next day to a room facing the pool.  The rooms were decent.  Not great but decent.  A little outdated but they were clean and the bathroom was big.  There are no elevators so you have to walk up steps to get to your room.  We did not mind that though.  The staff was always courteous and helpful.  It is a 10 minute (very hot) walk to the beach.  Hard to catch a shuttle there because unless your room is by the main lobby the shuttles do not come by often.  The beach was very pretty.  There was lots seaweed in the water but that is mother nature and not the hotel. The water is still a stunning green color.  The beach bar staff were fun and quick to serve drinks.  I really enjoyed the resort restaurant food but the teen girls I was with did not.  There were plenty of options though that kept them fed.  One of my girls got deathly sick the last day there.  So sick that she had to be hospitalized for 6 days after.  We were glad she was able to make it home on the plane to get treated in an American hospital.  She got a bacteria infection that turned septic.  Doctors said it could have been anything...fruit, bacteria in water, dirty glass. It could have been from the hotel but it could have been from a boat excursion we went on too.  Hard to know.  Out of 3 of us she is the only who got sick and I ate and drank more than anyone.  Anytime you go out of the US that is one of the risks you can run into.  Overall our stay was pleasant.  I have been a little frustrated since we got back I have been trying to contact their lost & found.  My daughter thinks she left a $400 Tory Burch watch in the room.  I have tried and tried to call and get info about a lost and found.  No one seems willing to even look. Keep getting transferred to 3 to 4 different people every time I call.   I probably won't go back but I do not regret going.  I would suggest if you go to bring lots of dollar bills to tip the staff.  They really do work hard and every tip I gave I felt was truly appreciated.

reviews.author: rsch2016
reviews.title: Preis-Leistung stimmt leider nicht
reviews.text:
Die Zimmer sind sehr schön und groß, aber leider schon ein wenig abgewohnt. Die Anlage ist im großen und ganzen gepflegt und schön. Der Pool ist groß und es stehen genügend Liegestühle zur Verfügung, auch wenn die Cabanas für die Family Concierge Members reserviert sind. Der Transfer zum Strand funktioniert gut, aber auch am Strand sind ein Großteil der Stühle für die Family Concierge Members reserviert sind. Kann sein, dass man dort keinen Platz im Reservebereich bekommt. Der Service ist sehr gemischt. Vielen im Service macht ihre Arbeit Spaß, aber es gibt auch viele die keine Lust haben. Wenn man schon morgens im Restaurant mit einem unfreundlichen Gesicht begrüßt wird und nicht einmal ein freundliches "Good mornig" möglich ist, ist diese Person meines Erachtens für diesen Job falsch, da sie den ersten Eindruck hinterlässt. Ist mir bei einem Hotel dieser Kategorie nicht verständlich. Beim Frühstück gibt es auch zu Stoßzeiten keine Plätze mehr und man muß ein paar Minuten warten. Dann funktioniert der Kaffeenachschub auch nicht. Es gab viele Tage, da war am Pool die Sauberkeit gut, aber vereinzelt werden Becher im Poolbereich einfach nicht weggeräumt und stehen dann bis Abends am und im Pool. Das sieht dann bei über 50 Bechern nicht schön aus und darf meiner Meinung nach in einem 5-Sterne Haus nicht sein. Teilweise ist auch das Personal nicht professionell. So hatte ein Pauolo Vasquez im Fitnesscenter mir mit dem Sicherheitsdienst gedroht, weil mein Sohn noch keine 18 Jahre alt war. Ich hatte aber eine schriftliche Genehmigung beim Management eingeholt, die ihn aber nicht interessierte und er sie nicht einmal angeschaut hat. Auch meine Bitte doch beim Management anzurufen, ignorierte er. Wir hatten ja schon 3-4 Mal bei seinem Vorgänger im Gym trainiert. Sein zweiter Satz war dann "Ich hole den Sicherheitsdienst". Ich habe das Gym dann mit meinem Sohn verlassen, da ich auf diesem Niveau nicht weitermachen wollte. Der Fitnesscenter ist leider auch schon etwas veraltet und die Laufbänder haben an einigen Stellen ordentlich Rost angesetzt. Optisch für ein solches Haus nicht ok.
Die Restaurants sind weitestgehend gut und natürlich Geschmacksache. Uns hat "The Grill" , die Winery und das Vento gefallen. Den Hydrogrill am Pool und das Mole fanden wir nicht so gut. Bei zwei Wochen Aufenthalt wird das Essen dann allgemein etwas langweilig. Die überwiegend amerikanischen Gäste sind auch nicht so lange dort.  
Die Cocktails sind von guter Qualität und der Service an der Bar war auch immer gut. Besonders gut haben sie uns unten an der Strandbar des Reservebereichs geschmeckt.
Insgesamt sind wir mit einem weitestgehend positiven Gefühl gegangen, aber es war nicht perfekt und ein paar Dinge haben uns gestört. Das sollte bei einem Haus dieser Kategorie und Preisklasse nicht sein. Daher nur meine befriedigende Bewertung.
Ich glaube, dass es für diesen Preis auch bessere Hotels in Punta Cana gibt. Daher würden wir wahrscheinlich nicht mehr wiederkommen.

reviews.author: amandatravels_11
reviews.title: Traveling with a baby and a teen to PPR
reviews.text:
We traveled with a one year old and a 15 year old last week.  I won't rehash everything that has been said in these reviews, but I did want to offer some specifics for those considering traveling with these ages.

For the 15 year old- no teen activities on site that we were aware of.  Thankfully, she was content to chill on the beach and by the pool.  She was not bothered by anyone selling stuff or staff.  Never offered alcohol or anything else.  I certainly felt safe with her walking through the resort alone until about 9-10pm.

For the one year old- crib provided was fine- the mattress was in good shape, about the size of a pack and play.  Sheet was a regular flat sheet folded around the mattress so I might consider bringing a crib sheet from home.  We took her to the kids club one day- its about a 5-8 minute golf ride to the reserve area.  New, beautiful building with a room just for infants, toddlers.  Plenty of age appropriate toys.  Staff lovely.  Very secure check in process.  Door locked- had to be buzzed in and out.  You have to call every 30 minutes to check on your kid, which I totally appreciate, but they may want to consider pagers of some sort.

In general... we had a one bedroom master suite, which was a great amount of room for our family of 4.  However, the sofa bed is NOT suitable for sleeping, not even a small child.  They brought us a rollaway bed instead.  They should not even call the sofa bed a "bed."  Our shower drain was very clogged and required 3 phone calls to get fixed.  The first time someone came, they left the dirt/hair in the shower. Gross.  Food mostly mediocre, sushi awful. Never offered drink service by pool or on beach, but plenty of bars close by.

Overall ok experience. Not sure we would go again unless I found an amazing deal.

reviews.author: Amado T
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This place is beautiful but not well staffed, We had to wait for our tables to be clean each time we tried to eat. the room was clean but the lighting need to be updated. The food for the most part was always cold.

reviews.author: GustavoSette
reviews.title: Huge disappointment, especially in food
reviews.text:
Last year, I spent a week in the neighbor of the same branch, Meliá Caribe Tropical. I enjoyed it a lot and of course, I expected much more from Paradisus, the "rich neighbor".

I found the Paradisus lower in all aspects except the beach chairs, which are very good. The Paradisus is about 30% more expensive and the beach chair is the only advantage.

The food is not bad, but it is restricted and understated. More expensive items, such as beef and seafood, are limited, you are encouraged not to consume. There is no free buffet with lobster, shrimp and steak as there was in the Caribe Tropical. In both, you need to queue and ask a cook, usually grumpy, to prepare. There is ONE  employee and ONE grill for a gigantic hotel. (it's fair to say that Palazzo restaurant has a very kind staff, no grumpy people there). 

The hotel has no attendants on the beach. I stayed in the "adults only" area, which has a pool bar, but the attendants do not serve you on the beach. You have to get off the beach and go get it.

Eating something during the afternoon or in the middle of the morning is a sacrifice. You need to leave the beach, get dressed, put on a shoe and go to the beach restaurant, ask to be seated, because you have dress code on the beach !!! Or go the lounge, which is a fancy area and also requires dress code. In the neighbour Caribe Tropical, there was a self service buffet on the beach, where you could get a burger, hot dog ... 

After the first of 4 nights, I emailed the hotel with some of these inquiries. I received no reply.

We had a butler. A sympathetic gentleman, but his acting was embarrassing, He called several times a day, appeared unannounced, on the beach, in restaurants. He wanted to help, but he did not realize we did not need anything. After so much insistence, I decided to try to make him feel useful. I commented on the beach that I wanted to eat something and asked if he could help me. He said I had to get dressed and go to the beach restaurant, following the dress code... Why would a butler do? 

The room has some usability pitfalls. First, there is a chandelier hanging over the bed, more or less at the height of your head. The bathroom has no lock and the toilet is visible to anyone in the apartment, nothing romantic ... The buildings have 3 floors and there is no lift.

In summary, you will be disappointed if you consider this hotel among the top of Punta Cana. It is not. I stayed another 4 nights at the Iberostar Grand Bavaro. The difference is rather embarrassing in favor of Iberostar. Adjusting expectation, you will have no problems ...

reviews.author: Daniel J
reviews.title: Kompliziert
reviews.text: NIemand informierte uns beim Check In am Nachmittag , dass Restaurants für den Abend reserviert werden müssen. Als wir dass dann um 1700 merkten. Sagte man uns, dass sei nicht mehr möglich. Das Restaurant war dann aber am Abend leer!

reviews.author: TravelmomNewJersey
reviews.title: Nice resort, mediocre service
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in early July 2017. We were a family of 10 spanning three generations. I waited to write this review so that I could reflect fairly and get beyond my initial disappointment. 

The trip was the kick-off to our summer and we were much in need of some relaxation and fun after some stressful weeks at work and the end of the school year. 

Well this started off with an hour and half wait to check in. I have never experienced such a thing. I understand that many of the planes arrive in the afternoon and there are many guests trying to check in at the same time. But the resort should anticipate these waves of people and plan accordingly, not have people taking their breaks and making the guests wait. This made us miss the opportunity to swim that day because by the time we got to our rooms it was tok late. 

The restaurants are another waiting game. Almost two hours at guest services the next day in order for me to reserve the a la carte restaurants and then I was only able to get for 3 out of 6 nights due to the resort being full occupancy and all the places being "too busy". That said, Rare (steakhouse) and Mizu (Japanese) were excellent and Sosa made the Tepanyaki experience so much fun. The buffet was average. The beach grill burgers were good but it was so understaffed that we only went there twice because we didn't want to waste our whole afternoon at lunch. 

The beach was lovely. Wide and clean and the water so warm and pleasurable. We spent hours there. The pool was also nice and big and the kids loved playing in it all afternoon. 

The rooms were nice and conveniently located and all the amenities by the beach and pool were plentiful and kept clean and organized. The grounds of the resort are also very nice and well maintained. 

We also tried the Oriental spa and it was wonderful. Great massage and nicely appointed huts and eastern theme. Would highly recommend if you're there. 

So overall the resort and beach there are very nice. The problem is with the service and not nearly enough staff to accommodate guest needs when the resort is full.

reviews.author: Cassie H
reviews.title: Summer Family Vcay
reviews.text: Pretty resort, but our shower leaked into our room the first night & hotel staff would not try & fix until morning. Beach was covered in sea weed- had not been cleaned in a while. We switched resorts.

reviews.author: Glenn D
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We have stayed at the Palma Real in the past when it was a 5 Star Resort. Booked 3 Deluxe Junior Suites Garden View Rooms. The first rooms TV did not work, the second rooms sliding glass door to the balcony did not work and could not have breakfast or drinks on the balcony. As far as housekeeping was concerned always had to call for towels and the rooms were not cleaned in most cases until 5 PM which is a problem when you are at the pool or beach and want to come back to shower and clean up to go to dinner. Called the first night for towels at 9:00 PM and finally someone knocked on the door at 12:30 AM with Towels. 

About 1 out of every 8 lounge chairs near the pool were either broken or worn out and on our last morning at the pool the grounds keeper was spraying insecticide around the lounge chairs and walkways while people were laying taking in the sun between 8 and 9 AM. The grounds keeper was wearing Rubber Boots and Gloves not wanting to get the insecticide on his feet or hands, meanwhile guests are walking barefoot where he sprayed. You would think that they would do this earlier in the morning before guests would be using the lounge chairs and walking around the pool area barefooted.

I had gone to the Front Desk and asked to speak to the Manager on Duty and Valdemir who was the Manager on Duty took all the information about the problems with the room and housekeeping and said it would be taken care of.  Needless to say none of the problems were addressed prior to our departure.

I will give credit to the Wait Staff, Restaurant Staff and Bar Staff, they all were outstanding, pleasant and went out of their way to help. Willy and Junior in the Buffet and Leonardo at the Pool Swim Up Bar  actually made this an enjoyable trip.

But Housekeeping and Lounges need to be fixed.

reviews.author: Rosy P
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I just spent two nights at this location.   The service was good, most of the time.   The Reception was excellent.  The facility is gorgeous  As you walk in, it looks like paradise.  Our waiter by the pool Daniel was awesome.  However, we never received hand and face towels at our room.  I received a phone call on Friday night to see how our stay was going.  We had not gone to dinner but I told her everything was fine except for the fact I had not received hand or face towels.  I was told they would be sending them right up.  I received them after I called again on Saturday night.  We were leaving on Sunday at 12 noon.   The food in the hotel was awful.  We ate at Fuego and Olio...both had a lot to be desired.  The food at the buffet, which we don't care for, was better than the restaurants.   We had friends who were staying at the adjacent property Melia Tropical Garden, which was much less expensive and they raved about the food and the service.   They had lobster every night.  Our two nights were $800 and when we asked if we could have lobster for dinner, they explained it would cost $25 per person.  However, every Thursday, they serve lobster.  I would not recommend staying here.  The place is beautiful but the food is awful.  We complained at the restaurant and later found out through others that the Director was new and had changed everything...to the worse, instead of the better....save your money and don't stay here.

reviews.author: Roberto B
reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: poor service no working television  in the room poor a/c system like least never go back to this resort for sure to  expense for too little service and comfort , needs to pamper people more and give better drinks

reviews.author: VICTOR L
reviews.title: Se esperaba mas, el servicio muy malo
reviews.text: La verdad no se entiende como un hotel con buena ubicación, en un pais que se caracteriza por su nivel de hoteleria y servicio...otorgue un servicio de este nivel. Fue muy evidente q el personal no estaba a la altura y por el contrario estaba enfadado o sin esas ganas de apoyar y servir. En mas de una ocasión quedo de manifiesto q el personal hacia doble turno generando en ellos un nivel de cansancio y por ende una falta de servicio. También entre ellos se decía q había cambiado la administración. Una lástima de verdad, pues se ofrece muy buena comida y bebida pero todo se demerita por el servicio

reviews.author: jbwpov42
reviews.title: First time at an all-inclusive
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradissus for a wedding in early June. It was our first time at an all-inclusive resort, as we prefer to book through places like airbnb and "live like locals" when travelling, but the wedding was on the property, with an entire weekend of festivities, so it only made sense to stay. Our experience was definitely a mixed bag.

the pros:
the location is beautiful - the beach, outdoor pool, seating areas and cabanas were all gorgeous
the food at the buffet was good and there were plenty of options for everyone
the hibachi restaurant and aqua (both at The Reserve) were really good, well presented and tasty
the bartenders at the swim up bar at the pool were friendly
the barista working at the tiny little coffee shop around the corner from the buffet was wonderful
the pool has lots of shaded spots to be in the water but still out of the sun
housekeeping was responsive and restocked the minibar with our special requests
when the check in staff met us, they moved our rooms without being asked so that we were on the main level in the main building (I was using a cane at the time following a car accident, and steps were difficult) because the rooms we were originally assigned were apparently in a different building up several flights of stairs with no elevator.

the cons:
extremely dated rooms in desperate need of updating
no privacy (travelling with family, my niece and I shared a room while her younger sister shared with my brother and his wife.The bathrooms are open to the rest of the room, and both the shower and the toilet have glass doors. There is LITERALLY no privacy at all; absolutely no where in the room to even change clothes in privacy)
long waits and poor service
poor communication from the hotel about activities, options for dining, locations of restaurants, etc. 
irresponsible bartenders (continuing to serve alcohol to clearly severely intoxicated people)
the resort nickels and dimes you (it's all inclusive, but they charge for room service! just, no. no. no.)

Overall, we were very disappointed in our stay. The Paradissus Palma Real touts itself as a high-end resort, and charges accordingly, but definitely does NOT deliver on that promise. The location is gorgeous, but the facilities have not been maintained appropriately and the service leaves much to be desired. I'm a pretty laid-back traveller (I don't need much and prefer to fend for myself rather than rely on servers/staff) but even I was frustrated by the end of our visit. Luckily, we were only there for a long weekend for the wedding, but I really feel like we did NOT get what we paid for. Everyone in our group, even the bride and groom, had issues during our stay with room condition and service problems. I was hoping for the trip of a lifetime, but got just an average stay in poor condition rooms, at least in a beautiful locale. Definitely NOT worth the money.

reviews.author: Denise C
reviews.title: Great Resort, needs improvements!!!
reviews.text:
Let me just start by saying I love Meliã resorts but this time it was a let down. Not because of the seaweed on the beach, (we all have to understand it's Mother Nature) We have visited 5 other Meliã properties in Dominican Republic and this is our second time staying at Paradisus Palma Real. The first time we were here was 4 years ago and we loved it. Well not this time!!! We booked 2 rooms one thru Expedia and the other thru Meliã's website. We called the hotel a month in advance to get the room close or at least on the same building. We also called them two days before our check in just to make sure we're going to get the room close. When we arrived the check in took longer than what we expected. My fiancé had a room upgrade through the Meliã rewards program he asked for it, not sure if the check in person even listened to him. "Looooong story " anyways after checking in we were told that they were not going to be able to give us the room close to each other or in the same building because the hotel didn't have any available rooms close to each other. Then he told us that because we were getting a bigger room he couldn't get us on the same building. (Not sure if he was just lying or what) We were a little sad but didn't mind, even when we were almost half a mile apart we still fine with not being close to each other. One of ours let down was when we arrived to the rooms, the furniture and decor looked sooo old and outdated that my 10yr old didn't wanted to stay in it. It was super far from everything, pool beach, lobby etc... It was very disappointed due to the fact that my family and I just had come from a beautiful resort great for families traveling with kids here in Punta Cana, they opened back in November 2016. It was kind of frustrating because the other place was way cheaper than here... So after seeing my oldest daughter disappointed I went back to front desk to see if they had anything closer to the pool. The girl at front desk was super nice and gave us a smaller room.  "I forgot her name I think it was Emery or Emerlyn " (THANK YOU ) This second one had a great location,a little old and small for a family of five but a least it was close to the pool. Three minutes after being in the room my son fell off on the floor and we noticed the AC was leaking and the floor was wet. We need to switch room again because I could not take the chance of staying in with a wet floor and a 22month old toddler. They switched us again to another room (third room). This time the room was uglier and further from everything than the other two. After this point I was extremely disappointed and a little pissed. What it was to suppose to be a relaxing place for us turned out to be a nightmare. Just imagine being switched three times, walking back and forth with a stroller and two kids, packing and unpacking here and there. After crying for a while I decided to go back out of the stinky room. On my way to the beach I met 4 other unhappy customers who were also staying for their second time and they all agreed on how much the resort needs improvements and how thing seems to have changed. (Yes they charge you for room service) here is a list of some of the pros and cons we faced here. I have to say I did noticed they are going under some kind of renovations , WHICH I THINK THE RESORT REALLY NEEDS. 

Pros: beautiful hotel structure, well kept grounds (except the ponds), close to the beach, very friendly hard working staff ("especially waiters and chefs"), decent food quality, quiet place, night entertainment, family oriented place, nice kids club located at Reserve, large conventions rooms, nice shopping center near by and much more. 

Cons: short on staff members, very outdated rooms and it's decor, filthy ponds, dirty walls, very repetitive menu at lunch and dinner at the buffet, showers not working properly, bugs and roaches. (yes I know we're in a tropical country, but please don't have them crawling on your dining tables at the Ibana restaurant) not enough garbage cans, beach had garbage (it looked more like Jersey beach than a Bávaro beach) 
Higher prices per night compared to other similar places in the area and many other little issues .....
 
 Overall the resort itself is not bad, it's a beautiful place that needs some improvements and renovations. Is very sad for me seeing and hearing people who's this was their first time visiting the Dominican Republic saying that they felt like the resort was not worth the money and that they will not be returning to the resort neither the country. I know for a fact that the Dominican Republic is a great place to visit with warm friendly hard working people. And Is not fair that they judge the whole country just because the resort didn't meet their expectations. Hopefully the hotel improves, so inconveniences like this won't happen to their future visitors. 

Permítanme empezaré diciendo que me encanta la cadena hotelera Meliã, pero esta vez fue una decepción. No a causa de las algas en la playa, (todos tenemos que entender es la Madre Naturaleza) Hemos visitado otros 5 Meliã propiedades en República Dominicana y esta es la segunda vez que nos alojábamos en el Paradisus Palma Real. La primera vez que estuvimos aquí fue hace 4 años y nos encantó. Pero esta vez no!!! Reservamos 2 habitaciones uno a través de Expedia y la otra a través del sitio web del Meliá. Llamamos al hotel con un mes de anticipación para conseguir la habitación cercas o al menos en el mismo edificio. También llamamos dos días antes de nuestro check-in sólo para asegurarnos de que íbamos a conseguir las habitaciones cerca. Cuando llegamos el check in se tomó más tiempo del que esperábamos. Mi novio tuvo un upgrade de categoría de habitación a través del programa de recompensas de Meliá y se lo pidió, no estoy seguro si el joven  lo escuchó. "Laaaaargos historia " de todas formas después de registrarnos nos dijeron que no iban a poder darnos la habitación cerca unos de otros o en el mismo edificio que el hotel no tiene habitaciones disponibles cerca uno del otro. Entonces nos dijo que porque estábamos a una habitación más grande que él no pudo darnos las habitaciones en el mismo edificio. (No estoy seguro si estaba mintiendo o qué) estábamos un poco triste, pero no nos importó incluso cuando estábamos casi media milla aparte, seguimos bien. Uno de nuestra decepción fue que cuando llegamos a las habitaciones, los muebles y la decoración parecía taaan viejo y anticuado que mis hijos de 10 años no quería permanecer en él. Fue super lejos de todo, piscina, playa, vestíbulo, etc... Estaba muy decepcionada por el hecho de que mi familia y yo acabábamos de venir de un hermoso complejo ideal para familias que viajen con niños aquí en Punta Cana, que abrió sus puertas en noviembre de 2016. Es frustrante porque el otro lugar era mucho más barato que aquí... No esperaba eso de aquí. Así que después de ver a mi hija mayor decepcionado volví a recepción para ver si tenían algo más cerca de la piscina. La chica de recepción fue muy amable y nos dio una habitación más pequeña. "Se me olvidó su nombre, creo que era el Esmeril o Emerlyn " (GRACIAS ) Este segundo tenía una ubicación estupenda,un poco vieja y pequeño para una familia de cinco, pero al menos estaba cerca de la piscina. Tres minutos después de estar en la habitación, mi hijo se resbaló en el suelo y notamos que el AC estaba goteando y el suelo estaba mojado. Necesitamos cambiar habitación nuevamente porque no pude tener la oportunidad de quedarme con un suelo húmedo y un niño de 22 meses de edad. De nuevo nos cambiaron a otra habitación (TERCERA). Esta vez la habitación era mucho peor y más allá de todo lo que los otros dos. Después de este punto, yo estaba muy decepcionada y un poco molesta. Lo que era de suponer que es un lugar relajante para nosotros resultó ser una pesadilla. Imagínense tres veces, yendo y viniendo con un cochecito y dos hijos, embalaje y desembalaje de aquí y allí. Después de llorar un rato he decidí volver fuera de la habitación. En mi camino a la playa me encontré con otros 4 clientes insatisfechos que también se estaban hospedando su segundo vez todos están de acuerdo en cuánto a que el complejo necesita mejoras y cómo parece haber cambiado. (Sí, te cobran por el servicio de habitación) Aquí está una lista de algunos de los pros y contras que enfrentamos aquí. Tengo que decir que he notado que van bajo algún tipo de renovación , QUE CREO QUE EL COMPLEJO NECESITA!
Pros: Hermosa estructura del hotel, los jardines bien cuidados, cerca de la playa, muy amable el personal, (trabajan duro especialmente camareros y cocineros), comida decente, calidad, lugar tranquilo, entretenimiento nocturno, orientada a la familia, bonito club para niños ubicado en la reserva, grandes salas de convenciones, bonito centro comercial cercano y mucho más. 
Contras: corto en empleados , muy anticuada la decoración de las habitaciones, un poco sucias las paredes , muy repetitivo menú de almuerzo y cena en el buffet, duchas no funciona correctamente, bichos y cucarachas. (Sí, sé que estamos en un país tropical, pero por favor no tienen ellos arrastrándose sobre sus mesas de comedor en el restaurante Ibana) no hay basta de basura suficiente, playa había basura (se veía más como una playa en Jersey), mayores precios por noche en comparación con otros lugares similares en la zona y muchos otros pequeños problemas ..... 
 
 En general, el complejo en sí no es malo, es un hermoso lugar que necesita algunas mejoras y renovaciones. Es muy triste para mí ver y oír a la gente que esta era su primera visita a la República Dominicana diciendo que sintieron que el resort no valía el dinero y que no volverá al complejo ni el país. Sé que es un hecho que la República Dominicana es un gran lugar para visitar con la cálida gente trabajadora. Y no es justo que juzguen a todo el país tan sólo porque el complejo no cumplan sus expectativas. Es de esperar que el hotel mejore, así inconvenientes como esto no ocurrirá a sus visitantes futuros.

reviews.author: Caroline G
reviews.title: Beaucoup trop cher!!
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une semaine au très bel Hotel Paradisus Palma Real du 28 juillet au 4 Août 2017.
Comme nous fêtions mon mari et moi nos 10 ans de mariage, nous avons réservé le "paquet".
Section Royale, adulte seulement et suite  vue mer.
À notre arrivée, le transport privé vers l'hôtel s'est très bien déroulé.
Une fois à l'hôtel, la réception fut très ordinaire. Après être passé au comptoir de la réception, nous attendions quelqu'un afin de nous mener à la réception de la section Rpyale...il n'est jamais arrivé
On s'est débrouillé pour trouver ce lounge VIP et faire notre check in.
Notre concierge pour la semaine nous est présenté, Faustino. Il nous remet un cellulaire afin de le joindre en tout temps et nous conduit à notre suite vue mer.
Très belle suite. Grand lit king, belle décoration. Petite déception au niveau de la terrasse...pas de bain tourbillon extérieur ni de lit pour s'y reposer, se faire bronzer, ou lire en fin de journée. Une petite table ronde et deux chaises composent notre terrasse.
La vue est tout de même très belle.
La section Royale, adulte est toute petite par rapport au reste de l'hôtel.
La piscine adulte est jolie, mais minuscule. Le seul bain tourbillon dans la piscine, ne fonctionne pas.
Il est facile d"obtenir un lit réservé à la plage ou à la piscine en passant par son concierge. Nous n'avions donc pas à nous soucier de nous trouver des chaises ou des lits pour la journée, j'ai trouvè que c'était le point le plus positif de la semaine.

Cependant à la mer, personne ne vient nous voir pour nous proposer des drinks, on va les chercher nous meme...plutôt décevant pour cette qualité d'hôtel.
Les verres à la mer et à la piscine sont des verres de cartons. Pas terrible pour y boire un petit mimosa ou autre drinks alcoolisês. De beaux verres de plastiques stylisés comme on retrouve ailleurs dans des Hotels 5 étoiles auraient mieux fait l'affaire!
Lorsque nous y étions, les abords de la mer étaient plein d'algues. Ils ont beau nettoyer tôt le matin, rien a faire...terrible!! ( voir photos)
Vous pouvez vous baigner jusqu'à environ midi, car la plage demeure relativement propre malgré les tas d'algues, après c'est franchement deguelasse.
Le sable est beau et blanc, la plage large.

Il y a beaucoup de vendeurs sur la plage, ils sont un peu fatiguants. Cigare, bijoux, excursions, lunettes, sacs à main,  etc... ça n'arrête pas beaucoup. Ils parlent forts et viennent nous déranger jusqu'à nos chaises ou à notre lit sous le palapa.
Je comprends qu'ils doivent gagner leur vie, mais je suis honnête, c'est dérangeant.

Le deuxième soir, nous avons décidé d'aller souper au fameux restaurant Passion. Quelle bonne idée!!
Un menu dégustation à 70$ US par personne, établi par un chef étoilé de 8 étoiles Michelin. Un vrai délice. Serveurs exceptionnels. Le notre faisait meme l'effort de nous expliquer nos assiettes en Francais, merci à Rodny Vanderpool.

La troisième journée, nous en avions assez de n'avoir aucun service à la plage, tel que stipulé dans le descriptif de la brochure d'air transat. J'en ai donc fait la remarque à notre concierge qui m'a garantie que nous aurions du service à l'avenir....l'après midi s'est super bien passé, mais le lendemain tout etait oublié, le service avec. Pourri.
Une fois installé, ne vous attendez pas à revoir le serveur.

Ce meme soir, nous avons mangé au Steak House, restaurant Rare. 
C'est un grand restaurant, très bruyant. Rien de romantique, ou de relaxant.
Il y a avait beaucoup de monde même à 21:00 le soir, le service etait donc très lent. J'ai meme ete nous chercher deux verres de vin au bar car nous en avions assez d 'attendre.
La nourriture etait très bonne , un 8/10. 
Peu de choix de steak inclu pour un steakhouse. Vous avez cependant la possible de choisir différents autres steaks avec un supplément.

Pour les amoureux de la langouste, il y en a le jeudi seulement au buffet.

Si vous désirez un souper plus décontracté, mais tout aussi bruyant, il y a le classique japonais avec tappanyaki. Restaurant Baja.
Beaucoup d'enfants, beaucoup de bruit, mais très bon,
Vous y avez également quelques tables si vous désirez manger des sushis.

Quant au restaurant Vento, comme il est classé restaurant chic, les hommes doivent porter le pantalon long.
C'est bien tout ce qu'il y a de chic la!!!! Le look général du resto est bien, mais rien d'extraordinaire. Encore une fois, un gros resto famille, bruyant, chaises droites et table de simili bois. Menu genre cuisine Grecque, avec couscous et shawarma,
Un max de 6/10 pour la cuisine.
Notre serveur etait très gentil, Seignor Anthony,
En 45 minutes nous étions ressorti...une usine!!

Le vin maison est un vin espagnol correct.

L'hôtel demeure un très beau complexe, avec de grandes colonnes blanches, de grandes piscines, très vaste en superficie.
Toutes les salles de bains sur le site sont bien entretenues. Petit commentaire sur les grandes salles de bains  du lobby principal, c'est la première fois que je vois des serviettes de table de papier ( Paradisus) comme essuie mains dans un 5 étoiles!! Ça fait "cheap"!!

Meme si vous choisissez la section Royale, 18 ans et plus, vous devez vous attendre à manger, au moins 80 % du temps avec des enfants...souvent très jeunes.
À moins de vous confiner à la section Royale et de manger 3 fois par jour au restaurant Palazzo réservé aux adultes. ( excellent serveur Miguel Jimenez)
Mais vous feriez vite le tour du menu.
Cependant, la nourriture y est excellente et le service également. ( à part au petit déjeuner)
Nous n'avons rien contre les enfants, nous en avons eu trois et avons beaucoup voyager pour eux, en tenant compte de leurs besoins et leurs envies.
Étant maintenant à une  autre étape de notre vie, la présence d'enfants lors de nos voyages de couple est idéalement à éviter.

Quant à la temperature, elle fut parfaite toute la semaine. Un beau soleil et un vent constant.

En conclusion, nous ne retournerons pas au Paradisus Palma Real. Il est difficile de ne pas comparer avec les derniers  Hotels dans lesquels nous avons séjourné récemment à Punta Cana. Par exemple le Iberostar grand Bavaro ou meme le Excellence El Carmen, tous les deux sont, à bien des points de vue, bien mieux que le Paradisus Palma Real.
Que l'on parle de tranquillité, de qualité de la nourriture, du service, de l'accueil des gens sur place, de la beaute des lieux , l'endroit est grandement dépassé par ces Hotels.
On compare bien sûr des 5 étoiles avec des 5 étoiles.
Cette semaine nous coûtait plus de 4000$ par personne, nous nous permettons donc d'être exigeants et je pense que c'est normal.
Bonnes vacances à vous!!

reviews.author: lynnhY326AS
reviews.title: Overbooked, so disappointed
reviews.text: Our room was overbooked, we had to be moved to their "upgraded" hotel, room not ready their, one wasted day, next day on the beach, which was nice, then the next day we had to be moved back to our original hotel that was booked.  We lost two whole days, so really instead of a 7 night we should have paid for a 5 night trip.  This was a 30th retirement vacation, so disappointed.  Then got food poisoning, toilet broke in the "upscale hotel we were moved to first", just one thing after another.  Last year we went to the NOW Lamier and had a wonderful time/stay.  I thought Melia resorts were suppose to be great, not for us.

reviews.author: 443bobbym
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Average place food was ok services was great they didn't have the top shelf liquid out you had to ask for it the staff was great very friendly entertainment great really like the resort grounds was very clean l would go back didn't like melia they me one price and they said it was on hold the next day they charge me $479.00 more per person

reviews.author: Jeannette D
reviews.title: Not happy with service so far for restaurants
reviews.text: Here now and frustrated. When we arrived yesterday, check in was quick ans easy and rooms are beautiful. However, we had to pick only 4 restaurants for our week. We were told we would have to go to the buffet our first night. We went to the Gabi but did not think the Gabi buffet had good good. However, we were told a  reservation slip would be under our door between 12 and4. No paper. I called the front desk the first time, he just said ok and then I waited on hold for awhile. I called back and was told we were reserved at"the BBQ". Tonight. That was not one of the reservation choices we had made and I did not even see it on the list. Then he said he would connect me and the phone just rang and rang. Then we went to the lady in the lobby below and we were told today, that we had to eat yet again at the buffet and that we were at "the bbq" tomorrow night and then two other restaurants coming up for night 3 and 4. When I asked which one, one of them was also, not on my list. I do not understand selecting places we would like to eat and not getting all 4 and only 3, 2 of which I did not choose. The lady tried to call for me and then asked me if I wanted to eat at 1 of the other restaurants I chose on Sunday. This is Thursday. I said yes but then noticed it was at a different time slot then I had chosen. Each time I would voice my complaint about the way this was being handled, she would say, "as I explained to you".  The entire process was very frustrating. She was sitting with another lady and the two of them kept speaking back and forth in their language which was also frustrating as I am sitting right there. They both speak english, so speak english so I can understand whats happening. So, bottom line. I paid for the reserve which is supposed to be on the higher end of service. I am here for 7 days. I got to make a "wish" list for 4 of my 7 days. I got 3 choices.  Wed and thur buffet, like it or not. Now I just notice I have 2 bookings for 1 night. So, now it is confirmed I have paid for 7 night of which I am "allowed to eat in 2 of the 12 restaurants they have. Now, we are gonna try again to get someone to help us. Arrrggg. So frustrating.

reviews.author: Carolina Avendaño
reviews.title: Nos robaron en la habitacion y no nos respondieron
reviews.text: Tengan mucho cuidado porque nos robaron en la habitacion dinero y un celular y al poner la queja en administración estaban diciendo que podría ser un auto robo. Ojo con dejarsen estafar con ese Club Melia por favor no vayan a esas charlas es una estafa apenas adquieres la membresia no te cumplen ni con la mitad de las cosas prometidas. Son unos ladrones.

reviews.author: Bruno p
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text:
We have been to this resort two time, the most recently 7-23-17 to 7-28-17. The first time seemed like customer service was top priority. 

This year our concierge did not pay us any mind. Front desk was not helpful getting us a later checkout. The reason we fly out of ny is to experience the local favorites, such as presidente beers. I was very disappointed because all they had was coorslight and Heineken stocked in my mini fridge. I asked for presidente but was told they don't carry it.  A resort in punta cana, DR not serving presidente is ridiculous.  Mall shopping needs to have more local vendors and less big corp stores. 

Other than that,

The resort is beautiful, I am shocked to see how well the team take care of the property. We were there 2012 and pretty much everything is well maintained and new until today. I work in a hotel in NYC and I know how hard it is. A big Bravo to engineering and housekeeping department. You guys are great!

reviews.author: ljgwjr
reviews.title: Seaweed, crowded, lack of air conditioning in restaurants and common area
reviews.text:
The seaweed was out of control! They were coming with dump trucks all day to pick it up. Unreal!!!  It was a disaster in the water and on the shore. Kids wouldn't even go in water. 
Too crowded and very slippery around property with tile. So hot in July and lack of aircondirioning  around property. 
If you have a family of 4, there is no privacy in your room. There are shutters and columns separating your room from bathroom. Clear doors on bathroom and showers. If you need to cover for privacy w/ teenage kids, never enough towels because housekeeping removes it and only leaves 4 towels. They do not leave washclothes ever and I would lock up your personal items!

reviews.author: LoveTravel_1718
reviews.title: NOT what we were expecting
reviews.text: The hotel is stunning, but there were a few things that were nagging, so I'll never return to this place. Check-in was a nightmare. Room not ready by 4 pm. and check-in person insisting we would just go out and eat while they cleaned. The shower kept leaking. They "fixed it" and then we only had cold water. They fixed it again by replacing the entire shower and there was no way to get the right temp. TV was broken. They "fixed it" where the control wouldn't work. They came and "fixed it" again saying the previous crew didn't know what they were doing. The hotel "Doctor" called 3 TIMES during one night with the wrong room number (and BTW, this is ALL in Spanish, which is my first language and I explained to him every single time he had the wrong number). The people selling "stuff' at the beach was BEYOND annoying, and management should do something about it. This doesn't happen in other areas in the island. Just here in Bávaro. So, all in all, we spent a good bit of time calling Guest Services (I know all the ladies on a first name basis) to fix problems in this 5 star suite. They also advertise a "Kids Club" but the club is not located in their property. It's part of their next door property and you need to take a shuttle to get there  (False advertising). Did management care? nope. At check out, I explained our experience and we never even heard the words "we are sorry". No, I won't go back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Aisha T
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with flaws..bring a can of lysol, raid bug/roach spray, and clorox wipes.
reviews.text:
When you arrive, the views are simply breathtaking.  Things quickly changed during check-in.  The front desk staff at the resort specifically Milton, was totally disrespectful to my entire group during check-in.  We had three reservations booked through Costco travel with two people in each room and rooms were supposed to be next to one another.  
 
We were immediately instructed by Milton that the resort was totally sold out and booked to capacity.  We thought, OK no worries we booked and requested double beds, rooms in close proximity to one another so we didn’t think there would be an issue since our Costco booking specifically stated the details (we thought our rooms were being held until we arrived to the resort mid afternoon after a 4 hour flight).  

To our surprise, the rooms didn’t have double beds and the rooms weren’t close to each other (we were in different buildings).  We showed Milton our Costco booking itinerary to verify the details of our booking.  Milton stated “they” had no record of additional companions in the rooms and they could not and would not accommodate our request and that “it was not his problem”, basically take it or leave it.  From what we gathered, our booking for double beds and rooms on the same floor are considered "special requests" by the resort and subject to resort availability.  The members of my group and I were totally shocked and caught off guard with Milton’s response, lack of compassion and verbal disrespect during our conversation.  

To diffuse the situation, my group and I took the last few rooms offered.  My group and I were determined to enjoy ourselves despite the horrible exchange at the cheek-in desk.

Except for the main building, the buildings DO NOT have elevators; my room was located on the first floor and smelled of mildew and mold.  The room was older and decorated with dark/old wood furniture that appeared to have been repainted at some point.  The room was bug infested and at one point water streamed down the walls in the bathroom from upstairs.  We alerted the front desk of the water problem and they never came to address our concerns.  We also noticed puddles of water in the hallway every day in addition to the neighborhood cats roaming around. The hallways have very, very, very dim lighting (watch your steps) we even noticed one hallway without lights the entire 5 days we were there (no one changed the bulb).  Room key cards worked when they wanted, we had to have our keys changed 3 times.

Housekeeping did a good job cleaning our room each day however they did not leave washcloths, we had to call the front desk EVERYDAY to request washcloths be delivered. 

The buffet restaurant staff especially "Junior" went above and beyond each day to ensure our group had a nice table.  Junior made sure all drink requests were provided quickly and correctly. We can’t express our gratitude to the waiters, waitresses and bartenders who worked tirelessly each day to ensure we were happy, happy, happy (tips well deserved). 

My group did not have any problem making reservations at the other restaurants. Just a suggestion, make restaurant reservations as soon as you arrive to you get the time slots you want. Transportation to and from the restaurants on the Royal side are provided.

The onsite Blue travel agent, Ms. Emma Espinal provided exceptional customer service during our stay at the resort. Emma provided my group with helpful safety tips while abroad, she booked all of our excursions quickly and was on site each day during our stay to offer any assistance.  She was polite, courteous, and patient and provided a wealth of knowledge regarding the resort and history of Dominique Republic.

Yhi Spa was fantastic, keep in mind there is an 18% fee charged on all services that they don't tell you at the time of spa booking. 

Don't waste your time going to the mall; the bus leaves resort every 15 mins.  The mall  consists of extremely high price tourist shops. The best place to buy gifts is the resort gift shop they have daily specials or the local grocery store outside of the mall.  The mall also has a Pandora jewelry store that sells all Pandora bracelet charms in addition to Dominican Republic charms that you can only get there.  

Despite our horrible check-in experience and additional setbacks during our stay overall my group and I enjoyed our trip.  Honestly, we would not recommend this resort to anyone in the future.

reviews.author: Vilmarie C
reviews.title: Family Yearly Vacay
reviews.text: My girls and I take a yearly vacation and we planned this trip from last year. Since I had received many recommendations that this was a 5 star hotel we were very excited! We arrived on June27th. Of course we arrived a little early so we walked around and looked at the premises and ate at the buffet. We were able to make reservations at all of the restaurants. When we returned to the check in desk everything was ready and our great concerige Franklin took us to our room. I couldn't live without Franklin. And he was always around when I needed him.  He wasn't overbearing or pushy. The room was clean and cool.  But the decor was dated. But I do have to say I had the best housekeeper, Miledy. She took care of the room and us. The pool and the beach was wonderful. The bartenders at the beach Luis and Lee were great. The first two days I had some severe stomach issue and Luis made me some stomach drink and I was feeling better afterwards. Moving forward, the buffet lacked taste and service at times.  At times there were only three waiters cleaning off the tables and serving drinks. The most moving moment was when my family and I was leaving early for an excursion and went early for breakfast and realized we really didn't have time to eat. The waiter, Davidson, ran up with a cup of coffee and a little snack. It was the best thing for a long day ahead. Also, the supervisor of the buffet Gregorio Arias was always helpful.  At all times I arrived at the buffet he made eye contact with me and ensure my family and I were taken care. Others staff at buffet weren't as welcoming as Davidson and Gregorin. Moreover, the best restaurant was Rare. The steak was delicious but the service took a little long. But it was a pretty popular restaurant after the first reservation we were not able to get reservation again. Also, the lunch burger restaurant was a good spot. Their aioli fries were a hit. But there service was very slow as well.  We enjoyed our stay because we met new friends and the majority of the staff was very helpful and warm. There was a free shuttle that took us the Palma Village to shop. But improvements need to be made in the dining and decor immediately. Sadly it didn't meet the expectations I had made in my mind prior to the trip.

reviews.author: Conor O
reviews.title: Great view; decent experience/service
reviews.text: View is amazing upon entering.  Rooms were clean and nice; not fantastic.  Food was pretty good.  Front desk service great; restaurant service was hit or miss.  The beach area was nice but crowded very early on.  The 'exclusive'  beach area was far too big and was not even 25% filled most of the time; allotting this much space for the exclusive area shrinks to available 'general' beach area.    I had a good time, but wouldn't stay here again. I would choose where I went previously (Secrets) or somewhere else.

reviews.author: mcalavano1971
reviews.title: Average, All depends upon what you are expecting in a vacation
reviews.text:
So I never write reviews. In this case I felt the need to in order to help others looking at going to the Paradisus Palma Real. Just returned last night. Stayed 5 nights stayed in a Luxury Junior Suite and paid $3,060 for 2 people flights included and the transfers as well. Costco Travel. Did not stay at the Reserve and after going to this resort I wouldn't recommend the extra money. The Reserve is set back furthest from the beach and really doesn't offer anything more. There is a special roped off area for reserve members on the beach but it is still the same beach and there are plenty of seating in the other area. Also when the hotel has on the website that theres are 8 restaurants per say. Well there kind of is and isn't. FYI the food is ok but thats about it. You can only go to Passion if you on the "Reserve" for free otherwise it is 70$ per head. And having great food in NYC and all over the country the Dominican is hardly a place I would spend that kind of money on based upon what the other restaurants were like. Vento is sub par. We had 8:00 reservations showed up on time and were not seated for 90 minutes later and people that came in after us with no reservations were seated before. That was fine we sat at the bar. Finally got seated took quite some time for 2 sub par appetizers ( actually were not good) and no one came to take our dinner order after another 30 minutes so we left. I didn't care my bf was annoyed. The mexican restaurant is the same as the burger bar during the day. Lets just say based upon the menu observation and what others said, I believe my 15 year old could cook and put together a better menu. We did not go. Fuego for lunch I believe is the best place there. the ambience was really nice. In fact all the bars at the restaurants were nice. I would in hindsight sit at one of those bars and then just hit the buffet. The buffet is surprisingly pretty ok. It just gets boring. Now to Palazzo. Italian. Subpar menu. I was excited to try RARE the steak house. We were seated on time, good start. If you wanted like a sirloin steak it was going to cost you extra. Sirloin is not exactly my idea of a great steak. Shrimp cocktail is not like in the states and what one would expect but at this point I was expecting it not to be. More like a ceviche. Whatever. Bread was terrible my Tuna was awful. The mac and cheese was well not good either. Got something else we blocked that out too and went to the buffet. Now there is a sushi and hibachi place Ibana but make sure that you specify if your reservations are for hibachi or sushi. I learned to ask and look on this vacation. Based upon it all we passed on this. Maybe if I lived in the middle of no where in the country and never had sushi or hibachi maybe this would be good. I do not not live a crazy rich life and live in an average jersey shore town. Buffet for breakfast is thumbs up. Made to order omelets works great. Nice cheese assortment at the buffet which I thought was cool for a pseudo happy hour. You cannot eat your food at any of the bars FYI. 
Plenty of mixed drinks, wine is not very good at all. Beer is beer. 
Room was clean, staff members were very great. Big pro here. 
Lots of family and kids so if you don't want that this is not your joint. 
Nothing to do at night. Casino is laughable after having lived in Atlantic City NJ. Disco even funnier. But whatever. 
No live music which was disappointing. I got better live music at the airport on the way out leaving punt cana. 
At night they have some stuff but its not really great to be honest. They are certainly no atlantic city or nyc acts. 
I do believe the resort tried really hard to make everything great for everyone. 
Water at the beach ( and I am not talking about the sea weed, they can't control mother nature and were diligent about trying to keep the beach clean). The water is not like the clear beautiful waters in the Exumas nor even what I saw in mexico or Antigua or Barbados. 
Value for the money paid, a good getaway. Would only have stayed 3-4 nights if I had to do it again but that being said I would not go to the Dominican again and if I would have known I would have spent more money and stayed at the Hard Rock as I heard they had live music outside at the pools. 
If the paradisus wants a calm feel who wouldn't like a little acoustic guitar music at the outside bar or at the pool for a few hours. Walking up the beach though this is a nicer resort down there. 
All in all average I should have spent a few more dollars and went back to a prettier island.

reviews.author: Glenn V
reviews.title: Wedding was beautiful
reviews.text: First time at this resort, The resort is beautiful and had a lot of amenities, but was not our cup of tea. Check in was slow, we got there and there was one person in front of us and it still took 40 minutes to get our room, this was at approximately 530 pm on a Friday. Even though the beaches in Punta Cana are beautiful, this time there was an a huge amount of seaweed on the beach and in the water (not the fault of the resort of course) and did not want to get in the water. We could never find a chair at the pool, people put towels on them early in the morning and keep them there all through the  day. the staff at the hamburger restaurant was awful, poor service and major attitudes!! The staff at the buffet was on the most part very nice and service was average. Tried to book times for the special restaurants but could only get late reservations or really early. We did find an employee that went out of his way for you and the was Enrique at guest services, he was fantastic!! All in all there was nothing that made us want to come back.

reviews.author: juliserrano
reviews.title: Aspectos para mejorar
reviews.text:
Es un hotel en el que la zona de la alberca es amplia y tiene varias Cabañas, por ese lado está muy bien. 
Los alimentos tienen mucho donde mejorar,  no es nada del otro mundo.... así como los cuartos pues la iluminación del es muy mala, y ya está todo viejo. La puerta del balcón con dificultad abre, la ducha es súper chiquita e incómoda.

es de destacar la amabilidad de las personas que ayudan en el servicio.

reviews.author: Tyndall_Family
reviews.title: Relaxing Trip, but one get tired of the reservation game
reviews.text:
This was our fourth family trip to Punta Cana.  Previous visits have been to the Melia Caribe and to the Paradisus Palma Real.  We have two boys who on this trip were 10 and 13 years old.

We stayed at the Reserve in a 1 BR Master Suite. The room was great. If you are comparing to the Palma Real, the rooms are smaller and the biggest difference is the patio / deck.  There isn't much reason to hand out on the patio at PC.  Palma Real wins hands down in this comparison.

The beach and pools are very nice.  The biggest downside to the pools and the beach are the lack of seats.  If you don't mind waking up early in the morning to reserve your seat then you will be fine.  It was madding to sit at the beach and see towels sitting on empty chairs for hours.  People and staff would reserve spaces at the pools and beaches and not use them for hours.

The food at the restaurants was good.  The reservation system was a mess.  We were able to eat at all the places that we wanted to during our stay, but it took active management to make sure that we were able to get in to the places we wanted to visit.
