reviews.text: We came in on a Saturday and tried making dinner reservations for the whole week because we knew that could become an issue. We were told not to worry that someone would help us with each reservation. We got cards with reservations the first day. They were for 9:30. We took it the first day. We told the conceirge that time was too late with our kids. They kept making reservations for 8:30, 9:00. One day they switched the time to 8:00 and when we showed up they didn't have any seats until 8:30. One of my kids fell asleep on the dinner table waiting for food. How atrocious. I complained and the next night they grudgingly accommodated us. It negatively flavored an otherwise wonderful vacation. But that's all we felt- the negative experience with dinners. Just left a bad taste in our mouth. Fighting to get fed when you've already paid for dinner in an all inclusive is frustrating.

reviews.author: Eat-Love-Repeat
reviews.title: Late review, Wrong time of year
reviews.text:
My family of four visited the Paradisus Puna Cana and the Reserve for Thanksgiving week 2016.  The grounds were absolutely beautiful. The weather was terrible.  We originally stayed int the original part which was a bit dated but comfortable.  We were moved to the Reserve which was more modern.
I did not feel that we had the best experience because the resort was flooded most of the time and raining the whole week,  there was a tropical storm that we couldn't have forseen because we booked so early.
The food was okay, I have been to the Dominican Republic before and stayed at the Riu resorts and the are "over the top" with the food.  I did not fee this way at all at this resort, however, they had a small selection of average food.  They had a server by the name of Anyolino Rosario, that was absolutely AMAZING.  She made us feel like family and even provided our kids with the most inviting dining experience.  We loved her, she is definitely an assest to this resort.
The shows were amazing!The Micheal Jackson expierence, The Lion KIng, and the Acrobat show was top notch. 
My twelve year old daughter loved the non alcoholic pina coladas.  Her and I kept our glasses full the whole time. 
Over all, we enjoyed our trip.  We would book in the summer months.
If you're a foodie like me, I would look elsewhere.
If you're a romantic, love great scenery, good dinners, quite escapes, great pictures, I would definitely choose this resort.

reviews.author: Kaltoum B
reviews.title: Hôtel passable
reviews.text:
Dommage mais pas à la hauteur des 5 étoiles!!! 

Accueil : inexistant 

Chambre : mobilier et literie pas top, douche catastrophe (pas d'eau), ménage à revoir ( boutons au lever le matin; on soupçonne la présence de punaise de lit qui été confirmé par notre concierge)

Restauration : pas de qualité et pas très diverse, 
Les Resto à réserver à heure fixe contraignant et parfois l'horaire n'est pas respectée. 

Piscine : rien de particulier.

Personnel : à l'écoute, ambiance sympa. 

Mini club : super !!👍 

Plage : belle mais la disposition des transat pas terrible,
La mer assez forte. 

SPA : à éviter : accueil pas terrible et super cher !! 

Environnement : magnifique parc , végétations +++

Animation spectacle : super les animations journée et soir. Le spectacle M.JAKSON à voir absolument !

reviews.author: Paula G
reviews.title: Very very Large
reviews.text:
Interesting resort. We were here as part of a large group. Grounds are beautiful, gorgeous landscaping with all types of bridges, ponds, eco walking trails, and gorgeous zen like design around the spa.
However, you are mostly left on your own to find your way around, as plan/ design was not well thought out. Each part is lovely, but isolated from the rest which creates no flow. Could walk all over, very flat, and good for running. I took a run to find the gym, but ran in circles until I found it. It was teeny with only 3 treadmills for a ton of people..they did have spin classes and only 5 people from the massive amount of guests showed up.  Maybe not an athletic crowd. Yoga class on the beach had a good turnout, but the instructor was not a real yoga person, and it was a terrible class. I expected better, but got used to not great. Paddle yoga in the pool ( sounds great) which I did want to do, had only 5 or 6 boards, all taken, so I couldn't participate when I really wanted to.
Rooms need updating. And heard most complaints about the sinks, the toilets, and very dark with no place to put clothes.
Food, good,but trying a little too hard to be gournet, and not quite up there. But tasty, fresh, and diverse.  Reservations needed, but very disorganized system. Passion, was a joke.
But, the place seems packed and popular in spite of its faults. Help is not really trained well compared to many other all inclusives from another resort company we usually frequent.
Stayed for 4 days, and was very pleasant and beach was great. Wouldn't be able to take the disorganization for a week!

reviews.author: Lindsey A
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with some flaws
reviews.text:
First of all the property is absolutely stunning and very well maintained. The pool area was great, not too busy and lots of lounging options. The huts with the sunbeds were great. The beach was beautiful, compared to neighbouring resorts, the parasisus reserve had the best set up. The food was average, I don't have high standards, the food was similar if not worse than other all-inclusives that I have stayed at in Cuba and Mexico with less star ratings. 
Our room was on the first floor, and we could hear everything above us. The floor is marble and everytime the people above used the dining chairs we would hear a loud screech. We were traveling with our 8 month old who was waken up by these noises frequently. Our patio door did not completely close or lock. It looked like it had been forced open with a crowbar in the past. 
Restaurant and bar staff were very friendly, but
 unfortunately we found the concierge service useless.

reviews.author: Missy M
reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text:
The resort is very nice and grounds are very beautiful but make sure you have the Royal Service, (Pay Extra) The Reserve is far from the beach just FYI.Check in is a nightmare, 3 hours in line. Then checking out tried to recharge our credit card for our entire stay. Keep all receipts!  

Food is normal all-inclusive food and drinks are good!

reviews.author: Lexington11
reviews.title: Bring your own Pinot Nior
reviews.text:
Because you can't get any here for less than $95 per bottle, and that's the stuff you would pay $19 at your local Food Lion.  Would never come back even though we stayed at the Reserve, which is comparable to the concierge level at a hotel.... supposed to be special with your own personal butler... really?  You met him on the first day and he gave you a cell phone in order to give you the confidence that he was available to you day and night..... and then he didn't answer your calls the very next day.... 
Infrascture of the place is phenomenal, room is very big and nicely laid out.  That's the biggest plus of this place.  Spa, well.... service is poor.  None of the jacuzzi's or saunas would get hot enough and there was no one around to assist.  Restaurants? Mmmm well at best a 3, again untrained service personnel.

reviews.author: Dukefamilyof4
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
3 days into our week long trip, but posting early since I know people were looking for information for near term travel. Note: we did not have royal service.

Restaurant Reservations - We tried emailing to make restaurant reservations the week before our trip, but got no response so decided to wait till we were on site. Once we checked in, it was 4pm and we were told it was too late to make reservations. The next morning, there was a long line at guest services. (After 30 min in line, one staff member saw that the line was moving very slowly so she started talking to people in line to see if she could help, taking notes so the team could follow up.) When I came back later, I was told that the best reservations they could give me were 9 or 9:30 each night (I was looking for 7-7:30). I found it ridiculous that they couldn't get me in before 9 for the entire week so insisted on speaking with a manager. Jindrich, the Food & Beverage Director, was exceedingly pleasant and was able to get more reasonable reservations. The interesting thing is, both nights so far the restaurants were only about a third full. Seems fishy.

Service - the service here doesn't seem quite as good as I've seen at other resorts (including another Paradisus resort). Bartenders have been very friendly and attentive. Same with entertainment crew. Guest services has been good as well (perhaps a little more practical, what you might expect in the US vs bend over backwards service orientation. Juan Carlos at Coming2 (for excursion planning) was super helpful and patient. 
It's our "concierge", restaurants and around the property where I've seen the shortcomings, which could mostly be a combination of language and insufficient staff. After check in, we had a woman tell us she was our concierge and she talked about all the things she could help us with as she showed us to our room. However, it seemed like all she was really interested in was giving us a presentation about the new Melia concept. 

Restaurant service has generally been slower than typical island time. Several times at the buffet, no one has come by with water or to take drink orders for the entire meal. Once, we tracked down a staff member holding a water bottle and asked for him to come fill our water glasses and he still didn't! (Had to be a that he didn't speakEnglish). The other big language issue was when my husband asked if a dessert had nuts (food allergy) in it and was told no.. it did. If you have a food allergy, make sure you talk to guest services about it so they can inform the staff and chefs properly.

Around the property, we've noticed towels and empty glasses lying around longer than I would expect. Not an eyesore or problem in any way, but makes you wonder. 

Transit - taxi to property was super easy, $30 and a quick drive

Room - generally happy with the layout, though it would have been nice if there were 2 half baths like the one in Playa Del Carmen. More importantly, wifi is spotty (you tube and even Netflix seem to work fairly well, but basic searches don't - not sure why). Water pressure is terrible. We had an issue with the bedroom TV. We called and they sent someone to fix it promptly (replaced TV when brief troubleshooting didn't work).

Resort - beautiful, but worn in some places (e.g. outdoor furniture, aqua area at the spa). Very cool (not heated) pool. Plenty of bars. No outside hot tub (relevant since it's been cold and windy).

Spa - hut for couples massage was super cool. Service was very nice. Layout is weird - the place with the steam room and indoor hot tub is a separate building from where you check in. And those facilities were really worn - showers weren't working, one hot tub wasn't, etc.

Restaurants
Olio - decent Italian (Olive Garden quality)
Rare - steak was tasty and only cooked one level past what I ordered, but mashed potatoes were awful
Naos (buffet) - some really good things and some not good, as you'd expect
Blue Agave at lunch - really small menu, but burgers aren't bad, opt for the potato wedges over the fries

Shows - Le Cirque was pretty good. Not impressed with the other two we've seen so far.

Will post more if there are other insights.

reviews.author: sunfunandservice
reviews.title: If your not staying in Royal Adults only They won't even look at you!
reviews.text: People are very right in saying this is not a family kind of resort. There is nothing for kids what so ever, and also the pool here is colder than the ocean for them. There's like 4 categories in this hotel. Firstly the royal gold banded adults only. That have half the resort only blocked for them including the beach. Then there is the executive concierge and they again have their own much smaller piece of the hotel and beach. Then third is the reserve new section not even located in the same hotel. Again have another part of the beach. These three get drink service and cozy chairs, then comes the regular rooms, that get the worst chairs, you can hardly sit in. No room to get a drink at the only pool bar for the largest amount of people. You are suppose to get pool and beach service, but you will never see them. Even if you tip yes. There is not really any ocean front rooms no matter which category your in. The architecture is pretty and beautiful beach. But because of the wear and tear on the rooms and the absolutely not 5 star service anywhere in the resort. Front desk will tell you yes and never deliver. Paradisius puna cana was much better than this one in palm beach punta cana.

reviews.author: Pascual M
reviews.title: Excelentes playas, mal servicio!
reviews.text:
La verdad es que lo mejor que tiene el hotel es la infraestructura y la playa. El servicio deja muchísimo que desear en un lugar que debería ser de excelencia. Son incapaces de resolver cualquier problema en poco tiempo, para todo se toman una eternidad...y hacen perder tiempo de calidad de vacaciones al huésped. 
Para comer, lo mejor está en el buffet, ni se asomen en los restos que la carta es súper reducida, y hay mala atención. 
En todo caso, vayan al "aqua", el resto del hotel "La Reserva". Ahí la atención y la comida son excelentes, y pertenece al mismo complejo y está incluido en el paquete.

reviews.author: Lauron2013
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: Great beach with lots of chairs. The beach was very clean. Hard to get a lounge chair, too many people saving them, however there was a lot. Too much VIP areas that weren't used. Room was tired and needed updating. Food was awesome, especially the steak house..We had previously stayed we a La Paradisus in Playa del Carmen and it was excellent, this was not up to that standard. Staff was awesome!  Golf was included in the price however no Marshall with slow play and carts and drinks were way overpriced

reviews.author: gadolfores
reviews.title: DESAYUNAR ES UNA ODISEA
reviews.text: Es muy demorado y un verdadero caos el servicio de desayunos. Muy pocos meseros y una gran descoordinación entre ellos. El almuerzo en el buffet, igual. Los demás restaurantes muy buenos. El bar barra libre es excelente y muy variado.

reviews.author: michel k
reviews.title: service et animation en forte régression
reviews.text:
Pour notre deuxième passage, n'avons plus retrouvé le niveau de service et d'attention, idem pour l'animation. Étant en mobilité réduite, avons dû accepter le premier étage alors que c'était précisé à la réservation. Au restaurant principal, pas moyen de regrouper notre famille (8 personnes) à une même table, sauf à s'en occuper soi même. Et il manquait toujours une fourchette ou serviette ou autre. Au bar de plage, vous devez aussi commander par vous même. Sommes pas habitués à cela et pour ce prix.
Quant aux courts de tennis, ils sont tellement délabrés qu'on n'a pas envie d'y aller.
Voilà c'est vraiment dommage, et nous ne savons pas si nous y retournerons.
Une accumulation de petits détails que nous regrettons.

reviews.author: WhiteCityJoe_Public
reviews.title: Short on living up to Club Melia
reviews.text: The rating is as a Club Melia member. The way to enjoy this resort is Royal Service. Club Melia members will be dissatisfied depending on their benchmark or reference. The staff at check in the VIP Lounge and private pool area fall short on the connection / engagement we are accustomed as Club Melia members. Too much VIP service is shifted over to guest services. However, good value for Royal Service from what we saw. For all: Fuego staff and food very good; great ceviche, Dominican soup, burgers and seafood. Olio very good place to eat too; the pasta is very good and the steak and salmon are excellente. Vente is a good dining and the Lamb soup is really good. Passions food and wine pairing is an extra cost but worth it. Cocotal Golf is a pleasure to play.

reviews.author: 590ralphb
reviews.title: Average resort
reviews.text: Hotel in some areas outdated. Our butler (we stayed in royal service adults only) was just average at best. Choice or restaurants very poor... royal service had one Resturant. .. which I thought was the best but gets tiring everynight. Steaks at rare the steak house were awful and if you wanted a permium cut there was an extra charge. Hibachi average...venta not good. Thought Melia the level was a better choice.

reviews.author: Philip T
reviews.title: Great resort , disappointing customer service.
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that the resort was amazing. From the pool to the food to the amenities. All top notch.

Here is where I had an issue. I have stayed with Melia resorts many times over the past few years and have chosen them to be my resort of preference. When I booked, I booked thru cheapcaribean.com and I booked the "The Reserve".  Having stayed at other Melia resorts I mistakenly booked the Reserve because I thought it was the "Royal Service". From my recollection other Melia resorts upgrades were called The Reserve.

I called a day before the trip to verify my reservation to come to find out The Reserve was not Royal Service. I was surprised and called cheapcaribean.com and they explained the situation that The Reserve is a separate area within the Paradisus resort further from the beach and restaurants and bars and much more quieter and secluded then what we were looking for. I asked cheapcaribean.com how much an upgrade to Royal Service would be and they quoted me $600 for the both of us. I then proceeded to to call Melia customer service for explaining my mistake and received a quote of  $1000 only minutes after the $600 quote. This being an unreasonable number I told my self I would go and see what they can do for me at the desk when I get there knowing I made the reservation incorrectly.... The individual at the desk who checked me in stated that they didnt have the Royal Service that night but could accommodate me the next night and for the rest of the trip and that they only had one Royal Service room available. The quote was for $1800 for 4 night only a day after receiving a $600 and $1000 quote and they then tried to selling me that I would be saving $300 in coupons which I knew would go to waste. I told them this was unreasonable and there had to be something they could do about the price... They then quoted me $1500 for the same room with a $300 coupon savings.

If you could have given me to lower price for the same room why didn't you? If cheapcaribean.com could do it for $600 why couldn't you?

This is the 6th Melia stay for me in 3 years and this is the first time I have not stayed in the upgraded area of the resort.

There was absolutely no consideration for customer service or my situation knowing I accidentally booked the wrong room and it was clear your only goal is to steal money from my pocket rather then make considerations knowing I made an error and that it would affect my experience on my vacation.

While the resort was amazing, I may now need to find another resort chain and see what they have to offer because it is clear what is important to this organization.

reviews.author: cindyerhardt
reviews.title: Need better service
reviews.text:
It is a HUGE resort. You can not get food anytime of the day from either the pool bar or restaurants, very disappointing! But you could get room service. And I have never paid for an upgrade and never had problems with getting drinks on the beach, you had to walk up to the bar. Other people in our group were very upset also.
My husband had his dress pants hanging up in the bathroom so they wouldn't get wrinkled, and the maid spilled bleach on them!

reviews.author: Pakiza R
reviews.title: And then there was the roach
reviews.text:
The first night we arrived we headed straight to the buffet and there it was... the roach. Roaming through the jungles of the seafood salad at the buffet, this did not even deter me from my meal but it did leave a lasting impression on my experience. Once we settled in our room my spouse wanted to jump right into the jacuzzi and relax...that didn't happen because like most of the drawers in the room...it was broken . I'm not sure how The Reserve is considered more prestigious compared to the other part of the resort ( Paradisus) but honestly the room needs major matinence. The vents were so moldy ( visually) that my husband sneezed and cough the whole time we were in the room, its pretty bad and they try to mask it by blasting the air conditioner but once you get fresh air in you could actually smell the mold.  
The food at the restaurants are "meh" at best , I would stick to the buffet.

reviews.author: El_Gali
reviews.title: Lugar correcto para vacaciones
reviews.text: Ante todo uno debe saber que va a de vacaciones a un lugar gigantesco, donde moverse desde su habitación a la playa le puede robar 30 minutos de su día (al no ser que intenten mejorar el transporte interno) el establecimiento es correcto , la atención del personal en algunos casos rayaba con lo cómico pero era suplido por un humor, una disposición y una amabilidad que hacia olvidar todo. La comida correcta, los restaurants incluidos en el All Inclusive correctos, las bebidas correctas (Al no se que quiera pagar para obtener mejor calidad) La playa correcta , las instalaciones deportivas (tennis, básquet) un desastre. Siempre que voy a Punta Cana pienso lo mismo, que linda la Riviera Maya...

reviews.author: Gustavo G
reviews.title: Increíble hotel pero con algunos detalles negativos!!!!!
reviews.text:
Positivo: Su imponente arquitectura,  su ubicación en la playa, la atención del personal, la limpieza en general y la del cuarto en particular, hermosa suite acorde al costo  . Excelente la variedad y calidad de la gastronomía, ( aunque deben mejorar la temperatura de la comida caliente, salvo las exquisitas sopas, todo lo demás esta siempre tibio o frío, ...una lástima).
Objetable: La poca privacidad del cuarto de baño, nada agradable, sobre todo si hay niños o familiares.
Negativo: Parece que no les interesa el huésped no frecuente sólo los miembros VIP.  Desde la llegada al hotel, el acoso por invitar a una charla para vender la membresía al servicio  VIP es insoportable, uno termina accediendo por cortesía o cansancio, y esto se convierte en  una verdadera pesadilla (un clásico de la cadena Meliá), Esta discriminación entre miembros y no miembros  VIP se nota en los espacios comunes, y sobretodo en la playa, (lugar fundamental por lo menos en nuestro caso),  donde hay pequeñas parcelas para el huésped común, y amplias y mejor ubicadas para  el sector VIP, (casi desiertas). Entonces y para finalizar, por haber sentido mi familia y yo esta discriminación no volveré a este hotel y a ninguno de la cadena meliá.

reviews.author: Kohl0002
reviews.title: Very disappointing resort
reviews.text:
First night needed bedding for the pull out bed. Called 3 times for bedding/pillows starting at 9:00 pm. At 11:30 pm still no bedding, walked to the reserve lobby and told them what happened and  asked again. Finally at 11:45pm got bedding, BUT NO PILLOWS. When someone turns water on in their room, you can hear it running in your room. You can hear the motorized carts going outside your room. It's 8:16 am and I just got woke up to the maids making lots if noise outside the room, so may as well get up. 

If you are thinking this is an all inclusive resort, then be prepared to get your own drinks on the beach. Went to the beach 3 times and 3 hours each time, no one came by to see if we needed drinks. It seems they don't want to serve drinks. It wasn't until I went to the Gabi bar and complained that someone actually came and waited on us. 

They have no dressers to unpack clothing, so be prepared to not unpack your suitcase for a week.

I have never paid this much to stay somewhere and WILL NEVER RECOMMEND THIS PLACE to anyone.

The food is average to below average. You can't get
Something to eat between 11:30 am and 12:30 pm. The food is the same every day so it gets old to eat the same thing every day.

Went to Pfuego and food was not good. We had an 8:00 reservation, arrived at 7:45 pm, we had friends who couldn't get a table to join us, when we got to the restaurant their were 16 open seats with no one getting seated in those seats until 9:30 when we left, so they had plenty of open seats.

I wish I had the money to leave and go stay at another resort as nothing is good hear. I expect to be waited on, and that never happens to our group.

We did have an event where Jose Moreno was working, and he was awesome.

Now as soon as the maids quiet down, I m going to take a nap and countdown the days to get out of this place.

Also this resort is so spread out, so don't buy the reserve package as your half mile walk to the beach.

reviews.author: Hardy H
reviews.title: Slightly better than Mediocre
reviews.text:
The resort was beautiful and the staff was friendly albeit generally unhelpful:

How do I redeem the vouchers I have for food and wine earned the quick response "I don't know" and caused us to forfeit $400 in unusable coupons. 

Where is the bike rental office "Not sure sir, I don't have my phone today" replied the blue belted concierge standing next to a pile of rusting bicycles. 

What time does the Mexican restaurant Mole open. "11:30am", the concierge happily informed us. Too bad, after walking over, we learned it wouldn't open until 1pm. 

Of course the above examples were rare because when a guest calls the front desk, too service, or housekeeping they rarely pick up the phone. 

The one saving grace was our family concierge, Stephanie, who did her best to make our stay comfortable despite fighting an uphill battle.

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Poor quality staff
reviews.text:
The overall trip was fabulous; The resort is breath-taking and the wait/pool staff are wonderful. The reason I gave this place a less than par review was due to the amount of things stolen from our room by the maid services. 
After discovering a large amount of money was stolen from my purse (our fault for not using the safe), we put a "Do Not Disturb" sign on our door and immediately went to report it. Upon returning to our room a half an our later with a security officer, The sign was gone and our door was wide open. The maid who was inside told us, verbatim, She watched us leave, and even though she saw the sign, she thought she could go in and clean anyways. Pretty sneaky!

reviews.author: Brian T
reviews.title: Nice resort, but saw through the hype.
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a 9 day, 8 night stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Overall, the resort was great, but it falls short of being a 5 star resort and we'd likely not return should we consider Punta Cana again. I apologize for the length of this review, but I hope it helps others who may be considering this resort with an honest perspective.

We arrived to the resort just before 1 PM, but our room wasn't ready. We were encouraged to get lunch and told that the room would be ready upon our return, but it wasn't available until almost 3:30 PM. We took a flight out at 7 AM specifically to enjoy the afternoon at the beach, and were disappointed to have wasted the entire first day. We kept getting told that "the room is large and there was a family of four that just checked out" as a reason for the delay.

The room itself was massive (bigger than our first apartment), with a large jacuzzi tub for two, balcony, living room, bedroom, and dining room. The light switches were extremely confusing, with easily two dozen switches controlling lights individually. The walls were exceptionally thin, and we were unfortunately stuck next to a family with a toddler that would not stop crying day and night. We also could hear staff outside each morning before 7 AM, leaving little opportunity to sleep late on our vacation.

The Reserve area is located a solid 10 - 12 minute walk from the beach and trams do not come frequently, so we walked most of the time. Housekeeping was decent, though we did have to ask for additional bottled water and tissues after 2 days of them not having been replenished. My wife brought her own travel size shampoo and conditioner and did not use what the hotel supplied. When her bottles started to run out, the maid did replenish with the same brand my wife brought. This was a nice touch!

There are plenty of restaurant options, although we decided to stick to the buffets for breakfast and lunch most times. No problem with room service the two times we ordered. Aqua was by far the best restaurant (Italian) and we were pleased to finally get a reservation on our last night. We were forced to make reservations for all restaurants from the get-go, which seemed excessive, considering most restaurants were nearly empty every time we were in them, even at peak dinner times. Despite the resort being all-inclusive, it was misleading as there were premium priced menu choices and wine lists. This was not made clear to us, so we opted not to order wine at dinner.

The beach area was beautiful, however, it was never made clear to us which areas we could use as part of the all-inclusive rate. For example, some covered beds were apparently $25/day, which we found out when someone came over after we settled in. The Reserve section of the beach has huts with beds at no extra charge, but unless you have a concierge, you'll never get one right up along the water no matter how early you arrive to stake your spot.

Our room was close to the gym, which I used once and my wife frequented. It's well-equipped with plenty of machines, TVs, and bottled water. We also had a couples massage at YHI Spa, which was great. However, remember to bring plenty of cash to tip since you're not told until afterwards that you cannot add the tip to the room charge or use a credit card. This isn't a big deal, but yet another frustrating and easily avoidable instance of the lack of transparency at this resort.

The grounds of this resort are jaw-droppingly beautiful and every detail was immaculate, but the fact that paying more for The Reserve simply meant a great room and a long walk to, well, everything unless you paid for royal service or family concierge leads one to wonder why, exactly, you paid so much when people at neighboring resorts are getting much more for their dollar. 

Most of the staff were super friendly. In particular, Ramon Ramirez on the Reserve beach absolutely made our trip. His upbeat spirit brought life to the beach and made it an awesome trip. Ramon actually made my wife and me sad to leave on our final day, and we deliberately waited to find him to say goodbye before we left. His attitude was genuine, and not once did he try to solicit us for a callout in a review. We will truly miss him. We did not pay for the concierge service, but utilized Elena in our building to make reservations for meals. She was also super friendly and helpful.

Unfortunately, it appears the company that runs the hotel holds the hardworking employees to specific mentions by name in TripAdvisor reviews in order to receive any recognition. It's really a shame, as many of these employees travel far and work for weeks on end, often at 12 hour shifts. One staff member in particular, Raynol, was very friendly with us, but it felt disingenuous since he appeared to only butter us up to pressure us to write a TripAdvisor review for him. Sadly, this was a significant turn-off and was borderline harassment. At one point, he removed the earbuds from my ear while sitting on the beach to strike up a conversation. He then incessantly demanded that my wife pull out her phone and write a TripAdvisor review at that moment. Daily, we were subjected to these types of pressures to write a TripAdvisor review and it's the main reason why we will not return to this resort.

We realize that the staff are incredibly hardworking, and each person we worked with was warm, friendly, and helpful, but repeated asks for TripAdvisor reviews made it feel forced and uncomfortable. Also, it made us realize that many of the positive reviews on the site are likely coerced by staff members the same way we were, instead of honestly reviewed by resort guests looking to help future guests. This is why I felt the need to write a long, but blunt review of our stay.

Lastly, we will say that this is a very family friendly resort...but as a couple with no children, we will consider an adults-only resort in the future. We are not opposed to children (we honeymooned at Walt Disney World), but it was rare to be on the beach or in the buffet without screaming children everywhere.

Upon checkout, there were additional charges on our bill that appeared to be a sneaky way to get us to donate to Club Melia. I promptly noticed this and informed the staff, and they removed it immediately, noting "their mistake."

All in all, the ridiculous sales pitches to join Club Melia and to write TripAdvisor reviews are enough for us to not return. There are far too many places along this beautiful beach that it's not worth the harassment in the future. It rarely felt as if the (significant) amount of money we paid to stay there was enough, and that people who paid more for family concierge or the royal service package were valued more than we were.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Awesome Venue, Mediocre Service
reviews.text:
The resort itself from a venue and location standpoint is awesome- nice rooms, nice pool, nice beach and lounge chairs and cabanas and all that happy stuff you'd hope to find. Before I speak negative about the staff I would just like to note that if your guy is Junior, he's the man and will help you with any and everything you could want. 

The whole place is smoke and mirrors. No matter how much research you do, you'll never actually know what you need to book to be in an optimal spot unless you read this tell-all review.  We originally booked The Reserve thinking that was the best of the best. Wrong. This resort is something around 90 acres... while The Reserve is the newest part of the resort, it is at the furthest most point from the beach and also in the kids section of the resort. In order to get down to the beach you're looking at a legit 10-15min walk or a golf cart shuttle ride if the service is kind enough to pick you up (4 out of 5 times they won't). Then while you're waiting for them to get your room ready they'll bring you to the bar where you'll soon find out that even in the Reserve section you don't get premium booze. So now you're a mile away from the beach and you can't have premium booze- guess you'll need to look into the upgrade. The "Royal Service" section of the resort, its highest and most prestigeous section, will put you within a pitching wedge to the beach, exclusive access to la palapa restaurant (meh), the sunset bar (nothing more than a bar) the royal service pool (nice pool), your own personal "butler" (Junior) and top shelf booze... HOWEVER, top shelf booze-ketel, goose, patron, Johnnie, etc- if you upgrade to "Royal Service", while the premium booze sits around most bars throughout the resort, you can only access it for free in two bars- Sunset Bar and La Palapa bar- of which the sunset bar closes around sunset. The other bars will have the booze you want and paid for but you can't get it without paying more for it. 

Your fridge will have two Budweiser in it and they won't provide you with any hard alcohol for your room. Not quite sure what kind of all-inclusive this is supposed to be. 

With that forewarning being thrown out there- beautiful resort, nice accommodations, food is eh- as expected for an all-inclusive, and if you buddy up with a staff or two, maybe they'll take a little better care of you. With better service and a little less smoke and mirror feel, this is a 4.5-5 star resort every day.

reviews.author: nathcaroline
reviews.title: Lovely but loud
reviews.text: We are currently staying at this hotel. The staff is amazing, the accommodations are nice but as a family with two kids, the live music is very loud until 11pm. Our first room faced the show and we could hear everything until the show ended and the music was turned off at 11pm (essentially impossible for kids to sleep). After complaining they moved us on our third night to a room on the third floor. While not ideal with two kids, we were willing to trade for some quiet. Unfortunately, while this room is a little bit quieter, we can still hear the loud music and shows. We were told this was the only room available. Personally, with two young kids who go to bed around 8pm, I would absolutely not stay here again because of the noise level.

reviews.author: Wahome1
reviews.title: Out with the family
reviews.text:
Great food , nice facilities and excellent grounds. Customer service could be improved. Rough start because if you have elderly family you have to call ahead to get a ground floor room as there is limited wheelchair access and NO ELEVATORS. 
This may be a big issue if the hotel is near capacity. 
We had some issues that were eventually resolved but many things took several attempts i.e. Three or four calls to get light bulbs changed etc. overall place get a B grade that could easily improved if the service improved

reviews.author: Annie
reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful and the staff was attentive but our jacuzzi didn't work and was never fixed even though they kept promising they would send someone to fix it. They were well aware of this because they fixed a bubble bath one night but no bubbles because it didn't work. They just left saying they would send someone.   After trying for 3 days we finally gave up requesting that it be repaired.  We were also sat down as soon as we got there and talked into an additional $300.  Even after corresponding with them several times, I never did understand what we got for that.

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: Good not great
reviews.text: First time at this all inclusive resort. It was ok but we were not wowed. Glitches with our room and check in. However the dining staff are excellent. Juan Suarez in particular treated us like royalty. We prefer club med resorts -. Better activities and more fun overall.

reviews.author: Sandy R
reviews.title: Noel Ventura fantastic in the fitness center.
reviews.text: Place beautiful, room adequate, the  food less than adequate except for Vento.  The food was mostly cold (when it should have been hot) in the buffet Naos.  The air conditioner in the room made a terrible loud grinding noise.  We told the concierge who said someone would fix it.  It never happened.

reviews.author: jana0703
reviews.title: Beautiful resort - Lots of issues
reviews.text:
Pros; beach is gorgeous, and so is the resort. Rooms are lovely.
Cons; food was mediocre, cold majority of time, both of us got sick, which is something that never has happened on any vacation, air conditioner did not work, took hours to get someone to help. Major issue with getting people to answer phones, and speak English. We wasted a good part of our vacation dealing with issues, and when I got home I noticed several items missing that were stolen. Would not go back, way to many issues. Probably in total spent 9-12 hours on phone and waiting for service that was promised but not delivered. What amazed me is the resort was not that busy so did not understand why the unanswered phones. We were there May of 2016. This trip was not cheap for a May vacation.

reviews.author: cparalph
reviews.title: Kind of Like a Cruise without the Ship
reviews.text:
My wife and I love the Caribbean so when the opportunity came do some continuing professional education in the DR we thought sure why not.  We are not really megaresort people so we should have realized this would not be our thing but it was the location of the conference so we booked.

First of all we thought well at least the beach and water should be nice and who knows maybe they would have been if it were not for the parasaling going on constantly in front of the resort or the swarm of hucksters waiting to pounce on you as soon as you cross some line in the sand beyond which you are apparently fair game.

Now I know many of you will say hey it is a underdevelped country and people are just trying to make a living and I agree however I am just stating the experience and my preference for something different. 

One day we did do a Saona Island trip and while the day trip was just fine what we did find was the little town we would like to stay at if we ever go back to the DR that is Bayahibe.

OK so as far as the resort goes It was fine.  The room was quite nice and spacious and kept pretty clean.  The pool area was very nice but lots of chemicals, but I am in the Caribbean so I want to be in the Ocean.

This being an all-inclusive means you get your choice of a bunch of restaurants but really you find out quickly that they are all pulling from the same pantry so there is not much variation and you just end up at the buffet realizing that it is probably the best option with the most choices.

Safe were overall nice and friendly but often worked you for a positive review on Trhipadvisor.  Not really a fault just kind of annoying.

So there you have it, kind of felt like a cruise without the boat.  Will not go back but if that is your sort of think I am sure you will enjoy it.

reviews.author: JohnSC5860XU
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
We decided to go to The Reserve for five days and then try another resort in Punta Cana for the remaining five days.  First the positive news. We had a great corner suite on the second floor of building 42. Large hot tub and balcony.  Unfortunately, The Reserve is quite far from the beach and major restaurants. They say you can have a golf cart bring you back and forth at any time. Not true. They have golf cart-like trains with erratic schedules. Many times we were forced to make the very long walk, which was probably good, since we did nothing but eat and drink for five days.

One thing that was incredibly disappointing. Upon arrival we were brought into a room at a table with a greeter whose sole purpose seemed to be to sell us on the special services for an additional $500. I felt like I just paid full price for a timeshare presentation. I quickly turned him off, but he sought me out at least five more times during our trip still pushing his sales. He finally stopped when I said I was going to include this in my trip adviser review. We never expect great food from all inclusive packages, and The Reserve did not disappoint. Even their best dinner restaurants or mediocre. On our first day, they advised there was no available space for dinner, so we were forced to pay an additional $90 to have dinner at their La Palapa restaurant. Not very special. Our best dinner was probably at The Grill. The flavor of the beef was very good, but also tough. You will not get a fillet mignon at this resort. They call their steaks beef fillet, but it is more like a sirloin.  We were excited to see lobster tail on the pre-dinner buffet. It looks good, but you could barely cut it with a knife. Very overcooked. As with most resorts on Punta Cana, the people were very friendly.

We are now at Secrets Cap Cana Resort, 30 minutes south of Punta Cana airport. It is a new resort and, so far, much better than The Reserve. Secrets does cost more. Our five days here will be about $3200, compared to $1900 for five days at The Reserve (excluding airfare). We should know by the end of the week if it is worth the difference. Lots of screaming kids at The Reserve. Secrets is adult only.  We love our grandchildren, just don't want to take every vacation with them.

reviews.author: Miguel Osca
reviews.title: Desastroso y bonito a la vez
reviews.text:
Es un gran complejo sobre todo para ir con niños, hemos estado 6 noches dos luxury suites, total 3 adultos y dos niños pagando 3800$+3.300$
Nuestra llegada prevista a las 02,00 de la madrugada y despues de llamar en dis ocasiones dia llegada  y poner en reserva q queriamos habitaciónes cercanas nos dieron hab a las 5am de la madrugada en una habitacion con mosquitos y no preparada para ser habitfa ese dia i ya otra con una sola cama para 3 personas( nos dicen duerma un no de 8 años en sofa, el cual daba verguenza xq sus muelles te hacian sentarte en el suelo) despues de pagar 600$ mas y estar reflejado asi en reserva y según ellos fue un error de la persona q en hoteles Melia hizo la reserva ya q ese tipo de hab , mas cara q la junior suite , no tienen dos camas
Nos ofrecen despues de habernos ido a dormir a las 5,30 am al dia siguiente cambiarnos de habitacion y q en la mañana fuera y lo tendriamos listo , pero de esa noche pagamos unos 1,100€ 
Dia siguiente como es normal nadie sabia nada y pedi hablar con el Dtor hotel, como es ligico lo max q consegui es hablar con jefe de recepcion Wally q la verdad hizo todo lo q pudo para ayudarnos en toda nuestra estadia pero pedi q cuando estuviera su superior q no era el dtor x supuesto, le dijeran q queria hablar con ella  pero nunca dio la cara
Les resumo, gran resort
Jardines y zonas comunes espectaculares 
Jefes son dioses q no dan la cara
Personal hotel encantador, Wally, Daniel del Carmen, Lucky Lucky de la Rosa, nos hicieron la estadia bonita
Habitaciones demasiado viejas, no hay presion de agua, sofas q dan pena
A veces en la tarde abren camas y cambian toallas a veces no, de seis noches solo dos lo hicieron
Toallas viejas q lijan la piel
Comida en gral no vale lo q pagas
Bebida , el vino frances q esta incluido Rebelle tinto ,blanco y el champagne( parece sidra) horrible , sin nInguna variedad y otras opciones 
Rte Mexicano , un engaño, en la mañana multiuso y en la noche se convierte en mexicano
Peruano, local espectacular comida so so, nada q ver con la exquisitez de un peruano
Rte Aqua,  dirigido x Chef español, provolone  al Ron, era incomible solo bebible ya q estaba inundado en Ron sin quemar tuvieron q retirarlo y el plato de pescado nacional Chillo lo retiraron xq no se podia cortar de lo duro q estaba
Dudo vuelva  a este hotel , a ese precio hay q dar calidad, y ellos no lo dan, solo su personal es extraordinario y opciones en la zona hay muy buenas

reviews.author: Sebastian U
reviews.title: Podria ser excelente, pero no lo es!
reviews.text:
Soy socio de Melia, he ido ya algunas veces al mismo hotel. En general lo hemos pasado bien, debiendo pasarlo extraordinario. El ambiente es excepcional, los restaurantes son muy buenos, pero las instalaciones están comenzando a deteriorarse. En nuestro caso, pasamos el año nuevo 2016/2017 en el resort y este estaba completamente lleno. Los restaurantes a pesar de tener reserva, nos hacían esperar mas de 30 minutos para ser atendidos, no entiendo para que hacemos reserva?. Las habitaciones, están comenzando a tener problemas, aire acondicionado, baños defectuosos, servicios a las habitaciones no efectuados, oscuridad en los pasillos de las instalaciones, camillas tanto de las piscinas como de l a playa saturadas, no habiendo lugar para estar. Si se jactan de tener 5 estrellas, estos servicios son básicos, no entiendo que les paso.
En el pasado los he recomendado, a partir de ahora no los recomendare mas. 
Si bien es cierto, lo pasamos bien, pero para lo que estamos pagando como membresía, debiéramos haberlo pasado espectacular.

reviews.author: dianapQ7655UA
reviews.title: Holiday Trip to Punta Cana
reviews.text: Overall a nice resort.  Needs more activities for older children. Did not have Royal Service but it certainly looked better.  Quieter and more attention by the staff.  Weather is phenomenal and their buffet has so many diversified choices.

reviews.author: gudmor33
reviews.title: "Wasn't as impressed as I thought I would be!!"
reviews.text:
Nice Hotel, very well kept and nice people. Having said that, more often than not the service was very slow. Waited 45-1hr for sheets, dinner service was slow in many of the restaurants and the trams took forever. The kids pool was great for our 6 year old but there was hardly anything for our teens to do besides swim and lay around so they were very bored. Decent selection of restaurants but the breakfast buffet was always the same and even the dinner buffet was repetitive. Another thing that was quite annoying was how we kept being pushed to come see there information on a group called Circle which I figured out was a time share scheme and we promptly told them we were not interested and then the people that were being so pleasant to us and offering us free lunches and free photo sessions all disappeared and of course did not come through with what they had offered us. I would like to reiterate that the staff was awesome and extremely nice. 
I do have to give special mention the our family concierge Diosmery. She was amazing, sweet, helpful and always went above and beyond in assisting us. She is a star employee. Another mention I would like to make is for Anyolina Rosario. She is an excellent staff member who is very attentive and professional.

reviews.author: TMaiden
reviews.title: Not a 5 star
reviews.text:
We stayed over winter break at the reserve with a family concierge.  I can give a detailed review, but I can some it up as I would not return.  The value for what we paid was not there.  
Cons;
Bad service....they tried but just not organized and so many staff members did not care
Rooms.. poorly outdated 
Health club...way too small for such a large property...same with spa
Loud...walls are very thin.  Can hear people above you and next to you.  All rooms are connecting so,it is like the room next to you is in your room.  You can hear their conversations, televisions, children crying, etc.

Pro:
Family concierge.  Sadly this was the only person who provided good service with a can do attitude.

reviews.author: Andrea H
reviews.title: Disappointed Return
reviews.text:
We went back to this resort because when we had our spring break vacation there on March, 2015 it was amazing. Well, apparently a lot of things have changed, we left with the impression that the administration was trying to cut corners everywhere. They are building a new property right beside this one and let a lot of wonderful employees go. The food quality is significantly different and there are no more fresh squeezed juices throughout the day. We had to complain to get everything fixed around the property, from the beach and the pool showers(they did fix it right away) to the telephone on my suite(8 days in there and they never fixed). I do feel the need to express our gratitude to a few employees that really tried hard to make everything better all the time. Our Butlers Hilario and Luis, to Rafael at room service, Pedro at the Gabi Club Bar and the 2 Corintianos at the Reserve Pool.
PS: No more heated pools.

reviews.author: Mon2233979
reviews.title: Twilight Zone
reviews.text:
We are a family of four with two kids (16 and 19) and had a nice vacation here for Christmas week.  This is not a five star experience whether it is the physical hotel or the service.  We travel often, have been to eight all-inclusives and are not picky people.  Things can and do go wrong everywhere.

The reason I refer to this destination as the twilight zone is every member of the staff seemed to be ignorant of the most basic information and would suggest where you could go (large distances) to get a sure answer.  Some of this may have had to do with the language barrier, but I actually believe they do not want the guests to know too much.  

This is a huge hotel and they have segmented it into many smaller pieces that actually do make the hotel not feel that crowded (we were there during Christmas week).   So for instance, if you ask about restaurants the answer is complicated because there are lots of restaurants but not all are accessible by all guests (and these rules keep changing) so no one was able to give us a complete list of the ones we could go to which I think helps to keep the crowds spread out.  The good news is we found at least nine restaurants we could go to and there might have been even more.  Another example was the Christmas Eve. Gala.  Most hotels go all out for this night (as well as New Years).  We were told by several people at the Concierge that the Gala was fully booked (even though we arrived several days in advance) but even though we could not go to the Gala, every restaurant would be serving the same menu so it really did not matter.  Being veteran holiday travellers we knew better and eventually they “squeezed” us in.  The Gala was indeed awesome and was decorated like a high end wedding, in the ballroom, red carpet, models, live band, really special (lobster) buffets, fantastic service and inconceivable that they could have replicated this in any of many small restaurants around the property.  The twilight zone part was that almost no one ended up coming to the Gala!!  I would estimate the ballroom was set for 800 people and there was only around 150 in attendance.  Again I believe they did too good of a job spreading the crowds out using intentionally wrong information.

Another weird thing is that most everyone gets a physical stack of coupons at check in for discounts on most everything that is not included in the all-inclusive.  But there are many versions of the coupons so when you present them the recipients are not clear on how to handle them because the coupons themselves do not include what, if any, the restrictions are.  For instance:  There are coupons for premium wine purchases.  We bought many bottles and three different sommeliers at three different restaurants told us the coupons could only be used for bottles over $100.  We went to the front desk and after much debate it was discovered that the coupons could be used for bottles over $50 but if felt like a let’s make a deal rather than a firm rule.  We had a similar experience in the Spa when we were told that the coupons could be used for some things but not others even though the price was about the same.   Also unless the paper coupons (you get like a hundred per room) are presented at time of purchase (wine, spa, casino, etc) they could not be used.

Christmas Day, they ran out of pool towels around 12:30.  What bothered me was the attendants had no idea when they might get towels and had me coming back every half hour to check.  It ended up taking two hours for the towels to arrive, but the attendant then searched for us and brought us towels.  The rooms needed some repairs but the hotel was very quick to come and fix.

The grounds are well maintained, it did not feel crowded, and the food and restaurants were great.  This balanced with the twilight zone experiences left us feeling it was an average place for the money.

reviews.author: beidig
reviews.title: Everything is just a little shy of "care free"
reviews.text: We spent a week at the resort with our two children aged 2 and 5. We found everything in the resort is just a little shy of getting you a "care free" vacation. Yes there's wifi in the resort but unstable. Yes there's buffet with great variety but the quality of the food is sub-par (seafood is not entirely fresh for example) and there's not enough staff to clean up tables and get your request fulfilled (granted it's peak season). Yes our concierge is very nice and friendly, but we sometimes had a hard time reaching him on his extension. The room has all the equipment but the closet door is jamed and the hot water pressure is low etc. etc. Over all, we had a good time, but there are lots of small places to fix at the place.

reviews.author: ric340
reviews.title: Good resort with major problems
reviews.text:
I spent a week at the Paradisus Palma Real. Overall we enjoyed our stay.  The beach and facilities are beautiful.  The majority of the staff are friendly and helpful.  The food, especially at Naos is excellent and we particularly enjoyed the Indian Station.  The DJs at night are a lot of fun.  

I have 2 major concerns:
1- Unusable Internet.   Though my family's computers, iPads and phones were able to connect to the routers well there was essentially no internet available.  The only times I could check my emails were at 5am when few other people were using the internet.  The rest of the days there was NO internet.  Anyone who needs internet access for work, finance or family reasons should NOT go this this resort.  Even iMessage was unusable and had to pay for texts.  No internet calling was available either.  Sometimes for email I would have to connect to the local phone carrier's 3G which will cost me.  No modern resort should have this problem.  I spoke to several employees who all said this is a continuing problem.  I tried speaking with management but no one was interested.  

2- Transportation to Cocotal Golf is extremely unreliable.  The course is a 3 minute drive but the shuttles are scheduled once an hour and come only 50% of the time.  I have been stranded at the golf course and had to call and pay for a taxi.  This Paradisus calls itself a golf resort, which is a joke.  They should provide reliable, frequent transportation for golf.  Any golfer should think twice about going there.

reviews.author: ahasnyc
reviews.title: Good for Babies, May 2016
reviews.text:
We arrived Memorial Day, May 30, 2016, for a 5 night, 6 day stay.
My husband, my son (15 months old), and myself (34 weeks pregnant) usually travel around this time of year. The resort was full the first day and then became super quiet after Memorial Day.
Upon arrival, our bags were checked, we were seated for a bit. Concierge Mikey signed us up and in about 20 minutes we were on our way to our room. I specifically asked for a 2nd floor room due to my pregnancy, toddler, stroller, and mosquitos. Unfortunately, they could not provide us with one. 
No biggie, we are active people. Unfortunately, its a pain walking up marble stairs when you are soaking wet.

We enjoyed staying the Reserve as we were right in front of the pool, the children pool was a couple of feet away, and the baby zone right next to the pool. Also, the Gabi restaurant was close so we could always snack when necessary.

Reservations are a pain to make. Staff tried to help us out as much as possible but it was a bit disappointing to see restaurants empty and they are telling you there are no seats available.

The restaurants aren't that great. My husband enjoys food and he was disappointed. The restaurants here did not compare to the restaurants over in the Paradisus Palma Real - Royal Service, next door.
The worst restaurant was Mole. Not only because the food was terrible, no cilantro, and just plain but the restaurant leaked every time it rained. The staff would shut the restaurant down in order to mop up all the water but even then more marble floors. So to get to your seat with a toddler in your arms was a feat.
Most restaurants are outside, no a/c. And my husband was constantly getting bitten over at the Gabi Restaurant by the beach on the main resort. So bring bug spray.

My husband says drinks were alright. Not to strong, took more than 4 mojitos to get a buzz and he doesn't  drink.

The highlight to this trip and the only reason I came to the Reserve was the Baby Zone.

Its hot in May/June. After a morning at the beach or pool, we would do lunch and afterwards we would go to the Baby Zone so my son could hang out and play in the A/C with other children his age.

The staff are great with children. I was hesitant in leaving my son only because I'm over protective but I saw plenty of small children 1 year and up being left by parents.

Staff would play, dance, sing, paint, etc. with all ages and when baby became tired I saw staff member rocks baby to sleep or take them for stroller walks and then put them in air conditioned rooms with cribs and monitors.

Every time my son would walk in they would pick him up and adore him, immediately take him to the matted area and play cars or whatever as I sat down and took a break.

As I became familiar with the staff, I found out that all of them were students studying subjects related to children. Child Psychology, Social work, etc. That made me feel more comfortable. They actually liked children!

All in all, it wasn't a terrible trip. If you have small children, they will enjoy this place.

Be aware that many resorts offer a kids zone but if you look closely they only cater to ages 3 and up. 

Next time, we may try Azul Sensatori in Riviera Maya.

reviews.author: TravelFanSFBayArea
reviews.title: In need of a facelift
reviews.text:
We selected this based on the TripAdvisor reviews and I was a bit  disappointed. 
Large resort which requires some walking/golf carting  if you are at the Reserve side where we were (long wait times). Nice enough staff but didn't go out of their way-especially at the Reserve Vento restaurant--very sour hostess and for breakfast/lunch @ Gabi Club despite the fact we had the bracelets they would come check our room # every single time--felt a little ridiculous for an all inclusive.
We had a nice hostess at Mole who actually accommodated us without a reservation--again such a hassle for a half empty resort which it was when we were there.
With a face lift and a little more staff retraining I may return but for now I will likely try another resort.
Also had a bad experience booking with Expedia (surprise charge for an additional person that I had confirmation wouldn't be a charge)--took over  5 hours of mostly on hold time (2.5 of those roaming internationally!!!) and still waiting for a refund!

reviews.author: HJ_SC1975
reviews.title: The good and the ugly
reviews.text:
We stayed at the hotel along with 2 other families and had a mixed trip. The hotel has a magnificent lobby area, great common areas, good restaurants, decent night club, good availability of beverages, F&B staff always willing to assist and a great travel desk. Now starts the ugly part - the rooms given to us were very dated and had a lot of problems, There was peeling roofs (water damaged), non functional running hot water for 4 of the 6 days we stayed there, broken main door lock (subsequently repaired) did not have any water for 1/2 day, not enough towels in the swimming pool area (would run out by later morning), the showers in the beach area did not work properly, the service cart would always be left in the common corridor next to our room as the space where it was supposed to be parked was leaking rain water, service closets in common areas were leaking and flooding the corridor, extremely poor response to service requests etc. In short the hotel has focused on Jazzing up the common areas and places where guests tend to take pictures. The rooms allotted to us were quite bad and left a bad taste.
I had booked rooms through a special Costco travel package and it seems the package is secretly locked to the worst rooms and lowest level of service. One example would be that room service ordered by my friend (did not use the same Costco pricing) would be more prompt and he would actually get a call back to confirm that food is on its way to be delivered.

reviews.author: Marina K
reviews.title: ужасный номер
reviews.text:
Уважаемый представитель отеля, прошу связаться со мной, так как к Вам дозвонится нереально, на данные момент наш турист заехал в номер мастер сжит и очень недоволен номером, грязно с все старое.
Прошу помочь с переселением

reviews.author: Jackiestravels54
reviews.title: Beautiful place but lacking
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and beautiful. Room was clean and ok, but little dated, tv small and not much privacy in the bathroom since you could see into the bath from bedroom. Ok if you are with your spouse, which for us was ok. 2nd day they took are wash cloths and did not put fresh ones. View from balcony was blocked by plants, so basically no view. Very dark long pathways with vegetation to your room, which felt too dark. The food was ok, but not great. At check out we asked to have our bags taken down at 11:00 am, waited till 11:15, no butler so we took them down. At check out counter they would not let us check out because we forgot (was not told to bring it to desk) the mobile phone for our butler, so ran back to the room, was gone. They still would not let us check out, we had to get on our bus to the airport, so our group's manager said she would check us out. Pretty place, but have had better service in Jamaica.

reviews.author: Valkiriasimas
reviews.title: Experiência válida para não voltar !!!
reviews.text: Sinceramente depois dessa experiência eu não tenho intenção de voltar a Punta cana nesse hotel e nem recomendo; eu esperava encontrar um mar com águas transparentes e cristalinas é uma praia com areia branquinha e limpa .... NÃO FOI NADA disso que EnCONTREI !!!!!! Encontrei um mar escuro é uma praia suja ;  o hotel muito bonito e bem cuidado SÓ as áreas comuns , o Jardim é belo , mas os quartos com mobílias velhas e precárias com cheiro de mofo e almofadas fedendo , lençóis encardidos; os restaurantes propostos para os jantares NUNCA tinham vaga e as recepcionistas confusas que ficavam perdidas ; as opções de passeios e distrações  todas são caaarriiiissssiiiimaaaaassss , tudo um absurdo, fica quase o preço da viagem guando vc vai em família como foi o meu caso ...; fica claro é evidente que todos lá querem ganhar muuuitoooo dinheiro; quase todos os passeios ficam em 100 dólares por pessoa ( imaginem 6 pessoas em cada passeio todos os dias ) ; sinceramente não pretendo voltar a Punta Cana e não recomendo a ninguém!!!!!!

reviews.author: Joseph F
reviews.title: Should have been much better..great place..but.....(stay tuned for improvements)
reviews.text:
I just came back from 10 days at Paradisus Palma Real. This is considered a 5 star Melia hotel. From previous experiences at a Paradisus, I was looking forward to our stay. As my wife and I arrive and walk in through the lobby, you can’t help but be overwhelmed with the view through a central plaza surrounded by roman collums with the beach and ocean as a backdrop. Just beautiful. We were directed to the Royal service lounge to get our room. The lounge is well situated with a view of the pool, beach and ocean. At the lounge there is some finger food and a bar with chairs and computer screens as well as staff to take care of our needs. So far looking really great. Took a bit of time but eventually we get to meet our butler Fermin, part of the Royal service. We are taken to our room, but were not pleased with it. We waited until Fermin found us another room that was better but still not great. We settle in.
At this point we should let you know that we arrived in Dominican Republic while it was raining. As we are driven through the streets we see flooding in many areas and streets. The driver informs us that it has been raining every day for weeks. Water everywhere. I rained straight for the first 2 days. And I mean raining. We later learned we were under a tropical storm/category 1 hurricane called Otto. Great! It rained everyday we were there, at all times of the day, any where between 1 minute or several hours. Needless to say we had our umbrellas with us constantly.

Now for the bad news:
-Water flooding the corridors.
-Water leaking from roofs here and there.
-missing lighting in the stairwells and corridors
-very very low lighting all over the resort paths, exacerbated by all the rain, dangerous walking anywhere
-some paths too narrow we have to walk single file
-low hanging palm leaf roofs we had to duck to avoid
-many ridges on walkways that you could trip over or twist your ankle
-uneven maid service, requests not met
-Rarely any beach towels available.
-inneficient bar service on the beach in royal service
-Guest services staff are not able to clearly provide information regarding guest services. Domingo, we talked about this.
Trying to get a glass of wine at the buffet, forget it. You have to kidnap a waiter! So before sitting down at lunch at the buffet, we passed by the adjacent bar and got ourselves glasses of wine.
Avenue Bar where we had a bit of after dinner fun dancing and drinks during the first 4-5 nights, all of a sudden closed! No explanation. No wait, Sandra said it was only closed Monday. Not true, was closed the last 4 nights. Gabi bar closes at 11 PM! So we had to go to the lobby bar, boring.
HSBC took over the resort at one point. Really loud music and all parties and spaces for them. Felt we were second class clients.
Resort credits: an insult to our intelligence. Ridiculous and cannot be used for anything.
Absolutely no service at the beach in the Royal service reserved area! Now I say this and it might sound like there is not enough staff. Quite the contrary, there are anywhere between 4 and 7 staff that can serve, but they all stand around and chat amongst themselves near the bar completely disregarding the clients. Domingo, as their boss, you should come around more often to see for yourself. Problem is there are some bad eggs that don’t pull their weight and infecting others who might.
Restaurants: Rare, Palazzo and Aqua good. Fuego ok. Ibana atrocious (worst sushi ever), Oleo whatever. Most of the menus from the restaurants are laden with dishes containing milk products. Not good for us lactose intolerants. But Passion, wow! Wish I had eaten there more often. Even at extra cost.
Service at the restaurants was uneven and awkward. There again not because of missing staff. Quite the contrary, there was too many! But there was no one in charge. We were advised by one waiter he was going to serve us, but then another waiter served us. When we order appetizers and a salad, we were brought all the plates at the same time, which is not appropriate unless the clients wishes it. We noticed that there is very little higher level supervision as well as obvious little training in hospitality practices. 

As far as our golf experience, let’s just say that for a ten day all inclusive golf vacation in the Dominican, it was a total disaster. Flooding, golf course not fit to be played on, ridiculous cart fees (75$US per person!), car path only, sinking in most areas water logged, submerged greens, rain, fairways as long as roughs. Needless to say we only went once. Luckily we were able to get our golf cart fees refunded.

Had a great time taking tennis lessons with Carlos and with Juan Carlos Vasquez for 4 lessons. Really great lessons Juan Carlos. Made lots of progress on my backhand. If you like tennis, go see him, nice guy.

So, now for the interesting twist to this story. We are the 8th night dinner at Fuego. We had just been served 4 dishes at the same time. My wife is frustrated, feeling the expeditiveness nature of this action. She voices her frustration to Petronila who is apologetic. A few minutes later, seemingly unrelated, we are accosted by a lady who asks us if she can ask us a few questions as part of a survey on the restaurants. And so, we began enumerating some of our frustrations. After less than 2 minutes, she stops us and eagerly says she prefers her boss speaks to us. That’s when we are met by Hicham. He is the Manager, Food and Beverage. It’s his initiative to conduct surveys as he is a man on a mission to improve the restaurants as a whole. He has been on the job for 4 months and knows there are many things to improve. We chat, the three of us for one hour. We had before us and energetic, take charge, skilled hospitality executive who was driven to do good things for the resort. Our discussion was the number one big positive at the resort second only to the wonderful meal we had on our last night at Passion, compliments from Hicham who was very appreciative of us sharing our opinions. The chef Fernando Pinson came out to see us. Truly amazing food! The following night he introduced us to his colleagues, Felipe Quezada, the executive chef as well as Jindrich Stipek the Director of F&B. These three gentlemen accompanied us throughout the rest of our stay each dinner ensuring we were well taken care of. We shared with them all the positives of our many years of travel experiences. All this made our vacation a lot more enjoyable and reversed some of the negatives we experienced. Thank you very much gentlemen from my wife Andrée and myself. We have every confidence they will make great improvements to the resort. Stay tuned.

Some staff top of our list:
Hicham Idlalene, Filipe, Jindrich, Fermin, Petronila, Jhonny, Samuel Calcagno, Ronnie Espiritosanto, Fernando Pinson, Zenova.

reviews.author: Jennipher B
reviews.title: You don't always get what you pay for
reviews.text:
We are currently at this resort in the club member section room 3425. Although the room is ok, we are facing the back of a restaurant that is EXTREMLY noisy first thing in the am. We have found the food to be fantastic we plenty of variety for even the pickiest of eaters. 

The thing that always sets a resort apart from others however is the service, which this one seems to be lacking. There is no beverage service on the beach or the pools (or none that we have experienced anyway, and we tip). There is no bar at the beach, so you have to go up to the pool area. None of the staff seem overly happy. You have to always greeet them first in passing, rarely are they smiling ( other than the bartenders at the Gabri or avenue bar). This review will be updated at the time goes on as we are here for 10 days and this is only day 4. Here is to hoping things improve.

reviews.author: LabarKH
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, lackluster service
reviews.text:
The hotel advertises many amenities that are off-limits to everyone except for the Reserve and Royal Service guests (extra $) and does a poor job of explaining this information upon arrival. While the grounds and beach are beautiful, we felt very separated and restricted to very specific areas of the hotel.  It was quite embarrassing to pay good money to be asked to leave a specific area of the beach, especially when we didn't know that we weren't supposed to be there in the first place!  Neither my travel agent nor the guest services employees alerted my to the different packages available, and had I known this information, I would have picked a different resort. Paradisus was simply too expensive of a trip to be treated like second-class guests. 

One interesting and valuable tip we did pick up along the way: while many guests blame the food for stomach troubles in the DR, our tour liaison informed us that it is actually the coconut in the drinks. Bartenders in the DR use real coconut in tropical drinks, which is a natural laxative (and it sure works)! He cautioned that we limit intake of coconut drinks to no more than 4 per day to avoid some unfortunate digestive issues.  Definitely a good tip and worth passing on!

reviews.author: Inigo Z
reviews.title: No es lo que era
reviews.text: El hotel no esta preparado para admitir tanta gente, sobre todo a la hora del desayuno, totalmente caóticos. Es la sexta vez que me alojo en el hotel y es, con diferencia. la peor estancia. No se si es por la coincidencia con las vacaciones de  Thanksgiving pero el hotel estaba saturado, convirtiendose en otro de los hoteles cutres de Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Einste1n
reviews.title: A nice resort, but.......we left
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Real Golf is a nice resort. They have a lot of activities going on. Watersports and Golf. We got a quite big one bed room appartment with a nice lanai. A very comfy bed and a large bathroom incl. a jacuzzi. We booked it for 10 days but left after 6 days. Reason was the bad weather, with thunderstorms, rain and rain. Our main purpose was to relax, enjoy the sun and play golf. We couldn't do any of those things. Sad, due to the facilities are so beatiful. Since I prepaid for 10 days, we didn't get back any dollars due to their Hotel policies when we decided to go back to Florida. They didn't offer any compensation for future stays. They have a lot of bars and restaurants and it's almost all-inclusive. At some restaurants you needed to pay extra. I think the Hotel staff were professional and very positive and we got very good service especially from our butler Enrique, a really nice guy. He followed up and tried his best to please us every day. 

We got USD 1000 in Hotel credits, this is just a joke. Some dollar to upgrade Hotel, some to use to get USD20 off a 100 dollar blottle of wine, some for dinner credit, some for use in Casino. For me this is not credit, these are discount vouchers and you probably wont use them. We also got discount vouchers for a shopping mall. Didn't use one voucher. 

Golf is another story. Due to bad weather the course was closed, I accepted that. Golf was included, but they charge each player USD65 dollar for a cart. That's 130 dollar for a couple. A lot of money. In fact same price AS we pay at a very good golf course in Florida for golf and cart. That means golf is not included, you pay for it through your cart rental.

reviews.author: dvkm
reviews.title: Family Thanksgiving Vacation
reviews.text: The resort grounds were absolutely beautiful and breathtaking.  All the pools were great.  The rooms - while good, needed some restoration from damage.  I did not experience the much touted "great service" that other vacationers experienced.  In fact we thought it was sub par for the quality of the resort. The only service I was truly impressed with was the poolside/beach drink service.  The food was not that great and dinner reservation system does not need to be this complicated.  Don't get me wrong, this is a great resort but expectations were not met.

reviews.author: IvanchoPeru
reviews.title: Pudo ser mejor
reviews.text: Lindo hotel, gente amable y buena comida. Mantenimiento malo con habitaciones defectuosas y lentitud en el servicio express te arruinan la llegada. Esos TVs realmente requieren un cambio con urgencia!!!

reviews.author: Luiz Fernando M
reviews.title: Otimo resort com ressalvas em promocoes
reviews.text:
Minha primeira vez na republica dominicana e pelas avaliacoes de varios sites o paradisus que é da rede melia esta em 3º no ranking dos melhores hoteis em avaliacoes de usuarios apesar de ser o segundo mais caro. Fiz toda a reserva com agencia de viagens para ter toda a seguranca de uma empresa. Surpresa boa apos a reserva que nos presentearam com um credito de 1500 dolares para utilizacao em itens que nao estavam inclusos no all inclusive. Como mostra a foto da reserva abaixo. 
Chegando ao check in perguntei sobre o tal credito e como seriam as regras p utilizacao. O atendente Oscar me disse que ja estava creditado na conta do quarto e que era somente necessario informar o num do quarto e assinar a conta. No segundo dia no hotel voltei a recepcao e novamente com o atendente oscar repetiu toda a informacao da mesma forma. 

Ficamos mais interessados nos servicos do spa ja que o hotel conta com um boa carta de bebidas ja inclusas como whiskys 18 anos. Boas vodkas. Licores etc. 
so que estes 1500 dolares sao na verdade cupons de descontos para utilizacao restrita. Me informaram ao tentar agendar servicos de spa que so poderia utilizar 50 dolares por quarto. Somente 300 dolares pra upgrade de quartos. Ou seja uma massagem mais simples q custa 100 dolares para cada pessoa seria 300 dolares para 3 pessoas e teria um desconto de 50. Pagaria ainda 250.
