Questionei com as atendentes e fui direto ao contato com minha agente de viagem para resolver tal questao. Uma vez que  utilizamos pouco mais de 300 dolares. Informaram ao meu agente que recebemos toda a informacao no momento do checkin e deveriamos pagar por todo consumo. O que era uma inverdade e ficamos furiosos. 

Pessoalmente no penultimo dia fui na recepcao e chamei a gerente que se chama Doralice. Que nos informou sobre os tal cupons e nao creditos. No ultimo dia ela me ligou e disse que nao nos cobraria nenhum consumo e nos ofereceu um upgrade na próxima estadia. Alem de um late checkout sem custo. Como segue tambem nas minhas fotos abaixo. 

Fora este tremendo incomodo recomendo super o resort que tem funcionarios sempre com sorriso para nos receber, sempre solicitos e agradaveis. Boa comida e bebida e acomodacoes. Infraestrutura na praia me pareceu ser uma das melhores comparado a outros bangalos espreguicadeiras e mobiliario de praia. 

Parece que é uma pegadinha pra reservas e quando chegamos no hotel nao tem nenhum documento com as restricoes de uso. Pois seria evitado um consumo sem consciencia.

reviews.author: Brenda G
reviews.title: Aniversario de bodas
reviews.text: El hotel es muy limpio, las habitaciones muy bonitas y comodas, las bebidas (alcoholicas) de mucha calidad, pero la comida del buffet, poca variedad y con falta de sabor, A parte de todo cuando llegamos al hotel tuvimos que esperar hasta las 5:30 pm porque no tenian nuestra habitacion lista. Las maletas duraron hasta las 7 de la noche por llevarlas a la habitacion. Personal poco motivado en el area del buffet. Poca relacion en cuanto precio/calidad para este hotel.

reviews.author: I8881WJrichardr
reviews.title: A nice 3 star resort...
reviews.text: Found the machete carrying grounds keeper somewhat intimidating and unsettling. Don't really need to walk past a machete caring individual first thing in the morning on the way to breakfast every day.

reviews.author: adambeck71
reviews.title: Disappointed!
reviews.text: Grounds are beautiful, waiters/waitresses/bartenders are some of the nicest, friendliest people. That's where the positives end...Food is sub-par at best. Reservation for restaurants are impossible. For a 7 night stay, we were able to get accommodations for 3 nights, two nights were the same restaurant. The concierge folks are rude and act like they are doing you a favor. Junior luxury suite says they have king beds... Only if it is two of you. The "king" bed is on rollers and splits up.  So if there are 4 people in your room, you are actually sleeping on a full or twin bed. Just imagine doing that for 7 nights.. I've been to a few all-inclusive resorts and this one just isn't great....

reviews.author: John W
reviews.title: Nice resort but not fell short of expectations
reviews.text:
We spent 6 nights at Melia’s Paradisus Palma Real resort in Bavaro Beach, Punta Cana, DR for our annual family Thanksgiving vacation.  We’ve never been to the Dominican Republic prior to this trip but our friends had been multiple times and always raved about the island.  Our week was filled with highs and lows.  
There are three Melia properties on this resort (Paradisus Palma Real, The Reserve, and Melia Caribe Tropical).  We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real but the Paradisus and the Reserve shared many of the same facilities (restaurants, beach, pools, entertainment, etc.) so this review has some applicability to The Reserve, as well.

Hotel: 
Arrival and check-in went smoothly and effortlessly.  The room we received was similar to what we reserved, a 1-bedroom suite.  Our room was in the “Opal” building located about a ¼ mile from the restaurants, pool, and beach.  The room itself was roomy for our family of four.  We had requested a roll away bed upon our arrival and it took nearly 8 hours to arrive after multiple requests.  Our king size bed was fairly comfortable but overall the room was somewhat outdated and a little worn down.  Instead of a small self-service bar refrigerator, our room had a full size refrigerator and freezer stocked with two bottles of Budweiser (really, I don’t event drink Bud at home), two cans each of Coke, Diet Coke, and Sprite, and a handful of water bottles. The cleaning service was average though we constantly had to request more towels.  The water pressure was extremely low compared to what we have a home so showers were just not the same.  
The resort’s grounds were beautiful with the exception of a few of their ponds which we had to walk by multiple times a day and they smelled like raw sewage.
One of our biggest issues with this all-inclusive resort was the constant selling that went on throughout the week.  From the time we arrived to the time we finally caved, we were pressured to sit through a 90 minute sales pitch on Melia’s “timeshare” program.  We had no interest in putting down $45k - $90k USD to cover our vacations for 25-50 years and when we expressed our lack of interest, making dinner reservations suddenly became harder to make.  Additionally, there is a multiple tier program that existed (determined by the color of your bracelet).  In our case, we elected not to have a personal concierge or butler so we were treated like commoners vice the middle or elite class who got access to more restaurants, pools, bars, and beach space.  Every day we had to walk through these upper class areas to get to “our” pool and beach area.  
The internet coverage on the property was one of the best I’ve seen at any resort.  It was free and readily available in the room, restaurants, bars, lobby, pools, and beach.  The bandwidth was good enough to make FaceTime calls to the kids without having to use foreign cellular service. 

Pool/Beach: 
As for the pool, it was one of the biggest I’ve ever seen with fountains, and built in loungers.  My biggest problem is that it was filthy (dirt, leaves, empty cups/bottles, paper, etc).  Additionally, the water was frigid for being in the tropics.  The beach had plenty of chairs with it and was fairly clean but often you’d see empty drink glasses from the day before.  Due to the strong northerly winds the week we were there, they were not letting people take out the few kayaks, sail boats, or paddle boards out.  The water was too rough and murky to do any kind of snorkeling off the beach.  Along the shoreline was never cleaned of seaweed and other sea trash that washed up with took away from the appeal of the beach.  Additionally, there were natives selling their services and products right along the shoreline so you couldn’t even get close to the water without getting harassed by these people.  Be warned, I heard one guest dropped $200 cash for a zip line adventure with one of these shoreline dealers and when he went to do the activity, they were a no show and he basically lost his money.  If you are going to do an excursion, have it booked directly with the hotel staff and not the fly-by night vendors walking the shoreline.

Food:  
Overall the food was average for what you’d expect at an all-inclusive.  We tried every restaurant that came with our package (Steak House, Sushi, Italian, Mexican, and Japanese Hibachi), as well as the buffet restaurant (Naos).  Though the al la carte restaurants were average and nothing to write home about, the buffet restaurant had an abundant selection of all kinds of cuisine for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  We were somewhat early dinner eaters so making reservations between 6p – 7p often were not a problem but you’d have to make reservations with your assigned concierge each day.
My teenagers ordered room service just about every day and overall it was better than other resorts we’ve visited though like most resorts, it took on average an hour for the food to arrive.

Activities: 
This hotel certainly caters to families with young children (under 8 years old) with their baby & kid zones.  Our two teenagers were constantly bored.  They were used to organized beach activities like beach soccer or volleyball, table tennis tournaments, pool games, etc.  This resort does not do these things.  In fact, our boys basically had no interactions with anyone their age all week because the lack of organized activities for this age group.  The hotel definitely pushed their casino which was rather small (a 25 x 60 ft room) with a dozen or so slot machines and a few blackjack, poker, and roulette tables.  In the evenings, there was almost something going on every night at 8:30p but there wasn’t a lot of communication on what those activities were (this held true with the daytime activities as well).  Our two favorite evening shows were their Circus Show and Tribute to Michael Jackson show.  Both were amazing and riveting.  
The workout facility was somewhat small for a property of this size but overall the equipment was average if not slightly above.  They offered exercise classes (spin, yoga, etc) but the schedules weren’t well advertised to those who didn’t have a personal concierge or butler.
We did take an excursion to Catalina Island (arrange on-site through ScubaQuatic) and did some amazing scuba ($195 included transportation (bus & boat), 2 dives, & lunch) and snorkeling $95 included transportation (bus & boat), 2 snorkel sites, & lunch).  It left at 7a from our lobby and we returned around 4:30p. I highly recommend taking this excursion.  

Weather:  
Allegedly, November isn’t supposed to be too wet but it rained every day we were there and we only saw sun the last 2 ½ days of our trip (few hours here and there).  This became one of the biggest lows of our trip was the rainy weather and strong northerly winds that definitely put a damper on just about all outdoor activities.  My son and I upgraded our PADI Scuba certifications (Paradisus’ on-site dive company is ScubaQuatic) and to finish up our open water testing we had to travel to the southern coast-Caribbean side (1 hr drive) where the waters were much calmer and much better visibility.  Though no one is able to control the weather, the hotel didn’t have much to do from an activity stand point when the weather turned bad.  

Miscellaneous: 
We received a $550 resort credit as part of our package.  We didn’t use a single $1 of it at the end.  For example, we had something like three $20 vouchers to use for wine purchase but they could only be used for bottles priced over $100 (trust me there were plenty to choose from with some has high as $700 USD).  We stuck with the standard house wines for our dinners and it was just fine.  Similarly, there was a $120 credit to upgrade our room (to be used within 24 hours after check-in) but we didn’t get our credit vouchers until the third day.   The remaining vouchers were for paid dinners that would have costed nearly $75 pp/USD and their overpriced Spa.

reviews.author: allachkaNY
reviews.title: 3 star hotel for a 5 star price
reviews.text:
MMy family and I checked into Paradisus Palma Real on Saturday afternoon.  We are club Melia members and it is our third time staying with Paradisus, and I'm unfortunately, very disappointed thus far.  None of the things that happened are major and perhaps if taken separately can all be overlooked, especially had the sun been shining, but I'm far too angry at this point not to make a public post. 

In 2012 was the first time that we stayed in Paradisus, we stayed in a one bedroom suite overlooking the pool and everything from the food, to service to hospitality was amazing.  We came back and quickly told our friends, all of which have visited paradisus over the years.  We have 4 families of friends currently staying there.  We came back when our 2nd child was 9 mos in early 2015 and we had family concierge and a first floor suite.  We had a fantastic time.  

When our friends booked Paradisus in Dominican for thanksgiving we quickly decided to join.  However, thus far we've been gravely disappointed.  We feel that we are getting 3 star service for a five star price.  It took us 20 minutes to check in and with two small children, we weren't ever offered milk or water or a welcome beverage.  Our room is far from the main building and we have to take an elevator, which has a smell and a broken button for now 4 days that we are here.  Why not put a family with a stroller within walking distance? We requested a rollaway bed prior to our arrival and a crib upon our arrival.  Neither was in our room upon checking, or even after dinner.  At 930pm after returning to the room, someone came to unfold the couch (after our calling).  At 10:30 pm someone came and brought the crib. Both of my kids were sleeping at this time.  The iron in my room spewed out black stuff onto my white shirt and while the iron was replaced with a newer model, nobody offered to clean my shirt when we know there's laundry/dry cleaning on premises.  The resort credits that we received are completely useless and we cannot seem to use them for anything.  We have a room upgrade included, but our room has not been upgraded.  We had a similar resort credit at a different hotel earlier this earlier this year and were able to use them for 2 FREE massages (not $50 off) and FREE swimming with dolphins for a family of four as well as a photo credit.  

Our jacuzzi wasn't working on the first day, the toilet doesn't flush properly, the mirror is broken, and soap isn't always replenished.  Again, none of these are monumental things but they do not equate with a 5 star hotel or the Paradisus brand.  We asked for Q-tips 6 times (to 4 days later find out there's no ear swabs at the property), I asked to speak to a manager several times to no avail, have gotten the run around and are just gravely disappointed.  The food and service are also not up to par with our prior Paradisus experience.  At blue agave yesterday, we waited for the kids pasta and meatballs for 1.5 hours.  This is not acceptable and it is very evident that the restaurants and kitchen as well as the resort in general, are very understaffed.

I've tried speaking with representatives (with a 20 min wait each time) at the hotel, everyone smiles and nothing gets done.  I've written via private message, with no response.  With the weather so awful the last four days, the staff should be doing a lot more to entertain the guests and especially the kids that paid a lot of money to be here during this week.  

Unfortunately, our experience will not have us returning to Paradisus.  Our friends are arriving today and I'm hoping that we can at least salvage some of our trip in good company and maybe the sun will come out sometime soon.

reviews.author: Marina R
reviews.title: Kids Club excelente... Mas fui roubada!!
reviews.text:
O hotel tem quartos ótimos, comida boa, atendimento bom, porém é distante da praia e necessário carrinhos (dirigidos pelos funcionários) para se locomover entre os principais restaurantes, SPA e praia. Algumas vezes ficamos esperando um carrinho por muito tempo. 
Fui com minha família, usufruímos da piscina e tivemos ótimos momentos. Destaque para o Kids club que é excelente. 
Outro detalhe importante é que fui roubada. Deixei 200 dólares dentro da minha bolsa e quando fui guardar o dinheiro no cofre, não estava mais. 
Enfim, acredito que tenham melhores opções em Punta Cana, pelo mesmo preço e nível ou até mais acessível.

reviews.author: Marcelo M
reviews.title: DESCASO
reviews.text:
Gostaríamos de lhe relatar sobre a nossa hospedagem no THE RESERVE PARADISUS PUNTA CANA, no período do dia 28/10 a 03/10. 
É oportuno ressaltarmos que era a segunda vez que visitamos Punta Cana, pois, há cinco anos ficamos hospedados no NOW LARIMAR e a experiência foi tão gratificante que resolvemos retornar para comemorar o aniversário de minha esposa, Carolina.
Estávamos hospedados no DREAMS LA ROMANA, em Bayahibe, do dia 23/10 a 28/10, cuja estadia foi perfeita, sem nenhum tipo de aborrecimento e nos deslocamos para Punta Cana, com destino ao THE RESERVE PARADISUS PUNTA CANA. 
Chegamos no hotel por volta das 15h30min do dia 28/10. De imediato, fomos encaminhados para a realização do check in em uma área exclusiva para os hóspedes do THE RESERVE, porém, nos causou estranheza a frieza e a falta de cordialidade dos funcionários. Foi nos repassado as informações preliminares sobre o hotel, através de um mapa que foi disponibilizado, bem como dois cartões de acesso ao nosso quarto e, por escrito, a senha de acesso ao wi-fi.
Logo em seguida, nos encaminharam ao nosso quarto. A partir daí, iniciou a nossa frustração e decepção por termos escolhido o Paradisus para terminar as nossas férias na República Dominicana. 
Quando chegamos no quarto , deparamos com a temperatura ambiente do ar condicionado marcando 10º C, porém, imaginávamos que não seria problema, haja vista que bastaria ajustar até ficar na temperatura que desejássemos.
Pois bem. Após diversas tentativas infrutíferas de tentar aumentar a temperatura do ar condicionado, resolvemos desfazer as nossas malas, acessar o wi-fi e tomar banho para que pudéssemos relaxar e desfrutar das dependências no hotel e, o mais esperado, da praia.
Acontece que o chuveiro somente saia água fria, a descarga do vaso sanitário não estava funcionando e não conseguíamos acessar o wi-fi com a senha disponibilizada. Resolvemos ligar para o lobby do hotel para solicitar um técnico responsável para arrumar o chuveiro e o vaso sanitário. O tempo foi passando, nenhum técnico chegava e a temperatura ambiente do quarto estava insuportável de tanto frio. Após insistirmos novamente, via telefone, e depois de quase uma hora que já tínhamos chegado no quarto, a pessoa que seria o responsável pela manutenção chegou no quarto. Olha daqui, olha de lá e nada de arrumar o ar, o vaso e a água do chuveiro. Enquanto a pessoa tentava, de forma infrutífera, arrumar os defeitos, resolvemos novamente ligar para o lobby para reclamar que não estávamos conseguindo acessar o wi-fi com a senha disponibilizada. Para nossa surpresa, a funcionária que fez o nosso check in, anotou a senha errada, ou seja, ao invés de “MELIA 001”, escreveu “MELIA 008”, conforme doc. anexo.
Desde o primeiro momento em que deparamos com essas mazelas, tentamos localizar o “concierge” que é disponibilizado para os hóspedes do THE RESERVE para nos auxiliar, porém, não encontramos no local onde o mesmo deveria permanecer que é na entrada da Vila onde era localizado o nosso quarto. Aliás, todo o período de nossa estadia, NUNCA vimos o concierge, diferentemente das outras Vilas onde pudemos perceber que sempre havia um à disposição dos hóspedes. 
Como até então estávamos apenas em função de sanar esses diversos problemas, sequer tínhamos saído do quarto. Então, resolvemos sair, sem banho, enquanto o técnico tentava arrumar os defeitos. Já era um pouco mais de 17h quando fomos para o lobby e apanhamos, as 17h40min, o translado disponibilizado pelo hotel para o Shopping Palma Real, na certeza de que quando retornássemos, os defeitos estariam sanados.
Chegamos por volta das 20h e, para a nossa surpresa, o quarto estava da mesma forma que deixamos: ar condicionado marcando a temperatura ambiente de 10ºc, chuveiro com água fria e vaso entupido! 
Imediatamente, nos deslocamos até o lobby e exigimos uma solução imediata, tendo em vista que sequer tínhamos usufruído das dependências do hotel, eis que somente havíamos feito o trajeto quarto/lobby e lobby/quarto. 
Após expormos as mazelas as quais fomos submetidos e que não iríamos permitir sermos ludibriados, tendo em vista que pagamos por uma área que, em tese, teria um atendimento diferenciado, nos foi oferecida uma quantidade maior de manta para nos cobrirmos. Dessa forma, nosso primeiro dia/noite no THE RESERVE foi em um ambiente insalubre, onde  tomamos banho com a água fria, dormimos com o clima gelado do quarto e vaso ainda entupido.
No dia seguinte, acordamos as 7h, ligamos para o lobby solicitando novamente a presença de um técnico e fomos tomar o café da manhã. Retornamos por volta das 7h50 e nenhum técnico havia comparecido no quarto, tendo em vista que os defeitos ainda persistiam. Resolvemos abrir todas as janelas do quarto, mas não adiantava, a temperatura do quarto permanecia gelada. 
Enfurecidos, nos deslocamos para o lobby e exigimos a presença do gerente geral e formos informados que somente chegaria as 9h. Por volta das 9h30min, a pessoa de LUIZ ORTIZ, que não me falhe a memória, teria se identificado como sendo o Gerente dos Concierge ou algum tipo de Gerente Geral, foi até o nosso quarto e, muito gentil, pediu desculpas e nos garantiu que os defeitos seriam sanados. Em contrapartida, LUIZ ORTIZ ofereceu acesso irrestrito às dependências exclusivas do ROYAL SERVICE, bem como um jantar de cortesia no Restaurante Passion para comemorar o aniversário da Carolina, além de disponibilizar um aparelho celular para que pudéssemos ligar para o nosso concierge quando fosse necessário.
Depois de 24h que chegamos no hotel, fomos conhecer a praia e as demais dependências do Paradisus. No final da tarde, retornamos para o nosso quarto e, felizmente, o chuveiro e o vaso foram arrumados, porém, o ar condicionado ainda insistia em permanecer frio, mesmo aumentando a temperatura. A solução foi desligá-lo durante toda a nossa estadia no Paradisus.
Gostaríamos de esclarecer que os privilégios oferecidos por LUIZ ORTIZ não foram capazes de minimizar o desgaste e aborrecimentos que sofremos e o tempo perdido de um dia.
Pudemos perceber que poucA diferença ou quase nenhuma existe entre a área do THE RESERVE e ROYAL SERVICE, bem como em relação ao THE RESERVE e a área tradicional, PPC (Paradisus Punta Cana).
já hospedamos em outros Resort da rede Meliá (PARADISUS VARADERO e SOL MELIÁ, localizados, respectivamente, em Varadero e Cayo Largo, ambos em Cuba e, em nenhum deles tivemos um tratamento tão depreciativo e humilhante, além de percebermos também a má vontade e falta de educação dos funcionários do hotel, ressalvado aqueles os funcionários do bar da praia da área localizada do THE RESERVE. 
Seria injusto de nossa parte não reconhecer as belíssimas instalações do Resort, das ótimas comidas oferecidas e dos excelentes drinks disponibilizados. Todavia, não achamos vantajoso ficar na área THE RESERVE, pois, todas as áreas mais atrativas e agradáveis são de uso comum de todos os hóspedes.

reviews.author: ptbecki
reviews.title: Nice, but not sure I would return...
reviews.text:
We stayed in a Family Concierge room the first weekend in November, which is definitely off season.
Pros: no trouble with getting tables at restaurants, beach was very uncrowded, choice of palapas/cabanas at pool and beach, food was pretty good, lovely grounds
Cons: service was lacking, confusing restaurant situation, terrible room service, check in

Our Family Concierge was Diosmery, who was wonderful.. She made our restaurant and cabana reservations which was great. She made a wonderful bubble bath for our daughter with balloon animals (as a surprise), and she attempted to check on our room service order. She kept our favorites stocked in the minibar (which is not a fridge but a "cooler" so we never did drink the beer in there since it wasn't very cold.) Since it was off season the markup on the concierge was minimal and we thought it was worth it.

We ordered room service for breakfast on the last day so we could get out to the beach earlier to take advantage of the sunny weather (not that prevalent during our trip but that of course is not the fault of the resort). We ordered, then gave our order again to our concierge who assured us she would double check on it. Our family members in another room also ordered room service as they were going on an excursion. Our order was 35 min late (we called after 20 min) and their order was who knows how late because they had to leave before it came (it was in their room when they returned at 4 pm). When our order finally fame it was half of what we had ordered, which was annoying.

The first day our room was cleaned at 4pm when we returned from the pool. The other days it was cleaned in the morning. The washcloths were never replaced so I had to nab a couple from one of the public bathrooms. They say to hang up towels you want to reuse, but there are only two racks for hand towels and two tiny hooks on the wall for towels. All unused towels are on shelves, so not useful for drying. Also  there was nowhere to hang wet swimsuits--the rain and humidity prevented us from putting them on the balcony. There should be a laundry line in the shower or 5+ hooks on the bathroom wall. We were thankful the room had an umbrella and we were able to get a second one (it rained almost daily).

The room was lovely, bed was comfortable, closets were spacious. The toilet seat was loose but I didn't call on it. The kids got shirts and robes and slippers for being in the concierge building but they were all too small--I asked for a bigger robe but never got one for my son. I also asked for a tie for my daughter's robe and bigger slippers but never got those either. The t shirts were ehhh so I just left those there for someone else--my kids wouldn't wear them even if they fit.

The shuttles to the beach were spotty--not sure if this was usual or an off season issue. The walk wasn't bad, so I would say we did 50-50 shuttle/walk.

The grounds were amazing and beautifully maintained. People were working nonstop and it showed.

The beach was well maintained and on the last day there was a bit of seaweed which was collected by a giant tractor--it wasn't the smelly sargassum so it wasn't a factor at all. The sand is so fine and wonderful and the water was warm. This was our favorite part. It was a little annoying to not be closer to the beach, esp the one time I went back to the room to get money for parasailing. No shuttle in sight so I walked halfway and signed up for a bike, then rode the bike back and forth which made it faster.  Service at the beach was OK--the bar was close so no worries to get up to get a drink if we wanted one. Tons of vendors walking the beach which was annoying after a while (cigars, braiding, excursions).

Kids loved the adventure park one day for an hour. They didn't use the kids club, though we all went and played foosball and air hockey a couple times together. There weren't enough kids there to make it interesting for them. The Reserve pool was very nice and well maintained. A little chilly though, but that was likely due to all the rain. We loved the cabanas at the pool.

They give you a list of restaurants to choose from but give you a 3 word description of each, plus no word on dress codes and no access to actual menus. Then we went to go to one of the buffets Naos, which seemed to be closed, though that was also confusing because our concierge told us it was open.  It would make sense for them to have one less buffet when so few people were there but please tell us upfront.

Check in took almost an hour for no apparent reason, except they seemed not to have enough staff. It was a gorgeous day and we could have spent some of that time at the pool instead. Often at the pool bar you had to wait a while for someone to come around and see that you were there.

Overall this is a nice resort but I doubt I would return to DR. I like to try different places and this place is not calling me or my family back. I would pick Cancun over here.

reviews.author: KathiKSL
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: I was there in 2009 and this was my second visit.  The physical property is gorgeous.  Great pool and beach facilities.  Sadly, I thought the food was less than average.  No creativity......nothing seemed fresh.  Breakfast was okay due to the omelet station, but the bacon was baked into a clump everyday.......no crispness and greasy.  Nothing looked appetizing, but I tried some different things and things that should be hot weren't or cold weren't.   Burger at Blue Agave pre cooked and no flavor.  Guacamole was like soup.  They took leftover pastries from breakfast to make cupcakes for the coffee bar (not horrible but not cupcakes).  Beverages seemed watered down.  Dinner at the Tempanyaki table was a let down.........our chef had no personality or showmanship like the other tables.  The meal was not great.  One night of two catered dinners was okay but again not great. Seemed to be a lot of issues with the rooms.  Some lost power, some toilets didn't flush, our lock was broken and our shower had to be fixed due to a leak and no hot water.  Staff is friendly and they try but even though the hotel was about 40% they seemed stretched.  Pedro (Mono Grande) on the beach is a delight....always smiling and offering help to make your day wonderful!

reviews.author: 979ignacior
reviews.title: El exceso no es la medida de todo
reviews.text: La enormidad de ciertas instalaciones hace perder el encanto del idílico lugar donde se encuentra; el acceso a ciertos recintos debería limitarse si los clientes no guardan un mínimo de decoro. Habría que exigir a determinados clientes un mínimo de etiqueta o educación en el uso y abuso de las mismas.

reviews.author: Kristen C
reviews.title: Liked but would not go back.
reviews.text:
We took a family trip to the Palma Real, as we visited its sister location, Paradisus Dominican Republic, the previous year and we LOVED it. This location was supposed to be an even better resort. The locals say this is the most beautiful resort on the island, and also one of the most expensive. 

The first three days were great. The resort was breathtaking. There was beach volleyball every day, good shows at night, a nice little casino, great activities throughout the day like painting, cigar rolling, candle making, finger painting. The staff spoke more English here than the other resort, and showed much interest in teaching us Spanish, which I loved. Excursions go straight through the resort and picked us up and dropped us off. The buffet had good food even though I am a very picky eater. 

After our third day there, half of our family was sick. So sick that we could not leave the room for the remaining 4 days. Having to be 10 feet from the bathroom and not being able to walk from the room to the pool without running straight to the bathroom. We did not drink any tap water, eat any salads, I only ate cooked food. When adventuring from the room to eat something from the buffet, I was talking to someone who was attending a wedding there, they indicated half of the wedding guests were sick as well. 

Still being sick on the flight home and I am currently sick and it has been 3 months since my return. Over the two resorts, I would return to Paradisus Dominican Republic but not this resort.

reviews.author: claudiasl82
reviews.title: No volvería!
reviews.text: La playa era espectacular!!! Pero la habitación me pareció súper básica, el servicio era malo, la comida no me gusto, la gente que trabaja ahí se nota que no está contenta y que los explotan al máximo!

reviews.author: maxcmo
reviews.title: Average property a decent value.
reviews.text: The hotel property itself is very nice and the staff is extremely helpful and attendant.  The food was average.  One night we ate at Passions not part of the all inclusive and it WAS NOT worth the additional money.  The dishes were strange for a lack of a better word.  We ended up going back to the room and ordering the inclusive room service after we ate here lol.  The rooms themselves are below average.  The pictures look far better than what you actually get.  We had a roach in our room and the bathrooms are extremely dark.  My wife could not really do her make up without using the iphone light to see her face.  The shower is almost like bathing completely in the dark.  The water pressure was good and the water temp was always hot.  The room ac was also very good and the room is pretty spacious.  For this reason I am giving them a review of average.  This place desperately needs a room renovation to truly be considered a 5 star destination.

reviews.author: Nuno D
reviews.title: Mais ao menos...
reviews.text:
Deixou muito a desejar! 
Música antiga!
Animações inapropriadas e eram muito chatos, ao ponto de a pessoa estar a descansar e eles acordarem a pessoa!
 Só os "dólares" faziam os  empregados fazer mais rápido e melhor!
A relação preço qualidade fica muito longe do é um hotel realmente de 5 estrelas luxo! 
A nossa "camareira/mordoma" como eles chamam só no último dia é que passou mais de 5 minutos connosco e foi para quase nos obrigar a escrever algo positivo no trip advisor... 
O Kids club e as pessoas de lá eram 10 estrelas! 
O hotel tem imensas piscinas de qualidade!
Os restaurantes em modo buffet são todos iguais e todos os dias com a mesma ementa (média qualidade) os restaurantes por marcação são razoáveis mas não achei nada de espectacular! 
A Rudelania que era a nossa pivot era simpática mas quando se atribuiu um serviço deste género a atenção e vontade de fazer tem de ser real e não apenas quando chegamos que nos diz que está ali e que é o seu contato e no último dia pede para classificar bem o hotel!
Detesto estas pressões! 
De uma forma geral é bastante razoável e nada de muito grave mas pelo posicionamento devia ser muito melhor!

reviews.author: Guillermo C
reviews.title: Desorganización en la recepción, picardía en el restaurant peruano........
reviews.text: Fui a un Congreso, y arribé al hotel cerca del mediodía. Me respondieron que las habitaciones se podían ocupar recién a las 15, pero una media hora antes de eso comenzaron a llegar diversos huéspedes anglo parlantes que recibieron su habitación de inmediato. Ante mi queja, me dijeron que se había demorado la liberación de mi habitación, lo cual no es la mejor práctica, porque los huéspedes debieran ser atendidos en una base de ¨primero llegado, primero atendido¨, y no con habitación fija. Luego pedimos un vino de 37 dólares con un colega, y nos descorcharon uno similar de 95. Para destacar, solamente la excelente atención en el bar de playa de Feliciano del Rosario y Joel Valdez. Por lo demás, el hotel es correcto, las habitaciones se hacen a tiempo, el minibar se repone y hay higiene y variedad de servicios. La playa no me pareció tampoco de las mejores, meramente regular, hay algunas algas y pozos

reviews.author: camillaf45
reviews.title: Algumas coisas não são verdadeiras
reviews.text:
Fiquei hospedada em setembro de 2016, e assim que fechamos nossa hospedagem diretamente com a Melia, recebemos um "Gift" de $1500,00 nele dizia que poderia utrilizar para diversos beneficios, sem nenhum tipo de observção, apenas diz, sujeito a disponibilidade (isso me da a entender se apenas não tiver horário).
Chegando no hotel na hora do check in questionamos se poderíamos utilizar esse gift para alguns itens e para a nossa infelicidade, descobrimos que se trata de um presente falso, pois por exemplo você quer usar o presente no SPA a massagem custa $150,00 você só pode usar $50,00  do GIFT e tem que arcar com $100,00 restantes, um absurdo, questionamos a recepcionista que não seria um presente, já que se você ganha um presente de aniversário você não deve pagar a outra parte do presente. Achamos um absurdo e pedimos explicações mais nada foi resolvido, então não caia, eles divulgarem como se fosse um benefício e na verdade é um pega trouxa. 
O hotel em si é bem confortável, os restaurantes são gostosos, mas fomos mau tratados no restaurante El Fuego por um funcionário que ficou nos olhando e rindo de nós.
No restaurante Aqua pedimos para repetir os pratos, os graçons tiveram que ir perguntar para o chefe se poderíamos repeti (LEMBRANDO QUE É UM HOTEL ALL INCLUSIVE), sem contar que o atendimento desse restaurante é péssimo.

reviews.author: E2239YTsabrinab
reviews.title: Punta Cana Stay
reviews.text: Overall stay was very good. Wish I could have experienced each restaurant. The entertainment was good. Loved the jewelry vendors. Just wish I didn't have to walk so far back and forth to the room. Bye

reviews.author: 565veruskam
reviews.title: Mejoras.
reviews.text: Muchas gracias por sus servicios y la calidad de sus empleados me sentí muy bien. Pero como antes comente creo que se puede mejorar la variedad de alimentos que ustedes ofrecen, porque gracias a la zona donde están existen una amplia diversidad gastronómica. Confío que mi comentario lo tomaran en cuenta para tales cambios. Por otro lado tengo una pequeña observación se trata del casino si lo pueden mejorar implementado mas actividades de azar, es muy simple y no me gusto mucho ya que en mi estadía invite a unos amigos y la experiencia no fue gratificante, tuvimos que irnos. Espero que cuando vuelva todo marche excelentemente bien. Muchas gracias y hasta el próximo año con Dios delante. Buen día.

reviews.author: sherrieleeb
reviews.title: Reserve at Paradisus
reviews.text: Resort was beautiful.  Room was great.  I thought the concierge service was poor.  We celebrated a 50th wedding anniversary and a wedding.  The wedding coordinator did a fantastic job.  Our anniversary was celebrated several times.  All very nice.  Restaurants were closed, some completely and others open at various times on various days.  There was no communications as to what was open when.

reviews.author: Eloygm
reviews.title: Hotel was really nice but not our cup of tea!
reviews.text: Overall the hotel was ok and the service was fine. However,  it just did not match the price tag. Nothing for us stood out during our stay and although the staff were really friendly they do need training on how to address guests respectfully. The check-in process was painful and lengthy so not the best experience to walk into.

reviews.author: ChoppyBadger
reviews.title: Work program saved by an INCREDIBLE Convention Services Manager
reviews.text: I was part of a team that operated a corporate incentive program & we had challenges at the property in getting things done. I believe our program would have failed if not for our CSM Niela EUGENIO.  She really went above and beyond and made sure that every single detail that we were concerned about was taken care of.  From a beach party that was rained out - she saved the day by surprising us with a video wall in the ballroom that made you feel like you were outside.  I would only come back to this property if you guaranteed me that I'd be able to work with Niela again.  AMAZING job, Niela!!!

reviews.author: Nadia972
reviews.title: decevant
reviews.text: Nous avons passé deux jours avec nos deux petites filles, et nous avons été déçus car rapport qualité prix il est loin d un grand hotel. Il est tres grand et le système de shuttle n'est pas du tout organise, donc lorsque nous allions mange le soir avec nais petites filles nous attendions parfois 15 20minutes pour une navette et très souvent elles ne venaient pas nous devions marcher avec nos puces endormies. Le service est très moyen le personnel vous annonce au départ qu'ils seront la pour vous mais si vous ne donnez pas de gros pourboires vous n aurez aucune attention ou aide durant le séjour. La literie est moyenne et aucune activité correcte est prévue pour les enfants avec un club enfant pas très professionnel. Seul point agréable les restaurants buffet très variés et très bon et le parc tropical ainsi que les piscines très beaux.

reviews.author: Q1595LHsamuelp
reviews.title: No recomendado para parejas
reviews.text: Esperaba más de este hotel ateniendo a lo que había leído de el pero no fue así las actividades para adultos son muy pobres y el menú de los restaurantes un tanto aburrido creo que tienen potencial para ser mejores

reviews.author: Franchetta L
reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text:
1. Had to wait 2 hours to check in
2. Roaches in our suite ALL the time
3. Housekeeping is done too late in the day
4. Staff very friendly and helpful
5. Shaky shaky is awesome
6. Restaurants/food excellent
7. LOVE the enrichment program activities

reviews.author: TravelTime
reviews.title: Had a good time BUT...
reviews.text: I have a very mixed review to offer for the Reserve. Some parts were great, some not so great. Lets start with the room. We had a one bedroom master suite. The room was very big and well decorated however the room was incredibly musty/moldy. I am extremely sensitive to mold so I was uncomfortable in the room. I asked other hotel guests if they also had musty rooms and all concurred that yes they were musty so we did not bother asking to switch rooms. I do understand that this is a tropical/humid location but for someone who is sensitive to mold this hotel would not be a good choice for you. The bed and the couch were both hard and uncomfortable. The shower was nice, had good pressure. The tub was huge and very nice. The balcony was nice as well.  We also had some issues getting items we needed in the room. We had called (more than once) before our trip to ensure that we would have a crib waiting for us upon arrival in our hotel room. There was no crib and we had to call three times to get one brought to us. The crib mattress was very hard and there was not a fitted sheet on the mattress but rather a large flat sheet wrapped around the mattress. I suggest bringing your own pack and play sheet if possible. Also the crib was very small and my son moves around a lot when he sleeps so he kept hitting his head and waking up crying. There was also no hair dryer in the room and it again took 3 calls to get one, hours later. Next, the restaurants... we LOVED every one of the restaurants we made a reservation for, the food was delicious. We especially loved Vento. The buffets were ok. The food was basic for a buffet not great but not bad either. We had great service everyday from Anthony at the buffet. The beach was ABSOLUTELY beautiful! White sand beaches with crystal clear blue water. Fantastic service at the beach from Emilio. We did not mind the cart ride down to the beach at all. One tip would be to get on/off the cart at either at the Reserve lobby or at Gabi beach for the best chance of quickly getting a ride. The kids club was nicely appointed and all the staff was friendly and inviting. We found the floor mats to be dirty. Even though you had to take your shoes off when in the baby room the colorful floor mat looked soiled. My son got impetigo (which is a staph infection of the skin) while we were at the Reserve. He came down with the rash the day before we left and i brought him right to the doctor upon return home. Our doctor explained to us it is very contagious so I immediately emailed the Reserve management to let them know that he had probably picked it up in the baby room and even if he didn't he was playing in there so the room should be throughly cleaned in order to prevent the spread to future guests. The response from the Reserve was defensive that he did not get it there. We have no idea if the room was cleaned after we made the hotel aware. The pools were all nice, warm and our son loved the slides at the kiddie pool. Overall the highlights for us were the beach and the restaurants and the staff  but the room would keep us from returning again.

reviews.author: NJResident2016
reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text:
My family and I (12 people) decided to go to Paradisus Palma Real for our annual summer vacation, many friends highly recommended this all inclusive resort, but at the end of 4 nights and 3 days stay we left with mixed feelings. 

The housekeeping and kitchen crews were amazing!!! But unfortunately some folks at the reception were not as professional. 

When we arrived 1 of our 4 rooms was not ready until 1.5 hrs later than agreed, and we were promised a late check out due to the inconvenience, but a gentleman at the reception told us an hour before regular check out, that he couldn't honored the late check out because the room was reserved for another party and we had to leave room. We finally received our late check out after a meeting with the resort General Manager.

The food is very good and the restaurants are clean and well maintained, but the restaurants are located around a small square area that could makes you feel restricted and overcrowded at peak times.

The prices for Spa services are on the high end in comparison to other resorts or similar facilities in the area (other resorts are located close by).

Again mixed feelings!!!

reviews.author: Katerina G
reviews.title: Not a bad place, but not in line with TripAdvisor reviews
reviews.text:
I would like to start with positive impressions.

This hotel has 2 huge advantages - the beach and nice suites. The beach is amazing, clean, spacious with nice lounge beds and plenty of towels. We stayed at the Reserve section of the Paradisus and the suites are actually very nice, clean, spacious and the air conditioner works very well.

The buildings are widely spread across the resort and you need a 5 min ride to get to the beach. Going to the beach was not a problem, but coming back was an issue. We had to wait every day for 35 min for the bus to get back to our room. Walking was not an option as it was extremely hot, We were told by other guests in the last 2 days of our stay that if we walk to the Paradisus beach, the bus services is better. The point is, we paid much more to stay on the private beach and why do we need to walk somewhere else to get a bus ride? 

Another big issue is that all buffets are an open space environment with no air conditioner. The birds and flies are happy to share your meal with you.

The main lobby of the Reserve is very poorly decorated with some old furniture. I think it was donated to the Reserve by Salvation Army store, The resort reminds me of a funeral home, very dark, gloomy, no lights, no music,

There is not much in terms of entertainment, No live music, or a band playing at night,. Where is the Dominican spirit with their upbeat music and dance? None of that at the Reserve. No piano bar, or anything that suppose to be available at 5 star resort.

Service is a mix as well at the Reserve, In general, people work hard and trying to help.. During our dinner at Bana, we got 3 very dirty glasses with white wine, when we pointed out to the glasses, we got clean glasses with wine , but no apologies were received, Not a  sign of a 5 star resort.

We have been to Bavaro Princess resort before, next door to Paradisus. The Reserve will cost you a double of Bavaro Princess, but it is very similar in quality. So you pay double at the Reserve for the same quality,

In summary, it is OK resort, but not as near as it was rated on this website, Much worse.

I would like to acknowledge Anthony who worked at the Reserve main buffet for his excellent service.

reviews.author: Yeseniaqui28
reviews.title: OLIO en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Recomiendo el restaurante OLIO en Paradisus Palma Real, muy buena las pastas y salsas. En especial la atención de Antony Maesta  súper amable y preocupado por hacerte sentir como en casa. Mil puntos 

En actividades: busquen a Happy boy, Gasoline, y a Chanty súper alegres siempre preocupándose por mantenerte sintonizado con todas las actividades

reviews.author: MPVanityEvents
reviews.title: Palma Real Average to say the least
reviews.text: Ascetic wise the Palma Real can't be beat, but let's be honest were not there to eat the structure! Many resorts in Punta Cana compete and say that they are the best in what they offer, this can be true for most and not for some. Palma Reals 1 pool, messy Buffett order and non answering room service line can old real quick. I have stayed and critiqued many PUJ resorts and Palma Real has been one of my least favorite thus far! No bar service on the beach or at least the wait staff never showed while I was there but either way the food is just OK and noting WOW about it. The rooms are beautiful, no early check in for early arrivals and sometimes massive confusion if you reserved a double walk to you room and get a king, it becomes a huge drama to get a new room! With that being said if you are planning on dineing on concrete then the place is for you, if not for the money your better off staying at a better resort that caters to offering a higher end level of service.

reviews.author: C4507HHsandrak
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Very unfriendly staff, had to wait every time going to the buffet for 30 min to get you coffee or any other type of drink, no one had any information and you felt like they were bothered when asked, also will not return

reviews.author: aladinp2016
reviews.title: Vacation 2016
reviews.text: Members of the vacation club but did not receive the perks I pay for year round. You are mislead byvtye sales people and only given attention when they are trying to make,the sale. I overpay when I can just book as a normal patron and get a better deal.

reviews.author: 559coca
reviews.title: Bares y Comidas
reviews.text: Falta carta de tragos en algunos bares y falta un acompañamiento como maní o snack para los tragos.   El café cierra a las 16 horas, demasiado temprano.  No hay snacks nocturnos como en muchos otros hoteles. Hay poca variedad en comidas.

reviews.author: SeaBee1828
reviews.title: Great resort but staff needs more training
reviews.text:
We can't fault the resort itself, but some of the staff required more training to be able to handle unforseen situations, although they were friendly. 
We had a dinner booking which didn't exist on their system, a mixed up in rooms which required us to move to another room. These were all unnecessary.

reviews.author: TessaPeru
reviews.title: Boring for teenagers and youg adults
reviews.text:
The hotel is great for couples.  For families with small children, there is a children´s club but not to close (it is located at the Reserve facilities). I went on a family trip and all kids up to 11 had a great time but there were no activities for the rest 12-19 years old.  It was kind of dull for them, especially if you compare with other hotels like Barcelo who have many activities for that age group.
Another thing that was very slow was room cleaning, they will make the rooms sometimes at 4pm or later.
It is an excellent hotel for couples since the restaurants are pretty good and have a good variety.  They even have a special area only for adults if you stay at that part of the hotel.  That are has a premium service.
I would recommend the hotel only for couples or families with small children who do not mind for them to stay at the kid´s club far from the beach.  Otherwise stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Stephanie Y
reviews.title: Was awed by beach but disappointed by service
reviews.text: My visit to Dominican Republican was blessed by beautiful weather despite dire predictions and Bavaro Beach is awesome. The Palma Real is a different story. The property is beautiful but the service offered causes me to give 2stars. My review is three because of the beach😎. Workers seem unhappy and it shows in their work. A pitiful few stand out but as a whole, we felt like a bother. We had to practically beg for towels everyday and things just didn't seem clean. I would definitely not stay there again. I went in thinking it would be spectacular like playa de Carmen but was wickedly surprised . Food was mediocre and souvenirs outrageously priced. It was like the resort was intentionally gouging. Probably will never return.

reviews.author: niteflite
reviews.title: Lobster, Shrimp, Mosquitoes
reviews.text:
I stayed here for four nights with my family.  I opted for the family concierge package and a 1 BR suite.

The GOOD:
Lobster, shrimp, delicious tropical fruit like papayas, mangoes, passion fruit, etc.  Beautiful beach with calm water.  Not overcrowded unlike some of my other all inclusive experiences.  Proximity to airport.  The Grill restaurant.  Premium drinks.  Service from around half the staff.  A few stood out - Jonathan working the bar, Wander(ful) working the pools, and Angelia Rosario at the Gabi Club.

The BAD:
Most of the facility is outdoors - this includes restaurants.  That calls for a hot, humid, and sweaty meal.  The biggest problem of the openness is the mosquitoes that ATE ME UP during the trip.  I saw exterminators spraying something but the mosquitoes here are sneaky - i visually didn't see too many but I literally must have had around 50 bites, mostly on my legs.

The food itself was good although I sensed a whole lot of MSG.  My favorite was when they put out big prawns and lobster tails.  Two of the three a la carte restaurants I went to were a big letdown - Mole was pretty bad as was Bana.  They have these two at their sister resort in Cancun and there the food was DELICIOUS.

The room was not bad but the walls are thin so I can hear a lot from next door, upstairs, andi outside.  The furnishings are kind of cheap and the room not well maintained.  i.e. toilet that is constantly running, chips in corners of furniture, a shower glass door that won't stay shut on its own, uncomfortable sofa bed.  the TV also didn't work in the first room and when I went to the desk to tell them, their immediate respone was it was broken in every room.  Also, about the noise, they said every room is like that.  An experienced person would say sorry first, then explain there was nothing they can do.  they did move me up to a higher floor which felt so much better than the dinky first floor property.

Another bad thing is having to take the golf cart everywhere.  Usually one would come around in 5-7 minutes but a couple of time sit felt like the wait was 15 minutes in the heat and humidity.

The service was inconsistent.  Some of the guys carry themselves with so much swag it almost felt inappropriate.  At breakfast it surprised me at first how mutiiple wait staff can walk past my table multiple times without asking to refill my water or coffee.  Some staff simply didn't smile.  Don't they know a simple smile could go a long way for them?  I'm sorry to say that this will probably be our last trip to the dominican as Cancun has it pat down for service.

the UGLY:
Nothing.  Everyone was beautiful.

reviews.author: Sam T
reviews.title: Honeymoon - The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at The Reserve section at Paradisus Punta Cana. Overall for what we payed (also got $200 off just for singing up for the Melia rewards), it was absolutely a more than fair price for what you're getting: gorgeous beach property, pools, unlimited alcohol/food. 

However, the food was consistently pretty bad, and slightly tainted the whole week for my wife and I. We like to cook and genuinely appreciate good food. We never looked forward to a meal. (Side note: Passion was oddly one of the most amazing restaurants I've ever been to - but you have to pay or it, so I'm not factoring it). 

The service was hit and miss. Our concierge and lobby service was great, and bar service was good. The service at the buffets and restaurants always seemed to be annoying (difficult to get drinks, different people checking on your table etc). Also, our dinner reservations got screwed up multiple times...

Overall it was more than fair for the price, however this place is kind of a quantity over quality type deal. I wish I would have spent more money for a smaller resort with better food and drinks. We will not be returning.

reviews.author: Joey C
reviews.title: Beautiful environment & OK experience
reviews.text:
This place is beautiful but I wouldn't return. I'm not a picky person either so if you're reading this, do your homework. I wouldn't do a single excursion - they literally just take you places to sell to you, and then when you don't buy mamajuana from them, they get hostile and pissed. 

Also, prepare for the beach (aka the used car lot) - The second you leave your beach chair, and start walking to the ocean, prepare yourself for 5-10 locals bombarding you with our favorite phrase, "Parasailing, Banaboat, Mamajuana, Scuba, Cigars..." At first it was tolerable, but by the 6th day I was literally on the verge of snapping. 

Food was okay, but nothing to write home about. Overall, I wouldn't rate this any higher than 3 stars. Anybody who does, simply hasn't had a 4 or 5 star experience.

reviews.author: 782candacea
reviews.title: No satisfied
reviews.text: The empolyees at this resort need to be trained in customer service. They need to learn how to be hospitable to everyone equally. I did not enjoy being stared at or talked about right in my face. I sure did not enjoy that everytime I came on the resort the security would stare me down and follow me until he saw my wrist band. He could of just simply asked to see it. I didnt like that it was a hassel to call  a cab for me when I wantedto leave the property. I also didnt like that when I wenf in to the buffet other people (races) were asked if they would like anything to drink and the wait staff would just keep walking by me even after I signaled to them several times.

reviews.author: Rickz07
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text:
The Reserve section of the hotel is well appointed. The pool area looks great, its not over-crowded; the rooms are nicely appointed, and the staff is trained to be polite and kind. The beach earns very,very high marks. However: 

1. The food is not particularly good. They don't cheap out, you get steak and lobster, they just don't taste good.
2. The food is highly repetitive. Especially breakfast, which WILL tire you after 2 days.
3. These wine is very bad. In a world where cheap, good wine is omnipresent, having  to pay US$35.00 for a good glass of wine at dinner is ridiculous.
4. The multiple layers of "classes" available make you feel like a second class guest.
5. The in-house restaurants were underwhelming. I can cook better. I ate at Vento and Mole. Just terrible.
6. The kid's zone seemed highly unprofessional; I went with my daughter and stayed for an hour. Bunch of kids crying, and the staff giving toddlers popcorn to quiet them... 
7. The staff is polite but seemingly uninterested in customer satisfaction. I would frequently wait 30-40 minutes for a drink or grill service at the pool.

If you're willing to spend this kind of money, go to Iberostar Grand, Nickelodeon, Hard Rock, or AlSol. I would skip this resort.

reviews.author: Cathy J
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and beach with some flaws
reviews.text: Beautiful rooms, landscaping, pools, & beach. The restaurants were horrible and we got sick at Mole. We ended up sticking to the buffet at the reserve & had fresh lobster, shrimp & fish every night. small menu but we were happy w those 3 choices. The drinks were a major problem. They use synthetic sugary flavored mixes & I couldn't find a single good drink.The staff is amazing! We LOVED the entire staff at the reserve buffet: Luis, Angolina Rosario Cruz (HARDEST worker in the entire resort), Mr Drinky Drinky Emilio, Junior (best mojitos), Yyurandi Bautista (reception desk) and Sandra Cedro (concierge) who showed us around 1st few days. Rooms cleaned & minibar stocked daily. The language barrier was a HUGE issue. 10x better if u speak Spanish. My 9yr old son was bored every day. The major reason I gave a low score. We were forced to buy expensive excursions to have something to do. He did kids club 1 day and he didn't want to go back. smaller kids (under 6yr) would enjoy it. This resort had NOTHING going on IN the pool. No pool volleyball or IN pool games etc. NO problems getting shaded seats at the reserve. Impossible (even a sunny one) at the regular pool (there aren't enough!). Only sun chairs at the beach. The beach is beautiful but we were eaten alive by bugs (30perleg). NO boogie boards or non motorized equip. shuttle buses were the WORST. We were constantly waiting! Night shows were really bad.Only reccmnd this resort to people who want to lay by pool n do nothing.

reviews.author: SusanLLyons
reviews.title: Not What We Were Hoping For
reviews.text:
Oh boy, where to start. This was a family trip - 4 adults and 3 kids. 

We stayed at the Reserve and in hindsight I'm not sure why. If it was supposed to be higher end, I'd hate to see the 'regular' rooms.

We were in the Family Concierge building but when we asked the family concierge to make a few dinner reservations for us we were told we didn't have that package.

That was a common, recurring theme for our entire stay that became like a long-running joke...

"Can we [insert activity or request here]?"
"Sorry, you don't have that package."

I felt like I was in that episode of Modern Family where they go to Las Vegas and Jay thinks he has the all-access "Excelsior" package but everything he asks for is on another Excelsior package.

Sorry, that's reserved for Excelsior PLUS members.
Sorry, that's reserved for Excelsior ULTRA members.
Sorry, that's reserved for Excelsior PLATINUM members.

The rooms don't smell very good and are in need of updating.

The chair legs could use some caps so we don't hear the chairs in all the rooms around us being dragged across marble.

The food in the buffets was OK. Not great. (Hard to believe there is no grapefruit juice on the entire resort.)

The restaurants are pretty good but make sure you get a concierge that will get you priority bookings or you'll end up eating at 6pm every night.

We missed a few dinners because the excursions don't even get back that soon.

The pools are FILTHY. We saw other guests just pouring their drinks in the pool and the build up of suntan oil, leaves, trash and cups is disgusting.

We tried to go to the adults only pool but... we didn't have that package.

The service is OK. The pool and beach waiters must take a siesta every afternoon because there's a solid 2 hour stretch in the afternoon where they're nowhere to be found.

No activities for kids that we could find other than a blow up water obstacle course they put in the pool every day.

The highlight of the trip was dinner at Passion by Martín Berasategui. Excellent food and service. 

Overall really disappointing. We won't be back.

reviews.author: Papa1967
reviews.title: Bad Hotel Management
reviews.text:
First of all I stayed at the resort with my wife and 9 year old son for a week in August. Myself and my family had a great time we had a master one bedroom garden room, I would highly recommend this room type it was like a one bedroom apartment.
We brought our best friends who are older and he has some health issues. So the problem that occurred for them started within the first hour of getting to there room! There AC didn't  work and there room ran a average of 80-85 degrees in there room! So they called the front desk and the front desk sent maintenance and the maintenance said ok all fixed well that was not the case! The calling and having no Ac went on for 3 Days!! I went with my friend finally and Franklin who is from club Melia ( who by the way was the only person that tried to help my friends) Franklin went in the back of the front desk and went and got the General Manager who came out and sat with us 3 as we explained everything that has occurred and there has been at least 6 maintenance man come into there room and they all have said they fixed it but it's still in the 80's in the room and the maintenance department even said at one time blamed my buddy in saying they must be leaving the balcony door open! So as we explaned to the General Manager ( I believe his name was Domingo) he was writing everything down and said to us I have another room for you but it will not be vacated until 12 and it should be ready by 1 pm! The general manager asked my buddy how can I get a hold of u and that he would personally call him when it ready! So my buddy gave him his cell phone number and the general manager said He would see to it that they got a new room so they can start to enjoy there vacation! So we felt good after we thought someone is going to help and finally move them to a room ! Well let me to tell you this is where the POOR Management happened !! So my buddy and I hung out at the pool that day so when we get the phone call the room is ready we can go move him to a new cool room!!! Needless to say our conversation with the General Manager went no further than as Only as a conversation !!!  We never heard from him again!!!! He Never called my buddy or text him or even got him another room!!!! This is the sad part!!!! So by 4 o'clock this is when my wife had enough!! She went to the front desk with her girlfriend and said could u tell us what is going on with there room ??? The response was we don,t know what your talking about it says by the maintenance department that there Ac is working!! Well my wife asked isn't there any notes from the General Manager about getting a new room?? The front desk worker said NO!!!! Well then my wife lost it!!! They got another manager a lady one( to verify management we talked to the General Manager at 930 am and the ladies talked to the female manager around 415 pm on Sunday July 31st) So the female manager sat with my wife and her girlfriend and my wife laid it all out demanding a new room and to for them to move right then!!  So finally they did get moved and they where able to finally start to enjoy there vacation after not being able to sleep for 3 days because of the room was so hot!! The sad part of this whole story is that my friends who r older and he has a bad heart and has a pacemaker where never contacted by any hotel management !!! There was no follow up or not even a Sorry or even a token of apology from any management!! So because of the lack of customer service by the top of the hotel management I would not recommend this hotel to anyone!! That's really bother some to me because the hotel is beautiful !

reviews.author: Dino2224
reviews.title: Molto bello ma con qualche riserva
reviews.text:
Posto stupendo con una spiaggia favolosa anche se il mare non è sempre trasparente in questa stagione. Con il Royal service, raccomandabile anche se più caro rispetto alle altre sistemazioni, si può accedere a una spiaggia riservata curatissima con palme e con ombrelloni molto distanziati tra di loro e dotati di lettini ampi e comodi. Il servizio in spiaggia e' di alto livello con bevande e snack a volontà. Il Royal service offre anche un maggiordomo che si occupa delle varie incombenze, una lounge riservata, una piscina specifica e soprattutto l'accesso al ristorante Palazzo ottimo per qualità e servizio. Insomma un vero Paradiso, senza confusione e rumori, a differenza di quanto avviene un po' nelle altri parti del resort. Bellissima la spa e molto ben tenuti i giardini. Le cose che non vanno sono nelle camere che, pur molto grandi, hanno il problema della smagnetizzazione frequentissima delle chiavi e soprattutto del climatizzatore molto rumoroso che in ogni caso va tenuto in funzione per il caldo umido notturno. A questo proposito la cosa gravissima che ci è capitata e' stata quando abbiamo dovuto cambiare stanza a tarda sera per un upgrade. Nella nuova suite, evidentemente non abitata da tempo e con un condizionatore non ben funzionante, abbiamo passato una nottata terribile perché la condensa di cui non ci eravamo resi conto all'inizio e' aumentata nella notte tanto che al mattino presto hanno iniziato a piovere gocce dal soffitto e l'umidità ha impregnato i nostri vestiti e soprattutto noi. Alle nostre pesanti lamentele, la prima reazione del personale e' stata di stizzita contestazione. Quando abbiamo alzato la voce (anche considerata la cifra da noi spesa), ci è stata di nuovo cambiata la sistemazione finalmente senza altri problemi e con il Royal Service. L'ultima considerazione negativa riguarda il personale alla reception non particolarmente cortese e attento.
In conclusione il Palma Real è solo potenzialmente da 5 stelle agli occhi di noi italiani (non ce ne erano altri oltre a noi) ma in realtà secondo me va bene solo per una certa clientela locale e per certi statunitensi con pacchetti speciali.

reviews.author: Sandy H
reviews.title: Large family trip
reviews.text: Everyone (15 people, 6 families) had a great time - the pool and beach are a lot of fun. As others have mentioned, the prime pool chairs are always taken (i.e., people put towels or other items on them) by early early morning. There are plenty of beach chairs. The rooms themselves need an update given the "luxury" level of the hotel.

reviews.author: ValMiles
reviews.title: Nice Grounds and Beach, Food and Service are Not Enjoable
reviews.text:
Short Summary:

Paridisus Palma Real is a nice resort in a beautiful location, but food, service and entertainment are severely lacking. On the scale of 1 (worst) to 10 (best), we would give:

•	Resort Grounds – 9
•	Beach – 9
•	Room – 8
•	Food – 3
•	Service – 2
•	Entertainment – 3

Read on for details:

We visited Paridisus Palma Real in July of 2016 and it was our first visit to this chain and to Dominican Republic.  We have stayed in many top-notch all-inclusive resorts in Mexico from Cancun to Rivera Maya, from Cabos and Puerto Vallarta.  So, we had an idea what good food and service look like.  We had a good time, after all it was a vacation, but would not return to this resort.  Not sure if we would came back to Dominican Republic.

First, the grounds of Paridisus Palma Real are absolutely beautiful.  At night, the main atrium of the resort is lit up in different colors and is absolutely gorgeous.  The beach is not far away from the resort and except for many sea weeds floating around, the shoreline is very gradual water is warm and pleasant to swim.  If you take a boat (can go on a snorkeling trip) about 5 minutes out to the ocean, the water is astonishingly clear and there is a lot of small fish.  We took a sailboat (catamaran) (free of charge) from the shore to the snorkeling spot just to enjoy the crystal clear water all around there.

The rooms are decent, although in need of a little facelift in some places.  But overall they were spacious and nice.  We had two adults and two kids and we all fit just fine.  Our friends stayed at the Reserva (an upscale area of the resort).  Their room was simply stunning.  But Reserve is further inland and lacks the fresh breeze we had in the main part of the resort.  Also, there is not much to do there, so our friends spent most of the time at the main resort.

Now to less flattering part of our trip.  The service for the most part was severely lacking.  Most employees did not speak any English, I mean none.  Those that did seem to lack any sort of idea what service means.  Few examples:

1.	We walked into the buffet in the morning for breakfast, sat down at a table and went to get food inside.  Shortly thereafter a waiter came and asked what we wanted to drink.  I asked for hot tea.  He returned in 10 minutes, brought an empty cup and a tea bag, but no water.  He left and we have not seen him or anyone else serving our table until we left.  Needless to say, I did not have a tea that morning.

2.	We bought a sail boat lesson.  The instructor did not speak any English, so the lesson was more of a pantomime show than useful.  While we were sailing, we came across an overturned sail boat with another tourist being pulled out of water by a motor boat.  The instructor leaped out of our boat onto the sinking boat to save it, leaving two of us alone without any sail experience to fend for ourselves.  Since I’m writing this review, we did make it ashore after about 10 days at sea.  Just kidding, we managed to control the boat, it wasn’t that hard.  But the so called lesson that we paid for and instructor leaving us alone at sea was a topic of jokes at a dinner table later that night.

3.	When I asked a cook at the buffet whether the meat on the grill was beef, he didn’t understand what I was asking or didn’t care to respond, was just looking at me like I was asking him to borrow his kidney for few minutes.
Peculiar intersection of service and food was when we had to make reservations for dinner.  Their system may be tried and true, in other words ancient, but it was a source of constant frustration.  One awful example was our friends making a reservation two days in advance for a Japanese restaurant. The resort would not confirm the reservation until the evening of the dinner.  Our friend had to walk to the lobby 3 times in 2 days to make sure we had the reservation confirmed.  After it was confirmed, as we were leaving our rooms heading to the restaurant, she gets a call that the reservation was not confirmed.  At that point, she let them have it and we were back on the guest list after all.

Food was there, the selection seemed to be good, but most things tasted awful.  Undercooked eggs, breakfast sausages tasted like cotton (perhaps were heated and reheated too many times).  While the quantity and selection of food wasn’t something we could complain about, but the quality just wasn’t there. On past trips to all-inclusive resorts, we actually looked forward to having a dinner to see what nice surprise that brings.  None of the restaurants that we visited had beef that was eatable, even at the steak house.  Fish was marginally better.  In the last two days of vacation, my 11-year old and I have developed diarrhea that persisted for 4 days.  I was certainly careful washing my hands and not drinking water from faucets.  So, this was probably a food-borne issue.

Overall, the service was lacking, at restaurants, on the resort grounds and at the beach.  To compare and contrast, when we stayed at Palace resort in Mexico, right by the beach, we had someone constantly asking if we wanted a drink or food.  At Paridisus Palma Real, there were days when we didn’t see anyone, other days, we felt lucky to get couple of drinks one time that day.

Entertainment was scheduled and there, but we didn’t particular enjoy most of the shows.  By contrast, many resorts in Mexico had excellent entertainment at night that kept our kids and us at the edge of our seats.

reviews.author: Alexandra S
reviews.title: 15jours en famille
reviews.text: Le site est très beau. Les chambre à la réserve sont grandes et agréables  mais le Menage tres mal fait. Les serviettes de toilettes sont tachées ce qui ne devrait pas être dans un 5*. La kids zone est très jolie mais le personnel pas du tout attentif sauf si vos enfants sont grand et autonomes. Le système de réservation des restaurants du soir est à revoir. Très belles piscine et belles plage. Le service dépend de votre "statut dans l hôtel" ce qui n est pas agréable.

reviews.author: Yuri S
reviews.title: Falta de servicio
reviews.text: Debe mejorar el servicio, las instalaciones no tienen buena higiene, las habitaciones (5) tenían dañado el teléfono y no se podía solicitar servicios, los baños de las mismas se veían sucios, el restaurante que mas visitamos fue el Gavi, el servicio muy pobre al igual que las opciones del menu

reviews.author: fernanleandryr
reviews.title: Deben renovar los espacios y lograr una mayor proporción entre el precio y la calidad que ofrecen.
reviews.text: He tenido la experiencia de estar en los hoteles Paradisus Punta Cana y Paradisus Palma Real de Meliá Hotels. Este último fue en el que me quedé en mi última estadía el cual es un poco más caro que el primero, pero de una calidad inferior. El Palma Real me dio una habitación que no estaba renovada, con un olor desagradable a humedad. La habitación tiene un aspecto desagradable, oscura, no está a la altura del precio. A pesar de que tenía un upgrade que me habían dado en una visita anterior al Paradisus, tuve que quedarme en esta habitación toda una noche porque nadie fue capaz de tomar la decisión de darme el upgrade inmediatamente, debían esperar a que algún director viniera al otro día (eso no puede ser posible). Ya, de por sí, mudarnos de habitación fue una tragedia, empacar las cosas, volver al check in para el cambio, sobre todo cuando la estadía iba a ser breve. Al llegar a nuestra habitación "renovada", nos damos cuenta que la diferencia era que los muebles oscuros fueron pintados de blanco y que las bolsas plásticas de lavandería fueron cambiadas por bolsas de tela que decían "Royal Service". La verdad lo único interesante de esta habitación era la vista parcial al mar y que era más clara por la pintura blanca en las paredes, pero nada que ver con las habitaciones de otros hoteles que ofrecen tarifas similares. Creo que deben mejorar mucho en cuanto a habitaciones y algunos espacios que no han sido renovados desde que el hotel empezó a operar.

reviews.author: Supermom1
reviews.title: Wouldn't return
reviews.text:
We vacationed here in May as part of a 12 group party. We upgraded to royal service. Honestly I was not impressed with this resort. Here are my thoughts divided into pros and cons:

Pros:
Nice rooms in the royal service buildings. Although we had ocean view, it was too far back to really see the ocean. More of garden view. 

Butlers were nice but really didn't provide anything I really needed. Overblown amenity in my opinion. 

Royal service pool was nice with cabanas and clean, quiet pool. 

Palazzo restaurant was delicious for breakfast lunch and dinner. 

Cons:
Felt that this resort had party atmosphere when we left the Royal service side. 

Waded into regular pool and felt that it was just nasty with paper cups left everywhere, many with cigarette butts. Gross. Many had blown back into pools. 

Food in every restaurant was essentially inedible. Especially in the steakhouse rare. What they called a ribeye,  we would call strip steak in the states. Thin cuts of tough beef.

Wait time at restaurants for food and service was 3-4 hours for our large party (12), even when restaurants were empty.

Royal service was the only reason i gave this place 3 stars. Food at palazzo was fantastic as was service-however the Royal service bar was located too far away from beach to access premium liquors from the beach. So we paid for upgraded alcohol but really just got drinks from the Royal service beach bar which served mediocre brands. 

The entertainment team tried hard but the nightlife was just bland. 

Would never return to this resort or recommend it to any of my friends. Unsure how it achieved a travelers choice award from TA.

reviews.author: Lara T
reviews.title: Over priced
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort.  Well maintained.  Nicest we saw.  However almost impossible to get reservations at restaurants.  Evening entertainment was mediocre.  Ex: The Lion King play was lip sync.  Main restaurant was difficult to find tables and often dirty.  Kids activities were sparse.  Rock wall available on certain days and only for an hour or so.  Same with trampoline.  Kids not allowed in painting classes by the beach.  Adults must get there 30 min ahead to get one of 10 spots avail for entire resort.  If dropping small kids at Kids Zone it is fine but kids 8-15 not interested in what was available 
Tipping is expected!!!

reviews.author: 90Central
reviews.title: WARNING-Very average for premium cost
reviews.text:
First of all, Luis Rosario & Julio Castro at the Avenue Bar are THE ABSOLUTE BEST! Fun, personable and skilled, had the best time here.  Additionally, Francisco in the Royal Service pool/beach area provided EXCELLENT service!  

Now, my experience at the Palma Real was a bit disappointing.  We stayed in a Royal Service suite, and this property needs a lot of TLC.  Lots of patchwork visible in many areas and the property is either very old or just not being maintained very well.  The room was okay, not luxury accommodations as described.  Oddly, the king bed actually was two double beds somehow put together which provided a weird sleeping/sitting surface.  The biggest issue was small but glaring -- for two days we did not have wash/face cloths.  We asked repeatedly and only after several attempts did we receive.  This occurred daily.
