Also, there were points that we had ONE towel and/or hand towel and had to call front desk to request these as well.  As a "general" OR Royal Service client (upgrade, additional cost) I can say that I expected a much higher quality, premium service.  The general staff was somewhat friendly but didn't seem interested in making special efforts to communicate with us as non-Spanish speaking visitors.  With all the other options available, I just do not see any point in considering this resort as an option when in the Dominican Republic in the future.  Another point of contention -- making reservations at the property restaurants was a hassle and just weird for an all-inclusive resort.  In most cases, you could find many empty tables in the various restaurants at key times so it was an aggravating process- for what purpose??  Finally, this may be information for the Costco our travel agency but the transportation arranged from the airport to the facility delivered us to the wrong property.  After some haggling and time, we were provided with a taxi (cost comped) to the Paradisus Palma Real but some advice -- DO NOT get off that shuttle if you are not at the correct place! One other family on our same shuttle waited more than TWO HOURS to get to the correct hotel!  Proceed with caution.

reviews.author: mannic777
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful, gorgeous beach, nice pools, nice rooms at the reserve, but the food is terrible to mediocre.  Also it's a little insulting to be an called all inclusive yet there are up charges for many food/drink options.  Passions, the restaurant that is not included but costs $60 p/p and wine is not included additional charge, is not very good either.  We were hoping for at least one good dinner.  We had a family concierge diosmary who wasn't all that helpful, then disappeared towards the end and we were reassigned Elaine who was great but only had her the last 2 days.  They say they'll give you a cell phone but you may have to wait a couple days until they're available.  We paid $10,000+ for 4 adults and 2/21 mo olds including airfare (no charge for lap babies) for 7 nights and it was not worth it.  We have had much nicer trips to the Dominican for less.  Some employees are great but overall service is inconsistent and often very slow.  We are really easy going people who have tons of experience in the service industry, and we were very disappointed.  Mini fridge is not always restocked well.  The buffets are fine for breakfast/lunch but understaffed and fish is always undercooked (not referring to sushi, which is one of the more palatable items they serve).  We made the best if the trip but wouldn't recommend.  Also drinks in pool are served in paper cups which get littered about.  For a place that claims to be Eco-friendly, they should invest in reusable plastic.

reviews.author: flaxenk123
reviews.title: Pretty disappointed
reviews.text:
We are still here on our 4th day of a 7 day vacation. I never leave reviews but just had to because I'm so disappointed. This is our 5th stay in Punta Cana. We decided to pay extra this time to stay at the reserve. NOT WORTH IT. This is a 3 star resort. This might seem trivial but when you're paying extra you expect extra special service. 
- there is an activity schedule. 2 days in, none of the activities are actually happening that are on the schedule. Finally, someone says "oh no, this is an old schedule". "I will bring you the right schedule". No one ever came back! Found a newer schedule... Still not happening. 
- sitting on the beach. If you ask for a drink you may or not get one. "Give me 10 min." About half the time someone comes back. 
-building concierge. We were told reservations for dinner would be in our rooms by 3:30. No reservations. Went to ask three times. No one there. Finally given reservations and only three are scheduled (suppose to have 4). "We will put in 4th one in your room tomorrow". Tomorrow.... no reservations. Had to hunt them down again.

It's a beautiful property. The cheapest Reserve Suite is quite spacious for 2 people and laid out as a two-room condo style with a bathroom.  The food is just average.  I have been told no one too many times.  The staff are polite but many are ineffectual.  I wouldn't recommend paying the extra for the Reserve or for the Paradisus in general. You can find as nice a property for 2/3 the price ..

reviews.author: bernardinoo598
reviews.title: Undecided on visiting again
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful but the all around experience was kind of a blah. Wasnt too great, as i was here 5 yrs ago and the experience was much better. The club opened till about 4am and it allowed us to really enjoy ourselves. The mini bars in the room could have been filled with things a bit more enjoyable. Also the beach chairs outside were all in use and if not, they were really messy.

reviews.author: FLmom19
reviews.title: Beautiful with problems
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful! Our room was just like the pictures. The pools, bars, restaurants are all wonderful. Here is the but...make sure you have resturant reservations before you arrive. We were told all the restaurants were booked & after speaking with 3 different people finally reservations were given to us. Their is a language barrier if you don't speak Spanish but everyone is very nice & helpful. Make sure you get a towel at the pool early! After a while they run out and forget about getting a new one later in the day. On the positive- the food is delicious. Alcohol that is included is great & nighly activities make this a great family resort.

reviews.author: alaingD9624JD
reviews.title: Not all that.
reviews.text: Overall is a good hotel but should give a little extra effort to attend guests. Reservations for restaurants is very bad managed and service in restaurants is not great. Food quality is very good. Service in restaurants is not that great either.

reviews.author: Alesarasino
reviews.title: Great Beach, average hotel
reviews.text: If you stayed at the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, do not expect the same quality of hotel, food and service at the one in Punta Cana. I do have to say the beach is amazing and the service was outstanding. Great place to go with family.

reviews.author: Lorenzo S
reviews.title: Melia Reward - Big lie!
reviews.text: I have nothing to complaint the resort. But I want to alert you about the Melia Rewards, which plays everything grey, there is nothing clear on it. First of all, you will never get an upgrade on your room doing the online check in. They offer this because they know the employees will tell you there is no avaiable room. But if want you have the option to pay for an upgrade, funny hum? Second is about the resort credit, you just learn how it works when you receive it. It is a BIG lie. You wont gain anything, you have to pay for each service and the resort credit is going to work as a discount! The point is that instead of doing my reserve through hoteis.com as usual where I gain points to change in free nigths (which really works) I did my reserve with Melia, so I ended up losing two times!! Melia? NEVER AGAIN!!

reviews.author: rolandlinda1
reviews.title: Large resort; Good Golf Course on Site; Good Food
reviews.text:
This is a very a large resort so its very difficult to get personalize service.  Overall the staff was friendly.  Make sure that you make dinner reservation as soon as you get to the resort.  If they say that they are booked I recommend that you make a personal visit to the hostess at the restaurant to see if they can accommodate you. Overall the property has very good food and good drinks.  

The property has several pools and a very nice beach.  

The property also has a Michelm rated restaurant on the property that is a "private restaurant" and is not part of the all inclusive.  The rate per person is $70 plus beverages.  The food is exquisite but you can easily run up a $200 tab with wine and tips.  Overall is a special experience and if you can afford it you should try it.  We celebrated my wife's birthday here and it was worth the price.    

Unfortunately the property has a water treatment plant near the property and depending which way the wind is blowing that you may get a unpleasant smell.

reviews.author: Laura M
reviews.title: Honeymoon trip, good, not great
reviews.text:
This place is overrated. It's not a great as everyone says. Rooms are outdated, food is ok. Some of the service people are very nice, others seem to care less about helping. Checked in a day late due for canceled flight and still had to wait for our room to be ready. No information given at all at front desk. You must ask lots of questions to get any information, they will not tell you anything! 

Luckily I speak Spanish, as otherwise could be difficult to communicate. Beach is beautiful! Drinks are weak, unless you ask for stronger ones. It poured one night and it leaked all over our bed, we had to change rooms at 3am! It seemed that we were inconveniencing them! TV and many lights in new room don't work. Super loud fan that can't be turned off. 

Impossible to reach front desk by phone, in states or here in the room. Food is ok at most places, blue agave is a sad claim to be Mexican food, don't even bother. Fuego is the best. 

Not the best, not the worst. Don't expect spectacular service. Even when tipping everyone. We've experienced much better and will not choose to come back here.

reviews.author: valetic
reviews.title: Alot of potential
reviews.text: this hotel is looks amazing! Most of the staff is nice with exception of check in. In my opinion the staff at check in is rude. Dinner is also challenging as it is all inclusive but you are REQUIRED TO MAKE RESERVATION at restaurants and MOST of the time they are booked, so you got to plan ahead of time spend about a few hours waiting in line to get reservations.  Some of the reservations staff make a lot of excuses before even looking they tell you the system is down or to come back later.  the wait staff at some restaurants are great, however some they assume they won't get tips so they don't even make an attempt to give you that quality of service. BASICALLY CARRY SOME CASH BECAUSE EVEN THOUGHT THIS IS ALL INCLUSIVE AND TIPS ARE "OPTIONAL" THE MORE YOU TIP THE BETTER SERVICE YOU GET.... SAD BUT TRUE... I WISH THEY WOULD MAKE TIPS NOT ALLOWED. LOL

reviews.author: Jeff G
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text:
Just wrapping up trip here this week 
Very mixed of a few things
Communicating with people in DR is a challenge
The resort did an awful job checking us in and overall did not make us feel welcome at their property
The friendliest people were the waiters at the pool and  but most seemed to care less
The chairs at the pool are very uncomfortable and many need to be replaced
The pool is nice but 5 feet deep everywhere which make it tough for some of the kids
I felt the rooms needed a facelift as well
The shower was terrible with poor water pressure
They are constantly trying to sell you excursions which gets annoying

The food was very good overall and the property is very nice
It's not too big like other resorts we have been to
The beach is nice but there is seaweed 

Overall the service at the front desk and concierge is poor, property is nice and food was good
Would definitely not come back here or to DR in general

reviews.author: Amo2020
reviews.title: hotel bonito com serviço ruim
reviews.text:
Estive com a minha familia por 3 dias nesse hotel. 
O lugar é muito bonito,nas areas sociais, tem mobiliários incríveis, mas os quartos são feios e escuros ( visitei vários)
Escolhemos uma das melhores categorias, que nos deu uma pulseira especial e tudo mais. Sinceramente, não valeu a pena. Quando a tal concierge percebeu que não compraríamos o time sharing que eles oferecem, ela desapareceu. O lugar da praia onde ficamos era realmente mais bacana. O clube náutico desorganizado,
A comida era muito boa, uma qualidade do hotel,
Reservamos restaurantes todas as noites, e nunca achavam a nossa reserva.
Entrava no quarto as 16:00 e ainda estava desarrumado.
Enfim, achei muito amadores para um hotel 5 estrelas com as tarifas altíssimas que pagamos.

reviews.author: Lul308
reviews.title: Just average
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Punta Cana and Meliá hotels since 1994. I have to say this has been average and never had so many disappointing experiences though compensated with the good ones.

First of all, the safety box was not working.  We called guest services and after insisting for a second time, they sent us a technician who said a piece was pending and fixed it.  After that, we had to wait for a security person to reprogram "in five minutes" who never arrived. And never arrived the following day either. Finally, we decided to stay without the safety box during all the trip. 

In addition, the air extractor in the bathroom was not working. We never received hand towels until the second day. It looks Francisca was doing her best juggling and finding towels for us. 

Infrastructure has improved since our last trip four years ago.  Food is better though you can qualify it as standard only. 

Service at restaurants with reservations is good but be prepared to be patient. Our first visit to Rare restaurant was with a 9pm reservation and we arrived and announced ourselves 10 minutes earlier.   We were seated at 9:18 only after insisting.  Order was taken at 9:35 and were told they were out of ribs (they said their specialty).  The appetizers were served at 9:52 and the main course at 10:25. My tuna, which I asked rare, came completely cooked.  We never asked for dessert. 

In Vento with a reservation at 9, things improved and we were seated at 9:16,,food was served faster. 

Service at Mizu and Olio were super b, and I could say the same from Naos, the bars and the people in the beach. 

We are part of the Vacations club and considered it a good investment before we had kids and because we liked the country. As usual, they were chasing us to attend a presentation "with the new advantages for the members". We went because the guy insisted and we finished in other meeting were no information was received but they were trying to make us sign for an upgrade in our contract. Financially, they were trying to make us pay the maintenance in advance (although it was said in other way and for some people it could sound advantageous)  but from our point of view, there was no additional value.  So I had to basically show him why this was not a good choice for us and we were released in 40 mins. A record!

Something I did not like and for this I would blame the hotel completely for lack of control.  They have inside the hotel the Scuba Dive service. The sales guys are walking around in the beach area selling products. As I considered them authorized by the hotel (they approached me when I was sitting in the beach area of the hotel) I decided to buy them the speed boat. When they picked up and took us to the starting point, we found it was the informal services outside  the hotel, exactly the ones I always ignore. 

Unfortunately, all of these experiences, reminded me why I should never trust anybody in this area of Punta Cana and why in the last ten years, I have only stayed at the hotel.   

I will go again to Paradisus next time again as I like the hotel and the area, but will remember not to buy anything outside and will be mentally prepared to a lower level of service when compared with other international brands.

reviews.author: genilda2019
reviews.title: Paraíso incrível
reviews.text: O hotel é maravilhoso, com uma vista incrível e muito completo. O atendimento, infelizmente, varia muito de acordo com a gorjeta oferecida e com a cara do hospede. Várias situações nosso atendimento foi preterido, não em função da cor da pulseira, pois isso já era esperado, mas em função de algo alem disso. A experiência de ser preterido, em um hotel magnífico, quando estamos aproveitando as férias em família, é péssimo.

reviews.author: HappyHoliday73
reviews.title: Pretty Lobby, Good Service, Overall just 'Okay'
reviews.text:
This is our second trip to PC - first at Paradisus.  This is defined as an 'Ultra Luxury' resort in the Melia family.  Not sure what their luxury rating scale is based on; this is neither Luxury or Ultra Luxury - to this end, I find it odd that they were asking folks to put their reviews on Trip Advisor upon leaving, as everyone we talked to had issues.  To summarize, this resort hangs its 'luxury emphasis' around it's lobby and the 'Reserve'/'Royal Service' extras, drives all activities from the pool and caters to conventions/business; unfortunately, you can't vacation/sleep in the lobby; while a pool is nice, I am sure you can find one near your home; and the conventions just overrun the property, including reservations, restaurants, beach chairs, facilities, etc - not much fun when you are here to forget work.  

Beach - We vacation at the beach.  The sand and palapas are fine (you'll have to slip the guys in yellow a $10 to help you reserve chairs); the water is terrible.  Little visibility, grass / seaweed overrun the water (this is an ongoing issue), no marine life at all, and while laying out, you'll get used to the constant smell of diesel/gas from the boats going up and down the beach.  The vendors at the water-line, while they can't approach your chair, are constantly attacking you as you simply try to go for a dip; if you don't want to parasail, they have drugs to offer you (so beware for your teenage kids).  Regarding the grass, while a truck comes to clean the grass each day, the resort should take more ownership of the issue and have workers raking the sand so the tides can limit the amount of grass being dragged back in the water.  Also, the grass in the water holds a significant amount of debris (shoes, towels, bottles, etc. - not good when you and your kids put the mask on to see what's underneath the surface).  Beach service is spotty; most of the boys spend time with the lifeguard behind the lifeguard chair bs'ing the entire day with each other.  I found the cabana boys that are working constantly are serving the 'royal service' customers.

Food - While the beach was a negative, the food was a positive.  I will give the resort overall a B+ for food quality, diversity and presentation.  DR Rum is weak, so ask for more in your drinks!

Reservations - Bring pants and closed shoes (men); you'll be overheated, but at least you'll get into a restaurant besides the buffet.  This system needs improvement - you will have to reserve your restaurants each day if you don't pay the butler fee.  When reservations open, they are all sold out, but will do what they can to fit you in.  When you are 'fit in', you'll show up and your reservation will not exist (the communication between workers needs help). On the last night, we finally had our name in the books.  

Conventions - I travel for work and attend a number of conventions.  The hotels we work with section off ball rooms and other locations so as not to intermingle us with the vacationers.  Here, you are integrated - so, all your reservation times disappear when the conventions come in.  There were 3  while we were there.  Everyone in the restaurants and upgraded to better rooms was wearing name tags - while the vacationers were stuck at the buffet.  Worse for me, it reminded me of work - I don't want to see brief cases or suits while here; I am here to forget all that. 

Service - Waiters, cooks, bartenders and show/event servers worked very hard to satisfy your needs - 'A' for these folks.  We speak Spanish, so I am sure that helped a bit here.  I brought $300 cash; most of it was used on tipping.

Melia Representatives - These are the folks in white, hanging around the lobby.  They want you to review the Melia concept for 90 minutes.  They will promise you things.  I wish we had politely declined their assistance in the beginning - it made for some embarrassing situations with our dinner reservations.

Room - 1990's and no privacy in the bathroom.  We had to hang towels up to have our kids not see us while we used the toilet and shower.  Beds are full size.  You have to ask for wash cloths; we never received any.  Towels - 2 max per day.  TV (original flat screen) - I had to fix it and the toilet for both to work.  Fridge contains Bud, Water and Coke; no food or snacks in the room :(.  Turn-down service - 3 of 6 nights.  The noise outside of our room was horrible - golf-carts zipping by at all times and trucks loading.  We were upgraded from a first floor (loading dock area) to second floor closer to the beach; still no better.  All rooms are close to the main building, which is good.

Activities - In 6 days, we were approached by 100's of people selling us stuff - in the hotel, at the pool and on the beach - ugh!!!  We ended up working with Ivan and did the Dolphin Cruiser.  This was a fun park - the sea-lion exhibit was interesting.  The snorkeling was on a dead reef (in fact, all snorkeling you'll do in PC is on a dead reef).  As snorkelers, we were disappointed; the men running the trips need to be educated about conservation (stepping on the corals, etc) - the captain of my boat told me in Spanish everything here is dead, you have to go to the Caribbean side.  Paradisus also runs bus trips to the local mall they helped build; they are trying to build a down-town.  We did not take advantage of any of the other excursions offered.  We did take advantage of the resort shows and nightly entertainment/food on the beach; these were terrific!

Paradisus Palma Real is overall a good resort for food quality, lobby luxury and pool facilities, but falls short at the beach, room accommodations and overall ability to unwind/escape.  I would not go out of my way to stay at another Melia property in the future.  Punta Cana has significantly increased in price since our last visit.  For the money and location, there are other islands that can serve my family vacation and beach needs better.

reviews.author: montejo83
reviews.title: Vacaciones 2016
reviews.text: Una vez mas escogimos este destino porque reune todos los requisitos para unas vacaciones familiares.sus jardines muy bien cuidados,su aroma-terapia hacen del complejo una zona de relax.nuestro mayordomo de cuarto,Hilario,siempre estaba al pendiente de nosotros y de lo que necesitabamos y aunque a veces no contaba con los recursos en sus manos no escatimo en esfuerzos para hacer de nuestra estancia unas vacaciones de lujo. el servicio en la piscina principal fue espectacular gracias a Diogenes,Christian y todo el equipo que cada dia nos delitaban con su buen sentido del humor y su buen servicio.los chicos de la playa en el area de la reserva nos hicieron sentir como principes siempre ofreciendonos lo mejor y muy buenas sugerencias de que tomar y que comer.a la noche los chicos de actividades nos deleitaron con muestras de su cultura y baile contagioso que hicieron de nuestras noches una eterna fiesta.el calido staff del lobby bar Julio Juan Pamela siempre con una sonrisa alegraban nuestra estancia en la barra ofreciendonos deliciosos tragos y una muetra de lo que es el tipico dominicano alegre y servicial. aunque todo nos parecio bueno hay que señalar algunos problemitas:el servicio de las habitacios no fue muy bueno,hubo problemas con la limpieza y con el servicio del cuarto porque las chicas no contaban con el suministro necesario para dejar en cada cuarto y teniamos que esperar muchas veces por toalla y aseo;las habitaciones cuentan con una estructura ya algo vieja asi como los muebles y colchones que ya se sienten que deben ser reemplazados asi como los baños y bañaderas que ya tambien necesitan que se les pase la mano;el servicio de los carritos a veces era demorado especialmente en las noches porque solo tenian 2 carritos que mueven 30 personas para todo un hotel de mas de 3000 personas;la comida de restauranes como el Mole y el Vento no cumplio con nuestras espectativas(muy demorado el servicio y la comida no era de buena calidad);para conseguir una cama en la playa teniamos que madrugar porque no tienen camas suficientes para la cantidad de personas que acoge el hotel tanto en el area de la reserva como el area regular;aunque el staff se esmeraba para brindarnos un servicio del alta calidad muchas veces no contaban con los recursos y eso no les dejaba cumplir con su objetivo de brindar un servicio espectacular.Pese a todo la escala se inclina a lo bueno y el proximo año pensamos repetir y ojala nuestros problemitas no se repitan.

reviews.author: Oscar C
reviews.title: Estuvo ok.
reviews.text: El servicio de Mayordomo es bueno, los tragos ok y el cuarto está bien. La comida está bien si estás en el Royal Service. En la playa nos toco una malísima atención en general a excepción de una barwoman y un el señor Pedro que fue muy amable.

reviews.author: elisa p
reviews.title: Falta de servicio al cliente
reviews.text: Las atenciones no son las mismas ya ! No se siente estar en un area reserve como antes el servicio especial no lo es la entrada al hotel fue tarde y ni si quiera disculpas . Las personas encargadas de la reservas nunca estaba en el area y al otro día no había hecho ninguna y para resolver los supervisores no aparecieron lo que hizo que mis reserva hechas no aparecieron y ni disculpasen . Me sentí que fui a estrenarme

reviews.author: mannymartinez2016
reviews.title: low customer service at the beach area, only great tippers get service.
reviews.text: dirty beach due to lack of maintaince, low service at beach and pool area only great tippers would be served. you need reservation for all the sit down restaurants and they are always booked (but you can negociate a table). my family and I were able to get in for free at The RARE restaurant the meat was too tough, but the taste and service were excellent. besides that, the hotel is very clean, beautiful and the beach is beautiful (if clean).

reviews.author: farmtraveler83
reviews.title: Get a Room Upgrade for Sure
reviews.text:
Came here for a Business Trip, so we did not pick this hotel to stay at.  Overall the grounds of the hotel are very nice, clean and well kept.  The beach is very good and like any large resort, get to the beach early to get the spot you want, otherwise you will be fighting the crowds for a chair with a table or an umbrella.  

Pros:
Beach quality and maintenance; Location excellent as you can walk the beach, housekeeping does a good job.

Food - the food was overall good and the drinks were made with better quality liquor than some of the other all inclusive locations we have stayed.

Cons:
Rooms are DATED - when we first checked in we were taken to a room that was terrible - it looked like it had not been updated since the early 90's  - the tv didn't work in the bedroom or the living room and it was not going to work.  I required we be moved as it was less than acceptable - we were taken to the main building and got a room with a garden view which was much better - this room had been updated and up to my expectations of a resort hotel.  If you are going to stay here - verify the room that you will have in advance.

Staff - the language barrier was terrible in the restaurants - we were charged for a bottle of wine that we didn't want and the hotel would not remove this from our bill.  I thought the service was a little slow compared to other all inclusive a we have stayed.

So, if you want a good beach and good food, this is the location for you; however, if you are looking for more of a room with a view of the ocean, I would recommend other locations.

We will stay at another resort the next time in the Dominican before coming back here again.

reviews.author: John P
reviews.title: Won't be coming back!
reviews.text:
I have to start by saying that I really like a lot of things about this resort.  The proximity to the beach is great, the food is generally good, and our family had a great time here.

The Good
- The location of our room was great, next to Fuego, the Club Melia Private Pool and a stone's throw from the beach
- The food was pretty good... You could find a meal that wasn't great from time to time but this is pretty good for an all inclusive.
- The activities (volleyball, spinning, fitness classes) were pretty good, the kids especially loved Shaky Shaky (staff member) and Francisco (spinning instructor).
- The beach is very nice, the water is generally calm and there wasn't a ton of seaweed this year.
- Fuego is a great place to have a nice relaxing lunch.  (Bartender Victor was great!)
- They did comp us 2 massages for some of our troubles.

The Bad
- We arrived at 2PM and didn't receive our bags until 5PM in our room.  We hoped to get more beach/pool time the first day but I think they misplaced our luggage.
- Building 34 is horrible if you actually want to sleep on vacation.  We were routinely kept up by loud music at Fuego and garbage trucks at 5AM daily. 
- Our room was horribly small for a family of 4.  We are Club Melia members and we've never had a room this small.  When we questioned the size of the room compared to other places that we've been (The Reserve, La Esmerelda & Melia Caribe Tropical) were were just told that's the way it is.  The location of this room was good during the day, but horrible at night.
- The service was not as good as it has been at other Paradisus resorts.  It seems that they are understaffed and that they can't keep tables and dishes clean during the peak hours at the main buffet.  Also, the buffet lines can get very long.
- We never had a complete set of clean towels, we always had to call for them.  This was a bit frustrating.
- We were told that the staff would reserve cabanas for us but we quickly realized that wasn't the case unless you slip someone a $20 bill occasionally.  I had to wait for the staff at 7AM every day to make sure that we had a great spot.  This wasn't too bad since I was up at 5AM due to the garbage trucks.
- We only saw our Club Melia Concierge a couple of times in passing... We've had much better experiences at other resorts.   They sell great service, but you only get that if you are giving people big tips!

The bottom line is that this resort is pretty nice and the food is pretty good as well.  But if we come back here again it will be at The Reserve primarily because of the larger rooms and tranquility.  Like I mentioned before, we are Club Melia members since 2013 and we've been very disappointed.  You get great service and more attention before you join the club.  Once you join you don't get what you are promised without a lot of complaints or by paying off the staff to stock your bar, reserve cabanas, or make you decent drinks.  If they ask you to sit through a Club Melia pitch, kindly decline!

reviews.author: Terry R
reviews.title: JUST OK
reviews.text:
This is my first time writing a review and I decided to do it because in preparation of our trip, I extensively used reviews to help with my decision.  Annually, my family and I (4 people including girls ages 20 & 17)  visit a Caribbean destination even though we live in Florida.  The Caribbean is "just different" than Florida in every way shape and form.  First and foremost, the beach at the resort is absolutely phenomenal.  Not commercialized at all, in fact, it just looked like it should; beautiful blue/green water, soft sand and the coast is lined with extremely tall, thin palm trees constantly swaying in the wind.

The resort itself, in my opinion is not laid out try well.  Tons and tons of walking and waiting for a trolley is a drag and when it finally comes, not everyone can fit on it...so you wait for another.  Furthermore, walking through the resort,trolleys are passing you left and right; some filled with passengers and others not AND not one time did one of them stop and ask us if we wanted to ride!  In addition, there are no sidewalks so you walk in the road and there are TONS of service vehicles on the roads and frankly, I feel it is unsafe.

Many of the reviews talked about people going out of their way to take care of you; we didn't find that.  In fact, in many spots we felt like we were putting people out by asking for coffee, more water, directions, etc.  We even paid more for the Family Concierge services and felt that was a waste of money.  Other than make reservations for us at a few restaurants, they did absolutely nothing.  As far as being on the beach and utilizing this service, it's slow and not request enough.  There is one or two waiters on the beach and it feels like you can go for an hour or more and not see them.This service really was a waste for us.  Outside of laying on the beach and hanging at the pool, there really isn't much do that is convenient OR fun!  

That said, you HAVE to rent dune buggies at Xtreme Buggies.  great guys and a great tour.  You go places on dune buggies you never thought you would!  Yes, you get dirty, muddy, wet but it was a great experience for my girls, learned a lot and saw life outside the resort.  Awesome tour!  We also rented a cab driver for half a day and had him tour us around Higuey and other neighboring towns so we could see how the local live, where kids go to school, etc, etc.  Wasn't expensive, but pedestrian safety is not high on their priority list, LOL.

The trip was OK.  Don't think I would do this one again and this is the first Caribbean trip I have said that about.  It wasn't bad, but maybe my expectations are too high

reviews.author: Carlos R
reviews.title: Paradisus OK not perfect.
reviews.text: Let me Begin by saying that first of all the hotel  room was not given to me till 3:30 due to lack of preparation and the room was very hot the air conditioning takes quite a while to cool up it's not as good as in the states. Aside from that it's a very nice room all rooms appear to be very nice.  The best part of the package is getting the food and beer and free hard liquor if you are interested in that so no need to worry about pulling out your wallet every two or three hours. If you are looking for a beach vacation this is a fantastic place to come. Also it's a beautiful architectural job everything is very relaxing there are plenty of sofas and lounge chairs and Rockers to sit and enjoy the view and rest. Also if you are a cigar connoisseur you will enjoy being able to buy quality Cuban cigars and may I add several different types of tequila that are not sold in the states.  you can also go on adventure trips that are exciting and romantic however I do not advise bringing the children here unless you have a nanny or are willing to drop them off at the daycare while you go off on an adult Adventure.  they are also lots of walking paths to go through and you can feed fish off small communicating Bridges overall I would say it's a very nice place to spend a week if you are looking for a beach and also some Adventures on the side. on a side note I would like to add that you if you are smoke sensitive to cigars and cigarettes this is not the place for you it is not regulated like the United States people actually smoke everywhere.

reviews.author: rer3
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: eh...Paid on points so I wasn't too concerned but I expected much better service for what we spent. It's a beautiful setting. There are some decent excursions but I think I've seen enough of the DR. There are prettier places at better value in the Caribbean. IMHO.

reviews.author: doreenphan139
reviews.title: Family get together
reviews.text: I thought this resort was very beautiful and so did my family, but I have to say when we arrived the first day everything was going well, a hostess showed us around the resort and told us that our room was not ready yet so we went to have lunch which was just ok. The rest of the evening was great, we enjoyed ourselves. The following morning we met up with our hostess and another gentleman, they wanted us to join there club med program but we kindly refused because we just wanted to enjoy ourselves in this inclusive resort. Once we refused there attitudes changed, they pretend that they didn't know us anymore during our stay which I didn't care because I came here to have fun.  Also one evening that our family went to a steakhouse restaurant our waiter asked us do u speak English or Spanish, we told him English and him too had then a attitude problem with us. The best restaurant that we went to was a Latin place called Fuergo, they were so friendly and courteous, we really liked the bartender named Nelson, he made us this special drink which was so delicious and we kept asking for more, he was so cool, we truly had a great time. As for this resort , I would probably not come back to stay , it wasn't what I expected.

reviews.author: lorvananos
reviews.title: If you like to receive a good service this resort is not for you
reviews.text: I am currently staying at this hotel, if you are costumed  to receive a good service in the restaurants this hotel is not for you, the service is terrible , there are a lot of people staying here and they don't have enough employees, this will be my first and last stay on a Melia resort, yesterday a 20 min waiting in line at the buffet for a scramble eggs and another 15 minutes for a coffee, food is just ok beach is very nice rooms are just ok, service on the rooms is a 3 stars, the employees while doing the rooms talking to loud at 8:30 am

reviews.author: DEglo74
reviews.title: Nice Property
reviews.text: The kid club was the best part of the experience , but the overall experience was just above average , staff were great but the food was not up to par to what i expected , we even tried the Passion By Martin Berasategui  and wasn't impressed , would say the food  was the only issue , and the gym was small and the treadmills were old

reviews.author: Thiago C
reviews.title: Estrutura muito boa. Alimentação péssima
reviews.text:
Hotel grandioso como todo grande resort. Quartos relativamente bons, com banheira de hidro inclusive.  Wifi no hotel todo. Vários bares disponibilizando bebida durante todo dia. Cassino no hotel outro ponto positivo.
Porém deixou MUITO a desejar na parte de alimentação, principalmente os restaurantes a la carte. No café da manhã e no almoço, o buffet disponibilizado até que superou nossas expectativas, possuindo boas variedades de comida e com certa qualidade. Porém o que tava muito fraco, foram os a la carte que funcionam de noite. Todos, sem excessão, não conseguem fazer uma comida melhor que um PF de esquina no Brasil. Os pratos são totalmente sem sabor, visivelmente feitos a toque de caixa para dar conta do público. Se soubesse o quão ruim seriam esses restaurantes, decidiríamos por ir apenas no buffet.

reviews.author: Ben M
reviews.title: Good but not great
reviews.text: After reading all of the great reviews on this resort, I was very excited for my stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. The pros: The grounds of this resort are beautiful. The hotel is modern, the pools are huge, and the whole resort is very green; filled with tropical plants. The beach is beautiful and calm with almost no waves. The water itself is super clear and just a joy to swim in. The cons: if you are a stickler on receiving good service, this resort is not for you! The service is almost nonexistent, even with the VIP upgraded package. Most of the workers don't speak english at all and it takes 30-40 minuets to receive your beverage that you ordered at one of the restaurants. The workers are not friendly and they tend to forget orders consistently! Its almost as if you have to serve yourself. Another con is the food! While there is a large variety of foods to pick from, the quality and taste of the food just isn't there. Making reservations for sit-down restaurants also was a drag. The concierge is almost useless as the reservations I made for the week were screwed up for almost everyday. I would come to the restaurant and be told that there was no reservation or that it was cancelled. Due to this, it was hard to enjoy dinners as I was always fighting with the concierge regarding reservations. Overall, I would give this resort a 3 star rating, no more and no less!

reviews.author: Gary G
reviews.title: Second time around ....not good
reviews.text:
Last year we stayed at the Palma real resort and loved everything about it.   The staff and food was amazing.   The resort was well maintained . We loved it so much that we decided to buy time share.   
 
After the meeting they upgraded our services and gave us extra attention.   They really made us feel like a part of the family.  
Fast forward a year.....   We used the free week that they gave us for joining.   They upgraded us to the  paradises .   Here is where everything went down hill.   
   The location was beautiful and so was the amenities .   The beach was relaxing and the food was good.     They wanted us to go to another meeting to see if we may have any other questions about how the time share works.   That was lie #1. This meeting was to try and make us upgrade ( even though we haven't started our time yet).  They explained that it was during a promotional time period and we bought , in not so many words"crap".  The sales person from last year didn't tell us everything.   Even though we were there for five hours.  Lie #2.  They asked us where would we love to take our family on vacation.   We told them "Disney world".  She said great. I will give you another week free at our resort on the Disney property.   That sold us and we signed the papers.   I could give you names of the sales people but I won't.  Apparently they don't have a resort that they can offer in Disney.   
   I will just sum this up.    After we told them to take it back.  The rest of or trip was not fun.   We were judged the whole time.  We didn't have hot water and we had a leak in the ceiling in our bathroom.   We called three or four times and no one came to fix.   A majority of the staff was rude .  
Do not buy time share from MElia.   We should have done more research.    Go online and see all the terrible reviews related to them.    They do not care about you.  They only care about their bottom line and how many rooms they can sell.    They will not give us the time of day.   
   We just came back from another resort on another side of world and we are so upset about the difference between them.  Wish we didn't buy!    STAY AWAY.....SAY NO!

reviews.author: Riana
reviews.title: Marvelous environment average room
reviews.text: The garden is a jewel, you don't want to stop walking. the hotel decoration at the lobby is also nice. The swimming pools for the kids and the adults are great. The entertainment program is ok. The staff is super!!! On the other hand the room was old. There was a leak from the shower making the whole bathroom wet. The bed for my child was not made when we arrived, even though we arrived at 22.00. We had to wait 45' till someone came after calling 3 times. The food was average.

reviews.author: Phi N
reviews.title: Very Disappointment
reviews.text: Resort is very nice,Buffet was excellent,staff is ok. big hassle was check in all guest have to go through this sale pitch for two hours before giving your room keys and that unacceptable. Check in is a little pushy and could be better

reviews.author: coruna1
reviews.title: The Good, the bad and the ugly!
reviews.text:
I have read many reviews and some could be misleading, if you're thinking of staying at this resort please be advise that there are three different levels of service. The first is what they call the basic at Paradisus Palma Real even if you book an upgraded suite the service and restaurant options will be the same.  This is what I have booked thru melia.com our suite was in building 35 furthest from the beach, be prepare to walk an average of 4 miles per day back and forth in the property.  So many people complaint about dinner reservations and with reason, we were only able to book only 4 out of the 7 nights we were there, and most were either too early like at 6 or too late at 9pm.  Restaurants were mostly empty, when we were there.  We were able to go back to some of the restaurants without a reservation. Excellent services at Fuego with Mario and Katia the hostess, Willie at Olio, Juan at the buffet and last Rafi at Gavi Club.

Kids Club-My 7 year old love it, she wanted to be there all day.  The staff is great with kids.

Room- Suite with separate sleeping area for the kids with a pull out sofa.  Bed and pull out was very uncomfortable, do not stay in these rooms if planning to use the pull out, you probably sleep more comfortable on the floor.  Rooms a bit dated, be ready to kill mosquitos, maids leave the door open while cleaning the room.

Spa-We were able to use the sauna and the pool, great way to relax everyday after the beach and to relieve the back pain from the horrible bedding.

Food-Was good overall, if you eat at the buffet everyday even tho they have a lot of selections you’ll get bored.

Our experience at this resort was good because we went with an open mind and did not let the small stuff bother us.  The fact that you don’t get to experience the different restaurants the resort has to offer, assigned pools and beach areas depending on upgrade, the chair and bed reserved with peoples names on them, even tho never used, can leave you aggravated and walking around looking for a chair just to lay your stuff should not be experience by anyone staying at this resort, specially when you paid over $500 per night for a suite is ridiculous. Melia has to step up their game or will not get many repeat customers.

Room Service-It takes about an hour to get room service, then someone called us at 1:00am to verify we got our food two hours later. This is unacceptable.

Overall it seems like you need to upgrade and pay over $700 per night to really enjoy this property and be treated like Royal.  Most excellent reviews are from the Reserve area and Royal Service. There are cheaper options in Mexico.

reviews.author: rxreilly
reviews.title: Great beach. Lots of people.
reviews.text:
We were invited on a business trip so there is no complaining about price when your company is taking you to the Caribbean. We loved some things: the disco, the lounges on the beach, and the bathtub in our suite. Other aspects were overrated. Examples include the butler, breakfast and lunch options. If you sleep late it is impossibly hard to find a decent cup of coffee after 11. Nevertheless, staff and grounds were helpful and beautiful. 

We enjoyed walking down the beach and leaving the property to find local markets to purchase jewelry (though the bracelet broke in less than 2 weeks but so it goes).

Just remember this is an industrial sized resort so lunch is with 1000 people at a buffet and while the choices were appealing, the are still making lunch for 1000.

reviews.author: JRoque10
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: Eu e a minha mulher passámos 1 semana em Royal Service mas seguramente não voltaremos a usar este serviço. O mordomo não fez mais do que reservar o restaurante para jantar, algo que poderia fazê-lo por mim próprio sem qualquer stress. De resto este serviço não acrescenta nada de Royal ! . Achei o Hotel normal comparando com outros em Punta Cana. Muito barulho, hóspedes Americanos completamente mal educados sem qualquer respeito pelos outros ... enfim nada de recomendar. Somente tenho uma palavra de apreço com o Martin que está na Praia a ajudar-nos e o Richard do Restaurante Palazzo. Sem dúvida são colaboradores para manter por muitos anos !

reviews.author: Melissa T
reviews.title: We're off to a bad start
reviews.text:
We arrived yesterday and have been faced with one disappointment after another. We arrived at 2pm and went straight to lunch at Fuego after being shown our room. The staff and food at Fuego were wonderful, but we waiting an hour for our food to come and we waited so long for one of the kid's dessert to come that we left without it. We looked around the property and went back to the room to change to go to the pool and our bags were still not in the room. We had to call to ask where the bags were and when we called they said the bags were on the way. We waited and waited and the bags finally showed up more than 3 hours after we were shown our room. When we went to freshen up for dinner, we realized there were no towels in the room. I went out to find the housekeeping staff and asked for towels and they said, "later." We called the concierge line to ask for towels because we had none left in our and an hour later, three bath towels were brought to the room (no hand towels, no wash cloths). We called again to ask for wash cloths. We managed to get ready for dinner without wash cloths, but the wash cloths were brought to our room eventually....when someone walked into our room with them hours later when we were all sleeping! Forgot to mention that even though we notified them in advance that we had three people in our one bedroom suite, they did not leave any linens in the room for the pull out sofa. Had to call again for that. 

This morning our room was cleaned and they left only three bath towels (no hand towels, no wash cloths). I guess we'll need to call every day just to get the basics. 

The room smells musty and the area rugs are filthy. Worse than that, there is a shade over the window behind the bed that is filthy with spots that I have to assume are someone's body fluids. 
 
Unfortuntely, we were conned into buying a membership here after our first stay when we were treated like royalty. Every experience we have had here since then has been sub-par and the attention from the staff just goes away once you have a membership. When we bought the membership we were told that our membership would get us the same room that we were staying in. Well, that was a lie....the room we got for this stay with our Club Membership is about 1/3 of the size of the room we were told we would get and the way it is set up makes it so that we have to squeeze past each other to get into the bathroom, into the closet, etc. The property is beautiful, but for the price of the membership and the daily cost of $103 per person (including our kids over 12 years), we are really disappointed by the poor service and the deception. It's really upsetting to invest so much money in a vacation (and a vacation membership) and to get a fraction of what you have been promised. Even worse, when you let the staff know that you are disappointed and upset that you have not received what you were promised and what you paid for, they give a sarcastic insincere apology and just continue what they were doing.

reviews.author: rominaforgione23
reviews.title: No supero las expectativas...
reviews.text: Reservé este hotel porque consideré que no había nada mejor y queríamos hacernos un regalo con mi novio. Si bien el hotel es bellisimo, la ambientación es soñada y el nivel de la gastronomía es excelente creo que hay detalles que no merecen la tarifa que tiene el hotel. En la zona de la playa hay muchas reposeras rotas y viejas y no hay suficientes para los huéspedes. La playa no es de las mejores. No obstante destacó la predisposición de todos los empleados del hotel siempre predipuestos y con una sonrisa. Destacó especialmente a un camarero que se llama Silverio Heredia del restaurante OLIO. Es un buena opción pero no con la tarifa que cobran.

reviews.author: Jocelyne J
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text:
My husband and I were joined by 3 other couples - we were total 8 people.  We were celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary.  We stayed for 8 days (7/8 to 7/16/16).  We have been going to the Paradisus for 20 years and have always enjoyed the people.  Specifically, Luis Santana and Ramon Ramirez were the most friendly beach attendants who made our experience at the beach "exceptional".  They had our beach chairs ready for us in the morning and kept us well hydrated through the day with a wide variety of tropical drinks.  Always with a smile.  Thank you both for making a difference!  Gracias!
The reason for low rating on service is because, despite the spectacular service we received at the beach, the other areas were very inconsistent.  The transportation from hotel to beach was frustrating at best.  They didn't have enough "wagons" or "golf carts" taking people around.  The Melia Vacation Club golf carts prefer zooming around by themselves or with other staff members than to offer rides to patrons.  Restaurant reservations were terrible.  I understand a group of 8 is more difficult to accommodate, but they have fewer restaurants to accommodate the guests, therefore I believe that is the issue.  The quality and quantity of food at the restaurants has also diminished over the years.  We had a few nights without reservations where we could only go to the buffet at the Gabi Club and sometimes, there was no food left... until someone started screaming which prompted some food to come out of the kitchen.  Still nothing special.  Go there for the beach and accommodations.  Hopefully the food and services will improve with this type of feedback.

reviews.author: Brimar12000
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
I read up on all the reviews prior to booking this place. Even though you do get negative reviews, I based my decision on the majority of the good reviews. If I could separate this review in sections, it would be better, however, it's an overall rating. 
The hotel and the grounds are beautiful. The food very good. The service no so good. It takes forever to get a drink at the pool bar! You are lucky if you see a waiter near the beach. Even at the pool, it's impossible. The concierge desk staff, about 25% are customer oriented, the other could care less. It's a 50/50 chance. There is no urgency at all. The staff does not seem to care. On occasion, you will get someone who is kind, however, it's a small percentage. When I go on vacation to any of the Caribbean Islands, that's the one thing I always could count on, Except for the particular location on Dominican Republic. I haven't even seen a management staff?? It is has been a bit of a disappointment.

reviews.author: Melissa B
reviews.title: Not luxury
reviews.text:
Just joined so date isn't correct. 

We stayed on the more expensive side and expected luxury. Mostly we were disappointed with the exception of Victor, our concierge. Victor was top notch! He even brought our daughter Medicine when she was sick. 

The food was inedible at almost every resturant on campus. We walked out of 2 resturant before the meal was over. The shining star was the Hibachi resturant compared to the others but only too how bad the other choices were. 
The pool on our side was ugly and laid out poorly. The grill was horrible with few unappealing choices. 

Another issue was the need to take a golf cart to the beach. Not only is this inconvenient it's smelly, being that you to pass septic tanks along the way. 

The upside is the weather, its perfect every day and the facility was fairly clean.  Aside from the above stated dissatisfaction we had a great time. There are lots of activities to do in the area and the hotel is happy to book excursions.

reviews.author: Angela M
reviews.title: Pretty but won't come back to this resort
reviews.text:
I searched and read so many reviews about this resort that I felt confident that we had chosen a great place for our vacation. We were somewhat disappointed and didn't have near the experience that most others have reported. 

First, family concierge was NOT worth the money. Could have been our particular concierge, however, we were not impressed. She didn't give us very good information regarding how beach cabanas were reserved or that you had to be there by 10am to get one. And she didn't mention HOW to get to the correct part of the beach to get a cabana. Concierge level is supposed to make getting dinner reservations easy and seamless. Not so much. We specifically said no Mexican food and she booked us there anyway. I declined that reservation. Not to mention that even though she came into work in the afternoon, we didn't have a backup person to contact for anything. We didn't have any way of contacting her ( she mentioned giving us a phone but that never happened). 

Food---it was ok. The reserve area buffet was by far the least impressive. My main issue is that if you have food allergies... You are screwed. I mean really screwed. We have a child with food allergies. We just had to wing it all week. We carried the EpiPen with us at all times. 

Poolside bar service after lunch is almost nonexistent. 

Good points..... It's absolutely beautiful. The resort is kept in pristine condition. The beach was heavenly. The beach staff were great. The rooms are spacious and well kept. Food was ok. 

I would highly recommend that if you have plans to eat dinner at any of the restaurants down by the beach.... Wear LOTS of bug spray. They didn't tell us that and my husband has 50+ bug bites on his legs. 

We made great memories with our family on this trip. We would come back to the Dominican republic, but would not stay here.

reviews.author: yeojinc104
reviews.title: Nice hotel but needs to be improved!
reviews.text:
My family liked this hotel in the begging. Food was good, pools were nice. 
Then we had a horrible experience at one of the international buffet restaurant one night and it pretty much ruined if for the rest of our stay.
Some parts of the resort have some issues with sewer system. It smelled disgusting when I passed by.
A lot of restaurants in this hotel don't provide AC, so be prepared to eat lunch or dinner with a lot of sweats!

reviews.author: Smiles70
reviews.title: Beginning of Visit
reviews.text: Well, it's only our first night here in the resort; and I'm going to give it another day or two before I give my review. Let's just say that things haven't been great thus far. The room we booked seems like it's a mile away from the beach and although we are on the 2nd floor, it does smell like mildew & mold. The room really needs some updating to make it feel more like the resort Paradisus claims it to be. I'm hoping that things will improve tomorrow and we can move to a different room that is closer to the pool & beach and that it is updated and lacks the unpleasant smell. I can say that our experiences with the staff, housekeeping, room service, etc. has been very positive and welcoming. I will post another review in a day or two with more details and better overview of this resort.

reviews.author: anthonycC11IW
reviews.title: Okay but disorganized
reviews.text:
Resort was pretty, food was good, pools were very nice, but overall just average.  We had a horrible experience at check-in regarding an expired credit card that we used to pre-pay in full.  That took two stressful hours to resolve (having the old credit card and a passport that matched name and address from the reservation was apparently not enough).  I feel a Disney resort or any hotel really would have resolved this same issue quickly.  Others in our party weren't even asked for their credit card, either, so much of this process seems random.

There seemed to be a lot to do activity wise, but finding out what and how to schedule it was difficult.  The one activity desk was usually overwhelmed or not staffed making it difficult to figure out what to do and how to sign up.

Kids had fun at the pools, especially the reserve area.  Kid Zone was fun as well.

We wish we'd saved our money on a regular room instead of the upgraded room.  The small extra space and no real benefit of having a kitchen (with no stove or microwave) is useless when food is available and free.

But the resort was clean and the staff was friendly.  So overall it was a good vacation, but the resort has some room for improvement.

reviews.author: puntacanabeachlover
reviews.title: Very Disappointed....
reviews.text: I have been visiting Punta Cana since 1993 and I must say...this has been the first time I have been really this disappointed.  We visited from June 29th through July 7th.  We traveled with about 60 family members which was the highlight of the trip. We were there for a family event which off course happened outside of the property being Palma Real has been so commercialized.  It is really sad to see such a beautiful property being managed as such.  The only 3 people I would really say made a difference during my stay where: The Pool Bar: Luis who is so proud of the work he does and goes above and beyond to make sure everyone is having a great time and always has a smile on his face, at the buffet during breakfast and lunch: Thomas & Argenis, both of them were always so welcoming.  Other than that, I cannot say anything positive about the people at the front desk (check-in) or anyone else other than the people I mentioned above.  I will never recommend the Palma Real to anyone I know.  I never get tired of being in a resort but this was the first time I was looking forward to coming home. Such an expensive vacation and a great disappointment.

reviews.author: pamella1
reviews.title: All Inclusive ....NOT!!!
reviews.text: The Good --location, beach, pools.  The Bad -- everything good is extra -- even in the Royal Service which you definitely want if you don't enjoy all the kiddos.  The only place to get premium alcohol without paying $12 for a drink is in the royal service lounge -- where the service is mediocre at best.  Your butler constantly tries to book services that cost extra.  Every bartender, waiter, maid, butler, etc. is only interested in your wallet..not you.  Food at the restaurants is okay...breakfast is the best. For beach side drink service -- better go to the pool bar yourself.  Obviously, "all Inclusive" in this place has a completely different meaning than other resorts we have visited.  We will never return to another Melia/Paradisus property.  There are better choices.

reviews.author: fwtraveler918
reviews.title: OK but have stayed at better
reviews.text: I am not impressed with Melia. The hotel is beautiful but the value for money isn't worth it. The service at the front is slow and rooms were given to us 3 hours late. They also do not do anything to make up for the lost time. Additionally, if you are part of Melia rewards, they do not automatically grant you your points and you will have to go through alot of trouble to get them if they mess them up.

reviews.author: Daisy P
reviews.title: 25th anniversary
reviews.text: Stayed here with our family of 50 for a week in July 2016. I want to say that this is my second time staying here. Our first time in 2012, the service was amazing. Now in 2016 the hotel is very understaffed. In the buffet area is was very difficult to get utensils or a glass of water. The food doesn't change much. About 10 in our group got very sick with horrible stomach ache. That being said I do have to give a shoutout to Vladimir Rodriguez for all his help. He was able to arrange for us to all have dinner reservations in each restaurant along with Germania Castro. We also lost our bag with go pro and iPhone and Vladimir along with the head of security was able to locate for us. Luis at the pool bar was also amazing at making sure we had drinks and chips while we hung out at the pool. It's too bad that management doesn't realize that they have a good staff but not the capability to handle the crowd which makes for a very poor hotel. Also Jose Vargas was another exceptional employee.

reviews.author: Patriciabiagioni
reviews.title: Poderia ser melhor
reviews.text:
Passamos uma semana agradável em Punta Cana com muito sol e calor mas poderia ter sido muito melhor.
O hotel possui uma estrutura muito boa, está situado em uma bela praia apesar das algas no mar serem desagradáveis mas tem muitos pontos a melhorar...
Nunca estivemos antes hospedados em um hotel com sistema all inclusive justamente por ouvirmos muitas reclamações às quais pudemos comprovar serem verídicas.
O hotel possui um restaurante principal no qual são servidos café da manhã, almoço e jantar e está sempre lotado, com garçons sem a mínima educação e treinamento para estarem ocupando o cargo ao qual se destinam. Por várias vezes fomos muito mal atendidos, mas o pior de todos os garçons foi o Wisly Foture, o qual praticamente jogava as bebidas em nossa mesa.
Além deste restaurante principal, há vários outros restaurantes temáticos, os quais necessitam de reserva (funcionam somente para o jantar) e tem um serviço um pouco melhor. Gostamos muito do atendimento e da comida dos restaurantes japonês e italiano (Olio), já o mediterrâneo e o mexicano, são bem fraquinhos tanto com relação ao cardápio, quanto ao atendimento.
O serviço de praia também é praticamente inexistente, passando garçon apenas uma vez ao dia, sendo que tinhamos que levantar para irmos até o bar da piscina pegar bebidas, já que na praia não há uma base de apoio para os hóspedes que queiram beber algum drink.
Os quartos são espaçosos e confortáveis mas a limpeza deixa a desejar. Possui um frigobar incluso na diária com poucas opções de bebidas as quais nem sempre eram repostas.
Não sei se nos hospedaremos novamente em um hotel com sistema all inclusive, a não ser que realmente haja uma reestruturação no atendimento.

reviews.author: Amydm7
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful resort but service very average
reviews.text: The beach is gorgeous, resort is stunning, and tons of employees bustling around.  That is why it was so confusing that the service was very average.  Of course there were some very helpful , friendly employees but overall the service just wasn't there.  We tipped waiters & room attendants but still average service for an all-inclusive.  Hard to get water refills at breakfast & lunch. No towels available in the cabana after 9:30-10AM. No chairs available around the pool after 9:30-10AM (hardly any people in the chairs, just towels "holding" beach chairs).  Bar service very good but never saw anyone bringing drinks to guests at the pool or beach.  You have to wear wristbands/bracelets.  If it's all-inclusive, why does everyone have to wear a bracelet? Dinner reservations are a PAIN. We could only get reservations for 8:30, 9:30 and no availability at all for a couple of the restaurants.  Odd thing is when we showed up for reservations there were tons of available tables.  Waitstaff in restaurants were very hospitable.  I think if I was fluent in Spanish I possibly would have had gotten better service.  A lady walked up for reservations right in from of me & told them where she wanted to eat & what times & it was no problem for her - it pays to speak the language.  It's awful to complain about such a lovely resort - just want to offer an opinion for those deciding between this resort and others. It must be a management style & a Dominican Republic attitude.  This is our first visit to the Dominican - we'll probably go back to an AMResort (Secrets, Dreams) in Mexico next time.  Impeccable service

reviews.author: S5025GMmiguell
reviews.title: Aparenta más de lo que ofrece
reviews.text:
Distribución del hotel complicada.
Servicios elementales como tumbonas, muy estropeadas y escasas, a las 10 de la mañana costaba encontrar 4 tumbonas en condiciones al lado de la piscina.
Restaurantes muy pequeños para la cantidad de gente que los utiliza.

José Vargas y Cruz reyes personal de recepción que ayudó a solucionar los problemas de la reserva, se portaron de forma excepcional.

reviews.author: DB_paradise_seeker
reviews.title: Great Vacation, beds were bad!!!!
reviews.text:
Staff was amazing! Food was delicious, views were to die for. BUT...
we were in room 3604 and my daughter and I were bit by something on our second/third night. We searched the room no bugs were found (I searched every inch) but there were 3 blood spots on the mattress. Upon complaining they moved us to another room in which I stripped the bed and blood on that bed as well they then moved us to a third room and same thing. I will take NO chances they then moved us to The Reserve (Newer side of resort). Search that room and it was clean as a whistle and what an upgrade!! The staff worked diligently with us to make us happy!

reviews.author: ernestodef
reviews.title: Beautiful facilities, horrible dining experience
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful; the facilities impeccably maintained. However, the dining experience is a disaster. The reservation process is absurd and most of the time they get it wrong. Food at Rare was horrible - meat served rare ever thought we stated medium well. Most of us got the wrong side order.

reviews.author: John_in_Evergreen
reviews.title: Nice resort...but dishonest and deceptive
reviews.text:
The resort itself is quite nice, the Dominicans who work there are some of the nicest people we've ever met, and the food is excellent but....

BEWARE THE BAIT AND SWITCH. 

for example:

- when we made the reservation, we were told that each room would receive $500 in resort CREDIT. What we found upon check in, however, is that there are NO resort credits. They give you resort "coupons" which are far different than the resort credits we've received at other all-inclusive resorts.  For example, we got several $50 spa "coupons" but we're not allowed to use more than one per treatment.  So they just jack the prices up by $50 and you end up paying full price for a massage. Forget using 3 of your $50 coupons for a $150 massage. At other all-inclusives that we've visited, we got CREDITS that could be used on ANYTHING, at any time, and in any amount. 

-when you check in, it is about a 30 minute process and they go over everything and answer any questions you have. The person who checked us in (Kelvin I think) sat with us and told us SPECIFICALLY that scuba diving was included in the all-inclusive.  We even asked him TWICE to make sure. Of course when we went to the dive center, that was not the case. So we had to spend $500 to go diving (2 people each doing three dives)

-they told us golf greens fees were included, both when we made the reservation and when we checked in.  When we went to golf, the course charged us $65 PER PERSON for a golf cart. Not $65 dollars per cart (or $20-$30 per cart, like everywhere else in the world) but $65 PER PERSON.  So it cost $195 for three of us to play one "included" round of golf. Hardly all-inclusive....and so dishonest to say golf is free when it is hardly free. 

-one of the "coupons" is for wine that is not on the "all-inclusive" list (how is it all-inclusive again?), but you have to buy at least a $100 bottle and you can only use ONE $25 coupon per bottle. 

Although we had a nice time as a family and we enjoyed the food, people, and the resort grounds, there was universal disappointment that the resort chooses to be dishonest with people about what you get and what, more importantly, you don't get.  If you go, go with your eyes open and your wallet full of extra cash.

reviews.author: lorena f
reviews.title: BASTANTE QUE DESEAR
reviews.text: el hotel es lindo, pero como suele pasar las habitaciones frente al mar tienen el problema que el mar no se ve, solo se ven palmeras o la scuba nautica. por otro lado lo unico que les interesa es venderte la membresia. la cena romantica en la playa que tiene un costo adicional, es un desastre hasta un raton por entre las piernas nos paso y la comida la traian sin tapa, por lo cual cuando llegaba a la mesa estaba helada. eramos hespedes con el servicio de mayordomo, pero la verdad que la estadia ahi se resume a una experiencia para reirse y no llorar.

reviews.author: C206T
reviews.title: 7 days in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
If you need anything at the pool or beach Edwin is your man. He provided us with exceptional service all week. Palapas, towels, drinks, ice buckets etc. All the resort staff are friendly helpful and want you to have a great time. Gabriel and the house keeping staff are also very efficient and attentive.
 
The worst is getting through customs and immigration at the airport which is not air conditioned. Over one hour of standing and melting in stagnant humid tropical air, yuk! Buy your tourist cards on line before you get there. If you don't, prepare to stand. They are $10 USD. Kid alert!! They are everywhere. Even in the adult pool....with food!

The best is the endless selection of food at the Gabi restaurant. 
Great beach scene palm trees and white sand. Very safe and secure. You can leave your things and swim nobody will bother. 
Overall we had a great time and would go back.

reviews.author: myvacations2016
reviews.title: Emails for dinner reservations!!!!
reviews.text:
As many have said, the hotel is beautiful, the grounds are nicely kept, and the closeness to the beach together with the spectacular views makes this a good experience.  However, curve your expectations when it comes to the service to make dinner reservations.  
At check in, the day of my arrival, and because I had read other reviews, I asked our concierge Yokaira, if I could make dinner reservations at Vento.  She quickly informed me that was impossible because reservations had to be made through her via email at 9 in the morning, and I had arrived at 3.  She told us to come back the next day at 9.
My husband went back the next day at 9, and now she was wondering if we could be flexible and reserve for agave instead of Vento.  We agreed with the understanding she would make our reservations for Vento for the next day.  By the way Agave wasn't even for sure yet, because according to Yokaira she would get an answer via email by 3; so we would have to inconvenience ourselves to go see her at that time again.  We were patient, and did as she told us, but when my husband went to confirm our reservation she had left for the day!!!!!  We received a call from her at 7:15 letting us know about our reservations for 7:30 at Agave, a restaurant I had no intentions to visit originally.
The next day we tried to make new reservations, and she kept telling us the story of the reservations having to be sent daily by 9, and that multiple reservations could not be made at once. 
By now we were frustrated and on our way to the buffet stopped by a half empty Vento, since it was around 6. After going back and forth they finally sat us making us feel they were doing us a great favor....A similar situation happened at Rare; another member of our group secured the reservation, and when we got there they told us we didn't have a reservation.  By now I wasn't as nice or as patient and they eventually sat us down,  but I don't go on vacations to fight or beg for dinner reservations.

reviews.author: Neish111
reviews.title: Overall great family vacation!
reviews.text:
My parents, my husband, our two kids 9 & 5 and I stayed at Club Melia Paradisus Palma Real all-inclusive resort  in Punta Cana.  It is important to know that this is separate from the Reserve, but right next door and guests can share some of the amenities at both resorts.  

Check-In: 
We had VIP check-in.  Upon arrival, we went into a separate air conditioned VIP lounge to check-in.  Staff was very kind and assisted us with all of our questions and they took the liberty to reserve each restaurant for us.  They offered us cold drinks and gave us our resort access bracelets.  The lounge has computers, games and lounge sofas for guests to use. Once we were all checked in, since it wasn't time to go to the room, we were given a tour of the resort and escorted to the buffet for lunch.  

Restaurants:
There are 7 restaurants at the Palma Real
Vento Mediterranean (men must wear pants), Bana Tappanyaki (Japanese Hibachi), Bana Sushi, Rare (Steak House), Blue Agave (Mexican), Fuego (Peruvian Fusion), Naos (Buffet).  

Be prepared for the restaurants (except for the buffet) to serve food that is more like fine dining/small plates, but there is more than one course. 

You can also make reservations to eat at the Reserve restaurants (2 min golf cart ride from Palma Real).  

We ate breakfast at the Naos buffet every morning.  There is an array of food and this buffet is much larger than the Reserve buffet with more options. There are omelette/fresh eggs stations, breakfast meats, anti pasti, cheeses, sweets, hot/cold cereals, fresh fruit, empanadas, pancakes, French toast, waffles and crepes.  Wait staff serves juice, water and alcoholic beverages. 

We typically had lunch at the Naos buffet or Blue Agave grill.  The again have an array of food at the buffet; such as, seafood rice, pizza, fajita chicken, stir fry, Dominican tastes, veggies and salads.  The grill had fresh fish, burgers, tacos and quesadillas.  Basically the same food everyday.  Blue Agave is poolside, so you can ask pool concierge to bring food and drinks as needed.  We typically sat at the Blue Agave to have lunch or in the buffet.  The food is ok, but after a couple of days, you may be looking for something different.  The buffet severs were great, but cooks were not as friendly. 

For dinner we went to Bana Teppanyaki it was your typical Japanese hibachi (fried rice, chicken, shrimp and steak).  It was ok and service was great.

We had dinner at Rare and we enjoyed the food.  They have a selection of steak and you can order appetizers, salad, sides and dessert. The ribs, ribeye and salmon were good.  Major reason for lower rating - we had a roach crawling on our dinner table!!!

We had dinner at Blue Agave and the menu selection is small and the food is ok.  

We also had lunch and dinner at Fuego.  The scenery was nice and you could feel the ocean breeze.  The food was ok.  Fuego has one of the best bars.  Order the Caipiroska...delicious!

For our anniversary night, my husband and I had dinner at Olio.  This was a reserve restaurant that was not included.  We had to pay $40 per person.  This restaurantis on the Palma Real site and the food was pretty good. 

We also had dinner at the Reserve International Buffet.  We were surprised that this was recommended.  This was a small buffet with little options.  On the upside, the restaurant had great visual appeal by the pool.  Downside - There was a stray cat in the restaurant.  

At the Reserve there is the Gabi Club international buffet, the Reserve Aqua (Mediterranean) and the Reserve Mizu (Japanese).  

Our last night, was at Mizu.   We took a 2 minute golf cart ride there.  This restaurant was the one I enjoyed the most.  It is Japanese Hibachi style.  Slightly different because they start off with a variety of sushi, then fried rice, grilled tuna, then grilled shrimp, then beef and vegetables followed by dessert.  Delicious! 

Rooms and Maid Service: 
We had two one bedroom suites (Coral building #35), each had a king size bed, jacuzzi tub, 2 sinks, a private toilet, a stand up shower, a balcony (our balcony faced the trees - no view), a kitchen with a full size refrigerator (stocked with complementary soda, water, orange juice boxes, beer and club soda), the kitchen had a coffee maker, blender, toaster, microwave and two stove top burners. 
There was also a dining area and living room space with a king size pull out sofa (kids slept on). The maid made the sofa bed every night as well. 

PROS: the rooms were very clean, freshly painted and visibly appealing 

CONS: my parent's room had a broken washer and microwave.  They also had a lot of sand ants that needed to be sprayed.  Their room had a mildew smell and they had to burn incense.  

Our primary maid came in to clean the room typically by 930 am each day.
