Ao menos deveria ser uma área somente para adultos, com funcionários mais bem preparados para atender seus seletos hóspedes. O Paradisus é um hotel muito bonito, com ótima comida, praia bonita mas muito agitada.Tem muita criança e não vi serviço de monitores. Os hóspedes não respeitam ou não sabem o que é "dress code". Jantam nos restaurantes a la carte de bermuda e chinelo de praia.  Não é um hotel  romântico. Teria até tudo para ser mas muitas crianças e muita gente desarrumada não tem como. Eu nem me imaginaria em lua de mel aqui. 
Voltaria ao Reserve? Não. Achei bom mas não gostaria de voltar. Não consegui me sentir conquistado nem pelo Paradisus nem por Punta Cana.
Nessa mesma viagem nos hospedamos por mais quatro noites no Excellence Punta Cana( serviço fabuloso, adults only, praia desértica mas também muito brava, hotel precisando de uma repaginada. Gostei mas nāo voltaria também. E depois mais oito noites no Sanctuary Cap Cana( Também adults only, e um dos mais lindos hotéis que já fomos na nada menos Juanillo Beach, considerada uma das mais lindas praias do Caribe, com um serviço absolutamente bom. Me conquistou e voltaria com certeza).

reviews.author: martar455
reviews.title: Estuve en palma real y me gusto mucho más
reviews.text:
Lo pasé muy bien pero es peor hotel q el palma real de la misma compañía ... Este está más lejos del golf y es peor , la próxima vez iremos al palma real si económicamente nos viene bien 
Lo pasamos muy bien porq fuimos toda la familia 26 personas

reviews.author: cbn456
reviews.title: Outdated
reviews.text: The rooms need an update--I feel like ours hadn't been touched since the '80s.  Food is generic all-inclusive buffet except for the Japanese and the restaurant that is not included.  Drinks are watered down.

reviews.author: MichaelC1
reviews.title: Really expensive....not always value for money
reviews.text:
Consider that the Reserve is the VIP area of the Resort Paradisus Punta Cana. 
If you want more "VIP" you can get the Royal Service for extra fee (Rooms close to the sea and premium services including the access to a special restaurant very good named La Palapa).
Here the real issue is the value for money ( a room could cost you 6/8'00€). For half-price you could have a real 5 stars in Mexico, Egypt,...
I think that Melia is doing something wrong as I see several hotel Melia dropping their services (including this Paradisus specially in the last 8 months (we went here in 2010/2012 and March 2015).
The good luck of Melia are their employees and the location: without them the hotel cannot survive. 
When you pay 5/800 $ per night , you expect the service similar of the service provided by Mandarin, SLH,...including cleaning the room (sometimes they clean at 3-4pm)

Officially they provide you a butler (but you need to be lucky to get a phone to call him) although it's not a a real butler-concierge. Don't expect a real concierge! 

You have several restaurants included but very hard to reserve the restaurant "a la carte". They don't have electronic system is in place and very often they will say that there is no availability (but if you go in the restaurant you will see many free place that never will be used). The best one are Passion and La Palapa (but unfortunately with 50$pp extra fee) alternatively the Grill is very good. Fuego was my favorite one but they decided to change cuisine and now very poor quality similar of Vento.

On the end...is a good solution but for a maximum price of 400/300$ for the room including all inclusive. The big issue is that you see that it's missing a real management and the goal bo be a real 5stars. The employee are realy very good but they need help,training and experience to be able to deliver the great experience for this kind of $$$$.

reviews.author: JLTP
reviews.title: A mixed, but overall disappointing experience
reviews.text:
The Reserve is considered a premier section of the Paradisus Punta Cana Resort, with certain amenities available only to Reserve guests.  Our experience was mixed, but disappointing overall.  Here’s how I’d rate the various components of our stay, roughly from best to worst:

The sprawling property is beautiful, with impressive architecture and landscaping throughout the complex.  The beach, which is about a 10 minute walk or short shuttle ride from the rooms, is beautiful and not overly crowded.  Palalpas were readily available and there was no need to claim a spot early in the day  The ocean water and sand are immaculate and there are water sports available (for a fee) for those interested.  There’s a long stretch of beach that’s very enjoyable to walk.  

There’s at least one dedicated pool for The Reserve which wasn’t crowded which had a nice mix of spots where you could decide between sun and shade.  There is bar service at the pool, but it was hit or miss in terms of getting service when desired.  We used the gym one day which was small but fine for us.  There is a spa on the property but we didn’t utilize it.

We played one “free” round at the Cocotal golf course that is available to guests for only the cart fee (which still makes it a fair price in my opinion).  The course was enjoyable (see separate review), though we were only able to take advantage of the complimentary shuttle service one way and had to take a taxi ($20) the other way.  (It’s about 10 minutes away by taxi, maybe a half hour on the shuttle due to stops at other hotels.)

We had a tastefully decorated two bedroom set-up that was quite spacious for four adults, with two nice balconies that looked out toward the pool area.  There were a few oddities and minor issues.  For example, the cold water in the bathroom sink wouldn’t get cold and the shower controls require an engineering degree or plumber’s license to figure out.  One of the shower doors didn’t close completely, letting water leak onto the floor.  There are several thermostats for the room (good) but we couldn’t get the temperature above 63 degrees for one of them despite asking for assistance (not good).  There were several minibars with complementary items (snacks, soft drinks, beers) that were replenished every day.  Strangely, even items (like chips) that aren’t normally served cold were refrigerated.

Between The Reserve and the main property there are quite a few places to eat.  All in all, we were disenchanted with the food.  While promoted as an all-inclusive, the two best restaurants (Passion and La Palapa, both of which are full table service and adults-only) required a substantial extra payment.  In the case of Passion, I believe the surcharge was $65 per person.  Passion and La Palapa were very good, but the falloff in quality at the other restaurants was steep.  Most of the restaurants at Paradisus are buffet-style, so you should keep that in mind as you choose your Punta Cana vacation resort.  I’m usually not a big fan of buffets, but have still had much better experiences at others in the past.  Eventually I adopted the approach of trying a bunch of things in the hope that I’d find a few that I enjoyed.  This seemed to work out ok, but I had hoped for better.  The alcoholic drinks included in the all-inclusive were mostly good, and the house chardonnay was better than I expected.  

The service level at the Paradisus did not meet expectations and certainly wasn’t worthy of a 5-star resort as this purports to be.  Here are a few examples to give you a sense of what I mean:
1.  The hotel didn’t send a welcome email a few days in advance of our stay as is normally standard practice in my experience.  This was a particular problem because they claimed to have no record of our pre-arranged airport transfer despite my having received a confirmation when I booked.  As a result, we had to go through some extra red tape and delay before getting a ride to the hotel.
2. The “free” transfers apparently have strings attached.  We ended up having to take a cab back to the airport because we delayed our visit to the transportation desk at the hotel to confirm our trip back to the airport.  To make a long story short, they’re trying to sell you tours or other extra trips in the area and if you’re only interested in a trip back to the airport, you can take a cab at your own expense ($35).
3. Our hotel greeter was helpful, but eventually made no bones about the fact that it was her job to try to sell us a time share.  No chance.
4. While many staff members tried their best to be helpful, on at least two occasions we literally had them walk away from us when we were asking a question.  It’s possible this was partly a language barrier issue, but to me that’s just not acceptable.  I’d also comment that the general tone taken by the staff tended to be a familiar, joking one.  I don’t associate this approach with a premium resort.  
5. A shuttle driver pulled away while I was still in the process of entering the vehicle.  Thankfully, I managed to escape without injury. 
6. When it was time to leave our room, we spent the better part of an hour trying to connect with a bellman to bring our bags out.  No answer.  We then went to the service desk and they tried calling.  No answer.  It was a good thing we allotted extra time.  Nonetheless, this was inexcusable.

Our only previous experience with Punta Cana was at the very upscale Tortuga Bay resort.  If your finances allow, I suggest you consider that property as it is in a very different league.  Best of luck with whatever you decide.

reviews.author: Robertandamanda
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Great Staff, OK food expected better from a 5 star and lacking in entertainment
reviews.text: Our family travelled there in November for 10 days.  Beautiful resort breathtaking pools and loved the private cabanas everywhere. I would not recommend going here without the concerige service especially with kids. Sophia out concerige was amazing to our family.  This is a very quiet hotel so if you are looking for downtime relaxation this is the place for you. We were a little disappointed with the nightly entertainment as their are only 3 shows a week.  Kids club is great and safe and has great staff. The Buffett restraunts are way better at the paradisus then the reserve so take advantage of that sadly the restraunts were just ok not bad just ok. The beach was very nice with great beds to lie on this was a plus 😃. All in all a great vacation

reviews.author: rajiders
reviews.title: Punta cana vacation
reviews.text:
Good resort but not exclusive as advertised ...ok food, bad service and can not trust the staff.
There are many folks running around but not helping guest with their issue.  I have to ask several times before get thing done, if I am lucky.

reviews.author: ric340
reviews.title: Overall great but needs some work
reviews.text:
We have been to the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana many times and overall have a great time. The staff is excellent in the restaurants.  However some of the negatives are becoming more of an issue. The gym in particular, needs a lot of work and is completely unworthy of a high-end resort. It is as if management has no interest in the gym. The equipment is old and worn. One of the weight machines is held together with tape. By 5pm there are never any towels.  There is not nearly enough equipment - for instance there are only 3 treadmills which is inadequate for a resort this size.  I always had to wait for a treadmill.  The yoga mats are ancient and are falling apart.   The gym is not clean either. The staff in the gym are fine but they likely have no control over the poor condition of the gym.  

Another issue I ran into was with the "free" transport to and from Cocotol golf. One afternoon the 5pm return shuttle never showed up. I had to take a taxi for $30. When I tried to complain to several staff members they all referred me to someone else- one even said it was my fault. I understand that at a resort like this there are many moving parts but the response from staff to a problem does not show any concern. 

I say these criticisms to let management know there are problems.

reviews.author: GalileoBlue
reviews.title: Not all Reserves are created equal
reviews.text:
I'll start with the positive: employees wanted to provide a good service. They were very friendly and seemed happy which does make a difference. The beaches were beautiful - better than those at the Paradisus Reserve Playa de Carmen, Mexico.

However, our experience left a lot to be desired compared to its sister resort in Playa del Carmen. The food quality was not very good, and was definitely inferior to their resort in Playa del Carmen. Room service would take about 10 calls plus holding before anyone would pick up. The rooms were also inferior: the air conditioning didn't work quite well the first two days and the water pressure was terrible. The Reserve buildings were very far from the beach. It took a shuttle ride or a long walk to get there

Overall it just did not seem to be a good value for the price that we paid for the vacation.

reviews.author: Wang L
reviews.title: Great resort - needs better hospitality!
reviews.text:
Stayed for 5 nights with family over Christmas

Good:
Excellent facilities, huge pool and great play areas / beach
Food - excellent variety, however with little day-to-day change
Tennis and paddle tennis courts were well-maintained and easy to book
Service was great outside of the main booking areas
Bargarita had the best drinks in the resort
Aqua and Rare were great!

Bad:
Our primary issue with the hotel was with our "concierge" Brunswick (who called himself Bruny). He added no value and detracted from our experience at the hotel. From the first day, he was very under-handed, basically threatening to not book any restaurants for us unless if we attended a 3-hour presentation on Melia properties. He claimed all the restaurants were booked (not true, as we found out later) and that he had "special connections" to get us reservations (also not true).
Even after we sat through this presentation, he had not booked anything for us, and it was a good thing we realized early enough to change it. Bruny subsequently decided to avoid us for the rest of the trip and walked away when we came by.
Also during our stay our AC stopped working for 2 nights and the workmen couldn't fix it, so we had to sleep with the windows open.
A couple of us got sick on the trip, although this seems to be a common DR issue. 

Overall a good stay, would recommend the hotel make the restaurant reservation process less ridiculous, as the days that we did eat in the restaurants the places were empty. Additionally would recommend that the hotel check the power trip that some of the concierge staff are on, as we heard that our experience was not a one-off.

reviews.author: Rosalie P
reviews.title: Average holiday
reviews.text: Hard to make dinner reservations!  Staff was friendly but not over the top accommodating.  I think for the money we were better served on a cruise.  Used of the spa was an awesome perk, very relaxing, thank you for that!

reviews.author: Sonal P
reviews.title: Beautiful resort- but not luxurious
reviews.text:
My husband and I just got back from a 6 night stay at this resort dec 13-19. I read a ton of reviews before and after booking so I feel obligated to leave my opinion. The resort is GORGEOUS! You feel as if you are at a 4 or 5 star resort. Very modern and nice- and the grounds are well taken care of. However our room was super outdated and old. Furniture was old, doors creaked, the toilet barely flushed. Not impressed with the room at all because after seeing the rest of the resort,it was a buzzkill to walk into our old outdates room. 

The food was probably the biggest disappointment. I chose this resort because it looked like there were a lot of food options to choose from however that was not the case. Some of the restaurants were for Royal service or club members only. There were only two options for lunch- and both were a buffet. The main buffet at naos was probably one of the best I have ever seen- but   Not what I expected for a luxury resort. The food sat under heat lamps for god knows how long. The food would be cold by the time you made it back to your table. The many options were nice- but it got boring after the 3rd day. Same food for lunch and dinner buffet- everyday. The other lunch buffet had hot dogs and hamburgers that were already cooked also sitting under heat lamps. And they called this lunch spot a "restaurant" instead of buffet however it really was just another buffet of meat sitting out under a lamp for hours. Why couldn't they just make burgers and hotdogs on the spot? My husband was afraid to eat any of the seafood or sushi there because it would also be sitting there all day, and even though the ceviche and sushi was on ice- it was not cold at all and sometimes it would all be melted. One day at lunch, I found a dead bug in my pad Thai-gross!!! The manager did come out and apologize but after that incident I just did not want to eat anything in the buffet unless they freshly made it. So gross.The restaurants there just didn't seem sanitary enough. The rice for sushi was always so sticky!! Did not enjoy sushi at all- even at the restaurant. The only restaurant we enjoyed fully was the hibachi grill. The food at Rare did not seem fresh. Got mashed potatoes as a side that seemed like they were made hours ago because they were so dry and starchy. Basically received a hard lump. My husband and I are foodies and we enjoy eating good, fresh, good quality food and the food at this resort was just not appealing to us. It would be nice if they had a bar/snack or pool menu due to lack of options During the day unless you were Royal service. 

They heavily stress making dinner reservations and would only give us 9 or 930pm seating even though we made all our reservations the first day we got there. However we were always the last ones to be seated for the night and the restaurants would pretty much be empty by the time we got there so I don't know why they couldn't give us earlier times. 

The drinks were okay- wish they had a drink menu and options to choose from!!! Only one beer option, and only two mojito options. Flavored mojitos woulda been nice. The margarita place had a menu of flavors to choose from- however the bartender said only two options were available- lime and mango. 

The spa is gorgeous and I did get a massage at the yhi spa and enjoyed it. We were able to use the facilities there on other days since I got a massage but if i hadn't- you have to pay $35 to use the facility if you want to use the sauna or jacuzzi- which I think is overpriced. Shout out to Joan at the yhi spa for keeping my husband entertained with the water ritual while I got my massage! Super friendly and accommodating. 

We went on a club melia tour and the guy that recommended it to us ensured us that it would be OVER breakfast so we don't waste vacation time however that was not the case. It took 2 hours and they didn't even start the presentation until AFTER you eat so don't fall for that. He also told us we can end 20 mins into the presentation if we wanted to and it would be okay- except you don't get the excursion voucher unless you finish the whole 90 minute presentation. 

One great thing about this resort though is the service and wait staff. Everyone is soooo nice and friendly and works hard. Best service we have received at a resort. With the exception of blue agaves dinner service- first and only waited we encountered that was just plain lazy and not helpful. We wanted to make alterations to the menu due to food restrictions and he said they can't and that the food is already made and prepared and that they just heat it up. 

Seaweed on the beach was a problem!! So gross! Did not seem like they raked it because if you walked over to the melia caribe Which was next resort over- their beach was so Much cleaner. 

Seems like anyone that did Royal service loved it according to these reviews- and the food seems better at palazzo. So if you have high expectations and want good quality food- do the Royal service!! We went on a slow week so their pool and lounge area was more than half empty but if I ever had to come back- I would choose this option only to get better food.

reviews.author: marialouiseg
reviews.title: Trip
reviews.text: good service, good food, aside from Vento and nice atmosphere.  easy trip from NY and it was just about value for money.  Butler could have been more proactive and the room upgrade voucher was useless because we didn't get it until the 2nd day and at that point had already unpacked and were settled in a room and didn't want to move.

reviews.author: Kim V
reviews.title: Très décevant
reviews.text: C'est la première fois que je donne mon avis pour un hotel, mais cette fois ci je ne pouvais pas faire autrement. Nous sommes une famille de 12 personnes avec deux enfants de 2 ans. J'écris en ce moment de la piscine, nous devons quitter l'hotel demain. Nous sommes tous malades, la nourriture est très mauvaise au buffets, les restaurants à la carte sont correcte, le bana est par contre très bien. Le service est plus que mauvais, les employés nous ignore complètement et on a toujours l'impression de les dérangers. Ils faut donner du tips à tout le monde pour recevoir ensuite. Nous sommes complètement décourager et nous voulons qu'une chose c'est de retourner à la maison. La plage est très bien et le site est magnifique.  La température est vraiment belle aussi. Nous sommes aller dans un hotel Riu a cancun l'an dernier le même groupe et nous avions eu des vacences exceptionnelles, ce n'est pas le cas cette année. Le service concierge est inutile, ne payer pas pour cela.

reviews.author: amy660
reviews.title: 5 Stars for families, 3 stars for couples
reviews.text:
"Honeymoon". I'm not very picky. Give me good beach with a bit of view of the sea, some shade and a drink and maybe a romantic dinner at a restaurant and we're happy. Overall, we're happy about the vacation -- came out feeling relaxed -- but definitely will be booking a proper Honeymoon sometime next year. 

We booked the Reserve with a prospect of a Private Beach without a hassle of fighting the rude Russians for some shade. Instead we got worse -- most of the cabanas at the Private Beach were reserved for families. Screaming children. babies EVERYWHERE. Not romantic at all. We also booked with the prospect of dinners at restaurants -- had to fight for reservations, and ironically did not have a dinner for my 30th birthday. and again at the restaurants -- screaming babies. I think it is a bit better at the "Royal Service" beach, but honestly I think next time we're opting for an Adults Only resort instead. 

Great beach, beautiful grounds -- the gentlemen in green, who kept the grounds and brought coconuts did a fantastic job. Good service by Louis and Ramon --- they made our day, by bringing drinks on the beach, always with a smile on their face and a positive attitude. Their job was not easy, on their feet all day in the sun and constantly dealing with frustrated beach goers who cannot find a cabana. Louis and Ramon deserve a raise! Louis in particular was very professional and Ramon has the best happy attitude! 

By far the most romantic part of our honeymoon was actually thanks to our Housekeeper -- Yelsy Geruan -- every day she left little flowers or towel sculpture. Also, one day we came home to a romantic bubble bath with a bottle of champagne. Fantastic! And while we were away for dinner, every day she would leave little chocolates on our pillows-- very thoughtful. 

Food at the Reserve Buffet -- Gabi restaurant --- FANTASTIC! Honestly probably better than most of the other restaurants. They had to die for lobster, caviar, ceviche, sushi, amazing selection of cheese and delicatessen. We tried them all. Don't waste your time on Mexican, the Grill or the Italian. Fuego -- latin fusion was the best. The Chinese/Japanese place was a close second. Forget the other restaurants.

Great Nightlife on the beach!!! Loved the parties under the stars. 

Overall, I think the Reserve could work on how they treat their couples and honeymooners. It could be as little as letting the waiters at the restaurant know so they can prepare something special. or maybe actually asking couples if they are celebrating something -- and then congratulating them. Just something to make it feel more than just a vacation. That is what I am hoping for in our proper Honeymoon.

reviews.author: Sharon M
reviews.title: Terrific family time on beautiful property and beach
reviews.text: We took multigenerational family of 9 for 6 nights.  We all had 'suites',  One son and wife with grandkids had concierge family service, but not special suite as we'd expected.  Concierge was very weak.  Made restaurant reservations for all nights without consulting us.  Showed up seldom, a few treats for kids.   The grounds are absolutely beautiful.  The beach is just wonderful for family fun- great sand, fun surf, good service from Reserve beach area attendants.  The "drinky, drinky, let's get drunk, family" thing got a little tiring.   But beach time was just wonderful.  Walk to beach is 7 minutes, pleasant, and can always wait for the trolley.   Suites are pretty, dark though, a bit dated, but met all needs with lots of room.   Road facing suites had next door resort music and noise till 2:30 AM.    Buffet breakfasts and lunches at several venues were full of myriad choices, something for everyone.   Food level was OK to good at those.  Restaurants fell below our expectations - we're Sandals/Beaches travelers and used to a higher level.  Mediocre was our over-all feel.  Aqua was the exception.   Sushi, 'Chinese', Teppi table, Italian - even Vento all fell pretty short on quality, but not like we starved.    Service at beach and restaurants was very attentive.   Desk help, kids' activities, activities in general were almost not there.   English seemed to be a language problem, but not sure if that was a real issue or a good way to avoid paying attention to requests.   We had a spectacular family time at a very affordable price, but most of fun was our own making.  Example:  painting on the beach activity - our 3 younger women and I showed up 15 minutes early to paint, to find only 6 easels set up, they wouldn't bring more, so only 2 of us could do the activity.  The resort had 1,000+ guests - who would set up 6 chairs after advertising the activity?  6???   That's how all the few activities that actually took place went.   There were zero planned activities for our two grandkids, 4 and 7.  Luckily, our family did a great job of making our own activities.    We did have 3-4 members have some intestinal issues - not trip ruining, but two still are dealing with it at home, despite our carefulness about bottle water.   Not nearly as big a problem as Mexico can be, but worth a mention.  Ice, icy drinks, and water poured from pitchers at meals, juices, etc. all were probably not from a bottled source.    That all said - again, we had a family vacation and tons of memories we'll cherish.  Visually, the resort is a treat to the eyes.   Everything was adequate.    We don't have a particular staff member to rave about - but, again, we felt restaurant and beach service staff were always kind and helpful.

reviews.author: Vinny L
reviews.title: good for a family getaway but could be better
reviews.text:
Although everything is inclusive, the facility has a lot things broken, the shower is leaking, no hot water shower (this is for sure everyone is complaining), broken concrete   inside the room, poor quality TV and channels, mainly the facility is not well maintained. Service is great, personnels are kind.

Some of them don't know where my room is when I first checked-in, lost in their weird building design and had asked two clerks - they don't know where it would be. This should not happen.   

Pool is clean all the time, drinks are great. Beach is clean but seawater is sandy. 

Food is just so so, yes all inclusive all you can eat, and they tried to make you feel good they have EVERYTHING, but everything is not really authenticated. A lot overcooked, you have to find what you can enjoy after couple tries. Water is salty so never drink the tap water.  

Overall, it's good for family staying if you can tolerate certain defections, it could be better.

reviews.author: Fabio O
reviews.title: nice resort but inconsistent service
reviews.text:
the resort itself is very nice but the knowledge and service level of the staff varies greatly!
We were given inconsistent and incorrect information many times during our stay.
We ordered room service breakfast our first morning here. When it finally arrived 30 mins later it was cold and was not as described in the room service menu.
The first day our room did not get cleaned even though we were out all day from 1000 to 1530.
When we called and asked for some extra soap it took 2 hours before someone came and delivered it.
When we went to the beach we found out it costs $50USD to rent a bed with shade on the beach!!
We were told by 1 person that you get clean towels from a towel barrel but then other staff said to put the dirty towels in there. We were told by our guest service person that only families could reserve the bed cabanas but then another staff member told us if there was no reserved card there we could take one.
When we arrived we were given a list of restaurants but found out the list was inaccurate as we turned out for lunch only to be told it had closed at 4 contrary to the information we had which stated it was open until 5pm.
I only mention the above as i do not think it can be rated 5 star with the above issues.
On the plus side the pool is very large and relaxing. Many of the staff were extremely pleasant and helpful, and the food is better than in the rest of the country.
In regards to the beach there are much better in the DR with no seaweed more shade from palm trees and calmer waters: Las Terrenas was by far a more beautiful  place!!

reviews.author: Cynarix
reviews.title: 3 stars and a half rating: Good
reviews.text:
We wanted to book a room at The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real, and got booked by mistake at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Melia customer service unhelpful, (who cares you are a Melia member?) and the reservation was impossible to change.
This resort is (including the grounds and the restaurants) a copy of The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. Grounds are beautiful, the beach is the same, but the suites and food are a downgrade. It's quite understandable, Palma Real charges more.
A nice resort overall but the food can be better. Especially breakfast. How difficult can it be to make a decent omlette? They invest in food quantity here not in quality.

reviews.author: 488irinas
reviews.title: Old musty and smelly rooms
reviews.text: I am a Gldr Melia member. I was sent a flyer in the mail with infro from Melia along with my Gold Card. Upon Check-in I presented the booklet which had said "welcome pack for kids upon arrival" to the front desk. Front desk said" oh, we do not have it", not even checking with anyone else, not even apologising or offering to do something else in return. So rude! Bad customer service!

reviews.author: Laura A
reviews.title: Thanksgiving Break
reviews.text:
My significant other and I went on a 10-day vacation and chose Reserve based on its rating on Trip Advisor. 

Rooms
Overall the rooms were very well-kept and modern. 

The downside were the regulations kept on modest comfort in regards to hot water and room climate control. 

There was a water temperature regulator on the shower even at its warmest setting. The result was a mild temperature shower. 

Temperature regulations on the in-room thermostat regulated the coolest setting at 72.

These things are minor in the grand scheme of things, but there should not be regulations placed on personal comfort. The air conditioning I can live with although it did get stuffy, but I prefer a hot shower. 

Staffing
Staff is highly encouraged and motivated to tell all guests to give them good reviews on TripAdvisor. Further, they hand out cards with their names asking them to be placed on TripAdvisor. I was asked multiple times to say good things and to mention names upon reviewing. I have never seen any hotel staff operate like this previously with the in-your-face approach to review. It leads me to be skeptical of skewed results and the integrity behind the resort's current ranking. 

We had a "concierge" assigned to us named Jeremy who seemed to have a chip on his shoulder upon not agreeing to spend 90-minutes of our vacation time with him to listen to a sales pitch. Being on vacation should be just that. We all have to do obligatory things in the world outside of vacation so if we do not want to waste precious vacation time listening to someone's pitch it should be accepted. It should not have resulted in the ignorant and complacent attitude that followed as a result. 

The only other staff member I would recall by name, and worth mentioning, is Ramon. He is a waiter at the beach bar and was super friendly with a positive vibe. 

Grounds
Having stayed at adults-only resorts the last couple of vacations, I will admit, I very much missed that staying at this resort. By no means do I have a problem with children. It is that it leaves very much to be desired when parents are oblivious and not mindful of badly behaved children. That being said, thankfully this was far and few between, but nonetheless something that can altogether be avoided at age-restricted resorts. 

The beach was well-maintained for the most part. Although I do have to admit, the resort next door took care of their beach maintenance with hard-working groundsmen taking the time to rake the beach by hand and remove seaweed throughout the day. Paradisus uses a tractor to remove the seaweed. It results in smelly diesel-filled air and a beach that is not cleaned as thoroughly. Unfortunately the lack of grooming further encourages the sand flies and itchy bug bites that follow. 

Food
The food was pretty lackluster and middle of the road for the most part. Understandably in order to appeal to the masses, that is the approach needed. Further, if seafood was a main ingredient in a dish, cost-cutting measures were taken to ensure the tiniest amount used. 

From memory, Aqua was one of the better and more memorable onsite restaurants. 

Overall it was a great vacation and much needed time away. I would look to other options however, if heading back to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Joseph Perkins
reviews.title: Punta Cana Paradisus by Melia
reviews.text: Very poor internet service. Restaurant booking process terrible. Look for 9:30 pm reservation times. Prepare to be sold Club membership, Reserve Membership, etc. Otherwise quality of the resort is good, beach is great and the people are super friendly but appears to be a DR trait.

reviews.author: 456mariannel
reviews.title: Bel hôtel mais...
reviews.text:
Cet hôtel est vraiment magnifique les jardins à couper le souffle tout est vraiment beau et propre! 
Ils vous propose le club Melia des votre arriver! Les coupons de 1500$ c'est vraiment pas utile! Les prix des vins des bouteilles d'alcool du spa sont tellement cher que les coupes n'en valent même pas la peine! Ils affichent beaucoup de belles bouteilles d'alcool mais rien n'est inclu dans cette sélection vous devez payer très cher! Nous étions dans la partie reserve et il y avait beaucoup de choses que nous n'avions pas Acces même dans cette partie! Exemple nous devions payer plus cher pour réserver nos places sur la plage! Nous avons une section réserver pour la reserve et en plus si vous voulez réserver vos chaises vous devez upgrader! Ca juste pas de sens comme il faut toujours payer! On paye déjà assez cher pour cet hôtel il faut en rajouter encore et encore!!
Les coupes rabais on nous avait dit qu'on aurait droit au restaurant le pallapa avec les coupons! Rendu ce soir là ils nous disent non les coupons ça fonctionne pas!!??? Vous devez payer... Encore payer....
Tres déçu...

reviews.author: WHTjr
reviews.title: Birthday party
reviews.text:
Be prepared to pay for the tips, upgrade to Royal Service to get truly premium liquor.  The other levels variety is equal to call!  Also, the food is average at best except for Rave. 

I will not return. Why because every time you tuyrn around someone's handis out for a tip.

reviews.author: Slk43
reviews.title: VERY mixed bag and FOOD POISONING!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from this resort - traveled with a group including 2 small children.  Overall, we had a very good time, but as my title indicates, it was a mixed bag.
Let me start with the positives:
1. The grounds are beautiful and very well kept
2.  Pools at the reserve are gorgeous, clean, and not crowded with plenty of very nice chairs/beds/cabanas
3.  Towels are plentiful at the pool and the beach
4.  Entertainment was fantastic - especially the Michael Jackson show, the circus show, and the dance instruction by Anthony and Happy Faith?
5.  Drinks were strong and plentiful.
6.  Music everywhere and dancing in the evenings was great.
7.  Reserve pool and pool area were much nicer and less crowded than main pool area.  
8.  Wifi was good everywhere

The negatives:
1.  While the service was sometimes great, it also often wasn't, I think because of language barriers?  It took over an hour to check in - this is ridiculous in my opinion! I also noticed major problems at the restaurants - no waiters could elaborate at all on the menu and they would bring the wrong thing fairly frequently.  One time we ordered a bottle of wine and they brought the wrong bottle three times.  
2.  I also found the whole reservation thing baffling - they lost our reservations TWICE that we had made for the entire week.  Then told us they would book us into 6 pm slots because nothing else was available.  When we went to the restaurants, they were more than half empty for the 2 hours we were there so I just don't understand what the mess and fuss was about.
3.  The food quality is POOR.  I think I am just used to a higher standard of food.  It was the same meat/fish/fruit/dessert recycled over and over again.  And it didn't differ much between restuarants.  We liked the Grill the least and Aqua the best (surprising because I'm not a huge Italian food fan).  Once at dinner, we even sent chicken back because it had clearly been fried twice and was dry as a bone.  Flavor was lacking, oily food.  The buffets were ok I guess, but food was neither hot nor cold when it was supposed to be - which leads me to the biggest gripe about the place:  out of a group of 9 people, 7 ended up with severe diarrhea and food poisoning over the course of the week!!!!!!!  
4.  Waiting for shuttles was super annoying.  The place is really big and trying to walk to the beach (at least 10-15 min walk) with 2 toddlers is tough.  
5.  Gym - I had to ask twice for them to turn on the air conditioning.  Trying to work out when the building is hotter than outside is not acceptable
6.  The beach and ocean were full of seaweed which was gross.  They were trying to clean it up, but it was just so much.

Overall, its a nice resort with bad food and food hygiene.  We had a good time because of the people we were with and the majority of the day was spent at the pool/beach.  I just really wish the food had been better.  Would not go back.

reviews.author: Leuys Taveras
reviews.title: Buen hotel con sus contras
reviews.text:
En cuanto a atención y comida es excelente, excelente atención de la joven reyes del lobby.

Desde mi punto de vista y de unas 16 personas que somos los que viajamos juntos nos parece mal que no aya musica en la piscina donde esta el bar, el que quiere tranquilidad puede visitar otra piscina o la playa.

Las habitaciones nosotros escogimos master suite real pero en realidad no entiendo para que pagamos mas que los demás no teníamos ningún privilegio distinto a los demás por una nevera y un comedor no es suficiente para uno pagar mas que una habitación estándar, el radio de la habitación muy obsoleto no pudimos hacer uso de el ya que no cuenta con bluetooth ni un cable auxiliar.

No hay ascensores en los edificios algo muy incomodo para mi y algunas personas subir tantas escaleras con unos escalones tan altos.

Pero como dije la calidad de la comida y bebida es de 1ra igual que su personal que es muy atento y amable.

Espero que mi opinión sea tomada en cuenta desde un buen punto de vista y que mejoren mucho mas!

La discoteca nos encanto pero su horario no demasiado poco hasta las 2 de la mañana.

reviews.author: santhama
reviews.title: Choses à revoir, dommage..,
reviews.text:
Un complexe magnifique avec une plage splendide mais des petites choses décevantes.
J'ai trouvé les repas peux varié et répétitif et si vous souhaitez quelques frites pour les enfants ils faut en faire la demande... 
Je souligne par contre la grande qualité du service et profite pour remercier Rose-Marie et Aila pour leurs gentillesse et leur professionnalisme.
Durant notre séjour nous avons dû changer de chambre car j'ai trouvé des cafards et le changement n'a pas été simple, aucune coordination entre les services, j'ai perdu 1 demi journée à régler le problème et obtenu des excuses uniquement de la directrice car je lui ai signalé le problème par mail.
L'hôtel et la Reserve sont en pleine rénovation mais aucune nuisance à signaler. Je trouve incorrect de maintenir les prix du spa quand les traitements ont lieu dans des chambres qui attendent d'être rénovée... Un discount s'impose !!! Si tu vas au spa c'est aussi pour le cadre.
Le sofa bed dans les chambres méritent vraiment d'être changé car une fois couché vous sentez les barres de fer. 
Je trouve pas pratique du tout d'avoir une poussette à la Reserve aucune rampe d'accès et des escaliers partout.
J'ai tout de même passé de bonne vacances et je trouve l'endroit magnifique le personnel très gentil et souriant.
Je reviendrais l'an prochain en espérant avoir de bonne surprises,

reviews.author: MIROSLAVBuenosAires
reviews.title: Demasiado caro por el servicio q ofrece
reviews.text: La verdad conociamos el hotel en playa del carmen excelente y por eso probamos en punta cana y anteriormente en cuba. La verdad una desilucion tras otra. El unico q vale la pena es el de Mexico. Cuba es como mucho un 3 estrellas el de Varadero. Y punta cana vale 3 veces mas q otras cadenas y nos dieron una habitacion interna, en planta baja y deteriorada cuando somos repetidores de esta cadena. La concierge Isabel q nos atendio no se hizo cargo de nuestra queja tampoco Ezequiel y ningun superior se comunico con nosotros al manifestarle nuestro descontento. Y eso q eramos como mucho 25 personas el hotel estaba con muy poca gente.  Despues de esperar 2 horas x la habitacion, faltaban bebidas en el frigobar, cafe en la cafetera, toallas. Recien a las 20 hs aparecieron con las cosas despues de llamar 3 veces . Y cada vez q llamas tenes q dar propinas x un servicio q es su obligacion tenerlo listo al entregarte la habitacion.  Teniamos idea de comprar la semana x la excelente experiencia de Mexico pero despues de ir a cuba y ahora darles otra oportunidad en Punta Cana definitivamente no repetiremos mas un Melia. Es muy caro, no hay buen servicio. La comida en todos los restsurantes es poca y falta variedad. No comi mariscos ni langosta ni nada q amerite semejante gasto. La estructura en gral es muy bonita muy sobria pero con lo lindo no hacemos nada!!

reviews.author: Miguel Galindo
reviews.title: Royal Service, no tan "royal" después de todo
reviews.text:
Pros: buenas y amplias instalaciones, jardines muy bonitos y bien cuidados, habitaciones amplias, excelente piscina y playa exclusiva, la atención del personal en general fue muy cordial, buena recepción.
Contras: la comida estuvo bien pero no al nivel de lo que se esperaría del Royal Service. Hay una marcada preferencia del personal y los Conserjes a atender más expedita y amablemente a algunos turistas vs. otros. Ejemplos: pude ver Conserjes que acompañaban a su grupo y lo dejaba cómodamente instalados en las mejores camas en primera línea de la playa que ya habían sido reservadas desde temprano, cuando solicité lo mismo, mi Conserje me informó que eso "no se hacía". Mi opinión: esperan que les den propinas por adelantado, lo cual no debería ser porque de por sí uno contrata un "Royal Service" a un precio más elevado para garantizar ese trato que debía ser el mismo para todos los de ese tipo de servicio. Cualquier propina debería ser extra y a criterio del turista después de haber recibido un servicio que hubiese superado las expectativas, no antes.

reviews.author: Richard P
reviews.title: Resort needs some work
reviews.text: The staff (butler, beach boys & waiters) was excellent and very helpful. The resort location and ambiance was wonderful. But the hotel rooms need to be refreshed. The towels in the bathroom were old & course from too much washing with no place them in the bathroom to hang them to dry. Our room over-looked a noisy service road rather than the Garden View we had reserved.

reviews.author: acm479
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Nothing special was done for us during our stay for our honeymoon, I felt like a regular guest and that's what I hoped to avoid. Communication was bad and could not get a clear answer on any of our questions. The buffet was horrible and making dinner reservations every night was a pain bc the restaurants would be booked so we ended up having to eat at the same place several times. Service was slow at times. If you don't go above and beyond to tip they won't even acknowledge your prescence even though they state "tip is already included" the weather was nice and the resort was very pretty. The night time experience wasn't too exciting.

reviews.author: Cassie B
reviews.title: Pretty but average service
reviews.text: The hotel and landscape are beautiful, gorgeous to take in. However we stayed part of our trip in a standard room and part in the "Royal Service". The rooms were exactly the same, both smelled of mildew. Staff was sometimes very friendly and others unaccompdating. We were supplied with a "butler" who didn't seem to handle any requests, just redirected them. Good was standard, restaurants weren't all open, flavor lacking. No food/snacks  available near lounging areas.

reviews.author: Adrian V
reviews.title: El hotel es bueno pero...
reviews.text: El hotel no es malo pero la seguridad y el personal como lo es luis el encargado del bar de la pisina  te niegan la bebida fuimos un grupo de 4 parejas y tuvimos que ir a quejarnos a recepción porque nos estaban negando el Remy Martí luego de la queja apareció la bebida luego de eso el encargado de área del bar gabi es un indecente la seguridad se nos pierden los id damos la queja al señor Mora y nos informa que no tendríamos problema y cada 5 minutos la seguridad  nos hacia la vida imposible pero ese Luis del bar de la pisina esta Bien errado ese hotel no es de el debe cambiar sí forma

reviews.author: kmyva
reviews.title: Should have been better
reviews.text:
Pros - The Kid Zone, The Kids Pool, Vento Restaurant, The pools, The grounds, All inclusive drinks, The in-villa concierge, rooms are very nice and clean

Cons - The long walk or shuttle to the beach, the response time for anything, the arrangements for pick up from airport, the random closings of restaurants, very dark at night

We called in advance for pick up from the airport and were promised a driver with a sign - no such luck.  The taxi driver did not speak english (none of them do fyi) and we were lost for over an hour.  There was also a conference happening at the resort when we arrived so we were given the back seat to everything.  Even had eat at the gross hydro grill (pool bar food) for lunch. The Kid Zone staff made up for where everyone else lacked - those ladies were so awesome!!  Make sure you tip the ones that do great!  We had a hard time getting service at the pool and at the Gabi - not sure why.

reviews.author: Humberto D
reviews.title: Seria perfeito se não fosse o roubo no quarto
reviews.text:
Comida excelente, atendimento excelente também.
O hotel é super bem cuidado e eu teria dado uma nota mais alta.
No penuútimo dia da minha estadia eu retirei 181 dólares do cofre, coloquei na bolsa da minha esposa, deixamos a bolsa na mesa do quarto e fomos tomar café. Retornamos cerca de 45 minutos depois e a bolsa continha apenas 131 dólares. O quarto estava organizado a a única pessoa a entrar no quarto foi a camareira Alessandra Silverio.
Chamamos a segurança que encenou uma investigação e concluiu o óbvio, não havia provas.
Ficamos decepcionados com a atitude do hotel que simplesmente ignorou o fato sem ao menos pedir desculpas. 
Obs importante aos novos turistas: A camareira permanece trabalhando la e parece bem amiga do chefe de segurança.

reviews.author: carvin97
reviews.title: El peor hotel que he visitado nunca!! y  si  te gusta es porque no has estado en un hotel  de  lujo de verdad!!
reviews.text: SI PONGO ESTRELLAS ES PARA QUE TODO EL MUNDO LO LEA PORQUE PARA MI ES  UN 0 !!!El personal maleducado!! el servicio a unos le servian y a otros no!! el servicio todo incluido es para los borrachos porque si no no lo amortizas.Trato diferenciado dependiendo del  pais de origen!!  Un dia la habitacion no estaba cuando llegue a las 18 h llame por telefono tardó 1 hora en venir y cuando se fue dió  un portazo, imaginate que lujo, colas para pedir restaurante y te dan la hora que quieren ellos a menos que le sueltes dinero. El bufet el mismo siempre  se salva algo los animadores pero siempre es lo mismo. Sitio aburrido !! a menos que te traigas 20 de familia jeje!! nosotros solo dos!!No volveré nunca  os lo dice alquién que ha visitado mas de 100 paises !! Cutre y carisimo 5 dias 2 personas 2500 euros !! Menudo lujo no saben lo que es!! Se me olvidaba y la playaaaa jeje lo mas sucio del mundo menudo Caribe!! Y encima te molestan cuando sales de alli. Ufff hasta nunca Punta Cana!!

reviews.author: HugoBelgiumAntwerp
reviews.title: A BIG DISAPPOINTMENT
reviews.text:
We stayed in september in the Paradisus Palma Real for almost 3 weeks with royal service.
Compared to other all inclusive hotels in Mexico and Cuba is this hotel a big disappointment.
Possitive : the staff whit a great service , the great beach and the beautiful gardens . 
The spacious room is ok but needed a up date .
All the rest i can summarize as follow : you paid to much for what you get.
Ok , we come from Europe whit another foodculture , but we could just enjoy restaurant Rare for a good steak.
It is low season but for lunch no choice , only the buffet restaurant. 
This is the ugliest building and most uninviting buffetrestaurant that i have ever seen.
All days the same cheap food , no presentation , poor hygiene .
Thank God we had royal service with restaurant Palazzo.
A higlight is restaurant Passion . We have eaten 2 times a degustation menu with matching wines and that was the extra charge well worth it.
Congratulations to manager Wander Caamano and his team .
They deliver beautiful work.
We like to drink sparklin wine . They serve in the hotel the cheapest ( with a plastic stop ) . Not to drink . Luckely there was sometimes a better alternative.
I come from Belgium , known for its many and delicious beers .Here i could choose from ONE local beer , for me it is yellow water.
The life music was virtually non existent and the plaza kolonial has changed in plaza plastic.
Tho the management : do you not now what other all in ressorts has to offer in the same price range ? Do you sleep ?.
Tho the public relations : a few days before our departure i sent 3 e-mails to 3 different adresses for a question , i get no response . Do you sleep ?. 
The most positive of this hotel is the staff with great service , always with a big smile .
PLEASE GIVE TIPS , THEY NEED IT AND DESERVE IT.
We like to specially mention :
our butlers Sandy Gil and miguel , Henry Romero from the buffet , Liony Familia 
and Francis Baez from the lobby bar , Juan the all rounder ,
Kenny De Jezus and Stefan from the bar in the Reserve 
and ofcource the Palazzo team : Jhoneidy Charles , Miguel Jimenez , Carlos Manuel ,
Marino Payans , Theodoro and the cook Alexis .
Thank all for the great service , ou deserve no 5 but 6 stars. 
.But the hotel is not more than a ( very expensive ) 3 star hotel.

reviews.author: NewYorkWsm
reviews.title: Mixed Feelings
reviews.text:
When we arrived at the hotel you could see the Asian influence in the design.  The complex consisted of over 40 2 story buildings that had about 10 units in each.  The layout, the pool and the beach are quite beautiful.  

Upon Arrival-  we got there we were first hit with their sales pitch for Royal Service at $100 extra per day or we could have a room near the beach for another $200 a day.  We were really disappointed on those tactics.   We declined and our room was a 10 minute walk to the beach or if you got lucky you could have a golf cart pick you up and drop you off.  

The restaurants and the buffets were great.  Definitely the best all-inclusive I have experienced.  I do have to mention that I have had stomach issues from the last day of my trip through the next 4 days at home.  Possibly the food or water but I don't know.  I would not suggest eating at Bana though.  I felt the food was there was substandard

Staff -  The staff was very friendly but could be inconsistent,   Our Concierge, Ezequial was never at his post and we would not be able to summon a golf cart to pick us up.  Funny thing we would run into him while we were out and around, but rarely at his post.   During the daytime our unit was a hangout for four of 5 staff members.  Not sure what any of them did.  I would like to let management know that we had a guy named Wilken as a waiter a couple of times and he was great.

Overall this place was decent, not great.

reviews.author: Haisy23
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Hotel is large for no real reason. Doesn't feel intitmate. The mini bar in the room was horrible only placing 2 cans of beer in the fridge at a time. The shower was leaking all day our entire stay. The swim up bar wasn't open for long and barely played music. No real entertainment during the day. Just not a type of stay that I am use to. The Red lounge was nice. I had my wedding here and overall had lots of fun with my friends and my wedding experience was good with the help of Natalia ! But i could've choosen a better, more up to beat resort.

reviews.author: Paul T
reviews.title: Ужин за счет заведения...
reviews.text:
После моих многочисленных жалоб на пляж, волейбольные мячи, снятие сетки волейбольной, грязи в отеле, шум при уборке, при разговорах горничных, шум от тук-туков, висящие криво полки, не работающий душ, вонючую джакузи, заболевшую от долгого check-in ребенка и супруги, на связь вышел наконец то управляющий отеля, ответственный за Guest Service Genaro Gil (Хенаро Хил (8625 или 8609)). После моего последнего обращения к Guest Service Assistant Marlena Belliard (8625, 8603, +18294707857) и моей грустной истории о том, почему я должен платить за доктора для моей дочери $130, если причина это 5 часовое заселение, она рассказала своему шефу об этом, и на пороге на следующее утро стоял доктор и менеджер. Я ему рассказал все мои претензии, он изо всех сил объяснил мне о том, что если мне что либо нужно, то я могу к нему обращаться, и как он хочет подарить мне ужин романтический в качестве компенсации. 
В результате мы договорились с ним о позднем check-out (стоит это $150 с человека, итого $300),
исправлении всех замечаний, а на романтический ужин я не стал сразу соглашаться, сказал, что зависит от самочувствия моей семьи.
В последний день мы согласились и на ужин. Ужин у бассейна. The Reserve далеко от океана, ну да ладно. Составили меню. Нарядились. Пошли. Уединение и тишина была гарантирована, романтическая обстановка тоже, даже официанта нашли со знанием русского языка. Когда принесли горячее блюдо в виде двух хвостов лобстера и ризотто из черного риса я был на пике восхищения, потому как не понимаю зачем дают тело и клешни. И вот на самом интересно месте, я вытаскиваю длинный черный прочный волос. В этот момент ко мне подошел официант и спросил как мне лобстер. Я сказал вот посмотрите.... ДА, подумал я, расскажет от своему начальнику об этом или нет. Я не особо акцентировал внимание на этом, потому как и не такое находил в еде. Выпив шампанского и вина, посидев на лежаках и посмотрев на звезды мы пошли ближе к дому....

reviews.author: eric g
reviews.title: Déçus
reviews.text:
Déçus dès notre arrivée. A 13H30, notre chambre était prête mais il ne nous a pas été possible de l'intégrer car une visite des lieux nous a été proposée. Très vite nous avons compris que cette visite était bien plus destinée à vendre des produits mélia que de nous faire découvrir le ressort. Dès que nous avons dit que nous ne serions pas intéressés par ces produits, la visite du ressort s'est arrêtée nette. Cela nous a rappelé les heures sombres du time share. L'employé qui nous dit que si l'on passe le lendemain du temps on va le valoriser... Le lendemain nouvelle tentative où nous avons fait savoir plus clairement que nous étions ici en vacances. Déçu aussi d'une bonne partie du personnel. où la courtoisie n'est pas toujours de mise. Beaucoup d'algues sargasses mais là l'hôtel n'y peu rien. Etonné aussi que l'hôtel nous fasse payer le solde lors du check in. Très déçu par les jus de fruit du petit déjeuner. A l'ibérostar nous avions du vrai jus de goyave, banane, ananas là rien de tout ça. Impossible d'accéder aux dessert, un employé doit vous servir. Problème il n'est pas toujours là et une vitre nous empêche de nous servir. Pour un 5* quelle déception. Hôtel sur dimensionné c'est à dire peu de touristes par rapport à l'infrastructure donc peu d'ambiance. pas de table de ping pong, les tennis en dehors du resort. Très peu d'animation sportives ou autres. C'était triste. C'est la première fois que j'ai l'impression de me tromper dans le choix d'un hôtel.   A chaque fois habituellement les notes trouvées sur tripadvisor correspondent aux hôtels et là j'avais plus l'impression que cet hôtel méritait bien moins que 4,5 (3?). Du coup, ce que je ne fais pas habituellement, J'ai regardé pendant mon séjour ce que j'avais raté à la lecture des critiques. J'ai été amusé de lire que des avis semblaient truqués. Je n'en ai pas été surpris. On finit toujours par être rattrapés par la vérité. Bravo à trip pour avoir depuis déclassé cet hôtel de la 7ème à la 30 ème puis maintenant la 47 ème place. Il est vrai qu'avec le recul et une relecture, on voit beaucoup d'avis laissés par des gens enregistrés en 2015 dont c'était le premier avis où l'on encense deux ou trois employés et où aucune réserve n'estprésente. Je pense avoir été trompé par cet hôtel . Très content de la réaction de trip. 
Pour être juste il existe des points positifs. Un décor grandiose, magnifique piscine des lits balinais agréables.

reviews.author: juanlb
reviews.title: Actually a step above average
reviews.text:
The hotel facilities are nice, beautiful landscaping, plenty of space, good pools. The decor is unususal in certain areas, but overall mostly pleasant.

Service is inconsistent, ocassionally great but just as often mediocre.

The food options were very limited, out of the 5 options supposedly available for lunch, only the 2 buffets were open, both of which had very similar offerings. In the evenings there were several restaurant options, but the hotel seemed to make an effort to prevent you from dining where you wanted by requiring reservations, and severly limiting availability; all this while the hotel was mostly empty.

reviews.author: dynik
reviews.title: Elegant but weary
reviews.text: No, not happy.  The safe had to be replaced, we have a room in the back, the pools of water are stagnant and smell bad and the great restaurants are charging a premium above what we are paying which is high. Loved the buffet, the music was excellent but too repetiitive, and we are somewhat disappointed.  Staff is friendly..

reviews.author: Suzyqnaptown
reviews.title: Fell short in many ways
reviews.text:
This place was very good, but they have the potential to be much better. I had very high expectations since the other reviews were so high, but the first day and half were ROUGH. I traveled here in August on my honeymoon, using my mother-in-law's "points" from REI to book the all-inclusive trip. I had read that upon check-in, the staff strong arms you into a sales presentation, but we experienced NONE of that. We were very relieved! The check in process was relatively smooth. Our luggage was in our room when we arrived to our beautiful first-floor suite. The only issue I noticed was there was a dirty paper plate in one of the wet bar cupboards, leading me to assume the maids had not done such a great job cleaning our room before our arrival. It was a bit unnerving to find the last guests' trash in our honeymoon suite, but I digress. We were supposedly assigned a concierge who would make all of our dinner resos. You have to have reservations at all of the non buffet-style places, which nobody told us our first day. I strongly recommend to management to have an Orientation class/meeting upon check-in that explains all of this to the guests. It was frustrating and left me almost in tears the first couple of days. We just felt lost! This is a huge resort and they kind of throw you to the wolves if you don't ask for help. After going to a restaurant on the No-No list the first night, and feeling a bit confused we sought out our concierge named Jirimy. He said he would make our dinner reservations for us each night, trying to get us in a variety of places so we could try all of them during our 6 night stay. He made the dinner reservation for that evening, but we had to hunt him down on the rest of the days to get reservations. It seemed like he would automatically do this, but that was not the case. The food was mostly delicious, but as others have stated, you may want to take some Immodium as we were "sick" just about every day. I couldn't go on the Catamaran excursion one of the last days because of the diahhrea. And that could be from the water. Only drink BOTTLED WATER and NO ICE! I thought it was odd they didn't ever offer ice in the drinks, but now I get it. The water there is no bueno. 

The other huge concern that stifled our trip was the LACK OF service at the swim up bar at the pool at the Reserve. We brought $500 cash to spend on tipping, and we ALWAYS tipped. For the first few days, there was only one bartender at that bar and we would wait 20 minutes to get drinks. This is unacceptable. There was a sweet woman who worked there wearing a white outfit and a colored belt. I hailed her over and told her the bar service was way too slow. She said she would look into it.

The next few days as we became more accustomed to the staff and such, the service improved. We had our favorite bartenders and they were so much fun and treated us like royalty! There is a bartender that worked at the beach pool and sometimes at the beach bar, named Danger Fully. HE WAS THE BEST. Made us lots of great drinks...try the Danger Vacation, Danger Relax, Danger Blue, Danger White, etc etc LOL. He had a great personality and we pretty much followed him to whichever bar he was working because he was so fantastic. 

They arranged a special Honeymooners Dinner for us at the exclusive restaurant. It was 9 couples who were all on their honeymoon. The server walked up to our table with a bottle of sauvingnon blanc, which is my favorite wine. I had ordered a glass the day before at lunch and I think they made note...he smirked when I asked him "How did you know?" It was cute. 

We went on a dolphin excursion which was definitely a highlight of the trip. They have a station at the Reserve that sets up the excursions for you. You must swim with dolphins!

I have seen many complaints about having to take a trolly to the beach from the Reserve and that there were long wait times. We never waited longer than 5-10 minutes. It wasn't a problem for us. If you find that you are waiting longer than that, tell the concierge and he will make a call.

We ordered room service one night, and they never showed. We also requested more beer in our fridge and they stocked it a couple of times. That was great. The Presidente local beer was good.

Take bug spray, the mosquitoes are really bad there. This is not the resorts fault!!

I also recommend to management to note that the pool water is TOO HOT!!! When it's 90 degrees out and the water is 91, it's gross. We spoke to one of the employees who was on break about this and he made a comment about "too much pee" in the pool. That's what if felt like on certain days. Cool off that water somehow. It's not refreshing.

The only other issue I have, which I would like to be contacted by management, is were were supposed to receive a credit because we arrive a day later that we were supposed to. They took my credit card info and the credit was something like $260. It has now been almost 3 weeks and I have not received any credit.

I wanted to LOVE LOVE LOVE this place, but they fell short in many ways. When you pay for all-inclusive and it's your honeymoon, you want to feel pampered at every turn. At least we had each other and ended up having  a great trip, but I don't know if we would go back.

PS. The ocean water is not clear blue in the slightest. It's full of algae and brown. You have to travel to some other island areas to get that pacific blue experience. This is not the Resort's fault (they clean it up periodically, this is just the nature of the DR). But if you are expecting clean beaches with sparkling water, you won't see that off the resort's coast.

reviews.author: Antonio D
reviews.title: Epectativas se quedan en el camino
reviews.text:
Error en la Reserva, la hice 3 meses antes y ni siquiera sé quien tiene la culpa, posiblemente mía. No la comprobé hasta que me entregaron el formulario en el avión de inmigración.
Solicité el cambio y el Jefe de Recepción D. Silvio Lantigua, me mintió diciendo que el Hotel The Reserve Palma Real estaba lleno. Y resulta que estaba vacío. Hasta cerraron el Gabi Club en The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real por las noches por no haber gente. 
Por lo demás todo bien.
Aclarar a la dirección de TripAdvisor, que me han borrado este comentario argumentando lo siguiente:
"Aunque sin duda agradecemos tu contribución, ha llegado a nuestra atención que tu opinión incluye puntuaciones de características del establecimiento que no llegaste a probar durante esta visita, como por ejemplo la calidad del sueño cuando no pasaste allí la noche, o la calidad de la comida, cuando no llegaste a probarla. Siguiendo nuestra política, hemos eliminado tu opinión al descubrir esta inconsistencia".

Precisamente he calificado de magnífica la calidad del sueño, ya que estuve 3 días de los 10 de mis vacaciones viviendo en The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana y los otros 7 conseguí el cambio en Servicio real y con el Club Melia a The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real.
Por lo tanto he dormido y comido, no como dicen como excusa para borrar una crítica que ni he dormido ni comido en este lugar.
Si hay un sitio donde se publican experiencias, hay que aguantar las buenas y las malas. Dichas por supuesto con educación y veracidad.
Si me llegan a borrar esta opinión de nuevo, no me quedará otra opción que publicar en todos los foros la política de TripAdvisor, que ya se está cuestionando de favorecer a algunos establecimientos en perjuicio de otros.
Un saludo

reviews.author: Susan W
reviews.title: Middle of the Road
reviews.text: Spent 7 days at this resort.  Though very beautiful,  it sits on the rough Atlantic Ocean with mass amounts of seaweed...not what one is expecting traveling to "paradise!" The resort is an "armband resort." This ment that everyone didn't have access to all pools, quality liquor, and restaurants. This idea doesn't sit well with me.  Too much money was spent to feel like an outcast. The service was hit or miss.  I am blaming the lack of minimal service on upper management.  These people are willing to help just not properly trained.

reviews.author: Jamilcade
reviews.title: Excursão a Isla Saona pela Blue
reviews.text: Comprei pelo Hotel a excursão e sou avisado de acordar as 06:30 am, porém já são 08:20 e nada deles chegarem. Total desrespeito com horário !! Péssimo negócio acordar cedo de férias por um serviço mal prestado !!! Nota 3 pro hotel que trabalha com empresas incompetentes !!

reviews.author: amandahA4678WP
reviews.title: Beautiful resort w sub par staff
reviews.text: Its a beautiful resort with beautiful water. The "experiences" they sell you are a scam. The Royal Service is a butler, who does nothing for you. The concierge tries to sell you on an hour time share lunch. Do not trust anyone that says "trust me", or believe them when they say that they will take care of it. The people at the help desk are generally rude, if you can get their attention at all. The beach waiters are there for ONE drink a day. After you give them a tip...they are gone. Everything sounds nice, but there is ALWAYS a catch.

reviews.author: Kim P
reviews.title: Not As Awesome as Expected
reviews.text:
We booked 7 nights to celebrate our 25th anniversary through Expedia. We had a luxury junior suite and the room was unbelievably disappointing. The toilet had a major leak which we managed to keep under control with towels.  We called for service and someone promptly came to repair it, but ultimately it still leaked although not as bad. 

There were 2 TV's in our room - living room and bedroom.  Neither worked and we only had one remote.  I called to request a DVD player because I had brought some movies to watch during the evenings. They brought one, but without a remote and the DVD's would only play in French. The sofa in the living room area was like sitting on a board.  Very uncomfortable.  I was looking forward to doing some reading in the room, but there just wasn't a comfortable spot to be in.

The walls of the room were paper thin and we could hear everything in the next room. 

The free WiFi was pretty terrible. I brought my tablet and couldn't really use it because the signal kept dropping out.

The grounds outside our room were not impressive due to several trash bags being heaped on the side of the walkway and one of the reflective pools was dry so the view wasn't too pleasing.

Like others before me, the seaweed on the beach and in the water was so utterly disappointing.  There was so much seaweed that they had heavy equipment sweeping the edge of the beach to make piles of seaweed.

I took advantage of their amazing pool which was always clean and not very busy so I felt like I had lots of room to swim around. 

The service was outstanding for the buffets and the restaurants. The waiters and waitresses were there for our every need and that was truly one of the best features of this all-inclusive resort.  Jhonatan A. Costa was amazing and we looked forward to seeing him every time we visited the buffet. You can't ask for a better waiter.

Overall the reviews for this property were a deciding factor in why we visited this resort and I came away very disappointed for the money I paid for this vacation.

reviews.author: eddieliv
reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.text: We went to this resort for my son's wedding. The resort is very spread out so everyone we traveled with were in different buildings even though we requested to be close to each other. Most of the rooms are in 3 story buildings with no elevators. First resort I've stayed at where I didn't have a nice view. The grounds were well kept, the pool and restaurants we went to were nice. I wouldn't travel there again. The resorts I've stayed at in Mexico are just as nice, less expensive, closer and the views are basically the same, white sandy beaches, beautiful turquoise water. Again this is the first resort I've stay at didn't have a nice view.

reviews.author: DOC_SGM
reviews.title: Not a real family place
reviews.text: There were far too many challenges starting with our dealing with RCI and the fallout/domino effect from it.  Several of the staff did the best they could to make things better, but not worth the all-inclusive fees paid for a family of 5 adults and two kids as well as not being able to take advantage of all options of the package.

reviews.author: edwardh409
reviews.title: not a 5 star resort
reviews.text: I'm not very picky and don't travel that much, but have been to 5 star resorts before and this is not one of them.  Although you should only expect so much with all inclusive deals, I just wasn't impressed with the food.  There was only one kind of beer in the entire resort.  It may have been a seasonal thing, but the beaches were not what I had envisioned.  I probably wouldn't go back.

reviews.author: Ian B
reviews.title: A deal is not a deal at Palma Real
reviews.text:
I attend a week long conference at the resort but to meet connecting flights I extended for a day. I was offered the extra day at $282 a night and this was taken from my credit card straight away so no disputes about the price. Went to checkout the next day and was told they need an extra $40 as THEY made a mistake and offered and charged me the wrong rate. 

The manager did not seem to be perturbed that this practice is unacceptable ethically and probably illegal any where else in the world. The manager was polite but not going to budge nor get my taxi and only after a long long discussion agreed it was there mistake and apologised. So given they would not get a taxi to allow me to get my flight I paid. It kind of felt like a polite hostage situation.

I can only assume they make them pay for mistakes like this. The bottom line is a deal is not a deal at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort, it's just a starting point for further negotiations.

It was a shame as I found the place well appointed and serving staff helpful and polite. Not so pleased with reception but maybe I am a bit scared from above incident.

Had one other incident with a maid entering the room when I was asleep. Scared the hell out of me. Probably a language thing as I said no turn down but really needed to put the sign out.

There is definitely however Dominican time and organising even the most basic things can be challenging. In fact it reminds me of Fiji, except in Fiji they follow normal commercial practices and would have at least done something to fix their mistakes. Bulla.

reviews.author: Alberta O
reviews.title: Jr suite problems
reviews.text: We recently returned from this resort having stayed there previously but at the Reserve. The hotel jr suite we received was in dire need of refurbishing. The shower leaked , even after calling to repair it. The toilet didn't always flush. Room was very dim and not all the lights worked. Flies in room. Not enough towels. Mildew smell in the room. Most of the staff were very friendly especially Georges Alrich who worked the pool and beach. The food and liquor served were excellent. We will return to Punta Cana again but not this hotel.

reviews.author: Sheila-Danny
reviews.title: Anniversary #36
reviews.text:
The Good:
Beautiful property
Good All-inclusive food
Rooms are nice
Service very good...Juan Suarez was a great guy and great waiter...
Beach is beautiful
Free wifi
Towel service surprisingly good for an all inclusive...normally they run out late afternoon.

The Not So Good:
Paper Cups for drinks at the pool....real bummer...drinks at the pool were not as good as most resorts we have visited...did we mention paper cups....bummer
Seaweed terrible....the resort has no control over this...we were at the Now Larimar at Christmas and the same problem....our mistake thinking it had gone away....we have a pool at home and went to enjoy the ocean....not possible.
Not a lot of activities...we compare this base on other all inclusive (13 total)
The Japanese restaurant was hot...food was good....could not eat dessert due to sweating...went to buffet and got dessert.
We had a great room at what we think was the prime location on the whole resort 1014....not royal service but convenient to everything...not noisy or heavy traffic. We still are trying to figure the draw to the royal service or the reserve...??? The main pool was full of people from the reserve and they have to ride a golf cart to get there...go figure. 
Entertainment was Good...we are early to bed early to rise...so not a big deal.
Would we go back...not until they get rid of the paper cups...even though we went down the beach to a local shop and bought 2 insulated cups...Seaweed has got to be gone.
Took a day trip....all day 11.5 hours from pickup to drop off to Catalina Island...an absolutely beautiful place...no paper cups...flimsy plastic, good food.Great snorkeling.
A lot of good things about this resort but when you have visited 13 you really start noticing and discussing the differences. Tipping is the rule...not the acceptation...we always tip so no big deal here either.

reviews.author: NHJimmy
reviews.title: Great Vacation Avoid The Melia Club Presentation
reviews.text: The Reserve is a beautiful property- the beach, pool and room were truly first rate. We had a family concierge - Sandra. She was available, kind and attentive. She set up dinner reservations, made sure we had a cabana at the beach and was friendly and warm to our 12 year old girls. She was an excellent illustration of the first class service throughout the property. The Paradisus experience was positive - well staffed and friendly service throughout. A few words of warning - don't get tricked into the presentation on the Melia Club - it was high pressure, failed to promptly deliver any message and was truly miserable. We attempted to get up and leave and they literally tried to stop us, claiming multiple levels of management were necessary to approve our exit. It was terrible.  The food was also sub-par. We had no problem with dinner reservations, eating at the Mexican, Italian, Japanese, Mediterranean and Dominican dinner options, but all fell well below food you would get at an average dinner at home. The best bet was simply the buffet where the food was plentiful and acceptable. The Paradisus does a wonderful job establishing tranquil spaces for rest and relaxation throughout the property. The grounds are exceptionally safe and well maintained. Real thought was applied to the layout of all the buildings. The room was better than the photos in line. We ran into kind staff at the beach and during Dance lessons where Antonio was a real character, entertaining in three languages to his small class of French, English and Spanish speaking students. Overall, we would recommend it so long as travelers do not have a high expectation of the dinner options and steer clear of high pressure sales tactics.

reviews.author: ODahveed
reviews.title: Family visit
reviews.text: This place is trying to compete with Las Vegas, which says it all. If you like Vegas you'll like this place. Positive: Rooms are very large, comfortable, and even a bit luxurious. Service is great and friendly. Pools are great and laid out in a way that it never feels crowded. Negative: the ocean is really bad, filled with seaweed and murky water, with zero visibility. Food is just ok.

reviews.author: lotsoftravel2015
