reviews.title: Beautiful resort - staff not as wonderful
reviews.text:
First let me start by saying the grounds of this resort and the beach were beautiful. Yes there was sea grass, but the beach was gorgeous! Was hard to find a chair at the pool, but only because people reserved chairs they didn't seem to use.
In terms of staff, I was very disappointed. Making dinner reservations was insanely difficult and everyone staff member gave you a different answer. They kept calling a manager Mr. Domingo who was AWFUL! He would assure us that the problem was resolved, but was just saying whatever we wanted to hear to make us go away. This lack of quality customer service was unacceptable. On two occasions, Mr. Domingo said he would take care of our reservations and have the confirmations delivered to the room. He flat out lied. This never happen!! Finally, Carlos helped me remedy the issue, but this was after two days of complete frustration. We weren't asking for something crazy, rather ANY reservation. At the beach, I do not want to spend hours dealing with staff who do not follow through just to have a place to eat dinner. Once we went to the sushi place which was awful and then were given heck by staff at a different restaurant because we wanted to change restaurants. This is the worst service I have ever had in regards to restaurants at an all inclusive. 
Both my mother and I also go sick while at the resort. Who knows what it was, but 24 hours of being sick was definitely a bummer on the vacation. I had to fight with room service to deliver something basic to the room because we were sick. 
In summary, gorgeous resort, but they have a lot of work to do in the customer service arena.

reviews.author: rajasha1
reviews.title: A nightmares
reviews.text: the rooms need repair had to move to another room tub leak water did not drain wet bar drinks hot no black out certain or screens Room service poor long wait  No a/c in dinning area the airport was hot and no a/c just fans

reviews.author: BigWayne1923
reviews.title: Lacks Customer Service
reviews.text:
I must say the resort is beautiful. But looks can be deceiving when it comes to front desk customer service. 
I arrived at 2pm and was told that the room will be assigned at 3pm. I returned at 3pm and then told that I had to wait another 30 minutes to get a room. At this very moment, I noticed everyone else that arrived after me get their room assignment. When I asked, I was told I had to wait. No clear cut answer as to why. 
After a short wait, I was given a room that was part of a wedding block of rooms. I returned to the front desk and questioned why am I given a room with a wedding party if I had an independent booking not involved in the wedding block. I was not given a straight answer either. Long story short I got a room at 6pm. By this time I was upset and had a buzz from drinking waiting for a room. 
I must commend the wait staff and bartenders for their tireless work ethic and always greeting with a smile. 
Buffet restaurant lacks variation of foods. They served the exact same thing every day for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Getting a reservation for dinner at any of the restaurant is nearly impossible. I spent 3 days trying to get dinner reservations for the Rare Steakhouse. And a after getting on the list, we enter the restaurant and it's half empty. Boggles my mind as to why they are being selective when making reservations and given guest a hard time. 
Lack of music near the open areas such as the pools and swim up bar area. Even when I asked, I was told the entertainment staff controls the music. Which they only turn it on when the come at noon and do there cheesy water aerobics. Same routine as in every other resort. Time to come up with a different routine. 
Everything is over priced for generic products and services. $30 U.S. Dollars for 6 oz sunscreen, etc. Spa services are outrages with their prices. I had $150 spa credit and when I booked a spa on the beach, I was told I could not use them as this was a special. I said okay and I booked the special price massage for $60 per person for $25 minutes. After the massage I go to pay and I get a bill for $81 U.S. Dollars. When I refused to pay and asked why am I paying that amount and not what I was told she stated that oh she didn't know. Hmmm this did not sit well with me. Please read everything before signing anything. She was quick to point out sign here and initial here meanwhile covering the total on the receipt. 
A few other minor things but overall beautiful property lacking customer service.

reviews.author: Navigate585883
reviews.title: experience was a little bumpy
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real, but had a few service issues.  When checking in we asked about upgrading our room & the only option presented to us cost over $170 per person/night.  We understand if the hotel was completely booked, but it wasn't per the staff.  We were willing to spend some money and had $500 My Time credits, that they continually reminded us we could apply, but spending an additional $3000 wasn't worth it.  The attitude at the front desk changed towards us when we said we weren't interested in spending the additional $3000.  When we finally got to our actual room we had to laugh.  It was really far from the lobby on the 3rd floor and it smelled terrible outside our door (we think they dumped old seaweed nearby).  It was also very dark walking down all of these outside hallways at night!  Maybe we should have paid the additional $3000.

We also had issues with making dinner reservations.  The first 2 nights we were there we couldn't get a reservation at any of the restaurants (even though the restaurants seemed relatively empty).  The next 2 nights our reservations were at 9:30 and we have kids (not babies) so we ate most of our meals at the buffet.  I emailed the property prior to arriving about making reservations because of reviews I read, but never received a response.

We did enjoy some of the pool activities - loved the water aerobics, zumba/dance lessons!  It was a fun atmosphere for the family.

Overall the vacation was fine, but the experience was a bit oversold on the TripAdvisor reviews.

reviews.author: 137Mike
reviews.title: Goods and Bads - Martin Mercedes #1
reviews.text: The grounds are very nice and well kept. Pool areas are clean and the water nice and warm. Beach is ok, Seems like in July and August they have a lot of seaweed in the water that washed up on the beach. Not a pretty sight. They have 2 sections, the reserve which is away from the beach but the nicer area. More for honeymooners and couples. Our section was nice also. Our room was very large and spacious. A little dated in areas that need attention. Our kids room had 2 broken lamp shades that were held together by tape. Furniture was a little beat up in places. Not picking on the resort but to be a 5 star resort then it must stand up to up keeping. Buffet was good not great. Many selections that were prepared nicely and plenty to each. After a couple of days you get tired of looking at all tis food. We also tried the restaurants, Vento, Rare, Aqua and the Japanese place. The first 3 were good not great. The Japanese was horrible. We did come across a busboy/waiter Martin Mercedes who was absolutely fabulous. Always had a smile and was very helpful. If you do decide to go make sure you see Martin and sit in his area. Wonderful young man. That's why I always said to him that Martin is #1.

reviews.author: Sakman73
reviews.title: Not all it's made out to be
reviews.text: I spent 6 days there last week with my family and was not particularly impressed.  While the grounds were very nice and clean, the overall amenities of the property were not great.  If you weren't there to eat and drink all day, there wasn't very much to do.  The gym was average, as was the spa.  The facilities for children were below average.  For example, they didn't have one slide for kids to use in the pool other than a few in the kiddie pool that was all of 24 inches deep.  The family concierge (Diosmery) was very good and pleasant , but didn't seem like we had access to things we couldn't otherwise do ourselves.  The restaurants scaled from good (Fuego and Bana Tepanaki) to poor (Bana Wok), but by the end of the week, all of us were suffering from stomach discomfort or worse.  The desserts at each place, including the buffets, were below average.  Also, while we there, the resort suffered a severe seaweed invasion which caused the beach to be closed for a couple of days.  All in all, won't be going back.

reviews.author: jiggi86
reviews.title: Beautiful but not worth quality
reviews.text:
This resort is stunning. Gorgeous views, comfortable accommodations and the friendliest staff.

However, their food is simply not good. Nothing tastes as it should and will most likely make you sick or nauseous at least once. Even the nicer restaurants had sub par food. Nothing to be impressed about. The drinks are very watered down and also taste 'off.' For the amount you're paying for the all inclusive experience, it's definitely not worth it. There are many other cheaper resorts that are still beautiful and cost half as much. Or better yet, take a cruise, you'll get the all inclusive and paradise experience but with excellent dining.

The beach was also very dirty, tons of algae everywhere that you had to trudge through just to get into the water. But obviously that's Mother Nature not the resort's fault ;)

reviews.author: Romy C
reviews.title: Decepcionante si ya fuiste a la Reserva de Palma Real
reviews.text:
No tiene punto de comparación con The Reserve de Palma Real. Las habitaciones son las mismas que las del Paradisus Palma Real, y no se parecen en nada a las de la Reserve (en especial la bedroom suite). Si no hubiera sido por el gerente de atención al cliente Silvio, realmente la hubieramos pasado mal.
Ahora, como hotel para ir en familia, no está mal; aunque, claro, si conoces The Reserve de Palma Real, no los compares.

reviews.author: komo5
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, but with aggressive sale pitch and bad food!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a 7 day vacation at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  After reading the overwhelmingly wonderful reviews from previous guests  we were expecting a near perfect vacation, unfortunately things fell a bit short.  First for the good... The rooms are amazing!  Well Appointed, very comfortable bedding, excellent air conditioning and most of all huge!  We booked 2 rooms for our family of 5 with three teens (14-19.) Our room with 1 king had a very nice private bedroom area and an adjoining living area with a sofa, table chairs, sink and mini bar stocked with beer, soda, water, milk and snacks.  Our kids room with 2 queen beds, had an ENORMOUS living area with 2 couches, a full dining room size table and 2 bathrooms!  More than enough room but oh so nice!!  (The distance to the beach however is another story.. It's about a 11 minute walk to the beach. The trolly comes by occasionally to pick you up but is still a hassle walking that far of a distance.) The Beach was gorgeous, wide, soft powdery sand and plenty of lounge chairs and thatched umbrellas. The surf got progressively rougher toward the end of the week but the waves were still relatively mild compared to the east coast waves we are used to. Plenty of pools at this resort and all had swim up bars which were great! The weather was also perfect, mid 80's to 90's all week, with 1 or 2 quick showers. Finally, no mosquito issue.  We brought several cans of OFF with us and they stayed in the suitcase the entire time.

Now for the bad:  This resort, unlike others we have stayed at, really tries to micro-manage your stay. As soon as we arrived at the resort, we were whisked into a lounge, offered a cold drink and and then began to get the "sales pitch."  Did we want the concierge service, "it's only 1,000.00 more? (side note, unless you have young children that need entertained it is totally not necessary.) When did we want to schedule our time to talk about the Melia Resorts time-shares, etc.. The staff was quite pushy, called us at 8:00am, followed us around at the beach to get us to sign up for the "presentation." My advise, be firm up front that you are not at all interested!  Food and Restaurant Bookings were another huge negative! The food was fair to awful!  Every buffet had the same awful selections every day.  Breakfast consisted of a runny scrambled eggs, fatty bacon, hash browns (exactly like McDonald's) assorted breads, and other basic breakfast stuff along with sweaty cheese slices, under ripe fruit and of all things corn on the cob.  Lunch was just as bad, no queso and chips, sandwiches or burgers, just vats of various casserole looking things fruit and dessert.  The Ala Cart restaurants, when you could get them because the staff at the resort assigns restaurants to you each night without your input, are slightly better but still offer that same fruit and mediocre desserts along with really bad cuts of meat. The alcohol at the resort is sub-par. Stick with beer and wine as the mixed drinks were not good... either way too sweet, watered down or inferior quality liquor.  

Finally.. the really bad.  We were super cautious and drank/used bottled water for drinking/brushing teeth, etc but all of us came down with severe traveler's diarrhea.  Could have been the ice or undercooked foods or raw veggies left out too long.. who knows.. just a word of caution.

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: NOT FOR KIDS , RECYCLED FOOD, no dominican feel .
reviews.text: A wedding resort for your pictures not worth Staying in Paradisus Suite Fancy shower not so fancyjets in shower are kinda clogged there goes your room cleaniness Front desk ehh dnt waste your money!!!

reviews.author: donnellas2015
reviews.title: My stay at your resort.
reviews.text: the facility is beautiful, grounds well kept, beach was wonderful.  My main issue is the poor quality of customer service, staff seemed too confused in most situations.  Being polite and friendly doesn't count for much if it takes too long to get anything done.

reviews.author: ewonggarvin
reviews.title: Decent 1st experience at an all-inclusive resort
reviews.text:
The beauty of an all-inclusive resort is you don't have to plan your meals ahead of time or worry about a huge tab at the end of each meal! 24/7 room service is a plus. Paradisus is very family-oriented resort. We went with a group of 25 people, including 8 kids. The kids had a blast at the pool. 

Naos buffet had a great variety of fresh food. Loved the sweet mangos and coconut ice cream. Resort was not crowded. Plenty of cabanas but reserve ahead of time. Night life at Gabi beach. Daily activities and events are posted by guest services in the lobby. Unfortunately, there were a ton of seaweed along the beach. Extra $40 per person if you request for a late checkout. Normal checkout is at noon. 

Shopping
You can find inexpensive larimar jewelry (earrings, bracelets) for $5 each at flea markets on both ends of the beach. Make a left to Pirates market, 5 min walk. Free shuttles to the mall. I only came her to shop for larimar jewelry. Vouchers were worthless. Attempted to use a voucher at Maraka store at the mall. Salesperson said it only applies to souvenirs and not larimar jewelry. They also have Dominican night where local vendors display their handcrafted items at the resort. 

Taxi 
Quick to get a taxi back to the airport for $30. No need to arrange ahead of time. 

Tourist visa - $10/person to enter
Departure tax $20 already included in your airfare. 

Making dinner reservations was a nightmare. Attempt to make reservations before you arrive. Most of these restaurants were disappointing. Nothing to rave about. 
Fuego - Salty but huge portions. My lobster was overcooked. 
Bana - Nice atmosphere, decent appetizers but sushi was average
Vento - Decent food. No shorts or flip flops. Men must wear slacks. 
Rare - Couldn't get reservations

Leaky ceiling on the one day it rained. Didn't have such a great Spa experience at Yhi. My masseuse was not experienced at giving me a deep tissue massage for $200 (after the $50 spa voucher).

reviews.author: sandreabril2016
reviews.title: ES UN HERMOSO HOTEL PERO NO LO RECOMIENDO LEAN MI OPINION
reviews.text:
No recomiendo ningún hotel cuyas playas den sobre el océano Atlantico. Punta Cana sufre una invasión de algas,desde hace algunos años, a tal punto que 2 veces al día pasan cosechadoras para recoger las que quedan en la costa. Horrible bañarse alli, el olor es desagradable y se llena de bichos.Y las algas se enriedan en uno.El agua entonces es verde amarronada. Un espanto.
Vayan a Hoteles que den sobre el mar Caribe. 
En cuanto a este hotel, es muy linda su arquitectura y la comida excelente, pero mala la limpieza, la seguridad y la playa horrible. no olvidemos que es un hotel de playa.

reviews.author: barleybuddy
reviews.title: Half good, half not so good
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, room spacious and accommodating, however for the first few days, the resort was completely understaffed.  All staff members were kind and made attempts to satisfy guests, but we witnessed many grumblings and complaints by other guests as well.  It was difficult to get towels and toiletries.  We did not meet our family concierge until we specifically requested and advised that he had not made an appearance.  We were reassigned to an alternate family concierge, Estephania, and she was fantastic.  The kids did not have the usual welcome gift on arrival and did not have robes, etc.  Yes, its the little things that we expected...and that we paid for the expectation.  I hate to ask for things that should already be in the room or be provided by the resort.  The beach and activities are quite a distance and we rarely ventured out due to the lack of shuttle service.  On many occasions, we waited 15-20 minutes for a shuttle--with small and hungry children.  As a positive, the food was amazing and the people could not have been nicer and willing to help.

reviews.author: Avid Traveler
reviews.title: Not as good as advertised
reviews.text: Rooms not cleaned, only ate at the buffet because if you don't have royal service, you get no service. If you need anything, ask Marco Florentino at the check in desk. He's the only one that knows what he's doing.

reviews.author: Mary J
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but lack of detail and staff attitude subpar
reviews.text:
Just returned this week from 6 nights at the hotel. You will see some reviews that royal service is the "way to go" but with the price I paid without Royal, I expected more! Especially compared to other resorts. 

1. Before my stay I tried to contact hotel several times, but website had wrong email addresses, when you call hotel they just answer in Spanish. It was very frustrating, finally got to someone by posting a message on FB page of resort.
2. Check in--I am Melia Rewards member and was told by pre checking in, very fast check in, no lines. INCORRECT, had to fill out forms, and wait in line.
3. The whole stay-it was the lack of checking and details in room. Missing umbrella when it was raining, so had to wait for one to be delivered. One night they totally missed nightly room service. 5 days out of 6--when they stocked the towels, didn't even stock many. Frig with beverages--shelves sticky. on arrival, phone not working. Just the little things that made it really annoying. Also they don't tell you  not to use water for brushing teeth, just noted in the really small print in hotel guide. 
4. When we checked in were told "come down here quickly to make dinner reservations we are gone at 5. Then we were told all restaurants booked, Only had one choice besides buffet. Were told that on Sunday could make it for rest of week. Well Sunday i called right away, like 20 times, no answer. Had to take time out of my vacation to wait in line to get dinner reservations at restaurants. Were told again that most full. So when we complained and said the restaurants are barely full, they said well most of the the reservations are from the Royal guests who don't show up, so you can walk up to the restaurants every night and just ask if they can get you in. WISH SOMEONE SAID THAT TWO DAYS EARLIER!!
5. lack of staff by the main pool to get drink orders. 
6. lack of staff by GABI Beach bar taking drink orders
7. main lobby bar, three staff members standing by bar, but didnt go up to us in the bar to ask us if we wanted more drinks.
8. Attitude. Some of the staff great, but every time asked for things--generally the attitude was like we were putting them "out". A few excpetions, but generally attitude very poor.

Pros:
1. location and property beautiful
2. Food at restaurants (non buffet) very good
3. Nightly entertainment very good!

Overall had a great time, but daily it was just annoyances like above that made me say I would not stay there again.

reviews.author: jessica s
reviews.title: Don't let the Beauty fool you!!!!
reviews.text:
I stayed here with my husband and two boys ages 10 and 16 yrs old from July 7-14. We were truly amazed by the beauty when we arrived, as you can see from the pics posted by others of the entrance to the hotel. This and a few of the workers saved the rating from being poor. One particular person was Davidson from the buffet, he is truly a gem to this hotel, always with a smile, had our table ready everyday. Food at the buffet is repetitive and either under cooked or over cooked (mini pancakes can be used as frisbees that's how hard they were. All other restaurants require reservations and aren't good. Rare was the only one where we actually left a little satisfied. We booked to excursions one with Ivan to Adventure Park and the other with Matias..So let my nightmare begin.. we booked an excursion to Adventure Boogies with MATIAS he works in the lobby (please remember this name people). The day of our trip it was raining, he told us we would get picked up at 2:20 pm. We are walking in the lobby, we get on a bus that is covered with the plastic thing that doesn't let you get wet. Another guy comes and tells us no its another bus, we go in the back this one doesn't have the plastic thing to protect you from the rain, yet we are still oblivious to anything, he starts driving to the exit but we are getting soaked, he tells us to try to squeeze in the passenger side with him (husband, son 10 yr. old, and I, my older son didn't fit so he rode in the back getting soaked). It was probably a 30 min. ride, driving at 90 mph. We get to a place that is a lot with no sign, it's empty with 6 guys and a woman. they are just staring at us.. at this point my heart is racing because i know that this is not what i paid for.. He sent us to Refine Racers a bootleg excursion. I inform the driver to take us back to the hotel. to make a long story short, went back gave me my money back. Paradisus  needs to fire this guy!! False propaganda!!

There is not much entertainment, all ends at 11 pm. then there is nothing to do but sit in the lobby or go to the club. 

Beach was horrible.. but you can't blame that on the hotel, they tried to clean the seaweed, but I've never ever seen so much seaweed in my life it was mountains! 

I'm really surprised at all the excellent reviews this hotel received.. I would not recommend this hotel or return to this hotel and I go to Punta Cana every year. Don't let beauty fool you!! Management can contact me regarding the Matias situation, don't let one rotten apple ruin your establishment.

reviews.author: Boti C
reviews.title: Just an average place
reviews.text:
I am Club Melia owner and obviously expect everything to be perfect from the time I arrive. When I arrived I was placed in a room that smelled moldy. The safe was not working, and we had to wait two hours in the suite to have the safe fixed. While waiting we realized that both my wife and I were starting to have respiratory problems. We sat in porch to recover. Thankfully we were moved to another room that smelled of insecticide, but at least here we did not have any respiratory issues. However, we had to make at least five or six calls to have various issues taken care off. This is not what we expected as we have paid a tremendous amount of money to buy weeks at the resort, and also pay a annual fee to maintain the property. What are they maintaining? We expect everything to be perfect, we pay for this privilege, and duly complained to the management and our expectations.
If you are not an owner, staying at any Melia property, avoid the timeshare sales people. They are dressed in white,, and you will recognize them. Just avoid them and say "no molesta". I do not think that buying into their vacation plan in worth the money. You can find better deals on the Internet.
Let's talk about the resort. After all the complaining, we received the treatment that we expected, and even a voucher for various services, that frankly I did not care for, and never use.
Apparently the July 4th week is the busiest week of the year,try to avoid this week in Punta Cana. The breakfast area is a shared area between Club Members and the general vacationers. It is always busy and the service staff are so busy they do not have time to take care of everyone, they try their best though. I noticed that if you decide to have breakfast earlier it is normally quieter, and service is better. There are numerous choices of food, you will always find something available including vegetarian options.
A snack bar is available all day if you fell peckish. There is food available to cater for all tastes if you prefer a snack. Ice- Cream is also available.
There are several bars around the resort, and service here is exceptional, even better if you tip the servers. However, if you require premium international drinks you need to pay for them, and it is expensive, for example a single shot of Patron tequila is $15. The same shot in the USA is about $10.
The dinner restaurants are all average expect the Mexican restaurant which I found to be poor. The sushi restaurant is average, I think that the chef should perfect her knife skills. Serving chunks of salmon certainly does not look appetizing, but they do serve a larger amount of fish, and the quality is good.
The Japanese Teppan Yaki restaurant is average as well. Personally the Teppan-Yaki restaurants in the USA are far better than this one. The steak house is also average; nothing to write home about. I asked for a medium-well steak and received a rare-medium steak. I duly sent it back.
I also had the opportunity to visit the Mediterranean buffet at the Reserve hotel. This is a sister hotel to to the Palma Real. Frankly, the food here was poor. It was mostly Spanish food, and all bland.
Pool service at the Palma Real is average as well. The guests that tip the servers  more tend to get more attention. I obviously do tip, but tipping is not mandatory though and I do believe that the service should be non discriminatory. You can always find a drink of choice at the pool.
Paradisus Palma Real is a family friendly resort. It is extremely busy with many babies and toddlers, and unruly children whose parents do not control. I really could not find peace here. I almost always had to experience howling children at every meal. I do love children, but next time I am going to an adults only resort. I would not recommend this resort for singles, or families with teenage children.
Unfortunately the beach was infested with sea weed. I am not complaining and do realize that it is a natural phenomenon.There were people cleaning the beach all week, but the seaweeds were too much to contain. People avoided the beach because of this. This is one more reason to avoid the July 4th week. Apparently this phenomenon occurs annually during this time of the year. During my previous visits to Punta Cana I have never observed seaweed on the beach in such large quantities. At the beach you will find the pesty sales people asking you to visit their stores, or have your hair braiding done. I found their stores to be very expensive though, and they will try to rip you off. I normally avoid the sales people on the beach.
The night entertainment was normally a show followed by disco at the bar. Once again there were too many children getting in the way. It must have been past their bed time. I normally avoided this area well.
In summary this was an average vacation at a high cost. I have stayed at the Iberostar resorts previously in Jamaica, Punta Cana and Playa Del Carmen. I think that their holiday packages are more value for money.

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: Good. Not great.
reviews.text: I traveled with my 12 year old son for a short 3 night stay.  Not a lot of choices for dining unless you plan on dressing up and going to one of the specialty restaurants. No elevators in the buildings that house the rooms. The grounds were beautifully kept, clean pool, decent rooms. In my opinion, the rooms need an update on the soft goods; bedding, draperies, etc. Unfortunately, one evening after dinner, we went back to our room and the maid had been in there for turn-down service. She apparently broke a glass and didn't get it all because I stepped on a piece. Luckily it was my last evening there and it didn't require medical attention.

reviews.author: Kristen B
reviews.title: Beautiful resort- lack of service
reviews.text: The property and amenities are 5 star, but the service is terrible!!  The resort is very large, but we were lost for the first day.  It is difficult to figure-out how to book dinner reservations or how to get to the special Reserve beach and the building concierge are not helpful!!  There were many water activities offered that we were not aware of until our last day.  The Kids Zone activities were great and the kids staff was energetic and friendly.  The spa services were amazing.  Once we were able to get dining reservations, the restaurants were wonderful.  The rooms were spacious and bwautiful, but we had to call to get them cleaned or get the minibar restocked each day.  Overall, a beautiful property with lots to offer but horrible service.  Will go back to Mexico next trip!!

reviews.author: Michele M
reviews.title: Not the best!
reviews.text: Clean resort, nice rooms, beautiful beach. Food not so good. Buffet way better than the restaurants. Service poor. You need to ask an average of 4x to get anything. The excursions were not that good either.  I wouldn't say that anyone really went the distance to make our stay memorable.   Disappointing at best.

reviews.author: Rangelardoc
reviews.title: Decepção
reviews.text:
Pelo valor cobrado fiquei decepcionado. Chegamos em um quarto com forte cheiro de mofo. Pedimos e trocaram o quarto, mas este também tinha cheiro de mofo. O espaço do quarto é muito bom e a decoração bonita. Mas o cheiro incomodou muito minha esposa alérgica. 
Outro ponto que decepcionou foi a pequena quantidade de cadeiras e espreguiçadeiras na praia. A praia é exclusiva aos hóspedes, mas não há quantidade suficiente a todos. 
Gostei da recepção em português dada pelo funcionário Franklin e dos restaurantes.

reviews.author: Laura D
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
When booking this hotel I was torn between stayed at "Paradisus Punta Cana" , "The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana" and then "Royal Service at Paradisus Punta Cana" 
After much research, I decided The Reserve would be the best bet.  Although I don't have any kids, it seemed like the rooms were more updated.  I can't compare it to the other rooms in the resort, but the room was very clean, comfortable, and romantic.  They had sliding doors to get into the actual bed and a Jacuzzi next to the bed.  HELLO ROMANCE!! 

When booking a resort, I always tend to look for an all inclusive that has it all - good entertainment, beautiful beach, good service and decent food.  I am a 29 year old gay female, and I came here with my girlfriend who has never stayed at an all inclusive resort before.  

The ground are beautiful - well landscaped.  

Since we stayed at The Reserve - our walk to the beach was further.  The trolley system, or lack thereof, didn't make sense to us.  Sometimes they would stop and pick us up, sometimes we would wave, and they would just smile and drive past us.  We didn't mind the walk - we are both active - but if you have foot/knee problems and can't walk 10 minutes, I suggest you not stay at this part of the resort.  

We are beach people - so that was important to me - when reading previous reviews I read that they cleaned the seaweed off the beach more so than the resorts around and I found that to be true.  There are days when there is not a lot of seaweed, and some days when it consumes the beach.  Obviously, the resort can't help that, but it was good to see that they make an effort to clean as much of it as they can.

We went to the pool once just to say we did it and grabbed a drink at the swim up bar.  The pool was like HOT bath water.  Maybe it was the timing, but when we went there were old, used cups all along the edge of the pool in a middle island they had.  That was gross.  (( CLEAN UP AFTER YOURSELF ))  Staff should take note to clean that more often - cause it is an eye sore in the middle of the pool.

Royal service has their own pool - but it is way smaller.

The reserve has a pool too - but it is geared more towards kids.

Food - Now I've stayed at other all inclusive resorts before.  I understand you are not going to have the meal of your life here.  But out of the 5 other AI resorts I've stayed at, this food was the worst.  Only thing I enjoyed was The Grill.  The buffets were NOT GOOD.  My parents stayed at this resort & so did my best friend and they warned me about the food as well.  We ate at Mole for lunch every day to avoid the buffet.  They had decent enchiladas & grouper, so that was our saving grace.  The dinners were just confusing.  Everything was a Fusion of something - AKA leftovers from breakfast and lunch.  I understand it is a big resort, and you can't expect the quality of the food to be good, and they must reuse so they don't waste, but it was just done poorly.  

Entertainment - HM......Well....again out of the 5 resorts I've stayed at, this is a contender of one of the worst entertainment.  The beach party on Saturday night was SO FUN.  Usually the staff at these resorts try and get you to be more involved, but this entertainment team seemed to be lacking that.  Marioello ( I think that is his name) was the best - super friendly - hugged us every time he saw us and kept us in the loop of things.  The thing that bothered me was that there was SO much going on in the resort and so little communication as to when it was happening, at what time, and where.  You really had to go out of your way to figure it out.  We missed a show because no one said it was going to be at the beach, not the theater.  We are a young, fun couple, we wanted to check it out!  They also had some painting classes, dance classes, but again, where is the entertainment team trying to get you involved?? NO WHERE.  It isn't hard to have a sign up (that isn't in size 8 font) near the pool / beach to let people know what is going on.  Take care of that management - it is an easy fix.  

Service - every one was very friendly (and gay friendly too).  We had $120 of singles that we gave out during our 7 day stay.  They work very hard and most of them were very appreciative of tips.  

Beach - Jose Luis de los santos & Ramon Ramirez walked around asking us for drinks all day.  They were funny, tried to get us drunk all the time, but would leave us alone if we were trying to nap.  If you get to the beach early enough you can find chairs under some shade.  Water wasn't wavy during our stay - but my parents who came one  month prior said that the water was rough for swimming.  I'm sure it all depends on the time of year you go/tide/currents/etc.  Overall - we loved the beach - we went banana boating ($20 pp) and snorkeling which is free through the resort.  No jet ski's on the beach when we went. 

Concierge - This is the person who is at the main floor of your building.  They help with dinner reservations.  On our first day, the lady at concierge (I don't remember her name) wasn't being clear on how the reservation system worked.  I understand she probably has to repeat herself 40x's a day to every person, but she wasn't being patient with us.  No offense, but the only person I liked was Yanet Alejandra Hernandez.  She was sweet, and gave us tips, pointers, helped us out with reservations and on our last day she arranged to have our Jacuzzi set up with flowers, candles and a love poem without us knowing!!!  It was so nice of her to do that for us.

The reserve has free use of computers. Spotty wifi - mostly had it in the rooms.    

Overall - we both had a wonderful vacation - it was beautiful, and we wish we could have stayed there one more week.  We will not return to this resort mainly because of the food though.  I'm sorry!!

reviews.author: Alex A
reviews.title: Altibajos
reviews.text:
pasamos nuestra Luna de miel en este hotel hoy estamos terminando nuestra estadía aunque es bello el lugar creo q aun les falta experiencia el trato del personal es muy bueno, hubo detalles como que nos llevaran inicialmente a una habitación q ya se encontraba ocupada, y al final la ultima noche llovió y eso descubrió q existían unas goteras enormes en el techo de la habitación lo cual arruino nuestra ultima noche en el hotel y nos vamos algo mal descansados y un mal
Sabor de boca ya q por el precio que se paga esto no debería ocurrir, igualmente felicitaciones al chef Luis Concepcion de Mizu y al personal del restaurante Passion y Vento, a los meseros del restaurante buffet

reviews.author: rockietino
reviews.title: Nice place, good food, customer service needs improvement.
reviews.text:
Let me preface this review by saying that I have been to several Caribbean islands (Bahamas, Cozumel, Cancun, Jamaica, and Aruba), both in all-inclusive resorts and not, so I know how it works and what "island time" is. I was here in May 2015 for 4 nights to attend my nephew's wedding. Very nice, open air, property. While the suite itself was nicely appointed, the bathroom lacked privacy. You can hear everything and practically see everything which would not be a problem, I guess, if you were sharing a room with your spouse or significant other. Not when you're with your sibling, a friend, or even your kids.  Our garden room view room was so humid that everything felt damp including the sheets. Perhaps the management should consider putting stand alone humidifiers in each room as the air conditioner is not enough. Everything in my suitcase including the suitcase itself smelled like mildew when I got home. 

The food and drinks were very good and is available anytime including room service and your mini-bar. Beverage service at the buffet is on "island time".  I had to ask several times for more water, coffee, or soda before getting it, but that's nothing compare to when I asked for bottled water at the Gabi beach bar. The girl helping me walked so slow, a toddler learning how to walk could've beaten her in a race. She took "island time" to the extreme. The bartenders are heavy handed with the alcohol so beware. LOL.

The beach and pools were very nice, but the ocean was full of seaweed and not calm and clear like you would expect in the Caribbean. There are plenty of lounge chairs at the beach but you need to get up early to save your lounge chairs at the pool if that's where you want to be. Also, the towel hut seems to run out in the early afternoon and once they're out, they're out. I was told to use the ones from our room the first afternoon we got there. 

What I found really different is the lack of smiling faces among the staff. Nobody greeted me with a "hello", "hola", "hi", "buenos dias" or even a smile. I was the one who greeted them FIRST.  Maybe it's the heat and humidity, but it certainly is interesting.

reviews.author: MaisieMaisie
reviews.title: Don't Get Fooled!
reviews.text: This was my second stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in eight years and it hasn't changed.  The resort itself is quite beautiful. The beach however is not! If you are traveling for the blue waters and sandy beaches of the islands this is not your place. The beach is littered with mass amounts of sea grass and weeds. The Resort has trucks out cleaning every morning but to no avail. Luckily the pool is quite nice.  Don't get tricked into paying extra for an early check in like I did. I was guaranteed an early check in after paying a $70 fee - in fact I was told it would be awaiting my early arrival.  At check in I was held for over an hour in their 'Private Check In" just a ploy to keep down the number of people at the woefully understaffed front desk.  After many starts and delays I was told that I could go and get some lunch and my room would be ready at 3pm.  When I asked for a refund for the $70 fee since they were not providing the service I paid for the clerk just blankly stared and said he would be back.  30 minutes later he came back and said my room was always available and I could go to the room now.  I didn't buy it for a minute - he said my room was 1027 - I indicated that I specifically requested not to be on the first floor but he insisted this was my room - I had reservations about his demeanor.  As I suspected I was given the worst room - located at the end of the resort - next to their laundry facilities - facing the parking lot and garbage bins.  I returned to the front desk and indicated I wouldn't stay in the room and that I wanted to be moved immediately.  I was eventually - one hour later - given another room but was told that technically I was given an early check in at 2:45 so there would be no refund!!!  Do not pay for anything extra here - including the $70 per person charge to eat at Passion restaurant - it is basically the same food served in all the other restaurants!!!!  Nothing special and not worth the additional charge.  Left a bad taste for the start of the week.  Wait staff are friendly but the front desk and guest services are abysmal and undertrained.  If you want a nice pool, decent food, and a pretty resort it is good.  If you want beaches and good service not your place.

reviews.author: Cindy B
reviews.title: Sister Summer Getaway (Straight Talk No Chaser)
reviews.text:
First off let me start off by saying that this was my first time to DR and the property is absolutely beautiful so my 3 star rating is highly based on the beauty and cleanliness of the resort.  Now on to the other things.  I guess my first mistake was comparing everything about this trip to my Jamaica trip last year and this doesn't even come close. 

1. We arrive at the hotel at 4pm (mind you check in is at 3) our room was not ready and we were given our wrist bands and told to come back in about 35 minutes and our room should be ready. Well we do that and its still not ready but we weren't leaving until it was so they decided to give us a good room. The room was sooooo far from everything so once we took the golf cart to the room it was beautiful as well but it was a King bed and we asked fro double beds...so we had to track all the way back to the front desk to ask why we didn't have double beds...They told us that we were given a better room than the double bed and that we could move but not until the next day...Well to make a long story short we ended up keeping the room and being upgraded to VIP level for our trouble. 

2. The food was OK. I ate the same thing pretty much everyday (omelet, fruit for breakfast, nachos rice and beef for lunch and whatever they had in the buffet for dinner) this was at the Gabi Beach area.

3. I guess i should have started with this but if you are looking for nightlife THIS IS NOT THE PLACE FOR YOU...i repeat THIS IS NOT THE PLACE FOR YOU! Their idea of night life is a "beach party" where infants are leading the dancing on the floor. There was hardly no music playing by the pool and the pool bar was dead. 

4. Speaking of Bars, the drinks were horrible. I stuck with rum and coke the entire time. When asked if there was a specialty drink of the day, there wasn't one. Dont even think about asking for a drink in a coconut those are reserved for the high rollers i guess my VIP status wasn't good enough...lol OH and the Bartender thought it was ok since they ran out of glasses to dump out someones old drink and rinse the cup and wipe the rim off with her hands and fix my drink...it was paper cups from then on out...

5. The Excursion was awesome I suggest the Side by Side (buggy, natural spring, lunch drinks, catamaran natural pool in the middle of the ocean) The crew was so nice and fun and the food was amazing. WAY BETTER THAN THE RESORT!

6. There are lots of people trying to sell you things all you have to do is say no thank you and keep moving. It was nice to have a free shuttle from the resort to the mall. That got us off property for a few hours. 

7. Finally Resort credits are a joke. How can you have 550.00 in credits and cant use them with spending just a much...we left them in the room since we couldn't use them. 

All in all if you want to just go to the beach and thats it then this is the place for you. If you are looking for tons of fun and partying and nightlife look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Q7532UWrichardp
reviews.title: All Inclusive
reviews.text: Experience was just OK, but the rooms and mechanical equipment were somewhat dated.  While the staff was for the most part accommodating, we felt that we would have been better served at a non-all inclusive resort and probably will not stay at an all inclusive again.

reviews.author: Joe P
reviews.title: Beautiful beach but everything falls short plus advice
reviews.text: I am still here in our third day. My experiences are really from the time your arrive to my experiences so far. Customs check is really fast. They don't even look at our pictures. They just want our $10 per person entry fee/tax. They are glad we are there to spend money in their country. After you get your luggage you will be bombarded with a lot of things I don't understand but just want to pass through. Taking a taxi ($35) will be the easiest and same price as any other travel agency transportation. Our taxi driver had no personality and even took us to a wrong side of our hotel even though he clearly knew our hotel is the Reserve . I had to tell him where to go (by reading the sign). Asked him if he did that on purpose and he never responded or didn't understand. Checking in is an interesting experience. They will ask you for your passport and make a copy. Will ask you for your basic information and for you to sign here and there. DO NOT sign the first box!!! It's about their timeshare. I bet a lot people sign not knowing what you are signing. After not signing receptionist was not as friendly as before. Even make us wait for our room. Room is spacious and clean. There were a lot of bottled water inside. Beach is clean with not a lot of seaweed. No rocks nor sea shell. Just water and sand. Casino is very small with min $10 but max bet at $100. Pittboss gets mad if you start winning. They would change dealers just after 10 mins. Foods is just average everywhere. DO not pay for concierge service. They are only there to make dinner reservations and to reserve a cabana. There are plenty of cabanas to go around and you can make dinner reservations yourself. Overall beautiful beach but hit and miss everything else.

reviews.author: Phiphii75
reviews.title: Good resort but bad front desk services!
reviews.text:
Pros:
Nice beach
Great food
Food service was good

Cons:
Front desk staff was not helpful

My flight was delay for 1 night so the airline compensated for an extra day but the hotel was not helpful to understanding my situation so instead of receiving 5 nights that I paid for, I only stay the remaining 4 nights. Make sure your flight does not delay because they will not make any changes to your hotel. 

Regardless, I paid for 5 nights and I expect 5 nights. They are not going to cheat me an extra night for $400. This will be disputed with the travel agent and my credit card company.

reviews.author: davidfD3817CH
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Amazing service from the minute we got off the plane and into the shuttle to the hotel.

Royal Service [butler] was a nice upgrade, however butler was average in terms of his proactiveness to serve us.  That said the overall service was still amazing.

Food was lacking freshness, typically not hot and quite bland across the entire resort.  

Attitude of service staff was wonderful.  

Pool and beach experience was amazing, no complaints.

reviews.author: KCKC
reviews.title: We had fun, but with some tweeking it could be much better
reviews.text:
Ok, so first of all... .this review is late. We went last Aug. and I just now got around to write this review. 

Although this resort has potential, it needs work. First and foremost, it is inconsistent as far as quality of service and food. Sometimes it's great and the next meal is awful.

They were renovating so perhaps this is fixed now.. but at breakfast I had to ask 4 times for coffee. At some points, I stood up with coffee cup in hand hoping to get someone's attention. 

Tip: Ask for espresso... they make it fresh and it is sooo much better than the coffee they mass produce.

The rooms: The screens separating the bedrooms from the bathrooms are pretty but don't give any privacy. I get that maybe lots of honeymooners go here, but so do families... I don't really wanna watch my kids on the bowl. We ended up hanging towels in the gaps for privacy. 

The beach-lots of seaweed. I understand this is not the fault of the hotel but they should try to rake it up every few days. It was very ugly. 

Tip: When taking beach photos.. take them from further up on the sand, that way you don't see the seaweed as much.

Food; it ranged from so-so to excellent with no rhyme or reason. My biggest complaint was at the Hibachi restaurant. While cooking our food the chef actually started to meow, jokingly that he was cooking cat! I couldn't beleive it, it was appalling! I didn't eat a bite after that, as I lost my appetite. I know he was kidding but it was awful!  Where is the staff training? We enjoyed the Meditterean restaurant most of all. 

I did enjoy the handcrafted cocktails that several restaurants and bars offered. They were unusual and delicious! 

The Spa- well it's unusual because anybody can go in and use some of the facilities. This made it crowded and noisy, and dirty. Drunks were coming in and hanging out in the hot tub with spa guests. Also, at least half of the spa facilities weren't working. It really was not impressive. The locker room is basically a closet, it is small and hot! 

Spa tip: Be sure to allow for extra time for your spa treatment. I was told to pay before the treatment and this took quite some time that I had not figured on before my appointment.  The treatment rooms are not air conditioned so it can be super hot. I was roasting during my massage and afraid I might have to stop mid way.
THe spa at the other facility was much nicer. My photos are of the sister property's spa. I forget the name.

The pool: Attractive except the staff did not pick up the cups from drinks fast enough. This meant lots of paper cups with pina colada in them are floating around the pool. I find that gross. THey did have several fun pool activiites and workouts. My children enjoyed the spin class in water.

Pool tip: Bring your own insulated cup! The paper cups the bar gives you soon turn mushy and your drink gets warm.

Tip: Don't leave your shoes by the pool after a certain hour. Staff will remove your shoes and you will never see them again.  We put our shoes under a chair to go for a barefoot walk on the beach (yes, crazy idea, I know). When we came back they were gone. The concierge acted as if we were in the wrong for asking her to contact maintance to try to get them back. 

One of my biggest complaints was the system of making dinner reservations. Often we were told we would be advised if our reservation was made by a certain time. That never happened and I had to go to the concierge wait on long lines to find out where/when we were eating... and get attitude for it as well. I hated to leave the pool/beach to see what time we were given to eat. Once it turned out we only had 15 minutes to get ready. No notice of our reservation was given at our room as we were told it would be. On top of this ... the concierge was unfriendly and not helpful.

Entertainment: we loved the Michael Jackson show, as well as the Lion King. My kids went to the "Stomp" show and enjoyed it too.

Wifi was spotty. 

As a wine drinker, I don't like that wine is not offered in the room mini bar.

Despite these complaints we had a great time... I just hope this hotel improves on it's services.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Good and Bad
reviews.text:
Good: The resort décor and pools are beautiful, the beach and cabanas are nice. Transportation around the resort was easy and the walks were nice, my husband and daughter took in a show and loved it. There is a nice variety of activities offered. I took the yoga class, it was nice, but too close to the volleyball net and had some close calls with the volleyball.

Bad: The hotel is marketed as new, but the rooms are pretty beat up and could use some love- good cleaning and paint. There is a nice selection of restaurants but the food quality is hit or miss, service at the buffets is not the greatest - we were challenged to get water and coffee - forget about a refill. The mixed drinks were horrible, all bottom shelf spirits and poorly mixed. I had one good margarita at the Mexican restaurants, otherwise stick to wine. Ordering room service was almost impossible, took over 20 minutes one morning to order breakfast. At least the food form room service was decent. 
The noise from the resort can be loud at times, especially if you are trying to get kids to bed around 8.
 Also beware of the mosquitos, I left with over 40 bites.

reviews.author: W9043EQdeniseb
reviews.title: it was ok
reviews.text: Had a decent time but nothing spectacular.  The food was good but I didn't enjoy being served drinks in paper cups.   There's no music by the pool so bring your own.  The place is clean and the bartenders are all very nice.  The staff for the most part are all nice except for some of the women.

reviews.author: mea5798
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real 5 day stay
reviews.text:
The resort is truly stunning..from the lobby level you can look out to the sea..so as you arrive you are starting to get a feel for all that is in store.
We are already Club Melia members..although we did not get any special treatment or “perks” because of our membership…that was rather disappointing . It made for a VERY ordinary few days,,
The staff is wonderful and because we took an extra moment with just about each and every staff member we met ,  they couldn’t have been nicer! We have to give mention to Caroline, one of the hostesses at Naos..just about the sweetest young lady, ever! Franklin, waiter at Naos..so pleasant!! Soezi Matos, waiter at Naos and then we saw him at Rare!. And always so pleasant !! Wily Mercado, waiter at Rare..so professional and personable! Miguel Germain, the magical bartender at Bana! He was awesome! 
The food was good! We enjoyed trying the different restaurants: Bana, Rare, Fuego, & Vento. During the day, we ate at Naos and Blue Agave.
We enjoyed all the different entertainments and the shows & even made it to Red lounge one night!!
The property is really pretty, lots of beach…a couple of pools..YHI spa was nice! My husband and I did a couple’s massage which takes place in the Oriental gardens..i actually went back the next day for a repeat! That’s how much I enjoyed it!
We found out thru the Otium  tour company,  located on the lower level of the resort,  that they offer a free ride (give the driver a tip!) to /from the hotel lobby to a couple of other cigar/souvenir/chocolate shops. We took advantage of this..that was fun and it was a break away from the resort for a bit.
Our 3d story room had a nice view of the ocean and our pool..the room would have been great if the AC had been working just right. It was damp to the point where everything was almost wet!!
The reason I can’t give 5 stars is,  this was let-down for us after the outstanding time we had at the Reserve, Paradisus Punta Cana last year.
All in all it was a pretty good trip..

reviews.author: Marcio A
reviews.title: DEAR HOTEL MANAGER. BE CAREFULL WITH THE PEOPLE YOU PUT AT FRONT-DESK
reviews.text:
My name is Marcio Araujo  and  I was a guest at Paradisus Palma Real from May 23rd to  May 29th.  . My room number was 1050 . I was having a great stay in your hotel during the week, great place, nice people, excellent food, guest services at high quality. Ms  Sugelis Cuevas (nickname “Su”) from Paradisus guest services team was in charge of my family for reservations and she made a great job, not only because she was kind, educated, highly qualified to deal with guests and also because when I needed her help  to fix a problem caused by your front desk staff , she was fast and assertive. 
The problem started when I received my room bill one day before I leave the hotel and that bill was showing by mistake a bottle of expensive wine that I never asked nor drink. I went to the front-desk, talked to a clerk named HERVAL who was rude and with me. I feel like an idiot trying to prove the obvious. Ms  Sugelis was not on duty at that time on the night and your staff on duty on the front desk and guest services played with me making me feel like an idiot and someone who was trying to cheat the hotel. I was  never treated like that before.
Very bad customer experience !  The answer I got from another guest services lady was I had to wait until an investigation to check my sign-off  made at check in  against the sign-off made by the person who asked for the wine on the restaurant and I what to wait for the next day. I could not imagine to get an answer like that. I had to wait for the next day to get an obvious answer. 
Bad communication, bad customer experience and taking such long time to investigate and confirm the obvious , brought to my attention your staff is not trained to deal with complaints and provide quick and assertive answers to your hotel guests when it is needed .
Next day Ms Sugelis Cuevas came to me and just said the obvious that situation was a mistake from the front-desk staff and I did not had to pay anything. They charged the wine by mistake to my room. Very simple, but I had to wait the next day to get an obvious answer 
I would like to give only good references on this post, and from the hotel infrastructure and food and they were wonderful, but a few staff members from your team, except from Ms Sugelis Cuevas, made me feel like an idiot trying to prove that I was a honest person and was saying the truth. Honestly speaking I will think twice before I recommend your hotel to a someone from my relatives or friends.

reviews.author: Pattybarrera80
reviews.title: Could've gotten a 5 star
reviews.text:
I would first like to say that this resort has lots of good qualities, but I guess we must have gotten the goose egg. It is beautiful, clean, pool is great, but the bar closes early.  There is a shopping mall in the same are that they take you to on a tram, but it is way over priced. Just walk down the beach to a flea market, we felt safe, there are so many people around.  The reservations for restaurants were a pain. But on with the review.
 My husband was there for a conference, but we decided to stay a few extra days.  We were with the Royal Service, where you supposedly get a butler, better liquor, beds on the beach (only if you tip the butler daily or someone on the beach)   Well, we did, but didn't meet  or hear from him (butler) until the next day. He was very sporadic too. The phones they give you to call him, usually would go straight to the front desk or something, because then he would call us back. Never did we call and he would answer.  We would see him sometimes out and about, but by then we had already gotten the two reservations handled.  Still, the purpose of paying for that service is for them to do it. 
At first, we thought that the staff upstairs (at the royal service) were just extremely friendly and we were so pleased with the service.. but then BAM... they hit you for a "presentation." The freebies you would get are pretty much spa services.   I had reserved a facial before finding this out, but since she guaranteed that she would credit it to my account, and that all we needed to do was go to breakfast and say no (So at the most we would be is 45 minutes), we decided to just do it.  
Well, the 45 minutes turned into an hour and half.  This is because we just kept saying no, no, no...We actually already have a timeshare and it doesn't make sense on what they offered.  Specifically, because the flight from DFW is so expensive to get there.  
Checkout- guess what was on our account... the facial.  All of sudden, the girl that offered and said this did not work for the same company that does the timeshare presentations.  Mind you, the transportation to the airport was waiting for us.  We had to pay for a taxi to go since they had to call all these people.  So basically, they lied to us, I didn't mind paying for the facial, but when you lie and promise things it just shows your ethical values.  
So warning, be careful what you get promised and make sure it is in writing or go after. 
In all, we were truly planning to go back to this resort with our family next month, but after that we are going elsewhere.  I wouldn't totally not recommend this resort, simply because if you don't go on that timeshare presentation, it is fine.  The extra for the royal service, in my opinion, was not worth it (you can go buy your own upgraded liquor cheaper).  Truly all you get are the beach bed, a small pool, a butler (which is hit and miss), and one extra restaurant. 
Oh and you get wifi, which is a plus.

reviews.author: CroChic
reviews.title: It was good, but not great!
reviews.text:
When I booked the Reserve it was ranked #1 on TripAdvisor and the reviews of it were stellar. Plus the pictures of everything looked amazing. The entire experience was an overall 3. And for the amount of money you spend to stay here, you really do want it to be a 4 or 5 star experience. We stayed 10 days and by the 7th day we were ready to go home. For us 10 days there felt way too long. I think a 5-7 days stay would suffice for a place like this. 

Do not drink the water in DR!!! Unless it comes in a bottle that hasn't been opened in front of you. When we first arrived at the resort the waiters were carrying water pitchers with ice to fill up people's drinking glasses. Towards the end of our stay they stopped that and were only filling up people's water glasses with bottled water.   

Food is different in DR. I hope you have a tough stomach that can handle it. All I know towards the end of our stay our daily meals ended up consisting of breads, fruit, some veggies and gatorade (you can buy it at the Gift Shop) or bottled soda. I was never so happy to come back to the US to eat something that I was not scared of turning my stomach into a mess. It doesn't mean that it will happen to you.. It's just a warning to not go crazy with the food your 1st day there. We started off slow and still had issues. Which is weird, because I've been to DR before and was totally fine. 

Food/ Restaurants: What annoyed me the most is that food (raw meat and fish) there is not properly handled. Sushi at the Gabi Beach was served warm. Why would you serve raw fish warm? They lay it out on a cold slab that is supposed to keep it cold, but yet they have it laying right next to a grill that is being used to grill up stuff? And while the food is presented nicely each day at all of the buffets, the food will became repetative. For a 5/7 day stay I wouldn't worry about it. For others staying longer - you may get bored. Our favorite place to eat at was the Gabi Club. We always ended up there. We tried the restaurants and we only liked the Japanese hibachi and Vento. Aqua was gross! It's an outdoor type of restaurant and has the potential to be a super romantic type of place for couples to come to. It's supposed to be Italian, but it tasted far from it.  Plus, the place was swarming with gnats or mosquitos - whatever they were they tore my skin up. And it was still daylight out too! I've never been bit up so much in the 10 mins that we were there. Yes, 10 mins. That's how long I lasted before we booked out of there. And so did some other couples, because we saw them later at the Gabi Club eating. Sadly, that happened a lot. We'd go to a restaurant and end up at a buffet looking for something edible to eat. We were not the only ones to do that. We had no issues with getting reservations at restaurants, althought we preferred to eat at 8:00pm or 8:30 pm instead of the 6:30/6:45 pm. that we got. That time made us feel rushed. We skipped a lot of our dinner reservations because of that. 

Resort: While I enjoyed the immaculate and beautiful grounds that the Reserve/Paradisus Punta Cana resort offers some things are a major turn off. For one:  It's huge! It's the first time I've stayed at a huge resort and last. I don't like them. 
The golf carts that are supposed to come to take you around from one place to another were at times non-existent. We preferred to walk, but at night time when the mosquitoes came out to feast on you it would've been nice to take the golf cart back to our room. Bring repellent! You will need it! 

Beach:  gorgeous & clean! The beach area is really beautiful. We did not have issues getting a cabana on the beach. We got one in the 1st/ 2nd row always. But we stayed at the resort during mid-May. When we left there were A LOT more people checking in so I can see why paying someone to reserve those at the pool & beach would be beneficial. I would not want to be there when the resort is fully booming. Beach service was awesome when the server who says "drinky, drinky" was there. When he wasn't .... you became your own server.

Room: Our room was big. We had a master suite on the 1st floor. Don't recommend it, unless you have mobility issues. The wooden chairs being moved above you and hearing your neighbors can become quite annoying fast. Housekeeping for the most part was good, and while we didn't have any shortages of towels I'm not sure when the last time the room was actually dusted. There was dust everywhere. Kind of gross because clean towels were put on dusty shelves. Mini bar was refilled, but it's not done by the cleaning lady. The morning cleaning lady always cleans your room in the AM, then someone comes to refill your mini-bar around noon-ish. And then in the evening another maid comes to turn down your bed. My suggestion: use the safe to store your valuables. 

Check-in: oh it's so painfully long for no reason. I prefer to get in, sign whatever I need to and get the key cards. But I must say that they do go over the Resorts activities, the Reserve lay out and Restaurants when you check in, so don't fret you will not be lost there. 

Wifi is a hit or miss. Sometimes it works great other times not at all. The Reserve wifi does not require a sign on password, you can link up to it automatically. Once you are over at the Main Lobby (Pardisus side) and on the beach you will need to link up to a different sign on and a password is required for that. Make sure you get that when you check in. 

For families the Reserve is a great choice! There were not a lot of children there when we were, but it's definitely very family/ kid friendly. The Royal Section was a joke. Their adults only pool area is tiny. And they do party it up there. Not bad, if you are into that. Their beach section mirrors the Reserve section. And then there is the Paradisus side, which is the largest area and everyone can use it and they have the hammocks there. 

For couples, pick your travel dates wisely and stay in the section that suites you the best. 

Oh and the workers do speak English; from what I saw there were mostly American tourists there anyways. Please don't be a cheapo - tip the workers! They are really nice/hospitable people & some of them do work really hard.

reviews.author: Wildcatviv
reviews.title: Beautiful property, but the service wasn't so beautiful
reviews.text:
1) 
I gave my concierge Elvis  three restaurants for the three upcoming nights the second morning that we arrived , and from then , we felt we have to chase down to the concierge for the reservation paper everyday (restaurants wont let you in without the paper) . And at the last evening we stayed, when we asked him for our reservation paper around 5pm ,he said he doesnt have the record for our reservation,  and finally he called us 30 mins later than he promised, he got us the reservation at 7pm (we eat our dinner at 6:30pm everyday). but we ended up in the buffet. because we lost the mood to walk all the way to the restaurant.
2)We reported to Elvis about our water running problem in the shower at the first night,
the water is going down very slowly. And we had to make arrangement with our shower time schedule. My friend would shower first, the I would shower 2 hours later. (Afraid that the water would overflow). and IT NEVER GOT FIXED DURING OUR ENTIRE STAY !!!
3)What really disappointed us was that on the day we had to check out, we asked the concierge if they can send someone to help us carry our luggage from the second floor, we asked them to come a little bit before 9:20am because our pick up time is 9:30am at the lobby. We waited till 9:25am and no one came. We decided to carry our luggage on our own and had to bump it all the way down.

I thought the concierge thing should make us lay back and relax ,but it was  not the story.

The pool was beautiful, and life enriching classes were fun. But the service still need to be work on.

reviews.author: JayFLORIDA123
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text:
Just getting back from a 4 day getaway at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The resort itself is magnificent.  Rooms are very big and very well kept.  Our only complaint was the food and drinks are not very good at all.  Sizzler or Golden Corral  defiantly have better food.  If you order any frozen or mixed drinks, they taste like pure sugar.  The last night we were at the resort, we had a wonderful experience at the Blue Agave Restaurant as a result out waiter Gregorio and Chef Jose.  We  asked the waiter if it was possible to was possible to order Mangu.  Gregorio brought the chef out and he explained to us that the restaurant didn't have Mangu, but nevertheless he said he would be glad to make us some.  No more than 20 minutes later, the chef had whipped up a fresh plate of local Dominican food and it was delicious.  
Additionally, the Entertainment crew surely made each day a lot of fun.  Big Mac and Rony were a lot of fun and always had a big smile on their faces.  Thanks so much guys!

reviews.author: 44VBB
reviews.title: Great Grounds / Average Rooms.........
reviews.text: Simply said, the public areas are beyond fantastic. Clean, Clean, Clean! Beautiful beach and pool areas with plenty of room. Staff incredibly helpful, polite and willing to help. Food is Average, entertainment was good enough. The only negative was the room. The rooms were redone beautifully probably 5-10 years ago and although quality materials were used, its now dated (old crooked ceiling fans; dresser drawers missing handles; slow wifi; hot tub could not fill up with water in any timely manor; living room furniture that was really old and we could not bring ourselves to sit on.) The most negative is that the lower level floors are SO damp that we are still trying to get the damp smell out of our cloths/luggage and we had quite a few mosquitos in the room that were impossible to get rid of. All in all, a B+ rating and might return but not unless an upper level floor was guaranteed.

reviews.author: Odalys S
reviews.title: beautiful hotel but not as expected
reviews.text: I have stayed at many hotels in Punta Cana so I wanted to try something new.  I am not sure Paradisus was the answer.  I gave this hotel a 3 star only because of most staff...I booked the "Reserve" and paid more than a regular room but I would't recommend that. You will not get much more than the regular hotel room. Throughout the hotel the grounds are beautiful, the service was great, the staff is sweet and courteous but some are not very knowledgeable. We tried booking several restaurants and they kept giving us what we told them we didn't want.  Every night, they said they would leave  a reservation confirmation under the door. If it was there, it was a surprise. Mind you, the minute we checked in, we asked them to book us for the week. We we're booked at Aqua  and it was not good.  Vento was equally as bad. I recommend Fuego, Gabi and Gabi Beach  (which are buffet).  Unfortunately I cannot comment on anything else because we weren't given the chance...Do not waste your money on Passion restaurant (not part of the all-inclusive) because it is not worth it. What I do recommend at all times, however, is a repellant... Even though I used one, the mosquitos on this property are everywhere... especially at the beach party. The beach was nothing spectacular and was full of seaweed the entire week we were there. Also, expect to wait a long time for shuttle to transport you from one place to the other.

reviews.author: Susan L
reviews.title: Good vacation but not perfect!
reviews.text: We loved everything about this place except the fact that we didn't feel welcomed by our conceirge in building 39. First night, we had issue with our shower, the water doesn't go down. We told the conceirge, and he told us he fixed it. After that, the water is going down very slowly. And we had to make arrangement with our shower time schedule. My friend would shower first, the I would shower 2 hours later. (Afraid that the water would overflow). We managed that ourselves and many other stuff. What really disappointed us was that on the day we had to check out, we asked the conceirge if they can send someone to help us carry our luggage from the second floor, we asked them to come a little bit before 9:30am because our pick up time is 9:30am at the lobby. We waited till 9:25am and no one came. We decided to carry our luggage on our own and had to bump it all the way down. I mean, we are two girls, if we could do it on our own, we wouldn't even bother to ask. When we finally made it down, there were three of the staffs talking and laughing and no one helped. And that really disappointed us. We had been reading alot of good reviews about their concierge, but we didnt feel the same.  There were no greetings/smiles each time we walked back in to the building and we were unhappy about it but it was fine. He could be shy or something. Everyone is different. But I was really upset when I asked for help and the conceirge didn't help at all. I dont want to post any names here but I would like you guys to know the situation. Probably it is my bad luck that we were assigned to this conceirge.

reviews.author: Josh C
reviews.title: Beautiful property but lacks options
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful.  On the trip from the airport we arrived and all the other guests going to other resorts were jealous.  Looking through the lobby to the ocean is a pretty amazing sight.   The lobby, grounds, pool, and ocean were amazing.  That was the main part we were there for and it lived up to its billing.  Most of the staff was amazing and we were even upgraded at check in.

The food was ok at first, but after a while it just seemed to be the same thing over and over and just wasn’t flavorful.  We did get room service and it was ok, but again similar to the other food.  Maybe a weekend trip would have been better.  We didn’t drink often, but we were happy with the drinks that were included.

Again, the pool and beach were amazing and a good way to relax.  My wife isn’t a beach person, but I was able to get her to go for a walk on the last day.  Other than the people trying to sell you things, it was great.  We enjoyed the excursions we were able to go on as well.

We also went on a tour for their vacation club.  The person showing us around was very nice and respectful until we told him that at that time we could not afford to buy into the service.  We even told him that both of our parents could possibly be interested.  He very bluntly told us he did not care about their business and was rude to us for the rest of the time.  Very much a turn off to visiting another hotel of this brand.

I would not go back to this particular resort.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: Espectacular estructura pero mal servicio
reviews.text:
Hemos decidido hospedarnos por segunda vez en el hotel. Luego de la primera experiencia, en 2007, habíamos quedado fascinados con el mismo.
El hotel conserva la estupenda estructura.
Sin embargo, hemos tenido varios problemas:
-servicio de mozos: casi todas las veces que nos sentamos a comer tuvimos que pedir 4 veces las bebidas. Algo inaudito para un all inclusive y más uno de esta categoría
-promesas incumplidas: nos prometieron del club melia que por más que no compremos la membresía, nos regalarían masajes y días de estadía. Ninguna de las dos cosas obtuvimos.
-fallas en el cuarto: tardaron casi una semana en cambiar de cuarto a mi hermana que se le cortaba la luz todas las veces que se bañaba
-fallas en restaurant: casi nunca tenían todos los platos ni los postres que figuran en la carta
-toallas: varios días tuvimos que esperar más de una hora para que nos den toallas para usar en la pileta
-calidad de bebidas: ha bajado notablemente desde 2007... hoy en día hay casi que rogar para que te den bebidas de buena calidad

En sí, el hotel es muy bueno, pero no se justifica pagar la diferencia de tarifa con, por ejemplo, el Riu Palace, hotel en el que nos hemos hospedado varias veces y el servicio ha sido excelente

reviews.author: Telly G
reviews.title: Could be better!
reviews.text:
I just got back last night from 4 nights at Paradisus Palma Real Resort (Bavaro Beach), Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  It took us about 20 minutes by private shuttle from the airport to the resort.  The resort sits on a huge, beautifully landscaped and gated property.  The lobby entrance and courtyard were grand & impressive with a view of the Atlantic Ocean.  The beach setting was picture perfect.  The pool areas were attractive and inviting.  The casino was tiny and had limited games.  Wifi was fast & free.  The resort is not smoke-free but the breeze from the ocean helped clear the air so it was not bothersome.

We were upgraded for free from a deluxe garden-view suite to a luxury garden-view jacuzzi junior suite booked through Costco Travel.  We checked in through VIP because we were here to attend a destination wedding.  The VIP reps were not very friendly & helpful though.  We were not greeted upon entering the VIP room.
