The garden-view rooms were a bit of a walk from the center of the resort and even if the rooms were numbered close, they were not exactly next door to each other.  Perhaps this was a good thing because we got a little exercise and helped burn all the calories we ate at this all-inclusive resort.  I did not like the lay out of the room as there were too many partitions especially in the small bathroom with 4 doors making it very tight & confusing.  I wish the floor plan was more open.  Some rooms have more open floor plans but not ours.  The room was clean but outdated and smelled musty.  You can get several channels on the flat TV in the sitting area but the old tubed TV in the bedroom could only get very few channels.  The balcony was a nice size.  Room service was very, very slow and sometimes we had to call twice to make sure.  When they cleaned our room, the towels were not replaced leaving us to call for towels on two occasions.  There was a hair dryer, iron, ironing board & safe inside the room.  The hallways of the garden-view rooms were very dark and a bit scary to walk at night.  

You have to make a reservation at all the restaurants, except the buffet.  This was very inconvenient.  We ate at the Bana, Aqua & Vento restaurants.  All the restaurants were nicely decorated and the ambiance was good.  The Naos buffet was nice, convenient and had an extensive selection of food.  Unfortunately, all the food I ate at the resort were forgettable.  The Blue Agave was a good option for hamburgers, hotdogs & quick bites.  The food served at the wedding was the same as in the restaurants, nothing exciting nor good enough to be remembered. 

Service was both good and bad.  They do have good employees that were funny, friendly & very efficient but some were not as helpful.  

I got a few mosquito bites on my arms & back.  My sister complained she found ants in her bed.  Bring insect repellants.  There were a lot of seaweeds in the beach.

Overall, I liked the setting of this resort with its beautiful lobby, courtyard, beach area, gardens, swimming pools and decor of the restaurants.  I was not crazy about the room, the musty smell of the room, the dark hallways, average food & cuisine, reservation needed restaurants except for the buffet, slow room service and average staff service around.  To me, this resort is just average or so-so.

reviews.author: Lynnea M
reviews.title: Beautiful property but awful service
reviews.text:
Family of 4. Kids ages 9 and 7. Nice property, clean pools, lots of pool and beach chairs and our kids did enjoy the KidZone the few times they went. Resort advertises amazing service, food, and drinks, we did not experience that. 
At the pool bar we were given water in place of vodka in our drink, which was discovered when we asked for a shot of vodka went to do it and found it was water. Service at all of the sit down restaurants was poor and slow and very similar to what is served at the buffet daily. The resort is all inclusive but yet most employees are looking for tips and if they know you tip they will wait on you before others, which is rude, it's supposed to be all inclusive. At checkout they checked me out of the wrong room, charged my card the wrong amount. We were also told we could use our vouchers for the spa treatment, not totally true. It's all inconsistent. You could ask the same question and get different answers. Sadly our family will not return to this hotel group. One more thing, unless you have an iron stomach, be ready for belly aches, vomiting, gas, heartburn, and constipation.

reviews.author: Christina L
reviews.title: Cool place but wifi is horrible
reviews.text: This place was very nice, clean, the food was good, service good. The only thing we had problems with was the wifi. We had our family trying to contact us with an emergency and we tried using the wifi calling and it was not available most of the time. Other resorts we have stayed at had free in-room calling to the US which made it nice. Another thing- it is very hot and humid in Punta Cana and this resort had no way to circulate the air- no fans. When the wind wasn't blowing it was almost unbearable. The one and only swim-up bar had very slow service with only 1 bartender. Besides those things, it was great.

reviews.author: Stephanie G
reviews.title: Secound and last time at Paradisus
reviews.text: The reserve at Paradiusus property is not located on the beach however it is a very beautiful property. This is the secound time I come to this resort and refered a large group to come celebrate a speacial occasion. Sincé before my arriveal I have spent my priceless vacation time writing emails try to fix "Melia" problems. This is not the Marriott or Hilton. The Operations in this place are non existant I dont go on vacation to remind others how to conduct a business. Next time I want to relax I will stay far away from this Company. On another note this place is beautiful the beaches are average. Hope this helps yu planning your next trip :)

reviews.author: 424michaele
reviews.title: somewhat disappointing
reviews.text: grounds and rooms nice. service was not equal to price. dinner reservations were not once at the times we requested and in fact could not get any one night.tram service was not good . we would wait 20 minutes start walking back and would see a convoy of 5 trams at once of course all empty. one driver would not even pick us at designated spot under cover made us walk in rain. this is a good resort for small children and young couples overall disappointed would not return

reviews.author: Gaviotagp
reviews.title: Lugar vale la pena, el hotel bueno
reviews.text:
Paradisus Punta Cana no decepciona, el lugar es realmente paradisíaco, la playa, la vegetación, valen la pena.
En cuanto al resort en sí, cuenta con dos sectores bastante diferenciados, nosotros estuvimos hospedados en Paradisus Punta Cana el cual tenia una habitación amplia pero la decoración y los detalles no eran modernos.
Muy distinto es Reserve, que si se nota que fue actualizada en detalles y comodidades.
El lugar es increíble, el hotel no decepciona pero tampoco sorprende.

reviews.author: Lisa50207
reviews.title: Beautiful! Relaxing! Quiet.  But not much to do.  Staff just OK.
reviews.text:
Definitely a nice vacation. Was with a small group.  Absolutely stunning property. Exactly what you'd expect!  The staff was very friendly and professional upon check in.  We were assigned a personal butler who showed us to our room, showed us how the room worked and presented us with a cell phone to contact him with anything we'd need.  The first day he called us several times.  After that, it was hard to find him and anything we asked for was a crap shoot if he'd follow through.  The Royal pool was cold but very pretty. Far too quiet.  No music being played.  There were not very many activities to participate in except first thing in the day.  The restaurants and buffet were nice but nothing to brag about.  When we went to get a bite to eat around 2:30 there was nothing open except a very small bar where we could get chips, salsa, fruit and guacamole and make a taco.  The casino was more like a very small poker room and the staff seemed annoyed when people wanted to stay later than midnight.  

I went to the spa with a small group.  It was beautiful.  However, you have to hop on a golf cart to get to the spa so arrive with plenty of time because we had to wait almost 20 minutes to get there and over 45 minutes to get back.  Someone at the spa told us we could go to another building to eat as part of the Royal area but when we got there we were told we could not have lunch there and had to go back to the main building.  Seemed as if the employees didn't all know what the agendas and hours of things were.  

One night there were a bunch of little shops set up in the center selling little crafts. Kind of pricey and when you'd walk away they'd make comments to you about not buying something.  A few vendors tried to braid my hair or put a bracelet on my arm. When I refused they'd get upset.  When you'd ask a price about something they would hand you a little basket and tell you to fill the basket up and they'd give you a price.  Then when you'd say no thank you they'd say why don't you think about it and I'll have it sent to your room to enjoy until you decide.  We obviously said no.

The room was comfortable. The robes and slippers were so nice and the Jacuzzi tub was fabulous.  however, the lack of bathroom privacy is a little strange.  There's a barely frosted glass door that separates you from the sink area and a folding wall with slats that separates you from the rest of the bedroom / room.  The bed was comfy. I ordered a lavender pillow which was fabulous. However, when I requested one for every night my butler said he would take care of it.  But after the first night we received a knock on the door and someone asking for the pillow back so they could prepare it for other guests.  When I told them that I had ordered one for each night they said that wasn't possible because other guests had orders.  When I complained, they did bring it back but never refreshed it for the rest of the stay.

The exercise area is very nice.  We also ordered breakfast in the room twice and it arrived quickly.  VERY limited selection on breakfast foods to order to the room.  The buffet was very good for breakfast though.  Some of our friends ordered the pizza to their rooms each night and said it was very good.  

My husband and I are very active people.  We like to relax on vacation but also to do activities and site see and shop.  There was really not much to do besides swim, drink and eat.  The pools, although stunning, were very quiet and boring.

It is an absolutely beautiful location!  We saw two weddings there and the staff did a great job of taking care of them and their guests.  

However, the staff left a lot to be desired.  The bartenders would speak Spanish and laugh a lot and spent more time on serving each other and the girls with bikinis then the rest of the group.  For the money and based on previous reviews and such we had expected similar service to what you'd receive on a cruise ship.  We were very disappointed that it was not even close.

reviews.author: Pope00
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel - Staff needs work
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a 4 night getaway as part of a promotional trip that my wife earned through her business. The hotel itself is very nice. Our suite was well appointed, and the grounds were very well kept. All of the facilities were very nice. It is important to note that we were not in the Reserve, nor were we Royal Service. 

The food was good. Not fabulous, but very good. Nice selection at buffets at breakfast and lunch. We ate at three of the restaurants, Steakhouse, Hibachi and Spanish. All three were good.

Bar selection was not very good. Only local brands of booze were served for the most part. 

Our only complaint about the trip was the service was not good. At every turn, they seemed to be understaffed. The staff itself would regularly forget our orders in restaurants. The pool bar seemed to be totally overwhelmed with orders at all times. To be clear, no one was rude. But no one ever really went out of their way to help us. This was not our experience at a few other properties we stayed at. Maybe it would have been better if we had Royal Service. 

We wouldn't rush back. While it didn't dampen the good time we had with work associates, there are better options.

reviews.author: Alxcv13
reviews.title: Algo ha cambiado, no es lo que era
reviews.text: Regresamos al hotel buscando la excelencia que tuvimos cuando lo hemos visitado antes, pero esta vez fue decepcionante, la atención en recepción de gente que no sabe hacer bien su trabajo si se cambia su "modus operandi" es irritable. Fuimos al Servicio Royal, para mas tranquilidad y exclusividad, lamentablemente los eventos que se preparan en la playa frente a la piscina del Royal convierten el área de la piscina en el almacén de lo que están armando, llenando de gente trabajando y de sillas, mesas, etc a las 4 pm, cuando estamos buscando desconectar... La gente en general es amable , pero se nota que no hay supervisión, el gimnasio tenía el aire acondicionado dañado y en el bufet, cuando fui a servirme a la parte de pescados y mariscos, vi que estaban preparando unas langostas y le dije al cocinero que me gustaría lo mismo, a lo que contesto que eran para un cliente VIP, que no había para nosotros, los jardines están secos y no se ven bien, no volveré al hotel hay demasiadas ofertas para ver si han mejorado.

reviews.author: Andrew L
reviews.title: Nice resort, nice views, good staff, needs upgrading
reviews.text:
We recently returned from our vacation. We stayed at The Golf and Spa in the Paradisus Palma Real. Overall I would rate the trip a 6 out of 10. The weather was perfect and the main hotel and views were top notch!. Our room  ( Garden View Junior Suite) left a lot to be desired. It is in serious need of some updating. The shower leaked, there was mosquito's in my room, and a lot of the tile work was in need of re-grouting. 
As far as food... The buffet was satisfactory. Open all day. Fuego and Palm were our favorite restaurants. Very good food.

I must say that even though it was all inclusive, certain top-shelf beverage items were extra. We were served local liquors in our cocktails that had to be watered down or 1/2 the amount of alcohol content as is here in the USA. It was only until the last night when we were told by another that we were "allowed" to have certain brand name liquors that are common here in the USA. The staff never told us.

Service by the employees for the most part was very good. Our attendant on the beach, George Alriche was fantastic and made the trip a lot more satisfying! I must say, we did not have the "Royal Service" and were glad. It definitely was not needed and not worth the extra cost.

reviews.author: Spa_Snobb
reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.text:
During the planning of our trip to D.R, we originally considered staying at the RIU or the Barcelo Adults Only property. Because the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was rated as one of the top resorts in Punta Cana, I made a last-minute switch to the Paradisus Punta Cana.  Overall, not sure how this resort rated so high. We're both well-traveled,  so we have other resorts to compare this experience to. This resort did not make our top list of resorts.  Not even close. 

Pros: 
Lovely grounds. The landscaping is nice.
The service is good (not exceptional). Very friendly staff.
We visited two restaurants: Fuego (delicious; definitely recommend) and Vento. Vento is not included in the all-inclusive rate but it was worth it ($60 USD pp).
The Reserve has restuarants and beach access exclusively for people staying at the Reserve, so you might find this to be a plus. 

Cons:
Check-in: the check-in process was easier than most resorts. We met Tony, who checked us in and gave us ideas for restuarants and tours in the area.  When we arrived to our room, we noticed that the floor in our room was dirty. Our socks had dirt and hair on them (disgusting). I spoke with the woman assigned to clean our room and she mentioned that she already mopped the floor but could sweep it again if we wanted  (yes, and take the random hair with you. Please and thank you).

Timeshare presentation: Just don't do it. It's a waste of 1-2hrs of your time. If you do it, at least get something out of it (spa service). Otherwise, just say no - especially if you're on a short trip. Spend that time on the beach. 

Room service: if you order room service after 11 p.m., it is terrible. Very limited options and just not good. 
No ice machines: if you need ice for your room, you have to call room service. Would be nice to have ice machines near the rooms instead of waiting 15 minutes for some ice cubes. 

Nightlife: not much nightlife at the Reserve. There is a small lounge next to Fuego restuarant and a bar at the main Paradisus. Aside from that, the property is a snooze fest after midnight. 

Food options:  The buffet food selections were pretty limited. Same buffet options daily. Definitely not what we're accustomed to. Other resorts have tables full of a tremendous amounts of food options.

Spa: we scheduled a couples massage at the spa. Now, I've been to many spas, both in the U.S and on overseas vacations. I'm a spa snob so I expect the best service. When we were led from the reception desk to the massage room, I was surprised to see that the massage room was located directly behind the reception desk. There was foot traffic and too much noise outside of the room.  Needless to say, I was distracted and not pleased. My masseuse was nice and did a good job but I just couldn't relax with all the noise. I mentioned this at the front desk. They apologized and offered a free 25 min massage for the both of us the next day but we didn't return. I was informed that the spa will be undergoing a renovation soon. Well, not soon enough for my taste. This spa is ranked dead last on my list of destination spas. 
If you plan to schedule a spa service, find out where the room is located first. 

Overall rating: 3, probably because I'm writing this review in May. Had I written the review in March, I probably would have given it 2.5.
I would not recommend this resort for couples.  I would, however,  recommend for families. Looks like families appreciate the concierge service and the resort is very kid-friendly.

reviews.author: peacelilly811
reviews.title: Prob won't return
reviews.text:
our room in the Royal Service area was spacious for the 2 of us, excellent comfortable bed, housekeeping did great job, resort grounds are beautiful and well maintained, the beach panaplas were comfortable, beach area was clean. The seaweed is a problem in the water, but not the fault of the resort.  We ate mostly at the Gabi buffet. Daniel was the best! The first couple of days we loved the food, then it became the same overall, just cooked different ways, and we couldn't wait to get home to eat healthier. My stomach is still queasy after 4 days now home. The papaya though was excellent! Loved the woman who made the delicious omelettes in the mornings. 

In no special order: Big Mac and his crew are excellent entertainers. Dancing music could be better though. The painting class was fun, but the fingerprinting class we did not enjoy bc the teacher criticized the people and was quite sarcastic most of the 40 min. Was not enjoyable at all.

our 'butler' was AWOL for a day or two, the pager didn't work, the bathroom sink had a foul odor most mornings, the water pressure in the shower most evenings was very low. Took me several times to figure out the shower knobs. Much water leaked on the floor. One night there was a knock at the door and it was a housekeeper mentioning that she'd be on holiday the next day, apparently wanting her tip to which we didn't give her! 

Our 'butler' could have done a better job. I think we sought him out more than he sought us out. Although he was very nice, with always a smile when he did show up. The beach butler also did not come around much. I did a lot of seeking him out as well. I had no problems with the transportation to and from the resort. The dinner meal at the Reserve was just okay. I enjoyed a massage by Silvery, very relaxing. Spa area quite beautiful.

I don't think I'd return to this resort, but just wanted a short beach vacation out of the States. I prefer small, quieter resort's, with healthier food/organic choices.

reviews.author: Olya M
reviews.title: Do not forget anything there. You will never see it again.
reviews.text:
Overall a good resort with good food, plenty of shade to hide from a sun and people if you want to. If you like company and swim in the ocean it is better not to stay at a Reserve. It is a good 10 min walk or need to take gulf cart.
Did not have good experience connecting to any of their representatives on a phone or email. They just do not answer any emails and with a phone bounce you around to different people. My first experience trying to book a shuttle to get from the airport to the hotel ended with just getting my own taxi.
Unfortunately. I forgot several pieces of clothes in my room and the same day reached out to the resort. Several emails later, phone calls, sending my friends who stayed behind to speak to the Managers did not produce any response. The same happened to 2 of my friends and they had identical experience so make sure do not forget anything and book  your own transportation.

reviews.author: SKLTW
reviews.title: Five star grounds and lodging -- but overrated food, staff and service
reviews.text:
Overall, this was a nice place to stay. Many people have already pointed out the high points of staying here -- private beach, spacious/updated/modern rooms, stunning well-maintained grounds, proximity to airport. There are many nice touches. Our first day we were greeted with sparkling wine and chocolates (yum). Also, rooms are very clean and well-stocked with towels/bathrobes/slippers. That said, we will point out a few of downsides just so that travelers can come prepared.

First, staff is a little pushy about their agenda to recruit "Club Melia" members. At first, we were flattered by what appeared to be attentive staff (asking about where we were from, our interests, joking freely), however, within minutes the conversation turned to highlights of joining Club Melia. Staff even asked to join our lunch table to discuss this in detail -- awkward! Our repeated attempts to end these conversations politely were unsuccessful. Unfortunately a direct approach worked best. Avoid eye contact with staff members wearing white outfits with blue sashes around the waist -- those are the recruiters!

The beach was beautiful with ample cabanas/huts, but don't expect a front and center ocean-view unless you pay for the "Family Concierge" upgrade. The first three rows of cabanas/huts are reserved for those guests and Club Melia members to claim until 10am. After 10 am they open these seats to other Reserve guests, but an opening in these sections is rare. This was unfortunate because we had already paid extra for the "perks" of staying in the Reserve suites with private beach access. If you do not plan to join Club Melia or pay for the Family Concierge service, consider staying at the main part of the resort or just using their portion of the beach -- seating there is first come/first serve!

Staff also dropped the ball with our dinner reservations. Restaurants other than buffets require reservations. Concierge staff asks that you provide a list of preferred dinner restaurants/dining times and then leaves confirmed reservations under your room door the following afternoon. We put in our requests right away, but did not receive confirmation the following day. We asked three times (separate staff members) about this and were ultimately assured that reservations were made and provided "confirmation." Upon arriving at two of the three restaurants, there was no confirmation and we were kept waiting/almost turned away. This was disappointing.

Regarding dining options, the buffets had a wide variety of food -- you can probably find something you will enjoy. The food was a little bland, but that may be intentional to satisfy mass consumption preferences. Most restaurants (Mole, The Grill, Vento) served food very similar to food available at the buffet. That said, the ambience at all restaurants was impressive. Staff there was courteous and attentive. The best food was at El Fuego -- unique and of higher quality. Overall the food wasn't bad for a busy, high-volume, all-inclusive resort.

One minor annoyance is that there is no dedicated foot path connecting the Reserve suites to the beach. You must walk along the road dodging service vehicles. A little scary at times.

Overall this resort has so much potential -- amazing scenery, excellent location, beautiful rooms. Maybe with a few changes this could be a five-star resort.

reviews.author: Tee J
reviews.title: NO DOMINICAN FOOD?!?!
reviews.text:
Traveled for birthday celebration April 2015
AIRPORT 
1- no signage or direction and a Spanish speaking country
2- you have to pay $10 when entering airport for "tourist card"! No ID required and you only get a receipt...no card...I guess that's the government hustle.
3- "helpers" are swarming luggage area to help you get to transportation area...which is just around the corner...another hustle
THE RESORT 
1- beautiful property. Opt for VIP service with butler. I am sure it's great bu I never called him..LOL!
2- I assumed the staff was African American, like me, carrying on a full conversation and realized they mostly speak Spanish..LMAO! Hey...my bad! The staff was amazing, greeting you throughout the day.
3-  I stayed inThe Reserve #40. It's near main lobby, but far from beach. Had to take ride from shuttle, which can take 30 mins...boooooo!
4- none of the restaurant serve Dominican food...which is strange!!! Mole is a Mexican restaurant that is not great., very commercial...small portion ... A tablespoon of beans and the same fried rice you get at the buffet. Guacamole is watery, chips are red/ green...no Bueno. The buffets were just OK, served the same food 4 days...desserts were not great. Fresh juice and fruit good.
5- bars were good, no la king of liquor. The Mamajuana drink shots can really get you going..
6- there are no inclusive water sports, so you have to pay at the place on the beach
7- to me it seems there would be Dominican music going, but no!. They play remixed versions of American classics and a few Spanish tunes...disappointed me greatly 
8- not much night life on the resort, one club and they seem to only have Pit Bull and Rihanna on rotation. 
9- there are kids who may get whiny, so get ready for that
10- nice resort, quiet and relaxed...wifi can be sketchy 
11- get the Outback tour excursion to see the locals, get some Dominican food and goods
12- the mall is like any other in US..avoid if you want local items
13- for local shopping go to beach and walk to your left and you will find about 3 cool shops with gifts, art, hair braiding, t-shirts and great sundresses. It is next to a black and white beachouse abou a 1/2 mile nice walk!!

reviews.author: Laurie I
reviews.title: Satisfied
reviews.text: Be sure to get a room on the first floor. There aren't any elevators in the Reserve buildings. The food is ok. Do not expect professional service in the restaurants. The beach has limited huts. I liked the pool area. The camp needs more activities for older children.

reviews.author: Raydioman61
reviews.title: Glad it was free!
reviews.text:
Annually, we go on a  reward trip, given to the top salespeople at my wife's company.  We've gone to places like Costa Rica, Cabo, Florida, etc, usually at a golf oriented resort.  The five day trip to Paradisus Palma Real happened in early April, 2015.

First of all, my review is based on my previous resort experience.. Some people will have different opinions than mine, different people have different tastes.

I'll say right off, that if you are looking for a private, romantic get-a-way with your spouse, spending quiet, relaxing time on the beach, listening to the waves lapping up to the beach and the wind ruffling through the palm trees, this probably isn't the spot for you.. I say this, because this is very family friendly, and you will have lots of kids screaming at the pool and at the beach.  That is one strike against already for me, because I like it peaceful.
Secondly, the rooms look fancy when you walk in, but as you look closer, there are lots of flaws and lack of attention to detail.  We had an upgraded room, which had a kitchen, as well as a dining area and living room.  The bathroom had a leak near the commode, which had obviously been there for quite awhile, since you could see the repair attempts, and also the floor drain in the little commode 'nook'.  Also, ceiling fans didn't work in the living room area.

This is an "all inclusive" resort, meaning that most of the restaurants are free.. There are a couple that are extra, most are included.  I didn't enjoy the food at any meal, the coffee wasn't good (they didn't even know how to make a latte, or other coffee drinks.. That's disappointing, since they are supposed to have excellent coffee in this country.

One really positive thing about the beach here.. the sand is white and soft, you don't need any kind of shoes to walk in it.  It's very nice.. However, during my time at the beach, there was loud, thumpin' music being played, both on the beach, and on party boats just off the beach.. There was no place, during the day, at least, where you could find a peaceful, romantic spot, if that's what you are looking for.

Room service started good, but went downhill the longer we stayed.  Most of the employees understand English, but few speak it well.  We had several days where clean towels weren't put in the bathroom, and coffee packets/stocked refrigerator items weren't replaced.  Wifi is terrible here.. I know, you're at a resort, you should be out enjoying it, not logged in to your computer.. but, it would be nice to check online for area events or information.. I thought maybe it was just our room, but almost everyone in our very large group had the same issues with the internet.

Here are some tips.. a cab ride to the Hard Rock Casino Resort is $30 BOTH WAYS.. taxi cabs are expensive here.  All the roads have speed bumps, and motorbike/scooter taxis crowd the road.  We went to see the Don Lucas cigar makers, and I did enjoy that.. However, the guard there, walked around with a shotgun, and that made me alittle nervous.  In face, every resort or business in that area, has a gated guard shack, and the guards are all packin' the heat, which says something about the country.

The small mall is just down the street from the resort, you probably could walk there, but the resort does have a free wagon ride down to it and back every fifteen minutes.. We bought our Larimar stuff there, at the jewelry shop.. Most of the stores are American type stores, like Addidas, Dior, etc.. they even have a Hard Rock Cafe, and Outback Steakhouse.

I love palm trees and peaceful beaches.. This place has the palm trees, but it's not peaceful to me.. Others will have a different opinion, as I said before, everybody has their own opinions.  I don't see any reason why I need to go back here, I can get pretty much the same stuff in south Florida.

reviews.author: SunshineFamily
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with mediocre food and service.
reviews.text: The hotel facility is spectacular and the scenery is wonderful. The foundation is set, but there is a whole lot of education that needs to go in with the staff on what top level service is. They are all incredibly friendly, but there is a language barrier and miscommunication, mediocre service at the main restaurant, and the food (other than 1 or 2 of the restaurants) could use a whole overhaul. Truthfully they need to bring in a top chef to set the menus and recipes and recreate the entire offering.

reviews.author: NattieV2014
reviews.title: Beware of beach vendors near the waters edge!
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd trip to the DR and our first time at a Paradisus Resort. This is a beautiful resort that seems very well kept.  Our room on the 3rd floor, a junior suite, was comfortable, quiet and clean but there was only a view of the tree tops but for us,  it was no deal breaker.  It was quite a walk (no elevator) to the main part of the resort so you may want to consider this if you have trouble walking

The buffet had a large variety of things to choose from and most of it was quite good.  I didn't see the choices change at all during our stay but with so much to choose from it shouldn't be a problem.  The stone fired pizza they served at lunch was surprisingly good but the desserts were very pretty to look at but lacked in taste.  There's something about the cream cheese and the chocolate they use that just have an odd texture and aftertaste. We did have dinner at Rare and I wouldn't recommend it at all.  The service was slow even though it wasn't busy and my medium well steak was not even medium rare.... it was VERY rare.  We got up and left after they gave us the dessert menu and we waited for them to take our orders for another 15 minutes so our total time there for dinner was 2 hours.  We also ate at the Hibachi style restaurant.  It was good and our chef Luis Taveras did an excellent job making us feel welcome and the dinner was quite good and there was plenty of it. 

The pool area was nice but again we had to get there early to "save" a spot or there would be nothing available by 10am.  This seems to be a common practice at the other resorts we've been to so we just go with the flow for that.  There was something different to do around the pool each day.  Water aerobics, water cycling, etc and always enthusiasm from the activity directors.  There were a number of children here but I saw nothing geared to the children on the beach OR by the pool so I'm not sure how they were kept entertained.

The beach LOOKED pretty but the wind was awful while we were there so we were not able to relax there one time during our 5 day stay.  We did take short walks when we needed a break from the pool but the number of beach vendors approaching us and wanting us to go back to their shops "5 minutes away" got to be WAY too much.  While I realize this is their way to make a living, it shouldn't be so intrusive at a 5 star resort.  They never stopped approaching or following us even when we said we were not interested.  Perhaps the resort would allow them space to sell their items a couple times a week to avoid this.  Our last day there the resort did have security standing on the beach with clubs in their hands... is that relaxing or what?

The language barrier seemed to be more of a problem here than at the Hard Rock DR or in Jamaica last year and the staff never seemed as eager to help us even when tips were involved.  They didn't seem to want to be "bothered" when we asked for help with anything from food to the front desk so much of the time we just tried to figure it out on our own.

For the most part we had an enjoyable stay but I doubt we would stay here again just because of the beach vendors.  When they tell you they can get you ANYTHING and all you need to do is follow them to their shop 5 minutes away, here's my advice..... it might be all well and good but I wouldn't go.

reviews.author: bigcat1981
reviews.title: Not the greatest place.
reviews.text:
The resort itself  was beautiful, usually any are in Mexico or on any island. It's what comes with the scenery that you don't see in the brochures. 

First and last time to Dominican Republic. Huge language barrier with hotel staff that actually interacted with you, let alone asking cleaning staff for extra towels. It was like pulling teeth. 

Staff wasn't rude, but basically you could have got the same experience  from people at a Motel 6 in Albuquerque. This doesn't apply to all staff by the way. You always get a few that go above and beyond for you.

No real wait staff on the beach. You are paying money for this kind of stuff, its kind of expected. 

Restaurants were mediocre at best. Buffet actually was very good! You can never go wrong with a buffet. 

Rooms were nice with the exception of floor mounted door stops. They really hurt when you stub your toe on one coming out of the shower. 

They never restocked the mini bar in the room either. It took til the fourth afternoon when I saw the guy with the cart and flagged him down.

All in all, I'm a Riviera Maya guy. 2.5 stars out of 5 for me.

reviews.author: Fifitio28
reviews.title: Hotel all-in mewah
reviews.text: Hotelnya sangat luas dan memiliki banyak aktivitas sehingga tidak perlu kemana mana. Makan pagi di Royal Service sangat enak. Kamar tidak terlalu besar, namun nyaman. Hanya saja jarak antara kamar dan tempat aktivitas lumayan jauh.

reviews.author: Thenewguy1122
reviews.title: Nice place but half-baked
reviews.text:
Pros: big room, all-inclusive, nice beach, big pool

Issues:

In general, everything looks nice when things work well, but they have no idea how to handle problems.

Wi-fi is free hotel wide, and that's great, but then it went out one evening, and was not back by the time we left, more than 24 hours. The only answer was "the technician is working on it". I asked several times to get a call from someone in charge, nobody called back. Phone simply kept ringing several minutes without anybody answering when I asked my call to be transferred. 

The open buffet is good, the variety looks nice, but it was the same for seven days we stayed there. 

The restaurants that require reservations had pretty much the similar variety of the food as the buffet, just different presentation.  Wine is overpriced.  
The only exception was Mizu, the hibachi place at Reserve. Good food, nice place. 

The service personnel is nice. They are trying to be helpful the best they can. However, their knowledge of English is very limited. If you do not speak Spanish, ordering room service is an adventure comparable to a funny scene from a sitcom. 
Housekeeping people are very good and diligent. They don't speak English well either, but it's not needed. 

The people with best knowledge of English are concierges, who are working as sales agents for Club Melia timeshare membership. Went out of curiosity. Usual stuff with high "maintenance" fees and hidden extras. Once we declined to purchase the membership, our personal concierge disappeared. He previously promised to be around all the time and help us with everything. 

Pool is big and nice. Water is cold. OK but not for everybody. Despite pool being big, sitting areas have very little capacity. We were lucky that hotel was not full when we stayed.

reviews.author: Ksenia311
reviews.title: Not so much for couples
reviews.text:
There were a few things that I didn't like about this property, hence 3 stars. Most importantly paradisus's premier Reserve hotel is 15 minutes away from the beach!! Yes, there is a shuttle that you can take, however it is not as readily available as I personally would like. Most importantly, I don't want to take a shuttle, I want to be staying on the beach like every other hotel in the carribean. Most people who were staying here had children so I felt out of place. The beds are way to old and stiff, both me and my fiance woke up with backaches. Property is to spread apart, it's a pain to walk from one place to the next.  Restaurants are so far away that you have no choice but take that shuttle. I wouldn't mind walking after the dinner but it's easy to get lost in the dark. All things considered, experience was ok at best. I'm still wondering if there is a gift shop ...everything is so spread out that there is no way to know...
The property and the pool areas are well taken care of.  Everything is very clean.  Food overall is pretty good.

reviews.author: chungaveitz
reviews.title: Sentimientos encontrados
reviews.text: Después de haber tenido una muy buena experiencia el año pasado en el Paradisus Punta Cana decidimos volver a la Reserva. La experiencia en general fue buena pero la comida en los restaurantes fue un poco decepcionante y con pocas opciones en los buffet. Tuvimos una mala experiencia al reservar una de las camas de la piscina, volvimos y una conserje había retirado nuestras pertenencias para dársela a otras personas. Hay zonas en las que  se siente el paso de los años y  necesita remodelaciones. Esperando tener una experiencia superior a la que tuvimos en el  Paradisus punta cana terminamos con sentimientos encontrados. Esperábamos mas de La Reserva.

reviews.author: Mitch M
reviews.title: Nice Place But Still Lacking
reviews.text: I don't have high expectations for all-inclusive resorts so I'm not really complaining.  The grounds were beautiful and clean and the food was good,  but the place seemed like it was being run by high school kids. Hardly anybody understood English.  The rooms were okay but the bathroom design was stupid.  A glass door for the toilet room, a toilet you had to flush twice to work properly, a shower that needed an owner's manual to operate.  I took a bath every night because I could figure out the shower.  My big complaint was the restuarant scam.  They force you to eat at the buffets which were good but if you wanted to eat at the nicer restuarants you couldn't.  They had some excuse about not having any avialability but all the nice restuarants were either vacant or sparsely populated every night all night.  We did complain and they miraculously found us a table.  I don't know why they even have the nice restuarants if they won't let people use them.  Other than that, it was a typical all-inclusive resort.  A cruise ship on land.

reviews.author: Ramiro D
reviews.title: The best in RD
reviews.text:
Merci à toute l'équipe du KIDZONE, merci à  KATYE une fille pleine de vie qui a émerveillé ma fille LUA, Merci à Jonathan, un jeune garçon très chaleureux et souriant....
Un grand merci à NOEL, ce petit gars de l'équipe d'animation qui a un grand coeur et de belles ambitions il a su nous donner sa gentillesse et son affection, j'adore ce garçon, et il faut dire que c'est un danseur hors paire....
Merci à Louis également, un basketteur hors paire toujours le sourire et le mot pour rire
Merci à José un serveur très gentil et enthousiaste qui avait toujours le sourire....
J'espère que ces 5 PERSONNES SERONT PRESENTES LORSQUE NOUS REVIENDRONS, si nous revenons .... 
J espère que la Direction saura évidemment les récompenser car ils le méritent ils sont au petit soin....
Les désagréments dans cet hôtel: une musique répétitive usante et abominable, que l'on a l'habitude d'entendre dans nos pays.... Si nous venons en RD c'est pour trouver de la batchata du merengue des sons qui donnent chaud au coeur ..... Vraiment c'est la grosse faiblesse de l'hôtel, la MUSIKA....
L'hotel devrait accentuer son offre vers plus d'exotisme, c'est ce que l'on vient chercher...Des cours de BATCHATA DE MERENGUE.......
Une grosse déception à ce niveau

reviews.author: Barb M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Wonderful People, Take Stomach Medicine
reviews.text:
We traveled to the Paradisus Palma Real Resort February 13th. 2015.
The resort is absolutely beautiful. Grounds are manicured to perfection. Our room was very nice and the bed was comfortable. Minibar had beer, soda and juice. No vodka etc. Every staff member we came into contact with was excellent and willing to do whatever they could to make our stay enjoyable.
Victor Benitz delivered our breakfast every morning and took our order for the next day. Always very prompt and friendly. 
Food at the buffets was just ok. There were lots of choices but not too much flavor. 
I guess that is a good thing since we got very sick during our stay with diarrhea. We were in a group of 94 people and almost everyone had a similar experience to ours. We tried to find a common "cause" but everyone went on different day trips, some drank liquor some didn't. We knew to not drink the water so we brushed teeth with bottled water and took precautions like that. We noticed a lot of people complaining about sickness at this resort since last November on trip advisor. My guess is that there is a bad water filter on an ice machine or someone mis-handling food.  I might give them another try in the future, but would probably take a long look at the reviews to see if the sicknes issue is resolved.

reviews.author: 421ohio
reviews.title: Beautiful place but food poisoning ruined the vacation
reviews.text: When we arrived at the hotel we were amazed at the beauty of the place. The staff was so friendly, but all of that quickly changed when one by one we watched our friends go down with food poisoning. By the end of our 5 day stay over 100 of our group of 400 were down with food poisoning and 1 remains in the Dominican hospital .  We've visited many islands and always dreaded returning home , but on this trip we couldn't get home soon enough.

reviews.author: Christine N
reviews.title: The staff was the best part!
reviews.text: Mini mi, Rey Rey, jazz and Reyna were the best staff at any of the resorts we have ever been to. They all made our week there so enjoyable! What a wonderful group on young people. The beach had a lot of seaweed and the people trying to sell you stuff were a pain. The food for the most part was good. The restaurant Rare was not good at all. You have to watch some of the fish also it comes out only partcially cooked.

reviews.author: Shalanda M
reviews.title: Staff needs more training
reviews.text:
The resort itself is beautiful and could be a permanent fixture in my vacation plans if they get a few things resolved.   Check in was horrible but the staff was nice.  The lines were long and our rooms weren't ready to hours after 3pm.  There were so many issues with rooms and no one could move to other rooms since the hotel was booked.  My keys did not work and I had to ask someone to meet me over to get new ones.  The staff at first requested I walk back over to the lobby.  When is it appropriate to ask your guest to come fix your problems?  

The rooms were nice but need some do need upgrading.  The resort is really for relaxation even though there is a lounge and casino.  Overall, I enjoyed my staff but hope the resort takes my comments seriously or they will lose interest of potential future guests.

reviews.author: khannah
reviews.title: Hits and missed
reviews.text:
We stayed first week of March.  What missed was the casino. I have a bigger closet. Literally 15 slot machines and three tables. Laughable. 
Royal service? Not sure how royal. Sure they brought a fruit tray. Big deal. I could walk to the buffet and get a tray of fruit day and night. Made dinner reservations. Again big deal. Very overrated. Accommodations? Very dated. Closet doors didn't open without a crane and my shoulder.  
We stayed at Atlantis in Bahamas last year and it makes Palma Real look cheap and very, very overrated.

reviews.author: Brian A
reviews.title: Nice but Overpriced
reviews.text:
Pros:  Clean rooms, volleyball for teenager daughters, good food, friendly staff.

Cons:  Housekeeping woman always in men's restroom at pool while it was occupied, staff not helpful at corner desk in main lobby, restaurants always booked but only 1/4 full, maintenance would seal/paint wood bridge over pool getting chemical in pool that would stick to swimmers like plastic wrap (difficult to remove) and manager ignored complaints from swimmers, lighting of stairwells too dim causing me to miss a step and fall to my knees on hard concrete floor, activities are way overpriced - $240 US for 5 to snorkel was best price,$4,000 in hotel credits were useless as items were severely overpriced to start ($150 US for 50 min massage but could only use $50 credit), and need to tip money for everything.

Nice place, but poor service, and not worth the money.

reviews.author: isa6768stcloud
reviews.title: Bien mais gros problème de réservation des restaurants
reviews.text:
Hotel dans un très beau décor, parc très bien entretenu.
Problème dans la réservation des restaurants : nous n'avons jamais pu avoir le resto que nous demandions (résas pourtant effectuées le 1er jour de l'arrivée pour les 7 diners), le concierge étant incapable ce qui fait que nous avons été obligé de diner aux buffets tous les soirs. Buffet normal mais sans changement donc au bout de 7 jours on en a un peu marre !
Golf : navette toutes les heures donc pas pratique, il vaut mieux aller au Paradisius palma real pour ceux qui jouent au golf car en face. Problème également dans la réservation : résa que la veille pour le lendemain et incapable d'avoir un horaire correct !
Bref une mauvaise gestion par le personnel de l'hotel.

reviews.author: Ted G
reviews.title: There are much better places to stay!
reviews.text:
Very Attractive Location, nice suite, average buffet --- but you need to need to check the reports from other reviewers about the ongoing "games" played at this resort to motivate you to participate in their "upgrades" or Time-share seminars  We were not on the "Royal" packages but the others in our group were told it was available for an additional $100 per night. 

Other guests in Royal service chatted about how their butler provided information about life in D.R. etc etc - our Staff didn't understand enough english to supply more coffee mate or sugar in the room when requested, and it was difficult to get bar drinks correct. (tipping generously did not seem to help).

Booking into the A la Carte resturants is quite a ordeal. I agree with the reviewer who thought this game was tied to participation in the "time-share" seminar and tour participation as well as Royal Service Booking. We were routinely told "no available times" at the resturant booking desk only to see these venues less than half full for evening. Significant tipping of the Resturant Hostess sometimes helped with access, but we NEVER saw a full A la Carte.

We have not experienced this type of "run-around" before. - We won't be back.

reviews.author: jhfw
reviews.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
reviews.text:
The Good:  The pool is awesome.  The property is beautiful. The staff (with exceptions noted below) are friendly and helpful.  Our suite was lovely.  The food is fine.  The Michael Jackson Tribute Show is life-changing.   And, none of us came down with Chikungunya.

The Bad:  The beach is kind of gross (I realize this isn't the hotel's fault...but its worth noting).  The sea is not the usual gorgeous, clear Caribbean water.  It's kind of murky and sea-weedy until you swim out about 25 yards, at which point you risk being decapitated by jet skis and speed boats. 

The Ugly:  The entire week is an elaborate game of Dominican Cat & Mouse, in which you (the hapless guest) attempt to procure the services you want (and have already paid for) while the management (notably NOT the lower-level staff, who are uniformly lovely) pretend they have no idea what you are talking about, until you (a) slip them ever-increasing cash tips, (b) agree to spend hours of your already-too-scarce vacation time attending seminars on Exciting Time Share Opportunities or (c) upgrade from whatever level of service you have already paid for.  Our "Concierge" literally chased us around the resort, called our room at 8:00 AM, and made a general nuisance of herself until we agreed to tour the timeshares.  We were mysteriously unable to get reservations for meals until we had consented.  MANAGEMENT, TAKE NOTE:  I work very hard, and I have come to your hotel to relax and to spend time with my family.  I have not come here to spend even one minute sitting in a "seminar".  Even if I LOVED your hotel, I will not buy a timeshare here if you pressure me to sacrifice my hard-earned vacation time.  MANAGEMENT, TAKE ADDITIONAL NOTE:  Your customers are not as dumb as we look.  We all figured out very quickly that there was a game going on in which the only way to secure coveted dinner reservations or chairs on the beach was to upgrade to the next level of service.  We get it.  You would be MUCH better off simply having a clear policy (for example, "This restaurant is only available to guests who are on the Royal Service plan"), rather than pretending that you are trying your darndest to find us a table, but, lo siento, señora, there are no tables available.  Its exhausting, silly, and ruins an otherwise lovely hotel.

reviews.author: BBarner
reviews.title: Stunning Scenery, Dated Facility
reviews.text:
The beaches of Punta Cana are stunning with their silky sand and clear waters. And the Paradisus campus is a tropical garden of birds, flowers, palms and ponds. It is easy to enjoy it all with the resort's multitude of pools, walking paths, airy restaurants and seating spaces, and expansive beach.

But Melia needs to consider refurbishing the rooms in its dated hotel facilities. Between the spotty phone service, paint spatter on the television, sagging shower fixtures, and DSL Internet, some capital upgrades are needed to restore the shine. The staff are very pleasant, but don't expect Asian-style service at this laid back resort. The supply of beach towels is exhausted by noon and it's rare to be approached by a server poolside (not to worry, the swim up bar is near by).

These are relatively minor inconveniences to endure, but you expect more at these prices. The most disappointing part of our trip was being asked to sit through a 90 minute sales pitch for Melia's time share business (we declined). Paying guests should be shown much more respect for their time.

reviews.author: MValetta
reviews.title: Thank Goodness for Royal Service- ASK FOR LUIS the Butler
reviews.text:
A few overall words to describe the hotel and the grounds: Busy, unromantic, mediocre food, sugary drinks, seaweed covered beaches, untrained service staff, lacking luxury.

Therefore, ROYAL SERVICE is NECESSARY!

There were however, 2 people and one special restaurant that made our stay memorable.
 LUIS SANCHEZ, our Royal Service Butler, and LEONARDO MOTA our royal service pool bartender know what the word SERVICE means! They are amazing in every way and they should be in charge of training all of the other staff members. 

Even though he was stationed behind the bar, Leonardo would still com down to the beach to see us, and ask what we wanted to drink. AND, he remembered all of our drinks every time and even brought them out to us at the beach. 

Luis, made sure everything was arranged for us: Pool cabanas, beach lounge chairs reserved, restaurant reservations secured, and transportation back to the airport arranged. He had wine delivered nightly along with cheese plates, chocolate covered strawberries, and other fruits. He also surprised the birthday girls of our group with a special Butler-Drawn-Bath complete with flowers and candles and birthday wishes "written" with the flower petals. On top of that he arranged for a special Birthday Cake one night that was so incredibly delicious, I think it was the best dessert we had on the entire trip! INCREDIBLE.

The one restaurant that really made our stay is PASSION. The only problem is, it costs extra. A lot extra. $70 a person plus beverages. However it was worth it. If only all the other restaurants had half that in food quality or service it would make a big difference. I loved every course and it truly reminded me of some of the amazing Michelin star restaurants I enjoyed in Spain.

Rooms are nice in the Royal Service section, although a little small for a resort. If you don't mind walking stairs (there are no elevators) ask to be on floor 2 or above so you can see the water from your bed when you awake. Ocean Views are worth it. Showers are a little intricate and unnecessary - we never once used all of those crazy jets and it was hard to get the thing to turn off and on with out spraying water everywhere. Mattresses are very comfy, BUT I wish they had King-size pillows instead of the tiny pillows they use.

Be warned that the beaches in the DR always seem to be strewn with seaweed and it is everywhere.  It is not fun to swim with! I get it, it is nature what can you do?

The Royal Service pool is nice and we didn't once go to the crazy overcrowded main pool with all the "Normal service" guests. It was nice to have a space to relax without kids and with a more civilized adult crowd.

Palazzo restaurant is reserved for just Royal Service guests and it offers a la carte ordering for breakfast and lunch (along with a small buffet option). TRUST ME, it is easy to get sick of buffet style food. The eggplant appetizer at dinner was so delicious.

THE SPA: disorganized. We had to select services and set up massage times THREE DIFFERENT TIMES to confirm an appointment because they just could not get it. The first time we requested was before our trip via email, but when we arrived, nothing was set up because that employee who set it up ANNA was not working that week, or had left... we never got the real story. SO, on the beach the day before our spa day, our butler along with a spa coordinator came to the beach and had us reselect services. We all WROTE DOWN on a piece of paper our selected services, along with our names and room numbers. We were supposed to have been set up for 11:30 am on Friday.  WELL, when we arrived Friday morning around 11am, SURPRISE! Nothing was set up. The paper got lost and nothing got entered into the system.... We had to start over AGAIN. NOT RELAXING.  

BE AWARE also, that the so-called FACIALS they offer are really not facials. I booked a 25 minute Shine facial that was supposed to be CUSTOMIZED to my skin-type. The therapist never asked me what type of skin I had, did not offer a selection of products and didn't even tell me exactly what she was putting on my face. She just kept slathering stuff on and wiping it off and repeating it over and over. NO steam, no extractions. VERY STRANGE. And for the high prices the charge, this is just UNACCEPTABLE. 

Overall we had a very nice trip because we were a group of 6 fun girls, but also because we came across a few great service staff members. But would I go back? NO. I would rather choose Mexico where the resorts can be higher-end, the beaches more beautiful and all the service staff rocks.

FYI, the Punta Cana airport has no AC and can be brutally hot!

reviews.author: DISNEYCHICKS
reviews.title: The stars were kind of stacked against us ...
reviews.text:
Travel dates October 21st through October 30, 2014..

Our vacation started on a rough note and ended on a rougher one...

Trying to depart on time from ATW was not in the stars. Arriving at airport about 3:00 AM and not departing till 10ish can make for a long morning.  Our Delta fight had mechanical problem.  But the people at ATW and Delta took phenomenal care of us.  Keeping us up to date with the latest information.  The care that they gave us ... I have never seen at any other airport. Granted ATW is a smaller airport. Delta had supplied us with coffee and muffins in the early hours. Another delay time was added. They had to have a part flown in from another state ...round 2 .. Sub sandwiches, chip and drinks were supplied.  Bellies full and flight left around 10.  Again thank-you Delta for taking good care of your "cargo" ...Bad part, we missed our connecting flight in Atlanta :( had to do an unexpected sleep over. Delta put us up in a hotel in Atlanta (see my Atlanta review of hotel)  and gave us a small travel pouch with some necessities, since our luggage was sent to the international part of the airport it was locked up supposedly it would take hours to find.  Hotel was great and serves a wonderful hot breakfast to get us started on the right foot...

Airport was a breeze...and arrived quickly to our resort.

Arrived one day late but, we finally arrive to start our vacation.
Check-in ...the only thing I really remember them saying to me was ... You look very tired and not happy (Oh, OK). Thinking, just get us to our room so we can unpack and get this vacation started.

Room was wonderful, clean, and huge with a partial view of the pool. We unpacked and set off to start our new adventure.
For some reason it seemed like we were walking around blindly ... Having a hard time getting information out of people and felt like no one wanted to help ?!?!?!  Just a strange feeling.  A few days later we figured out we never received our information packet :( 

Resort ... Beautiful, lush and breath taking. Well maintained in all aspects.
I'm not sure why ... But both my friend  and myself felt ... Like we were a bit invisible to employees ... Finding the people at this resort very much on the cold side, not warm and inviting at all ....very disappointing.  Neither my friend nor I are the demanding, pushy cater to me type...

The only time that people seemed remotely interested in us ...I have a TA luggage tag attached on my back pack that I carry around during the day ...the employees would come right up to us and ask us to do a review on TA about them. Sure you delivered me one drink  ... I will give you a raving review ... Really ...Some came right up to us and asked that we never even met . I have never been to a resort were the employees are constantly asking you if you will/did write a review on them yet ...as they would point in the direction of the nearest computer we could use ...why sure, thank-you, not a problem ... I'll run right over there to do it ....  After a few days I took the tag off my backpack...so we wouldn't get bothered any more... Yes I know their sole purpose of wanting to see their name in a review... is to get time off ... But really ... STOP hounding the guest.  There were a few that were pretty good to us ..but the constant asking, I decided not to say their names (sorry). We saw this happening with many of the guest. Don't get me wrong I enjoy TA immensely and is a wealth of information and give credit were credit is due... but.

About our 3rd day we decided to book a spa treatment ...  We were so bummed to find out that the main spa building was closed down and being refurbished. They were using one of the buildings for makeshift spas. Both of us booked facials ...oh Dear God and Baby Jesus ...Was not sure about my gal right off the bat. First of all she wanted me to lay on the table with my street clothes on… Don't you usually get undressed and cover up with a sheets ... She was not liking it but I ended doing it anyways...Then the music came on, over the top loud...it sounded like 2 sea animals trying to "get it on" ....while mixing up her different lotions and potions to apply on my face...it sounded like she was more in a kitchen... she was clanging and banging things together.... So relaxing… NOT. Now for the application of the product to my face  ... Can you say let's "frost a cake" with a spatula... Now comes the middle part where they "usually" gently with flowing motions work on your neck shoulders (this is why I was wondering why I was supposed to keep my street clothes on) arms, hands, legs and feet ... This lady “motions” we from a beat of a different drum. Now the smell of cigarette smoke is wafting into my room. Can it really get any better ??? Now it is time to un-frost the cake ....you got it ... Clang banging in the sink...the noise, the smoke, the animals getting it on and the lady un-frosting the cake.... Can I please just be done and have a stiff drink...

My friend came out of her room. And she her experience was OK ... What, no special treatment for her… What's the deal !!! 

So now I'm excited we get to go to the bar . Have a drink and I get to tell her all about magical experience. That she would be extremely jealous about.
While standing by the bar area ... My BFF said ... "You know what, my belly kind of feels weird, icky, bloated and rumbling noises ( she should of been in by me ...and heard my sea creatures noises) would you mind if went back to the room and call it a night"....it just can't get any better than this ... Right ?!? I grab a night cap on off we go back to our room...remember when I said  "it couldn't get any better ...well...got in the door and that poor girl lost her innards right in the toilet :( Thank God she just  got her hair cut short, so I didn't have to hold it out of the toilet :) score 1 for me ...well my friend had permanent toilet seat marks on her  derrière for the next 5 dayz :( 

It's alive ... She came out of the room after 2 days of being confined. I love it .She goes to a AI resort to have the "BRAT" diet.  Which consist of bananas, rice and toast.  Found a lounger for her out by the pool next the restroom for parts of the day. Poor girl :(  We do not know what caused this problem for her ... Not blaming anyone ...just have no idea what caused it. 

I did get to take in a couple shows by myself… This was the highlight of my evenings for as my friend was tucked into bed or stuck to the toilet...absolutely love the Michael Jackson show and Bounce!!!  These performers are absolutely wonderful. The main lobby of these two complexes...beautiful…I could've hung out in this area for days.

For us the Wi-Fi  was great... pool, beach and room.

I did get to enjoy a few a la carte meals, alone. For the most part all in all ...the restaurants and buffets I would rate a seven or eight out of the 10. I loved have breakfast, early morning coffee and the lovely morning sunshine.

Bars and drinks, Tried an array of different cocktail and pretty much enjoyed them all.

Enjoyed the walk to the beach, all of the beautiful landscaping and flower, this is always a treat for me. Only took the tram a few times  I believe there are 3 different paths to get there. 

Beach was very maintained and groomed. We had our own beach area for  "reserve" people. Enjoyed the beach/bar service.  Lots of shade if needed with plenty of towels.

The second day of our trip, we went parasailing… This is a first for me and her!  We had 2 gentlemen join us on our flight out to the main boat… It was hard for them to get into the boat from land because of the large waves, then the one said to his friend "mind you're nuts Nelly" in their English accent (love it).  For the duration of the trip  this was our saying  :)
 
Somewhere along the line here… My face was exposed to too much sun or broke out from the day the lady decorating my face with frosting... it looked like I had the chickenpox… or a nail gun went ballistic on my face....does the fun never end.

The only person that I am going to knowledge on this trip is,  Annabel a concierge in our building....Annabelle was always checking on my friend and checking with me when I would meet up with her and asking about how my friend was doing. Annabella even took it upon herself to send up room service for my BFF. Consisting of crackers, water bananas… What a wonderful lady!!

This was probably one of the larger resorts that I've stayed at. Lots of things going on day or night or you could have you quiet space.  I personally enjoy a smaller quaint resort instead.  If the "Reserve" area would have been on the beach..it would of just been more of a bonus...So relaxing to be by the water.

With all this unplanned adventures we had… We sat at the resort and laughed about them… As we still do today. What else can could we do ... But laugh.

Off to find my next adventure...

reviews.author: joan n
reviews.title: Nice but slow
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed  there on a business trip. The resort is spacious and nice. They have golf carts to take you around the property so you don't have to walk very far. The service was a little lacking and so was the food.

reviews.author: scott r
reviews.title: beautiful island and resort but the food almost killed me
reviews.text: the title says it all.The resort is amazing clean and beautiful. staff will take care of you just remember 5 and 10 will get royal treatment with out making the hotel rich give it to the people they need it. Now back to the food be very careful I picked up a paracite in the food and was hospilized for 4 days.

reviews.author: Krabito
reviews.title: No superó mis expectativas.
reviews.text: De acuerdo a mi experiencia y a las veces que he visitado Punta Cana, definitivamente hay mejores opciones si solo van adultos o parejas, pero si asistes con niños puede resultar una buena elección ya que hay una zona exclusiva para infantes y varias piscinas. Hablando en general la comida es aceptable, en cuanto al personal del hotel hay personas amables y otras no. Las habitaciones son cómodas y lo mejor fue el Internet, buena cobertura en todas las áreas. Los aspectos negativos, el personal no fue eficiente cuando solicité que realicen las reservas en los restaurantes, se demoraban demasiado en contestar las llamadas y tenia que reconfirmarlas, al hacerlo me daba con la ingrata sorpresa que no tenia reserva alguna,  Otro aspecto es que se debe tomar un carrito para ir a la playa.

reviews.author: Jennifer P
reviews.title: Service is spotty
reviews.text:
I just got back from a 5 day stay as part of a work function.  There were over 200 of us and it was the second year my company booked at this resort.  We had name badges that identified us as part of the group and the service received was very different depending on whether or not I was wearing my name badge.  If I was wasn't wearing the name badge service was very, very slow even though I was tipping well.  It was quicker to get my own drinks and even then the wait at the bar was often 5 minutes or more even though it wasn't busy.  The bartenders seemed to find it more interesting to talk to each other than the guests that were waiting to be served.  We waited for 20 minutes for to make a dinner reservation and the lady that booked it rolled her eyes when we told her we wanted it for that night.  It seemed like a huge imposition but when we got the restaurant there were only 4 other tables there.  The food at the buffet was good but we were often finished our meals before we even got water.  The rooms were large and very clean but, like other reviewers have pointed out, the bathroom situation was less than ideal if you wanted any privacy.  All of the regular rooms were far away from the pool and the beach and there were no convenient elevators.  We didn't mind taking the stairs but if you have a mobility issue ask for a ground floor room.  Skip the disco, it's tiny.  
I noticed that the majority of the 5 star reviews were from people who upgraded to Royal Service.  I agree if you pay extra you should get extras however, this resort is quite pricey and the service for the "standard" trip should be better than it was.  
The pool, the beach, and the grounds are stunning, however, the pool was freezing!   When I had my name badge on the service was great!  Based on that I would have to say that upgrading to royal service is probably worth it.  I probably wouldn't go back to this resort based on bang for your buck.  I have stayed at another all inclusive in DR and the service was much better for a lower price.

reviews.author: Richard N
reviews.title: Not so good
reviews.text:
Ils ne font pas assez d'effort pour garder la plage propre; bouteilles, algues , etc..
Vérifiez votre facture comme il faut au départ. Nous avions $550 US de chargé en trop
Manque d'organisation; le dernier jour, nous avions réservé le matin un restaurant pour le soir même; le Fuego et il était fermé le soir. Pas de réservation, pas de souper au restaurant. Nous avons quand même réussi après beaucoup de négociations.
Ne laissez rien trainer dans votre chambre. Utiliser le coffre. J'ai égaré une paire d'écouteur par ma négligence. Je les ai laissé sur le bureau de la chambre pendant mon absence.
Soyez patient, ce n'est pas toujours évident de se faire comprendre.

reviews.author: Red B
reviews.title: Lovely staff not so hot room
reviews.text:
The staff at the Paradisus Reserve couldn't have been nicer.  Veronica Martinez, the hostess at the Gabi, made our meals there a delight.  She was friendly, concerned and followed up to make sure all our needs were met.  Emilio Valdez, at the Reserve pool, was a warm, concerned pool host, always coming by to see if we needed anything.  By the second day he knew our names, and his greetings made us feel as though we were valued. The food was average with two exceptions:  Mole and the Grab and Go Grill at the Reserve pool. We enjoyed eating at both 
Unfortunately, our room seemed to be a haven for mosquitoes. On our first night we had an exterminator come to the room at 1 AM because we were tired of trying to deal with them.  While the situation improved, we were never without the flying pests in our room.  We were told the pests entered via the terrace which had neither screens nor an outside handle on the door, so, we didn't use the terrace.  So, nice people, pretty pool, fair food and mosquitoes.

reviews.author: Fiyaz
reviews.title: Good,  not great..
reviews.text:
Based on the reviews we expected a lot more.  

The good.. 
1. The kids zone in fantastic.  All of the staff are amazing and do a great job bonding with the kids. 
2. Santos at the pool for the Reserve is great.  He was very attentive and checked in regularly. 

The bad.. 
1. The rooms look dated.  The room we were in (1385) had dings in the wall,  scuffed up furniture,  and generally looked shabby. 
2. Most requests take forever to fulfill and often require you to ask more than once 
3. The cost that we were quoted for a bottle of Children's Tylenol was $35 USD by the front desk via a local pharmacy (they have a service that will deliver to the hotel front desk).  The same bottle was $5 USD from the hotel gift shop.  That quote was borderline robbery.  

The terrible..
1. We were inexplicably and without warning taken to the room where you have to listen to a sales pitch on the hotels sales program.  We were told that we were receiving information about excursions,  but then all of a sudden ended up in the sales office for a 30 minute presentation.  We left after 30 seconds. 

Overall,  a good but not great resort.  There are definitely better options in Punta Cana and the surrounding area.

reviews.author: Bernie V
reviews.title: Not a good value for the money
reviews.text:
We are world travelers and had never been to Punta Cana.  The resort was gorgeous, but service and food were mediocre.  In addition, the housekeeping staff was unpredictable and extremely loud.
The YHI spa was amazing, and I got the best massage ever (bamboo) from Rizalyn.  Would I return? No, Mexico is better!!

reviews.author: Bucketlistin
reviews.title: Ladies beware of the men staff
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real bavaro 
Shame on the staff the activities and entertainment staff of men very unprofessional they are trying to romance ladies outside the resort after they complete work. Ask to get your number, take you dancing, romance you then ask you for money, to buy them things. It's the same script "meet me outside the gates, I'll show you the town.", dancing, fun, then tell you I love you and ask for money. You think they would have better training and management watching these men. In 30min at the outside bar I had 4 of them hand me their phone number and ask for a date when they got off. 
They are busy  working more than the job your paying them to do.

reviews.author: Katie R
reviews.title: Fun trip but listen to the other reviews
reviews.text:
We had a nice trip over New Year 2015 at the Paradisis.  The weather was perfect and the resort was nice.   The food was fine for us and we found something to eat every meal.  We mainly at the buffet.  

Good- the pools and resort were clean and beautiful.  The activity staff was fun.  Big Mac was friendly and great with my kids.  The man who taught water aerobics and Zumba was excellent.  Fun and friendly (I forgot his name). The evening shows were enjoyable.  Jose at the dessert buffet daily was so nice and helpful to my kids.  Angelo de Aza, mini bar, was helpful and kind.  He even spent some time to teach me Spanish.  The kids club was nice and my boys enjoyed doing the daily crafts.   We enjoyed the quiet time at the Reserve!   Beautiful resort and we may stay there next time.  

Issues- The resturant reservations is an issue!   It was annoying to have to struggle for reservations at restaurants.  Our travel agent made them before we departed, I "made" them the first day and my mother in law had to "make" the reservations a third time.  Each of the visit to the resturant, they didn't have our reservations.  This issue was a tad annoying to experience for the money we paid to stay at the resort We did eat to eat each night but the experience was wearing.   We has wonderful pool chairs and a cabana daily but my husband had to wake up at 6 am every day to ensure we had pool seats.  Large groups hoarded seats and this is an issue.  We did not like the "vacation sales" pitch for the vacation club.  The resort prides itself on the vacation guests.  They seem to have less amenities for the paying guests who are not vacation club.  

Nice trip and we had a great time,

reviews.author: Marianna S
reviews.title: One and Done
reviews.text:
This was our first time in Punta Cana.  Unfortunately, this was not a good experience. The beach (which is very important when we travel) was very dirty.  The seaweed was everywhere and swimming was extremely unpleasant.  My 2yo son had hives all over his legs due to whatever was in that seaweed/ocean.  I wouldn't recommend going into that water with small children at all!!!  
The restaurants were exceptionally hard to get into.  Even though we traveled with a large group of friends (13 adults and kids) and stayed for 10 days, we were able to get only once to ONE restaurant.  On numerous occasions, we tried to make reservations ahead of time and even attempted to use the concierge service, it was still useless.  The staff was really uncooperative and spoke very little English.
But the worst part of our stay was the construction. On the second day of our stay, the buffet location closed and did not open for a week.  It was particularly inconvenient to use their alternate location, which was set up in Apollo theater.  The theater obviously is not equipped for this type of service, hence the food selection was minimal (to say the least). On top of that, the entire resort side where the construction was happening, reeked of paint.   What’s more, when we arrived, there was already construction of a new wing of the resort.  So there was constant noise if you were near that area.  What upset me the most was the dishonesty of the resort staff about this construction.  We booked this resort though a travel agent who called them ahead of time and was ASSURED that there is currently no construction on the premises and will not be any construction in the near future.  So you can imagine our surprise… 
To sum it up, we will not be coming back to this resort EVER again.

reviews.author: Jan B
reviews.title: Not exactly what we were hoping for...
reviews.text:
The beach at Punta Cana is amazing and the sand is the best I have ever walked on. We had a prevailing wind for most of our stay which actually made it easier to stay in the sun so do not be put off if the forecast says windy. The hotel is beautiful BUT it runs on a caste system. If you are a regular guest there are large parts of the resort you cannot access at all, for example the adult only pool and the double sun loungers on the beach. You can upgrade to Royal Service to access these parts and buy a membership for access to Club Melia, their version of a TimeShare. I did not appreciate the pressure to receive a sales pitch for this vacation club. We were only there for a week and did not want to waste a morning to learn that we could buy a membership for $85,000!!! (Yes $85,000 plus a monthly resort fee). 
We were told before we arrived that we would have the choice of 7 restaurants and that one would have an uncharge of $50 per person. On arrival this became $75 per person and getting reservations at the others was a pain. On a good note it didn't seem to matter what time the reservation was for, you could just show up and get seated long as your name was on the list. Vento, Rare and Blue Agave were all good, although desserts seem to be a challenge for all of them. Bana and Agua were both extremely disappointing.
