The water never was turbid, and filled with seaweed and plastic debris of all sorts as it is now. The water quality has dramatically gone down hill over the past ten years and it has been in direct proportion to the number of hotel rooms and increase number of visitors to Punta Cana. I have travelled all over the Island from Puerto Plata, to Boca de Yuma, Samana Penisula and more as well as local beaches like Macao and I can report that the water in the ocean there is alot less dirty and there is no detecatable odor like the water at the resorts in Punta Cana. For the first time in all of my travels I was guenuinely concerned about the ocean water quality. It was just plain filthy! The resort was undergoing quite a few renovations as well. That is expected after ten years however Melia has expanded the resort by adding an entirely new Resort called the Reserva and in my opinion this huge mega resort has ruined the Palma Real. The Reserva guests can use all of the facilities at the Palma Real not visa versa.....it is just one more symptom of how the D.R. in general has changed. If you are looking for an intimate charm it no longer exists. For most people just trying to escape the cold you will find the weather and resorts in the D. R. sutible, however, we knew it when, the old chef was there, the steak house was open, food quality was higher, the beaches were less crowded and less noisy and the water was clean. You can still find a place to get out of the cold and into the sun with warm tropical breeze , the staff is friendly, however Paradisus Palma Real has changed. We are in search of cleaner waters and beaches with a charm that the D.R. had when we first started visiting more than ten years ago. Millions of visitors to a small destination like Punta Cana has both positive and negative affects but when the water quality goes down hill like it has its time for me to find a better place to spend my vacation dollars.

reviews.author: JayneRehm
reviews.title: Grande desapontamento
reviews.text:
Por meses estava planejando uma viagem a Republica Dominicana, uma duvida enorme aonde se hospedar, e, por fim , escolhi o Paradisus Palma Real incluindo  Servico Royal.
Havia lido coisas maravilhosas aqui mas a realidade e bem diferente, especialmente se vc trabalha DURO para se dar ao luxo de umas ferias tao exorbitantemente caras para o padrão do serviço oferecido.
Nao posso falar da viagem pois o voo foi muito bom , assim como o translado para o hotel.
O desapontamento comecou na chegada.
Primeiro  nos deixaram esperando na entrada , e , so depois de verem na reserva "Servico Royal" recebemos atenção.
O check in privativo foi meio demorado mas tudo bem.
Atencao, somente la(sala VIP do SERVICO ROYAL) vc encontra bebidas e destilados de primeira linha, ou seja, vc tem que dar uma passada por la se aprecia algo mais sofisticado.
O quarto ,  DESAPONTAMENTO TOTAL !!  Quarto antigo, fios da televisão assim como dos outros aparelhos pendurados na parede (não e exagero não), moveis arranhados em péssimo estado de conservação, cabine da ducha muito antiga com agua escorrendo para fora na hora do banho,  banheira muito usada, entre outras coisas , baratinhas que eu aprisionei para mostrar a gerencia.
Reclamei , dizendo que o hotel não era o que eu tinha imaginado e a gerencia me ofereceu um outro quarto , ou seja, um upgrade para outra suite com visão parcial mar, acho.
 Ai sim deu  inicio do nosso STRESS .
Como não gosto de ficar presa a favores , retruquei que eu queria apenas o que eu havia pago.
 Eles insistiram, disseram que era a forma do hotel se desculpar pelo inconveniente causado. Essa conversa havia sido pela manha do dia seguinte a nossa chegada. O novo quarto seria entregue a tarde e nos seriamos avisados. 
As 6 da tarde ainda não tínhamos noticias e resolvi passar no Royal Service. La a atendente me disse que não havia quarto e que não poderiam ter dado um upgrade.Foi entao que a discussão começou , eu disse que queria outro quarto , UM QUARTO BOM do jeito que estava especificado quando comprei a viagem e que não queria upgrade.
Recebi outro quarto em estado muito melhor , mas muito melhor mesmo , mas so depois das 20 hs.
Esse foi nosso inicio de ferias!!!!

Pontos positivos:

Localizacao
Praia com area exclusiva para Royal Service  (so servem bebidas)
Cafe da manha no restaurante exclusivo
Garcons

Pontos negativos

Servico da piscina do Royal Service
Variedade de bebidas
Cheiro de esgoto exalando das fossas pelo hotel
Buffets tem apresentação caprichada mas tudo muito convencional e medíocre
Restaurantes a la carte tbm nada de mais
Passion , degustacao nao convenceu

Na minha opniao nao vale a pena.
E meio enganacao para os novatos.
Espero que tenha ajudado
Ps para as mulheres:   no spa eles fazem uma unha péssima

reviews.author: jkwd71
reviews.title: Mixed Review
reviews.text:
We recently returned (a day early) from Paradisus and honestly have mixed reviews.  The property is quite beautiful and very large.  We stayed in the Royal Service area and I don't feel it provided a different service than any other hotel concierge service would provide.  The rooms themselves were spacious and clean, albeit a bit dated. They like to push 2 doubles together to make a huge king, but one person only has half a sheet and the pillows fall between the headboards.   Our room was "ocean view" and you could see a small slice of it, but we were also over a service area which was quite noisy. To us, beach was not relaxing. Tour helicopters are constantly flying over, catamarans jamming loud music, kids playing at the resort area next door.  There is no food service on the beach, although there is a bar. It's very crowded and we were bothered by all of the cigarette smoke.  On a positive note, the beach staff are extremely nice and attentive.  
If you are looking for gourmet food, this is not the place.  Most of the food was tasteless (a consensus with our group) and I was lucky enough to watch some kids pick up food and return it to the buffet. 
That being said, if you are looking for a place to go with a group or children, this may be your place. They have a huge pool with a bar, activities for kids, a nice disco and a casino.  I just would not call it a very relaxing resort. Beautiful, friendly, lively, but not relaxing in the sense of finding peace and quiet.  I know this review is all over the place, but liking or not liking the resort really depends on what your looking for in your vacation. This was our first experience with an all inclusive and we just didn't enjoy it.

reviews.author: Luis Miguel I
reviews.title: DECEPCION
reviews.text: Es la segunda vez que vamos con mi mujer a este hotel y la verdad esta vez tuvimos una gran decepción. Volvimos con nuestro hijo (ya mayor de edad) al Royal Service y las habitaciones puro ruido y mal mantenida (sábanas viejas, no funcionaba la cafetera -dos veces- y tampoco el wifi y el servicio de limpieza muy malo; un pedazo de jabón estuvo en la rejilla del baño durante los 14 días). El servicio de playa un caos; todas las palapas estan teóricamente ocupadas y pasa el día nadie las utiliza; si uno da buena propina hacen una excepción y la liberan por ese día; es la mafia de la playa. También hay descontrol en la playa (borrachos, sexo en la palapa vecina, etc) y nadie hace nada; los empleados se ríen y llevan mas tragos.. También hay menores con visitas y nadie controla. Quejarse no vale de nada y lo pretenden arreglar con un plato de frutas. Luego de las quejas de mi mujer, donde se preocupan de la pulsera y no de lo que uno denuncia, fui especialmente y pedi por la gerente y nunca me atendio y su emisario un inepto total. Siempre dicen lo mismo: lo vamos a reportar. Me tuve que mudar en la playa para evitar estas escenas. Rescato la comida en general y los camareros, especialmente del restaurante Palazzo; su cheff también excelente y super ambale y preocupado de que todo funcione bien.  Lo mimso en los bares, muy buena atención. Esto ha compensado nuestro estadía que en estas condiciones es imposible repetir o recomendar.

reviews.author: B B
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: We were not happy with our stay. We had to ask for everything. Snacks for kids (which all they had were crackers), water, anything by pool. No one approached us to ask if we needed anything by pool. The food was mediocre. The location and beach was amazing. Kids pool and kids club was awesome. The pool deck was slippery and my kids fell at least 3-4 times. Someone even slipped and broke their hip and had to get medi vac back home. We didn't drink much but when I asked for juice for my kids it wasn't fresh and was high sugary mixers. I had to go and ask for fresh squeezed juice which they had. Wifi was poor and had no access in my room. Wouldn't return and very disappointed. Staff is friendly and grounds were beautiful.

reviews.author: MollyY588
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Service Not Good
reviews.text: This hotel is absolutely stunning. The beaches are beautiful, the hotel is clean, and the rooms were fabulous. The service was not good and many workers were rude and dismissive. The only way service is good is if you upgrade to the Royal Service which I highly recommend but is quite a bit more expensive. If you are going on vacation to have fun and do activities and have great fruity drinks, this is not the location for you. This hotel is more leisurely and relaxing with very few activities during the day except for volleyball and zumba dancing for an hour in the afternoon. My boyfriend and I love our fruity mixed drinks and they were horrible at this resort. I think it is because they don't use real fruit juice so it tastes like pure sugar. Also, the restaurant food is HORRIBLE. Bana sushi and hibatchi is ok and entertaining and Vento is good. Do not go to Market...the steak is HORRIBLE and very tough. If you are looking for a relaxing hote, you should go here but make sure you upgrade to ROYAL SERVICE or the service will be HORRIBLE!!!

reviews.author: Mommysince2011
reviews.title: We had a good time, but...
reviews.text:
We just returned from 4 nights 5 days stay at Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We had a family concierge one bedroom suite, and we were with our 2 year old who slept in a crib. 

Our overall experience was positive: the family concierge service was pretty good in reserving cabana at the pool/beach, or making restaurant reservations. She surprised us with gifts of bottles of champagne, etc. Kids Zone was a great space...very large beautiful outdoor play area, and a good variety of activity centers (BUT see my comments below). The circus show we saw was great. People overall were friendly and service speed was above average.

But there were some negatives that cannot be ignored.

First, the one-bedroom room seemed crowded with furniture and felt quite restricted, especially with a crib. Also, cleaning service wasn't great. The furniture had stains, table wasn't wiped clean...overall, the room felt somewhat yucky.

Second, we were a bit disappointed that we couldn't get a dinner reservation on the first night when we arrived around 3:30pm. Had we known, we would have called the hotel in advance to arrange one. We were also disappointed that the only breakfast/lunch options had to be at the two buffet restaurants. Buffet food was, well, buffet food. We were especially surprised at the low quality of fruits. Room service was better but we had to wait 45 mins or more and the selection was limited. As for the restaurants, we tried "The Grille" (Steak House), "Fuego" (Latin Fusion) and "Bana" (Japanese). Fuego was fantastic. The Grille was pretty good. But Bana was so bad that we couldn't really eat anything more than a bite other than soup and dessert. The chef totally overcooked our food and seasoning was awful. I am Japanese, so take my word for it. Whatever you do, don't eat at Bana.

Third, the reserve section is far from the beach and we needed to take a "train" (= shuttle) every time we wanted to go to the beach. Some of the nightly entertainment was on the beach, so we sometimes had to "commute" twice during a day. Train was supposed to come every 5 mins, but in reality, we often found ourselves waiting around wasting time. Our son who is crazy about trains enjoyed the ride, though.

Lastly, we happened to witness a potentially very scary situation of the daycare service losing a 3-4 year old girl. Fortunately, I recognized her by the pool as she was playing with my son earlier that day and my son and I brought her back to the daycare (he literally held her hand and led her)...but not after we followed her for a good 10 minutes as she wondered around by herself. At first, the staff insisted that her parents had checked her out, which turned out to be untrue as the unsuspecting parents soon walked in. Needless to say, the parents were quite upset. The incident happened toward the end of the day when the center seemed understaffed. It is nice that they offer a daycare service but we'd just use it for a nap time and when the center has enough personnel.

reviews.author: Cecile F
reviews.title: Ce n'est plus ce que c'était !
reviews.text:
De retour dans cet hôtel après 5 ans, nous avons trouvé beaucoup de changement mais malheureusement pas en bien!

Les points négatifs:
Le buffet du gaby beach;le service de navette à travers le complexe ( petit train quasiment inexistant); eau bouillante à la douche les 5 premiers jours avec impossibilité de se laver; chambres vieillissantes très humides et sentant le moisi;aucun service pour les boissons à la piscine.
Mais surtout la nullité du service réservation et l'organisation à la réception ( pas de trace d une de nos réservation puis demande de paiement de frais de non présentation alors que nous étions bien là ) Entêtement de la direction à vouloir nous faire payer des frais occasionnés par la mauvaise gestion des réservations entre l'hôtel et notre agence malgré un geste commercial.

Les points positifs:
Les matelas de plage;le wifi dans tout le complexe;le restaurant japonais et le grill;le service de boissons à la plage;l'accueil au restaurant du gabi club en particulier par Bianca.
La plage et les jardins sont toujours aussi beaux.

reviews.author: anton s
reviews.title: Fluch der Karibik
reviews.text:
Fluch der Karibik!!

Wir suchten ein Hotel mit Benützung Golfplatz ohne Kinder für unsren 3 wöchig geplant Urlaub über die Weihnachtsfeiertage 2013.Da uns bewusst war ,dass zu dieser Zeit besonders viele Familien mit Kindern unterwegs sein werden überlegten wir lange welche Hotels  überhaupt von Tui angeboten werden. Das Hotel Paradisus Pal Real stieß uns sofort ins Auge. ROYLA SERVICE über 18 Jahre Golf inklusive( Greenfee fei) !!Beste Lage 5Stern, zwar der Aufpreis auf Rojal Service teuer, aber es schien uns dies wert. Das klang gut und wurde im Katalog so verkauft.
1) Es dauerte nicht lange entdeckten wir im sogenannten Rojal Service Trakt in jedem zweiten Zimmer Kinder.

2) Ebenso im Poolbereich , der eigentlich nur für Rojal Gäste vorbehalten sein sollte.

3) nur 1 RESTAURANT (Palazzo) welchen wirklich und tatsächlich ohne Kinder war wurde angeboten. In alle anderen Restaurants waren Kinder erlaubt. Für  drei Wochen lediglich ein LOKAL in dem die Speisekarte begrenz war!!!!

Also meldete ich diese Dinge in der Reception dokumentiert mit Fotos. Dort meinte man die Kinder im Pool wären im Hauptpool das dürfe sein. Aber die Dame ( A. Mercedes) war ganz erstaunt darüber, das könne nicht sein und dürfe nicht sein. Ja sie beauftragte mich ich solle auf jeden Fall die Zimmernummern derer bekannt geben in dem sich Kinder befinden sollten.
Mit dieser Information schickte man mich weg. Wir machten uns die Mühe und notierten diese Zimmernummer, meldeten dies unserer Dame von Tui. 

Nach 12 Tagen gab man zu das Hotel sei überbucht und man hätte die Zimmer anderen Gästen übergeben aber sie haben eh kein Rojal Service ????hmmm 
Es wurde uns ein anderes Zimmer angeboten indem Trakt seien keine Kinder untergebracht!!
Indirekt gab man den Fehler zu, und komischer Weise stand auch beim Pool eine Aufsichtsperson, die alles Personen welche keine Rojal Service hatten und Kinder weg schickten.
Nächste Überraschung war beim Golf inklusive Greenfee.

1) es wurde nirgends darauf hingewiesen, dass zwingen ein Golfcar welches 65 Dollar pro Person kostet vorgeschrieben ist !!!!!...wir hatten uns vorgenommen jeden zweiten Tag zu spielen !!!( darum inclusive)

2) noch dazu ist der Golfplatz umringt von wirklich wunderschön anzuschauenden Villen, welche von der Kindern Hunden als Spielplatz genutzt wurde.( besonders gefährlich ) das nicht nur einmal sondern jedes mal wenn wir spielten !!!!

Abschließend möchte ich aber noch erwähnen, das Personal speziell in den Restaurants ( Palazzo)besonders bemüht waren und das Essen uns sehr gut geschmeckt hat.

Die Anlage ist optisch sehr gut angelegt und sehr ansprechend. 
Zum weiterempfehlen ist das Royal Service und Golf inklusive nicht. Die unsres Erachtens überhöhte Aufzahlung steht in keiner Relation zum tatsächlich gebrachten Leistung.

reviews.author: Noe F
reviews.title: NO ES UN 5 ESTRELLAS GRAN LUJO.
reviews.text:
Estuvimos una semana a principios de enero. La temperatura era muy agradable, incluso llegamos a los 30 grados pero hacía un viento algo molesto(ellos le llaman brisa de invierno).
En referencia al hotel quiero destacar varios aspectos que os ayudará a entender que no se trata de un verdadero resort de lujo:
1. Ofrecen wifi gratuita en todo el resort cuando en realidad solo funciona en el hall. No es posible conectarse  ni en piscina ni en las habitaciones ni en los restaurantes.
2. Llegamos a la 11 de la noche y aunque el check in fue rápido nos asignan una habitación en la que no se podía respirar del olor a humedad. Exigimos cambio de habitación que nos concedieron.
3. Nos trasladan a la habitación 1038 que continuaba oliendo a humedad y que tenía múltiples desperfectos; la puerta corredera del balcón  estaba rota(cualquiera podía acceder al interior de nuestra cámara ya que estaba en la planta baja),la pintura dejaba mucho que desear, constante humedad en las toallas y sábanas......
4. La televisión de nuestra habitación tardaba aprox. 10 minutos en encenderse, había que probar una y otra vez hasta que se encendía; en este sentido tuvimos que llamar dos días al técnico de mantenimiento
5. Cuando llegas te asignan un empleado para que te ayude a realizar las reservas en los diferentes restaurantes y para canalizar las posibles quejas. El primer día le pedimos que ambientaran nuestra habitación a diario para evitar el mal olor. Lo hicieron el primer día y punto.
6. Se trata de un hotel de la cadena MELIA con lo que intentaron vendernos su famosa MEMBRESÍA durante 2 horas. Al final les dimos a entender que estábamos de vacaciones y que nos dejaran en paz.
7. Olvidaron colocar las toallas del baño dos días.

Las instalaciones son correctas y al llegar  quedamos asombrados del imponente y bonito hall que para nada refleja la realidad del resort.

Piscina y zona de playa muy decente, así como las hamacas.

Una mención especial para el RESTAURANTE PASSION donde cenamos especialmente bien y para el YHI SPA situado en THE RESERVE con unas instalaciones realmente bonitas y cómodas.

Sin ningún tipo de duda no se trata de un resort de lujo y mucho menos de un hotel de 5 estrellas gran lujo.
Cualquiera que haya frecuentado los hoteles de lujo asiático e incluso los europeos entenderá mi crítica. 
En general, es el mejor resort de Punta Cana y también el mas caro pero, desde mi punto de vista, deja mucho que desear.

reviews.author: VadimGan
reviews.title: Little Overpriced and No Information
reviews.text:
Resort is beautiful - very nice and very well made. However,lack of information of all services - main issue.Map of the resort is poorly made.
Also, We had black bracelets and other members of our weeding party had green bracelets - noone from the staff facility can explain what is the difference, they only said that black bracelets are VIP -  therefore we unable to fully enjoy the VIP services and spa facilities (they were free for VIP). The SPA experience was outstanding!!!!

reviews.author: Sal** M
reviews.title: Chirstmas/New Years
reviews.text: Check in Experience was horrendous.  No one spoke English and 5 people stared at the computer screen for 15 minutes without saying anything.  This was in the so called VIP lounge.  No one gave us (my husband and me and 3 tweens and an 11 year old girl) our luggage tickets (who knew we needed it) so we had to go into the luggage room to identify our luggage.  Once in the room, the "sofa bed" was disgusting and totally unacceptable."  Although I was expecting two beds for my two girls and two beds for my boys who are 6'2" in another room, we got creaky, saggy sofa beds.  They brought in roll aways that were a notch above a cot with only flat sheets (no fitted.)  Asked for extra blankets which they clearly got from a local military base--wed did not use them.  We had a suite with two bedrooms, two baths and a common room in the middle.  Another room on a different floor for boys!! They put us next to a french couple with screaming babies.  Ugh!  Furniture is cheap and sofa was sagggy.  Shower pressure was awful.  Finally got to the Mole restaurant--best person there is Mateo who made all the check-in nonsense go away. It is the mexican restaurant on the property.  Food was excellent and Mateo was funny, relaxed and welcoming.  5Be aware that 5 of the seven restaurants require long pants and closed shoes for men.  Nice khaki shorts with a belt, collared shirt and clean sandals doesnt cut it.  Therefore we had to cancel three of our reservations for restuarants.  You absolutely MUST reserve dining and spa a couple of weeks before you get there.  My travel agent didnt tell us about the pants requirement and I did not read the website carefully enough--so I had to suffer through trying to get reservations at the nice shorts are ok restaurants.  Stephanie, one of the few concierges that speaks decent Englich was surly and dismissive, but when I pressed a little harder she came through with a grimace with reservations.  It requitred me sitting there listening to her dial to a busy signal at least 14 times then she finally went down to the "reservation office" to make it happen.The resort really wants people to eat the buiffet every night because none of the restaurants were full. Bana Rest-good. Evening shows-Fun. Drinks at bars-AWFUL(watered down). Pool and beach clean. Spa-service good/place gorgeous but no staff.  Horrible SEWAGE smell every time I walked to Spa.  Bad!!  They need something for teens/tweens at night.

reviews.author: DubaiHiggins
reviews.title: Is Punta Cana a luxury destination??? Really ???
reviews.text:
I have to say I have a very uncertain opinion of our stay at the Reserve. But I don't know if it's the average quality of the overall stay or a mistake we made choosing Punta Cana, as a short holiday destination...Compare with immediate neighboring The Reserve at Paradisus was not so bad... But regarding what I read on the Melia website and what we experienced... may I say there is gap.. a huge gap in ability to deliver 5star service.. of course not bad not good... nothing.... Concierge service could be very good or absolutely rude, the guest manager is the only one really naturally kind and professional.... At Pool or beach there is almost no service/nobody to ake care of you ... Restaurants are not bad experiences but are not memorable ones... so I'm confused on my stay... good or bad... absolutely not in my memory!! and that s the problem we finally faced... service inconsistency... no warmth of welcoming...some staff are so nice so kind... and others really don't care about guest...
The worst experience anytime, any staff, any contact :the reception... the worst attitude of the hotel really administrative people without any empathy!!
My recommendation think twice before heading to Punta Cana....

reviews.author: Colin
reviews.title: Solid, but...
reviews.text:
I really wanted to LOVE this place... And for the price, I should have. It is good, but not great. I upgraded to the Royal Service package. Let me start by saying, you MUST do this option if you don't have kids (it is adults only)... The butler service is very helpful and the extra restaurant option comes in handy (more on that later)...
Here is what is really good:
- Sandy Gil, our butler, was the BEST. Five stars for Sandy. You must request him. He doesn't miss a beat to go out of his way to make your stay memorable. Whether arranging for a cab or activity or dinner reservation, he has it covered.  This guy taught himself almost flawless English at the age of 24 (and also built his family house with his own hands)... Very impressive.
- the property is gorgeous. The bali beds are HEAVEN and the attendants at the beach are phenomenal. The views are surreal. Leo is an excellent bartender always with a smile and great attitude.
- spa was good

The Bad:
- the food is really not good (passion not included here as you pay extra for that....ate there twice and it is phenomenal)... And thankfully the Palazzo was decent enough (and only included with royal service) and makes it tolerable. Some of the other "restaurants" are really not good. For the price, it actually is pretty bad. Cafeteria style.
- management is pretty unorganized. We extended our vacation, they quoted us a rate and then after we change our flights they come back with a higher price saying they made a mistake quoting blah blah (that is MY fault?!?!) and split the difference with me.
- the room had some small ants/bugs in them. Housekeeping would get rid of them daily, but still
- rooms are fairly noisy - you can here the slightest thing above or
Beside you.
- room service is not prompt and the language barrier with some of the staff is pretty annoying

Again, keep in mind, if this place wasn't as expensive as it is, I wouldn't mind as much, but they price it like a 5 star resort and deliver 3 star results on some of the most important pieces.

The casino and night time vibe is actually pretty fun.  

Because of the above, not sure I would come back. It was a great vacation overall, relaxing thanks to the Royal Service private areas. Hope this helps.

reviews.author: barnguy
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but horrible dinner reservation process
reviews.text: A beautiful property, on one of the largest, cleanest beaches in the Caribbean. Even over the Christmas holiday, you never felt crowded on the beach. Rooms were not ready at 2pm because they screwed up the requirement for two beds on one of the rooms, which took an hour to resolve. All inclusive is taken literally here, as food is constantly available as is pretty much any alcoholic beverage you want. The biggest negative, and its a big one, is that you cannot make dinner reservations easily and the staff (the VIP concierges) are horrible at it. Every night they suggested the sushi option when we were told everything was full!! I was told by the manager that I could not book dinner before arriving, but when I arrived we were told all a la carte restaurants were booked for the week!! Obviously someone was able to book in advance. Eventually we got in to most of where we wanted, at 9pm each night, but it took a lot of work, and we had to spend quite a bit of time each day with the staff to get anywhere. The worst night was Christmas Eve, when they booked us for dinner in a restaurant that was closed for the evening. Thankfully the buffet was open and we could do that. But how would anyone book us in a restaurant closed for the evening?

reviews.author: loveNY2002
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, but....
reviews.text:
I must say this is the most beautiful hotel we have visited in Dominican Republic ( we have been before at Puerto Plata as well as Punta Cana) . Hands down to that, rooms are very clean and everyone is nice, willing to serve, with a big smile.  But the reservation system for the restaurants is unacceptable for the kind of money all of us are paying to visit this hotel. There is nothing wrong with having dinner at the buffet IF I feel like it, but if someone wants to have dinner every single night at a la carte restaurant, that should be granted, without giving hard time to the customer, saying the restaurants are full, when in reality there are plenty of empty tables when you pass by.  The management must do something about it, this approach is VERY CHEAP, and I am sure everyone feels frustration when they tell to come back tomorrow or the day after to the front desk to see if there is a cancellation for a restaurant.  RIDICULOUS!!!!!
The " assigned concierge" is a lovely person until you let him know you do not want to waste your time attending the famous presentation, to sell you their time share program.  They bother you constantly with the topic, from the minute you set foot on the hotel. Our concierge, Franklin De La Cruz did not do anything for us, after we rejected his " invitation for an special breakfast". He even told us when we got to the hotel that the reservations for restaurants were hard to make because people were showing at the hotel with already make reservations, from home.  Big lie, as far as I know their website does not provide that kind of service.  Overall we had a good time because i did not let him , or the management, or their ridiculous system to spoil my vacation after paying $ 5000. We simply showed at the restaurants and manage to have dinner every night, but for what they are charging that is unacceptable.  We are not drinkers, therefore i can not say anything about alcohol.  I can say the red wine is ver cheap. 
The weather was not the best, I would not go back in December again.  
Actually I do not think I would be back at this hotel or any other hotel with obnoxious concierges, trying to sell something that the majority of us know it is not worthy.

reviews.author: Bobby J
reviews.title: Quick 1 night trip
reviews.text:
I give this a 3 out of 5 based on the cost per person vs. what you're getting for the money. We took a quick 2 day 1 night trip out of Miami to take a look for wedding planning purposes. The hotel was pretty empty. We received differing answers on the occupancy. The front desk said 'about half' but another staff member later in the day gave us a more definitive 28% full. Having the place somewhat empty was both good and bad. The good is that we were able to do whatever we wanted and eat wherever we wanted without a line. The bad was that the bars and the in-house 'club' were pretty dead minus us and 2 other couples. 

The food was about as expected. It was good but as with most all-inclusive places, they have to make their money somewhere and not over doing the food quality is a good place to look for profits. At least 1 restaurant had a pants required dress code (i.e. no shorts). I didn't have any and it was empty so it was a little annoying that in spite of the lack of crowds they were such sticklers about the pants rule but rules are rules. For beer, you're pretty much stuck with Presidente. It's a generic Pilsner. 

The beach is fantastic. The water was clear. 20 meters out you could see where the seaweed started. The pool was likewise nice. There is a swim-up bar connected to the walk up so either way, you're talking with the same bartender while you're in the pool area. He was very quick and willing to modify his regular mix if he had whatever you were looking for on-hand. There was a bit of maintenance going on so the hotel had a guy in a snorkel mask swimming around caulking tiles that had come off the hole day. I suppose doing this kind of work at 28% occupancy is as good a time as any. 

The hotel grounds felt very safe; however, the front desk advised us not to attempt to walk anywhere off-site (there's a club down the street) after it got dark and to take a cab instead. The rooms were nice. There was a small fridge that's stocked with drinks when you arrive. We didn't spend much time in the room other than to change between eating and swimming and I couldn't see why anyone would with such a nice beach.

reviews.author: Harry M
reviews.title: Nice Hotel, horrible Concierge service!!!!!
reviews.text: Trip was planned 5 months in Advance.  When we arrived, they told us that our 2 Bdr suite was not available.  They wanted to split our family up into 2 rooms and 2 diff buildings--- that was'nt going to happen.  Next problem was that they were adamant about us bringing our passports and credit cards to a 90 minute meeting, which ended up being a sales pitch to buy a time share.  How do you buy a time share at a place that did'nt even have your correct room available at check in.  Wagner, our concierge, promised us the world prior to that meeting, as soon as we declined on the time share, we never saw him again and did'nt help us one bit.  Reservations are a nightmare--Food was really good, but service sucked!!

reviews.author: ninac4116
reviews.title: Did Not Receive Luxury
reviews.text:
We have stayed at two Secrets Resorts in Mexico (Vallarta Bay and the Vine Cancun) and had impeccable time.  We decided to try something new because of the great reviews on TripAdvisor.  Perhaps we were spoiled by Secrets, but The Reserve at Paradisus just doesn't compare.  

Our number one problem was lack of communication.  While I'm not completely fluent in Spanish, I do speak conversational Spanish, but even with that, I had trouble.  I'm not expecting to go to a Spanish speaking country and have everyone there speak in English.  But what I would like is for the staff to at least clarify or to follow up to make sure everything is okay.  If learned within a few hours that if I asked for anything outside of what the menu stated, something in the order would go wrong.  I'm not talking about something out of the ordinary, but if I wanted dressing on the side of my salad instead of on top, it just wouldn't happen.  Another example, we ordered room service one night and asked for a cheese burger.  I stated it 3 times in 3 different way (cheese burger, burger with cheese, and hamburgesa con queso).  They just said "okay" and then they asked if I wanted chips.  I said no I wanted fries like the menu said.  Rather than clarifying the order at the end or repeating it back to me they just said okay.  And of course I just got a regular hamburger.  When they came to the door I asked "no cheese" they said I should have asked for "chips".  So chips = cheese?  These are things which show a lack of training.  Also, many of the service staff were less than helpful or very slow.  I ordered the bbq chicken sandwich that came with caramelized onions on a soft cheese by the pool snack bar.  After about a good 20 minutes I got a plain chicken sandwich, which I had to ask for the bbq sauce, caramelized onions, cheese.  Another couple next to me only ordered fries which also took 20 minutes (and this was not being delivered, we were just waiting there).

The Room:  B
Pros:  Beautifully designed, nice and spacious.  
Cons:  the lightswitches.  There were hundreds of them all over the place.  Some worked, some didn't, some only dimmed.  Paper thin walls.  I was woken up every day by either kids screaming, trolley outside, other guests walking in the room above me, or housecleaning moving furniture/cleaning.

Food:  D
The only option for lunch was a buffet.  The food was standard buffet food.  Not a lot changed on a daily basis.  There was a pasta station, a grill station for burgers, and some hot plate items, then your standard cold plate items with different types of fruits/salads.  The dessert was different gelatin-like desserts, typical of what you may see on Carnival cruise line.  Dinner was not much better.  First off, you have to make reservations.  There were some restaurants that they didn't even have availability to despite trying to book 5 days in advance.  Also, if you want to do appetizers at one restaurant and have your main course at another you can't make more than 1 reservation per night.  On the first night, since our flight arrived after 5, we couldnt make dinner reservations, so we were stuck eating at the buffet.  The second night we had reservations to Fuego, which was okay at best.  The third night we ate at Grill.  I didn't want their appetizer because it was just the same salad buffet they have usually for lunch.  So instead I wanted to order two entrees (mind you the portions are small) and the waiter gave me a hard time about that.  Fourth night we ate at Vento, and again food was okay at best.  Although the Tiramisu dessert there was phenomenal.  Our last night we had reservations at Bento.  The food there was inedible.  It turns out they had a hibachi dinner, but you had to make reservations (isn't that what we did?  We needed another reservation for our reservation?  Why didn't anyone tell us?)  Breakfast buffet was also nothing to write home about.  

Drinks:  D
I don't think they ever put much alcohol in any drinks I ordered, despite asking for it to be strong each time.  Anything "top shelf" cost money.  Brands like Heradura Tequila were considered top shelf.  Otherwise it was some random house brand.  The only beer they have is Presidente.

Service: D
Most of the staff was friendly, but not really helpful.  At the pool bar, they never came around to take our orders or serve us, they would just hang out at the bar and make the customers come up to the bar to get what they wanted.

Trolley:  C
Completely inconsistent.  Sometimes only 5 minutes, other times 25 minutes.  Normally, I love taking walks, especially when the walk is scenic.  But when its hot or raining and there are mosquitos swarming the place, having reliable transportation makes a difference.  I don't know how the rooms at just the Paradisus Punta Cana are, but due to the close proximity to the beach and several other larger dining options, they may be worth it.

On a final note, the property is beautiful and well maintained.  The landscaping was gorgeous.  However, I would still not return to the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  I had much higher expectations based on the reviews on trip advisor in addition to their own advertising.  I never felt like I was living in luxury.

reviews.author: RickR
reviews.title: Upsells downgrade my rating
reviews.text:
There is lots of good to talk about at Paradisus Palma Real. It is an absolutely stunning property-noteworthy are the physical plant of the resort, the beach, the pool, and especially the landscaping. Even though we had the lowest level accommodation, the room was large and elegant and the garden view was lovely. My wife and I considered the food, on balance, to be very good. We mostly drank beer and wine so I can't comment on other accusations of watered down liquor. Entertainment is below cruise ship quality but it is adequate and as expected for the size of the place. We especially enjoyed the afternoon activities. The finger painting class is not to be missed both from the take home quality of your own artwork to the very entertaining instructor. My wife participated in the water aerobics class each day. The activities staff deserve a special shout out. We particularly enjoyed the friendliness and personality of Wilfredo.

My downrating of the resort concerns the class structure of the guests. I did not want to add what turned out to be an additional $100 a day for Royal Service. Essentially it gets you a butler and an exclusive roped off area of the beach and pool. I just don't need it and it clearly is not a good value-at least to me.

However, at times we felt like steerage customers when it came to restaurant reservations. There appears to be little effort in accommodating non Royal Service guests. Even though the resort was far from full when we were there in mid-December, I could not get the restaurants I wanted at the times I wanted them. And, there was less than satisfactory effort shown by the concierge desk to help.

While I'm in a ranting mood, let me suggest to the management that they should dial back the time share marketing effort. My guard was up so I was not schmoozed into a presentation, but the sales people are persistent and, I must say, very good at their jobs. But I didn't spend the kind of money for a resort of this level to have to tolerate the marketing pitches.

I also agree with an earlier reviewer that the hundreds of dollars in credits offered were completely useless as they just amounted to a discount on hugely inflated prices for options like spa services.

Other than that, we had a great week. It's a lovely place with an overall great staff.

reviews.author: Rachael R
reviews.title: Not a 5 or ever 4 star resort, atleast not the room they put us in..
reviews.text: Let me start off by saying we booked Breathless at first, but it was new and had bad reviews, we paid MORE money to come to the reserve b/c of the glowing reviews.  Got there, the beach was OK, it was filled with broken furniture and just looked so worn out and disorganized.  It was so windy that day (not the resort's fault) but the ocean was impossible to swim in and you couldn't lay out.  We went to the bar, NO TOP SHELF!!! You have to PAY MORE FOR IT!! Are you freaking kidding me????  we paid MORE money toy come to this resort that was advertised with ALL INCLUSIVE PREMIUM LIQUEUR.  We have only stayed at Secrets which is an AM resort and they know how to do unlimited luxury right... not to mention the bracelet that left dug into my wrist from having to sleep with it on... well I didn't really sleep as the walls are paper thin, I heard children SCREAMING all night and house keeping and other workers, and the TRAMS, they are gas powered and are SO loud, I was in tears our first night and called our cheap Caribbean rep to switch back to Breathless and we had to pay MORE money again to leave the resort.  The people were very friendly though, no one was rude.  But this is not 5 star, and the ADULT pool was teaming with CHILDREN.  You just can't escape them!!!  The food at the Gabi buffet was all inedible, I am not picky either, I love buffets but the meat was so fake tasting and dry, I couldn't eat it.  Maybe if we stayed longer than 1 night and tried the al a cart places it would have been better but we didn't want to chance it.  Over all, this place is average, maybe if you've never been to an AM Resort brand then this place is like paradise but I guess we got spoiled at Secrets and Breathless to appreciate a resort such as The Reserve.  Our room was very dilapidated too, and the light switched... WTF nothing makes sense!!  The room had so many broken things in it, the shelf below the sink was broken, the doors on the "kitchen" were all busted up some didn't open they were nailed shut and the knobs missing... I mean come on... you can't charge that much $$ for a 2-3 start quality experience... I'm sooooooooo glad we switched to Breathless but sad we wasted a day at the Reserve.

reviews.author: nonna B
reviews.title: Paradise at Palma Real –  Dominican republic
reviews.text:
It was my son wedding at this resort and it  was really disappointed.The food is well below average.Service is terrible. Every time you asked for something,wait time is 30 minutes even for a glass of water. We have to pay extra for  every little step.We asked to put a welcome  gifts to the the guests at check-in area  so people can take it while checking in.Hotel manager told us that they have no room for that.But for $5 plus tax,they can deliver gifts ti the room.We asked to get us a table's number holder,they did not have that .Hotel,who is holding few weddings every week??
We asked them to provide us with 10 martini glasses for decoration, wedding coordinator said that they do not have that as well. Martini glasses???? The centerpieces was delivered in 2 shipment .So half of the centerpieces were delivered on time and for  another half we were waited for 30 minutes.
Some days we had 10 different towels in the room,some days-4 towels. Once the girl, who was giving beach towels,  told us that we are entitled to 1 towel per day per person.We had 80 people wedding and they could not accommodate us with a reservation to the restaurant.We have to divide to parties of 6-8 people if we wanted to go to the restaurant.When waiters saw more then 4 people at the table,they did not know what to do. They took an order from half of the table and forgot about the other half.If you place an order and  need to change or add something,it was a nightmare because they would never bring us that .If this is a big resort who accommodate large parties,how come you have waiters who do not know how to handle that.One of our guest left early.The other guest left on time but his flight got cancelled due to the problem with a plane.We asked manager to let him use the room which already was paid for,but we could not get that done.
We are  traveling  to Dominican republic every year.That was by far the most expensive resort we ever go to and one of the worst one. The variety and presentation of the food is very poor.The drinks are decent.The shows are awful.We used to go to IberoStar resort and we love those shows even if they also  are not professional.they do not bring drinks to the beach.
Honestly,I do not understand why are they charge that much.Never again and never recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: All are equal, but some are more equal than others - (George Orwell )
reviews.text:
This hotel has 3 different levels of services provided:
1 regular - yellow wrist band
2 VIP - black wrist band
3 Royal Services - gold wrist band
 Places like some beaches, SPA bars and certain restaurants, are for Royal services gests only!
Don't be confused by advertising,  if you purchase regular or VIP trips many of things advertised are not included.
My travel agent did not tell me about this matter so I purchased regular service and many times was told this is not for you (go away).
Now about hotel :  Beautiful landscape, the best what I've seen at "Bavaro" or La Romana beaches.
Very good rooms. Beach and lounge chairs, towel services were just the best .
Food is descent. Drinks depend from you level of service you purchase. If you are not "Royal service" guest your Pina colada will be served from reg. factory frozen mixes and local cheap rum. Royal service guests will drink fresh mixes from  fresh pineapples, fresh coconut cream and premium rum. Same goes for the other drinks cheap booze and wines versus premium.
I stayed at this hotel because i was invited for a wedding, so guests were divided to different groups depending on the level of service they bought.
My choice at "Bavaro"  beach is Rio Palace  Macao - small,  old, recently renovated adults only hotel.
Also, "Bavaro"  beach located at the Southern tip of the island where the Atlantic meets Caribbean sea has more waves then La Romana or Jamaica. Keep it in mind if you are vacationing with kids.

reviews.author: kaarby1
reviews.title: 3 stars is a correct rating.
reviews.text:
We are back from our vacation, and I wanted to give you some feed back.
The hotel was beautiful, our room on the 3rd floor was very nice, facing the pool with
partial ocean view, and the people that worked at the hotel was very nice.
We spent about $ 20 per day in tips, $3 to the room cleaning lady, $2 for breakfast,
$5 for lunch and  $5 for dinner, and $5 on the beach to the guy that got us the chair and drinks
also tipped the butler $ 20.
We loved the juice bar on the adult only beach, private pool and restaurant.
We did not think the Royal Service was worth $ 1,500.00, but we wanted it and we got it.
The service and the quality of the food was not very good, we think that they
need better training, and a better chef, when we arrived the assigned us a butler, 
after 1 hour we had a different butler, 2 days later they had change the butler again,
and the last day we had a last butler, only one time they for warned us that the butler will
be changed.
We had cats roaming the hall way and restaurant, one evening on our way to dinner the cat had taken a crap outside our room, we told the staff, when we came back after dinner it was still there.
The next morning I got up to go to golf, it was still there, when I came back from golf around 12 it was gone.
The golf course was nice, but I was very surprised when I had to pay $65.00 for each round, when I had the impression the golf was included.
WE talked to an other couple and they told us the money and clothing was stolen from there room.
The wine was not good at all, we asked if the had a free wine list and we was told that there was only 1 kind of free wine  
Also we where surprised to see that one of the restaurants, Passion, was not included in the all inclusive and we had to pay $50 
per person to eat there and additional $ 25 per person for the wine tasting.
The people that did not purchase the Royal Service had to pay for the restaurant at Gabi Beach.
We feel that they are trying to mix high and low quality in to one place and I don't think it is working,
like Starbucks and Dunking donuts in the same room.
I think 3 stars is a correct rating for this place.

reviews.author: Lourdes M
reviews.title: Excellent service  Gerardo Raposo
reviews.text:
Gerardo Raposo nos presto un servicio excelente!!!!! Muy amable y atento a todas las necesidades. El hotel muy lindo! Las plantas preciosas, muy bien cuidado, el personal de primera clase. Es la quinta vez que estuvimos en Punta caña pero considero que en diciembre hay mucho viento.
Michel y Lourdes

reviews.author: Oli M
reviews.title: Hotel is nice BUT......
reviews.text:
I was here with my wife and my parents for a week in april.
It was my 7th trip to punta cana.

1st of all the hotel is nice but way to big.
you will need to move with cart's and sometimes it takes more than 20m to arrive.

2nd the service is honestly not that good for what your paying. The Paradisus playa del carmen's service is higher quality compared to the punta cana.

3rd the Food! 
No variety at all! The buffet section's are very small (2 small buffet in diff locations of the hotel)
No seafood or very little (Compared to Secrets royal in punta cana)
And again I'm stressing on the Service because we are paying for a upper scale 5 star  but honestly the service is a 3 star.

A la carte: the mexican was discusting but the rest were Good.
And btw the waiters dont know a word in english. Don't try to explain "well done" to a waiter.

The rooms are very nice at the Reserve. But honestly, try somewhere else. The food and the service were not what we expected for what we payed

reviews.author: Junfly
reviews.title: Una de cal u otra de arena
reviews.text:
Nuestra llegada al hotel fue lamentable, pues el primer acto que realizas al llegar no es, como en todos los hoteles que hasta la fecha habíamos visitado, facilitar los datos de la tarjeta que garantice el pago al finalizar la estancia, si no firmar el cargo total de la reserva efectuada, y no sólo eso ya que además hay que firmar un cargo de 500 $ para garantizar el pago de cualquier consumo que se pueda producir no incluido en el importe anterior. El primero de los cargos se efectúa en tu tarjeta el mismo día de su firma. En relación al segundo te informan que sólo se producirá el cargo en caso de que se realicen los citados consumos y por el importe de los mismos ¡sólo faltaría!
Me parece, ofensiva la falta de confianza en la solvencia y seriedad del cliente. Hasta ahora no me había encontrado con nada parecido viajando por Europa, Estados Unidos y Asia incluyendo varios hoteles de la cadena Meliá En España, París y Londres.

Otro aspecto negativo del hotel fue la lucha por disponer de los productos de baño mínimos de los que se dispone el cualquier hotel de cuatro estrellas o más y en muchos de tres. Así cómo de tener dos toallas de manos en el baño, dado que la habitación estaba ocupada por dos personas. Etc. Todo lo anterior a pesar de estar alojados en el Royal Service

También hubo aspectos positivos. Tanto Las instalaciones del hotel como las habitaciones son magníficas y la amabilidad del personal extraordinaria.

El mayordomo Nicolás Maracallo magnífico, aunque probablemente un poco sobrecargado de trabajo.

El equipo del bar de la piscina, capitaneado por el simpático y excelente barman y buen acróbata Ramón FUEGO, muy bueno.

El hamaquero y magnífico barman de la piscina del Royal Service Francisco Cabrera muy amable y eficiente.

Grande el chef del restaurante Palazzo Carlos Seuno. Y muy amables los camareros com mención especial para Yudelca y Pasquel.

Magnífica atención al cliente del maître del Marquet Grill Iasaias y magníficos los cortados que prepara.

Y para finalizar nuestro reconocimiento al personal del Royal Service, en particular a las srtas. Rosi y Teurys, con especial mención de la gerente srta. María Gil. Lásima que a esta última la conocimos al efectuar el check out.

Es una lástima tener que hacer los comentarios efectuados en los primeros párrafos de esta opinión, ya que sí no fuera por ello la calificación del hotel sería excelente, como debería ser para un establecimiento de estas características y precio.

reviews.author: pushincushin
reviews.title: All good but the robbery!
reviews.text:
Took $1000 in cash for our vacation to Paradise. Decided to leave $800 in the safe along with other valuables. Left room for day and came back to find cash stolen. Tried unsuccessfully for almost one month to get resolution, but nobody at resort wants to take any responsibility for employing a thief.

Beware that even the room safes are not secure from "inside help".  Be very careful with your valuables as they hotel staff and management are not concerned.

reviews.author: Márcia Kristiny A
reviews.title: Deixou a desejar
reviews.text:
A localização dispensa comentários, já que o mar do Caribe é indescritível. 
A recepção foi boa.
A área do SPA é linda.
A internet do hotel não presta. Tivemos muito trabalho até um técnico ir ao nosso apartamento. Na verdade tive que ir atrás do gerente para que ele tomasse as providências necessárias.
Para utilizar os restaurantes à noite tem que se fazer reserva para jantarmos nos restaurantes do hotel. 
Tivemos a péssima surpresa ao sermos induzidos pela "concierge" a nos filiar à rede Meliá. Nos prometeram um café da manhã. Quando chegamos lá, ficamos sabendo que essa conversa nos "roubariam" 90 minutos. Quando recusamos, foi notória a frieza no tratamento conosco.

reviews.author: Christine B
reviews.title: Don't order vodka you will get tequila
reviews.text: The hotel is the stunning! The rooms, the view, the beach are beautiful. The staff is very friendly. The market grill and buffet are satisfactory. The food is the same and not that good. I recommend making a reservation at vento and the hibachi grill at the reserve both are fabulous. Don't expect to get a vodka soda even though they will pour the so called vodka from a stoli, grey goose or absolut bottle extremely frustrating. We tried every bar at the hotel. Expect to be served tequila at least half the time. My advice bring your own vodka even though alcohol is included in the price :(

reviews.author: Steven T
reviews.title: Dissappointed
reviews.text: This was my 3rd time back. 1st room I was checked in, had crayon marks all over the sofa and the TV did not work. 2nd room had ants and several lights were burned out. The Internet connectivity is horrible and several computers in their lobby do not work. I very rarely got a connection and most times, I was disconnected.The buffet food quality and offering is below average. The beach is nice and the golfing was a good experience. "Free" golfing was included in my package but you still have to pay a $50 cart fee. The casino at their sister hotel is small but nice. The staff was friendly.

reviews.author: Augusto L
reviews.title: Excelente infraestructura y servicio mediocre
reviews.text: La infraestructura es espectacular y la comida de los restaurantes también (excepto el Bana sushi que es pésimo), pero hay mucho personal que trabaja con mala disposición y que te acosa constantemente para venderte cosas extras, lo cual finalmente agota.

reviews.author: DrTodd7
reviews.title: Beautiful property Royal Service not so Royal
reviews.text: A great property…but our Butler was absolutely of no value.  Some of the staff were AMAZING.  BILLY at the pool, Luiz the bartender and the Hostess Jessica at Bana.  Staying on the third floor with no elevator was not Royal treatment.  Our butler let us down on many occasions.  We have stayed at another property in the past which was a much more pleasurable experience.  With some of the staff so exceptional I hate to write any negativity but the bad experiences really left a bad taste on our vacation.

reviews.author: wcynthy
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text:
Check in and check out was the quickest I have ever had. I do wish they gave us a drink upon arrival though :-)!  The room we had was overlooking the pool. After requesting two separate beds they did accommodate us and change us from the king bed. The rooms at the Reserve are 15 minutes from the beach. I love to walk so we did not mind however it is not an easy walk because the trolly and the gardens in the trucks drive by. The trolly was not always easy to get. You wait 15 minutes a lot of times and the exhaust has a strong smell.  Everything in the resort is far apart. We would have loved if there were signs to help you get around. Some of the staff are friendly and helpful and others are not at all. The beach when we went was very wavy and had strong undertow. I do believe that this is the time of year we went. The resort does have great beach lounges and straw huts for everyone. Please note though if you are Family Reserve you can reserve the front beach huts.They put your names on them. We unfortunately got up at 7am and they were all taken but because we were just the Reserve we were unable to reserve seating.  You also at the Reserve are not allowed to go on the left side of the beach as that is for Royal members only. The first day we didn't realize this and got kicked off that side of beach by staff when we asked for a drink. There is  definitely plenty of room on our side of the beach though. We just didn't know. I prefer resort where there are no restrictions by class of room. I also think that the lay out of the resort is confusing. 

The speciality restaurants the food was decent. We especially love the Latin fusion. That was the best food and service we received.  It took a few phone calls to get reservations. I recommend to make reservations for all the restaurants on the day you arrive.

reviews.author: Williams86
reviews.title: Bring Ear Plugs!!
reviews.text:
This resort is NOT quiet. If you want quiet, do not get a room facing the very large pool. You will hear children screaming all day. Yes, there is a kids pool as well but many parents take their children to the main pool. There is also a daily Zumba and water aerobic classes at the pool with blasting music. If you want peace and quiet, it won't happen, hence, the ear plugs! 

The grounds are beautiful with small, three floor buildings (I didn't see an elevator). I've never seen so may different kinds of palm trees. The grounds people do an amazing job. The rooms are spacious but dated.  There is no signage in the rooms regarding conserving water so they take your towels even if you hang them up. My personal pet-peeve. 

Every building has a "guest concierge" in the lobby, however, our concierge didn't seem to understand that he was there to service the guest. The beach is at least a 12-minute walk away from the hotel. Also, many of the restaurants are near the beach so you will either walk at night (there are lights), or take the trolley, which is infrequent. So if you want to be on the beach, this isn't the hotel for you. 

The food is a tad better than Applebees, at best; however, Vento was good. The house white and red wine is truly undrinkable. I didn't expect Opus One, but their wine is truly terrible. Ordering off the wine list will cost you $40.00 or more for a decent bottle. You must make reservations on your very first day or you run the risk of eating at the main dinning room, Gabi Grill, which serves mediocre buffet. There are two restaurants that required an additional fee: $25 pp and $45 pp. Unlike our experience in Mexico, most of the staff do not speak English so communicating with them or asking for help was challenging. Due to the language barrier, checking in and out was not ideal. The airport is 40-minutes away. 

PLEASE NOTE: Upon check-in they will volunteer to take you to breakfast the next day near the beach. Since we didn't know the resort, we agreed to meet with a staff member only to find out this was a time-share scam. The staff person wanted us to fill out paperwork with our annually salary and credit card number! Not to mention, she wanted to sit with us for 90-minutes. This really left us with a bad taste and seemed extremely underhanded. The resort needs to find a more transparent way to address this since 99% of guest do not want to sit with a stranger for 90-minutes on their much deserved vacation. I'm glad I got to visit Punta Cana, but we'll be returning to Rivera Maya (Playa del Carmen) in January. I find the high-end resorts in Mexico really exceed at guest services and the foods is excellent.

reviews.author: JT T
reviews.title: Francisco Cabrera
reviews.text: My wife and I were there in November 2013.  We enjoyed sitting on the beach and especially the great service from Francisco Cabrera.  The beaches and pools are beautiful.  The food and drinks were plentiful.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Lue M
reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: I booked this hotel as I was attending a fantastic conference, which would have been just as good if it was hosted in a jungle. Yes, the grounds were beautiful and the rooms were lovely and the staff very pleasant. The food was quite decent by all-inclusive standards. Admittedly, I haven't stay at many AI's, as they are not my first accommodation choice, however, I do appreciate good service. This hotel didn't have terrible service, but they did drop the ball a few times for myself and other fellow conference attendees. I was underwhelmed for the price I paid. I have stayed at three stars with far more outstanding service than at this property. More often than not, I would not receive my drink order at meals, and the lobby bar service was extremely slow - I waited 15 minutes for one drink and the bar wasn't even busy. I consider myself a very patient and forgiving customer, having worked in the hospitality industry for numerous years in another life, I do cut alot of slack. I regret to say, I was less than impressed overall, unless you count the ceviche. The ceviche was outstanding and you had no less than two to choose from every lunch time.

reviews.author: Natalie J
reviews.title: Just "OK"
reviews.text:
This resort was recommended by a friend--she has stay three times in the past so I was expecting more. PROS: Beautiful, CLEAN hotel and very nice pools, the standard rooms are being renovated so we were upgraded to The Reserve side, which was nice, but keep in mind you will need to bike, walk or take a staff driven golf cart to where a lot of the activities take place; we didn't mind the idea of it once we figured out how everything worked. The the beach is as wonderful and calm as their website states, spa services (plenty of services to chose from), drinks are good depending on where you get them on the property, decent tours/excursions to choose from as well as activities on the beach (i.e. parasailing, canoeing, snorkeling, wind sailing) CONS: There's tons of pressure to listen to the time share presentation...JUST KEEP SAYING NO! the food is nothing to write home about, but manageable over a week, Wi-Fi is a bit slow and the TV channel selections are slim (just added that in case you need your technology creature comforts while on vacay). We weren't too comfortable walking more than 5-7 minutes away from the resort due to busy local traffic, but the resort property itself is super safe.  AREAS TO IMPROVE: Even with the private concierge service we had at The Reserve, there were still a lot to learn/figure out about the resort; we asked other travelers that had been there for a few days while.

It was an okay vacation, but when we visit the DR again we will definitely try another resort.

reviews.author: Luis M
reviews.title: Excelentes instalaciones, pero las comidas y bebidas.....
reviews.text: Las instalaciones, habitaciones de este hotel, son excelentes, pero en las comidas casi hay variedad. Las comidas sin carnes o mariscos, prácticamente no existen, y las bebidas sin alcohol, solo hay una o dos y malas. Los jugos no son naturales y son malísimos.

reviews.author: Larissa GRD
reviews.title: O Hotel é bom, mas tive muito problemas, mesmo sendo Royal Service
reviews.text:
Fiquei hospedada de 6/11 a 9/11 e para ter um atendimento impecável, solicitei o Royal service. Paguei uma diária altíssima e não tie um serviço condizente. 
Minha cafeteira do quarto não funcionou durante todos os dias em que estive hospedada e a minha internet wifi do quarto só funcionou durante o primeiro dia.
Além disso, a minha mala de mão sumiu entre a recepçao do hotel e a chegada ao meu quarto, que também aconteceu depois da hora da hora do check-in... Fiquei 20 minutos no lobby esperando e cheguei no quarto somente às 15:30.  Para finalizar, o táxi que tinham pedido para mim não chegou, suspeito que isso aconteceu porque não pediram e eu estava ali com as malas, sem ninguém para me dar uma satisfação. Depois de meia hora na recepcao chegou um taxi que conseguiram ali na hora, aí tive que correr muito para nao me atrasar e perder o meu voo. Saí de lá desapontada, mas agora ao chegar no Brasil, fico surpresa com mais um problema que devo alertar: NAO RESERVEM pelo MELIA para o bem de vcs.
Estou pagando 200 reais a mais, pois pela reserva do site o valor era em dólares, e no lobby assinei o contrato no valor do combinado pelo site, mas passaram meu cartão em outra moeda, logo gera duas conversões, o vai me fazer pagar aqui mais 90 dolares.

SInceramente, o custo-beneficio nao vale.

reviews.author: Tami H
reviews.title: Beautiful but service not so bueno
reviews.text: The facilities are beautiful & clean. Internet & hair dryer did not work. Room not serviced everyday. No pool towels in room each day or available at pool. At checkout, they miscalculated my bill by double- after 30 minutes it was finally rectified!! Grrr... Would not stay again...

reviews.author: pgutz
reviews.title: Hotel  bueno pero no acorde al precio, demasiado pretencioso
reviews.text:
Estuvimos alojados durante el mes de octubre por 7 días en servicio real en una hab con vista al jardín.  Era nuestra 1ra. experiencia en la cadena, ya que somos huéspedes habituales de la cadena Iberostar, de hecho habíamos estado previamente en el mes de agosto pero quisimos probar.
Pasaré a detallar los puntos fuertes y debilidades del hotel.

1) Check in:  muy rápido, al ser de servicio real teníamos check in privado en un lounge preparado para tal fin.  Fuimos atendidos por una srta. donde nos hizo firmar la documentación y nos solicitó una tarjeta de crédito para realizar un depósito de USD 500 sobre gastos u extras, cuya operatoria sería anulada en el momento del check out con el descuento de las extras en caso que hubiesen ocurrido. (cosa insólita para un hotel de tal característica, pero tendrán sus razones).  Nos asignó la habitación, me solicitó la tarjeta MAS (programa de fidelidad de Meliá) para cargar los puntos (los cuales aún brillan por su ausencia), y nos presentó al mayordomo que nos iba a asistir en nuestra estadía (Sr. Yohelvi) el cual nos hizo una recorrida un poco extensa por el hotel y nos llevó  a la habitación (después de un viaje tan largo, no tenés ganas de seguir caminando y de ver las instalaciones)
2)  Habitación:   la hab. aparentemente estaba muy linda, en orden, con una cama king con dosel, baño con hidromasaje, living, TV, y ahí comenzaron los problemas, a detallar:  no funcionaba internet (tuvimos que llamar y vino el técnico), la llave de luz donde está el inodoro hacía falso contacto y se movía toda lo cual era un peligro (llamado nuevamente y al día siguiente la arreglaron), habían sacado el reproductor de DVD (llamar para que lo coloquen), pero no había suficientes enchufes, si se conectaba el DVD había que desenchufar el equipo de radio (INSOLITO!), parece que no conocen los triples.  Lo más insólito fue que me senté en el sillón del balcón y tenía pintura fresca negra uno de los apoyabrazos por lo cual me ensucié el antebrazo con pintura que me costó como 2 días poder sacar.  Nos comunicamos con el mayordomo y con el personal del lounge de servicio real quienen nos iban solucionando las cosas pero a las 48 hs ya harto de los problemas solicité cambio de habitación la cual nos dieron y nos pasaron a otro cuarto el cual no tenía ningún inconveniente, salvo alguna que otra cucaracha (!!) como verán en la foto.   Las amenities al principio estaban muy bien ya que eran Terry Mugler, pero a los 2 días parece que se acabaron y ponían unas feas que no eran de marca, demás está decir que varias veces tuve que llamar porque no reponían acondicionador ni shampoo (otra cosa insólita en esta categoría).  Aire acondicionado sumamente ruidoso.  Se notaba que las habitaciones tenían unos cuantos años, creo que es momento de someterlas a un rejuvenecimiento.
3) Mayordomo:  buena atención con lindos detalles por parte de Yohelvi; en el check in te daban un celular para estar en comunicación  con el mayordomo.  Este se encargaba de las reservaciones de los restaurantes y demás encargos que uno le quisiera hacer.  Previo pedido preparaba el jacuzzi a la hora indicada, nos ha dejado también un plato de fiambres en el cuarto, una torta el día antes de retirarnos y nos coordinó el desayuno en la habitación el día del check out y los maleteros.  El servicio es útil y bien atendido por el mayordomo, se merece el reconocimiento.
4)  Restaurantes:  lo más lindo del servicio real era un restaurant exclusivo para el desayuno y almuerzo, ya que era buffet gourmet y a la carta, muy tranquilo y muy bien atendido.  Destaco la labor del camarero Smerlyn, el cual era muy atento y simpático con nosotros.  En ese sitio también funcionaba durante la noche el restaurant Palazzo de cocina italiana, muy lindo.  Los otros restaurant que eran comunes de todo el complejo, pero no del servicio real, es decir, podía haber niños ya que no eran para adultos era el Vento (bien, pero los camareros un poco atolondrados, olvidable), tailandés (muy bueno), japonés (sumamente ruidoso, con mesas compartidas por lo cual no entramos y nos fuimos al buffet), Gabi (bueno, nada de otro mundo, supuestamente este el restaurant exclusivo de la cadena, para ir 1 vez y no repetir), buffett (fuimos sólo una vez, bastante bien, pero en la zona donde se retiraba la comida, la cual estaba aparte, quedabas con un olor a comida bárbaro en la ropa).
5)  Bares:  el único que valía la pena era el del lounge del servicio real donde uno podía ir a cualquier hora, comer algunos snacks y beber alguna cosas.  Destaco sumamente la atención del Sr. Miguel Moya, el cual era muy atento, servicial y cordial en el trato.
6)  Piscina y playa privada:  eran muy lindas, como todas las playas de la zona, lástima que la arena donde estaban las reposeras estaban sucias, nunca limpiaban, con pajitas, colillas, plásticos, etc.  Si bien la gente es sucia, había pocos cestos de residuos (de hecho los que habían nunca tenían bolsas), creo que debería haber pequeños cestos y/o ceniceros en cada mesita de las sombrillas.  El servicio de concierge de playa, bien gracias!!, eran como 4 cuatro que supuestamente te acomodaban y pasaban para ofrecer algo para tomar, se la pasaban hablando en el bar de la piscina, 1 sóla vez en  7 días nos ofrecieron algo (calculo que por equivocación), era más simple caminar 50 metros y recogerlo nosotros.  O cambian a los concierges de playa o los vigilan un poco más porque trabajar lo hacen poco.
7)  Internet:  merece aclaración aparte, malísima!   Si bien la teníamos sin cargo, en la habitación, la mayoría de las veces no funcionaba, y en la playa jamás funcionó.
8)  Club Meliá:  también merece aclaración aparte.  Como vieron que nosotros viajamos mucho (aprox cada 3-4 meses al exterior) nos invitaron a un desayuno que no duraría más de 90 minutos (por escrito y con firma nuestra y del hotel) donde nos explicarían las bondades de adquirir la membresía durante 50 años para alojarnos en cualquier hotel de la cadena en el mundo con costos mínimos.  Era un día de playa divino, nos encontramos 8.30 AM para desayunar y nos contactaron con la Sra. Jackie, la cual nos habló de las bondades del programa, nos mostró las habitaciones de "The Reserve" y nos llevó luego para hablar con la encargada de la venta, ya llevábamos como 3 horas, en vez de los 90 minutos de compromiso firmado, el cual nunca cumplieron.  La gerenta de ventas (una inglesa muy simpática) nos dió los costos junto con 2 incentivos (eran 2 estadías de 7 y 12 días respectivamente sin cargo en cualquier hotel del mundo de la cadena o de sus asociados) pero había que decidirlo en las 2 horas siguientes en forma cohercitiva.  A esta altura estábamos hartos, el precio era elevado (unos USD 40000 con facilidades de pago) pero no estábamos convencidos de la cadena, por suerte!!     Por haber asistido a esta reunión nos darían 30.000 puntos MAS, los cuales los estoy esperando sentado, ya que nunca lo acreditaron  a pesar de haber hecho los reclamos pertinentes a la Srta. Natalia (personal de lounge real, quien nos coordinó esta infructífera reunión).
9)  Gastronomía:  muy gourmet, es decir, elaborada pero con porciones pequeñas.  Muy buena.
10)  Servicio de mucamas:  de regular a normal.  Durante el día, hacían el cuarto siempre en horarios diferentes y siempre faltando algo que había que pedir por teléfono.  El servicio de mucamas por la noche, creo que lo tuvimos 2 veces o se olvidaban o estaban con poco personal.  No nos gustó.
11)  Frigobar y cafetera:  la reposición era a diario, con agua mineral, gaseosas, jugos, lo estándar.   La habitación tiene una cafetera expresso con variedades de cafés, pero la mayoría eran horribles, ya que solicité que nos pongan sólo café expresso regular y descafeinado y nos alegaron que no tenían (!! insólito, pero cierto).
12)  Créditos para usar:  en el momento del check in te dan como una chequera por valor de USD 1500 que uno puede usar como descuentos en algunas cosas, ej. casino, spa, etc.  No los utilizamos porque no nos resultaron convenientes.
13)  Check out:  rápido, en el mismo sector privado.  Ahí devolvimos el teléfono y nos anularon el cargo de la tarjeta de crédito por USD 500 que habíamos hecho en el ingreso.  Consejo:   no olvidarse de hacer esto.

Calificación global:  7.75

Creo que es un hotel demasiado caro para lo que ofrecen, no vale la pena a nuestro entender.  En síntesis, seguiremos siendo fiel a nuestra cadena habitual.

reviews.author: Lobuio
reviews.title: Não é bem assim . . . .
reviews.text: Não é o paraíso que te prometem, o Hotel é antigo, tive problemas com vazamento no vaso sanitário que não arrumaram, abajur não funcionou, reposição das utilidades de banheiro não aconteciam com regularidade, contratamos Royal Service, quando conseguíamos falar com nosso Concirge, pois nos deram um fone para contato que não funcionava, ele não fazia nada a contento, tentei falar com a responsável, Sra. Maria Gil, ela simplesmente não nos atendeu e mandou outra pessoa. O atendente de praia se escondia da gente, as bebidas mais sofisticadas ficavam fora da visão dos hóspedes, mas, tudo isso de resolvia com uma coisa chamada “propina” para eles, “caixinha” para nós, e para fechar com chave de ouro, pela Cia Aérea Gol, cada passageiro pode sair do Brasil com duas malas de 32 Kg., mas só pode voltar com uma cada de 23 Kg., o restante excesso de bagagem à US$ 8,00 por quilo ou jogue tudo fora, não esquecendo que tomaram meio dia da nossa estadia tentando vender um título se sócio da rede Meliá, que como contrapartida, teríamos desconto nos passeios, coisa que o Sr. Ivan da Blue Tour, simplesmente ignorou, só faltou falar, reclame com o Papa.  A parte boa da viajem não foi além do que nós pagamos por ela, acho que não é necessário enaltecer, porém vale ressaltar que o povo da República Dominicana, é extremamente hospitaleiro, não volto a esse hotel.

reviews.author: Capt Mitch
reviews.title: Shuttle waits No Bueno.
reviews.text:
Shuttle waits No Bueno.

This mature property is beautiful.
Stayed at The Reserve.
Room was perfect with a pool view, just one issue.
Hot Water! Not a lack of it, too much hot water.
Let concierge know and it was fixed that day. Other rooms in adjacent building were having same issue, and it returned for balance of our stay. In evenings, one of our rooms in adjacent building was super noisy due to excited younger guests. Our room in our building was mostly quiet.

Restaurants were ok.
Buffets were ok. Nothing spectacular. 
Typical omelette bar, and small grill for lunch.
Would have liked to see a greater selection of ingredients to put in omelette, such as bacon and shrimp.

Pools are awesome. We used the swim up bar at the reserve a lot.
Would also like to see guacamole and chips offered at small grill next to pool.

October is low season, so getting pool chairs and or  cabanas was easy.
Extra towels are self service, at unattended hut.

The beach is awesome. Again, low season so not problem getting chairs or cabana.
Drinks are self serve at the beach, not a far walk but still self serve.

Most all waiters, bartenders and staff are super friendly and outgoing.

Specialty restaurants were ok. Nothing like the food at The Vine Cancun or Zoetry.
Desserts  were varied and for the most part delicious.

Most aren't air conditioned, and some have so many Mosquitos that it would be prudent to apply great amount of bug spray or cream with deet prior to arrival. Two in our party got their legs bitten dozens of times in the ten minutes prior to staff offering Off spray.

I'd say the best meal we had was at the Grill. Not what you are thinking. Not the steak, ribs or sausage, those were not of good quality. The chicken and chicken soup were delicious.
We saw a fellow diner near that had Salmon. Fish was thick and looked great. Waiter offered us fish after he saw most left on my plate. It was thick, not at all fishy tasting (Fresh) and Delish.

The disco that opens at 11:30 pm in the main lobby was fun.
The shows by staff in the main showroom skip.

Drinks were ok, but most of the liquor is not premium and tasted it.

Some tips from our second trip to Punta Cana:

Buy your airport transfers online prior as cost vary.
We found $69 Round Trip for three online by Optim. Instructions online were clear, service was dependable, all brand new air conditioned vans and we were the only ones on board to and from the hotel. Five star rating from me on Optim.

Costco has a salesman in the lobby. Snorkel trip with transportation was $55 each, where lowest I could find in hotel for same trip was $69. You don't even have to be a costco member.
That trip was excellent as well.

Enjoy your next trip to Punta Cana.
I'll be returning, just probably not to this resort.

reviews.author: brooklyn
