Al llegar te asignan una persona que te hace las reservas de restaurantes que te presiona a sisitir a un almuerzo o desayuno de 90 minutos donde te quieren vender un Club Vacacional de Melia, si bien no te presionan la charla dura mas de 2 horas y si no quieres comprar no te recomiendoperder 3 hs de playa
En la playa no te ofrecen comida como en otros hoteles y el Market grill sobre la playa donde supestamente hacen hamburguesas, papas fritas estuvo cerrado toda la semana
Las clases de tenis son a las 10 y 17 hs luego tienes que pagarlas en otros horarios 30 dolares la hora
Nuestra habitacion tenia una gotera de agua en el aire acondicionado, lo arregalron pero luego sigui perdiendo agua en el living, los canales de tv se veian  mal como con lluvia
No te dejan programa de actividades impreso por lo que tienes que andar averiguando que ocurre cada dia
En la playa hay muchas algas marinas ( No es Mar Caribe ) en Bavaro es Oceano Altantico no te confundas
Lo peor fue la comida, me dijeron que el cheff principal es mexicano y tambien su asistente, en reciclaje y decoracion de la comida es un genio, en calidad, sabor les falta muchisimo!!
De postres no tienen idea son postres casi todos artificiales con gusto a nada, les falta reposteria, los helados solo eran de frutilla y chocolate muy artificiales, si te gustan los dulces este no es tu lugar
En conclusion es un buen Hotel pero no esperes un Leading of the Word deberian sacarlo de la lista

reviews.author: Orb
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text:
Hemos estado en Agosto de 2010 y encontramos el hotel un tanto decepcionante, no por las instalaciones en sí que son buenas pero algunas se pueden mejorar ,por ejemplo, el gimnasio es pequeño y poco cuidado tiene máquinas estropeadas y con óxido, las habitaciones tienen mucha humedad y hay muchos “desconchones” de pintura por todas paredes, el DVD de la habitación no funcionaba, la TV en muchas ocasiones, se oía pero no se veía nada, la psicina principal, un tanto sucia, sobre todo en la zona de piscina dónde está el bar dónde había vasos o bolsas de patatas en el agua...... si no eres socio del Vacation Club o está alojado en el  Reserve, no hay internet incluido, si lo quieres, lo pagas y muy caro, 8$ 15 minutos en una sala con dos viejos portátiles o por WIFI tampoco gratis, nuestra habitación, estaba muy lejos de las piscinas y de la recepción, había que caminar durante un buen rato por un pasillo tipo laberinto para llegar a las zonas comunes y eso fue lo 1º que nos dijo el chico de recepción para al mismo tiempo, ofrecernos una habitación más cercana pero por supuesto, más cara, la playa del hotel,está llena de algas, muchas hamacas de la piscina o de  la playa, están rotas o en mal estado, no se puede pasar a zonas comunes de hoteles de la misma cadena que están pegados, muchas lagartijas por las paredes de las zonas comunes para ir a las habitaciones, cosa normal porque están llenas de plantas y vegetación .......etc.

Por las noches, los espectáculos son de escasa calidad y dentro de las instalaciones, hay una discoteca ridícula, descuidada y sin ningún tipo de movimiento, en resumen, parece que el hotel no es para gente joven y que está enfocado a un turismo de edad avanzada o a familias con niños que prefieren tranquilidad y si llueve (llovió un día entero) no hay alternativas de ocio y ni siquiera el hotel las propone, el huésped se dedica a estar en la habitación o  deambular por las zonas comunes pero en ningún momento el personal del hotel incentiva o propone alternativas para pasar el rato, con lo cuál, el aburrimiento se llega a contagiar pues ves a todo el mundo sentado pasando las horas sin hacer nada ya que ni naipes tienen en el hotel.

Aunque lo peor de toda la semana, fue el "acoso" sufrido para que nos hiciéramos socios del Vacation Club de la cadena, nos hicieron perder 90 minutos de una estupenda mañana de sol para  vendernos este tema y la chica que nos atendió al final de la reunión, nos resultó un tanto borde e incluso maleducada cuándo le dijimos que no estábamos interesados en hacernos socios, dando lugar a una situación muy desagradable porque en todo momento te dicen que no tienes ningún compromiso pero parece todo lo contrario, te hablan como si te sobrase el dinero para esto y finalmente te hacen sentir muy incómodo por no estar interesado. Este tema y las formas de algunos agentes, directamente sobran en un hotel de esta supuesta categoría.

Otra cosa a destacar, es el servicio de camareros, es bueno pero muy lento (Sirva como ejemplo que en varias comidas en el buffet, nos trajeron la bebida cuándo ya habíamos terminado de comer y eso es porque no hay bebidas para que tú te sirvas, ellos te ponen agua al sentarte y si quieres otra cosa, se la pides en ese momento, luego vas a por tu comida y te deberían traer la bebida, pero tardan muchísimo cuándo había muchos camareros y poca gente). El servicio, tiene una actitud muy diferente ante los clientes que dejan propinas, es decir, ante los ojos de todo el mundo, se deshacen en servicios y en elogios de forma muy descarada con la gente que les deja propinas, teniendo con el resto de clientes una actitud correcta pero muy diferente y esto, no nos parece bien, pues el hotel, parece que dejara caer en manos del cliente la calidad de su atención según deje o no propinas y esto no debería ser así en un hotel de calidad superior y muy caro como es éste, esos detalles, se deberían cuidar mucho por parte de la dirección del hotel al igual que la actitud de los chicos/as que te reciben al llegar y te enseñan un poco las instalaciones, en todo momento te están insistiendo para que cada vez que reservas o quieres hacer algo dentro del hotel, digas que ha sido gracias a ellos o por recomendación de ellos, me imagino que será porque reciben incentivos y yo entiendo que se trata de un país con necesidades, pero también entiendo que no es lo más correcto en un hotel de esta categoría, haciendo sentir a la gente que tienen la obligación de dejar propinas a todo el mundo, cuándo ya has pagado una cantidad de dinero muy considerable por pasar allí una semana.

Los restaurantes y la comida, en general están bien, pero tienen unas normas un tanto "extremas", si quieres comer en cualquiera de los restaurantes que no sea el buffet, pero que también están incluidos en el precio, tienes que hacer la reserva en recepción, antes de las 16.00 Horas del mismo día, si estás en la piscina y te olvidas, pues cenas en el buffet porque en los restaurantes se necesita esa reserva y eso aunque haya mesas disponibles, que las hay ,pues son restaurantes grandes y hay varios por no decir que si llegas en punto a la hora, recogen toda la comida y no te dan opción para comer.

En resumen, nos imaginábamos un hotel de gran categoría y muy superior al resto de complejos  de los alrededores pero por lo que vimos y nos contó gente que se alojaba en otros complejos muchísimo más baratos que éste, creemos que no vale la pena pagar más porque ofrecen lo mismo. 

Un consejo sería que el que vaya a este hotel o a uno cercano, es que se cerciore bien antes de viajar a que aeropuerto llega o se va, pues el aeropuerto de Santo Domingo desde el hotel, se tardan 4 horas en autobús por unas carreteras comarcales dónde literalmente te juegas la vida circulando por las mismas pues la conducción en el país es realmente temeraria, no es broma pues lo llegas a pasar mal con las cosas que ves en la carretera. El aeropuerto más cercano, es el de Punta Cana, a 15 minutos.

A lo mejor, es porque en verano es la temporada baja y el servicio es peor pero lo consideramos un tanto flojo para el dinero pagado y es una opinión compartida por otros huéspedes con los que hablamos del tema y no es que seamos unos sibaritas, pero viajábamos con unas altas expectativas pues nos vendieron el hotel como el mejor y más exclusivo resort ( o por lo menos de los mejores) de la isla y no ha sido así.

reviews.author: Francisca S
reviews.title: paradisus
reviews.text: El lugar es hermoso. Las piezas impecables. El servicio muy bueno. Pudimos hacer snorkeling casi todos los días previa reserva. Lo malo, los tragos o bebidas alcohólicas. Todas eran tan artificiales que se hacían intomables, fue mi mayos desilusión. Uno espera poder beber buenos tragos en un lugar así y este no fue el caso. Las bebidas como son de máquina nunca tenían gas... muy malo.  De todos los restaurantes el más entretenido fue el mizu... pero no por eso la mejor comida. Creo que todos están parejos en su calidad de comida, no tan buena. El Gabi club tb fue uno con mejor aspecto en comida. Es un lugar para ir con la familia o ir a descansar.

reviews.author: WorldyImages
reviews.title: Accident at the Reserve
reviews.text:
I booked a trip for my father in law and his fiance to stay at the Reserve in June 2010 since they have not been on vacation for over 20 years. Everything was very good except that the glass on the coffee table in the room was broken. My father in law raised his foot and cut his entire foot on the broken glass table. He had to go to the doctor to get stiches and antibiotics. He was unable to swim and enjoy most of his vacation. I asked the hotel to give them a free week since they are clearly at fault. They said flat out that they would not give him anything. Even when I told them I would contact a lawyer, they apologized and said they could not offer him anything. 
I have been to this hotel and recommended friends and family. When I stayed at Melia next door they were giving out free vouchers for 1 week for viewing the Reserve time shares. But clearly they could not give my father in law the same offer after having the incident doumented from their doctor and pictures provided. Needless to say he did not have a good vacation being he was injured and unable to go swimming in the 90 degree.

reviews.author: deedoots11
reviews.title: Overall we made the best of our vacation....
reviews.text:
First of all I was very skeptical to go to this resort after having read all the negative reviews but I have to say it was actually not as BAD as I thought it would be.  My husband and I were in the Royal Service so I think that had a lot to do with it.  The butler service was nice and the private beach and pool area was also very nice. There were a few negative comments I have about the resort: 
1. The room had a very gross and mildew like smell.  Every time I walked into our building I got a whiff of the smell.  I am still trying to wash the smell out of my clothing.  It is kind of a VERY big turn off. 
2. The beach was full of sea weed and pollution.  There were cigarette boxes floating in the water and water bottles.  It was kind of disappointing to see.  I can see that here at Jones Beach.  
3. The whole having to make reservations for dinner is kind of a pain.  I mean the resort was EMPTY and we still had to make dinner reservations.  Luckily our butler did it all for us when we first arrived but if we had to remember to do it every night I would have been high annoyed.  I am on vacation I don’t want to have to think about making a reservation when I wake up in the morning. Especially when there is no one in the restaurants.  

Some positive comments: 
1. Grounds and pools are beautiful.  I mean the main pool is so amazing and the bartender Luis is about the only friendly person on the resort.  
2. The food was actually pretty good for an all inclusive.  Vento was amazing my husband and I ate there for breakfast and lunch almost everyday and we had an amazing dinner there one night.  Passion and Bana were also very good.  The buffet is horrible and schevey.  It looks like the food as been sitting out there all day.  And Gabi beach the restaurant you have to pay for to eat there (we didn’t thankfully b/c we were in the Royal Service) was horrible.  I mean so gross I couldn’t eat one bite of my dish.  
3. They had very good entertainment every night we were there and they also had great activities during the day.  My husband and I took a sushi making class and he took a cigar making class.  There also were dance classes.  It was very nice and broke up the day a little.  

All in all we made the best of our vacation and we relaxed which was what I wanted to do.  I can say I will probably never go back to Dominican Republic again but I would try another Paradisus resort.  Maybe Costa Rica will be next. Honestly, I would rather go to Anguilla which is a beautiful island with amazing food and wonderful friendly people.  If you do not speak Spanish this is not a good place to go.

reviews.author: FortyLuv
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but service and food quality need improvement.
reviews.text:
We just returned 8/7/10 from a weeks stay at Paradisus Palma Real.  The architecture and grounds are quite lovely.  Rooms are nice too.  We had no problems with theft but did not bring jewelry with us and anything of value was locked in the safe when we were out of the room.  Same goes for around the pool and beach - you can't leave valuables on your chairs - no ipods, kindles, money, etc. - theft can happen anywhere so I can't blame the resort if it were to happen.  You are visiting a poor country.  Leave the expensive watches, jewelry at home.  

Ok - let's discuss service.  Service was not the best.  I would have to ask 2, 3, 4 times for water at breakfast - same goes for tea.  Same at lunch.  I would start calling for washclothes in the morning  so we could scrub the sunscreen off.  It would take two more calls and by 5:30 the wash clothes would finally arrive.  Why not provide them with the hand and bath towels?  More training was needed for the service staff.  As far as tipping goes, we paid alot for two suites and it was an all-inclusive.  Tipping shouldn't be necessary for decent service.  Rewarding really good service with a tip was appropriate at times. We had the best service from a fellow by the name of Ezkeial at the Agua restaurant on the Reserve.  He should be in charge of training more of the service staff.

Don't waste your money on an ocean view room - there is no view.  Also - think twice about the Reserve - it's way too far from the beach   They do push people to stay there but all you have is a pool.  The beach is no bargain as it is quite weedy.  Don't think about walking on the beach past the resort property - you will be bombarded by the local merchants and hair braiders and they don't  stop pestering you.  The huts are nice to lay in the shade.  The pool is nice too - always clean but on the deep side.  

OK - let's talk about the restaurant reservation policy.  You must make all you reservations for each night when you get there or you will not be allowed into the restaurants even if they look half full.  8:15 is a nice time but every night?  No reservations - you will be eating at the buffet.  Food is marginal.  We did have a decent dinner at the tereyaki grill, Gabi Beach (good service there) and Agua.  The Gabi on the Reserve was really warm the night we ate there - we were sweating profusely - no air.  Mushy grilled lobster too.  Asked for French martini and got some sweet mago concoction with an olive in it - yuk!  Skip the dinner show - food not good and no air.  Skip the Market Grill too on Friday night - not so good.  Best bar is in the lobby - the  bartender made the best mojito and did a great job.  The tacky shopping setup on the square with men pestering you to buy the junk was a bit much too.  They did it two night while we were stayiing there - best to avoid the high priced junk.

We did the 2 hr sunset horseback ride - fun.  It was a bit disconcerting to see a guy on horseback with a gun strapped to his thigh and the guy sitting in the hut with the gun in his waistband.  They were both there to insure our safety.  Make no mistake - Punta Cana must have it's share of crime.  Also - watch for the guy who rides up and down the beach on  his motorcycle with a gun in his waistband.  

One more thing, don't buy the Mamawana bottle of sticks that you add your own wine, honey and rum too.  It will be confiscated at the airport by the agriculture people.  Strangely enough, you can buy the same thing from the shop inside the airport.  Go figure.  

Will we go back to Punta Cana - no - once was enough.  If I had to stay there - Paradisus Palma Real is the place to stay but don't expect a five star resort.  We made the best of it and had a nice time with our daughters.

reviews.author: Babeejag
reviews.title: I was really disappointed
reviews.text:
Just returned from the Paradisus Palma Real (7-12-10 thru 7-19-10).  Let me begin this by saying we had been there 4 years ago and had always dreamed of going back.  The place was brand new, and totally mesmerized my family.  So much so that this was for my daughters destination wedding.  The wedding itself was beautiful.  The problem that we had found that 4 years in hotel life is a long time,a lot of wear and tear .  We stayed again in Royal Service, and was disappointed.  The rooms have lost that luxurious feel, they look kind of beat up.  The Royal Service exclusive beach is a joke anyone can go and they do.  There used to be an attendant with a clipboard to check, no more.  The pools need to be done they show much wear, the air conditioning is practically non existing in the restaurants, pretty hard to eat while dressed and very hot.  What is up with that?  It seems the pumped all the money into the Reserve very beautiful but not beachfront.  The grill used to be a treat, now it looks like a bad cafeteria(not too clean) hard to eat food that is not looking to good.  This place is not cheap by anymeans and I would not write it off, if they would change a few important things that people expect when going to at least a 4.5 star place.  First clean up rooms and bring back the luxury feel. Second clean up the grill, bring back the feel of eating really good food (sanitary and appealing).
Third when staying in Royal Service make them feel special and exclusive.  Not let anyone wonder on the beach we paid extra for the priveledge and privacy.

reviews.author: Lyns007
reviews.title: Would Not Go Back!!!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the reserve and the rooms were very nice and the grounds were always keep nice and clean. This is the only good thing I can say about this hotel. There is only three resturants on the reserve side of the hotel so you have to walk or take a golf cart. The walk is about 10 min. and we found that this sometimes was quicker than waiting for the golf cart. Every time we went to the beach their were so many people trying to sell us things. They are trying to get you different activities for cheaper than what it will cost you if you did this with the hotel. We went with the hotel because we did not trust the local people. The food was very bad. This is ny secound time at an all inclusive hotel and both time the food to me was not good enough to eat. The was also a problem with staff members trying to sell us timeshares which we did not want but no matter how many times we said know they would still try and push for a sell. We are on vacation and did not want people asking us to purchase thang we did not want. The last problem was they at check in they tried to put a hold on my credit card for $550.00 for a $12.00 internetn cord without tell me she was dung it for that high amount.

reviews.author: edennis01
reviews.title: Nice but some bad service
reviews.text: Hotel was clean and I am a bit dirt phobic. The food was pretty good although not what we would have at a 5 star in dc but good overall. The Front Desk Supervisor Vera was very nice but our Concierge was Nasty after we told him we would not be interested in the time share information session. Also, they messed up our dinner reservations after it took several times for us to get through to make the reservations...we showed up for our reservation and the hotess told us in an unapologetic way that we were not on the list.

reviews.author: Tito-Paradise
reviews.title: Buffet needs improvement...
reviews.text: Althou the hotel is beatiful , if you take in to consideration the price you are paying , the buffet should be more  paltable , with more variety and excellense. You have to wait in line if you want to have a sacamble egg ,or if you go to ask for a steak their are all gone with nobody around to help you. Certainly that area needs lot of improvement.

reviews.author: Back_Bay_Dog
reviews.title: Royal Service is not exactly Royal.
reviews.text:
Do not bother with Royal Service.  You pretty much get the same crappy service whether you pay for Royal Service or not.  If you go to the Royal Service lounge to attempt to address the poor service issues...they sit there with a blank look on their face and nothing is done to correct it.  
We had stayed at the Paradisus Punt Cana a couple of years ago and it was excellent. The Palma Real resort is not even close to the service level of Paradisus Punta Cana.
The list of complaints is too long to type here.  
Simply put, the Royal Service is not a value.
One note, the week we were there, the air conditioning in the breakfast buffet area was not on.  Normally they have automatic sliding doors and the inside (where the chefs prepare omlets etc. ) is air conditioned.  It was not working or on, so as a result it was like 105 degrees in there and the poor chefs were sweating on the food - kinda gross. Not their fault - the management seems lacking - never once did you ever see a manager check with any guests on how things were going. I supose they were afraid of the answer!

reviews.author: Alli4847
reviews.title: Don't go without Royal Service
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that I am still at the resort right now.  Be careful reading these reviews - the ones who raved were all ones with the Royal Service.  We have traveled all over the Caribbean and Mexico and have stayed in numerous resorts.  I can honestly say that this is the most beautiful resort we've been to.  They have everything you can imagine and the staff works 24 hours a day to keep it beautiful.  .

The hotel was extremely accommodating when our flight was cancelled and we had to change our reservation.  Upon arrival, we were greeted by our "concierge" who told us he would take care of our dinner reservations.  However, when we told him that we could not promise the 9 am meeting (we have a 10 month old), we never heard from him again and we never got the gabi beach dinner he promised.

The first night, we accepted that we had to eat at 6:45 because we had just arrived.  Like everyone else said, the restaurants were extremely empty and they clearly catered to the royal service guests because each night, the only reservations available were 6:45 and 9.  The second night we also had reservations at 6:45.  However, when returning to our room at 5:30, the cleaners were there and didn't leave until 6.  When I explained this to the concierge, the reservations were miraculously changed to 7:15.  By then, we figured out that you could make reservations 2 days in advance so we went on wed am to get reservations for 7:30 (our preferred time) on friday.  Friday morning we went to double-check the reservation since we didn't trust anyone, and, no surprise, they had been changed to 6.

The facility was clean and the staff were extremely friendly; particularly with our son.  They all loved him and even went out of their way to learn his name.  What was disturbing was that the groundskeepers, people who cleaned the pool, and the wait staff were the nicest and most helpful.  The "higher up" you went (concierge, manager), the service plummeted.  What a shame!

Bottom line - if you can afford it, come with the royal service.  Otherwise, stick with the

reviews.author: Frelys
reviews.title: Dommage
reviews.text:
Nous sommes actuellent au Paradisius " la Reserve " service conciergerie jusqu'au 23 Avril avec ma famma et mon fils
le cadre et les chambres sont magnifiques avec une balneo et un jacuzzi dans notre jardin privé.le service conciergerie presque parfait et sommes tres bien servis. Rien à redire sur l'hotelerie.
Le gros bémol vient de la restauration qui est vraiement indigne d'un hotel de cet categorie.Tres peu de choix dans les plats,à la limite de la fraicheur,carte jamais renouvelée...Les restaurants à themes sont d'une sinistroce....
De plus une tres mauvaise organisation dans les navettes,avons atttendus souvent 15m pour aller à la plage ou pour rentrer de l'hotel à la reserve.Mais le comble est si vous voulez allez à l'entrée de l'hotel pour aller au centre commercial ou à l'autre hotel qui appartient au meme groupe,vous devez prendre un taxi....nul
Le deuxieme jour ,nous avond deposé notre fil de 7 ans au kids club, en le recuperant vers 17h ,il nous a dit etre rester toute la journée devant la tv et les jeux video et qu"il avait vomi,le responsable nous avait maintenu que tout c'etait bien passé.Le soir vers 20h il a était de nouveau malade....Depuis il n'est jamais retouné.

En résumé : un hotel superbe mais dommage pas à la hauteur coté restauration
la direction de l hotel à deja répondu à un internaute sur ce sujet, mais helas n'a fait aucun effort malgré ses dires....   dommage cela pourrait etre un complexe fantastique

reviews.author: EyedocNewJersey
reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.text: Our family spent Easter week at Paradisus Palma Real.. The hotel is beautiful, the suite was spacious.  The beach was great for walking but the sea was filled with seaweed making it impossible to swim.  Because the hotel was full, we had problems getting lounges at the beach and pool.  Reluctantly, we set our alarm to get up at 6:30 am to secure a spot for the day.  Reservations for dinner were difficult to get since we could only make the reservation one day in advance.  No matter when I called, 9:00 was the earliest time many nights.  The buffet was our only other choice and the food was mediocre at best.  Activities were very expensive.  Fortunately, the weather was great.  Next vacation we will go back to Aruba.

reviews.author: Redstorm54
reviews.title: Not as good as it used to be
reviews.text: Last year my husband and stepdaughter stayed at the Reserve in February 2009.  The resort was amazing.  This year we visited for Easter break and I don't believe the hotel staff was prepared for a very busy week.  We arrived to be told the Reserve room we booked was not available since the hotel was overbooked.  After spending over an hour talking with the front desk a room miracleously opened up.  The waits at the front desk this week for even change were unbearable.  They had a problem with their key system so we were given i kid you know at least  6 keys that did not work within a one day span.  The grounds and facility are still stunning but the service went downhill.  It takes hours before someone comes by the beach or pool to ask if you want a drink.  The service was very disappointing.  Not sure I will be back.

reviews.author: cheenay
reviews.title: 5 Start Hotel but 2 Star Service
reviews.text: When I first checked into the Paradisus Palma Real, I was very excited to stay there.  The grounds were amazing and clean.  After the first night, my bf and I were approached by the security guards and escorted to the front desk like criminals.  It turns out that the front desk did not give us our all-inclusive bracelets.  I assumed that their establishment did not require guests to wear bracelets.  After that embarrassment, they front desk did and said very little to apologize for their mistake.  In the room, the lights had a mind of their own.  Not sure why, but the lights in the room would not turn on/off when we click the switches.  Most times we would have to brush our teeth or go to the bathroom in the dark.  Also there are 5 great restaurants in the place, neither of which we were able to make reservations for because the reservation area did not pick up the phone.  I had to go down the front desk and concierge, hoping they would help me.  No one would.  My bf and I just ended up eating at the same greasy buffet everyday, breakfast, lunch and dinner.  For the amount of money paid at this resort, I expected the service and amenities to be excellent, but it was not.  I would stay here again, but only because i was told it was the best one in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: c0reyann
reviews.title: Loved the views, hated the food
reviews.text:
I somewhat wish that I had read up on the reviews for this resort before traveling here for business (photographer for a wedding at the resort) but in a way I'm glad that I didn't because I didn't go in with any preconceived ideas of what it would be like.  

Check In:  
Check in was pretty easy, we were able to get a room right away, but there were a lot of people lounging in the lobby and it was easy to tell that they had been waiting a long time.  There was definitely some issues with the language barrier as neither of us spoke a whit of Spanish.  

Room:
Since we were there for work (and the room was paid for by the bride and groom) we had the cheapest room on the resort.  It was laid out in the typical hotel room standard with island flare.  The room was cool and we had no issues at all with air conditioning - but we heard from others in the group that wasn't always the case in the rooms.  Also I have to make note of the bathrooms - there are just some wooden blinds with lots of open spaces between the bathroom and the rest of the room.  You can see and hear EVERYTHING that goes on in there - if you are remotely shy, it may be a disaster for you!  

Service:
While we had to ask for some beverages at mealtimes a few times, I never was bothered by it.  There was definitely a language barrier at times but nothing that ever completely frustrated me.  While we only had one day to enjoy the beach/pool, I wasn't bothered by the fact that there wasn't waiters wandering around getting me drinks - I was fine going to the bar myself for it. Housekeeping was efficient and the only thing that annoyed me with them is that they would show up early - often at 8AM or so - for service in the morning.  Room service was always quick- 30 minutes or so - and accurate. 

Food & Drink:
Here's where my beef is, the food was TERRIBLE in my opinion.  By far the best meal of the stay was the reception food at the wedding.  Since we didn't have Royal Service, VIP, Vacation Club or any of the other special services, we were stuck with eating at Naos for most of our meals and to say the food was lacking there is being generous.  I never thought of myself as an overly picky eater until this trip.  We were able to get one reservation for the trip at Vento and while some of the food was good, the filet was awful.  Very tough and overcooked.  They also didn't bring out a steak knife and cutting that tough meat with a butter knife was a joke.  The Market Grill was never open so we weren't able to try that as a secondary option.  Room service was okay - better than the buffet for sure.  Just overall though it was hard for me to find food I liked and enjoyed (I don't like seafood).  I hear that the food for the more elite services (Reserver, VIP, Royal Service) was better though.  I heard later that there were a few people who got sick in the wedding group from one of the restaurants.  The drinks were good and weren't hard to find - the lounge bar was probably one of the better ones to hit up for a drink compared to the others. 

Resort:
The resort is beautiful.  Perfect landscaping, beautiful pools and stunning beaches.  It really was a visual paradise.  Definitely one of the nicest pools that I've been to - and remember, I was in the normal pools.  The fancier service pools looked even nicer.  The beach area was nice and our first day there we didn't know any better and ended up in the Royal Service area of the beach on one of the mattresses and weren't kicked off.  I have to say, those are really really nice!!!  The one day that we had to enjoy the resort I do have to say it wasn't easy finding a chair but it wasn't impossible.  

Wedding:
I can't review the wedding from a guest or bridal party viewpoint but from a vendor viewpoint the wedding was perfect.  The ceremony location on the beach was stunning and by far one of the most beautiful locations I've seen on the beach (right between two palm trees).  The reception was set up on Gabi Beach and was also beautiful and perfect for a destination wedding.  The food was really good - the best meal of the trip for me.  A lot of why the wedding was so amazing was because the couple were simply amazing but the resort did set the frame for a perfect day.  

Overall it wasn't a BAD experience, but just wasn't one I came home raving about.  If hired again to go there, I would in a heartbeat and wouldn't be upset about it but I can't say that it is a place that I would choose to return to for a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: zkmd
reviews.title: what a 5 star hotel would be like if the DMV ran food services.
reviews.text:
the hotel is beautiful;.  great pools for kids, nice beach and very kid frindly.
but the service is a joke.  they never bring you coffee/juice/water for breakfast.  you have to ask like 3-5 times.  and they smile whenever you ask but take forever to bring it.

its a little like the DMV running food services at a 5 star hotel.  occasionally you would find one good guy. essentially, no one there cares about service.
 
if you are going beacuse you want to sit  by the water and have them bring you drink and watch the kids play or whatever, forget it.  dont go...
you will have to get up for every drink.   if you are going because you just want free drinks and dont mind getting up and going to the bar and maybe having to ask 2 times for the same drink, then its perfect.  since its all inclusive, you dont carry money so its nice from that perspective

room service was hysterical/
they would bring the wrong order and forget utensils.  they would come back 30 min later  with utensils.

check in was at 3pm 
our suite wasnt avilable until 430pm.  there were at least 4 other families in the same situation, all upset.  they kept asking us what we wanted for dinner and we kept saying we just want our room.  they would smile and ask if we like steak.....it was a weird twilight zone like DMV in the carribean.  when we finally got the room it was nice.

reviews.author: 24frets
reviews.title: Beautiful Property, But NO Service...Beware
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Reserve with 6,13,16 year old, Great pools, clean property, beautiful resort (Reserve) absolutely NO service in any outlet. The management is fully aware of how inefficient it is too. Menus need complete revamping. Can't get any local fish, poolside restaurant serves pork chops and steaks for lunch? No light fare to be had. Poorly trained cooks, frozen food galore, excess salt on everything. Luckily the spirits are top shelf.
If you don't speak the language, don't go. Staff is poorly trained (if at all).
VERY expensive, much better service and sense of urgency at the Riviera Maya property.

reviews.author: robandlil
reviews.title: Great if you don't pay too much
reviews.text:
We just got back from one week at the Paradisus Palma Real.  We got a real bargain thru Bestresorts4less on e-bay.  So we had to sit thru a time share presentation.  Basically they just charged us for the all inclusive fee as if we were time share people.  Stupidly we upgraded at check in to "VIP" service for an additional $600.  At less then $1400 for a week this place is wonderful.  At $2000 we were a little annoyed now and then.  Had we paid $4000 for the room as some did, we'd be furious.

On the plus side - A beautiful beach, a clean comfortable room and bed, a great buffet breakfast,  a great lunch a Gabi Beach, great drinks, very sweet staff who want to be helpful, and  respectful time share people who took our "no thanks" gracefully.  Also free internet in the VIP lounge.

On the negative side-The towel game is played big time.  I suggest you get to the beach by 8am to put down towels and books.  Better yet, make friends with a beach waiter and tip him $5 a day to save the chairs you want.   In general the ala carte restaurants were awful.  Gabi Club served my husband raw chicken.  In Market Grill the chicken was so overcooked, it was as if it had been cooked and reheated all week before it was served to me.  In Aqua the ambiance is great and the food is terrible so we went to the buffet to eat afterward.  Friends who had been here last year told us they had lobster everyday in different restaurants.   This is no longer available.  Lobster is only available on the buffet on Friday or in Gabi Beach restaurant.   (P.S. it was terribly overcooked as is most of the food)   I think they make it ahead and reheat it as ordered.

Like I said above at $1400 for the week, I'm happy just eating at the buffet and would recommend trying Vento, Passion, and the Teppanyaki restaurant.  These three were OK as a change of pace.  If you can get yourself into the Gabi Beach restaurant - it's the best they have but you have to jump thru hoops to get in.  Gabi Beach restaurant is often open for lunch and it was ala carte and wonderful (like a real restaurant).

We upgraded for an extra $600 to have full access to the private beach and all the restaurants.  Turned out this was [--] as we were kicked out of Vento for the ala carte breakfast and lunch and we were kicked out of the Royal Service Beach.  Vento and RS beach are only for  "royal service" guests - gold bracelets.  With the upgrade we had black bracelets.  We were originally supposed to have white bracelets, which is the lowest level.

So with our black bracelets, we still had to beg and tip the concierges to get us in to all the ala carte restaurants at a decent time.  And they came thru for us, we ate everywhere which turned out to be unfortunate.  And then we saw people with white bracelets eating in the same places!
Also with our black bracelets we had access to the Family Concierge beach and Gabi Beach.  And you guessed it there were plenty of white bracelets there also.  So we felt like suckers upgrading for no reason.  The family concierge beach has cushions on the chairs and was quite nice.

The only thing wrong with the room is the pillow.  Pillow menu is [--], I asked and was told it didn't exist.    Also, if you ask your concierge they will arrange a bubble bath with rose petals for you.  But set the time for an hour to an hour and a half before you really want it.  They make the water so hot that you can scald yourself.
The room is sometimes cleaned early sometimes late.  Sometimes you get turn down service and sometimes you don't.  Language was a bit of a barrier, you don't always get what you ask for.  I asked for a Decaf Capacino and got a demitase.  but in general you can get a capacino or any kind of drink any time.

The golf is "free" but costs $100 cart fee for 2 people.  Book ahead on line to get the tee time you want.

So in conclusion, if you get a great buy - go and enjoy what you can, there's a lot to like.  but if you're thinking of spending a lot, choose a Hyatt or Four Seasons.

reviews.author: leemubai
reviews.title: ven en invierno, nunca en verano
reviews.text:
lo primero que tienes que saber es que hay dos hoteles. el normal y la reseve. hablare del normal aunque conozco la reseve, bueno: la gente es fantástica, la playa muy bonita, el hall del hotel es agradable y la comida esta muy bien para un todo incluido. yo doy propinas de vez en cuando y la gente ha sido amable cuando las ha recibido y cuando no. 
mal: las habitaciones tienen humedad, los mosquitos son mortales, el wifi es gratis en el
lobby aunque me lo intentaron cobrar y en verano con el hotel lleno necesitas un mayordomo si quieres no pelearte.
lo peor: estoy harto de que cada vez que voy a un Melia me intente vender el club de vacaciones. en un hotel con el sello leading hotel of the word (conozco muchos) no pueden acosarte con el club de vacaciones. SOLO es un hotel leading 'la reserve', que es una parte del hotel no cercana a la playa y que esta muy bien, aunque vacía por su alto precio. conclusión: vente en invierno al calorcito con poca gente y buen servicio. ah, esto desde el hall del hotel, el ascensor se estropeo hace 6 días y me voy sin que nadie lo arregle. el gim muy pequeño aunque hay sala de pilates fuera.
ni bueno ni malo solo para que se sepa: extender el check out de las 12.00 a las 18.00 son 92 dólares por persona.

reviews.author: VinceEurope
reviews.title: Very nice hotel but very poor service
reviews.text:
The hotel in general is very nice, the beach and the pool are very relaxing. The room and the bathroom are in line with 4* hotels.
However, the service is very poor:
- you need to book every activity in advance (golf, restaurant, diving, horse riding, etc.), sign several vouchers and do not forget to them with you (otherwise you cannot do the activity even the reservation desk keeps a copy of the vouchers). People at the reservation desk do not help and do not provide any advice neither. As you cannot book activities more than 24 hours in advance, you have to go back to the reservation every day and spend sometimes more than 30-45 minutes to book the activities and restaurants of the day.
- we booked a horse riding trip. We mist the shuttle which left the hotel 10 minutes in advance.
- we could not book a restaurant. In the evening we realised that many tables were empty
- it will take you up to 30 minutes to start your golf because of the cumbersome procedures at the proshop
- the diving centre will not bring you to the best spot, it would take them more 30 minutes to get there. Too long, not profitable.
- etc.
My wife and I travelled a lot across the world. The service of this hotel is the worst we have experienced. Hence I do not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: STEPHANIE8657
reviews.title: The Place does not deserve 5 Stars... maybe 3
reviews.text: The beach and pool are fantastic. BUT it took us 3 hours and a bride to check in to our rooms. We had 12 total people and each one got sick on the food.  Having to use bottled water to brush your teeth is not a 5 star hotel.  Anyone that depends on tips was very pleasant - the rest of the staff was arrogant. I would recommend the Dominician Rebublic to anyone --- just not this place.

reviews.author: michaelaurasmom
reviews.title: Beautiful resort & beach, but not up to "Leading Hotels of the World" stature
reviews.text: This is a gorgeous resort, but they are behind on service, particularly with it's 5 star rating.  Punta Cana itself is a beautiful place, but one should not have to brush their teeth with bottled water in this day and age.   We paid for the "Royal Service" which entitles you to a butler, whom I never met in the 6 nights we were there.  Food is adequate.  This place has great potential, but not there yet.

reviews.author: viajero17panama
reviews.title: no tienen capacidad para administrar algo tan grande
reviews.text:
viaje con mi familia en un grupo de 19 invitados por mis padres para pasar este fin de ano, desde el 30 de Diciembre al 5 de Enero,invitados por mis Padres quienes habian viajado en noviembre pasado y por un acoso diario de los vendedores del hotel compraron un paquete de su vacation club, supuestamente podrian tener muchos beneficios que finalmente al momento de pedirlos ninguno se podia porque si leias las letras chiquitas decian otra cosa. Muy mal que se aprovechen de personas mayores ofreciendo algo totalmente distinto a lo que es, luego de reclamos y hablar practicamente con todos en el hotel nos dijjeron que iban a analizar y antes de irnos nos daban respuesta, por supuesto nos fuimos y nunca nos llamaron. el inicio fue lo peor, habiamos hecho reservacion y confirmado para que el hotel nos buscara al aeropuerto de Santo Domingo en horas de madrugada (repito confirmado por el hotel que nos buscarian)cuando llegaba nuestro avion y sorpresa, nadie nos busco y nisiquiera nos pidieron perdon, cuando llamamos al hotel nadie sabia nada y simplemente nos dijeron hagan lo que puedan que nosotros ahora no podemos hacer nada, para los que no saben el hotel esta a mas de 200 Km del aeropuerto. Tuvimos que viajar en 5 taxis en mal estado en horas de la madrugada por carreteras en construccion y choferes a alta velocidad, tomemos en cuenta que viajabamos 9 adultos y 10 ninos entre 2 y 17 anos todos distribuidos en losa autos como fuera. fue una experiencia pavorosa para todos. luego las reservas de restaurantes que supuestamente estaban confirmadas nunca estuvieron, a la hora de comer era una pelea diaria pidiendo la mesa de 19 personas que nos habian prometido para comer en familia todos juntos incluyendo la cena de ano nuevo, querian sentarnis separados porque segun ellos se habian equivocado (otra vez). Los cuartos que eran 5 unidades , habian 3 que le faltaban cortinas en los cuartos y a primera luz del sol todos arriba porque no se podia seguir durmiendo con el sol en el rostro, la mayoria de las veces no habia agua caliente . A la hora de comida las bebidas llegaban cuando ya habias terminado, ni hablar de los mosquitos al atardecer, lleve su repelente de mosquitos. el dia 2 de enero estuvimos sin agua en la habitacion desde las 5 de la tarde hasta media noche. Pero hay que darle credito al personal de servicio, la verdad gente con muchas ganas de complacerte y siempre con una sonrisa y ganas de ayudarte, no se puede decir lo mismo que los del vacation club, para mi una estafa.
por este precio hay mejores lugares que ir en el resto del mundo y con la mismas facilidades de playa y piscinas y la belleza natural. No se les ocurra contratar los servicio de las actividades acuaticas, todas un desastre, no cumplen horarios, equipos deteriorados, no hay proteccion a los corales y la vida marina, los supuestos servicios gratis de actividades acuaticas del hotel windsurf y otras, son practicamente imposibles, yo en lo personal reserve por 4 dias y nunca habia quien diera la clase y siempre inventaban una excusa y te decian ven en unas hora, solo para decirte no podemos, conclusi'on otro servicio ineficiente, bueno los gratis porque para cobrarte los otros si estan al dia y disponibles. Buenas instalaciones, belleza natural pero la administracion no tiene capacidad para tratar tanta gente y mucho menos del nivel que pretenden atender. Los paquetes del vacation club una gran estafa y no esperes respuesta despues de pagar, luego que tienen tu dinero jamas vuelves a ver al vendedor de tu paquete y porsupuesto todo lo que te prometio no existe,

reviews.author: marielafd
reviews.title: No se compagina el precio con el servicio.-
reviews.text:
Mi esposo, mi bebita (de 9 meses) y yo fuimos a recibir el fin de año en el hotel, la semana que correspondia del día sábado 26 de diciembre al sábado 02 de Enero.
En cuanto llegamos a la recepciópn le informamos a la chica que nuestra bebita tenia 9 meses y que por favor nos asignara una habitación que tuviese fácil acceso porque teniamos un cochecito para trasladarla. Despues que nos hizo esperar más de 1 hora sentados nos llega con las llaves de la habitación y nos dice que no nos pudo conseguir nada y que no nos preocuparamos que siempre contariamos con una persona para que nos ayudara a subir y bajar  el coche de la bebé.
La habitación que nos tocó estaba en el TERCER PISO del modulo 38, para ser exactos, la habitación nro. 3834 donde no existe ascensor y donde TAMPOCO nunca habia nadie que me pudiera ayudar a subir y bajar el coche. Hicimos el reclamo en varias oportunidades y NUNCA obtuvimos respuesta.
Cuando llegamos a la habitación 3834 (despues de subir el coche entre mi esposo y yo) revisamos la habitación y nos encontramos con lo siguiente:
- El bombillo de la lámpara de la ducha no funcionaba.
- El bombillo de una de las lámparas de la mesa de noche de la cama tampoco funcionaba.
- La caja fuerte de la habitación nunca funcionó.
- Los controles remotos de los dos (02) televisores que tiene la habitación NUNCA nos lo dieron.
Despues de hacer los respectivos reclamos durante varios dias, lo único que hicieron es cambiar los bombillos de las lámparas que estaban quemadas. La caja fuerte nunca la revisaron y por supuesto los controles de los televisores nunca nos lo dieron.

Aunado a todo esto el techo de la habitación tiene unas filtraciones que por lo desconchado de la pintura tiene BASTANTE TIEMPO ASI... Las puertas de madera de la habitación se encuentran  deterioradas y sucias. Igualmente la limpieza no es precisamente su fuerte. Estuvo toda la semana una especie de plástico (que asumo seria de otro huesped)  detrás de una silla  lo que corrobora que no mueven los muebles para barrer.....
La comida de los restaurantes es aceptable pero no para la categoria que dice ser el hotel....
Aunque no puedo dejar de mencionar la cordialidad de los muchachos que trabajan en el hotel, siempre muy simpaticos y bien dispuestos. Las areas comunes del hotel siempre estan muy limpias. Los jardines impecables.....

Lamentablemente el precio del hotel no se compagina con el servicio que dan. Si la persona quiere unas vacaciones de lujo no lo recomendaria.

reviews.author: Janet P
reviews.title: Way over-rated!!!!!!
reviews.text: We just returned from the Paradisus Palma Real.  To say the least, we were very disappointed.  First of all our room was an ocean front suite in the Royal Service area.  That was a  joke.  The room was your typical hotel room, with no special ammenities.  The only thing special about this room was the horrendous smell of mildew and mold, covered up by lemon pine sol.  I didn't wear half the clothes I brought, but everything had to be washed because they smelled soooooo bad.   I still can't get the smell out of my hair.   The Royal Service is nothing special.  We saw our buttler maybe twice all week.  The only thing she did was make our dinner reservations, and half the time they were wrong.   The Royal Service pool is very small and not enough chairs for people to lounge on.  The main pool was much more comfortable.  Although you couldn't  get a drink unless you went to the bar yourself.   The place was maybe 50% occupied so it wasn't because they were so busy that the customer service suffered.   The buffet was horrible.  I am not a picky eater, but some of the food was unedible.  The restaurant food was much better.  It was a major ordeal to get a bucket of ice or a diet soda.  I'm still waiting on my 7 up lite.  Ha Ha.  This was my 50th birthday, and wanted something really special.  We spent twice as much on this trip as usual, and what a disappointment.  Managment at this facility has its work cut out for them.   I read every review about this place and just thought that the people who wrote bad reviews were just being overly picky.  Well,  they were right on.   If you are booked at this resort, i would highly consider changing to another.   As I said this place is Way over-rated.

reviews.author: Paul-Hartsdale
reviews.title: Staff and Management not equipped to assist and accomodate in event of crisis.
reviews.text:
In July, stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana with my wife and 10 month old son, attending a destination wedding. When we checked in, we requested a crib be brought to our room. The crib did not arrive until the next day when we were not in the room. When we arrived at the room that evening, we put our son in the crib as my wife and I got ready for evening dinner with the bride, groom, and other wedding guests; dinner was held off the resort. About 5 minutes later, as my son stood leaning against the side panel of the crib, the entire side panel gave way, and both my son and the panel crashed to the floor. My son was crying hysterically. I rushed to the front desk for help. Front desk did not have authorization to help; they sent me to the concierge. concierge could not get a manager or assistant manager immediately. They tranferred us to another room, which was filthy. We complained, but no one arrived. We contacted the bride, who had her resort contact assist us. We were moved to another room again. My wife left items in the original room, so I tried to call the front desk to ask if someone can retrieve the items for us. The phone wasn't working. My sister-in-law was with us. She walked all the way to the front desk, which was a hike, but the front desk refused to allow her to enter our original room. She walked all the way back, and then I walked to the front desk and they walked me over to the original room. At this point, it was a few hours later. Needless to say, we missed the dinner with the bride, groom, and other guests. Soooo, we tried to make a reservation to one of the restaurants on the property, but we were denied by the concierge. They said all the restaurants were booked. We explained the circumstances, and they still gave us a hard time. They finally got us into one of the restaurants, which was practically EMPTY for the entire time that we were there!!!

The next day, we finally saw an assistance manager (Roci), who was very nice and tried to help. She assured us that (1) the crib will no longer be used, and (2) she will investigate the incident and speak to me further. 

OK, enough with the meetings, I'll deal with it when I get back home.

Contacted FRANK PEETERS, who is the Resident Manager. EXTREMELY RUDE, AND INSISTED THAT THERE WAS NOTHING THAT THE RESORT COULD HAVE DONE DIFFERENTLY. MR. FRANK PEETERS DID NOT SHOW ANY SYMPATHY FOR MY SON FALLING OUR OF THE CRIB AND ONTO THE FLOOR ON TOP OF THE CRIB'S SIDE PANEL. I asked if the crib was still in use. His reply was "YES IT IS." I think it's a shame that the crib is still in use. Mr. Peeters said he looked into the incident and would not offer me compensation for what happened. COMPENSATION??? I WAS LOOKING FOR A LITTLE COMPASSION FOR MY SON AND ASSURANCE THAT THE CRIB WOULD BE TAKEN OUT OF CIRCULATION!!! 

You should have a good time if you don't have any incidences. Otherwise, do not expect much help and accomodation.

reviews.author: Julie-et-yann
reviews.title: Très bel hotel, mais...
reviews.text:
Après être allé il y a 10 ans au Paradisus Punta Cana (Hotel situé un peu plus au nord appartenant à la même chaine hotelière), nous avons décidé de retourner en République Dominicaine cette année ; car nous avions gardé énormément de bons souvenirs de ce voyage.
Ainsi, voici le récit de cette deuxième expérience dominicaine, mais cette fois au Paradisus Palma Real :
- Compagnie aérienne  XL Airways : compagnie très satisfaisante, personnel à bord serviable, apéro et plateaux repas corrects, respect des horaires annoncés, mais espace entre les sièges un peu juste.
- Arrivée à l'aéroport : aéroport toujours aussi joli avec ses toits typiques. Là, des Dominicaines vous attendent en costumes "folkloriques" pour une photo pour essayer de vous la vendre au retour...mais pas le temps de flâner, elles vous font vite avancer comme du bétail... Bienvenue dans un pays devenu une destination avant tout commerciale et nonchalante !!!
Après avoir récupéré vos bagages, des porteurs vous attendent pour vous aider à les porter à l'aide d'un chariot  jusqu'à votre bus ou taxi pour le transfert. Une fois accompli ces 50 ou 60 mètres (maximum), votre porteur tend la main pour le pourboire. Nous lui avons donner 2 dollars. Il nous a regardé en nous faisant comprendre qu'ont se moquaient de lui ! ...
Après 30 minutes de transfert, nous arrivons à l'hotel.
En fait, l'hotel se situe dans un parc comprenant plusieurs hotels : le Mélia Bavaro, La Réserve et le Paradisus Palma Real. Les 3 appartiennent évidemment à la chaine Melia.
Le parc est superbe quoique un peu trop "urbanisé".
- L'hotel: Grandiose édifice décoré avec soin et mobilier contemporain. On a l'impression d'arriver dans un hotel de haut standing. Toutefois la mauvaise qualité du service et la nonchalance des Dominicains vont vite nous faire redescendre sur terre !
Ici, pas de pourboire pas de sourire !
- Les chambres : ce sont des suites ! Très grandes. Bien équipées. Le ménage dans la salle de bain n'est pas parfait. Aucune décoration de lit durant le séjour. Manque réellement d'une touche de romantisme et de bien-être. Mauvais écoulement des toilettes. Odeur de renfermé malgré le brasseur d'air et la clim.
- La restauration : buffets complets et diversifiés. Nourriture servie pas assez chaude (voire froide) que ce soit au restaurant principal ou dans les autres restaurants. "Aux heures de pointe des repas", il n'est pas toujours facile d'avoir une table rapidement. Il faut être patient pour les boissons car tout est servi au verre, et, les serveurs sont très vite débordés!
A noté qu'il faut réserver pour pouvoir dîner dans les autres restaurants. En ce qui nous concerne, un soir nous avions une réservation au restaurant Le Passion à 20 H15. Nous sommes arrivé à 20 H35. Hé bien on nous a refoulé froidement alors que le restaurant était presque vide ! Donc nous sommes allé dîner au restaurant principal...
- Les bars : faible choix de coktails même si il y a une très grande diversité d'alcool. Barmans pas très sympas et pas très rapides. Rupture de stock de feuilles de menthe pendant 4 jours, donc pas de Mojitos. tant pis !
- Piscine : gigantesque ! Propre. A bonne température.
- Plage : petite car divisée en 3 ! Hé oui, 40 % pour le Royal service, 40 % pour La Réserve et seulement 20 % pour les clients "standards" ...
- La boutique de l'hotel : choix satisfaisant mais hors de prix.
- Navette pour le centre commercial : c'est une arnaque ! elle n'est pas gratuite : 6 dollars. En fait il vous appel un taxi ! Alors que c'est seulement à 5 minutes à pied sans risques !
- Le centre commercial : boutiques comme chez nous à la mode îlienne. Tout est très très cher. Aucun intérêt !
En fait, maintenant tout est hors de prix là-bas. En 10 ans, les Dominicains ont beaucoup évolué. C'est normal et bien pour eux. Mais, en même temps ils en ont perdu le sourire, la sympathie. Ils ne pensent qu'à l'argent. Comme en Europe...
- Les activités sportives et animations en soirée : elles sont timides ! Et pas forcément bien appropriées par rapport à la clientèle de l'hotel (soirées Michael Jakson, cirque, hip-hop, techno avec gogo-danseuses ! ...)
- Les excursions : évitez l'île de Saona, les dauphins et le parc de perroquets : Attrapes touristes !
-Départ : nos valises sont restées de midi jusqu'à notre départ (18H00) dans le hall d'accueil de l'hotel, en plein soleil, au lieu d'être enfermées dans la pièce de bagagerie.
Pas d'au revoir de la part des employés de réception. Aucun geste humain... Très déçu !
Peut-être fallait-il laisser un pourboire pour avoir un petit signe de la main en guise d'au revoir ! ...
Conclusion : Très bel hotel mais destination et pouplation devenues décevantes. N'y retournerons pas de si tôt. Il ya bien d'autres lieux dans le monde où nous n'avons pas besoin de payer continuellement pour être bien servi, respecté et bien accueilli !

Remarque très importante à l'encontre de la chaine Melia : 
Durant notre séjour, notre majordome, ainsi que d'autres majordomes responsables d'autres chambres, n'ont pas arrêté successivement de nous pousser à avoir un entretien avec un conseiller financier du groupe Mélia afin d'investir dans leur partenariat de vacances. Ceci était très désagréable car ils nous guettaient dès le petit déjeuner pour nous convaincre. Ce qui donnait l'impression de n'être plus des touristes mais des "proies financières". Allant jusqu'à vous offrir un dîner dans le restaurant Gabi Beach juste à coté dédié aux clients de La Réserve...Certainement qu'ils devaient beaucoup avoir à y gagner...
Une telle pression au quotidien n'a rien à faire dans un complexe hotelier où les clients paient suffisamment cher pour profiter de leur séjour !!! 
Donc maintenant pour nous : Melia ! Non merci !!!

reviews.author: atlanta96
reviews.title: Décor 5 étoiles pour une service 2 étoiles - Pas prêt pour les européens
reviews.text:
Cet hotel est magnifique, spacieux et les vues sur la mer et la plage sont somptueuses.  Les chambres sont grandes et très bien entretenues. La grande piscine centrale est incroyable : on se croit très vite au paradis.
Le buffet est délicieux, fourni et les serveurs très sympathiques. C'est d'ailleurs le cas dans tous les restaurants du resort. 
Nous avions choisi le RoyalService qui met à votre disposition pour la durée de notre séjour un concierge sensé satisfaire à toutes nos petites demandes. Et là, ça se gate :  
Le service est pompeux mais inefficace. Les concierges sont élevés à l'américaine, c'est à  dire qu'ils s'attendent à recevoir un pourboire dès qu'ils executent une de vos demandes ( donc c'est royal service all inclusive excepté le concierge !!!). 
C'est lui qui décide de l'heure et du restaurant ou vous mangerez le soir, pas cool ! -
-  Vous demandez un changement et là tout va de travers la résa bien que confirmée n'est pas faite quand on se présente, et pour couronner le tout on se fait gentilement remettre à sa place. 
- Ne laisser pas trainer 5 euros dans votre chambre car la femme de ménage considère que c'est un pourboire. Bien que nous ayons spécifier que ce n'était pas le cas, rien n'a été fait : c'est comme ça et puis c'est tout. 
- Une carte désactivée et c'est à vous de vous déplacer pour faire le changement
- Nous avons eu un accident de bateau et là l'hotel n'est responsable de rien (alors qu'il s'agissait d'un de ces prestataires), c'est à peine s'ils appellent un médecin, prévoir 95 dollars pour avoir un morceau de glace sur la tête au bout d'une heure. Ils n'appellent pas l'ambulance ni rien car ils ne sont responsables de rien encore une fois. bref, nous aurions pu mourir 10 fois que rien ne se serait passé. Nous avons du tout gerer nous même.
- Le jour de notre départ le concierge avait disparu
Finalement le concierge ne sert à rien à part à  déambuler avec son carnet noir autour des piscines à vous servir des How are you doing today ???? C'est le seul hôtel de punta cana à bénéficier de l'appellation "Leading of the world", mais ne vous y trompez pas le service n'est absolument pas à la hauteur. En tout cas, les critères de service sont à l'américaine, en fonction du pourboire que vous laisser vous avez un niveau de service : mais dans un all inclusive il y a un décalage. Ils ne sont pas prêt pour recevoir des européens. C'est très décevant pour un hôtel classé 5 étoiles, si le lieu les mérite le service est très très en dessous. Pour moi c'est un hôtel qui n'est pas classifié correctement et mieux vaut quelque chose de moins prétentieux avec un vrai service de qualité.

reviews.author: travbud540
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, service doesn't match the facade
reviews.text:
I originally booked the trip through an RCI timeshare deal.  I am not a part of RCI nor do I pay fees to them, but I got a decent deal through them in the "Reserve" section of the hotel.  I traveled in September, which is the off session to avoid most of the crowds.  The hotel was extremely empty and from talking to the staff they were only at 15% occupancy.  Great for lounging at the pool and scheduling in dives (free daily dive per package - great perk!) and the remote relaxation that I needed.
That being said, you would think that issues would be handled in a quick manner since there were more staff then guests within the resort....Not so much.  I figured I would just list the things that I had issue with:
- power loss through out the trip (usually only for a short period of time)
- room seemed clean, but the mens underwear under my bed would suggest other wise (as I'm a girl and I brought no men back to my room....well you do the math)
- After a heavy evening shower the ceiling began to leak pooling up in the bathroom
- Addressed the leaky roof to our concierge and she stated she would get someone to look at it, no one ever came
- Checked back with the front desk concerning the leak 3 times, still no one came (thankfully there were no more rainy nights)
- Large amounts of sea weed in the beach area (I can live with this, it's nature)
- half of the restaurants were closed due to the low season
- they push the timeshare package
- At check out the desk was unable to void the $600 deposit I had placed, it toke over half an hour to figure things out.  They ended up charging 1 cent on my card to cancel the whole transaction.

I'm all about making the best of a trip, but I can see if someone had high expectations they might be disappointed.

reviews.author: reservado
reviews.title: Do not ruin your vacations!
reviews.text:
For starting I had two times cold water on the shower.
The lack of cleanliness in the rooms and at the restaurants is not aceptable.
50% of the personnel is unfriendly. 
The beach if ful with algae. For me it's ok but for my wife it was not...
I arrive at the beach at 9AM and everytime it was full with plastic bags....

I ask for the complainments book and I was informed that they do not have it. So they send a inquiry after you left for your e-mail...

This shows bad management! 

Last year I have been at Paradisus Riviera Cancun and it was very good, so this year I went to Palma Real and it proved that didn't worth the 1700€ I spent for the 8 days.

My advice: Chosse another and you will have a better quality/price relation.

reviews.author: GlobalVilla9er
reviews.title: Great beach, Terrible Management, 3 out of 5
reviews.text: If you are a spanish speaking bachelor who is travelling solo and you oscillate from the beautiful beach to the all you can eat & drink buffet, this is a 5 star resort. Otherwise, it is just average. The most shocking let down is the bathroom, which is separated from your room by a half wall. You can look out your window at the nicely manicured lawns and turn around to see someone using the toilet (glass door on toilet). Also, you easily fill the entire room with stench on a trip to toilet. TV is good with nearly 100 channels. Internet also good speed for $12/hr, but closes when guy goes to lunch. The beach is beautiful fine white sand. Buffet is nice, but all three resort restaurants are poor. Gym is nice, but not one of three plasma TVs work or have worked in a long time. Management does not care, but employees are quite pleasant. However, they do not speak english. My obviously pregnant wife asked for a non-alcoholic beer. The waiter, with an everpresent smile, brought a lite beer. All in all 3 out of 5. Beach is great, management is bad and has no intention of improving..

reviews.author: marin_antonio19
reviews.title: No volveria.....por lo menos a una royal service
reviews.text:
Contratamos una suite royal  service de las que están enfrente del mar.

La llegada fue una pesadilla. Tuvimos que esperar hasta las 5 o 6 de la tarde y para colmo de males, cuando entramos en la suite, FALTABAN la mitad de las amenites. Las botellas de agua y el café estaban abiertos.......sin comentarios. Pensábamos que era una broma de cámara oculta, hasta que al día siguiente nos trajeron una botella de ron, también abierta.

El servicio de habitaciones de coña. Desayunar en la habitación se podía convertir casi en comer, depende del siroco que le diese al que tenía que atenderte, podía tardar dos, tres horas......

Un día echamos ropa a lavar. La sorpresa fue mayúscula cuando ví que no llegaban dos camisas. Me decían que ya llegarán.......nunca llegaron. Puse una queja a a la responsable del club royal y la poco profesional de ella no me hizo ningún caso y todavía la energúmena mirando mal, en vez de disculparse.......

Al final, por muy bonita que fuese la habitación, el mal trato recibido y lo guarro que fue el servicio de habitaciones, hizo que el lujo desmereciese.

Fantástico el mayordomo, el servicio de playa y en general, el servicio de restauración.

Absolutamente lamentable y demencial el trato recibido por la responsable del club royal. No está a la altura de ese hotel

reviews.author: Junior101
reviews.title: Decent, but not worth the money
reviews.text: We traveled to this resort christmas week through new years last year. I am a 21 yr old guy with a 25 yr old sibling and we traveled there with our parents for just over a week. The facility was seriously incredible and beautiful, and the atmosphere was spectacular. Upon arrival, you enter an open lobby facing the ocean. It is filled with many places to hang your hat and have a drink every day. Growing up in a family that has visited many countries and various fine hotels, I was a bit shocked by a few aspects of this particular vacation. After checking into both rooms, we came across various issues. First off, my brother and i were not on our honeymoon so the "see through" bathroom wasnt so great for us. The room was humid as hell and the power went out every night when getting dressed to go out. I understand the whole going green thing, but come on no one should have to get stuck in the shower in the dark!!! The nightlife was ok, if not for the casino we would have killed ourselves. The facility was spectacular at night especially, and we made our way to the beach huts after eating dinner. I am a hospitality major and have never seen such terrible food, although this is all inclusive it does not mean your paying for low quality slop. Also, all the food for each restaurant is made in one kitchen, so running from one restaurant to another within the resort is just useless. Unfortunately, the hotel is just not reaching its potential. It is not feasible to ask people to upgrade to the "royal service" and than assign them a useless butler that ends up being a inconvenience that needs to be tipped when departing. It was impossible to get a bed at the Royal pool and the upgrade was a complete waste for my parents. The staff has good intentions, however, they simply cannot communicate with the tourists and therefore makes the service awful. I do not mean to be negative, however, we all know in this day and age that the economy has declined and we all want value for our dollar, this place really doesnt give that. My last and final complaint is the food, who goes on vacation and wants bad food? My family ended up trying most of the restaurants, however, we would make our way to the buffet every night to replenish ourselves after not eating. Passion was the best restaurant in retrospect, however, at least with the buffet you know what your getting. Despite what others say, the buffet is the only way  to get by we thought. The beach is incredible and there are various gardens and places to lay out and enjoy the sun. I will also say, from a young adults point of view, the water activities are difficult to come by. My brother and I chased around some vendors on the beach and finally were able to sign up for some fun activities, however, they are extremely expensive and not all that safe. Keep in mind, beach activities are not run by the hotel. I would recommend the ATV excursion, make sure to put 7 hours aside though. Overall, the biggest problem with Paradisus is the lack of communication between everyone , both staff and guests. The all inclusive alcohol is great and there is a good bar scene. Guests are generally very friendly and actually share the same complaints with each other during the stay. I think this hotel has so much potential, i just think for now I would not recommend it!

reviews.author: Rockeymoore
reviews.title: Roman Temple in the Carribbean with Uneven Service
reviews.text: My husband and I wanted to go someplace nice to celebrate our one year wedding anniversary and picked Paradisus Palma Real. The facility and grounds were breathtaking. My husband who is a stickler for quality, gave the facility a two thumbs up. I especially loved the view of the ocean from the lobby and the artwork interspersed throughout the facility and grounds. The landscaping and flora and fauna were a delight to the eye. We particularly enjoyed a group of pink flamingos who set up their home in a pond under the main lobby. Now for the areas of improvement. Others who complain about the service are right. We found the service to be very uneven, with some gracious and attentive waiters and waitresses and some rude and unattentive waiters and waitresses. One example is that we were sitting in a cabana by the pool when the pool bar waitress/bartender came over to take our drink order. My husband ordered a diet coke and she never came back with the order. Another example, is the breakfast buffet staff: on several mornings we got wait staff whom we had to flag down to order coffee or ask for a refill of water. While the restaurant was often busy, we felt that the inattention had more to do with a lack of training and surly attitudes. Which brings us to our 5 hour time share experience. We had no intention of doing the timeshare presentation on our anniversary vacation but our "concierge" (whom we liked and felt sorry for because it was his anniversary but he was away from his wife) approached us several times (over breakfast, at lunch, etc) asking us to take advantage of the "no pressure,"  "90 minute" presentation. We finally agreed and were taken on a several hour tour of "The Reserve"--a quite fabulous secluded area of the resort that is literally reserved for timeshare owners. When we got back to the resort, we were given a heavy sales job (they were selling ownership at $72K plus $1K per year in maintenance for 50 years) by a timeshare employee. When my husband mentioned that we were told that the presentation wouldn't include a heavy sales pitch, he proceeded to push anyway. My husband finally called a time out and we walked out. The experience placed a pall over the rest of our day. The other restaurants were decent and included great wait staff. Even though it was odd and the food was just so-so, we actually enjoyed the asian-themed restaurant as they were playing American soul music. Which brings me to my last comment about the entertainment. If you don't gamble and you haven't come with friends, all you have in the evening (aside from the restaurants and yourselves) is the entertainment. We were amused and bemused to be entertained on our last night's stay by pole dancers (without the pole) who literally stood above the crowd on platforms and gyrated the night away. While it was interesting to watch for the first 10 minutes, they went on and on. We finally got up and called it a night. Overall, I would recommend the Paradisus Palma Real but I would encourage anyone going to tip up front liberally if you expect to get decent service and to avoid the timeshare presentation (but make sure to go to the spa over at the Reserve). Enjoy!

reviews.author: CRS2001
reviews.title: Work paid so that is the saving grace of this trip.
reviews.text:
First off, I will say that this place is absolutely beautiful when you get in there.  There are fountains all over, the restaurants are beautiful, and even the furniture is top notch.  The golf course was gorgeous as well and very reasonably priced.  Sound good?  Well, back up.

One of the biggest problems I had with this place was the service.  Hardly anyone speaks solid English and there is no place to exchange money other than the casino.  Then you think maybe you can go swim in the ocean and take a break.  But when you get there, there is seaweed everywhere and apparently the idea of having someone sweep it out every day has not hit this place yet.  Service at the pool bar stinks and for a place that is supposed to have areas for kids and adults respectively, it sure seemed like there were kids everywhere.  Now kids are great, but not when you leave home to get a break from them.  Oh, and no infiniti pool.

Basically, the people are either moronic or rude.  Neither of which I appreciate.  So I would recommend that if you are going to spend this kind of money on a 5 star resort, go to a Sandals in Jamaica....

reviews.author: RoadWarrior-FL
reviews.title: Nice, but wouldn't do again.
reviews.text:
I was here for three nights with a group and have to say, all of the reviews are about right.  This is a hotel with breathtaking features, a great stretch of beach, and immaculate grounds.  It also has very hit and miss service and awful food.

First thing, when you get to the airport, prepare for an onslaught of people offering to help you.  We chose a car service in advance, and if you are making your first trip, this is advisable.  Now that I know the deal, would probably just cab it, but the first time can be a little tough.

We arrived and the check-in process was smooth.  Our room, like 95% of the rooms, overlooked a garden.  We were not in the concierge area.  The room was clean, though looked worn in places  It was very humid---a theme that recurred in our room and every room in our group all three nights.  It was so humid that the sheets were damp.  We later learned that the AC turns off in the room when you leave due to motion sensors (which means it also shuts off at night when sleeping)---but if you leave your fan on, it leaves the AC on.  I had to keep it around 58-60 on the thermostat to keep it cool, due to the dampness.

The service was hit and miss.  Some people were very helpful, some where unhelpful.  We never could get room service to answer the phone and there were never towels by the pool, but we found getting drinks and other help very easy.  It is not an easy place if you don't know any Spanish, but if you can hack through a couple dozen words and phrases, you will be fine.  We also found room service hit and miss.  Sometimes our room was immaculate, sometimes they didn't even tuck in the sheets or pick up all the towels.  The amount of tip seemed to have no bearing. 

The food here was awful.  This was the biggest downfall.  The buffet was atrocious.  The running joke in our group was this place was a weight loss facility.  They could screw up the easiest things, like corn and potatoes.  We ate one night at Passion, which was decent and one at Gabi Beach, which was very good---but it comes with a bill.  One in my group compared the sushi restaurant to eating shoes.  For the price, the food should be better.

I played golf at the course across the street.  It was a nice layout, fairly challenging and well maintained.  The shuttle runs on a "schedule," unless you pay the driver (who just hangs in the parking lot) to take you the 1/4 mile back to the resort.    If you play golf, it is a fun course.  One thing- do stock up on bottled water before you start playing as there is no cart service on the course.

The pools are great.  The beach is great (there is a nice little art market down the beach) and the people mostly were great.  But the food was  inedible and the service was sketchy enough that for the price, I would not make a return visit.

reviews.author: kthorpe826
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, but high pressure time share sale!!
reviews.text:
This is one of the most beautiful hotels I have ever stayed in.  The pool, room, and entire resort were absolutely gorgeous.  The spa was amazing as well.

Food was great at Vento and Bana, and just ok at Passion and downright bad at the Japanese hibachi restaurant.

HOWEVER, what blew my mind was that we were immediately greeted by a concierge pretending to want to show us around the entire hotel, and said to contact him for dinner reservations and excursions, or anything else we may need, but really was just trying to get us to listen to a time share presentation.  When we said we weren't interested, he immediately diappeared, and never to be seen again.  He wasted at least an hour of our time upon our arrival to the hotel.
